14.translation: Their messengers said: Can there be doubt concerning Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth? He calleth you that He may forgive you your sins and reprieve you unto an appointed term. They said: Ye are but mortals like us, who would fain turn us away from what our fathers used to worship. Then bring some clear warrant

14.arabic: قالَت لَهُم رُسُلُهُم إِن نَحنُ إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُم وَلٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَمُنُّ عَلىٰ مَن يَشاءُ مِن عِبادِهِ وَما كانَ لَنا أَن نَأتِيَكُم بِسُلطٰنٍ إِلّا بِإِذنِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَليَتَوَكَّلِ المُؤمِنونَ
14.transliteration: Qalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illa basharun mithlukum walakinna Allaha yamunnu AAala man yashao min AAibadihi wama kana lana an natiyakum bisultanin illa biithni Allahi waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona
14.translation: Their messengers said unto them: We are but mortals like you, but Allah giveth grace unto whom He will of His slaves. It is not ours to bring you a warrant unless by the permission of Allah. In Allah let believers put their trust

14.arabic: وَما لَنا أَلّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَقَد هَدىٰنا سُبُلَنا وَلَنَصبِرَنَّ عَلىٰ ما ءاذَيتُمونا وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَليَتَوَكَّلِ المُتَوَكِّلونَ
14.transliteration: Wama lana alla natawakkala AAala Allahi waqad hadana subulana walanasbiranna AAala ma athaytumoona waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almutawakkiloona
14.translation: How should we not put our trust in Allah when He hath shown us our ways? We surely will endure the hurt ye do us. In Allah let the trusting put their trust

14.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لِرُسُلِهِم لَنُخرِجَنَّكُم مِن أَرضِنا أَو لَتَعودُنَّ فى مِلَّتِنا فَأَوحىٰ إِلَيهِم رَبُّهُم لَنُهلِكَنَّ الظّٰلِمينَ
14.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min ardina aw lataAAoodunna fee millatina faawha ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna alththalimeena
14.translation: And those who disbelieved said unto their messengers: Verily we will drive you out from our land, unless ye return to our religion. Then their Lord inspired them, (saying): Verily we shall destroy the wrong-doers

14.arabic: وَلَنُسكِنَنَّكُمُ الأَرضَ مِن بَعدِهِم ذٰلِكَ لِمَن خافَ مَقامى وَخافَ وَعيدِ
14.transliteration: Walanuskinannakumu alarda min baAAdihim thalika liman khafa maqamee wakhafa waAAeedi
14.translation: And verily We shall make you to dwell in the land after them. This is for him who feareth My Majesty and feareth My threats

14.arabic: وَاستَفتَحوا وَخابَ كُلُّ جَبّارٍ عَنيدٍ
14.transliteration: Waistaftahoo wakhaba kullu jabbarin AAaneedin
14.translation: And they sought help (from their Lord) and every froward potentate was bought to naught

14.arabic: مِن وَرائِهِ جَهَنَّمُ وَيُسقىٰ مِن ماءٍ صَديدٍ
14.transliteration: Min waraihi jahannamu wayusqa min main sadeedin
14.translation: Hell is before him, and he is made to drink a festering water

14.arabic: يَتَجَرَّعُهُ وَلا يَكادُ يُسيغُهُ وَيَأتيهِ المَوتُ مِن كُلِّ مَكانٍ وَما هُوَ بِمَيِّتٍ وَمِن وَرائِهِ عَذابٌ غَليظٌ
14.transliteration: YatajarraAAuhu wala yakadu yuseeghuhu wayateehi almawtu min kulli makanin wama huwa bimayyitin wamin waraihi AAathabun ghaleethun
14.translation: Which he sippeth but can hardly swallow, and death cometh unto him from every side while yet he cannot die, and before him is a harsh doom

14.arabic: مَثَلُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا بِرَبِّهِم أَعمٰلُهُم كَرَمادٍ اشتَدَّت بِهِ الرّيحُ فى يَومٍ عاصِفٍ لا يَقدِرونَ مِمّا كَسَبوا عَلىٰ شَيءٍ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلٰلُ البَعيدُ
14.transliteration: Mathalu allatheena kafaroo birabbihim aAAmaluhum karamadin ishtaddat bihi alrreehu fee yawmin AAasifin la yaqdiroona mimma kasaboo AAala shayin thalika huwa alddalalu albaAAeedu
14.translation: A similitude of those who disbelieve in their Lord: Their works are as ashes which the wind bloweth hard upon a stormy day. They have no control of aught that they have earned. That is the extreme failure

14.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بِالحَقِّ إِن يَشَأ يُذهِبكُم وَيَأتِ بِخَلقٍ جَديدٍ
14.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi in yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin
14.translation: Hast thou not seen that Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth? If He will, He can remove you and bring (in) some new creation

14.arabic: وَما ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزيزٍ
14.transliteration: Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin
14.translation: And that is no great matter for Allah

14.arabic: وَبَرَزوا لِلَّهِ جَميعًا فَقالَ الضُّعَفٰؤُا۟ لِلَّذينَ استَكبَروا إِنّا كُنّا لَكُم تَبَعًا فَهَل أَنتُم مُغنونَ عَنّا مِن عَذابِ اللَّهِ مِن شَيءٍ قالوا لَو هَدىٰنَا اللَّهُ لَهَدَينٰكُم سَواءٌ عَلَينا أَجَزِعنا أَم صَبَرنا ما لَنا مِن مَحيصٍ
14.transliteration: Wabarazoo lillahi jameeAAan faqala aldduAAafao lillatheena istakbaroo inna kunna lakum tabaAAan fahal antum mughnoona AAanna min AAathabi Allahi min shayin qaloo law hadana Allahu lahadaynakum sawaon AAalayna ajaziAAna am sabarna ma lana min maheesin
14.translation: They all come forth unto their Lord. Then those who were despised say unto those who were scornful: We were unto you a following, can ye then avert from us aught of Allah's doom? They say: Had Allah guided us, we should have guided you. Whether we rage or patiently endure is (now) all one for us; we have no place of refuge

14.arabic: وَقالَ الشَّيطٰنُ لَمّا قُضِىَ الأَمرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَعَدَكُم وَعدَ الحَقِّ وَوَعَدتُكُم فَأَخلَفتُكُم وَما كانَ لِىَ عَلَيكُم مِن سُلطٰنٍ إِلّا أَن دَعَوتُكُم فَاستَجَبتُم لى فَلا تَلومونى وَلوموا أَنفُسَكُم ما أَنا۠ بِمُصرِخِكُم وَما أَنتُم بِمُصرِخِىَّ إِنّى كَفَرتُ بِما أَشرَكتُمونِ مِن قَبلُ إِنَّ الظّٰلِمينَ لَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
14.transliteration: Waqala alshshaytanu lamma qudiya alamru inna Allaha waAAadakum waAAda alhaqqi wawaAAadtukum faakhlaftukum wama kana liya AAalaykum min sultanin illa an daAAawtukum faistajabtum lee fala taloomoonee waloomoo anfusakum ma ana bimusrikhikum wama antum bimusrikhiyya innee kafartu bima ashraktumooni min qablu inna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun
14.translation: And Satan saith, when the matter hath been decided: Lo! Allah promised you a promise of truth; and I promised you, then failed you. And I had no power over you save that I called unto you and ye obeyed me. So blame not, but blame yourselves. I cannot help you, nor can ye help me, Lo! I disbelieved in that which ye before ascribed to me. Lo! for wrong-doers is a painful doom

14.arabic: وَأُدخِلَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها بِإِذنِ رَبِّهِم تَحِيَّتُهُم فيها سَلٰمٌ
14.transliteration: Waodkhila allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha biithni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun
14.translation: And those who believed and did good works are made to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein abiding by permission of their Lord, their greeting therein: Peace

14.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ كَيفَ ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا كَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً كَشَجَرَةٍ طَيِّبَةٍ أَصلُها ثابِتٌ وَفَرعُها فِى السَّماءِ
14.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa daraba Allahu mathalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluha thabitun wafarAAuha fee alssamai
14.translation: Seest thou not how Allah coineth a similitude: A goodly saying, as a goodly tree, its root set firm, its branches reaching into heaven

14.arabic: تُؤتى أُكُلَها كُلَّ حينٍ بِإِذنِ رَبِّها وَيَضرِبُ اللَّهُ الأَمثالَ لِلنّاسِ لَعَلَّهُم يَتَذَكَّرونَ
14.transliteration: Tutee okulaha kulla heenin biithni rabbiha wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi laAAallahum yatathakkaroona
14.translation: Giving its fruit at every season by permission of its Lord? Allah coineth the similitudes for mankind in order that they may reflect

14.arabic: وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبيثَةٍ اجتُثَّت مِن فَوقِ الأَرضِ ما لَها مِن قَرارٍ
14.transliteration: Wamathalu kalimatin khabeethatin kashajaratin khabeethatin ijtuththat min fawqi alardi ma laha min qararin
14.translation: And the similitude of a bad saying is as a bad tree, uprooted from upon the earth, possessing no stability

14.arabic: يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا بِالقَولِ الثّابِتِ فِى الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا وَفِى الءاخِرَةِ وَيُضِلُّ اللَّهُ الظّٰلِمينَ وَيَفعَلُ اللَّهُ ما يَشاءُ
14.transliteration: Yuthabbitu Allahu allatheena amanoo bialqawli alththabiti fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati wayudillu Allahu alththalimeena wayafAAalu Allahu ma yashao
14.translation: Allah confirmeth those who believe by a firm saying in the life of the world and in the Hereafter, and Allah sendeth wrong-doers astray. And Allah doeth what He will

14.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ إِلَى الَّذينَ بَدَّلوا نِعمَتَ اللَّهِ كُفرًا وَأَحَلّوا قَومَهُم دارَ البَوارِ
14.transliteration: Alam tara ila allatheena baddaloo niAAmata Allahi kufran waahalloo qawmahum dara albawari
14.translation: Hast thou not seen those who gave the grace of Allah in exchange for thanklessness and led their people down to the Abode of Loss

14.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصلَونَها وَبِئسَ القَرارُ
14.transliteration: Jahannama yaslawnaha wabisa alqararu
14.translation: (Even to) hell? They are exposed thereto. A hapless end

14.arabic: وَجَعَلوا لِلَّهِ أَندادًا لِيُضِلّوا عَن سَبيلِهِ قُل تَمَتَّعوا فَإِنَّ مَصيرَكُم إِلَى النّارِ
14.transliteration: WajaAAaloo lillahi andadan liyudilloo AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAAoo fainna maseerakum ila alnnari
14.translation: And they set up rivals to Allah that they may mislead (men) from His way. Say: Enjoy life (while ye may) for lo! your journey's end will be the Fire

14.arabic: قُل لِعِبادِىَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا يُقيمُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَيُنفِقوا مِمّا رَزَقنٰهُم سِرًّا وَعَلانِيَةً مِن قَبلِ أَن يَأتِىَ يَومٌ لا بَيعٌ فيهِ وَلا خِلٰلٌ
14.transliteration: Qul liAAibadiya allatheena amanoo yuqeemoo alssalata wayunfiqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan min qabli an yatiya yawmun la bayAAun feehi wala khilalun
14.translation: Tell My bondmen who believe to establish worship and spend of that which We have given them, secretly and publicly, before a day cometh wherein there will be neither traffick nor befriending

14.arabic: اللَّهُ الَّذى خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَأَخرَجَ بِهِ مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ رِزقًا لَكُم وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الفُلكَ لِتَجرِىَ فِى البَحرِ بِأَمرِهِ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الأَنهٰرَ
14.transliteration: Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhraja bihi mina alththamarati rizqan lakum wasakhkhara lakumu alfulka litajriya fee albahri biamrihi wasakhkhara lakumu alanhara
14.translation: Allah is He Who created the heavens and the earth, and causeth water to descend from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you, and maketh the ships to be of service unto you, that they may run upon the sea at His command, and hath made of service unto you the rivers

14.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الشَّمسَ وَالقَمَرَ دائِبَينِ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ
14.transliteration: Wasakhkhara lakumu alshshamsa waalqamara daibayni wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara
14.translation: And maketh the sun and the moon, constant in their courses, to be of service unto you, and hath made of service unto you the night and the day

14.arabic: وَءاتىٰكُم مِن كُلِّ ما سَأَلتُموهُ وَإِن تَعُدّوا نِعمَتَ اللَّهِ لا تُحصوها إِنَّ الإِنسٰنَ لَظَلومٌ كَفّارٌ
14.transliteration: Waatakum min kulli ma saaltumoohu wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna alinsana lathaloomun kaffarun
14.translation: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate

14.arabic: وَإِذ قالَ إِبرٰهيمُ رَبِّ اجعَل هٰذَا البَلَدَ ءامِنًا وَاجنُبنى وَبَنِىَّ أَن نَعبُدَ الأَصنامَ
14.transliteration: Waith qala ibraheemu rabbi ijAAal hatha albalada aminan waojnubnee wabaniyya an naAAbuda alasnama
14.translation: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols

14.arabic: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضلَلنَ كَثيرًا مِنَ النّاسِ فَمَن تَبِعَنى فَإِنَّهُ مِنّى وَمَن عَصانى فَإِنَّكَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
14.transliteration: Rabbi innahunna adlalna katheeran mina alnnasi faman tabiAAanee fainnahu minnee waman AAasanee fainnaka ghafoorun raheemun
14.translation: My Lord! Lo! they have led many of mankind astray. But whoso followeth me, he verily is of me. And whoso disobeyeth me - Still Thou art Forgiving, Merciful

14.arabic: رَبَّنا إِنّى أَسكَنتُ مِن ذُرِّيَّتى بِوادٍ غَيرِ ذى زَرعٍ عِندَ بَيتِكَ المُحَرَّمِ رَبَّنا لِيُقيمُوا الصَّلوٰةَ فَاجعَل أَفـِٔدَةً مِنَ النّاسِ تَهوى إِلَيهِم وَارزُقهُم مِنَ الثَّمَرٰتِ لَعَلَّهُم يَشكُرونَ
14.transliteration: Rabbana innee askantu min thurriyyatee biwadin ghayri thee zarAAin AAinda baytika almuharrami rabbana liyuqeemoo alssalata faijAAal afidatan mina alnnasi tahwee ilayhim waorzuqhum mina alththamarati laAAallahum yashkuroona
14.translation: Our Lord! Lo! I have settled some of my posterity in an uncultivable valley near unto Thy holy House, our Lord! that they may establish proper worship; so incline some hearts of men that they may yearn toward them, and provide Thou them with fruits in order that they may be thankful

14.arabic: رَبَّنا إِنَّكَ تَعلَمُ ما نُخفى وَما نُعلِنُ وَما يَخفىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِن شَيءٍ فِى الأَرضِ وَلا فِى السَّماءِ
14.transliteration: Rabbana innaka taAAlamu ma nukhfee wama nuAAlinu wama yakhfa AAala Allahi min shayin fee alardi wala fee alssamai
14.translation: Our Lord! Lo! Thou knowest that which we hide and that which we proclaim. Nothing in the earth or in the heaven is hidden from Allah

14.arabic: الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذى وَهَبَ لى عَلَى الكِبَرِ إِسمٰعيلَ وَإِسحٰقَ إِنَّ رَبّى لَسَميعُ الدُّعاءِ
14.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi allathee wahaba lee AAala alkibari ismaAAeela waishaqa inna rabbee lasameeAAu aldduAAai
14.translation: Praise be to Allah Who hath given me, in my old age, Ishmael and Isaac! Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of Prayer

14.arabic: رَبِّ اجعَلنى مُقيمَ الصَّلوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتى رَبَّنا وَتَقَبَّل دُعاءِ
14.transliteration: Rabbi ijAAalnee muqeema alssalati wamin thurriyyatee rabbana wtaqabbal duAAai
14.translation: My Lord! Make me to establish proper worship, and some of my posterity (also); our Lord! and accept my prayer

14.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغفِر لى وَلِوٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلمُؤمِنينَ يَومَ يَقومُ الحِسابُ
14.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir lee waliwalidayya walilmumineena yawma yaqoomu alhisabu
14.translation: Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents and believers on the day when the account is cast

14.arabic: وَلا تَحسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ غٰفِلًا عَمّا يَعمَلُ الظّٰلِمونَ إِنَّما يُؤَخِّرُهُم لِيَومٍ تَشخَصُ فيهِ الأَبصٰرُ
14.transliteration: Wala tahsabanna Allaha ghafilan AAamma yaAAmalu alththalimoona innama yuakhkhiruhum liyawmin tashkhasu feehi alabsaru
14.translation: Deem not that Allah is unaware of what the wicked do. He but giveth them a respite till a day when eyes will stare (in terror)

14.arabic: مُهطِعينَ مُقنِعى رُءوسِهِم لا يَرتَدُّ إِلَيهِم طَرفُهُم وَأَفـِٔدَتُهُم هَواءٌ
14.transliteration: MuhtiAAeena muqniAAee ruoosihim la yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum waafidatuhum hawaon
14.translation: As they come hurrying on in fear, their heads upraised, their gaze returning not to them, and their hearts as air

14.arabic: وَأَنذِرِ النّاسَ يَومَ يَأتيهِمُ العَذابُ فَيَقولُ الَّذينَ ظَلَموا رَبَّنا أَخِّرنا إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ قَريبٍ نُجِب دَعوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ الرُّسُلَ أَوَلَم تَكونوا أَقسَمتُم مِن قَبلُ ما لَكُم مِن زَوالٍ
14.transliteration: Waanthiri alnnasa yawma yateehimu alAAathabu fayaqoolu allatheena thalamoo rabbana akhkhirna ila ajalin qareebin nujib daAAwataka wanattabiAAi alrrusula awalam takoonoo aqsamtum min qablu ma lakum min zawalin
14.translation: And warn mankind of a day when the doom will come upon them, and those who did wrong will say: Our Lord! Reprieve us for a little while. We will obey Thy call and will follow the messengers. (It will be answered): Did ye not swear before that there would be no end for you

14.arabic: وَسَكَنتُم فى مَسٰكِنِ الَّذينَ ظَلَموا أَنفُسَهُم وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُم كَيفَ فَعَلنا بِهِم وَضَرَبنا لَكُمُ الأَمثالَ
14.transliteration: Wasakantum fee masakini allatheena thalamoo anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faAAalna bihim wadarabna lakumu alamthala
14.translation: And (have ye not) dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves (of old) and (hath it not) become plain to you how We dealt with them and made examples for you

14.arabic: وَقَد مَكَروا مَكرَهُم وَعِندَ اللَّهِ مَكرُهُم وَإِن كانَ مَكرُهُم لِتَزولَ مِنهُ الجِبالُ
14.transliteration: Waqad makaroo makrahum waAAinda Allahi makruhum wain kana makruhum litazoola minhu aljibalu
14.translation: Verily they have plotted their plot, and their plot is with Allah, though their plot were one whereby the mountains should be moved

14.arabic: فَلا تَحسَبَنَّ اللَّهَ مُخلِفَ وَعدِهِ رُسُلَهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزيزٌ ذُو انتِقامٍ
14.transliteration: Fala tahsabanna Allaha mukhlifa waAAdihi rusulahu inna Allaha AAazeezun thoo intiqamin
14.translation: So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong)

14.arabic: يَومَ تُبَدَّلُ الأَرضُ غَيرَ الأَرضِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ وَبَرَزوا لِلَّهِ الوٰحِدِ القَهّارِ
14.transliteration: Yawma tubaddalu alardu ghayra alardi waalssamawatu wabarazoo lillahi alwahidi alqahhari
14.translation: On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth, and the heavens (also will be changed) and they will come forth unto Allah, the One, the Almighty

14.arabic: وَتَرَى المُجرِمينَ يَومَئِذٍ مُقَرَّنينَ فِى الأَصفادِ
14.transliteration: Watara almujrimeena yawmaithin muqarraneena fee alasfadi
14.translation: Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains

14.arabic: سَرابيلُهُم مِن قَطِرانٍ وَتَغشىٰ وُجوهَهُمُ النّارُ
14.transliteration: Sarabeeluhum min qatranin wataghsha wujoohahumu alnnaru
14.translation: Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces

14.arabic: لِيَجزِىَ اللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفسٍ ما كَسَبَت إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَريعُ الحِسابِ
14.transliteration: Liyajziya Allahu kulla nafsin ma kasabat inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi
14.translation: That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning

14.arabic: هٰذا بَلٰغٌ لِلنّاسِ وَلِيُنذَروا بِهِ وَلِيَعلَموا أَنَّما هُوَ إِلٰهٌ وٰحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُولُوا الأَلبٰبِ
14.transliteration: Hatha balaghun lilnnasi waliyuntharoo bihi waliyaAAlamoo annama huwa ilahun wahidun waliyaththakkara oloo alalbabi
14.translation: This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One Allah, and that men of understanding may take heed

15.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ الر تِلكَ ءايٰتُ الكِتٰبِ وَقُرءانٍ مُبينٍ
15.transliteration: Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi waquranin mubeenin
15.translation: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading

15.arabic: رُبَما يَوَدُّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لَو كانوا مُسلِمينَ
15.transliteration: Rubama yawaddu allatheena kafaroo law kanoo muslimeena
15.translation: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims

15.arabic: ذَرهُم يَأكُلوا وَيَتَمَتَّعوا وَيُلهِهِمُ الأَمَلُ فَسَوفَ يَعلَمونَ
15.transliteration: Tharhum yakuloo wayatamattaAAoo wayulhihimu alamalu fasawfa yaAAlamoona
15.translation: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know

15.arabic: وَما أَهلَكنا مِن قَريَةٍ إِلّا وَلَها كِتابٌ مَعلومٌ
15.transliteration: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa walaha kitabun maAAloomun
15.translation: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it

15.arabic: ما تَسبِقُ مِن أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَها وَما يَستَـٔخِرونَ
15.transliteration: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona
15.translation: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind

15.arabic: وَقالوا يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذى نُزِّلَ عَلَيهِ الذِّكرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجنونٌ
15.transliteration: Waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila AAalayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun
15.translation: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman

15.arabic: لَو ما تَأتينا بِالمَلٰئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
15.transliteration: Law ma tateena bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqeena
15.translation: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful

15.arabic: ما نُنَزِّلُ المَلٰئِكَةَ إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَما كانوا إِذًا مُنظَرينَ
15.transliteration: Ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi wama kanoo ithan munthareena
15.translation: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated

15.arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نَزَّلنَا الذِّكرَ وَإِنّا لَهُ لَحٰفِظونَ
15.transliteration: Inna nahnu nazzalna alththikra wainna lahu lahafithoona
15.translation: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian

15.arabic: وَلَقَد أَرسَلنا مِن قَبلِكَ فى شِيَعِ الأَوَّلينَ
15.transliteration: Walaqad arsalna min qablika fee shiyaAAi alawwaleena
15.translation: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old

15.arabic: وَما يَأتيهِم مِن رَسولٍ إِلّا كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
15.transliteration: Wama yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
15.translation: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

15.arabic: كَذٰلِكَ نَسلُكُهُ فى قُلوبِ المُجرِمينَ
15.transliteration: Kathalika naslukuhu fee quloobi almujrimeena
15.translation: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty

15.arabic: لا يُؤمِنونَ بِهِ وَقَد خَلَت سُنَّةُ الأَوَّلينَ
15.transliteration: La yuminoona bihi waqad khalat sunnatu alawwaleena
15.translation: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before

15.arabic: وَلَو فَتَحنا عَلَيهِم بابًا مِنَ السَّماءِ فَظَلّوا فيهِ يَعرُجونَ
15.transliteration: Walaw fatahna AAalayhim baban mina alssamai fathalloo feehi yaAArujoona
15.translation: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it

15.arabic: لَقالوا إِنَّما سُكِّرَت أَبصٰرُنا بَل نَحنُ قَومٌ مَسحورونَ
15.transliteration: Laqaloo innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qawmun mashooroona
15.translation: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched

15.arabic: وَلَقَد جَعَلنا فِى السَّماءِ بُروجًا وَزَيَّنّٰها لِلنّٰظِرينَ
15.transliteration: Walaqad jaAAalna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena
15.translation: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders

15.arabic: وَحَفِظنٰها مِن كُلِّ شَيطٰنٍ رَجيمٍ
15.transliteration: Wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin
15.translation: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil

15.arabic: إِلّا مَنِ استَرَقَ السَّمعَ فَأَتبَعَهُ شِهابٌ مُبينٌ
15.transliteration: Illa mani istaraqa alssamAAa faatbaAAahu shihabun mubeenun
15.translation: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue

15.arabic: وَالأَرضَ مَدَدنٰها وَأَلقَينا فيها رَوٰسِىَ وَأَنبَتنا فيها مِن كُلِّ شَيءٍ مَوزونٍ
15.transliteration: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin
15.translation: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein

15.arabic: وَجَعَلنا لَكُم فيها مَعٰيِشَ وَمَن لَستُم لَهُ بِرٰزِقينَ
15.transliteration: WajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena
15.translation: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not

15.arabic: وَإِن مِن شَيءٍ إِلّا عِندَنا خَزائِنُهُ وَما نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلّا بِقَدَرٍ مَعلومٍ
15.transliteration: Wain min shayin illa AAindana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin maAAloomin
15.translation: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure

15.arabic: وَأَرسَلنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَأَسقَينٰكُموهُ وَما أَنتُم لَهُ بِخٰزِنينَ
15.transliteration: Waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena
15.translation: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof

15.arabic: وَإِنّا لَنَحنُ نُحيۦ وَنُميتُ وَنَحنُ الوٰرِثونَ
15.transliteration: Wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona
15.translation: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor

15.arabic: وَلَقَد عَلِمنَا المُستَقدِمينَ مِنكُم وَلَقَد عَلِمنَا المُستَـٔخِرينَ
15.transliteration: Walaqad AAalimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad AAalimna almustakhireena
15.translation: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards

15.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحشُرُهُم إِنَّهُ حَكيمٌ عَليمٌ
15.transliteration: Wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun
15.translation: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware

15.arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ مِن صَلصٰلٍ مِن حَمَإٍ مَسنونٍ
15.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
15.translation: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered

15.arabic: وَالجانَّ خَلَقنٰهُ مِن قَبلُ مِن نارِ السَّمومِ
15.transliteration: Waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi
15.translation: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire

15.arabic: وَإِذ قالَ رَبُّكَ لِلمَلٰئِكَةِ إِنّى خٰلِقٌ بَشَرًا مِن صَلصٰلٍ مِن حَمَإٍ مَسنونٍ
15.transliteration: Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
15.translation: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered

15.arabic: فَإِذا سَوَّيتُهُ وَنَفَختُ فيهِ مِن روحى فَقَعوا لَهُ سٰجِدينَ
15.transliteration: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
15.translation: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him

15.arabic: فَسَجَدَ المَلٰئِكَةُ كُلُّهُم أَجمَعونَ
15.transliteration: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona
15.translation: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together

15.arabic: إِلّا إِبليسَ أَبىٰ أَن يَكونَ مَعَ السّٰجِدينَ
15.transliteration: Illa ibleesa aba an yakoona maAAa alssajideena
15.translation: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate

15.arabic: قالَ يٰإِبليسُ ما لَكَ أَلّا تَكونَ مَعَ السّٰجِدينَ
15.transliteration: Qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona maAAa alssajideena
15.translation: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate

15.arabic: قالَ لَم أَكُن لِأَسجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقتَهُ مِن صَلصٰلٍ مِن حَمَإٍ مَسنونٍ
15.transliteration: Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin
15.translation: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered

15.arabic: قالَ فَاخرُج مِنها فَإِنَّكَ رَجيمٌ
15.transliteration: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
15.translation: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast

15.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيكَ اللَّعنَةَ إِلىٰ يَومِ الدّينِ
15.transliteration: Wainna AAalayka allaAAnata ila yawmi alddeeni
15.translation: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment

15.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرنى إِلىٰ يَومِ يُبعَثونَ
15.transliteration: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
15.translation: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised

15.arabic: قالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ المُنظَرينَ
15.transliteration: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
15.translation: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved

15.arabic: إِلىٰ يَومِ الوَقتِ المَعلومِ
15.transliteration: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
15.translation: Till the Day of appointed time

15.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ بِما أَغوَيتَنى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُم فِى الأَرضِ وَلَأُغوِيَنَّهُم أَجمَعينَ
15.transliteration: Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
15.translation: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one

15.arabic: إِلّا عِبادَكَ مِنهُمُ المُخلَصينَ
15.transliteration: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
15.translation: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves

15.arabic: قالَ هٰذا صِرٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُستَقيمٌ
15.transliteration: Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun
15.translation: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me

15.arabic: إِنَّ عِبادى لَيسَ لَكَ عَلَيهِم سُلطٰنٌ إِلّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الغاوينَ
15.transliteration: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena
15.translation: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee

15.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوعِدُهُم أَجمَعينَ
15.transliteration: Wainna jahannama lamawAAiduhum ajmaAAeena
15.translation: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place

15.arabic: لَها سَبعَةُ أَبوٰبٍ لِكُلِّ بابٍ مِنهُم جُزءٌ مَقسومٌ
15.transliteration: Laha sabAAatu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun
15.translation: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion

15.arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى جَنّٰتٍ وَعُيونٍ
15.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
15.translation: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings

15.arabic: ادخُلوها بِسَلٰمٍ ءامِنينَ
15.transliteration: Odkhulooha bisalamin amineena
15.translation: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure

15.arabic: وَنَزَعنا ما فى صُدورِهِم مِن غِلٍّ إِخوٰنًا عَلىٰ سُرُرٍ مُتَقٰبِلينَ
15.transliteration: WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan AAala sururin mutaqabileena
15.translation: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised

15.arabic: لا يَمَسُّهُم فيها نَصَبٌ وَما هُم مِنها بِمُخرَجينَ
15.transliteration: La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena
15.translation: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence

15.arabic: نَبِّئ عِبادى أَنّى أَنَا الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ
15.transliteration: Nabbi AAibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu
15.translation: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful

15.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذابى هُوَ العَذابُ الأَليمُ
15.transliteration: Wa anna AAathabee huwa alAAathabu alaleemu
15.translation: And that My doom is the dolorous doom

15.arabic: وَنَبِّئهُم عَن ضَيفِ إِبرٰهيمَ
15.transliteration: Wanabbihum AAan dayfi ibraheema
15.translation: And tell them of Abraham's guests

15.arabic: إِذ دَخَلوا عَلَيهِ فَقالوا سَلٰمًا قالَ إِنّا مِنكُم وَجِلونَ
15.transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona
15.translation: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you

15.arabic: قالوا لا تَوجَل إِنّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَليمٍ
15.transliteration: Qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin AAaleemin
15.translation: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom

15.arabic: قالَ أَبَشَّرتُمونى عَلىٰ أَن مَسَّنِىَ الكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرونَ
15.transliteration: Qala abashshartumoonee AAala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni
15.translation: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings

15.arabic: قالوا بَشَّرنٰكَ بِالحَقِّ فَلا تَكُن مِنَ القٰنِطينَ
15.transliteration: Qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena
15.translation: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing

15.arabic: قالَ وَمَن يَقنَطُ مِن رَحمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلَّا الضّالّونَ
15.transliteration: Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona
15.translation: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray

15.arabic: قالَ فَما خَطبُكُم أَيُّهَا المُرسَلونَ
15.transliteration: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
15.translation: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)

15.arabic: قالوا إِنّا أُرسِلنا إِلىٰ قَومٍ مُجرِمينَ
15.transliteration: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
15.translation: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk

15.arabic: إِلّا ءالَ لوطٍ إِنّا لَمُنَجّوهُم أَجمَعينَ
15.transliteration: Illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajmaAAeena
15.translation: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one

15.arabic: إِلَّا امرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرنا إِنَّها لَمِنَ الغٰبِرينَ
15.transliteration: Illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena
15.translation: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind

15.arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَ ءالَ لوطٍ المُرسَلونَ
15.transliteration: Falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona
15.translation: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot

15.arabic: قالَ إِنَّكُم قَومٌ مُنكَرونَ
15.transliteration: Qala innakum qawmun munkaroona
15.translation: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me)

15.arabic: قالوا بَل جِئنٰكَ بِما كانوا فيهِ يَمتَرونَ
15.transliteration: Qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona
15.translation: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing

15.arabic: وَأَتَينٰكَ بِالحَقِّ وَإِنّا لَصٰدِقونَ
15.transliteration: Waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona
15.translation: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers

15.arabic: فَأَسرِ بِأَهلِكَ بِقِطعٍ مِنَ الَّيلِ وَاتَّبِع أَدبٰرَهُم وَلا يَلتَفِت مِنكُم أَحَدٌ وَامضوا حَيثُ تُؤمَرونَ
15.transliteration: Faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli waittabiAA adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona
15.translation: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded

15.arabic: وَقَضَينا إِلَيهِ ذٰلِكَ الأَمرَ أَنَّ دابِرَ هٰؤُلاءِ مَقطوعٌ مُصبِحينَ
15.transliteration: Waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtooAAun musbiheena
15.translation: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn

15.arabic: وَجاءَ أَهلُ المَدينَةِ يَستَبشِرونَ
15.transliteration: Wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona
15.translation: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals)

15.arabic: قالَ إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ ضَيفى فَلا تَفضَحونِ
15.transliteration: Qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni
15.translation: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not

15.arabic: وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلا تُخزونِ
15.transliteration: Waittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni
15.translation: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not

15.arabic: قالوا أَوَلَم نَنهَكَ عَنِ العٰلَمينَ
15.transliteration: Qaloo awalam nanhaka AAani alAAalameena
15.translation: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone

15.arabic: قالَ هٰؤُلاءِ بَناتى إِن كُنتُم فٰعِلينَ
15.transliteration: Qala haolai banatee in kuntum faAAileena
15.translation: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so)

15.arabic: لَعَمرُكَ إِنَّهُم لَفى سَكرَتِهِم يَعمَهونَ
15.transliteration: LaAAamruka innahum lafee sakratihim yaAAmahoona
15.translation: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death

15.arabic: فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصَّيحَةُ مُشرِقينَ
15.transliteration: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena
15.translation: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise

15.arabic: فَجَعَلنا عٰلِيَها سافِلَها وَأَمطَرنا عَلَيهِم حِجارَةً مِن سِجّيلٍ
15.transliteration: FajaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin
15.translation: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay

15.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِلمُتَوَسِّمينَ
15.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena
15.translation: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs

15.arabic: وَإِنَّها لَبِسَبيلٍ مُقيمٍ
15.transliteration: Wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin
15.translation: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced

15.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً لِلمُؤمِنينَ
15.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena
15.translation: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers

15.arabic: وَإِن كانَ أَصحٰبُ الأَيكَةِ لَظٰلِمينَ
15.transliteration: Wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena
15.translation: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers

15.arabic: فَانتَقَمنا مِنهُم وَإِنَّهُما لَبِإِمامٍ مُبينٍ
15.transliteration: Faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin
15.translation: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see

15.arabic: وَلَقَد كَذَّبَ أَصحٰبُ الحِجرِ المُرسَلينَ
15.transliteration: Walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena
15.translation: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers

15.arabic: وَءاتَينٰهُم ءايٰتِنا فَكانوا عَنها مُعرِضينَ
15.transliteration: Waataynahum ayatina fakanoo AAanha muAArideena
15.translation: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them

15.arabic: وَكانوا يَنحِتونَ مِنَ الجِبالِ بُيوتًا ءامِنينَ
15.transliteration: Wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena
15.translation: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure

15.arabic: فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصَّيحَةُ مُصبِحينَ
15.transliteration: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena
15.translation: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour

15.arabic: فَما أَغنىٰ عَنهُم ما كانوا يَكسِبونَ
15.transliteration: Fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona
15.translation: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not

15.arabic: وَما خَلَقنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَإِنَّ السّاعَةَ لَءاتِيَةٌ فَاصفَحِ الصَّفحَ الجَميلَ
15.transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssaAAata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela
15.translation: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness

15.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الخَلّٰقُ العَليمُ
15.transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
15.translation: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator

15.arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينٰكَ سَبعًا مِنَ المَثانى وَالقُرءانَ العَظيمَ
15.transliteration: Walaqad ataynaka sabAAan mina almathanee waalqurana alAAatheema
15.translation: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an

15.arabic: لا تَمُدَّنَّ عَينَيكَ إِلىٰ ما مَتَّعنا بِهِ أَزوٰجًا مِنهُم وَلا تَحزَن عَلَيهِم وَاخفِض جَناحَكَ لِلمُؤمِنينَ
15.transliteration: La tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan AAalayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena
15.translation: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers

15.arabic: وَقُل إِنّى أَنَا النَّذيرُ المُبينُ
15.transliteration: Waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu
15.translation: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner

15.arabic: كَما أَنزَلنا عَلَى المُقتَسِمينَ
15.transliteration: Kama anzalna AAala almuqtasimeena
15.translation: Such as We send down for those who make division

15.arabic: الَّذينَ جَعَلُوا القُرءانَ عِضينَ
15.transliteration: Allatheena jaAAaloo alqurana AAideena
15.translation: Those who break the Qur'an into parts

15.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسـَٔلَنَّهُم أَجمَعينَ
15.transliteration: Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaAAeena
15.translation: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one

15.arabic: عَمّا كانوا يَعمَلونَ
15.transliteration: AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona
15.translation: Of what they used to do

15.arabic: فَاصدَع بِما تُؤمَرُ وَأَعرِض عَنِ المُشرِكينَ
15.transliteration: FaisdaAA bima tumaru waaAArid AAani almushrikeena
15.translation: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters

15.arabic: إِنّا كَفَينٰكَ المُستَهزِءينَ
15.transliteration: Inna kafaynaka almustahzieena
15.translation: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers

15.arabic: الَّذينَ يَجعَلونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ فَسَوفَ يَعلَمونَ
15.transliteration: Allatheena yajAAaloona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa yaAAlamoona
15.translation: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know

15.arabic: وَلَقَد نَعلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضيقُ صَدرُكَ بِما يَقولونَ
15.transliteration: Walaqad naAAlamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona
15.translation: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say

15.arabic: فَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِنَ السّٰجِدينَ
15.transliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena
15.translation: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him)

15.arabic: وَاعبُد رَبَّكَ حَتّىٰ يَأتِيَكَ اليَقينُ
15.transliteration: WaoAAbud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu
15.translation: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee

16.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ أَتىٰ أَمرُ اللَّهِ فَلا تَستَعجِلوهُ سُبحٰنَهُ وَتَعٰلىٰ عَمّا يُشرِكونَ
16.transliteration: Ata amru Allahi fala tastaAAjiloohu subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona
16.translation: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him)

16.arabic: يُنَزِّلُ المَلٰئِكَةَ بِالرّوحِ مِن أَمرِهِ عَلىٰ مَن يَشاءُ مِن عِبادِهِ أَن أَنذِروا أَنَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا أَنا۠ فَاتَّقونِ
16.transliteration: Yunazzilu almalaikata bialrroohi min amrihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi an anthiroo annahu la ilaha illa ana faittaqooni
16.translation: He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no Allah save Me, so keep your duty unto Me

16.arabic: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بِالحَقِّ تَعٰلىٰ عَمّا يُشرِكونَ
16.transliteration: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi taAAala AAamma yushrikoona
16.translation: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him)

16.arabic: خَلَقَ الإِنسٰنَ مِن نُطفَةٍ فَإِذا هُوَ خَصيمٌ مُبينٌ
16.transliteration: Khalaqa alinsana min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun
16.translation: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent

16.arabic: وَالأَنعٰمَ خَلَقَها لَكُم فيها دِفءٌ وَمَنٰفِعُ وَمِنها تَأكُلونَ
16.transliteration: WaalanAAama khalaqaha lakum feeha difon wamanafiAAu waminha takuloona
16.translation: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat

16.arabic: وَلَكُم فيها جَمالٌ حينَ تُريحونَ وَحينَ تَسرَحونَ
16.transliteration: Walakum feeha jamalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoona
16.translation: And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture

16.arabic: وَتَحمِلُ أَثقالَكُم إِلىٰ بَلَدٍ لَم تَكونوا بٰلِغيهِ إِلّا بِشِقِّ الأَنفُسِ إِنَّ رَبَّكُم لَرَءوفٌ رَحيمٌ
16.transliteration: Watahmilu athqalakum ila baladin lam takoonoo baligheehi illa bishiqqi alanfusi inna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun
16.translation: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful

16.arabic: وَالخَيلَ وَالبِغالَ وَالحَميرَ لِتَركَبوها وَزينَةً وَيَخلُقُ ما لا تَعلَمونَ
16.transliteration: Waalkhayla waalbighala waalhameera litarkabooha wazeenatan wayakhluqu ma la taAAlamoona
16.translation: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not

16.arabic: وَعَلَى اللَّهِ قَصدُ السَّبيلِ وَمِنها جائِرٌ وَلَو شاءَ لَهَدىٰكُم أَجمَعينَ
16.transliteration: WaAAala Allahi qasdu alssabeeli waminha jairun walaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeena
16.translation: And Allah's is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright

16.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً لَكُم مِنهُ شَرابٌ وَمِنهُ شَجَرٌ فيهِ تُسيمونَ
16.transliteration: Huwa allathee anzala mina alssamai maan lakum minhu sharabun waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoona
16.translation: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture

16.arabic: يُنبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ الزَّرعَ وَالزَّيتونَ وَالنَّخيلَ وَالأَعنٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً لِقَومٍ يَتَفَكَّرونَ
16.transliteration: Yunbitu lakum bihi alzzarAAa waalzzaytoona waalnnakheela waalaAAnaba wamin kulli alththamarati inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona
16.translation: Therewith He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect

16.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ وَالشَّمسَ وَالقَمَرَ وَالنُّجومُ مُسَخَّرٰتٌ بِأَمرِهِ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِقَومٍ يَعقِلونَ
16.transliteration: Wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara waalnnujoomu musakhkharatun biamrihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona
16.translation: And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you, and the stars are made subservient by His command. Lo! herein indeed are portents for people who have sense

16.arabic: وَما ذَرَأَ لَكُم فِى الأَرضِ مُختَلِفًا أَلوٰنُهُ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً لِقَومٍ يَذَّكَّرونَ
16.transliteration: Wama tharaa lakum fee alardi mukhtalifan alwanuhu inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaththakkaroona
16.translation: And whatsoever He hath created for you in the earth of divers hues, lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who take heed

16.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى سَخَّرَ البَحرَ لِتَأكُلوا مِنهُ لَحمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَستَخرِجوا مِنهُ حِليَةً تَلبَسونَها وَتَرَى الفُلكَ مَواخِرَ فيهِ وَلِتَبتَغوا مِن فَضلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُم تَشكُرونَ
16.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee sakhkhara albahra litakuloo minhu lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka mawakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona
16.translation: And He it is Who hath constrained the sea to be of service that ye eat fresh meat from thence, and bring forth from thence ornaments which ye wear. And thou seest the ships ploughing it that ye (mankind) may seek of His bounty and that haply ye may give thanks

16.arabic: وَأَلقىٰ فِى الأَرضِ رَوٰسِىَ أَن تَميدَ بِكُم وَأَنهٰرًا وَسُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُم تَهتَدونَ
16.transliteration: Waalqa fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bikum waanharan wasubulan laAAallakum tahtadoona
16.translation: And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way

16.arabic: وَعَلٰمٰتٍ وَبِالنَّجمِ هُم يَهتَدونَ
16.transliteration: WaAAalamatin wabialnnajmi hum yahtadoona
16.translation: And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way

16.arabic: أَفَمَن يَخلُقُ كَمَن لا يَخلُقُ أَفَلا تَذَكَّرونَ
16.transliteration: Afaman yakhluqu kaman la yakhluqu afala tathakkaroona
16.translation: Is He then Who createth as him who createth not? Will ye not then remember

16.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدّوا نِعمَةَ اللَّهِ لا تُحصوها إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَغَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
16.transliteration: Wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna Allaha laghafoorun raheemun
16.translation: And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful

16.arabic: وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ ما تُسِرّونَ وَما تُعلِنونَ
16.transliteration: WaAllahu yaAAlamu ma tusirroona wama tuAAlinoona
16.translation: And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim

16.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يَدعونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ لا يَخلُقونَ شَيـًٔا وَهُم يُخلَقونَ
16.transliteration: Waallatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona
16.translation: Those unto whom they cry beside Allah created naught, but are themselves created

16.arabic: أَموٰتٌ غَيرُ أَحياءٍ وَما يَشعُرونَ أَيّانَ يُبعَثونَ
16.transliteration: Amwatun ghayru ahyain wama yashAAuroona ayyana yubAAathoona
16.translation: (They are) dead, not living. And they know not when they will be raised

16.arabic: إِلٰهُكُم إِلٰهٌ وٰحِدٌ فَالَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِالءاخِرَةِ قُلوبُهُم مُنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُستَكبِرونَ
16.transliteration: Ilahukum ilahun wahidun faallatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati quloobuhum munkiratun wahum mustakbiroona
16.translation: Your Allah is One Allah. But as for those who believe not in the Hereafter their hearts refuse to know, for they are proud

16.arabic: لا جَرَمَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعلَمُ ما يُسِرّونَ وَما يُعلِنونَ إِنَّهُ لا يُحِبُّ المُستَكبِرينَ
16.transliteration: La jarama anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona innahu la yuhibbu almustakbireena
16.translation: Assuredly Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He loveth not the proud

16.arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُم ماذا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُم قالوا أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ
16.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahum matha anzala rabbukum qaloo asateeru alawwaleena
16.translation: And when it is said unto them: What hath your Lord revealed? they say: (Mere) fables of the men of old

16.arabic: لِيَحمِلوا أَوزارَهُم كامِلَةً يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ وَمِن أَوزارِ الَّذينَ يُضِلّونَهُم بِغَيرِ عِلمٍ أَلا ساءَ ما يَزِرونَ
16.transliteration: Liyahmiloo awzarahum kamilatan yawma alqiyamati wamin awzari allatheena yudilloonahum bighayri AAilmin ala saa ma yaziroona
16.translation: That they may bear their burdens undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens of those whom they mislead without knowledge. Ah! evil is that which they bear

16.arabic: قَد مَكَرَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم فَأَتَى اللَّهُ بُنيٰنَهُم مِنَ القَواعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيهِمُ السَّقفُ مِن فَوقِهِم وَأَتىٰهُمُ العَذابُ مِن حَيثُ لا يَشعُرونَ
16.transliteration: Qad makara allatheena min qablihim faata Allahu bunyanahum mina alqawaAAidi fakharra AAalayhimu alssaqfu min fawqihim waatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona
16.translation: Those before them plotted, so Allah struck at the foundations of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them from above them, and the doom came on them whence they knew not

16.arabic: ثُمَّ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ يُخزيهِم وَيَقولُ أَينَ شُرَكاءِىَ الَّذينَ كُنتُم تُشٰقّونَ فيهِم قالَ الَّذينَ أوتُوا العِلمَ إِنَّ الخِزىَ اليَومَ وَالسّوءَ عَلَى الكٰفِرينَ
16.transliteration: Thumma yawma alqiyamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tushaqqoona feehim qala allatheena ootoo alAAilma inna alkhizya alyawma waalssooa AAala alkafireena
16.translation: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and will say: Where are My partners, for whose sake ye opposed (My guidance)? Those who have been given knowledge will say: Disgrace this day and evil are upon the disbelievers

16.arabic: الَّذينَ تَتَوَفّىٰهُمُ المَلٰئِكَةُ ظالِمى أَنفُسِهِم فَأَلقَوُا السَّلَمَ ما كُنّا نَعمَلُ مِن سوءٍ بَلىٰ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَليمٌ بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
16.transliteration: Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu thalimee anfusihim faalqawoo alssalama ma kunna naAAmalu min sooin bala inna Allaha AAaleemun bima kuntum taAAmaloona
16.translation: Whom the angels cause to die while they are wronging themselves. Then will they make full submission (saying): We used not to do any wrong. Nay! Surely Allah is Knower of what ye used to do

16.arabic: فَادخُلوا أَبوٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدينَ فيها فَلَبِئسَ مَثوَى المُتَكَبِّرينَ
16.transliteration: Faodkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha falabisa mathwa almutakabbireena
16.translation: So enter the gates of hell, to dwell therein for ever. Woeful indeed will be the lodging of the arrogant

16.arabic: وَقيلَ لِلَّذينَ اتَّقَوا ماذا أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُم قالوا خَيرًا لِلَّذينَ أَحسَنوا فى هٰذِهِ الدُّنيا حَسَنَةٌ وَلَدارُ الءاخِرَةِ خَيرٌ وَلَنِعمَ دارُ المُتَّقينَ
16.transliteration: Waqeela lillatheena ittaqaw matha anzala rabbukum qaloo khayran lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waladaru alakhirati khayrun walaniAAma daru almuttaqeena
16.translation: And it is said unto those who ward off (evil): What hath your Lord revealed? They say: Good. For those who do good in this world there is a good (reward) and the home of the Hereafter will be better. Pleasant indeed will be the home of those who ward off (evil)

16.arabic: جَنّٰتُ عَدنٍ يَدخُلونَها تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ لَهُم فيها ما يَشاءونَ كَذٰلِكَ يَجزِى اللَّهُ المُتَّقينَ
16.transliteration: Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha tajree min tahtiha alanharu lahum feeha ma yashaoona kathalika yajzee Allahu almuttaqeena
16.translation: Gardens of Eden which they enter, underneath which rivers flow, wherein they have what they will. Thus Allah repayeth those who ward off (evil)

16.arabic: الَّذينَ تَتَوَفّىٰهُمُ المَلٰئِكَةُ طَيِّبينَ يَقولونَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيكُمُ ادخُلُوا الجَنَّةَ بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
16.transliteration: Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salamun AAalaykumu odkhuloo aljannata bima kuntum taAAmaloona
16.translation: Those whom the angels cause to die (when they are) good. They say: Peace be unto you! Enter the Garden because of what ye used to do

16.arabic: هَل يَنظُرونَ إِلّا أَن تَأتِيَهُمُ المَلٰئِكَةُ أَو يَأتِىَ أَمرُ رَبِّكَ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم وَما ظَلَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَلٰكِن كانوا أَنفُسَهُم يَظلِمونَ
16.transliteration: Hal yanthuroona illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kathalika faAAala allatheena min qablihim wama thalamahumu Allahu walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona
16.translation: Await they aught say that the angels should come unto them or thy Lord's command should come to pass? Even so did those before them. Allah wronged them not, but they did wrong themselves

16.arabic: فَأَصابَهُم سَيِّـٔاتُ ما عَمِلوا وَحاقَ بِهِم ما كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
16.transliteration: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
16.translation: So that the evils of what they did smote them, and that which they used to mock surrounded them

16.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ أَشرَكوا لَو شاءَ اللَّهُ ما عَبَدنا مِن دونِهِ مِن شَيءٍ نَحنُ وَلا ءاباؤُنا وَلا حَرَّمنا مِن دونِهِ مِن شَيءٍ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم فَهَل عَلَى الرُّسُلِ إِلَّا البَلٰغُ المُبينُ
16.transliteration: Waqala allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma AAabadna min doonihi min shayin nahnu wala abaona wala harramna min doonihi min shayin kathalika faAAala allatheena min qablihim fahal AAala alrrusuli illa albalaghu almubeenu
16.translation: And the idolaters say: Had Allah willed, we had not worshipped aught beside Him, we and our fathers, nor had we forbidden aught without (command from) Him. Even so did those before them. Are the messengers charged with aught save plain conveyance (of the message)

16.arabic: وَلَقَد بَعَثنا فى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ رَسولًا أَنِ اعبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاجتَنِبُوا الطّٰغوتَ فَمِنهُم مَن هَدَى اللَّهُ وَمِنهُم مَن حَقَّت عَلَيهِ الضَّلٰلَةُ فَسيروا فِى الأَرضِ فَانظُروا كَيفَ كانَ عٰقِبَةُ المُكَذِّبينَ
16.transliteration: Walaqad baAAathna fee kulli ommatin rasoolan ani oAAbudoo Allaha waijtaniboo alttaghoota faminhum man hada Allahu waminhum man haqqat AAalayhi alddalalatu faseeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena
16.translation: And verily We have raised in every nation a messenger, (proclaiming): Serve Allah and shun false gods. Then some of them (there were) whom Allah guided, and some of them (there were) upon whom error had just hold. Do but travel in the land and see the nature of the consequence for the deniers

16.arabic: إِن تَحرِص عَلىٰ هُدىٰهُم فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَهدى مَن يُضِلُّ وَما لَهُم مِن نٰصِرينَ
16.transliteration: In tahris AAala hudahum fainna Allaha la yahdee man yudillu wama lahum min nasireena
16.translation: Even if thou (O Muhammad) desirest their right guidance, still Allah assuredly will not guide him who misleadeth. Such have no helpers

16.arabic: وَأَقسَموا بِاللَّهِ جَهدَ أَيمٰنِهِم لا يَبعَثُ اللَّهُ مَن يَموتُ بَلىٰ وَعدًا عَلَيهِ حَقًّا وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَعلَمونَ
16.transliteration: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim la yabAAathu Allahu man yamootu bala waAAdan AAalayhi haqqan walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona
16.translation: And they swear by Allah their most binding oaths (that) Allah will not raise up him who dieth. Nay, but it is a promise (binding) upon Him in truth, but most of mankind know not

16.arabic: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذى يَختَلِفونَ فيهِ وَلِيَعلَمَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا أَنَّهُم كانوا كٰذِبينَ
16.transliteration: Liyubayyina lahumu allathee yakhtalifoona feehi waliyaAAlama allatheena kafaroo annahum kanoo kathibeena
16.translation: That He may explain unto them that wherein they differ, and that those who disbelieved may know that they were liars

16.arabic: إِنَّما قَولُنا لِشَيءٍ إِذا أَرَدنٰهُ أَن نَقولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكونُ
16.transliteration: Innama qawluna lishayin itha aradnahu an naqoola lahu kun fayakoonu
16.translation: And Our word unto a thing, when We intend it, is only that We say unto it: Be! and it is

16.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هاجَروا فِى اللَّهِ مِن بَعدِ ما ظُلِموا لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُم فِى الدُّنيا حَسَنَةً وَلَأَجرُ الءاخِرَةِ أَكبَرُ لَو كانوا يَعلَمونَ
16.transliteration: Waallatheena hajaroo fee Allahi min baAAdi ma thulimoo lanubawwiannahum fee alddunya hasanatan walaajru alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona
16.translation: And those who became fugitives for the cause of Allah after they had been oppressed, We verily shall give them goodly lodging in the world, and surely the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they but knew

16.arabic: الَّذينَ صَبَروا وَعَلىٰ رَبِّهِم يَتَوَكَّلونَ
16.transliteration: Allatheena sabaroo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona
16.translation: Such as are steadfast and put their trust in Allah

16.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنا مِن قَبلِكَ إِلّا رِجالًا نوحى إِلَيهِم فَسـَٔلوا أَهلَ الذِّكرِ إِن كُنتُم لا تَعلَمونَ
16.transliteration: Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona
16.translation: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men whom We inspired - Ask the followers of the Remembrance if ye know not

16.arabic: بِالبَيِّنٰتِ وَالزُّبُرِ وَأَنزَلنا إِلَيكَ الذِّكرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنّاسِ ما نُزِّلَ إِلَيهِم وَلَعَلَّهُم يَتَفَكَّرونَ
16.transliteration: Bialbayyinati waalzzuburi waanzalna ilayka alththikra litubayyina lilnnasi ma nuzzila ilayhim walaAAallahum yatafakkaroona
16.translation: With clear proofs and writings; and We have revealed unto thee the Remembrance that thou mayst explain to mankind that which hath been revealed for them, and that haply they may reflect

16.arabic: أَفَأَمِنَ الَّذينَ مَكَرُوا السَّيِّـٔاتِ أَن يَخسِفَ اللَّهُ بِهِمُ الأَرضَ أَو يَأتِيَهُمُ العَذابُ مِن حَيثُ لا يَشعُرونَ
16.transliteration: Afaamina allatheena makaroo alssayyiati an yakhsifa Allahu bihimu alarda aw yatiyahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona
16.translation: Are they who plan ill-deeds then secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them, or that the doom will not come on them whence they know not

16.arabic: أَو يَأخُذَهُم فى تَقَلُّبِهِم فَما هُم بِمُعجِزينَ
16.transliteration: Aw yakhuthahum fee taqallubihim fama hum bimuAAjizeena
16.translation: Or that He will not seize them in their going to and fro so that there be no escape for them

16.arabic: أَو يَأخُذَهُم عَلىٰ تَخَوُّفٍ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُم لَرَءوفٌ رَحيمٌ
16.transliteration: Aw yakhuthahum AAala takhawwufin fainna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun
16.translation: Or that He will not seize them with a gradual wasting? Lo! thy Lord is indeed Full of Pity, Merciful

16.arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَوا إِلىٰ ما خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِن شَيءٍ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلٰلُهُ عَنِ اليَمينِ وَالشَّمائِلِ سُجَّدًا لِلَّهِ وَهُم دٰخِرونَ
16.transliteration: Awa lam yaraw ila ma khalaqa Allahu min shayin yatafayyao thilaluhu AAani alyameeni waalshshamaili sujjadan lillahi wahum dakhiroona
16.translation: Have they not observed all things that Allah hath created, how their shadows incline to the right and to the left, making prostration unto Allah, and they are lowly

16.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ يَسجُدُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ مِن دابَّةٍ وَالمَلٰئِكَةُ وَهُم لا يَستَكبِرونَ
16.transliteration: Walillahi yasjudu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi min dabbatin waalmalaikatu wahum la yastakbiroona
16.translation: And unto Allah maketh prostration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth of living creatures, and the angels (also) and they are not proud

16.arabic: يَخافونَ رَبَّهُم مِن فَوقِهِم وَيَفعَلونَ ما يُؤمَرونَ
16.transliteration: Yakhafoona rabbahum min fawqihim wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona
16.translation: They fear their Lord above them, and do what they are bidden

16.arabic: وَقالَ اللَّهُ لا تَتَّخِذوا إِلٰهَينِ اثنَينِ إِنَّما هُوَ إِلٰهٌ وٰحِدٌ فَإِيّٰىَ فَارهَبونِ
16.transliteration: Waqala Allahu la tattakhithoo ilahayni ithnayni innama huwa ilahun wahidun faiyyaya fairhabooni
16.translation: Allah hath said: Choose not two gods. There is only One Allah. So of Me, Me only, be in awe

16.arabic: وَلَهُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَلَهُ الدّينُ واصِبًا أَفَغَيرَ اللَّهِ تَتَّقونَ
16.transliteration: Walahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi walahu alddeenu wasiban afaghayra Allahi tattaqoona
16.translation: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth, and religion is His for ever. Will ye then fear any other than Allah

16.arabic: وَما بِكُم مِن نِعمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ إِذا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَإِلَيهِ تَجـَٔرونَ
16.transliteration: Wama bikum min niAAmatin famina Allahi thumma itha massakumu alddurru failayhi tajaroona
16.translation: And whatever of comfort ye enjoy, it is from Allah. Then, when misfortune reacheth you, unto Him ye cry for help

16.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنكُم إِذا فَريقٌ مِنكُم بِرَبِّهِم يُشرِكونَ
16.transliteration: Thumma itha kashafa alddurra AAankum itha fareequn minkum birabbihim yushrikoona
16.translation: And afterward, when He hath rid you of the misfortune, behold! a set of you attribute partners to their Lord

16.arabic: لِيَكفُروا بِما ءاتَينٰهُم فَتَمَتَّعوا فَسَوفَ تَعلَمونَ
16.transliteration: Liyakfuroo bima ataynahum fatamattaAAoo fasawfa taAAlamoona
16.translation: So as to deny that which We have given them. Then enjoy life (while ye may), for ye will come to know

16.arabic: وَيَجعَلونَ لِما لا يَعلَمونَ نَصيبًا مِمّا رَزَقنٰهُم تَاللَّهِ لَتُسـَٔلُنَّ عَمّا كُنتُم تَفتَرونَ
16.transliteration: WayajAAaloona lima la yaAAlamoona naseeban mimma razaqnahum taAllahi latusalunna AAamma kuntum taftaroona
16.translation: And they assign a portion of that which We have given them unto what they know not. By Allah! but ye will indeed be asked concerning (all) that ye used to invent

16.arabic: وَيَجعَلونَ لِلَّهِ البَنٰتِ سُبحٰنَهُ وَلَهُم ما يَشتَهونَ
16.transliteration: WayajAAaloona lillahi albanati subhanahu walahum ma yashtahoona
16.translation: And they assign unto Allah daughters - Be He Glorified! - and unto themselves what they desire

16.arabic: وَإِذا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِالأُنثىٰ ظَلَّ وَجهُهُ مُسوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظيمٌ
16.transliteration: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bialontha thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun
16.translation: When if one of them receiveth tidings of the birth of a female, his face remaineth darkened, and he is wroth inwardly

16.arabic: يَتَوٰرىٰ مِنَ القَومِ مِن سوءِ ما بُشِّرَ بِهِ أَيُمسِكُهُ عَلىٰ هونٍ أَم يَدُسُّهُ فِى التُّرابِ أَلا ساءَ ما يَحكُمونَ
16.transliteration: Yatawara mina alqawmi min sooi ma bushshira bihi ayumsikuhu AAala hoonin am yadussuhu fee altturabi ala saa ma yahkumoona
16.translation: He hideth himself from the folk because of the evil of that whereof he hath had tidings, (asking himself): Shall he keep it in contempt, or bury it beneath the dust. Verily evil is their judgment

16.arabic: لِلَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِالءاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوءِ وَلِلَّهِ المَثَلُ الأَعلىٰ وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
16.transliteration: Lillatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati mathalu alssawi walillahi almathalu alaAAla wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
16.translation: For those who believe not in the Hereafter is an evil similitude, and Allah's is the Sublime Similitude. He is the Mighty, the Wise

16.arabic: وَلَو يُؤاخِذُ اللَّهُ النّاسَ بِظُلمِهِم ما تَرَكَ عَلَيها مِن دابَّةٍ وَلٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُم إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذا جاءَ أَجَلُهُم لا يَستَـٔخِرونَ ساعَةً وَلا يَستَقدِمونَ
16.transliteration: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bithulmihim ma taraka AAalayha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum la yastakhiroona saAAatan wala yastaqdimoona
16.translation: If Allah were to take mankind to task for their wrong-doing, he would not leave hereon a living creature, but He reprieveth them to an appointed term, and when their term cometh they cannot put (it) off an hour nor (yet) advance (it)

16.arabic: وَيَجعَلونَ لِلَّهِ ما يَكرَهونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلسِنَتُهُمُ الكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ الحُسنىٰ لا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ النّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُفرَطونَ
16.transliteration: WayajAAaloona lillahi ma yakrahoona watasifu alsinatuhumu alkathiba anna lahumu alhusna la jarama anna lahumu alnnara waannahum mufratoona
16.translation: And they assign unto Allah that which they (themselves) dislike, and their tongues expound the lie that the better portion will be theirs. Assuredly theirs will be the Fire, and they will be abandoned

16.arabic: تَاللَّهِ لَقَد أَرسَلنا إِلىٰ أُمَمٍ مِن قَبلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيطٰنُ أَعمٰلَهُم فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ اليَومَ وَلَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
16.transliteration: TaAllahi laqad arsalna ila omamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu alyawma walahum AAathabun aleemun
16.translation: By Allah, We verily sent messengers unto the nations before thee, but the devil made their deeds fairseeming unto them. So he is their patron this day, and theirs will be a painful doom

16.arabic: وَما أَنزَلنا عَلَيكَ الكِتٰبَ إِلّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِى اختَلَفوا فيهِ وَهُدًى وَرَحمَةً لِقَومٍ يُؤمِنونَ
16.transliteration: Wama anzalna AAalayka alkitaba illa litubayyina lahumu allathee ikhtalafoo feehi wahudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoona
16.translation: And We have revealed the Scripture unto thee only that thou mayst explain unto them that wherein they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe

16.arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَأَحيا بِهِ الأَرضَ بَعدَ مَوتِها إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً لِقَومٍ يَسمَعونَ
16.transliteration: WaAllahu anzala mina alssamai maan faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yasmaAAoona
16.translation: Allah sendeth down water from the sky and therewith reviveth the earth after her death. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a folk who hear

16.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُم فِى الأَنعٰمِ لَعِبرَةً نُسقيكُم مِمّا فى بُطونِهِ مِن بَينِ فَرثٍ وَدَمٍ لَبَنًا خالِصًا سائِغًا لِلشّٰرِبينَ
16.transliteration: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butoonihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khalisan saighan lilshsharibeena
16.translation: And lo! in the cattle there is a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, from betwixt the refuse and the blood, pure milk palatable to the drinkers

16.arabic: وَمِن ثَمَرٰتِ النَّخيلِ وَالأَعنٰبِ تَتَّخِذونَ مِنهُ سَكَرًا وَرِزقًا حَسَنًا إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً لِقَومٍ يَعقِلونَ
16.transliteration: Wamin thamarati alnnakheeli waalaAAnabi tattakhithoona minhu sakaran warizqan hasanan inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaAAqiloona
16.translation: And of the fruits of the date-palm, and grapes, whence ye derive strong drink and (also) good nourishment. Lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who have sense

16.arabic: وَأَوحىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى النَّحلِ أَنِ اتَّخِذى مِنَ الجِبالِ بُيوتًا وَمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمّا يَعرِشونَ
16.transliteration: Waawha rabbuka ila alnnahli ani ittakhithee mina aljibali buyootan wamina alshshajari wamimma yaAArishoona
16.translation: And thy Lord inspired the bee, saying: Choose thou habitations in the hills and in the trees and in that which they thatch

16.arabic: ثُمَّ كُلى مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ فَاسلُكى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًا يَخرُجُ مِن بُطونِها شَرابٌ مُختَلِفٌ أَلوٰنُهُ فيهِ شِفاءٌ لِلنّاسِ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً لِقَومٍ يَتَفَكَّرونَ
16.transliteration: Thumma kulee min kulli alththamarati faoslukee subula rabbiki thululan yakhruju min butooniha sharabun mukhtalifun alwanuhu feehi shifaon lilnnasi inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona
16.translation: Then eat of all fruits, and follow the ways of thy Lord, made smooth (for thee). There cometh forth from their bellies a drink divers of hues, wherein is healing for mankind. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect

16.arabic: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم ثُمَّ يَتَوَفّىٰكُم وَمِنكُم مَن يُرَدُّ إِلىٰ أَرذَلِ العُمُرِ لِكَى لا يَعلَمَ بَعدَ عِلمٍ شَيـًٔا إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَليمٌ قَديرٌ
16.transliteration: WaAllahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffakum waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali alAAumuri likay la yaAAlama baAAda AAilmin shayan inna Allaha AAaleemun qadeerun
16.translation: And Allah createth you, then causeth you to die, and among you is he who is brought back to the most abject stage of life, so that he knoweth nothing after (having had) knowledge. Lo! Allah is Knower, Powerful

16.arabic: وَاللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعضَكُم عَلىٰ بَعضٍ فِى الرِّزقِ فَمَا الَّذينَ فُضِّلوا بِرادّى رِزقِهِم عَلىٰ ما مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُهُم فَهُم فيهِ سَواءٌ أَفَبِنِعمَةِ اللَّهِ يَجحَدونَ
16.transliteration: WaAllahu faddala baAAdakum AAala baAAdin fee alrrizqi fama allatheena fuddiloo biraddee rizqihim AAala ma malakat aymanuhum fahum feehi sawaon afabiniAAmati Allahi yajhadoona
16.translation: And Allah hath favoured some of you above others in provision. Now those who are more favoured will by no means hand over their provision to those (slaves) whom their right hands possess, so that they may be equal with them in respect thereof. Is it then the grace of Allah that they deny

16.arabic: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِن أَنفُسِكُم أَزوٰجًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِن أَزوٰجِكُم بَنينَ وَحَفَدَةً وَرَزَقَكُم مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ أَفَبِالبٰطِلِ يُؤمِنونَ وَبِنِعمَتِ اللَّهِ هُم يَكفُرونَ
16.transliteration: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wajaAAala lakum min azwajikum baneena wahafadatan warazaqakum mina alttayyibati afabialbatili yuminoona wabiniAAmati Allahi hum yakfuroona
16.translation: And Allah hath given you wives of your own kind, and hath given you, from your wives, sons and grandsons, and hath made provision of good things for you. Is it then in vanity that they believe and in the grace of Allah that they disbelieve

16.arabic: وَيَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ما لا يَملِكُ لَهُم رِزقًا مِنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ شَيـًٔا وَلا يَستَطيعونَ
16.transliteration: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yamliku lahum rizqan mina alssamawati waalardi shayan wala yastateeAAoona
16.translation: And they worship beside Allah that which owneth no provision whatsoever for them from the heavens or the earth, nor have they (whom they worship) any power

16.arabic: فَلا تَضرِبوا لِلَّهِ الأَمثالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعلَمُ وَأَنتُم لا تَعلَمونَ
16.transliteration: Fala tadriboo lillahi alamthala inna Allaha yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona
16.translation: So coin not similitudes for Allah. Lo! Allah knoweth; ye know not

16.arabic: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبدًا مَملوكًا لا يَقدِرُ عَلىٰ شَيءٍ وَمَن رَزَقنٰهُ مِنّا رِزقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنهُ سِرًّا وَجَهرًا هَل يَستَوۥنَ الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ بَل أَكثَرُهُم لا يَعلَمونَ
16.transliteration: Daraba Allahu mathalan AAabdan mamlookan la yaqdiru AAala shayin waman razaqnahu minna rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wajahran hal yastawoona alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona
16.translation: Allah coineth a similitude: (on the one hand) a (mere) chattel slave, who hath control of nothing, and (on the other hand) one on whom we have bestowed a fair provision from Us, and he spendeth thereof secretly and openly. Are they equal? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not

16.arabic: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلَينِ أَحَدُهُما أَبكَمُ لا يَقدِرُ عَلىٰ شَيءٍ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلىٰ مَولىٰهُ أَينَما يُوَجِّههُ لا يَأتِ بِخَيرٍ هَل يَستَوى هُوَ وَمَن يَأمُرُ بِالعَدلِ وَهُوَ عَلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
16.transliteration: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan rajulayni ahaduhuma abkamu la yaqdiru AAala shayin wahuwa kallun AAala mawlahu aynama yuwajjihhu la yati bikhayrin hal yastawee huwa waman yamuru bialAAadli wahuwa AAala siratin mustaqeemin
16.translation: And Allah coineth a similitude: Two men, one of them dumb, having control of nothing, and he is a burden on his owner; whithersoever he directeth him to go, he bringeth no good. Is he equal with one who enjoineth justice and followeth a straight path (of conduct)

16.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ غَيبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما أَمرُ السّاعَةِ إِلّا كَلَمحِ البَصَرِ أَو هُوَ أَقرَبُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
16.transliteration: Walillahi ghaybu alssamawati waalardi wama amru alssaAAati illa kalamhi albasari aw huwa aqrabu inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
16.translation: And unto Allah belongeth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth, and the matter of the Hour (of Doom) is but as a twinkling of the eye, or it is nearer still. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things

16.arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَخرَجَكُم مِن بُطونِ أُمَّهٰتِكُم لا تَعلَمونَ شَيـًٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمعَ وَالأَبصٰرَ وَالأَفـِٔدَةَ لَعَلَّكُم تَشكُرونَ
16.transliteration: WaAllahu akhrajakum min butooni ommahatikum la taAAlamoona shayan wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata laAAallakum tashkuroona
16.translation: And Allah brought you forth from the wombs of your mothers knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts that haply ye might give thanks

16.arabic: أَلَم يَرَوا إِلَى الطَّيرِ مُسَخَّرٰتٍ فى جَوِّ السَّماءِ ما يُمسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا اللَّهُ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِقَومٍ يُؤمِنونَ
16.transliteration: Alam yaraw ila alttayri musakhkharatin fee jawwi alssamai ma yumsikuhunna illa Allahu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona
16.translation: Have they not seen the birds obedient in mid-air? None holdeth them save Allah. Lo! herein, verily, are portents for a people who believe

16.arabic: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِن بُيوتِكُم سَكَنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِن جُلودِ الأَنعٰمِ بُيوتًا تَستَخِفّونَها يَومَ ظَعنِكُم وَيَومَ إِقامَتِكُم وَمِن أَصوافِها وَأَوبارِها وَأَشعارِها أَثٰثًا وَمَتٰعًا إِلىٰ حينٍ
16.transliteration: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum min buyootikum sakanan wajaAAala lakum min juloodi alanAAami buyootan tastakhiffoonaha yawma thaAAnikum wayawma iqamatikum wamin aswafiha waawbariha waashAAariha athathan wamataAAan ila heenin
16.translation: And Allah hath given you in your houses an abode, and hath given you (also), of the hides of cattle, houses which ye find light (to carry) on the day of migration and on the day of pitching camp; and of their wool and their fur and their hair, caparison and comfort for a while

16.arabic: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِمّا خَلَقَ ظِلٰلًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِنَ الجِبالِ أَكنٰنًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم سَرٰبيلَ تَقيكُمُ الحَرَّ وَسَرٰبيلَ تَقيكُم بَأسَكُم كَذٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعمَتَهُ عَلَيكُم لَعَلَّكُم تُسلِمونَ
16.transliteration: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum mimma khalaqa thilalan wajaAAala lakum mina aljibali aknanan wajaAAala lakum sarabeela taqeekumu alharra wasarabeela taqeekum basakum kathalika yutimmu niAAmatahu AAalaykum laAAallakum tuslimoona
16.translation: And Allah hath given you, of that which He hath created, shelter from the sun; and hath given you places of refuge in the mountains, and hath given you coats to ward off the heat from you, and coats (of armour) to save you from your own foolhardiness. Thus doth He perfect His favour unto you, in order that ye may surrender (unto Him)

16.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوا فَإِنَّما عَلَيكَ البَلٰغُ المُبينُ
16.transliteration: Fain tawallaw fainnama AAalayka albalaghu almubeenu
16.translation: Then, if they turn away, thy duty (O Muhammad) is but plain conveyance (of the message)

16.arabic: يَعرِفونَ نِعمَتَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرونَها وَأَكثَرُهُمُ الكٰفِرونَ
16.transliteration: YaAArifoona niAAmata Allahi thumma yunkiroonaha waaktharuhumu alkafiroona
16.translation: They know the favour of Allah and then deny it. Most of them are ingrates

16.arabic: وَيَومَ نَبعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهيدًا ثُمَّ لا يُؤذَنُ لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا وَلا هُم يُستَعتَبونَ
16.transliteration: Wayawma nabAAathu min kulli ommatin shaheedan thumma la yuthanu lillatheena kafaroo wala hum yustaAAtaboona
16.translation: And (bethink you of) the day when we raise up of every nation a witness, then there is no leave for disbelievers, nor are they allowed to make amends

16.arabic: وَإِذا رَءَا الَّذينَ ظَلَمُوا العَذابَ فَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنهُم وَلا هُم يُنظَرونَ
16.transliteration: Waitha raa allatheena thalamoo alAAathaba fala yukhaffafu AAanhum wala hum yuntharoona
16.translation: And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved

16.arabic: وَإِذا رَءَا الَّذينَ أَشرَكوا شُرَكاءَهُم قالوا رَبَّنا هٰؤُلاءِ شُرَكاؤُنَا الَّذينَ كُنّا نَدعوا مِن دونِكَ فَأَلقَوا إِلَيهِمُ القَولَ إِنَّكُم لَكٰذِبونَ
16.transliteration: Waitha raa allatheena ashrakoo shurakaahum qaloo rabbana haolai shurakaona allatheena kunna nadAAoo min doonika faalqaw ilayhimu alqawla innakum lakathiboona
16.translation: And when those who ascribed partners to Allah behold those partners of theirs, they will say: Our Lord! these are our partners unto whom we used to cry instead of Thee. But they will fling to them the saying: Lo! ye verily are liars

16.arabic: وَأَلقَوا إِلَى اللَّهِ يَومَئِذٍ السَّلَمَ وَضَلَّ عَنهُم ما كانوا يَفتَرونَ
16.transliteration: Waalqaw ila Allahi yawmaithin alssalama wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona
16.translation: And they proffer unto Allah submission on that day, and all that they used to invent hath failed them

16.arabic: الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَصَدّوا عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ زِدنٰهُم عَذابًا فَوقَ العَذابِ بِما كانوا يُفسِدونَ
16.transliteration: Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi zidnahum AAathaban fawqa alAAathabi bima kanoo yufsidoona
16.translation: For those who disbelieve and debar (men) from the way of Allah, We add doom to doom because they wrought corruption

16.arabic: وَيَومَ نَبعَثُ فى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ شَهيدًا عَلَيهِم مِن أَنفُسِهِم وَجِئنا بِكَ شَهيدًا عَلىٰ هٰؤُلاءِ وَنَزَّلنا عَلَيكَ الكِتٰبَ تِبيٰنًا لِكُلِّ شَيءٍ وَهُدًى وَرَحمَةً وَبُشرىٰ لِلمُسلِمينَ
16.transliteration: Wayawma nabAAathu fee kulli ommatin shaheedan AAalayhim min anfusihim wajina bika shaheedan AAala haolai wanazzalna AAalayka alkitaba tibyanan likulli shayin wahudan warahmatan wabushra lilmuslimeena
16.translation: And (bethink you of) the day when We raise in every nation a witness against them of their own folk, and We bring thee (Muhammad) as a witness against these. And We reveal the Scripture unto thee as an exposition of all things, and a guidance and a mercy and good tidings for those who have surrendered (to Allah)

16.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأمُرُ بِالعَدلِ وَالإِحسٰنِ وَإيتائِ ذِى القُربىٰ وَيَنهىٰ عَنِ الفَحشاءِ وَالمُنكَرِ وَالبَغىِ يَعِظُكُم لَعَلَّكُم تَذَكَّرونَ
16.transliteration: Inna Allaha yamuru bialAAadli waalihsani waeetai thee alqurba wayanha AAani alfahshai waalmunkari waalbaghyi yaAAithukum laAAallakum tathakkaroona
16.translation: Lo! Allah enjoineth justice and kindness, and giving to kinsfolk, and forbiddeth lewdness and abomination and wickedness. He exhorteth you in order that ye may take heed
