18.translation: I think not that the Hour will ever come, and if indeed I am brought back unto my Lord I surely shall find better than this as a resort

18.arabic: قالَ لَهُ صاحِبُهُ وَهُوَ يُحاوِرُهُ أَكَفَرتَ بِالَّذى خَلَقَكَ مِن تُرابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُطفَةٍ ثُمَّ سَوّىٰكَ رَجُلًا
18.transliteration: Qala lahu sahibuhu wahuwa yuhawiruhu akafarta biallathee khalaqaka min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma sawwaka rajulan
18.translation: His comrade, when he (thus) spake with him, exclaimed: Disbelievest thou in Him Who created thee of dust, then of a drop (of seed), and then fashioned thee a man

18.arabic: لٰكِنّا۠ هُوَ اللَّهُ رَبّى وَلا أُشرِكُ بِرَبّى أَحَدًا
18.transliteration: Lakinna huwa Allahu rabbee wala oshriku birabbee ahadan
18.translation: But He is Allah, my Lord, and I ascribe unto my Lord no partner

18.arabic: وَلَولا إِذ دَخَلتَ جَنَّتَكَ قُلتَ ما شاءَ اللَّهُ لا قُوَّةَ إِلّا بِاللَّهِ إِن تَرَنِ أَنا۠ أَقَلَّ مِنكَ مالًا وَوَلَدًا
18.transliteration: Walawla ith dakhalta jannataka qulta ma shaa Allahu la quwwata illa biAllahi in tarani ana aqalla minka malan wawaladan
18.translation: If only, when thou enteredst thy garden, thou hadst said: That which Allah willeth (will come to pass)! There is no strength save in Allah! Though thou seest me as less than thee in wealth and children

18.arabic: فَعَسىٰ رَبّى أَن يُؤتِيَنِ خَيرًا مِن جَنَّتِكَ وَيُرسِلَ عَلَيها حُسبانًا مِنَ السَّماءِ فَتُصبِحَ صَعيدًا زَلَقًا
18.transliteration: FaAAasa rabbee an yutiyani khayran min jannatika wayursila AAalayha husbanan mina alssamai fatusbiha saAAeedan zalaqan
18.translation: Yet it may be that my Lord will give me better than thy garden, and will send on it a bolt from heaven, and some morning it will be a smooth hillside

18.arabic: أَو يُصبِحَ ماؤُها غَورًا فَلَن تَستَطيعَ لَهُ طَلَبًا
18.transliteration: Aw yusbiha maoha ghawran falan tastateeAAa lahu talaban
18.translation: Or some morning the water thereof will be lost in the earth so that thou canst not make search for it

18.arabic: وَأُحيطَ بِثَمَرِهِ فَأَصبَحَ يُقَلِّبُ كَفَّيهِ عَلىٰ ما أَنفَقَ فيها وَهِىَ خاوِيَةٌ عَلىٰ عُروشِها وَيَقولُ يٰلَيتَنى لَم أُشرِك بِرَبّى أَحَدًا
18.transliteration: Waoheeta bithamarihi faasbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi AAala ma anfaqa feeha wahiya khawiyatun AAala AAurooshiha wayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oshrik birabbee ahadan
18.translation: And his fruit was beset (with destruction). Then began he to wring his hands for all that he had spent upon it, when (now) it was all ruined on its trellises, and to say: Would that I had ascribed no partner to my Lord

18.arabic: وَلَم تَكُن لَهُ فِئَةٌ يَنصُرونَهُ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ وَما كانَ مُنتَصِرًا
18.transliteration: Walam takun lahu fiatun yansuroonahu min dooni Allahi wama kana muntasiran
18.translation: And he had no troop of men to help him as against Allah, nor could he save himself

18.arabic: هُنالِكَ الوَلٰيَةُ لِلَّهِ الحَقِّ هُوَ خَيرٌ ثَوابًا وَخَيرٌ عُقبًا
18.transliteration: Hunalika alwalayatu lillahi alhaqqi huwa khayrun thawaban wakhayrun AAuqban
18.translation: In this case is protection only from Allah, the True, He is Best for reward, and best for consequence

18.arabic: وَاضرِب لَهُم مَثَلَ الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا كَماءٍ أَنزَلنٰهُ مِنَ السَّماءِ فَاختَلَطَ بِهِ نَباتُ الأَرضِ فَأَصبَحَ هَشيمًا تَذروهُ الرِّيٰحُ وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ مُقتَدِرًا
18.transliteration: Waidrib lahum mathala alhayati alddunya kamain anzalnahu mina alssamai faikhtalata bihi nabatu alardi faasbaha hasheeman tathroohu alrriyahu wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin muqtadiran
18.translation: And coin for them the similitude of the life of the world as water which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingleth with it and then becometh dry twigs that the winds scatter. Allah is able to do all things

18.arabic: المالُ وَالبَنونَ زينَةُ الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا وَالبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوابًا وَخَيرٌ أَمَلًا
18.transliteration: Almalu waalbanoona zeenatu alhayati alddunya waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun amalan
18.translation: Wealth and children are an ornament of the life of the world. But the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better in respect of hope

18.arabic: وَيَومَ نُسَيِّرُ الجِبالَ وَتَرَى الأَرضَ بارِزَةً وَحَشَرنٰهُم فَلَم نُغادِر مِنهُم أَحَدًا
18.transliteration: Wayawma nusayyiru aljibala watara alarda barizatan wahasharnahum falam nughadir minhum ahadan
18.translation: And (bethink you of) the Day when we remove the hills and ye see the earth emerging, and We gather them together so as to leave not one of them behind

18.arabic: وَعُرِضوا عَلىٰ رَبِّكَ صَفًّا لَقَد جِئتُمونا كَما خَلَقنٰكُم أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ بَل زَعَمتُم أَلَّن نَجعَلَ لَكُم مَوعِدًا
18.transliteration: WaAAuridoo AAala rabbika saffan laqad jitumoona kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin bal zaAAamtum allan najAAala lakum mawAAidan
18.translation: And they are set before thy Lord in ranks (and it is said unto them): Now verily have ye come unto Us as We created you at the first. But ye thought that We had set no tryst for you

18.arabic: وَوُضِعَ الكِتٰبُ فَتَرَى المُجرِمينَ مُشفِقينَ مِمّا فيهِ وَيَقولونَ يٰوَيلَتَنا مالِ هٰذَا الكِتٰبِ لا يُغادِرُ صَغيرَةً وَلا كَبيرَةً إِلّا أَحصىٰها وَوَجَدوا ما عَمِلوا حاضِرًا وَلا يَظلِمُ رَبُّكَ أَحَدًا
18.transliteration: WawudiAAa alkitabu fatara almujrimeena mushfiqeena mimma feehi wayaqooloona ya waylatana ma lihatha alkitabi la yughadiru sagheeratan wala kabeeratan illa ahsaha wawajadoo ma AAamiloo hadiran wala yathlimu rabbuka ahadan
18.translation: And the Book is placed, and thou seest the guilty fearful of that which is therein, and they say: What kind of a Book is this that leaveth not a small thing nor a great thing but hath counted it! And they find all that they did confronting them, and thy Lord wrongeth no-one

18.arabic: وَإِذ قُلنا لِلمَلٰئِكَةِ اسجُدوا لِءادَمَ فَسَجَدوا إِلّا إِبليسَ كانَ مِنَ الجِنِّ فَفَسَقَ عَن أَمرِ رَبِّهِ أَفَتَتَّخِذونَهُ وَذُرِّيَّتَهُ أَولِياءَ مِن دونى وَهُم لَكُم عَدُوٌّ بِئسَ لِلظّٰلِمينَ بَدَلًا
18.transliteration: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa kana mina aljinni fafasaqa AAan amri rabbihi afatattakhithoonahu wathurriyyatahu awliyaa min doonee wahum lakum AAaduwwun bisa lilththalimeena badalan
18.translation: And (remember) when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, and they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He was of the jinn, so he rebelled against his Lord's command. Will ye choose him and his seed for your protecting friends instead of Me, when they are an enemy unto you? Calamitous is the exchange for evil-doers

18.arabic: ما أَشهَدتُهُم خَلقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَلا خَلقَ أَنفُسِهِم وَما كُنتُ مُتَّخِذَ المُضِلّينَ عَضُدًا
18.transliteration: Ma ashhadtuhum khalqa alssamawati waalardi wala khalqa anfusihim wama kuntu muttakhitha almudilleena AAadudan
18.translation: I made them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor their own creation; nor choose I misleaders for (My) helpers

18.arabic: وَيَومَ يَقولُ نادوا شُرَكاءِىَ الَّذينَ زَعَمتُم فَدَعَوهُم فَلَم يَستَجيبوا لَهُم وَجَعَلنا بَينَهُم مَوبِقًا
18.transliteration: Wayawma yaqoolu nadoo shurakaiya allatheena zaAAamtum fadaAAawhum falam yastajeeboo lahum wajaAAalna baynahum mawbiqan
18.translation: And (be mindful of) the Day when He will say: Call those partners of Mine whom ye pretended. Then they will cry unto them, but they will not hear their prayer, and We shall set a gulf of doom between them

18.arabic: وَرَءَا المُجرِمونَ النّارَ فَظَنّوا أَنَّهُم مُواقِعوها وَلَم يَجِدوا عَنها مَصرِفًا
18.transliteration: Waraa almujrimoona alnnara fathannoo annahum muwaqiAAooha walam yajidoo AAanha masrifan
18.translation: And the guilty behold the Fire and know that they are about to fall therein, and they find no way of escape thence

18.arabic: وَلَقَد صَرَّفنا فى هٰذَا القُرءانِ لِلنّاسِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ وَكانَ الإِنسٰنُ أَكثَرَ شَيءٍ جَدَلًا
18.transliteration: Walaqad sarrafna fee hatha alqurani lilnnasi min kulli mathalin wakana alinsanu akthara shayin jadalan
18.translation: And verily We have displayed for mankind in this Qur'an all manner of similitudes, but man is more than anything contentious

18.arabic: وَما مَنَعَ النّاسَ أَن يُؤمِنوا إِذ جاءَهُمُ الهُدىٰ وَيَستَغفِروا رَبَّهُم إِلّا أَن تَأتِيَهُم سُنَّةُ الأَوَّلينَ أَو يَأتِيَهُمُ العَذابُ قُبُلًا
18.transliteration: Wama manaAAa alnnasa an yuminoo ith jaahumu alhuda wayastaghfiroo rabbahum illa an tatiyahum sunnatu alawwaleena aw yatiyahumu alAAathabu qubulan
18.translation: And naught hindereth mankind from believing when the guidance cometh unto them, and from asking forgiveness of their Lord unless (it be that they wish) that the judgment of the men of old should come upon them or (that) they should be confronted with the Doom

18.arabic: وَما نُرسِلُ المُرسَلينَ إِلّا مُبَشِّرينَ وَمُنذِرينَ وَيُجٰدِلُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا بِالبٰطِلِ لِيُدحِضوا بِهِ الحَقَّ وَاتَّخَذوا ءايٰتى وَما أُنذِروا هُزُوًا
18.transliteration: Wama nursilu almursaleena illa mubashshireena wamunthireena wayujadilu allatheena kafaroo bialbatili liyudhidoo bihi alhaqqa waittakhathoo ayatee wama onthiroo huzuwan
18.translation: We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Those who disbelieve contend with falsehood in order to refute the Truth thereby. And they take Our revelations and that wherewith they are threatened as a jest

18.arabic: وَمَن أَظلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـٔايٰتِ رَبِّهِ فَأَعرَضَ عَنها وَنَسِىَ ما قَدَّمَت يَداهُ إِنّا جَعَلنا عَلىٰ قُلوبِهِم أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفقَهوهُ وَفى ءاذانِهِم وَقرًا وَإِن تَدعُهُم إِلَى الهُدىٰ فَلَن يَهتَدوا إِذًا أَبَدًا
18.transliteration: Waman athlamu mimman thukkira biayati rabbihi faaAArada AAanha wanasiya ma qaddamat yadahu inna jaAAalna AAala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran wain tadAAuhum ila alhuda falan yahtadoo ithan abadan
18.translation: And who doth greater wrong than he who hath been reminded of the revelations of his Lord, yet turneth away from them and forgetteth what his hands send forward (to the Judgment)? Lo! on their hearts We have placed coverings so that they understand not, and in their ears a deafness. And though thou call them to the guidance, in that case they can never be led aright

18.arabic: وَرَبُّكَ الغَفورُ ذُو الرَّحمَةِ لَو يُؤاخِذُهُم بِما كَسَبوا لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ العَذابَ بَل لَهُم مَوعِدٌ لَن يَجِدوا مِن دونِهِ مَوئِلًا
18.transliteration: Warabbuka alghafooru thoo alrrahmati law yuakhithuhum bima kasaboo laAAajjala lahumu alAAathaba bal lahum mawAAidun lan yajidoo min doonihi mawilan
18.translation: Thy Lord is the Forgiver, Full of Mercy. If He took them to task (now) for what they earn, He would hasten on the doom for them; but theirs is an appointed term from which they will find no escape

18.arabic: وَتِلكَ القُرىٰ أَهلَكنٰهُم لَمّا ظَلَموا وَجَعَلنا لِمَهلِكِهِم مَوعِدًا
18.transliteration: Watilka alqura ahlaknahum lamma thalamoo wajaAAalna limahlikihim mawAAidan
18.translation: And (all) those townships! We destroyed them when they did wrong, and We appointed a fixed time for their destruction

18.arabic: وَإِذ قالَ موسىٰ لِفَتىٰهُ لا أَبرَحُ حَتّىٰ أَبلُغَ مَجمَعَ البَحرَينِ أَو أَمضِىَ حُقُبًا
18.transliteration: Waith qala moosa lifatahu la abrahu hatta ablugha majmaAAa albahrayni aw amdiya huquban
18.translation: And when Moses said unto his servant: I will not give up until I reach the point where the two rivers meet, though I march on for ages

18.arabic: فَلَمّا بَلَغا مَجمَعَ بَينِهِما نَسِيا حوتَهُما فَاتَّخَذَ سَبيلَهُ فِى البَحرِ سَرَبًا
18.transliteration: Falamma balagha majmaAAa baynihima nasiya hootahuma faittakhatha sabeelahu fee albahri saraban
18.translation: And when they reached the point where the two met, they forgot their fish, and it took its way into the waters, being free

18.arabic: فَلَمّا جاوَزا قالَ لِفَتىٰهُ ءاتِنا غَداءَنا لَقَد لَقينا مِن سَفَرِنا هٰذا نَصَبًا
18.transliteration: Falamma jawaza qala lifatahu atina ghadaana laqad laqeena min safarina hatha nasaban
18.translation: And when they had gone further, he said unto his servant: Bring us our breakfast. Verily we have found fatigue in this our journey

18.arabic: قالَ أَرَءَيتَ إِذ أَوَينا إِلَى الصَّخرَةِ فَإِنّى نَسيتُ الحوتَ وَما أَنسىٰنيهُ إِلَّا الشَّيطٰنُ أَن أَذكُرَهُ وَاتَّخَذَ سَبيلَهُ فِى البَحرِ عَجَبًا
18.transliteration: Qala araayta ith awayna ila alssakhrati fainnee naseetu alhoota wama ansaneehu illa alshshaytanu an athkurahu waittakhatha sabeelahu fee albahri AAajaban
18.translation: He said: Didst thou see, when we took refuge on the rock, and I forgot the fish - and none but Satan caused me to forget to mention it - it took its way into the waters by a marvel

18.arabic: قالَ ذٰلِكَ ما كُنّا نَبغِ فَارتَدّا عَلىٰ ءاثارِهِما قَصَصًا
18.transliteration: Qala thalika ma kunna nabghi fairtadda AAala atharihima qasasan
18.translation: He said: This is that which we have been seeking. So they retraced their steps again

18.arabic: فَوَجَدا عَبدًا مِن عِبادِنا ءاتَينٰهُ رَحمَةً مِن عِندِنا وَعَلَّمنٰهُ مِن لَدُنّا عِلمًا
18.transliteration: Fawajada AAabdan min AAibadina ataynahu rahmatan min AAindina waAAallamnahu min ladunna AAilman
18.translation: Then found they one of Our slaves, unto whom We had given mercy from Us, and had taught him knowledge from Our presence

18.arabic: قالَ لَهُ موسىٰ هَل أَتَّبِعُكَ عَلىٰ أَن تُعَلِّمَنِ مِمّا عُلِّمتَ رُشدًا
18.transliteration: Qala lahu moosa hal attabiAAuka AAala an tuAAallimani mimma AAullimta rushdan
18.translation: Moses said unto him: May I follow thee, to the end that thou mayst teach me right conduct of that which thou hast been taught

18.arabic: قالَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَستَطيعَ مَعِىَ صَبرًا
18.transliteration: Qala innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran
18.translation: He said: Lo! thou canst not bear with me

18.arabic: وَكَيفَ تَصبِرُ عَلىٰ ما لَم تُحِط بِهِ خُبرًا
18.transliteration: Wakayfa tasbiru AAala ma lam tuhit bihi khubran
18.translation: How canst thou bear with that whereof thou canst not compass any knowledge

18.arabic: قالَ سَتَجِدُنى إِن شاءَ اللَّهُ صابِرًا وَلا أَعصى لَكَ أَمرًا
18.transliteration: Qala satajidunee in shaa Allahu sabiran wala aAAsee laka amran
18.translation: He said: Allah willing, thou shalt find me patient and I shall not in aught gainsay thee

18.arabic: قالَ فَإِنِ اتَّبَعتَنى فَلا تَسـَٔلنى عَن شَيءٍ حَتّىٰ أُحدِثَ لَكَ مِنهُ ذِكرًا
18.transliteration: Qala faini ittabaAAtanee fala tasalnee AAan shayin hatta ohditha laka minhu thikran
18.translation: He said: Well, if thou go with me, ask me not concerning aught till I myself make mention of it unto thee

18.arabic: فَانطَلَقا حَتّىٰ إِذا رَكِبا فِى السَّفينَةِ خَرَقَها قالَ أَخَرَقتَها لِتُغرِقَ أَهلَها لَقَد جِئتَ شَيـًٔا إِمرًا
18.transliteration: Faintalaqa hatta itha rakiba fee alssafeenati kharaqaha qala akharaqtaha litughriqa ahlaha laqad jita shayan imran
18.translation: So they twain set out till, when they were in the ship, he made a hole therein. (Moses) said: Hast thou made a hole therein to drown the folk thereof? Thou verily hast done a dreadful thing

18.arabic: قالَ أَلَم أَقُل إِنَّكَ لَن تَستَطيعَ مَعِىَ صَبرًا
18.transliteration: Qala alam aqul innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran
18.translation: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me

18.arabic: قالَ لا تُؤاخِذنى بِما نَسيتُ وَلا تُرهِقنى مِن أَمرى عُسرًا
18.transliteration: Qala la tuakhithnee bima naseetu wala turhiqnee min amree AAusran
18.translation: (Moses) said: Be not wroth with me that I forgot, and be not hard upon me for my fault

18.arabic: فَانطَلَقا حَتّىٰ إِذا لَقِيا غُلٰمًا فَقَتَلَهُ قالَ أَقَتَلتَ نَفسًا زَكِيَّةً بِغَيرِ نَفسٍ لَقَد جِئتَ شَيـًٔا نُكرًا
18.transliteration: Faintalaqa hatta itha laqiya ghulaman faqatalahu qala aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad jita shayan nukran
18.translation: So they twain journeyed on till, when they met a lad, he slew him. (Moses) said: What! Hast thou slain an innocent soul who hath slain no man? Verily thou hast done a horrid thing

18.arabic: قالَ أَلَم أَقُل لَكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَستَطيعَ مَعِىَ صَبرًا
18.transliteration: Qala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran
18.translation: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me

18.arabic: قالَ إِن سَأَلتُكَ عَن شَيءٍ بَعدَها فَلا تُصٰحِبنى قَد بَلَغتَ مِن لَدُنّى عُذرًا
18.transliteration: Qala in saaltuka AAan shayin baAAdaha fala tusahibnee qad balaghta min ladunnee AAuthran
18.translation: (Moses) said: If I ask thee after this concerning aught, keep not company with me. Thou hast received an excuse from me

18.arabic: فَانطَلَقا حَتّىٰ إِذا أَتَيا أَهلَ قَريَةٍ استَطعَما أَهلَها فَأَبَوا أَن يُضَيِّفوهُما فَوَجَدا فيها جِدارًا يُريدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقامَهُ قالَ لَو شِئتَ لَتَّخَذتَ عَلَيهِ أَجرًا
18.transliteration: Faintalaqa hatta itha ataya ahla qaryatin istatAAama ahlaha faabaw an yudayyifoohuma fawajada feeha jidaran yureedu an yanqadda faaqamahu qala law shita laittakhathta AAalayhi ajran
18.translation: So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it

18.arabic: قالَ هٰذا فِراقُ بَينى وَبَينِكَ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأويلِ ما لَم تَستَطِع عَلَيهِ صَبرًا
18.transliteration: Qala hatha firaqu baynee wabaynika saonabbioka bitaweeli ma lam tastatiAA AAalayhi sabran
18.translation: He said: This is the parting between thee and me! I will announce unto thee the interpretation of that thou couldst not bear with patience

18.arabic: أَمَّا السَّفينَةُ فَكانَت لِمَسٰكينَ يَعمَلونَ فِى البَحرِ فَأَرَدتُ أَن أَعيبَها وَكانَ وَراءَهُم مَلِكٌ يَأخُذُ كُلَّ سَفينَةٍ غَصبًا
18.transliteration: Amma alssafeenatu fakanat limasakeena yaAAmaloona fee albahri faaradtu an aAAeebaha wakana waraahum malikun yakhuthu kulla safeenatin ghasban
18.translation: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force

18.arabic: وَأَمَّا الغُلٰمُ فَكانَ أَبَواهُ مُؤمِنَينِ فَخَشينا أَن يُرهِقَهُما طُغيٰنًا وَكُفرًا
18.transliteration: Waamma alghulamu fakana abawahu muminayni fakhasheena an yurhiqahuma tughyanan wakufran
18.translation: And as for the lad, his parents were believers and we feared lest he should oppress them by rebellion and disbelief

18.arabic: فَأَرَدنا أَن يُبدِلَهُما رَبُّهُما خَيرًا مِنهُ زَكوٰةً وَأَقرَبَ رُحمًا
18.transliteration: Faaradna an yubdilahuma rabbuhuma khayran minhu zakatan waaqraba ruhman
18.translation: And we intended that their Lord should change him for them for one better in purity and nearer to mercy

18.arabic: وَأَمَّا الجِدارُ فَكانَ لِغُلٰمَينِ يَتيمَينِ فِى المَدينَةِ وَكانَ تَحتَهُ كَنزٌ لَهُما وَكانَ أَبوهُما صٰلِحًا فَأَرادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبلُغا أَشُدَّهُما وَيَستَخرِجا كَنزَهُما رَحمَةً مِن رَبِّكَ وَما فَعَلتُهُ عَن أَمرى ذٰلِكَ تَأويلُ ما لَم تَسطِع عَلَيهِ صَبرًا
18.transliteration: Waamma aljidaru fakana lighulamayni yateemayni fee almadeenati wakana tahtahu kanzun lahuma wakana aboohuma salihan faarada rabbuka an yablugha ashuddahuma wayastakhrija kanzahuma rahmatan min rabbika wama faAAaltuhu AAan amree thalika taweelu ma lam tastiAA AAalayhi sabran
18.translation: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear

18.arabic: وَيَسـَٔلونَكَ عَن ذِى القَرنَينِ قُل سَأَتلوا عَلَيكُم مِنهُ ذِكرًا
18.transliteration: Wayasaloonaka AAan thee alqarnayni qul saatloo AAalaykum minhu thikran
18.translation: They will ask thee of Dhu'l-Qarneyn. Say: I shall recite unto you a remembrance of him

18.arabic: إِنّا مَكَّنّا لَهُ فِى الأَرضِ وَءاتَينٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَيءٍ سَبَبًا
18.transliteration: Inna makkanna lahu fee alardi waataynahu min kulli shayin sababan
18.translation: Lo! We made him strong in the land and gave him unto every thing a road

18.arabic: فَأَتبَعَ سَبَبًا
18.transliteration: FaatbaAAa sababan
18.translation: And he followed a road

18.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا بَلَغَ مَغرِبَ الشَّمسِ وَجَدَها تَغرُبُ فى عَينٍ حَمِئَةٍ وَوَجَدَ عِندَها قَومًا قُلنا يٰذَا القَرنَينِ إِمّا أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمّا أَن تَتَّخِذَ فيهِم حُسنًا
18.transliteration: Hatta itha balagha maghriba alshshamsi wajadaha taghrubu fee AAaynin hamiatin wawajada AAindaha qawman qulna ya tha alqarnayni imma an tuAAaththiba waimma an tattakhitha feehim husnan
18.translation: Till, when he reached the setting-place of the sun, he found it setting in a muddy spring, and found a people thereabout. We said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Either punish or show them kindness

18.arabic: قالَ أَمّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوفَ نُعَذِّبُهُ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِ فَيُعَذِّبُهُ عَذابًا نُكرًا
18.transliteration: Qala amma man thalama fasawfa nuAAaththibuhu thumma yuraddu ila rabbihi fayuAAaththibuhu AAathaban nukran
18.translation: He said: As for him who doeth wrong, we shall punish him, and then he will be brought back unto his Lord, Who will punish him with awful punishment

18.arabic: وَأَمّا مَن ءامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صٰلِحًا فَلَهُ جَزاءً الحُسنىٰ وَسَنَقولُ لَهُ مِن أَمرِنا يُسرًا
18.transliteration: Waamma man amana waAAamila salihan falahu jazaan alhusna wasanaqoolu lahu min amrina yusran
18.translation: But as for him who believeth and doeth right, good will be his reward, and We shall speak unto him a mild command

18.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتبَعَ سَبَبًا
18.transliteration: Thumma atbaAAa sababan
18.translation: Then he followed a road

18.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا بَلَغَ مَطلِعَ الشَّمسِ وَجَدَها تَطلُعُ عَلىٰ قَومٍ لَم نَجعَل لَهُم مِن دونِها سِترًا
18.transliteration: Hatta itha balagha matliAAa alshshamsi wajadaha tatluAAu AAala qawmin lam najAAal lahum min dooniha sitran
18.translation: Till, when he reached the rising-place of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had appointed no shelter therefrom

18.arabic: كَذٰلِكَ وَقَد أَحَطنا بِما لَدَيهِ خُبرًا
18.transliteration: Kathalika waqad ahatna bima ladayhi khubran
18.translation: So (it was). And We knew all concerning him

18.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتبَعَ سَبَبًا
18.transliteration: Thumma atbaAAa sababan
18.translation: Then he followed a road

18.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا بَلَغَ بَينَ السَّدَّينِ وَجَدَ مِن دونِهِما قَومًا لا يَكادونَ يَفقَهونَ قَولًا
18.transliteration: Hatta itha balagha bayna alssaddayni wajada min doonihima qawman la yakadoona yafqahoona qawlan
18.translation: Till, when he came between the two mountains, he found upon their hither side a folk that scarce could understand a saying

18.arabic: قالوا يٰذَا القَرنَينِ إِنَّ يَأجوجَ وَمَأجوجَ مُفسِدونَ فِى الأَرضِ فَهَل نَجعَلُ لَكَ خَرجًا عَلىٰ أَن تَجعَلَ بَينَنا وَبَينَهُم سَدًّا
18.transliteration: Qaloo ya tha alqarnayni inna yajooja wamajooja mufsidoona fee alardi fahal najAAalu laka kharjan AAala an tajAAala baynana wabaynahum saddan
18.translation: They said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Lo! Gog and Magog are spoiling the land. So may we pay thee tribute on condition that thou set a barrier between us and them

18.arabic: قالَ ما مَكَّنّى فيهِ رَبّى خَيرٌ فَأَعينونى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجعَل بَينَكُم وَبَينَهُم رَدمًا
18.transliteration: Qala ma makkannee feehi rabbee khayrun faaAAeenoonee biquwwatin ajAAal baynakum wabaynahum radman
18.translation: He said: That wherein my Lord hath established me is better (than your tribute). Do but help me with strength (of men), I will set between you and them a bank

18.arabic: ءاتونى زُبَرَ الحَديدِ حَتّىٰ إِذا ساوىٰ بَينَ الصَّدَفَينِ قالَ انفُخوا حَتّىٰ إِذا جَعَلَهُ نارًا قالَ ءاتونى أُفرِغ عَلَيهِ قِطرًا
18.transliteration: Atoonee zubara alhadeedi hatta itha sawa bayna alsadafayni qala onfukhoo hatta itha jaAAalahu naran qala atoonee ofrigh AAalayhi qitran
18.translation: Give me pieces of iron - till, when he had levelled up (the gap) between the cliffs, he said: Blow! - till, when he had made it a fire, he said: Bring me molten copper to pour thereon

18.arabic: فَمَا اسطٰعوا أَن يَظهَروهُ وَمَا استَطٰعوا لَهُ نَقبًا
18.transliteration: Fama istaAAoo an yathharoohu wama istataAAoo lahu naqban
18.translation: And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it)

18.arabic: قالَ هٰذا رَحمَةٌ مِن رَبّى فَإِذا جاءَ وَعدُ رَبّى جَعَلَهُ دَكّاءَ وَكانَ وَعدُ رَبّى حَقًّا
18.transliteration: Qala hatha rahmatun min rabbee faitha jaa waAAdu rabbee jaAAalahu dakkaa wakana waAAdu rabbee haqqan
18.translation: He said: This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord cometh to pass, He will lay it low, for the promise of my Lord is true

18.arabic: وَتَرَكنا بَعضَهُم يَومَئِذٍ يَموجُ فى بَعضٍ وَنُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ فَجَمَعنٰهُم جَمعًا
18.transliteration: Watarakna baAAdahum yawmaithin yamooju fee baAAdin wanufikha fee alssoori fajamaAAnahum jamAAan
18.translation: And on that day we shall let some of them surge against others, and the Trumpet will be blown. Then We shall gather them together in one gathering

18.arabic: وَعَرَضنا جَهَنَّمَ يَومَئِذٍ لِلكٰفِرينَ عَرضًا
18.transliteration: WaAAaradna jahannama yawmaithin lilkafireena AAardan
18.translation: On that day we shall present hell to the disbelievers, plain to view

18.arabic: الَّذينَ كانَت أَعيُنُهُم فى غِطاءٍ عَن ذِكرى وَكانوا لا يَستَطيعونَ سَمعًا
18.transliteration: Allatheena kanat aAAyunuhum fee ghitain AAan thikree wakanoo la yastateeAAoona samAAan
18.translation: Those whose eyes were hoodwinked from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear

18.arabic: أَفَحَسِبَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا أَن يَتَّخِذوا عِبادى مِن دونى أَولِياءَ إِنّا أَعتَدنا جَهَنَّمَ لِلكٰفِرينَ نُزُلًا
18.transliteration: Afahasiba allatheena kafaroo an yattakhithoo AAibadee min doonee awliyaa inna aAAtadna jahannama lilkafireena nuzulan
18.translation: Do the disbelievers reckon that they can choose My bondmen as protecting friends beside Me? Lo! We have prepared hell as a welcome for the disbelievers

18.arabic: قُل هَل نُنَبِّئُكُم بِالأَخسَرينَ أَعمٰلًا
18.transliteration: Qul hal nunabbiokum bialakhsareena aAAmalan
18.translation: Say: Shall We inform you who will be the greatest losers by their works

18.arabic: الَّذينَ ضَلَّ سَعيُهُم فِى الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا وَهُم يَحسَبونَ أَنَّهُم يُحسِنونَ صُنعًا
18.transliteration: Allatheena dalla saAAyuhum fee alhayati alddunya wahum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sunAAan
18.translation: Those whose effort goeth astray in the life of the world, and yet they reckon that they do good work

18.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا بِـٔايٰتِ رَبِّهِم وَلِقائِهِ فَحَبِطَت أَعمٰلُهُم فَلا نُقيمُ لَهُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ وَزنًا
18.transliteration: Olaika allatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim waliqaihi fahabitat aAAmaluhum fala nuqeemu lahum yawma alqiyamati waznan
18.translation: Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them

18.arabic: ذٰلِكَ جَزاؤُهُم جَهَنَّمُ بِما كَفَروا وَاتَّخَذوا ءايٰتى وَرُسُلى هُزُوًا
18.transliteration: Thalika jazaohum jahannamu bima kafaroo waittakhathoo ayatee warusulee huzuwan
18.translation: That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers

18.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كانَت لَهُم جَنّٰتُ الفِردَوسِ نُزُلًا
18.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kanat lahum jannatu alfirdawsi nuzulan
18.translation: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs are the Gardens of Paradise for welcome

18.arabic: خٰلِدينَ فيها لا يَبغونَ عَنها حِوَلًا
18.transliteration: Khalideena feeha la yabghoona AAanha hiwalan
18.translation: Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence

18.arabic: قُل لَو كانَ البَحرُ مِدادًا لِكَلِمٰتِ رَبّى لَنَفِدَ البَحرُ قَبلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمٰتُ رَبّى وَلَو جِئنا بِمِثلِهِ مَدَدًا
18.transliteration: Qul law kana albahru midadan likalimati rabbee lanafida albahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbee walaw jina bimithlihi madadan
18.translation: Say: Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord, verily the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even though We brought the like thereof to help

18.arabic: قُل إِنَّما أَنا۠ بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُم يوحىٰ إِلَىَّ أَنَّما إِلٰهُكُم إِلٰهٌ وٰحِدٌ فَمَن كانَ يَرجوا لِقاءَ رَبِّهِ فَليَعمَل عَمَلًا صٰلِحًا وَلا يُشرِك بِعِبادَةِ رَبِّهِ أَحَدًا
18.transliteration: Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun faman kana yarjoo liqaa rabbihi falyaAAmal AAamalan salihan wala yushrik biAAibadati rabbihi ahadan
18.translation: Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord

19.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ كهيعص
19.transliteration: KafhayaAAaynsad
19.translation: Kaf. Ha. Ya. A'in. Sad

19.arabic: ذِكرُ رَحمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبدَهُ زَكَرِيّا
19.transliteration: Thikru rahmati rabbika AAabdahu zakariyya
19.translation: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah

19.arabic: إِذ نادىٰ رَبَّهُ نِداءً خَفِيًّا
19.transliteration: Ith nada rabbahu nidaan khafiyyan
19.translation: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret

19.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ إِنّى وَهَنَ العَظمُ مِنّى وَاشتَعَلَ الرَّأسُ شَيبًا وَلَم أَكُن بِدُعائِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qala rabbi innee wahana alAAathmu minnee waishtaAAala alrrasu shayban walam akun biduAAaika rabbi shaqiyyan
19.translation: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord

19.arabic: وَإِنّى خِفتُ المَوٰلِىَ مِن وَراءى وَكانَتِ امرَأَتى عاقِرًا فَهَب لى مِن لَدُنكَ وَلِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wainnee khiftu almawaliya min waraee wakanati imraatee AAaqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyyan
19.translation: Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor

19.arabic: يَرِثُنى وَيَرِثُ مِن ءالِ يَعقوبَ وَاجعَلهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّا
19.transliteration: Yarithunee wayarithu min ali yaAAqooba waijAAalhu rabbi radiyyan
19.translation: Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee)

19.arabic: يٰزَكَرِيّا إِنّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ اسمُهُ يَحيىٰ لَم نَجعَل لَهُ مِن قَبلُ سَمِيًّا
19.transliteration: Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka bighulamin ismuhu yahya lam najAAal lahu min qablu samiyyan
19.translation: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him)

19.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ أَنّىٰ يَكونُ لى غُلٰمٌ وَكانَتِ امرَأَتى عاقِرًا وَقَد بَلَغتُ مِنَ الكِبَرِ عِتِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun wakanati imraatee AAaqiran waqad balaghtu mina alkibari AAitiyyan
19.translation: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age

19.arabic: قالَ كَذٰلِكَ قالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَقَد خَلَقتُكَ مِن قَبلُ وَلَم تَكُ شَيـًٔا
19.transliteration: Qala kathalika qala rabbuka huwa AAalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan
19.translation: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught

19.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ اجعَل لى ءايَةً قالَ ءايَتُكَ أَلّا تُكَلِّمَ النّاسَ ثَلٰثَ لَيالٍ سَوِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalatha layalin sawiyyan
19.translation: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights

19.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلىٰ قَومِهِ مِنَ المِحرابِ فَأَوحىٰ إِلَيهِم أَن سَبِّحوا بُكرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
19.transliteration: Fakharaja AAala qawmihi mina almihrabi faawha ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan waAAashiyyan
19.translation: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night

19.arabic: يٰيَحيىٰ خُذِ الكِتٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ وَءاتَينٰهُ الحُكمَ صَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Ya yahya khuthi alkitaba biquwwatin waataynahu alhukma sabiyyan
19.translation: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child

19.arabic: وَحَنانًا مِن لَدُنّا وَزَكوٰةً وَكانَ تَقِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wahananan min ladunna wazakatan wakana taqiyyan
19.translation: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout

19.arabic: وَبَرًّا بِوٰلِدَيهِ وَلَم يَكُن جَبّارًا عَصِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wabarran biwalidayhi walam yakun jabbaran AAasiyyan
19.translation: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious

19.arabic: وَسَلٰمٌ عَلَيهِ يَومَ وُلِدَ وَيَومَ يَموتُ وَيَومَ يُبعَثُ حَيًّا
19.transliteration: Wasalamun AAalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yubAAathu hayyan
19.translation: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive

19.arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ مَريَمَ إِذِ انتَبَذَت مِن أَهلِها مَكانًا شَرقِيًّا
19.transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi maryama ithi intabathat min ahliha makanan sharqiyyan
19.translation: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East

19.arabic: فَاتَّخَذَت مِن دونِهِم حِجابًا فَأَرسَلنا إِلَيها روحَنا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَها بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
19.transliteration: Faittakhathat min doonihim hijaban faarsalna ilayha roohana fatamaththala laha basharan sawiyyan
19.translation: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man

19.arabic: قالَت إِنّى أَعوذُ بِالرَّحمٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qalat innee aAAoothu bialrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan
19.translation: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing

19.arabic: قالَ إِنَّما أَنا۠ رَسولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلٰمًا زَكِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qala innama ana rasoolu rabbiki liahaba laki ghulaman zakiyyan
19.translation: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son

19.arabic: قالَت أَنّىٰ يَكونُ لى غُلٰمٌ وَلَم يَمسَسنى بَشَرٌ وَلَم أَكُ بَغِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qalat anna yakoonu lee ghulamun walam yamsasnee basharun walam aku baghiyyan
19.translation: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste

19.arabic: قالَ كَذٰلِكِ قالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌ وَلِنَجعَلَهُ ءايَةً لِلنّاسِ وَرَحمَةً مِنّا وَكانَ أَمرًا مَقضِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qala kathaliki qala rabbuki huwa AAalayya hayyinun walinajAAalahu ayatan lilnnasi warahmatan minna wakana amran maqdiyyan
19.translation: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained

19.arabic: فَحَمَلَتهُ فَانتَبَذَت بِهِ مَكانًا قَصِيًّا
19.transliteration: Fahamalathu faintabathat bihi makanan qasiyyan
19.translation: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place

19.arabic: فَأَجاءَهَا المَخاضُ إِلىٰ جِذعِ النَّخلَةِ قالَت يٰلَيتَنى مِتُّ قَبلَ هٰذا وَكُنتُ نَسيًا مَنسِيًّا
19.transliteration: Faajaaha almakhadu ila jithAAi alnnakhlati qalat ya laytanee mittu qabla hatha wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan
19.translation: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten

19.arabic: فَنادىٰها مِن تَحتِها أَلّا تَحزَنى قَد جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحتَكِ سَرِيًّا
19.transliteration: Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzanee qad jaAAala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyan
19.translation: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee

19.arabic: وَهُزّى إِلَيكِ بِجِذعِ النَّخلَةِ تُسٰقِط عَلَيكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wahuzzee ilayki bijithAAi alnnakhlati tusaqit AAalayki rutaban janiyyan
19.translation: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee

19.arabic: فَكُلى وَاشرَبى وَقَرّى عَينًا فَإِمّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ البَشَرِ أَحَدًا فَقولى إِنّى نَذَرتُ لِلرَّحمٰنِ صَومًا فَلَن أُكَلِّمَ اليَومَ إِنسِيًّا
19.transliteration: Fakulee waishrabee waqarree AAaynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faqoolee innee nathartu lilrrahmani sawman falan okallima alyawma insiyyan
19.translation: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal

19.arabic: فَأَتَت بِهِ قَومَها تَحمِلُهُ قالوا يٰمَريَمُ لَقَد جِئتِ شَيـًٔا فَرِيًّا
19.transliteration: Faatat bihi qawmaha tahmiluhu qaloo ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyyan
19.translation: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing

19.arabic: يٰأُختَ هٰرونَ ما كانَ أَبوكِ امرَأَ سَوءٍ وَما كانَت أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّا
19.transliteration: Ya okhta haroona ma kana abooki imraa sawin wama kanat ommuki baghiyyan
19.translation: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot

19.arabic: فَأَشارَت إِلَيهِ قالوا كَيفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كانَ فِى المَهدِ صَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Faasharat ilayhi qaloo kayfa nukallimu man kana fee almahdi sabiyyan
19.translation: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy

19.arabic: قالَ إِنّى عَبدُ اللَّهِ ءاتىٰنِىَ الكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلَنى نَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qala innee AAabdu Allahi ataniya alkitaba wajaAAalanee nabiyyan
19.translation: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet

19.arabic: وَجَعَلَنى مُبارَكًا أَينَ ما كُنتُ وَأَوصٰنى بِالصَّلوٰةِ وَالزَّكوٰةِ ما دُمتُ حَيًّا
19.transliteration: WajaAAalanee mubarakan ayna ma kuntu waawsanee bialssalati waalzzakati ma dumtu hayyan
19.translation: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive

19.arabic: وَبَرًّا بِوٰلِدَتى وَلَم يَجعَلنى جَبّارًا شَقِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wabarran biwalidatee walam yajAAalnee jabbaran shaqiyyan
19.translation: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest

19.arabic: وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَومَ وُلِدتُ وَيَومَ أَموتُ وَيَومَ أُبعَثُ حَيًّا
19.transliteration: Waalssalamu AAalayya yawma wulidtu wayawma amootu wayawma obAAathu hayyan
19.translation: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive

19.arabic: ذٰلِكَ عيسَى ابنُ مَريَمَ قَولَ الحَقِّ الَّذى فيهِ يَمتَرونَ
19.transliteration: Thalika AAeesa ibnu maryama qawla alhaqqi allathee feehi yamtaroona
19.translation: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt

19.arabic: ما كانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ سُبحٰنَهُ إِذا قَضىٰ أَمرًا فَإِنَّما يَقولُ لَهُ كُن فَيَكونُ
19.transliteration: Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu
19.translation: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is

19.arabic: وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ رَبّى وَرَبُّكُم فَاعبُدوهُ هٰذا صِرٰطٌ مُستَقيمٌ
19.transliteration: Wainna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun
19.translation: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path

19.arabic: فَاختَلَفَ الأَحزابُ مِن بَينِهِم فَوَيلٌ لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن مَشهَدِ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
19.transliteration: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin AAatheemin
19.translation: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day

19.arabic: أَسمِع بِهِم وَأَبصِر يَومَ يَأتونَنا لٰكِنِ الظّٰلِمونَ اليَومَ فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
19.transliteration: AsmiAA bihim waabsir yawma yatoonana lakini alththalimoona alyawma fee dalalin mubeenin
19.translation: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest

19.arabic: وَأَنذِرهُم يَومَ الحَسرَةِ إِذ قُضِىَ الأَمرُ وَهُم فى غَفلَةٍ وَهُم لا يُؤمِنونَ
19.transliteration: Waanthirhum yawma alhasrati ith qudiya alamru wahum fee ghaflatin wahum la yuminoona
19.translation: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not

19.arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نَرِثُ الأَرضَ وَمَن عَلَيها وَإِلَينا يُرجَعونَ
19.transliteration: Inna nahnu narithu alarda waman AAalayha wailayna yurjaAAoona
19.translation: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned

19.arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ إِبرٰهيمَ إِنَّهُ كانَ صِدّيقًا نَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi ibraheema innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan
19.translation: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet

19.arabic: إِذ قالَ لِأَبيهِ يٰأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعبُدُ ما لا يَسمَعُ وَلا يُبصِرُ وَلا يُغنى عَنكَ شَيـًٔا
19.transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi ya abati lima taAAbudu ma la yasmaAAu wala yubsiru wala yughnee AAanka shayan
19.translation: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee

19.arabic: يٰأَبَتِ إِنّى قَد جاءَنى مِنَ العِلمِ ما لَم يَأتِكَ فَاتَّبِعنى أَهدِكَ صِرٰطًا سَوِيًّا
19.transliteration: Ya abati innee qad jaanee mina alAAilmi ma lam yatika faittabiAAnee ahdika siratan sawiyyan
19.translation: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path

19.arabic: يٰأَبَتِ لا تَعبُدِ الشَّيطٰنَ إِنَّ الشَّيطٰنَ كانَ لِلرَّحمٰنِ عَصِيًّا
19.transliteration: Ya abati la taAAbudi alshshaytana inna alshshaytana kana lilrrahmani AAasiyyan
19.translation: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent

19.arabic: يٰأَبَتِ إِنّى أَخافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذابٌ مِنَ الرَّحمٰنِ فَتَكونَ لِلشَّيطٰنِ وَلِيًّا
19.transliteration: Ya abati innee akhafu an yamassaka AAathabun mina alrrahmani fatakoona lilshshyatani waliyyan
19.translation: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil

19.arabic: قالَ أَراغِبٌ أَنتَ عَن ءالِهَتى يٰإِبرٰهيمُ لَئِن لَم تَنتَهِ لَأَرجُمَنَّكَ وَاهجُرنى مَلِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qala araghibun anta AAan alihatee ya ibraheemu lain lam tantahi laarjumannaka waohjurnee maliyyan
19.translation: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while

19.arabic: قالَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيكَ سَأَستَغفِرُ لَكَ رَبّى إِنَّهُ كانَ بى حَفِيًّا
19.transliteration: Qala salamun AAalayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyyan
19.translation: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me

19.arabic: وَأَعتَزِلُكُم وَما تَدعونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ وَأَدعوا رَبّى عَسىٰ أَلّا أَكونَ بِدُعاءِ رَبّى شَقِيًّا
19.transliteration: WaaAAtazilukum wama tadAAoona min dooni Allahi waadAAoo rabbee AAasa alla akoona biduAAai rabbee shaqiyyan
19.translation: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest

19.arabic: فَلَمَّا اعتَزَلَهُم وَما يَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ وَهَبنا لَهُ إِسحٰقَ وَيَعقوبَ وَكُلًّا جَعَلنا نَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Falamma iAAtazalahum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wakullan jaAAalna nabiyyan
19.translation: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet

19.arabic: وَوَهَبنا لَهُم مِن رَحمَتِنا وَجَعَلنا لَهُم لِسانَ صِدقٍ عَلِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina wajaAAalna lahum lisana sidqin AAaliyyan
19.translation: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown

19.arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ موسىٰ إِنَّهُ كانَ مُخلَصًا وَكانَ رَسولًا نَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyyan
19.translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet

19.arabic: وَنٰدَينٰهُ مِن جانِبِ الطّورِ الأَيمَنِ وَقَرَّبنٰهُ نَجِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wanadaynahu min janibi alttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyyan
19.translation: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion

19.arabic: وَوَهَبنا لَهُ مِن رَحمَتِنا أَخاهُ هٰرونَ نَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyyan
19.translation: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise)

19.arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ إِسمٰعيلَ إِنَّهُ كانَ صادِقَ الوَعدِ وَكانَ رَسولًا نَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi ismaAAeela innahu kana sadiqa alwaAAdi wakana rasoolan nabiyyan
19.translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet

19.arabic: وَكانَ يَأمُرُ أَهلَهُ بِالصَّلوٰةِ وَالزَّكوٰةِ وَكانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِ مَرضِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati waalzzakati wakana AAinda rabbihi mardiyyan
19.translation: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord

19.arabic: وَاذكُر فِى الكِتٰبِ إِدريسَ إِنَّهُ كانَ صِدّيقًا نَبِيًّا
19.transliteration: Waothkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan
19.translation: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet

19.arabic: وَرَفَعنٰهُ مَكانًا عَلِيًّا
19.transliteration: WarafaAAnahu makanan AAaliyyan
19.translation: And We raised him to high station

19.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ أَنعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم مِنَ النَّبِيّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءادَمَ وَمِمَّن حَمَلنا مَعَ نوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبرٰهيمَ وَإِسرٰءيلَ وَمِمَّن هَدَينا وَاجتَبَينا إِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتُ الرَّحمٰنِ خَرّوا سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا
19.transliteration: Olaika allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamalna maAAa noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna waijtabayna itha tutla AAalayhim ayatu alrrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyyan
19.translation: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping

19.arabic: فَخَلَفَ مِن بَعدِهِم خَلفٌ أَضاعُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوٰتِ فَسَوفَ يَلقَونَ غَيًّا
19.transliteration: Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun adaAAoo alssalata waittabaAAoo alshshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan
19.translation: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception

19.arabic: إِلّا مَن تابَ وَءامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صٰلِحًا فَأُولٰئِكَ يَدخُلونَ الجَنَّةَ وَلا يُظلَمونَ شَيـًٔا
19.transliteration: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan
19.translation: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught

19.arabic: جَنّٰتِ عَدنٍ الَّتى وَعَدَ الرَّحمٰنُ عِبادَهُ بِالغَيبِ إِنَّهُ كانَ وَعدُهُ مَأتِيًّا
19.transliteration: Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan
19.translation: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment

19.arabic: لا يَسمَعونَ فيها لَغوًا إِلّا سَلٰمًا وَلَهُم رِزقُهُم فيها بُكرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
19.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan
19.translation: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening

19.arabic: تِلكَ الجَنَّةُ الَّتى نورِثُ مِن عِبادِنا مَن كانَ تَقِيًّا
19.transliteration: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan
19.translation: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit

19.arabic: وَما نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلّا بِأَمرِ رَبِّكَ لَهُ ما بَينَ أَيدينا وَما خَلفَنا وَما بَينَ ذٰلِكَ وَما كانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan
19.translation: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful

19.arabic: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما فَاعبُدهُ وَاصطَبِر لِعِبٰدَتِهِ هَل تَعلَمُ لَهُ سَمِيًّا
19.transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan
19.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him

19.arabic: وَيَقولُ الإِنسٰنُ أَءِذا ما مِتُّ لَسَوفَ أُخرَجُ حَيًّا
19.transliteration: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan
19.translation: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive

19.arabic: أَوَلا يَذكُرُ الإِنسٰنُ أَنّا خَلَقنٰهُ مِن قَبلُ وَلَم يَكُ شَيـًٔا
19.transliteration: Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan
19.translation: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught

19.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحشُرَنَّهُم وَالشَّيٰطينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحضِرَنَّهُم حَولَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
19.transliteration: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan
19.translation: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell

19.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شيعَةٍ أَيُّهُم أَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحمٰنِ عِتِيًّا
19.transliteration: Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan
19.translation: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent

19.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحنُ أَعلَمُ بِالَّذينَ هُم أَولىٰ بِها صِلِيًّا
19.transliteration: Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan
19.translation: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein

19.arabic: وَإِن مِنكُم إِلّا وارِدُها كانَ عَلىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتمًا مَقضِيًّا
19.transliteration: Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan
19.translation: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord

19.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى الَّذينَ اتَّقَوا وَنَذَرُ الظّٰلِمينَ فيها جِثِيًّا
19.transliteration: Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan
19.translation: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there

19.arabic: وَإِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتُنا بَيِّنٰتٍ قالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا أَىُّ الفَريقَينِ خَيرٌ مَقامًا وَأَحسَنُ نَدِيًّا
19.transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan
19.translation: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army

19.arabic: وَكَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِن قَرنٍ هُم أَحسَنُ أَثٰثًا وَرِءيًا
19.transliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan
19.translation: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming

19.arabic: قُل مَن كانَ فِى الضَّلٰلَةِ فَليَمدُد لَهُ الرَّحمٰنُ مَدًّا حَتّىٰ إِذا رَأَوا ما يوعَدونَ إِمَّا العَذابَ وَإِمَّا السّاعَةَ فَسَيَعلَمونَ مَن هُوَ شَرٌّ مَكانًا وَأَضعَفُ جُندًا
19.transliteration: Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan
19.translation: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army

19.arabic: وَيَزيدُ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ اهتَدَوا هُدًى وَالبٰقِيٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَيرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوابًا وَخَيرٌ مَرَدًّا
19.transliteration: Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan
19.translation: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort

19.arabic: أَفَرَءَيتَ الَّذى كَفَرَ بِـٔايٰتِنا وَقالَ لَأوتَيَنَّ مالًا وَوَلَدًا
19.transliteration: Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan
19.translation: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children

19.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ الغَيبَ أَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحمٰنِ عَهدًا
19.transliteration: AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan
19.translation: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent

19.arabic: كَلّا سَنَكتُبُ ما يَقولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُ مِنَ العَذابِ مَدًّا
19.transliteration: Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan
19.translation: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment

19.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُ ما يَقولُ وَيَأتينا فَردًا
19.transliteration: Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan
19.translation: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children)

19.arabic: وَاتَّخَذوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ءالِهَةً لِيَكونوا لَهُم عِزًّا
19.transliteration: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan
19.translation: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them

19.arabic: كَلّا سَيَكفُرونَ بِعِبادَتِهِم وَيَكونونَ عَلَيهِم ضِدًّا
19.transliteration: Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan
19.translation: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them

19.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنّا أَرسَلنَا الشَّيٰطينَ عَلَى الكٰفِرينَ تَؤُزُّهُم أَزًّا
19.transliteration: Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan
19.translation: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion

19.arabic: فَلا تَعجَل عَلَيهِم إِنَّما نَعُدُّ لَهُم عَدًّا
19.transliteration: Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan
19.translation: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days)

19.arabic: يَومَ نَحشُرُ المُتَّقينَ إِلَى الرَّحمٰنِ وَفدًا
19.transliteration: Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan
19.translation: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company

19.arabic: وَنَسوقُ المُجرِمينَ إِلىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِردًا
19.transliteration: Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan
19.translation: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd

19.arabic: لا يَملِكونَ الشَّفٰعَةَ إِلّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِندَ الرَّحمٰنِ عَهدًا
19.transliteration: La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan
19.translation: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord

19.arabic: وَقالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحمٰنُ وَلَدًا
19.transliteration: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan
19.translation: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son

19.arabic: لَقَد جِئتُم شَيـًٔا إِدًّا
19.transliteration: Laqad jitum shayan iddan
19.translation: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing

19.arabic: تَكادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرنَ مِنهُ وَتَنشَقُّ الأَرضُ وَتَخِرُّ الجِبالُ هَدًّا
19.transliteration: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan
19.translation: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins

19.arabic: أَن دَعَوا لِلرَّحمٰنِ وَلَدًا
19.transliteration: An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan
19.translation: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son

19.arabic: وَما يَنبَغى لِلرَّحمٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
19.transliteration: Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan
19.translation: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son

19.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ إِلّا ءاتِى الرَّحمٰنِ عَبدًا
19.transliteration: In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan
19.translation: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave

19.arabic: لَقَد أَحصىٰهُم وَعَدَّهُم عَدًّا
19.transliteration: Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan
19.translation: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering

19.arabic: وَكُلُّهُم ءاتيهِ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ فَردًا
19.transliteration: Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan
19.translation: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone

19.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَيَجعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحمٰنُ وُدًّا
19.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan
19.translation: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love

19.arabic: فَإِنَّما يَسَّرنٰهُ بِلِسانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ المُتَّقينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِ قَومًا لُدًّا
19.transliteration: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan
19.translation: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk

19.arabic: وَكَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِن قَرنٍ هَل تُحِسُّ مِنهُم مِن أَحَدٍ أَو تَسمَعُ لَهُم رِكزًا
19.transliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan
19.translation: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound

20.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ طه
20.transliteration: Taha
20.translation: Ta. Ha

20.arabic: ما أَنزَلنا عَلَيكَ القُرءانَ لِتَشقىٰ
20.transliteration: Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa
20.translation: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed

20.arabic: إِلّا تَذكِرَةً لِمَن يَخشىٰ
20.transliteration: Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha
20.translation: But as a reminder unto him who feareth

20.arabic: تَنزيلًا مِمَّن خَلَقَ الأَرضَ وَالسَّمٰوٰتِ العُلَى
20.transliteration: Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula
20.translation: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens

20.arabic: الرَّحمٰنُ عَلَى العَرشِ استَوىٰ
20.transliteration: Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa
20.translation: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne

20.arabic: لَهُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما وَما تَحتَ الثَّرىٰ
20.transliteration: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara
20.translation: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod

20.arabic: وَإِن تَجهَر بِالقَولِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخفَى
20.transliteration: Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa
20.translation: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden

20.arabic: اللَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ لَهُ الأَسماءُ الحُسنىٰ
20.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna
20.translation: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names

20.arabic: وَهَل أَتىٰكَ حَديثُ موسىٰ
20.transliteration: Wahal ataka hadeethu moosa
20.translation: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses

20.arabic: إِذ رَءا نارًا فَقالَ لِأَهلِهِ امكُثوا إِنّى ءانَستُ نارًا لَعَلّى ءاتيكُم مِنها بِقَبَسٍ أَو أَجِدُ عَلَى النّارِ هُدًى
20.transliteration: Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan
20.translation: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire

20.arabic: فَلَمّا أَتىٰها نودِىَ يٰموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Falamma ataha noodiya ya moosa
20.translation: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses

20.arabic: إِنّى أَنا۠ رَبُّكَ فَاخلَع نَعلَيكَ إِنَّكَ بِالوادِ المُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
20.transliteration: Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan
20.translation: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa

20.arabic: وَأَنَا اختَرتُكَ فَاستَمِع لِما يوحىٰ
20.transliteration: Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha
20.translation: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired

20.arabic: إِنَّنى أَنَا اللَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا أَنا۠ فَاعبُدنى وَأَقِمِ الصَّلوٰةَ لِذِكرى
20.transliteration: Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree
20.translation: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance

20.arabic: إِنَّ السّاعَةَ ءاتِيَةٌ أَكادُ أُخفيها لِتُجزىٰ كُلُّ نَفسٍ بِما تَسعىٰ
20.transliteration: Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa
20.translation: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve)

20.arabic: فَلا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنها مَن لا يُؤمِنُ بِها وَاتَّبَعَ هَوىٰهُ فَتَردىٰ
20.transliteration: Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda
20.translation: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish

20.arabic: وَما تِلكَ بِيَمينِكَ يٰموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa
20.translation: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses

20.arabic: قالَ هِىَ عَصاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيها وَأَهُشُّ بِها عَلىٰ غَنَمى وَلِىَ فيها مَـٔارِبُ أُخرىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra
20.translation: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses

20.arabic: قالَ أَلقِها يٰموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala alqiha ya moosa
20.translation: He said: Cast it down, O Moses

20.arabic: فَأَلقىٰها فَإِذا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسعىٰ
20.transliteration: Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa
20.translation: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding

20.arabic: قالَ خُذها وَلا تَخَف سَنُعيدُها سيرَتَهَا الأولىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola
20.translation: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state

20.arabic: وَاضمُم يَدَكَ إِلىٰ جَناحِكَ تَخرُج بَيضاءَ مِن غَيرِ سوءٍ ءايَةً أُخرىٰ
20.transliteration: Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra
20.translation: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token

20.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِن ءايٰتِنَا الكُبرَى
20.transliteration: Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra
20.translation: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents

20.arabic: اذهَب إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ إِنَّهُ طَغىٰ
20.transliteration: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha
20.translation: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds)

20.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ اشرَح لى صَدرى
20.transliteration: Qala rabbi ishrah lee sadree
20.translation: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind

20.arabic: وَيَسِّر لى أَمرى
20.transliteration: Wayassir lee amree
20.translation: And ease my task for me

20.arabic: وَاحلُل عُقدَةً مِن لِسانى
20.transliteration: Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee
20.translation: And loose a knot from my tongue

20.arabic: يَفقَهوا قَولى
20.transliteration: Yafqahoo qawlee
20.translation: That they may understand my saying

20.arabic: وَاجعَل لى وَزيرًا مِن أَهلى
20.transliteration: WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee
20.translation: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk

20.arabic: هٰرونَ أَخِى
20.transliteration: Haroona akhee
20.translation: Aaron, my brother

20.arabic: اشدُد بِهِ أَزرى
20.transliteration: Oshdud bihi azree
20.translation: Confirm my strength with him

20.arabic: وَأَشرِكهُ فى أَمرى
20.transliteration: Waashrikhu fee amree
20.translation: And let him share my task

20.arabic: كَى نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثيرًا
20.transliteration: Kay nusabbihaka katheeran
20.translation: That we may glorify Thee much

20.arabic: وَنَذكُرَكَ كَثيرًا
20.transliteration: Wanathkuraka katheeran
20.translation: And much remember Thee

20.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنا بَصيرًا
20.transliteration: Innaka kunta bina baseeran
20.translation: Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us

20.arabic: قالَ قَد أوتيتَ سُؤلَكَ يٰموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala qad ooteeta sulaka ya moosa
20.translation: He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses

20.arabic: وَلَقَد مَنَنّا عَلَيكَ مَرَّةً أُخرىٰ
20.transliteration: Walaqad mananna AAalayka marratan okhra
20.translation: And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour

20.arabic: إِذ أَوحَينا إِلىٰ أُمِّكَ ما يوحىٰ
20.transliteration: Ith awhayna ila ommika ma yooha
20.translation: When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired

20.arabic: أَنِ اقذِفيهِ فِى التّابوتِ فَاقذِفيهِ فِى اليَمِّ فَليُلقِهِ اليَمُّ بِالسّاحِلِ يَأخُذهُ عَدُوٌّ لى وَعَدُوٌّ لَهُ وَأَلقَيتُ عَلَيكَ مَحَبَّةً مِنّى وَلِتُصنَعَ عَلىٰ عَينى
20.transliteration: Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee
20.translation: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will

20.arabic: إِذ تَمشى أُختُكَ فَتَقولُ هَل أَدُلُّكُم عَلىٰ مَن يَكفُلُهُ فَرَجَعنٰكَ إِلىٰ أُمِّكَ كَى تَقَرَّ عَينُها وَلا تَحزَنَ وَقَتَلتَ نَفسًا فَنَجَّينٰكَ مِنَ الغَمِّ وَفَتَنّٰكَ فُتونًا فَلَبِثتَ سِنينَ فى أَهلِ مَديَنَ ثُمَّ جِئتَ عَلىٰ قَدَرٍ يٰموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Ith tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAala man yakfuluhu farajaAAnaka ila ommika kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alghammi wafatannaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAala qadarin ya moosa
20.translation: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses

20.arabic: وَاصطَنَعتُكَ لِنَفسِى
20.transliteration: WaistanaAAtuka linafsee
20.translation: And I have attached thee to Myself

20.arabic: اذهَب أَنتَ وَأَخوكَ بِـٔايٰتى وَلا تَنِيا فى ذِكرِى
20.transliteration: Ithhab anta waakhooka biayatee wala taniya fee thikree
20.translation: Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me

20.arabic: اذهَبا إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ إِنَّهُ طَغىٰ
20.transliteration: Ithhaba ila firAAawna innahu tagha
20.translation: Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds)

20.arabic: فَقولا لَهُ قَولًا لَيِّنًا لَعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَو يَخشىٰ
20.transliteration: Faqoola lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yatathakkaru aw yakhsha
20.translation: And speak unto him a gentle word, that peradventure he may heed or fear

20.arabic: قالا رَبَّنا إِنَّنا نَخافُ أَن يَفرُطَ عَلَينا أَو أَن يَطغىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta AAalayna aw an yatgha
20.translation: They said: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant

20.arabic: قالَ لا تَخافا إِنَّنى مَعَكُما أَسمَعُ وَأَرىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala la takhafa innanee maAAakuma asmaAAu waara
20.translation: He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing

20.arabic: فَأتِياهُ فَقولا إِنّا رَسولا رَبِّكَ فَأَرسِل مَعَنا بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ وَلا تُعَذِّبهُم قَد جِئنٰكَ بِـٔايَةٍ مِن رَبِّكَ وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلىٰ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الهُدىٰ
20.transliteration: Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda
20.translation: So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance

20.arabic: إِنّا قَد أوحِىَ إِلَينا أَنَّ العَذابَ عَلىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّىٰ
20.transliteration: Inna qad oohiya ilayna anna alAAathaba AAala man kaththaba watawalla
20.translation: Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away

20.arabic: قالَ فَمَن رَبُّكُما يٰموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala faman rabbukuma ya moosa
20.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Who then is the Lord of you twain, O Moses

20.arabic: قالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذى أَعطىٰ كُلَّ شَيءٍ خَلقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala rabbuna allathee aAAta kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hada
20.translation: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright

20.arabic: قالَ فَما بالُ القُرونِ الأولىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala fama balu alqurooni aloola
20.translation: He said: What then is the state of the generations of old

20.arabic: قالَ عِلمُها عِندَ رَبّى فى كِتٰبٍ لا يَضِلُّ رَبّى وَلا يَنسَى
20.transliteration: Qala AAilmuha AAinda rabbee fee kitabin la yadillu rabbee wala yansa
20.translation: He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither erreth nor forgetteth

20.arabic: الَّذى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الأَرضَ مَهدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُم فيها سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَأَخرَجنا بِهِ أَزوٰجًا مِن نَباتٍ شَتّىٰ
20.transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta
20.translation: Who hath appointed the earth as a bed and hath threaded roads for you therein and hath sent down water from the sky and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds of vegetation

20.arabic: كُلوا وَارعَوا أَنعٰمَكُم إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِأُولِى النُّهىٰ
20.transliteration: Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha
20.translation: (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought

20.arabic: مِنها خَلَقنٰكُم وَفيها نُعيدُكُم وَمِنها نُخرِجُكُم تارَةً أُخرىٰ
20.transliteration: Minha khalaqnakum wafeeha nuAAeedukum waminha nukhrijukum taratan okhra
20.translation: Thereof We created you, and thereunto We return you, and thence We bring you forth a second time

20.arabic: وَلَقَد أَرَينٰهُ ءايٰتِنا كُلَّها فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبىٰ
20.transliteration: Walaqad araynahu ayatina kullaha fakaththaba waaba
20.translation: And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused

20.arabic: قالَ أَجِئتَنا لِتُخرِجَنا مِن أَرضِنا بِسِحرِكَ يٰموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala ajitana litukhrijana min ardina bisihrika ya moosa
20.translation: He said: Hast come to drive us out from our land by thy magic, O Moses

20.arabic: فَلَنَأتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحرٍ مِثلِهِ فَاجعَل بَينَنا وَبَينَكَ مَوعِدًا لا نُخلِفُهُ نَحنُ وَلا أَنتَ مَكانًا سُوًى
20.transliteration: Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan
20.translation: But we surely can produce for thee magic the like thereof; so appoint a tryst between us and you, which neither we nor thou shall fail to keep, at a place convenient (to us both)

20.arabic: قالَ مَوعِدُكُم يَومُ الزّينَةِ وَأَن يُحشَرَ النّاسُ ضُحًى
20.transliteration: Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan
20.translation: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high

20.arabic: فَتَوَلّىٰ فِرعَونُ فَجَمَعَ كَيدَهُ ثُمَّ أَتىٰ
20.transliteration: Fatawalla firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma ata
20.translation: Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst)

20.arabic: قالَ لَهُم موسىٰ وَيلَكُم لا تَفتَروا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسحِتَكُم بِعَذابٍ وَقَد خابَ مَنِ افتَرىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala lahum moosa waylakum la taftaroo AAala Allahi kathiban fayushitakum biAAathabin waqad khaba mani iftara
20.translation: Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably

20.arabic: فَتَنٰزَعوا أَمرَهُم بَينَهُم وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجوىٰ
20.transliteration: FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa
20.translation: Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their counsel secret

20.arabic: قالوا إِن هٰذٰنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ يُريدانِ أَن يُخرِجاكُم مِن أَرضِكُم بِسِحرِهِما وَيَذهَبا بِطَريقَتِكُمُ المُثلىٰ
20.transliteration: Qaloo in hathani lasahirani yureedani an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihima wayathhaba bitareeqatikumu almuthla
20.translation: They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions

20.arabic: فَأَجمِعوا كَيدَكُم ثُمَّ ائتوا صَفًّا وَقَد أَفلَحَ اليَومَ مَنِ استَعلىٰ
20.transliteration: FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo saffan waqad aflaha alyawma mani istaAAla
20.translation: So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful

20.arabic: قالوا يٰموسىٰ إِمّا أَن تُلقِىَ وَإِمّا أَن نَكونَ أَوَّلَ مَن أَلقىٰ
20.transliteration: Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona awwala man alqa
20.translation: They said: O Moses! Either throw first, or let us be the first to throw

20.arabic: قالَ بَل أَلقوا فَإِذا حِبالُهُم وَعِصِيُّهُم يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيهِ مِن سِحرِهِم أَنَّها تَسعىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala bal alqoo faitha hibaluhum waAAisiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tasAAa
20.translation: He said: Nay, do ye throw! Then lo! their cords and their staves, by their magic, appeared to him as though they ran

20.arabic: فَأَوجَسَ فى نَفسِهِ خيفَةً موسىٰ
20.transliteration: Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moosa
20.translation: And Moses conceived a fear in his mind

20.arabic: قُلنا لا تَخَف إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الأَعلىٰ
20.transliteration: Qulna la takhaf innaka anta alaAAla
20.translation: We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher

20.arabic: وَأَلقِ ما فى يَمينِكَ تَلقَف ما صَنَعوا إِنَّما صَنَعوا كَيدُ سٰحِرٍ وَلا يُفلِحُ السّاحِرُ حَيثُ أَتىٰ
20.transliteration: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata
20.translation: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain

20.arabic: فَأُلقِىَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قالوا ءامَنّا بِرَبِّ هٰرونَ وَموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa
20.translation: Then the wizards were (all) flung down prostrate, crying: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses

20.arabic: قالَ ءامَنتُم لَهُ قَبلَ أَن ءاذَنَ لَكُم إِنَّهُ لَكَبيرُكُمُ الَّذى عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحرَ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيدِيَكُم وَأَرجُلَكُم مِن خِلٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُم فى جُذوعِ النَّخلِ وَلَتَعلَمُنَّ أَيُّنا أَشَدُّ عَذابًا وَأَبقىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa
20.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he is your chief who taught you magic. Now surely I shall cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and I shall crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and ye shall know for certain which of us hath sterner and more lasting punishment

20.arabic: قالوا لَن نُؤثِرَكَ عَلىٰ ما جاءَنا مِنَ البَيِّنٰتِ وَالَّذى فَطَرَنا فَاقضِ ما أَنتَ قاضٍ إِنَّما تَقضى هٰذِهِ الحَيوٰةَ الدُّنيا
20.transliteration: Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya
20.translation: They said: We choose thee not above the clear proofs that have come unto us, and above Him Who created us. So decree what thou wilt decree. Thou wilt end for us only this life of the world

20.arabic: إِنّا ءامَنّا بِرَبِّنا لِيَغفِرَ لَنا خَطٰيٰنا وَما أَكرَهتَنا عَلَيهِ مِنَ السِّحرِ وَاللَّهُ خَيرٌ وَأَبقىٰ
20.transliteration: Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa
20.translation: Lo! we believe in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins and the magic unto which thou didst force us. Allah is better and more lasting

20.arabic: إِنَّهُ مَن يَأتِ رَبَّهُ مُجرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُ جَهَنَّمَ لا يَموتُ فيها وَلا يَحيىٰ
20.transliteration: Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama la yamootu feeha wala yahya
20.translation: Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live

20.arabic: وَمَن يَأتِهِ مُؤمِنًا قَد عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَأُولٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ العُلىٰ
20.transliteration: Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula
20.translation: But whoso cometh unto Him a believer, having done good works, for such are the high stations

20.arabic: جَنّٰتُ عَدنٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها وَذٰلِكَ جَزاءُ مَن تَزَكّىٰ
20.transliteration: Jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao man tazakka
20.translation: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth

20.arabic: وَلَقَد أَوحَينا إِلىٰ موسىٰ أَن أَسرِ بِعِبادى فَاضرِب لَهُم طَريقًا فِى البَحرِ يَبَسًا لا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَلا تَخشىٰ
20.transliteration: Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha
