20.translation: And verily We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night and strike for them a dry path in the sea, fearing not to be overtaken, neither being afraid (of the sea)

20.arabic: فَأَتبَعَهُم فِرعَونُ بِجُنودِهِ فَغَشِيَهُم مِنَ اليَمِّ ما غَشِيَهُم
20.transliteration: FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi ma ghashiyahum
20.translation: Then Pharaoh followed them with his hosts and there covered them that which did cover them of the sea

20.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرعَونُ قَومَهُ وَما هَدىٰ
20.transliteration: Waadalla firAAawnu qawmahu wama hada
20.translation: And Pharaoh led his folk astray, he did not guide them

20.arabic: يٰبَنى إِسرٰءيلَ قَد أَنجَينٰكُم مِن عَدُوِّكُم وَوٰعَدنٰكُم جانِبَ الطّورِ الأَيمَنَ وَنَزَّلنا عَلَيكُمُ المَنَّ وَالسَّلوىٰ
20.transliteration: Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa
20.translation: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and we made a covenant with you on the holy mountain's side, and sent down on you the manna and the quails

20.arabic: كُلوا مِن طَيِّبٰتِ ما رَزَقنٰكُم وَلا تَطغَوا فيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيكُم غَضَبى وَمَن يَحلِل عَلَيهِ غَضَبى فَقَد هَوىٰ
20.transliteration: Kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wala tatghaw feehi fayahilla AAalaykum ghadabee waman yahlil AAalayhi ghadabee faqad hawa
20.translation: (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed

20.arabic: وَإِنّى لَغَفّارٌ لِمَن تابَ وَءامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صٰلِحًا ثُمَّ اهتَدىٰ
20.transliteration: Wainnee laghaffarun liman taba waamana waAAamila salihan thumma ihtada
20.translation: And lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright

20.arabic: وَما أَعجَلَكَ عَن قَومِكَ يٰموسىٰ
20.transliteration: Wama aAAjalaka AAan qawmika ya moosa
20.translation: And (it was said): What hath made thee hasten from thy folk, O Moses

20.arabic: قالَ هُم أُولاءِ عَلىٰ أَثَرى وَعَجِلتُ إِلَيكَ رَبِّ لِتَرضىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala hum olai AAala atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litarda
20.translation: He said: They are close upon my track. I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased

20.arabic: قالَ فَإِنّا قَد فَتَنّا قَومَكَ مِن بَعدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ السّامِرِىُّ
20.transliteration: Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu
20.translation: He said: Lo! We have tried thy folk in thine absence, and As-Samiri hath misled them

20.arabic: فَرَجَعَ موسىٰ إِلىٰ قَومِهِ غَضبٰنَ أَسِفًا قالَ يٰقَومِ أَلَم يَعِدكُم رَبُّكُم وَعدًا حَسَنًا أَفَطالَ عَلَيكُمُ العَهدُ أَم أَرَدتُم أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيكُم غَضَبٌ مِن رَبِّكُم فَأَخلَفتُم مَوعِدى
20.transliteration: FarajaAAa moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala ya qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan hasanan afatala AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an yahilla AAalaykum ghadabun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee
20.translation: Then Moses went back unto his folk, angry and sad. He said: O my people! Hath not your Lord promised you a fair promise? Did the time appointed then appear too long for you, or did ye wish that wrath from your Lord should come upon you, that ye broke tryst with me

20.arabic: قالوا ما أَخلَفنا مَوعِدَكَ بِمَلكِنا وَلٰكِنّا حُمِّلنا أَوزارًا مِن زينَةِ القَومِ فَقَذَفنٰها فَكَذٰلِكَ أَلقَى السّامِرِىُّ
20.transliteration: Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu
20.translation: They said: We broke not tryst with thee of our own will, but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk, then cast them (in the fire), for thus As-Samiri proposed

20.arabic: فَأَخرَجَ لَهُم عِجلًا جَسَدًا لَهُ خُوارٌ فَقالوا هٰذا إِلٰهُكُم وَإِلٰهُ موسىٰ فَنَسِىَ
20.transliteration: Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya
20.translation: Then he produced for them a calf, of saffron hue, which gave forth a lowing sound. And they cried: This is your god and the god of Moses, but he hath forgotten

20.arabic: أَفَلا يَرَونَ أَلّا يَرجِعُ إِلَيهِم قَولًا وَلا يَملِكُ لَهُم ضَرًّا وَلا نَفعًا
20.transliteration: Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan
20.translation: See they not, then, that it returneth no saying unto them and possesseth for them neither hurt nor use

20.arabic: وَلَقَد قالَ لَهُم هٰرونُ مِن قَبلُ يٰقَومِ إِنَّما فُتِنتُم بِهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحمٰنُ فَاتَّبِعونى وَأَطيعوا أَمرى
20.transliteration: Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree
20.translation: And Aaron indeed had told them beforehand: O my people! Ye are but being seduced therewith, for lo! your Lord is the Beneficent, so follow me and obey my order

20.arabic: قالوا لَن نَبرَحَ عَلَيهِ عٰكِفينَ حَتّىٰ يَرجِعَ إِلَينا موسىٰ
20.transliteration: Qaloo lan nabraha AAalayhi AAakifeena hatta yarjiAAa ilayna moosa
20.translation: They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us

20.arabic: قالَ يٰهٰرونُ ما مَنَعَكَ إِذ رَأَيتَهُم ضَلّوا
20.transliteration: Qala ya haroonu ma manaAAaka ith raaytahum dalloo
20.translation: He (Moses) said: O Aaron! What held thee back when thou didst see them gone astray

20.arabic: أَلّا تَتَّبِعَنِ أَفَعَصَيتَ أَمرى
20.transliteration: Alla tattabiAAani afaAAasayta amree
20.translation: That thou followedst me not? Hast thou then disobeyed my order

20.arabic: قالَ يَبنَؤُمَّ لا تَأخُذ بِلِحيَتى وَلا بِرَأسى إِنّى خَشيتُ أَن تَقولَ فَرَّقتَ بَينَ بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ وَلَم تَرقُب قَولى
20.transliteration: Qala ya bna omma la takhuth bilihyatee wala birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israeela walam tarqub qawlee
20.translation: He said: O son of my mother! Clutch not my beard nor my head! I feared lest thou shouldst say: Thou hast caused division among the Children of Israel, and hast not waited for my word

20.arabic: قالَ فَما خَطبُكَ يٰسٰمِرِىُّ
20.transliteration: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu
20.translation: (Moses) said: And what hast thou to say, O Samiri

20.arabic: قالَ بَصُرتُ بِما لَم يَبصُروا بِهِ فَقَبَضتُ قَبضَةً مِن أَثَرِ الرَّسولِ فَنَبَذتُها وَكَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَت لى نَفسى
20.transliteration: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee
20.translation: He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me

20.arabic: قالَ فَاذهَب فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى الحَيوٰةِ أَن تَقولَ لا مِساسَ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوعِدًا لَن تُخلَفَهُ وَانظُر إِلىٰ إِلٰهِكَ الَّذى ظَلتَ عَلَيهِ عاكِفًا لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُ فِى اليَمِّ نَسفًا
20.transliteration: Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan
20.translation: (Moses) said: Then go! and lo! in this life it is for thee to say: Touch me not! and lo! there is for thee a tryst thou canst not break. Now look upon thy god of which thou hast remained a votary. Verily we will burn it and will scatter its dust over the sea

20.arabic: إِنَّما إِلٰهُكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذى لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيءٍ عِلمًا
20.transliteration: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman
20.translation: Your Allah is only Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah. He embraceth all things in His knowledge

20.arabic: كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيكَ مِن أَنباءِ ما قَد سَبَقَ وَقَد ءاتَينٰكَ مِن لَدُنّا ذِكرًا
20.transliteration: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran
20.translation: Thus relate We unto thee (Muhammad) some tidings of that which happened of old, and We have given thee from Our presence a reminder

20.arabic: مَن أَعرَضَ عَنهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَحمِلُ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ وِزرًا
20.transliteration: Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran
20.translation: Whoso turneth away from it, he verily will bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection

20.arabic: خٰلِدينَ فيهِ وَساءَ لَهُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ حِملًا
20.transliteration: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan
20.translation: Abiding under it - an evil burden for them on the Day of Resurrection

20.arabic: يَومَ يُنفَخُ فِى الصّورِ وَنَحشُرُ المُجرِمينَ يَومَئِذٍ زُرقًا
20.transliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan
20.translation: The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror)

20.arabic: يَتَخٰفَتونَ بَينَهُم إِن لَبِثتُم إِلّا عَشرًا
20.transliteration: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran
20.translation: Murmuring among themselves: Ye have tarried but ten (days)

20.arabic: نَحنُ أَعلَمُ بِما يَقولونَ إِذ يَقولُ أَمثَلُهُم طَريقَةً إِن لَبِثتُم إِلّا يَومًا
20.transliteration: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman
20.translation: We are Best Aware of what they utter when their best in conduct say: Ye have tarried but a day

20.arabic: وَيَسـَٔلونَكَ عَنِ الجِبالِ فَقُل يَنسِفُها رَبّى نَسفًا
20.transliteration: Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan
20.translation: They will ask thee of the mountains (on that day). Say: My Lord will break them into scattered dust

20.arabic: فَيَذَرُها قاعًا صَفصَفًا
20.transliteration: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan
20.translation: And leave it as an empty plain

20.arabic: لا تَرىٰ فيها عِوَجًا وَلا أَمتًا
20.transliteration: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan
20.translation: Wherein thou seest neither curve nor ruggedness

20.arabic: يَومَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعونَ الدّاعِىَ لا عِوَجَ لَهُ وَخَشَعَتِ الأَصواتُ لِلرَّحمٰنِ فَلا تَسمَعُ إِلّا هَمسًا
20.transliteration: Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan
20.translation: On that day they follow the summoner who deceiveth not, and voices are hushed for the Beneficent, and thou hearest but a faint murmur

20.arabic: يَومَئِذٍ لا تَنفَعُ الشَّفٰعَةُ إِلّا مَن أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحمٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُ قَولًا
20.transliteration: Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan
20.translation: On that day no intercession availeth save (that of) him unto whom the Beneficent hath given leave and whose word He accepteth

20.arabic: يَعلَمُ ما بَينَ أَيديهِم وَما خَلفَهُم وَلا يُحيطونَ بِهِ عِلمًا
20.transliteration: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman
20.translation: He knoweth (all) that is before them and (all) that is behind them, while they cannot compass it in knowledge

20.arabic: وَعَنَتِ الوُجوهُ لِلحَىِّ القَيّومِ وَقَد خابَ مَن حَمَلَ ظُلمًا
20.transliteration: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman
20.translation: And faces humble themselves before the Living, the Eternal. And he who beareth (a burden of) wrongdoing is indeed a failure (on that day)

20.arabic: وَمَن يَعمَل مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤمِنٌ فَلا يَخافُ ظُلمًا وَلا هَضمًا
20.transliteration: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman
20.translation: And he who hath done some good works, being a believer, he feareth not injustice nor begrudging (of his wage)

20.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنزَلنٰهُ قُرءانًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفنا فيهِ مِنَ الوَعيدِ لَعَلَّهُم يَتَّقونَ أَو يُحدِثُ لَهُم ذِكرًا
20.transliteration: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran
20.translation: Thus we have revealed it as a Lecture in Arabic, and have displayed therein certain threats, that peradventure they may keep from evil or that it may cause them to take heed

20.arabic: فَتَعٰلَى اللَّهُ المَلِكُ الحَقُّ وَلا تَعجَل بِالقُرءانِ مِن قَبلِ أَن يُقضىٰ إِلَيكَ وَحيُهُ وَقُل رَبِّ زِدنى عِلمًا
20.transliteration: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman
20.translation: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge

20.arabic: وَلَقَد عَهِدنا إِلىٰ ءادَمَ مِن قَبلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَم نَجِد لَهُ عَزمًا
20.transliteration: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman
20.translation: And verily We made a covenant of old with Adam, but he forgot, and We found no constancy in him

20.arabic: وَإِذ قُلنا لِلمَلٰئِكَةِ اسجُدوا لِءادَمَ فَسَجَدوا إِلّا إِبليسَ أَبىٰ
20.transliteration: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba
20.translation: And when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, they fell prostrate (all) save Iblis; he refused

20.arabic: فَقُلنا يٰـٔادَمُ إِنَّ هٰذا عَدُوٌّ لَكَ وَلِزَوجِكَ فَلا يُخرِجَنَّكُما مِنَ الجَنَّةِ فَتَشقىٰ
20.transliteration: Faqulna ya adamu inna hatha AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fala yukhrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa
20.translation: Therefor we said: O Adam! This is an enemy unto thee and unto thy wife, so let him not drive you both out of the Garden so that thou come to toil

20.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلّا تَجوعَ فيها وَلا تَعرىٰ
20.transliteration: Inna laka alla tajooAAa feeha wala taAAra
20.translation: It is (vouchsafed) unto thee that thou hungerest not therein nor art naked

20.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لا تَظمَؤُا۟ فيها وَلا تَضحىٰ
20.transliteration: Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha
20.translation: And that thou thirstest not therein nor art exposed to the sun's heat

20.arabic: فَوَسوَسَ إِلَيهِ الشَّيطٰنُ قالَ يٰـٔادَمُ هَل أَدُلُّكَ عَلىٰ شَجَرَةِ الخُلدِ وَمُلكٍ لا يَبلىٰ
20.transliteration: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla
20.translation: But the devil whispered to him, saying: O Adam! Shall I show thee the tree of immortality and power that wasteth not away

20.arabic: فَأَكَلا مِنها فَبَدَت لَهُما سَوءٰتُهُما وَطَفِقا يَخصِفانِ عَلَيهِما مِن وَرَقِ الجَنَّةِ وَعَصىٰ ءادَمُ رَبَّهُ فَغَوىٰ
20.transliteration: Faakala minha fabadat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati waAAasa adamu rabbahu faghawa
20.translation: Then they twain ate thereof, so that their shame became apparent unto them, and they began to hide by heaping on themselves some of the leaves of the Garden. And Adam disobeyed his Lord, so went astray

20.arabic: ثُمَّ اجتَبٰهُ رَبُّهُ فَتابَ عَلَيهِ وَهَدىٰ
20.transliteration: Thumma ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba AAalayhi wahada
20.translation: Then his Lord chose him, and relented toward him, and guided him

20.arabic: قالَ اهبِطا مِنها جَميعًا بَعضُكُم لِبَعضٍ عَدُوٌّ فَإِمّا يَأتِيَنَّكُم مِنّى هُدًى فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُداىَ فَلا يَضِلُّ وَلا يَشقىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala ihbita minha jameeAAan baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hudaya fala yadillu wala yashqa
20.translation: He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But when there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief

20.arabic: وَمَن أَعرَضَ عَن ذِكرى فَإِنَّ لَهُ مَعيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحشُرُهُ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ أَعمىٰ
20.transliteration: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman
20.translation: But he who turneth away from remembrance of Me, his will be a narrow life, and I shall bring him blind to the assembly on the Day of Resurrection

20.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرتَنى أَعمىٰ وَقَد كُنتُ بَصيرًا
20.transliteration: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran
20.translation: He will say: My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind, when I was wont to see

20.arabic: قالَ كَذٰلِكَ أَتَتكَ ءايٰتُنا فَنَسيتَها وَكَذٰلِكَ اليَومَ تُنسىٰ
20.transliteration: Qala kathalika atatka ayatuna fanaseetaha wakathalika alyawma tunsa
20.translation: He will say: So (it must be). Our revelations came unto thee but thou didst forget them. In like manner thou art forgotten this Day

20.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجزى مَن أَسرَفَ وَلَم يُؤمِن بِـٔايٰتِ رَبِّهِ وَلَعَذابُ الءاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبقىٰ
20.transliteration: Wakathalika najzee man asrafa walam yumin biayati rabbihi walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaddu waabqa
20.translation: Thus do We reward him who is prodigal and believeth not the revelations of his Lord; and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be sterner and more lasting

20.arabic: أَفَلَم يَهدِ لَهُم كَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِنَ القُرونِ يَمشونَ فى مَسٰكِنِهِم إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِأُولِى النُّهىٰ
20.transliteration: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha
20.translation: Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many a generation We destroyed before them, amid whose dwellings they walk? Lo! therein verily are signs for men of thought

20.arabic: وَلَولا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَت مِن رَبِّكَ لَكانَ لِزامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى
20.transliteration: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman
20.translation: And but for a decree that had already gone forth from thy Lord, and a term already fixed, the judgment would have been inevitable (in this world)

20.arabic: فَاصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ قَبلَ طُلوعِ الشَّمسِ وَقَبلَ غُروبِها وَمِن ءانائِ الَّيلِ فَسَبِّح وَأَطرافَ النَّهارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرضىٰ
20.transliteration: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda
20.translation: Therefor (O Muhammad), bear with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere the going down thereof. And glorify Him some hours of the night and at the two ends of the day, that thou mayst find acceptance

20.arabic: وَلا تَمُدَّنَّ عَينَيكَ إِلىٰ ما مَتَّعنا بِهِ أَزوٰجًا مِنهُم زَهرَةَ الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا لِنَفتِنَهُم فيهِ وَرِزقُ رَبِّكَ خَيرٌ وَأَبقىٰ
20.transliteration: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa
20.translation: And strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoy, the flower of the life of the world, that We may try them thereby. The provision of thy Lord is better and more lasting

20.arabic: وَأمُر أَهلَكَ بِالصَّلوٰةِ وَاصطَبِر عَلَيها لا نَسـَٔلُكَ رِزقًا نَحنُ نَرزُقُكَ وَالعٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقوىٰ
20.transliteration: Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa
20.translation: And enjoin upon thy people worship, and be constant therein. We ask not of thee a provision: We provided for thee. And the sequel is for righteousness

20.arabic: وَقالوا لَولا يَأتينا بِـٔايَةٍ مِن رَبِّهِ أَوَلَم تَأتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ ما فِى الصُّحُفِ الأولىٰ
20.transliteration: Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola
20.translation: And they say: If only he would bring us a miracle from his Lord! Hath there not come unto them the proof of what is in the former scriptures

20.arabic: وَلَو أَنّا أَهلَكنٰهُم بِعَذابٍ مِن قَبلِهِ لَقالوا رَبَّنا لَولا أَرسَلتَ إِلَينا رَسولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءايٰتِكَ مِن قَبلِ أَن نَذِلَّ وَنَخزىٰ
20.transliteration: Walaw anna ahlaknahum biAAathabin min qablihi laqaloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika min qabli an nathilla wanakhza
20.translation: And if we had destroyed them with some punishment before it, they would assuredly have said: Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent unto us a messenger, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced

20.arabic: قُل كُلٌّ مُتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصوا فَسَتَعلَمونَ مَن أَصحٰبُ الصِّرٰطِ السَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ اهتَدىٰ
20.transliteration: Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man ashabu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada
20.translation: Say: Each is awaiting; so await ye! Ye will come to know who are the owners of the path of equity, and who is right

21.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ اقتَرَبَ لِلنّاسِ حِسابُهُم وَهُم فى غَفلَةٍ مُعرِضونَ
21.transliteration: Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona
21.translation: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness

21.arabic: ما يَأتيهِم مِن ذِكرٍ مِن رَبِّهِم مُحدَثٍ إِلَّا استَمَعوهُ وَهُم يَلعَبونَ
21.transliteration: Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona
21.translation: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play

21.arabic: لاهِيَةً قُلوبُهُم وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجوَى الَّذينَ ظَلَموا هَل هٰذا إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُم أَفَتَأتونَ السِّحرَ وَأَنتُم تُبصِرونَ
21.transliteration: Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona
21.translation: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)

21.arabic: قالَ رَبّى يَعلَمُ القَولَ فِى السَّماءِ وَالأَرضِ وَهُوَ السَّميعُ العَليمُ
21.transliteration: Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu
21.translation: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower

21.arabic: بَل قالوا أَضغٰثُ أَحلٰمٍ بَلِ افتَرىٰهُ بَل هُوَ شاعِرٌ فَليَأتِنا بِـٔايَةٍ كَما أُرسِلَ الأَوَّلونَ
21.transliteration: Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona
21.translation: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents)

21.arabic: ما ءامَنَت قَبلَهُم مِن قَريَةٍ أَهلَكنٰها أَفَهُم يُؤمِنونَ
21.transliteration: Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona
21.translation: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe

21.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنا قَبلَكَ إِلّا رِجالًا نوحى إِلَيهِم فَسـَٔلوا أَهلَ الذِّكرِ إِن كُنتُم لا تَعلَمونَ
21.transliteration: Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona
21.translation: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not

21.arabic: وَما جَعَلنٰهُم جَسَدًا لا يَأكُلونَ الطَّعامَ وَما كانوا خٰلِدينَ
21.transliteration: Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena
21.translation: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals

21.arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقنٰهُمُ الوَعدَ فَأَنجَينٰهُم وَمَن نَشاءُ وَأَهلَكنَا المُسرِفينَ
21.transliteration: Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena
21.translation: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals

21.arabic: لَقَد أَنزَلنا إِلَيكُم كِتٰبًا فيهِ ذِكرُكُم أَفَلا تَعقِلونَ
21.transliteration: Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona
21.translation: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense

21.arabic: وَكَم قَصَمنا مِن قَريَةٍ كانَت ظالِمَةً وَأَنشَأنا بَعدَها قَومًا ءاخَرينَ
21.transliteration: Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena
21.translation: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk

21.arabic: فَلَمّا أَحَسّوا بَأسَنا إِذا هُم مِنها يَركُضونَ
21.transliteration: Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona
21.translation: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it

21.arabic: لا تَركُضوا وَارجِعوا إِلىٰ ما أُترِفتُم فيهِ وَمَسٰكِنِكُم لَعَلَّكُم تُسـَٔلونَ
21.transliteration: La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona
21.translation: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned

21.arabic: قالوا يٰوَيلَنا إِنّا كُنّا ظٰلِمينَ
21.transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena
21.translation: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers

21.arabic: فَما زالَت تِلكَ دَعوىٰهُم حَتّىٰ جَعَلنٰهُم حَصيدًا خٰمِدينَ
21.transliteration: Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena
21.translation: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct

21.arabic: وَما خَلَقنَا السَّماءَ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما لٰعِبينَ
21.transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena
21.translation: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play

21.arabic: لَو أَرَدنا أَن نَتَّخِذَ لَهوًا لَاتَّخَذنٰهُ مِن لَدُنّا إِن كُنّا فٰعِلينَ
21.transliteration: Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena
21.translation: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did

21.arabic: بَل نَقذِفُ بِالحَقِّ عَلَى البٰطِلِ فَيَدمَغُهُ فَإِذا هُوَ زاهِقٌ وَلَكُمُ الوَيلُ مِمّا تَصِفونَ
21.transliteration: Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona
21.translation: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him)

21.arabic: وَلَهُ مَن فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَمَن عِندَهُ لا يَستَكبِرونَ عَن عِبادَتِهِ وَلا يَستَحسِرونَ
21.transliteration: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona
21.translation: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary

21.arabic: يُسَبِّحونَ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ لا يَفتُرونَ
21.transliteration: Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona
21.translation: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not

21.arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذوا ءالِهَةً مِنَ الأَرضِ هُم يُنشِرونَ
21.transliteration: Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona
21.translation: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead

21.arabic: لَو كانَ فيهِما ءالِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتا فَسُبحٰنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العَرشِ عَمّا يَصِفونَ
21.transliteration: Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona
21.translation: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him)

21.arabic: لا يُسـَٔلُ عَمّا يَفعَلُ وَهُم يُسـَٔلونَ
21.transliteration: La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona
21.translation: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned

21.arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذوا مِن دونِهِ ءالِهَةً قُل هاتوا بُرهٰنَكُم هٰذا ذِكرُ مَن مَعِىَ وَذِكرُ مَن قَبلى بَل أَكثَرُهُم لا يَعلَمونَ الحَقَّ فَهُم مُعرِضونَ
21.transliteration: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man maAAiya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona alhaqqa fahum muAAridoona
21.translation: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse

21.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنا مِن قَبلِكَ مِن رَسولٍ إِلّا نوحى إِلَيهِ أَنَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا أَنا۠ فَاعبُدونِ
21.transliteration: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudooni
21.translation: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me

21.arabic: وَقالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحمٰنُ وَلَدًا سُبحٰنَهُ بَل عِبادٌ مُكرَمونَ
21.transliteration: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal AAibadun mukramoona
21.translation: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves

21.arabic: لا يَسبِقونَهُ بِالقَولِ وَهُم بِأَمرِهِ يَعمَلونَ
21.transliteration: La yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi yaAAmaloona
21.translation: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command

21.arabic: يَعلَمُ ما بَينَ أَيديهِم وَما خَلفَهُم وَلا يَشفَعونَ إِلّا لِمَنِ ارتَضىٰ وَهُم مِن خَشيَتِهِ مُشفِقونَ
21.transliteration: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfaAAoona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona
21.translation: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him

21.arabic: وَمَن يَقُل مِنهُم إِنّى إِلٰهٌ مِن دونِهِ فَذٰلِكَ نَجزيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجزِى الظّٰلِمينَ
21.transliteration: Waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena
21.translation: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers

21.arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا أَنَّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ كانَتا رَتقًا فَفَتَقنٰهُما وَجَعَلنا مِنَ الماءِ كُلَّ شَيءٍ حَىٍّ أَفَلا يُؤمِنونَ
21.transliteration: Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona
21.translation: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe

21.arabic: وَجَعَلنا فِى الأَرضِ رَوٰسِىَ أَن تَميدَ بِهِم وَجَعَلنا فيها فِجاجًا سُبُلًا لَعَلَّهُم يَهتَدونَ
21.transliteration: WajaAAalna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim wajaAAalna feeha fijajan subulan laAAallahum yahtadoona
21.translation: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way

21.arabic: وَجَعَلنَا السَّماءَ سَقفًا مَحفوظًا وَهُم عَن ءايٰتِها مُعرِضونَ
21.transliteration: WajaAAalna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum AAan ayatiha muAAridoona
21.translation: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents

21.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى خَلَقَ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ وَالشَّمسَ وَالقَمَرَ كُلٌّ فى فَلَكٍ يَسبَحونَ
21.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona
21.translation: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit

21.arabic: وَما جَعَلنا لِبَشَرٍ مِن قَبلِكَ الخُلدَ أَفَإِي۟ن مِتَّ فَهُمُ الخٰلِدونَ
21.transliteration: Wama jaAAalna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona
21.translation: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal

21.arabic: كُلُّ نَفسٍ ذائِقَةُ المَوتِ وَنَبلوكُم بِالشَّرِّ وَالخَيرِ فِتنَةً وَإِلَينا تُرجَعونَ
21.transliteration: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turjaAAoona
21.translation: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned

21.arabic: وَإِذا رَءاكَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا إِن يَتَّخِذونَكَ إِلّا هُزُوًا أَهٰذَا الَّذى يَذكُرُ ءالِهَتَكُم وَهُم بِذِكرِ الرَّحمٰنِ هُم كٰفِرونَ
21.transliteration: Waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona
21.translation: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent

21.arabic: خُلِقَ الإِنسٰنُ مِن عَجَلٍ سَأُو۟ريكُم ءايٰتى فَلا تَستَعجِلونِ
21.transliteration: Khuliqa alinsanu min AAajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tastaAAjiloona
21.translation: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten

21.arabic: وَيَقولونَ مَتىٰ هٰذَا الوَعدُ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
21.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
21.translation: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful

21.arabic: لَو يَعلَمُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا حينَ لا يَكُفّونَ عَن وُجوهِهِمُ النّارَ وَلا عَن ظُهورِهِم وَلا هُم يُنصَرونَ
21.transliteration: Law yaAAlamu allatheena kafaroo heena la yakuffoona AAan wujoohihimu alnnara wala AAan thuhoorihim wala hum yunsaroona
21.translation: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped

21.arabic: بَل تَأتيهِم بَغتَةً فَتَبهَتُهُم فَلا يَستَطيعونَ رَدَّها وَلا هُم يُنظَرونَ
21.transliteration: Bal tateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum fala yastateeAAoona raddaha wala hum yuntharoona
21.translation: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved

21.arabic: وَلَقَدِ استُهزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِن قَبلِكَ فَحاقَ بِالَّذينَ سَخِروا مِنهُم ما كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
21.transliteration: Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
21.translation: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them

21.arabic: قُل مَن يَكلَؤُكُم بِالَّيلِ وَالنَّهارِ مِنَ الرَّحمٰنِ بَل هُم عَن ذِكرِ رَبِّهِم مُعرِضونَ
21.transliteration: Qul man yaklaokum biallayli waalnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum AAan thikri rabbihim muAAridoona
21.translation: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord

21.arabic: أَم لَهُم ءالِهَةٌ تَمنَعُهُم مِن دونِنا لا يَستَطيعونَ نَصرَ أَنفُسِهِم وَلا هُم مِنّا يُصحَبونَ
21.transliteration: Am lahum alihatun tamnaAAuhum min doonina la yastateeAAoona nasra anfusihim wala hum minna yushaboona
21.translation: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us

21.arabic: بَل مَتَّعنا هٰؤُلاءِ وَءاباءَهُم حَتّىٰ طالَ عَلَيهِمُ العُمُرُ أَفَلا يَرَونَ أَنّا نَأتِى الأَرضَ نَنقُصُها مِن أَطرافِها أَفَهُمُ الغٰلِبونَ
21.transliteration: Bal mattaAAna haolai waabaahum hatta tala AAalayhimu alAAumuru afala yarawna anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alghaliboona
21.translation: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors

21.arabic: قُل إِنَّما أُنذِرُكُم بِالوَحىِ وَلا يَسمَعُ الصُّمُّ الدُّعاءَ إِذا ما يُنذَرونَ
21.transliteration: Qul innama onthirukum bialwahyi wala yasmaAAu alssummu aldduAAaa itha ma yuntharoona
21.translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned

21.arabic: وَلَئِن مَسَّتهُم نَفحَةٌ مِن عَذابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقولُنَّ يٰوَيلَنا إِنّا كُنّا ظٰلِمينَ
21.transliteration: Walain massathum nafhatun min AAathabi rabbika layaqoolunna ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena
21.translation: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers

21.arabic: وَنَضَعُ المَوٰزينَ القِسطَ لِيَومِ القِيٰمَةِ فَلا تُظلَمُ نَفسٌ شَيـًٔا وَإِن كانَ مِثقالَ حَبَّةٍ مِن خَردَلٍ أَتَينا بِها وَكَفىٰ بِنا حٰسِبينَ
21.transliteration: WanadaAAu almawazeena alqista liyawmi alqiyamati fala tuthlamu nafsun shayan wain kana mithqala habbatin min khardalin atayna biha wakafa bina hasibeena
21.translation: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners

21.arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا موسىٰ وَهٰرونَ الفُرقانَ وَضِياءً وَذِكرًا لِلمُتَّقينَ
21.transliteration: Walaqad atayna moosa waharoona alfurqana wadiyaan wathikran lilmuttaqeena
21.translation: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil

21.arabic: الَّذينَ يَخشَونَ رَبَّهُم بِالغَيبِ وَهُم مِنَ السّاعَةِ مُشفِقونَ
21.transliteration: Allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi wahum mina alssaAAati mushfiqoona
21.translation: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom)

21.arabic: وَهٰذا ذِكرٌ مُبارَكٌ أَنزَلنٰهُ أَفَأَنتُم لَهُ مُنكِرونَ
21.transliteration: Wahatha thikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afaantum lahu munkiroona
21.translation: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it

21.arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا إِبرٰهيمَ رُشدَهُ مِن قَبلُ وَكُنّا بِهِ عٰلِمينَ
21.transliteration: Walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi AAalimeena
21.translation: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him

21.arabic: إِذ قالَ لِأَبيهِ وَقَومِهِ ما هٰذِهِ التَّماثيلُ الَّتى أَنتُم لَها عٰكِفونَ
21.transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi alttamatheelu allatee antum laha AAakifoona
21.translation: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion

21.arabic: قالوا وَجَدنا ءاباءَنا لَها عٰبِدينَ
21.transliteration: Qaloo wajadna abaana laha AAabideena
21.translation: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them

21.arabic: قالَ لَقَد كُنتُم أَنتُم وَءاباؤُكُم فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
21.transliteration: Qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeenin
21.translation: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error

21.arabic: قالوا أَجِئتَنا بِالحَقِّ أَم أَنتَ مِنَ اللّٰعِبينَ
21.transliteration: Qaloo ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina allaAAibeena
21.translation: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester

21.arabic: قالَ بَل رَبُّكُم رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ الَّذى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنا۠ عَلىٰ ذٰلِكُم مِنَ الشّٰهِدينَ
21.transliteration: Qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamawati waalardi allathee fatarahunna waana AAala thalikum mina alshshahideena
21.translation: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that

21.arabic: وَتَاللَّهِ لَأَكيدَنَّ أَصنٰمَكُم بَعدَ أَن تُوَلّوا مُدبِرينَ
21.transliteration: WataAllahi laakeedanna asnamakum baAAda an tuwalloo mudbireena
21.translation: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs

21.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُم جُذٰذًا إِلّا كَبيرًا لَهُم لَعَلَّهُم إِلَيهِ يَرجِعونَ
21.transliteration: FajaAAalahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum laAAallahum ilayhi yarjiAAoona
21.translation: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it

21.arabic: قالوا مَن فَعَلَ هٰذا بِـٔالِهَتِنا إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الظّٰلِمينَ
21.transliteration: Qaloo man faAAala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina alththalimeena
21.translation: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer

21.arabic: قالوا سَمِعنا فَتًى يَذكُرُهُم يُقالُ لَهُ إِبرٰهيمُ
21.transliteration: Qaloo samiAAna fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheemu
21.translation: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham

21.arabic: قالوا فَأتوا بِهِ عَلىٰ أَعيُنِ النّاسِ لَعَلَّهُم يَشهَدونَ
21.transliteration: Qaloo fatoo bihi AAala aAAyuni alnnasi laAAallahum yashhadoona
21.translation: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify

21.arabic: قالوا ءَأَنتَ فَعَلتَ هٰذا بِـٔالِهَتِنا يٰإِبرٰهيمُ
21.transliteration: Qaloo aanta faAAalta hatha bialihatina ya ibraheemu
21.translation: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham

21.arabic: قالَ بَل فَعَلَهُ كَبيرُهُم هٰذا فَسـَٔلوهُم إِن كانوا يَنطِقونَ
21.transliteration: Qala bal faAAalahu kabeeruhum hatha faisaloohum in kanoo yantiqoona
21.translation: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak

21.arabic: فَرَجَعوا إِلىٰ أَنفُسِهِم فَقالوا إِنَّكُم أَنتُمُ الظّٰلِمونَ
21.transliteration: FarajaAAoo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu alththalimoona
21.translation: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers

21.arabic: ثُمَّ نُكِسوا عَلىٰ رُءوسِهِم لَقَد عَلِمتَ ما هٰؤُلاءِ يَنطِقونَ
21.transliteration: Thumma nukisoo AAala ruoosihim laqad AAalimta ma haolai yantiqoona
21.translation: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not

21.arabic: قالَ أَفَتَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ما لا يَنفَعُكُم شَيـًٔا وَلا يَضُرُّكُم
21.transliteration: Qala afataAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAukum shayan wala yadurrukum
21.translation: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you

21.arabic: أُفٍّ لَكُم وَلِما تَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ أَفَلا تَعقِلونَ
21.transliteration: Offin lakum walima taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi afala taAAqiloona
21.translation: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense

21.arabic: قالوا حَرِّقوهُ وَانصُروا ءالِهَتَكُم إِن كُنتُم فٰعِلينَ
21.transliteration: Qaloo harriqoohu waonsuroo alihatakum in kuntum faAAileena
21.translation: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing

21.arabic: قُلنا يٰنارُ كونى بَردًا وَسَلٰمًا عَلىٰ إِبرٰهيمَ
21.transliteration: Qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman AAala ibraheema
21.translation: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham

21.arabic: وَأَرادوا بِهِ كَيدًا فَجَعَلنٰهُمُ الأَخسَرينَ
21.transliteration: Waaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alakhsareena
21.translation: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers

21.arabic: وَنَجَّينٰهُ وَلوطًا إِلَى الأَرضِ الَّتى بٰرَكنا فيها لِلعٰلَمينَ
21.transliteration: Wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lilAAalameena
21.translation: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples

21.arabic: وَوَهَبنا لَهُ إِسحٰقَ وَيَعقوبَ نافِلَةً وَكُلًّا جَعَلنا صٰلِحينَ
21.transliteration: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba nafilatan wakullan jaAAalna saliheena
21.translation: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous

21.arabic: وَجَعَلنٰهُم أَئِمَّةً يَهدونَ بِأَمرِنا وَأَوحَينا إِلَيهِم فِعلَ الخَيرٰتِ وَإِقامَ الصَّلوٰةِ وَإيتاءَ الزَّكوٰةِ وَكانوا لَنا عٰبِدينَ
21.transliteration: WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fiAAla alkhayrati waiqama alssalati waeetaa alzzakati wakanoo lana AAabideena
21.translation: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone)

21.arabic: وَلوطًا ءاتَينٰهُ حُكمًا وَعِلمًا وَنَجَّينٰهُ مِنَ القَريَةِ الَّتى كانَت تَعمَلُ الخَبٰئِثَ إِنَّهُم كانوا قَومَ سَوءٍ فٰسِقينَ
21.transliteration: Walootan ataynahu hukman waAAilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat taAAmalu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeena
21.translation: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd

21.arabic: وَأَدخَلنٰهُ فى رَحمَتِنا إِنَّهُ مِنَ الصّٰلِحينَ
21.transliteration: Waadkhalnahu fee rahmatina innahu mina alssaliheena
21.translation: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous

21.arabic: وَنوحًا إِذ نادىٰ مِن قَبلُ فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ فَنَجَّينٰهُ وَأَهلَهُ مِنَ الكَربِ العَظيمِ
21.transliteration: Wanoohan ith nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi
21.translation: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction

21.arabic: وَنَصَرنٰهُ مِنَ القَومِ الَّذينَ كَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِنا إِنَّهُم كانوا قَومَ سَوءٍ فَأَغرَقنٰهُم أَجمَعينَ
21.transliteration: Wanasarnahu mina alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawma sawin faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena
21.translation: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all

21.arabic: وَداوۥدَ وَسُلَيمٰنَ إِذ يَحكُمانِ فِى الحَرثِ إِذ نَفَشَت فيهِ غَنَمُ القَومِ وَكُنّا لِحُكمِهِم شٰهِدينَ
21.transliteration: Wadawooda wasulaymana ith yahkumani fee alharthi ith nafashat feehi ghanamu alqawmi wakunna lihukmihim shahideena
21.translation: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment

21.arabic: فَفَهَّمنٰها سُلَيمٰنَ وَكُلًّا ءاتَينا حُكمًا وَعِلمًا وَسَخَّرنا مَعَ داوۥدَ الجِبالَ يُسَبِّحنَ وَالطَّيرَ وَكُنّا فٰعِلينَ
21.transliteration: Fafahhamnaha sulaymana wakullan atayna hukman waAAilman wasakhkharna maAAa dawooda aljibala yusabbihna waalttayra wakunna faAAileena
21.translation: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof)

21.arabic: وَعَلَّمنٰهُ صَنعَةَ لَبوسٍ لَكُم لِتُحصِنَكُم مِن بَأسِكُم فَهَل أَنتُم شٰكِرونَ
21.transliteration: WaAAallamnahu sanAAata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiroona
21.translation: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful

21.arabic: وَلِسُلَيمٰنَ الرّيحَ عاصِفَةً تَجرى بِأَمرِهِ إِلَى الأَرضِ الَّتى بٰرَكنا فيها وَكُنّا بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عٰلِمينَ
21.transliteration: Walisulaymana alrreeha AAasifatan tajree biamrihi ila alardi allatee barakna feeha wakunna bikulli shayin AAalimeena
21.translation: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware

21.arabic: وَمِنَ الشَّيٰطينِ مَن يَغوصونَ لَهُ وَيَعمَلونَ عَمَلًا دونَ ذٰلِكَ وَكُنّا لَهُم حٰفِظينَ
21.transliteration: Wamina alshshayateeni man yaghoosoona lahu wayaAAmaloona AAamalan doona thalika wakunna lahum hafitheena
21.translation: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them

21.arabic: وَأَيّوبَ إِذ نادىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنّى مَسَّنِىَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرحَمُ الرّٰحِمينَ
21.transliteration: Waayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alddurru waanta arhamu alrrahimeena
21.translation: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy

21.arabic: فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ فَكَشَفنا ما بِهِ مِن ضُرٍّ وَءاتَينٰهُ أَهلَهُ وَمِثلَهُم مَعَهُم رَحمَةً مِن عِندِنا وَذِكرىٰ لِلعٰبِدينَ
21.transliteration: Faistajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin waataynahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan min AAindina wathikra lilAAabideena
21.translation: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers

21.arabic: وَإِسمٰعيلَ وَإِدريسَ وَذَا الكِفلِ كُلٌّ مِنَ الصّٰبِرينَ
21.transliteration: WaismaAAeela waidreesa watha alkifli kullun mina alssabireena
21.translation: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast

21.arabic: وَأَدخَلنٰهُم فى رَحمَتِنا إِنَّهُم مِنَ الصّٰلِحينَ
21.transliteration: Waadkhalnahum fee rahmatina innahum mina alssaliheena
21.translation: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous

21.arabic: وَذَا النّونِ إِذ ذَهَبَ مُغٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَن نَقدِرَ عَلَيهِ فَنادىٰ فِى الظُّلُمٰتِ أَن لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا أَنتَ سُبحٰنَكَ إِنّى كُنتُ مِنَ الظّٰلِمينَ
21.transliteration: Watha alnnooni ith thahaba mughadiban fathanna an lan naqdira AAalayhi fanada fee alththulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina alththalimeena
21.translation: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer

21.arabic: فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ وَنَجَّينٰهُ مِنَ الغَمِّ وَكَذٰلِكَ نُۨجِى المُؤمِنينَ
21.transliteration: Faistajabna lahu wanajjaynahu mina alghammi wakathalika nunjee almumineena
21.translation: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers

21.arabic: وَزَكَرِيّا إِذ نادىٰ رَبَّهُ رَبِّ لا تَذَرنى فَردًا وَأَنتَ خَيرُ الوٰرِثينَ
21.transliteration: Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheena
21.translation: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors

21.arabic: فَاستَجَبنا لَهُ وَوَهَبنا لَهُ يَحيىٰ وَأَصلَحنا لَهُ زَوجَهُ إِنَّهُم كانوا يُسٰرِعونَ فِى الخَيرٰتِ وَيَدعونَنا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا وَكانوا لَنا خٰشِعينَ
21.transliteration: Faistajabna lahu wawahabna lahu yahya waaslahna lahu zawjahu innahum kanoo yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wayadAAoonana raghaban warahaban wakanoo lana khashiAAeena
21.translation: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us

21.arabic: وَالَّتى أَحصَنَت فَرجَها فَنَفَخنا فيها مِن روحِنا وَجَعَلنٰها وَابنَها ءايَةً لِلعٰلَمينَ
21.transliteration: Waallatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feeha min roohina wajaAAalnaha waibnaha ayatan lilAAalameena
21.translation: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples

21.arabic: إِنَّ هٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُم أُمَّةً وٰحِدَةً وَأَنا۠ رَبُّكُم فَاعبُدونِ
21.transliteration: Inna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faoAAbudooni
21.translation: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me

21.arabic: وَتَقَطَّعوا أَمرَهُم بَينَهُم كُلٌّ إِلَينا رٰجِعونَ
21.transliteration: WataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna rajiAAoona
21.translation: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us

21.arabic: فَمَن يَعمَل مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤمِنٌ فَلا كُفرانَ لِسَعيِهِ وَإِنّا لَهُ كٰتِبونَ
21.transliteration: Faman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala kufrana lisaAAyihi wainna lahu katiboona
21.translation: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him

21.arabic: وَحَرٰمٌ عَلىٰ قَريَةٍ أَهلَكنٰها أَنَّهُم لا يَرجِعونَ
21.transliteration: Waharamun AAala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarjiAAoona
21.translation: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return

21.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا فُتِحَت يَأجوجُ وَمَأجوجُ وَهُم مِن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلونَ
21.transliteration: Hatta itha futihat yajooju wamajooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloona
21.translation: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound

21.arabic: وَاقتَرَبَ الوَعدُ الحَقُّ فَإِذا هِىَ شٰخِصَةٌ أَبصٰرُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا يٰوَيلَنا قَد كُنّا فى غَفلَةٍ مِن هٰذا بَل كُنّا ظٰلِمينَ
21.transliteration: Waiqtaraba alwaAAdu alhaqqu faitha hiya shakhisatun absaru allatheena kafaroo ya waylana qad kunna fee ghaflatin min hatha bal kunna thalimeena
21.translation: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers

21.arabic: إِنَّكُم وَما تَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُم لَها وٰرِدونَ
21.transliteration: Innakum wama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridoona
21.translation: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come

21.arabic: لَو كانَ هٰؤُلاءِ ءالِهَةً ما وَرَدوها وَكُلٌّ فيها خٰلِدونَ
21.transliteration: Law kana haolai alihatan ma waradooha wakullun feeha khalidoona
21.translation: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein

21.arabic: لَهُم فيها زَفيرٌ وَهُم فيها لا يَسمَعونَ
21.transliteration: Lahum feeha zafeerun wahum feeha la yasmaAAoona
21.translation: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not

21.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ سَبَقَت لَهُم مِنَّا الحُسنىٰ أُولٰئِكَ عَنها مُبعَدونَ
21.transliteration: Inna allatheena sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika AAanha mubAAadoona
21.translation: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence

21.arabic: لا يَسمَعونَ حَسيسَها وَهُم فى مَا اشتَهَت أَنفُسُهُم خٰلِدونَ
21.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona haseesaha wahum fee ma ishtahat anfusuhum khalidoona
21.translation: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire

21.arabic: لا يَحزُنُهُمُ الفَزَعُ الأَكبَرُ وَتَتَلَقّىٰهُمُ المَلٰئِكَةُ هٰذا يَومُكُمُ الَّذى كُنتُم توعَدونَ
21.transliteration: La yahzunuhumu alfazaAAu alakbaru watatalaqqahumu almalaikatu hatha yawmukumu allathee kuntum tooAAadoona
21.translation: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised

21.arabic: يَومَ نَطوِى السَّماءَ كَطَىِّ السِّجِلِّ لِلكُتُبِ كَما بَدَأنا أَوَّلَ خَلقٍ نُعيدُهُ وَعدًا عَلَينا إِنّا كُنّا فٰعِلينَ
21.transliteration: Yawma natwee alssamaa katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nuAAeeduhu waAAdan AAalayna inna kunna faAAileena
21.translation: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it

21.arabic: وَلَقَد كَتَبنا فِى الزَّبورِ مِن بَعدِ الذِّكرِ أَنَّ الأَرضَ يَرِثُها عِبادِىَ الصّٰلِحونَ
21.transliteration: Walaqad katabna fee alzzaboori min baAAdi alththikri anna alarda yarithuha AAibadiya alssalihoona
21.translation: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth

21.arabic: إِنَّ فى هٰذا لَبَلٰغًا لِقَومٍ عٰبِدينَ
21.transliteration: Inna fee hatha labalaghan liqawmin AAabideena
21.translation: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout

21.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنٰكَ إِلّا رَحمَةً لِلعٰلَمينَ
21.transliteration: Wama arsalnaka illa rahmatan lilAAalameena
21.translation: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples

21.arabic: قُل إِنَّما يوحىٰ إِلَىَّ أَنَّما إِلٰهُكُم إِلٰهٌ وٰحِدٌ فَهَل أَنتُم مُسلِمونَ
21.transliteration: Qul innama yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoona
21.translation: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)

21.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوا فَقُل ءاذَنتُكُم عَلىٰ سَواءٍ وَإِن أَدرى أَقَريبٌ أَم بَعيدٌ ما توعَدونَ
21.transliteration: Fain tawallaw faqul athantukum AAala sawain wain adree aqareebun am baAAeedun ma tooAAadoona
21.translation: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised

21.arabic: إِنَّهُ يَعلَمُ الجَهرَ مِنَ القَولِ وَيَعلَمُ ما تَكتُمونَ
21.transliteration: Innahu yaAAlamu aljahra mina alqawli wayaAAlamu ma taktumoona
21.translation: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal

21.arabic: وَإِن أَدرى لَعَلَّهُ فِتنَةٌ لَكُم وَمَتٰعٌ إِلىٰ حينٍ
21.transliteration: Wain adree laAAallahu fitnatun lakum wamataAAun ila heenin
21.translation: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while

21.arabic: قٰلَ رَبِّ احكُم بِالحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحمٰنُ المُستَعانُ عَلىٰ ما تَصِفونَ
21.transliteration: Qala rabbi ohkum bialhaqqi warabbuna alrrahmanu almustaAAanu AAala ma tasifoona
21.translation: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him)

22.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ اتَّقوا رَبَّكُم إِنَّ زَلزَلَةَ السّاعَةِ شَيءٌ عَظيمٌ
22.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqoo rabbakum inna zalzalata alssaAAati shayon AAatheemun
22.translation: O mankind! Fear your Lord. Lo! the earthquake of the Hour (of Doom) is a tremendous thing

22.arabic: يَومَ تَرَونَها تَذهَلُ كُلُّ مُرضِعَةٍ عَمّا أَرضَعَت وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذاتِ حَملٍ حَملَها وَتَرَى النّاسَ سُكٰرىٰ وَما هُم بِسُكٰرىٰ وَلٰكِنَّ عَذابَ اللَّهِ شَديدٌ
22.transliteration: Yawma tarawnaha tathhalu kullu murdiAAatin AAamma ardaAAat watadaAAu kullu thati hamlin hamlaha watara alnnasa sukara wama hum bisukara walakinna AAathaba Allahi shadeedun
22.translation: On the day when ye behold it, every nursing mother will forget her nursling and every pregnant one will be delivered of her burden, and thou (Muhammad) wilt see mankind as drunken, yet they will not be drunken, but the Doom of Allah will be strong (upon them)

22.arabic: وَمِنَ النّاسِ مَن يُجٰدِلُ فِى اللَّهِ بِغَيرِ عِلمٍ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيطٰنٍ مَريدٍ
22.transliteration: Wamina alnnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri AAilmin wayattabiAAu kulla shaytanin mareedin
22.translation: Among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge, and followeth each froward devil

22.arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيهِ أَنَّهُ مَن تَوَلّاهُ فَأَنَّهُ يُضِلُّهُ وَيَهديهِ إِلىٰ عَذابِ السَّعيرِ
22.transliteration: Kutiba AAalayhi annahu man tawallahu faannahu yudilluhu wayahdeehi ila AAathabi alssaAAeeri
22.translation: For him it is decreed that whoso taketh him for friend, he verily will mislead him and will guide him to the punishment of the Flame

22.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ إِن كُنتُم فى رَيبٍ مِنَ البَعثِ فَإِنّا خَلَقنٰكُم مِن تُرابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُطفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِن مُضغَةٍ مُخَلَّقَةٍ وَغَيرِ مُخَلَّقَةٍ لِنُبَيِّنَ لَكُم وَنُقِرُّ فِى الأَرحامِ ما نَشاءُ إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ نُخرِجُكُم طِفلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبلُغوا أَشُدَّكُم وَمِنكُم مَن يُتَوَفّىٰ وَمِنكُم مَن يُرَدُّ إِلىٰ أَرذَلِ العُمُرِ لِكَيلا يَعلَمَ مِن بَعدِ عِلمٍ شَيـًٔا وَتَرَى الأَرضَ هامِدَةً فَإِذا أَنزَلنا عَلَيهَا الماءَ اهتَزَّت وَرَبَت وَأَنبَتَت مِن كُلِّ زَوجٍ بَهيجٍ
22.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu in kuntum fee raybin mina albaAAthi fainna khalaqnakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min AAalaqatin thumma min mudghatin mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fee alarhami ma nashao ila ajalin musamman thumma nukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffa waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali alAAumuri likayla yaAAlama min baAAdi AAilmin shayan watara alarda hamidatan faitha anzalna AAalayha almaa ihtazzat warabat waanbatat min kulli zawjin baheejin
22.translation: O mankind! if ye are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then lo! We have created you from dust, then from a drop of seed, then from a clot, then from a little lump of flesh shapely and shapeless, that We may make (it) clear for you. And We cause what We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed time, and afterward We bring you forth as infants, then (give you growth) that ye attain your full strength. And among you there is he who dieth (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the most abject time of life, so that, after knowledge, he knoweth naught. And thou (Muhammad) seest the earth barren, but when We send down water thereon, it doth thrill and swell and put forth every lovely kind (of growth)

22.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُ يُحىِ المَوتىٰ وَأَنَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
22.transliteration: Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waannahu yuhyee almawta waannahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
22.translation: That is because Allah, He is the Truth and because He quickeneth the dead, and because He is Able to do all things

22.arabic: وَأَنَّ السّاعَةَ ءاتِيَةٌ لا رَيبَ فيها وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبعَثُ مَن فِى القُبورِ
22.transliteration: Waanna alssaAAata atiyatun la rayba feeha waanna Allaha yabAAathu man fee alquboori
22.translation: And because the Hour will come, there is no doubt thereof; and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves

22.arabic: وَمِنَ النّاسِ مَن يُجٰدِلُ فِى اللَّهِ بِغَيرِ عِلمٍ وَلا هُدًى وَلا كِتٰبٍ مُنيرٍ
22.transliteration: Wamina alnnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri AAilmin wala hudan wala kitabin muneerin
22.translation: And among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge or guidance or a scripture giving light

22.arabic: ثانِىَ عِطفِهِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُ فِى الدُّنيا خِزىٌ وَنُذيقُهُ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ عَذابَ الحَريقِ
22.transliteration: Thaniya AAitfihi liyudilla AAan sabeeli Allahi lahu fee alddunya khizyun wanutheequhu yawma alqiyamati AAathaba alhareeqi
22.translation: Turning away in pride to beguile (men) from the way of Allah. For him in this world is ignominy, and on the Day of Resurrection We make him taste the doom of burning

22.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِما قَدَّمَت يَداكَ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ لَيسَ بِظَلّٰمٍ لِلعَبيدِ
22.transliteration: Thalika bima qaddamat yadaka waanna Allaha laysa bithallamin lilAAabeedi
22.translation: (And unto him it will be said): This is for that which thy two hands have sent before, and because Allah is no oppressor of His slaves

22.arabic: وَمِنَ النّاسِ مَن يَعبُدُ اللَّهَ عَلىٰ حَرفٍ فَإِن أَصابَهُ خَيرٌ اطمَأَنَّ بِهِ وَإِن أَصابَتهُ فِتنَةٌ انقَلَبَ عَلىٰ وَجهِهِ خَسِرَ الدُّنيا وَالءاخِرَةَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الخُسرانُ المُبينُ
22.transliteration: Wamina alnnasi man yaAAbudu Allaha AAala harfin fain asabahu khayrun itmaanna bihi wain asabathu fitnatun inqalaba AAala wajhihi khasira alddunya waalakhirata thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu
22.translation: And among mankind is he who worshippeth Allah upon a narrow marge so that if good befalleth him he is content therewith, but if a trial befalleth him, he falleth away utterly. He loseth both the world and the Hereafter. That is the sheer loss

22.arabic: يَدعوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ما لا يَضُرُّهُ وَما لا يَنفَعُهُ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلٰلُ البَعيدُ
22.transliteration: YadAAoo min dooni Allahi ma la yadurruhu wama la yanfaAAuhu thalika huwa alddalalu albaAAeedu
22.translation: He calleth, beside Allah, unto that which hurteth him not nor benefiteth him. That is the far error

22.arabic: يَدعوا لَمَن ضَرُّهُ أَقرَبُ مِن نَفعِهِ لَبِئسَ المَولىٰ وَلَبِئسَ العَشيرُ
22.transliteration: YadAAoo laman darruhu aqrabu min nafAAihi labisa almawla walabisa alAAasheeru
22.translation: He calleth unto him whose harm is nearer than his benefit; verily an evil patron and verily an evil friend

22.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدخِلُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفعَلُ ما يُريدُ
22.transliteration: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu inna Allaha yafAAalu ma yureedu
22.translation: Lo! Allah causeth those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Lo! Allah doth what He intendeth

22.arabic: مَن كانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَن يَنصُرَهُ اللَّهُ فِى الدُّنيا وَالءاخِرَةِ فَليَمدُد بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى السَّماءِ ثُمَّ ليَقطَع فَليَنظُر هَل يُذهِبَنَّ كَيدُهُ ما يَغيظُ
22.transliteration: Man kana yathunnu an lan yansurahu Allahu fee alddunya waalakhirati falyamdud bisababin ila alssamai thumma liyaqtaAA falyanthur hal yuthhibanna kayduhu ma yagheethu
22.translation: Whoso is wont to think (through envy) that Allah will not give him (Muhammad) victory in the world and the Hereafter (and is enraged at the thought of his victory), let him stretch a rope up to the roof (of his dwelling), and let him hang himself. Then let him see whether his strategy dispelleth that whereat he rageth

22.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنزَلنٰهُ ءايٰتٍ بَيِّنٰتٍ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ يَهدى مَن يُريدُ
22.transliteration: Wakathalika anzalnahu ayatin bayyinatin waanna Allaha yahdee man yureedu
22.translation: Thus We reveal it as plain revelations, and verily Allah guideth whom He will

22.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَالَّذينَ هادوا وَالصّٰبِـٔينَ وَالنَّصٰرىٰ وَالمَجوسَ وَالَّذينَ أَشرَكوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفصِلُ بَينَهُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ شَهيدٌ
22.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waallatheena hadoo waalssabieena waalnnasara waalmajoosa waallatheena ashrakoo inna Allaha yafsilu baynahum yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin shaheedun
22.translation: Lo! those who believe (this revelation), and those who are Jews, and the Sabaeans and the Christians and the Magians and the idolaters - Lo! Allah will decide between them on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! Allah is Witness over all things

22.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَسجُدُ لَهُ مَن فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَن فِى الأَرضِ وَالشَّمسُ وَالقَمَرُ وَالنُّجومُ وَالجِبالُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوابُّ وَكَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ وَكَثيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيهِ العَذابُ وَمَن يُهِنِ اللَّهُ فَما لَهُ مِن مُكرِمٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَفعَلُ ما يَشاءُ
22.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha yasjudu lahu man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi waalshshamsu waalqamaru waalnnujoomu waaljibalu waalshshajaru waalddawabbu wakatheerun mina alnnasi wakatheerun haqqa AAalayhi alAAathabu waman yuhini Allahu fama lahu min mukrimin inna Allaha yafAAalu ma yashao
22.translation: Hast thou not seen that unto Allah payeth adoration whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the hills, and the trees, and the beasts, and many of mankind, while there are many unto whom the doom is justly due. He whom Allah scorneth, there is none to give him honour. Lo! Allah doeth what He will

22.arabic: هٰذانِ خَصمانِ اختَصَموا فى رَبِّهِم فَالَّذينَ كَفَروا قُطِّعَت لَهُم ثِيابٌ مِن نارٍ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوقِ رُءوسِهِمُ الحَميمُ
22.transliteration: Hathani khasmani ikhtasamoo fee rabbihim faallatheena kafaroo quttiAAat lahum thiyabun min narin yusabbu min fawqi ruoosihimu alhameemu
22.translation: These twain (the believers and the disbelievers) are two opponents who contend concerning their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, garments of fire will be cut out for them; boiling fluid will be poured down on their heads

22.arabic: يُصهَرُ بِهِ ما فى بُطونِهِم وَالجُلودُ
22.transliteration: Yusharu bihi ma fee butoonihim waaljuloodu
22.translation: Whereby that which is in their bellies, and their skins too, will be melted

22.arabic: وَلَهُم مَقٰمِعُ مِن حَديدٍ
22.transliteration: Walahum maqamiAAu min hadeedin
22.translation: And for them are hooked rods of iron

22.arabic: كُلَّما أَرادوا أَن يَخرُجوا مِنها مِن غَمٍّ أُعيدوا فيها وَذوقوا عَذابَ الحَريقِ
22.transliteration: Kullama aradoo an yakhrujoo minha min ghammin oAAeedoo feeha wathooqoo AAathaba alhareeqi
22.translation: Whenever, in their anguish, they would go forth from thence they are driven back therein and (it is said unto them): Taste the doom of burning

22.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدخِلُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ يُحَلَّونَ فيها مِن أَساوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤلُؤًا وَلِباسُهُم فيها حَريرٌ
22.transliteration: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun
22.translation: Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will be allowed armlets of gold, and pearls, and their raiment therein will be silk

22.arabic: وَهُدوا إِلَى الطَّيِّبِ مِنَ القَولِ وَهُدوا إِلىٰ صِرٰطِ الحَميدِ
22.transliteration: Wahudoo ila alttayyibi mina alqawli wahudoo ila sirati alhameedi
22.translation: They are guided unto gentle speech; they are guided unto the path of the Glorious One

22.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَيَصُدّونَ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَالمَسجِدِ الحَرامِ الَّذى جَعَلنٰهُ لِلنّاسِ سَواءً العٰكِفُ فيهِ وَالبادِ وَمَن يُرِد فيهِ بِإِلحادٍ بِظُلمٍ نُذِقهُ مِن عَذابٍ أَليمٍ
22.transliteration: Inna allatheena kafaroo wayasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi waalmasjidi alharami allathee jaAAalnahu lilnnasi sawaan alAAakifu feehi waalbadi waman yurid feehi biilhadin bithulmin nuthiqhu min AAathabin aleemin
22.translation: Lo! those who disbelieve and bar (men) from the way of Allah and from the Inviolable Place of Worship, which We have appointed for mankind together, the dweller therein and the nomad: whosoever seeketh wrongful partiality therein, him We shall cause to taste a painful doom

22.arabic: وَإِذ بَوَّأنا لِإِبرٰهيمَ مَكانَ البَيتِ أَن لا تُشرِك بى شَيـًٔا وَطَهِّر بَيتِىَ لِلطّائِفينَ وَالقائِمينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ السُّجودِ
22.transliteration: Waith bawwana liibraheema makana albayti an la tushrik bee shayan watahhir baytiya lilttaifeena waalqaimeena waalrrukkaAAi alssujoodi
22.translation: And (remember) when We prepared for Abraham the place of the (holy) House, saying: Ascribe thou no thing as partner unto Me, and purify My House for those who make the round (thereof) and those who stand and those who bow and make prostration

22.arabic: وَأَذِّن فِى النّاسِ بِالحَجِّ يَأتوكَ رِجالًا وَعَلىٰ كُلِّ ضامِرٍ يَأتينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَميقٍ
22.transliteration: Waaththin fee alnnasi bialhajji yatooka rijalan waAAala kulli damirin yateena min kulli fajjin AAameeqin
22.translation: And proclaim unto mankind the pilgrimage. They will come unto thee on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every deep ravine

22.arabic: لِيَشهَدوا مَنٰفِعَ لَهُم وَيَذكُرُوا اسمَ اللَّهِ فى أَيّامٍ مَعلومٰتٍ عَلىٰ ما رَزَقَهُم مِن بَهيمَةِ الأَنعٰمِ فَكُلوا مِنها وَأَطعِمُوا البائِسَ الفَقيرَ
22.transliteration: Liyashhadoo manafiAAa lahum wayathkuroo isma Allahi fee ayyamin maAAloomatin AAala ma razaqahum min baheemati alanAAami fakuloo minha waatAAimoo albaisa alfaqeera
22.translation: That they may witness things that are of benefit to them, and mention the name of Allah on appointed days over the beast of cattle that He hath bestowed upon them. Then eat thereof and feed therewith the poor unfortunate

22.arabic: ثُمَّ ليَقضوا تَفَثَهُم وَليوفوا نُذورَهُم وَليَطَّوَّفوا بِالبَيتِ العَتيقِ
22.transliteration: Thumma lyaqdoo tafathahum walyoofoo nuthoorahum walyattawwafoo bialbayti alAAateeqi
22.translation: Then let them make an end of their unkemptness and pay their vows and go around the ancient House

22.arabic: ذٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّم حُرُمٰتِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيرٌ لَهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ وَأُحِلَّت لَكُمُ الأَنعٰمُ إِلّا ما يُتلىٰ عَلَيكُم فَاجتَنِبُوا الرِّجسَ مِنَ الأَوثٰنِ وَاجتَنِبوا قَولَ الزّورِ
22.transliteration: Thalika waman yuAAaththim hurumati Allahi fahuwa khayrun lahu AAinda rabbihi waohillat lakumu alanAAamu illa ma yutla AAalaykum faijtaniboo alrrijsa mina alawthani waijtaniboo qawla alzzoori
22.translation: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the sacred things of Allah, it will be well for him in the sight of his Lord. The cattle are lawful unto you save that which hath been told you. So shun the filth of idols, and shun lying speech

22.arabic: حُنَفاءَ لِلَّهِ غَيرَ مُشرِكينَ بِهِ وَمَن يُشرِك بِاللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّما خَرَّ مِنَ السَّماءِ فَتَخطَفُهُ الطَّيرُ أَو تَهوى بِهِ الرّيحُ فى مَكانٍ سَحيقٍ
22.transliteration: Hunafaa lillahi ghayra mushrikeena bihi waman yushrik biAllahi fakaannama kharra mina alssamai fatakhtafuhu alttayru aw tahwee bihi alrreehu fee makanin saheeqin
22.translation: Turning unto Allah (only), not ascribing partners unto Him; for whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky and the birds had snatched him or the wind had blown him to a far-off place

22.arabic: ذٰلِكَ وَمَن يُعَظِّم شَعٰئِرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّها مِن تَقوَى القُلوبِ
22.transliteration: Thalika waman yuAAaththim shaAAaira Allahi fainnaha min taqwa alquloobi
22.translation: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the offerings consecrated to Allah, it surely is from devotion of the hearts

22.arabic: لَكُم فيها مَنٰفِعُ إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ مَحِلُّها إِلَى البَيتِ العَتيقِ
22.transliteration: Lakum feeha manafiAAu ila ajalin musamman thumma mahilluha ila albayti alAAateeqi
22.translation: Therein are benefits for you for an appointed term; and afterward they are brought for sacrifice unto the ancient House

22.arabic: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلنا مَنسَكًا لِيَذكُرُوا اسمَ اللَّهِ عَلىٰ ما رَزَقَهُم مِن بَهيمَةِ الأَنعٰمِ فَإِلٰهُكُم إِلٰهٌ وٰحِدٌ فَلَهُ أَسلِموا وَبَشِّرِ المُخبِتينَ
22.transliteration: Walikulli ommatin jaAAalna mansakan liyathkuroo isma Allahi AAala ma razaqahum min baheemati alanAAami failahukum ilahun wahidun falahu aslimoo wabashshiri almukhbiteena
22.translation: And for every nation have We appointed a ritual, that they may mention the name of Allah over the beast of cattle that He hath given them for food; and your god is One God, therefor surrender unto Him. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the humble

22.arabic: الَّذينَ إِذا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَت قُلوبُهُم وَالصّٰبِرينَ عَلىٰ ما أَصابَهُم وَالمُقيمِى الصَّلوٰةِ وَمِمّا رَزَقنٰهُم يُنفِقونَ
22.transliteration: Allatheena itha thukira Allahu wajilat quloobuhum waalssabireena AAala ma asabahum waalmuqeemee alssalati wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona
22.translation: Whose hearts fear when Allah is mentioned, and the patient of whatever may befall them, and those who establish worship and who spend of that We have bestowed on them

22.arabic: وَالبُدنَ جَعَلنٰها لَكُم مِن شَعٰئِرِ اللَّهِ لَكُم فيها خَيرٌ فَاذكُرُوا اسمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيها صَوافَّ فَإِذا وَجَبَت جُنوبُها فَكُلوا مِنها وَأَطعِمُوا القانِعَ وَالمُعتَرَّ كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرنٰها لَكُم لَعَلَّكُم تَشكُرونَ
22.transliteration: Waalbudna jaAAalnaha lakum min shaAAairi Allahi lakum feeha khayrun faothkuroo isma Allahi AAalayha sawaffa faitha wajabat junoobuha fakuloo minha waatAAimoo alqaniAAa waalmuAAtarra kathalika sakhkharnaha lakum laAAallakum tashkuroona
22.translation: And the camels! We have appointed them among the ceremonies of Allah. Therein ye have much good. So mention the name of Allah over them when they are drawn up in lines. Then when their flanks fall (dead), eat thereof and feed the beggar and the suppliant. Thus have We made them subject unto you, that haply ye may give thanks

22.arabic: لَن يَنالَ اللَّهَ لُحومُها وَلا دِماؤُها وَلٰكِن يَنالُهُ التَّقوىٰ مِنكُم كَذٰلِكَ سَخَّرَها لَكُم لِتُكَبِّرُوا اللَّهَ عَلىٰ ما هَدىٰكُم وَبَشِّرِ المُحسِنينَ
22.transliteration: Lan yanala Allaha luhoomuha wala dimaoha walakin yanaluhu alttaqwa minkum kathalika sakhkharaha lakum litukabbiroo Allaha AAala ma hadakum wabashshiri almuhsineena
22.translation: Their flesh and their food reach not Allah, but the devotion from you reacheth Him. Thus have We made them subject unto you that ye may magnify Allah that He hath guided you. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the good

22.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدٰفِعُ عَنِ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوّانٍ كَفورٍ
22.transliteration: Inna Allaha yudafiAAu AAani allatheena amanoo inna Allaha la yuhibbu kulla khawwanin kafoorin
22.translation: Lo! Allah defendeth those who are true. Lo! Allah loveth not each treacherous ingrate

22.arabic: أُذِنَ لِلَّذينَ يُقٰتَلونَ بِأَنَّهُم ظُلِموا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلىٰ نَصرِهِم لَقَديرٌ
22.transliteration: Othina lillatheena yuqataloona biannahum thulimoo wainna Allaha AAala nasrihim laqadeerun
22.translation: Sanction is given unto those who fight because they have been wronged; and Allah is indeed Able to give them victory

22.arabic: الَّذينَ أُخرِجوا مِن دِيٰرِهِم بِغَيرِ حَقٍّ إِلّا أَن يَقولوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ وَلَولا دَفعُ اللَّهِ النّاسَ بَعضَهُم بِبَعضٍ لَهُدِّمَت صَوٰمِعُ وَبِيَعٌ وَصَلَوٰتٌ وَمَسٰجِدُ يُذكَرُ فيهَا اسمُ اللَّهِ كَثيرًا وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ اللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزيزٌ
22.transliteration: Allatheena okhrijoo min diyarihim bighayri haqqin illa an yaqooloo rabbuna Allahu walawla dafAAu Allahi alnnasa baAAdahum bibaAAdin lahuddimat sawamiAAu wabiyaAAun wasalawatun wamasajidu yuthkaru feeha ismu Allahi katheeran walayansuranna Allahu man yansuruhu inna Allaha laqawiyyun AAazeezun
22.translation: Those who have been driven from their homes unjustly only because they said: Our Lord is Allah - For had it not been for Allah's repelling some men by means of others, cloisters and churches and oratories and mosques, wherein the name of Allah is oft mentioned, would assuredly have been pulled down. Verily Allah helpeth one who helpeth Him. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty

22.arabic: الَّذينَ إِن مَكَّنّٰهُم فِى الأَرضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَءاتَوُا الزَّكوٰةَ وَأَمَروا بِالمَعروفِ وَنَهَوا عَنِ المُنكَرِ وَلِلَّهِ عٰقِبَةُ الأُمورِ
22.transliteration: Allatheena in makkannahum fee alardi aqamoo alssalata waatawoo alzzakata waamaroo bialmaAAroofi wanahaw AAani almunkari walillahi AAaqibatu alomoori
22.translation: Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish worship and pay the poor-due and enjoin kindness and forbid iniquity. And Allah's is the sequel of events

22.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبوكَ فَقَد كَذَّبَت قَبلَهُم قَومُ نوحٍ وَعادٌ وَثَمودُ
22.transliteration: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wathamoodu
22.translation: If they deny thee (Muhammad), even so the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, before thee, denied (Our messengers)

22.arabic: وَقَومُ إِبرٰهيمَ وَقَومُ لوطٍ
22.transliteration: Waqawmu ibraheema waqawmu lootin
22.translation: And the folk of Abraham and the folk of Lot

22.arabic: وَأَصحٰبُ مَديَنَ وَكُذِّبَ موسىٰ فَأَملَيتُ لِلكٰفِرينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذتُهُم فَكَيفَ كانَ نَكيرِ
22.transliteration: Waashabu madyana wakuththiba moosa faamlaytu lilkafireena thumma akhathtuhum fakayfa kana nakeeri
22.translation: (And) the dwellers in Midian. And Moses was denied; but I indulged the disbelievers a long while, then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My abhorrence

22.arabic: فَكَأَيِّن مِن قَريَةٍ أَهلَكنٰها وَهِىَ ظالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خاوِيَةٌ عَلىٰ عُروشِها وَبِئرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصرٍ مَشيدٍ
22.transliteration: Fakaayyin min qaryatin ahlaknaha wahiya thalimatun fahiya khawiyatun AAala AAurooshiha wabirin muAAattalatin waqasrin masheedin
22.translation: How many a township have We destroyed while it was sinful, so that it lieth (to this day) in ruins, and (how many) a deserted well and lofty tower

22.arabic: أَفَلَم يَسيروا فِى الأَرضِ فَتَكونَ لَهُم قُلوبٌ يَعقِلونَ بِها أَو ءاذانٌ يَسمَعونَ بِها فَإِنَّها لا تَعمَى الأَبصٰرُ وَلٰكِن تَعمَى القُلوبُ الَّتى فِى الصُّدورِ
22.transliteration: Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fatakoona lahum quloobun yaAAqiloona biha aw athanun yasmaAAoona biha fainnaha la taAAma alabsaru walakin taAAma alquloobu allatee fee alssudoori
22.translation: Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind

22.arabic: وَيَستَعجِلونَكَ بِالعَذابِ وَلَن يُخلِفَ اللَّهُ وَعدَهُ وَإِنَّ يَومًا عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلفِ سَنَةٍ مِمّا تَعُدّونَ
22.transliteration: WayastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi walan yukhlifa Allahu waAAdahu wainna yawman AAinda rabbika kaalfi sanatin mimma taAAuddoona
