22.translation: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon

22.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِن قَريَةٍ أَملَيتُ لَها وَهِىَ ظالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذتُها وَإِلَىَّ المَصيرُ
22.transliteration: Wakaayyin min qaryatin amlaytu laha wahiya thalimatun thumma akhathtuha wailayya almaseeru
22.translation: And how many a township did I suffer long though it was sinful! Then I grasped it. Unto Me is the return

22.arabic: قُل يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ إِنَّما أَنا۠ لَكُم نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
22.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu innama ana lakum natheerun mubeenun
22.translation: Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you

22.arabic: فَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُم مَغفِرَةٌ وَرِزقٌ كَريمٌ
22.transliteration: Faallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun
22.translation: Those who believe and do good works, for them is pardon and a rich provision

22.arabic: وَالَّذينَ سَعَوا فى ءايٰتِنا مُعٰجِزينَ أُولٰئِكَ أَصحٰبُ الجَحيمِ
22.transliteration: Waallatheena saAAaw fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika ashabu aljaheemi
22.translation: While those who strive to thwart Our revelations, such are rightful owners of the Fire

22.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنا مِن قَبلِكَ مِن رَسولٍ وَلا نَبِىٍّ إِلّا إِذا تَمَنّىٰ أَلقَى الشَّيطٰنُ فى أُمنِيَّتِهِ فَيَنسَخُ اللَّهُ ما يُلقِى الشَّيطٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحكِمُ اللَّهُ ءايٰتِهِ وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ حَكيمٌ
22.transliteration: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin wala nabiyyin illa itha tamanna alqa alshshaytanu fee omniyyatihi fayansakhu Allahu ma yulqee alshshaytanu thumma yuhkimu Allahu ayatihi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun
22.translation: Never sent We a messenger or a prophet before thee but when He recited (the message) Satan proposed (opposition) in respect of that which he recited thereof. But Allah abolisheth that which Satan proposeth. Then Allah establisheth His revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise

22.arabic: لِيَجعَلَ ما يُلقِى الشَّيطٰنُ فِتنَةً لِلَّذينَ فى قُلوبِهِم مَرَضٌ وَالقاسِيَةِ قُلوبُهُم وَإِنَّ الظّٰلِمينَ لَفى شِقاقٍ بَعيدٍ
22.transliteration: LiyajAAala ma yulqee alshshaytanu fitnatan lillatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalqasiyati quloobuhum wainna alththalimeena lafee shiqaqin baAAeedin
22.translation: That He may make that which the devil proposeth a temptation for those in whose hearts is a disease, and those whose hearts are hardened - Lo! the evil-doers are in open schism

22.arabic: وَلِيَعلَمَ الَّذينَ أوتُوا العِلمَ أَنَّهُ الحَقُّ مِن رَبِّكَ فَيُؤمِنوا بِهِ فَتُخبِتَ لَهُ قُلوبُهُم وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهادِ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
22.transliteration: WaliyaAAlama allatheena ootoo alAAilma annahu alhaqqu min rabbika fayuminoo bihi fatukhbita lahu quloobuhum wainna Allaha lahadi allatheena amanoo ila siratin mustaqeemin
22.translation: And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from thy Lord, so that they may believe therein and their hearts may submit humbly unto Him. Lo! Allah verily is guiding those who believe unto a right path

22.arabic: وَلا يَزالُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فى مِريَةٍ مِنهُ حَتّىٰ تَأتِيَهُمُ السّاعَةُ بَغتَةً أَو يَأتِيَهُم عَذابُ يَومٍ عَقيمٍ
22.transliteration: Wala yazalu allatheena kafaroo fee miryatin minhu hatta tatiyahumu alssaAAatu baghtatan aw yatiyahum AAathabu yawmin AAaqeemin
22.translation: And those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt thereof until the Hour come upon them unawares, or there come unto them the doom of a disastrous day

22.arabic: المُلكُ يَومَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ يَحكُمُ بَينَهُم فَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فى جَنّٰتِ النَّعيمِ
22.transliteration: Almulku yawmaithin lillahi yahkumu baynahum faallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fee jannati alnnaAAeemi
22.translation: The Sovereignty on that day will be Allah's, He will judge between them. Then those who believed and did good works will be in Gardens of Delight

22.arabic: وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا وَكَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِنا فَأُولٰئِكَ لَهُم عَذابٌ مُهينٌ
22.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina faolaika lahum AAathabun muheenun
22.translation: While those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, for them will be a shameful doom

22.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هاجَروا فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلوا أَو ماتوا لَيَرزُقَنَّهُمُ اللَّهُ رِزقًا حَسَنًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيرُ الرّٰزِقينَ
22.transliteration: Waallatheena hajaroo fee sabeeli Allahi thumma qutiloo aw matoo layarzuqannahumu Allahu rizqan hasanan wainna Allaha lahuwa khayru alrraziqeena
22.translation: Those who fled their homes for the cause of Allah and then were slain or died, Allah verily will provide for them a good provision. Lo! Allah, He verily is Best of all who make provision

22.arabic: لَيُدخِلَنَّهُم مُدخَلًا يَرضَونَهُ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَليمٌ حَليمٌ
22.transliteration: Layudkhilannahum mudkhalan yardawnahu wainna Allaha laAAaleemun haleemun
22.translation: Assuredly He will cause them to enter by an entry that they will love. Lo! Allah verily is Knower, Indulgent

22.arabic: ذٰلِكَ وَمَن عاقَبَ بِمِثلِ ما عوقِبَ بِهِ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفورٌ
22.transliteration: Thalika waman AAaqaba bimithli ma AAooqiba bihi thumma bughiya AAalayhi layansurannahu Allahu inna Allaha laAAafuwwun ghafoorun
22.translation: That (is so). And whoso hath retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer and then hath (again) been wronged, Allah will succour him. Lo! Allah verily is Mild, Forgiving

22.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ يولِجُ الَّيلَ فِى النَّهارِ وَيولِجُ النَّهارَ فِى الَّيلِ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَميعٌ بَصيرٌ
22.transliteration: Thalika bianna Allaha yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli waanna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun
22.translation: That is because Allah maketh the night to pass into the day and maketh the day to pass into the night, and because Allah is Hearer, Seer

22.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الحَقُّ وَأَنَّ ما يَدعونَ مِن دونِهِ هُوَ البٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ العَلِىُّ الكَبيرُ
22.transliteration: Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waanna ma yadAAoona min doonihi huwa albatilu waanna Allaha huwa alAAaliyyu alkabeeru
22.translation: That is because Allah, He is the True, and that whereon they call instead of Him, it is the false, and because Allah, He is the High, the Great

22.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَتُصبِحُ الأَرضُ مُخضَرَّةً إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطيفٌ خَبيرٌ
22.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fatusbihu alardu mukhdarratan inna Allaha lateefun khabeerun
22.translation: Seest thou not how Allah sendeth down water from the sky and then the earth becometh green upon the morrow? Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware

22.arabic: لَهُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَهُوَ الغَنِىُّ الحَميدُ
22.transliteration: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wainna Allaha lahuwa alghaniyyu alhameedu
22.translation: Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Lo! Allah, He verily is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise

22.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم ما فِى الأَرضِ وَالفُلكَ تَجرى فِى البَحرِ بِأَمرِهِ وَيُمسِكُ السَّماءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى الأَرضِ إِلّا بِإِذنِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِالنّاسِ لَرَءوفٌ رَحيمٌ
22.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha sakhkhara lakum ma fee alardi waalfulka tajree fee albahri biamrihi wayumsiku alssamaa an taqaAAa AAala alardi illa biithnihi inna Allaha bialnnasi laraoofun raheemun
22.translation: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath made all that is in the earth subservient unto you? And the ship runneth upon the sea by His command, and He holdeth back the heaven from falling on the earth unless by His leave. Lo! Allah is, for mankind, Full of Pity, Merciful

22.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى أَحياكُم ثُمَّ يُميتُكُم ثُمَّ يُحييكُم إِنَّ الإِنسٰنَ لَكَفورٌ
22.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee ahyakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum inna alinsana lakafoorun
22.translation: And He it is Who gave you life, then He will cause you to die, and then will give you life (again). Lo! man is verily an ingrate

22.arabic: لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلنا مَنسَكًا هُم ناسِكوهُ فَلا يُنٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى الأَمرِ وَادعُ إِلىٰ رَبِّكَ إِنَّكَ لَعَلىٰ هُدًى مُستَقيمٍ
22.transliteration: Likulli ommatin jaAAalna mansakan hum nasikoohu fala yunaziAAunnaka fee alamri waodAAu ila rabbika innaka laAAala hudan mustaqeemin
22.translation: Unto each nation have We given sacred rites which they are to perform; so let them not dispute with thee of the matter, but summon thou unto thy Lord. Lo! thou indeed followest right guidance

22.arabic: وَإِن جٰدَلوكَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُ أَعلَمُ بِما تَعمَلونَ
22.transliteration: Wain jadalooka faquli Allahu aAAlamu bima taAAmaloona
22.translation: And if they wrangle with thee, say: Allah is Best Aware of what ye do

22.arabic: اللَّهُ يَحكُمُ بَينَكُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ فيما كُنتُم فيهِ تَختَلِفونَ
22.transliteration: Allahu yahkumu baynakum yawma alqiyamati feema kuntum feehi takhtalifoona
22.translation: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein ye used to differ

22.arabic: أَلَم تَعلَم أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعلَمُ ما فِى السَّماءِ وَالأَرضِ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ فى كِتٰبٍ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسيرٌ
22.transliteration: Alam taAAlam anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma fee alssamai waalardi inna thalika fee kitabin inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun
22.translation: Hast thou not known that Allah knoweth all that is in the heaven and the earth? Lo! it is in a record. Lo! that is easy for Allah

22.arabic: وَيَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ما لَم يُنَزِّل بِهِ سُلطٰنًا وَما لَيسَ لَهُم بِهِ عِلمٌ وَما لِلظّٰلِمينَ مِن نَصيرٍ
22.transliteration: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan wama laysa lahum bihi AAilmun wama lilththalimeena min naseerin
22.translation: And they worship instead of Allah that for which He hath sent down no warrant, and that whereof they have no knowledge. For evil-doers there is no helper

22.arabic: وَإِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتُنا بَيِّنٰتٍ تَعرِفُ فى وُجوهِ الَّذينَ كَفَرُوا المُنكَرَ يَكادونَ يَسطونَ بِالَّذينَ يَتلونَ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتِنا قُل أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِن ذٰلِكُمُ النّارُ وَعَدَهَا اللَّهُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَبِئسَ المَصيرُ
22.transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin taAArifu fee wujoohi allatheena kafaroo almunkara yakadoona yastoona biallatheena yatloona AAalayhim ayatina qul afaonabbiokum bisharrin min thalikum alnnaru waAAadaha Allahu allatheena kafaroo wabisa almaseeru
22.translation: And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey's end

22.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَاستَمِعوا لَهُ إِنَّ الَّذينَ تَدعونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ لَن يَخلُقوا ذُبابًا وَلَوِ اجتَمَعوا لَهُ وَإِن يَسلُبهُمُ الذُّبابُ شَيـًٔا لا يَستَنقِذوهُ مِنهُ ضَعُفَ الطّالِبُ وَالمَطلوبُ
22.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu duriba mathalun faistamiAAoo lahu inna allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi lan yakhluqoo thubaban walawi ijtamaAAoo lahu wain yaslubuhumu alththubabu shayan la yastanqithoohu minhu daAAufa alttalibu waalmatloobu
22.translation: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought

22.arabic: ما قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدرِهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزيزٌ
22.transliteration: Ma qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi inna Allaha laqawiyyun AAazeezun
22.translation: They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty

22.arabic: اللَّهُ يَصطَفى مِنَ المَلٰئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ النّاسِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَميعٌ بَصيرٌ
22.transliteration: Allahu yastafee mina almalaikati rusulan wamina alnnasi inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun
22.translation: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer

22.arabic: يَعلَمُ ما بَينَ أَيديهِم وَما خَلفَهُم وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرجَعُ الأُمورُ
22.transliteration: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru
22.translation: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A

22.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنُوا اركَعوا وَاسجُدوا وَاعبُدوا رَبَّكُم وَافعَلُوا الخَيرَ لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ
22.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo irkaAAoo waosjudoo waoAAbudoo rabbakum waifAAaloo alkhayra laAAallakum tuflihoona
22.translation: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper

22.arabic: وَجٰهِدوا فِى اللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهادِهِ هُوَ اجتَبىٰكُم وَما جَعَلَ عَلَيكُم فِى الدّينِ مِن حَرَجٍ مِلَّةَ أَبيكُم إِبرٰهيمَ هُوَ سَمّىٰكُمُ المُسلِمينَ مِن قَبلُ وَفى هٰذا لِيَكونَ الرَّسولُ شَهيدًا عَلَيكُم وَتَكونوا شُهَداءَ عَلَى النّاسِ فَأَقيمُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَءاتُوا الزَّكوٰةَ وَاعتَصِموا بِاللَّهِ هُوَ مَولىٰكُم فَنِعمَ المَولىٰ وَنِعمَ النَّصيرُ
22.transliteration: Wajahidoo fee Allahi haqqa jihadihi huwa ijtabakum wama jaAAala AAalaykum fee alddeeni min harajin millata abeekum ibraheema huwa sammakumu almuslimeena min qablu wafee hatha liyakoona alrrasoolu shaheedan AAalaykum watakoonoo shuhadaa AAala alnnasi faaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waiAAtasimoo biAllahi huwa mawlakum faniAAma almawla waniAAma alnnaseeru
22.translation: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper

23.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قَد أَفلَحَ المُؤمِنونَ
23.transliteration: Qad aflaha almuminoona
23.translation: Successful indeed are the believers

23.arabic: الَّذينَ هُم فى صَلاتِهِم خٰشِعونَ
23.transliteration: Allatheena hum fee salatihim khashiAAoona
23.translation: Who are humble in their prayers

23.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم عَنِ اللَّغوِ مُعرِضونَ
23.transliteration: Waallatheena hum AAani allaghwi muAAridoona
23.translation: And who shun vain conversation

23.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم لِلزَّكوٰةِ فٰعِلونَ
23.transliteration: Waallatheena hum lilzzakati faAAiloona
23.translation: And who are payers of the poor-due

23.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم لِفُروجِهِم حٰفِظونَ
23.transliteration: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona
23.translation: And who guard their modesty

23.arabic: إِلّا عَلىٰ أَزوٰجِهِم أَو ما مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُهُم فَإِنَّهُم غَيرُ مَلومينَ
23.transliteration: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena
23.translation: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy

23.arabic: فَمَنِ ابتَغىٰ وَراءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ العادونَ
23.transliteration: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona
23.translation: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors

23.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم لِأَمٰنٰتِهِم وَعَهدِهِم رٰعونَ
23.transliteration: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona
23.translation: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant

23.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم عَلىٰ صَلَوٰتِهِم يُحافِظونَ
23.transliteration: Waallatheena hum AAala salawatihim yuhafithoona
23.translation: And who pay heed to their prayers

23.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الوٰرِثونَ
23.transliteration: Olaika humu alwarithoona
23.translation: These are the heirs

23.arabic: الَّذينَ يَرِثونَ الفِردَوسَ هُم فيها خٰلِدونَ
23.transliteration: Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoona
23.translation: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide

23.arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ مِن سُلٰلَةٍ مِن طينٍ
23.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teenin
23.translation: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth

23.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلنٰهُ نُطفَةً فى قَرارٍ مَكينٍ
23.transliteration: Thumma jaAAalnahu nutfatan fee qararin makeenin
23.translation: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging

23.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقنَا النُّطفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقنَا العَلَقَةَ مُضغَةً فَخَلَقنَا المُضغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَونَا العِظٰمَ لَحمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأنٰهُ خَلقًا ءاخَرَ فَتَبارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحسَنُ الخٰلِقينَ
23.transliteration: Thumma khalaqna alnnutfata AAalaqatan fakhalaqna alAAalaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata AAithaman fakasawna alAAithama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeena
23.translation: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators

23.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتونَ
23.transliteration: Thumma innakum baAAda thalika lamayyitoona
23.translation: Then lo! after that ye surely die

23.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ تُبعَثونَ
23.transliteration: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tubAAathoona
23.translation: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again)

23.arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنا فَوقَكُم سَبعَ طَرائِقَ وَما كُنّا عَنِ الخَلقِ غٰفِلينَ
23.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sabAAa taraiqa wama kunna AAani alkhalqi ghafileena
23.translation: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation

23.arabic: وَأَنزَلنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسكَنّٰهُ فِى الأَرضِ وَإِنّا عَلىٰ ذَهابٍ بِهِ لَقٰدِرونَ
23.transliteration: Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona
23.translation: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it

23.arabic: فَأَنشَأنا لَكُم بِهِ جَنّٰتٍ مِن نَخيلٍ وَأَعنٰبٍ لَكُم فيها فَوٰكِهُ كَثيرَةٌ وَمِنها تَأكُلونَ
23.transliteration: Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloona
23.translation: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat

23.arabic: وَشَجَرَةً تَخرُجُ مِن طورِ سَيناءَ تَنبُتُ بِالدُّهنِ وَصِبغٍ لِلءاكِلينَ
23.transliteration: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bialdduhni wasibghin lilakileena
23.translation: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters

23.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُم فِى الأَنعٰمِ لَعِبرَةً نُسقيكُم مِمّا فى بُطونِها وَلَكُم فيها مَنٰفِعُ كَثيرَةٌ وَمِنها تَأكُلونَ
23.transliteration: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafiAAu katheeratun waminha takuloona
23.translation: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat

23.arabic: وَعَلَيها وَعَلَى الفُلكِ تُحمَلونَ
23.transliteration: WaAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona
23.translation: And on them and on the ship ye are carried

23.arabic: وَلَقَد أَرسَلنا نوحًا إِلىٰ قَومِهِ فَقالَ يٰقَومِ اعبُدُوا اللَّهَ ما لَكُم مِن إِلٰهٍ غَيرُهُ أَفَلا تَتَّقونَ
23.transliteration: Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona
23.translation: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)

23.arabic: فَقالَ المَلَؤُا۟ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن قَومِهِ ما هٰذا إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُم يُريدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيكُم وَلَو شاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلٰئِكَةً ما سَمِعنا بِهٰذا فى ءابائِنَا الأَوَّلينَ
23.transliteration: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala AAalaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena
23.translation: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old

23.arabic: إِن هُوَ إِلّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصوا بِهِ حَتّىٰ حينٍ
23.transliteration: In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hatta heenin
23.translation: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while

23.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ انصُرنى بِما كَذَّبونِ
23.transliteration: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni
23.translation: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me

23.arabic: فَأَوحَينا إِلَيهِ أَنِ اصنَعِ الفُلكَ بِأَعيُنِنا وَوَحيِنا فَإِذا جاءَ أَمرُنا وَفارَ التَّنّورُ فَاسلُك فيها مِن كُلٍّ زَوجَينِ اثنَينِ وَأَهلَكَ إِلّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيهِ القَولُ مِنهُم وَلا تُخٰطِبنى فِى الَّذينَ ظَلَموا إِنَّهُم مُغرَقونَ
23.transliteration: Faawhayna ilayhi ani isnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru faosluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona
23.translation: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned

23.arabic: فَإِذَا استَوَيتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَعَكَ عَلَى الفُلكِ فَقُلِ الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذى نَجّىٰنا مِنَ القَومِ الظّٰلِمينَ
23.transliteration: Faitha istawayta anta waman maAAaka AAala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi alththalimeena
23.translation: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk

23.arabic: وَقُل رَبِّ أَنزِلنى مُنزَلًا مُبارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيرُ المُنزِلينَ
23.transliteration: Waqul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubarakan waanta khayru almunzileena
23.translation: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land

23.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ وَإِن كُنّا لَمُبتَلينَ
23.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatin wain kunna lamubtaleena
23.translation: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test

23.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأنا مِن بَعدِهِم قَرنًا ءاخَرينَ
23.transliteration: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena
23.translation: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation

23.arabic: فَأَرسَلنا فيهِم رَسولًا مِنهُم أَنِ اعبُدُوا اللَّهَ ما لَكُم مِن إِلٰهٍ غَيرُهُ أَفَلا تَتَّقونَ
23.transliteration: Faarsalna feehim rasoolan minhum ani oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona
23.translation: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)

23.arabic: وَقالَ المَلَأُ مِن قَومِهِ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَكَذَّبوا بِلِقاءِ الءاخِرَةِ وَأَترَفنٰهُم فِى الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا ما هٰذا إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُم يَأكُلُ مِمّا تَأكُلونَ مِنهُ وَيَشرَبُ مِمّا تَشرَبونَ
23.transliteration: Waqala almalao min qawmihi allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biliqai alakhirati waatrafnahum fee alhayati alddunya ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yakulu mimma takuloona minhu wayashrabu mimma tashraboona
23.translation: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink

23.arabic: وَلَئِن أَطَعتُم بَشَرًا مِثلَكُم إِنَّكُم إِذًا لَخٰسِرونَ
23.transliteration: Walain ataAAtum basharan mithlakum innakum ithan lakhasiroona
23.translation: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers

23.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُم أَنَّكُم إِذا مِتُّم وَكُنتُم تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُخرَجونَ
23.transliteration: AyaAAidukum annakum itha mittum wakuntum turaban waAAithaman annakum mukhrajoona
23.translation: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth

23.arabic: هَيهاتَ هَيهاتَ لِما توعَدونَ
23.transliteration: Hayhata hayhata lima tooAAadoona
23.translation: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised

23.arabic: إِن هِىَ إِلّا حَياتُنَا الدُّنيا نَموتُ وَنَحيا وَما نَحنُ بِمَبعوثينَ
23.transliteration: In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena
23.translation: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again)

23.arabic: إِن هُوَ إِلّا رَجُلٌ افتَرىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَما نَحنُ لَهُ بِمُؤمِنينَ
23.transliteration: In huwa illa rajulun iftara AAala Allahi kathiban wama nahnu lahu bimumineena
23.translation: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him

23.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ انصُرنى بِما كَذَّبونِ
23.transliteration: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni
23.translation: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me

23.arabic: قالَ عَمّا قَليلٍ لَيُصبِحُنَّ نٰدِمينَ
23.transliteration: Qala AAamma qaleelin layusbihunna nadimeena
23.translation: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant

23.arabic: فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصَّيحَةُ بِالحَقِّ فَجَعَلنٰهُم غُثاءً فَبُعدًا لِلقَومِ الظّٰلِمينَ
23.transliteration: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi fajaAAalnahum ghuthaan fabuAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena
23.translation: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk

23.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأنا مِن بَعدِهِم قُرونًا ءاخَرينَ
23.transliteration: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim quroonan akhareena
23.translation: Then after them We brought forth other generations

23.arabic: ما تَسبِقُ مِن أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَها وَما يَستَـٔخِرونَ
23.transliteration: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona
23.translation: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it

23.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرسَلنا رُسُلَنا تَترا كُلَّ ما جاءَ أُمَّةً رَسولُها كَذَّبوهُ فَأَتبَعنا بَعضَهُم بَعضًا وَجَعَلنٰهُم أَحاديثَ فَبُعدًا لِقَومٍ لا يُؤمِنونَ
23.transliteration: Thumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaa ommatan rasooluha kaththaboohu faatbaAAna baAAdahum baAAdan wajaAAalnahum ahadeetha fabuAAdan liqawmin la yuminoona
23.translation: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not

23.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرسَلنا موسىٰ وَأَخاهُ هٰرونَ بِـٔايٰتِنا وَسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
23.transliteration: Thumma arsalna moosa waakhahu haroona biayatina wasultanin mubeenin
23.translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant

23.arabic: إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِ فَاستَكبَروا وَكانوا قَومًا عالينَ
23.transliteration: Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman AAaleena
23.translation: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk

23.arabic: فَقالوا أَنُؤمِنُ لِبَشَرَينِ مِثلِنا وَقَومُهُما لَنا عٰبِدونَ
23.transliteration: Faqaloo anuminu libasharayni mithlina waqawmuhuma lana AAabidoona
23.translation: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us

23.arabic: فَكَذَّبوهُما فَكانوا مِنَ المُهلَكينَ
23.transliteration: Fakaththaboohuma fakanoo mina almuhlakeena
23.translation: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed

23.arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا موسَى الكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُم يَهتَدونَ
23.transliteration: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba laAAallahum yahtadoona
23.translation: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright

23.arabic: وَجَعَلنَا ابنَ مَريَمَ وَأُمَّهُ ءايَةً وَءاوَينٰهُما إِلىٰ رَبوَةٍ ذاتِ قَرارٍ وَمَعينٍ
23.transliteration: WajaAAalna ibna maryama waommahu ayatan waawaynahuma ila rabwatin thati qararin wamaAAeenin
23.translation: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings

23.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلوا مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَاعمَلوا صٰلِحًا إِنّى بِما تَعمَلونَ عَليمٌ
23.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kuloo mina alttayyibati waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun
23.translation: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do

23.arabic: وَإِنَّ هٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُم أُمَّةً وٰحِدَةً وَأَنا۠ رَبُّكُم فَاتَّقونِ
23.transliteration: Wainna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faittaqooni
23.translation: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me

23.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعوا أَمرَهُم بَينَهُم زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزبٍ بِما لَدَيهِم فَرِحونَ
23.transliteration: FataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona
23.translation: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets

23.arabic: فَذَرهُم فى غَمرَتِهِم حَتّىٰ حينٍ
23.transliteration: Fatharhum fee ghamratihim hatta heenin
23.translation: So leave them in their error till a time

23.arabic: أَيَحسَبونَ أَنَّما نُمِدُّهُم بِهِ مِن مالٍ وَبَنينَ
23.transliteration: Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wabaneena
23.translation: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them

23.arabic: نُسارِعُ لَهُم فِى الخَيرٰتِ بَل لا يَشعُرونَ
23.transliteration: NusariAAu lahum fee alkhayrati bal la yashAAuroona
23.translation: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not

23.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ هُم مِن خَشيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُشفِقونَ
23.transliteration: Inna allatheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoona
23.translation: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord

23.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم بِـٔايٰتِ رَبِّهِم يُؤمِنونَ
23.transliteration: Waallatheena hum biayati rabbihim yuminoona
23.translation: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord

23.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِم لا يُشرِكونَ
23.transliteration: Waallatheena hum birabbihim la yushrikoona
23.translation: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord

23.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يُؤتونَ ما ءاتَوا وَقُلوبُهُم وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُم إِلىٰ رَبِّهِم رٰجِعونَ
23.transliteration: Waallatheena yutoona ma ataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim rajiAAoona
23.translation: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord

23.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ يُسٰرِعونَ فِى الخَيرٰتِ وَهُم لَها سٰبِقونَ
23.transliteration: Olaika yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wahum laha sabiqoona
23.translation: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race

23.arabic: وَلا نُكَلِّفُ نَفسًا إِلّا وُسعَها وَلَدَينا كِتٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِالحَقِّ وَهُم لا يُظلَمونَ
23.transliteration: Wala nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waladayna kitabun yantiqu bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona
23.translation: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged

23.arabic: بَل قُلوبُهُم فى غَمرَةٍ مِن هٰذا وَلَهُم أَعمٰلٌ مِن دونِ ذٰلِكَ هُم لَها عٰمِلونَ
23.transliteration: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hatha walahum aAAmalun min dooni thalika hum laha AAamiloona
23.translation: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing

23.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا أَخَذنا مُترَفيهِم بِالعَذابِ إِذا هُم يَجـَٔرونَ
23.transliteration: Hatta itha akhathna mutrafeehim bialAAathabi itha hum yajaroona
23.translation: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate

23.arabic: لا تَجـَٔرُوا اليَومَ إِنَّكُم مِنّا لا تُنصَرونَ
23.transliteration: La tajaroo alyawma innakum minna la tunsaroona
23.translation: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us

23.arabic: قَد كانَت ءايٰتى تُتلىٰ عَلَيكُم فَكُنتُم عَلىٰ أَعقٰبِكُم تَنكِصونَ
23.transliteration: Qad kanat ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum AAala aAAqabikum tankisoona
23.translation: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels

23.arabic: مُستَكبِرينَ بِهِ سٰمِرًا تَهجُرونَ
23.transliteration: Mustakbireena bihi samiran tahjuroona
23.translation: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together

23.arabic: أَفَلَم يَدَّبَّرُوا القَولَ أَم جاءَهُم ما لَم يَأتِ ءاباءَهُمُ الأَوَّلينَ
23.transliteration: Afalam yaddabbaroo alqawla am jaahum ma lam yati abaahumu alawwaleena
23.translation: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old

23.arabic: أَم لَم يَعرِفوا رَسولَهُم فَهُم لَهُ مُنكِرونَ
23.transliteration: Am lam yaAArifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroona
23.translation: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him

23.arabic: أَم يَقولونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَل جاءَهُم بِالحَقِّ وَأَكثَرُهُم لِلحَقِّ كٰرِهونَ
23.transliteration: Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaahum bialhaqqi waaktharuhum lilhaqqi karihoona
23.translation: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth

23.arabic: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الحَقُّ أَهواءَهُم لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالأَرضُ وَمَن فيهِنَّ بَل أَتَينٰهُم بِذِكرِهِم فَهُم عَن ذِكرِهِم مُعرِضونَ
23.transliteration: Walawi ittabaAAa alhaqqu ahwaahum lafasadati alssamawatu waalardu waman feehinna bal ataynahum bithikrihim fahum AAan thikrihim muAAridoona
23.translation: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away

23.arabic: أَم تَسـَٔلُهُم خَرجًا فَخَراجُ رَبِّكَ خَيرٌ وَهُوَ خَيرُ الرّٰزِقينَ
23.transliteration: Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena
23.translation: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision

23.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدعوهُم إِلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
23.transliteration: Wainnaka latadAAoohum ila siratin mustaqeemin
23.translation: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path

23.arabic: وَإِنَّ الَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِالءاخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرٰطِ لَنٰكِبونَ
23.transliteration: Wainna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati AAani alssirati lanakiboona
23.translation: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path

23.arabic: وَلَو رَحِمنٰهُم وَكَشَفنا ما بِهِم مِن ضُرٍّ لَلَجّوا فى طُغيٰنِهِم يَعمَهونَ
23.transliteration: Walaw rahimnahum wakashafna ma bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona
23.translation: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy

23.arabic: وَلَقَد أَخَذنٰهُم بِالعَذابِ فَمَا استَكانوا لِرَبِّهِم وَما يَتَضَرَّعونَ
23.transliteration: Walaqad akhathnahum bialAAathabi fama istakanoo lirabbihim wama yatadarraAAoona
23.translation: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray

23.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا فَتَحنا عَلَيهِم بابًا ذا عَذابٍ شَديدٍ إِذا هُم فيهِ مُبلِسونَ
23.transliteration: Hatta itha fatahna AAalayhim baban tha AAathabin shadeedin itha hum feehi mublisoona
23.translation: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat

23.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمعَ وَالأَبصٰرَ وَالأَفـِٔدَةَ قَليلًا ما تَشكُرونَ
23.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee anshaa lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona
23.translation: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye

23.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى ذَرَأَكُم فِى الأَرضِ وَإِلَيهِ تُحشَرونَ
23.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona
23.translation: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered

23.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى يُحيۦ وَيُميتُ وَلَهُ اختِلٰفُ الَّيلِ وَالنَّهارِ أَفَلا تَعقِلونَ
23.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu walahu ikhtilafu allayli waalnnahari afala taAAqiloona
23.translation: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense

23.arabic: بَل قالوا مِثلَ ما قالَ الأَوَّلونَ
23.transliteration: Bal qaloo mithla ma qala alawwaloona
23.translation: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old

23.arabic: قالوا أَءِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَءِنّا لَمَبعوثونَ
23.transliteration: Qaloo aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
23.translation: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again

23.arabic: لَقَد وُعِدنا نَحنُ وَءاباؤُنا هٰذا مِن قَبلُ إِن هٰذا إِلّا أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ
23.transliteration: Laqad wuAAidna nahnu waabaona hatha min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena
23.translation: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old

23.arabic: قُل لِمَنِ الأَرضُ وَمَن فيها إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
23.transliteration: Qul limani alardu waman feeha in kuntum taAAlamoona
23.translation: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge

23.arabic: سَيَقولونَ لِلَّهِ قُل أَفَلا تَذَكَّرونَ
23.transliteration: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tathakkaroona
23.translation: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember

23.arabic: قُل مَن رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبعِ وَرَبُّ العَرشِ العَظيمِ
23.transliteration: Qul man rabbu alssamawati alssabAAi warabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi
23.translation: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne

23.arabic: سَيَقولونَ لِلَّهِ قُل أَفَلا تَتَّقونَ
23.transliteration: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tattaqoona
23.translation: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)

23.arabic: قُل مَن بِيَدِهِ مَلَكوتُ كُلِّ شَيءٍ وَهُوَ يُجيرُ وَلا يُجارُ عَلَيهِ إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
23.transliteration: Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wahuwa yujeeru wala yujaru AAalayhi in kuntum taAAlamoona
23.translation: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge

23.arabic: سَيَقولونَ لِلَّهِ قُل فَأَنّىٰ تُسحَرونَ
23.transliteration: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul faanna tusharoona
23.translation: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched

23.arabic: بَل أَتَينٰهُم بِالحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُم لَكٰذِبونَ
23.transliteration: Bal ataynahum bialhaqqi wainnahum lakathiboona
23.translation: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars

23.arabic: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَما كانَ مَعَهُ مِن إِلٰهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلٰهٍ بِما خَلَقَ وَلَعَلا بَعضُهُم عَلىٰ بَعضٍ سُبحٰنَ اللَّهِ عَمّا يَصِفونَ
23.transliteration: Ma ittakhatha Allahu min waladin wama kana maAAahu min ilahin ithan lathahaba kullu ilahin bima khalaqa walaAAala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona
23.translation: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege

23.arabic: عٰلِمِ الغَيبِ وَالشَّهٰدَةِ فَتَعٰلىٰ عَمّا يُشرِكونَ
23.transliteration: AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fataAAala AAamma yushrikoona
23.translation: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)

23.arabic: قُل رَبِّ إِمّا تُرِيَنّى ما يوعَدونَ
23.transliteration: Qul rabbi imma turiyannee ma yooAAadoona
23.translation: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised

23.arabic: رَبِّ فَلا تَجعَلنى فِى القَومِ الظّٰلِمينَ
23.transliteration: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi alththalimeena
23.translation: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk

23.arabic: وَإِنّا عَلىٰ أَن نُرِيَكَ ما نَعِدُهُم لَقٰدِرونَ
23.transliteration: Wainna AAala an nuriyaka ma naAAiduhum laqadiroona
23.translation: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them

23.arabic: ادفَع بِالَّتى هِىَ أَحسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ نَحنُ أَعلَمُ بِما يَصِفونَ
23.transliteration: IdfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu aAAlamu bima yasifoona
23.translation: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege

23.arabic: وَقُل رَبِّ أَعوذُ بِكَ مِن هَمَزٰتِ الشَّيٰطينِ
23.transliteration: Waqul rabbi aAAoothu bika min hamazati alshshayateeni
23.translation: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones

23.arabic: وَأَعوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحضُرونِ
23.transliteration: WaaAAoothu bika rabbi an yahdurooni
23.translation: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me

23.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا جاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ المَوتُ قالَ رَبِّ ارجِعونِ
23.transliteration: Hatta itha jaa ahadahumu almawtu qala rabbi irjiAAooni
23.translation: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back

23.arabic: لَعَلّى أَعمَلُ صٰلِحًا فيما تَرَكتُ كَلّا إِنَّها كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قائِلُها وَمِن وَرائِهِم بَرزَخٌ إِلىٰ يَومِ يُبعَثونَ
23.transliteration: LaAAallee aAAmalu salihan feema taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huwa qailuha wamin waraihim barzakhun ila yawmi yubAAathoona
23.translation: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised

23.arabic: فَإِذا نُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ فَلا أَنسابَ بَينَهُم يَومَئِذٍ وَلا يَتَساءَلونَ
23.transliteration: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori fala ansaba baynahum yawmaithin wala yatasaaloona
23.translation: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another

23.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَت مَوٰزينُهُ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ المُفلِحونَ
23.transliteration: Faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona
23.translation: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful

23.arabic: وَمَن خَفَّت مَوٰزينُهُ فَأُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ خَسِروا أَنفُسَهُم فى جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدونَ
23.transliteration: Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona
23.translation: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding

23.arabic: تَلفَحُ وُجوهَهُمُ النّارُ وَهُم فيها كٰلِحونَ
23.transliteration: Talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona
23.translation: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein

23.arabic: أَلَم تَكُن ءايٰتى تُتلىٰ عَلَيكُم فَكُنتُم بِها تُكَذِّبونَ
23.transliteration: Alam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona
23.translation: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them

23.arabic: قالوا رَبَّنا غَلَبَت عَلَينا شِقوَتُنا وَكُنّا قَومًا ضالّينَ
23.transliteration: Qaloo rabbana ghalabat AAalayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena
23.translation: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk

23.arabic: رَبَّنا أَخرِجنا مِنها فَإِن عُدنا فَإِنّا ظٰلِمونَ
23.transliteration: Rabbana akhrijna minha fain AAudna fainna thalimoona
23.translation: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers

23.arabic: قالَ اخسَـٔوا فيها وَلا تُكَلِّمونِ
23.transliteration: Qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni
23.translation: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me

23.arabic: إِنَّهُ كانَ فَريقٌ مِن عِبادى يَقولونَ رَبَّنا ءامَنّا فَاغفِر لَنا وَارحَمنا وَأَنتَ خَيرُ الرّٰحِمينَ
23.transliteration: Innahu kana fareequn min AAibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena
23.translation: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy

23.arabic: فَاتَّخَذتُموهُم سِخرِيًّا حَتّىٰ أَنسَوكُم ذِكرى وَكُنتُم مِنهُم تَضحَكونَ
23.transliteration: Faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona
23.translation: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them

23.arabic: إِنّى جَزَيتُهُمُ اليَومَ بِما صَبَروا أَنَّهُم هُمُ الفائِزونَ
23.transliteration: Innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona
23.translation: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant

23.arabic: قٰلَ كَم لَبِثتُم فِى الأَرضِ عَدَدَ سِنينَ
23.transliteration: Qala kam labithtum fee alardi AAadada sineena
23.translation: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years

23.arabic: قالوا لَبِثنا يَومًا أَو بَعضَ يَومٍ فَسـَٔلِ العادّينَ
23.transliteration: Qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin faisali alAAaddeena
23.translation: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count

23.arabic: قٰلَ إِن لَبِثتُم إِلّا قَليلًا لَو أَنَّكُم كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
23.transliteration: Qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum taAAlamoona
23.translation: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew

23.arabic: أَفَحَسِبتُم أَنَّما خَلَقنٰكُم عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُم إِلَينا لا تُرجَعونَ
23.transliteration: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona
23.translation: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us

23.arabic: فَتَعٰلَى اللَّهُ المَلِكُ الحَقُّ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ رَبُّ العَرشِ الكَريمِ
23.transliteration: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alkareemi
23.translation: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace

23.arabic: وَمَن يَدعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ لا بُرهٰنَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّما حِسابُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لا يُفلِحُ الكٰفِرونَ
23.transliteration: Waman yadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu AAinda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona
23.translation: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful

23.arabic: وَقُل رَبِّ اغفِر وَارحَم وَأَنتَ خَيرُ الرّٰحِمينَ
23.transliteration: Waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena
23.translation: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy

24.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ سورَةٌ أَنزَلنٰها وَفَرَضنٰها وَأَنزَلنا فيها ءايٰتٍ بَيِّنٰتٍ لَعَلَّكُم تَذَكَّرونَ
24.transliteration: Sooratun anzalnaha wafaradnaha waanzalna feeha ayatin bayyinatin laAAallakum tathakkaroona
24.translation: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed

24.arabic: الزّانِيَةُ وَالزّانى فَاجلِدوا كُلَّ وٰحِدٍ مِنهُما مِا۟ئَةَ جَلدَةٍ وَلا تَأخُذكُم بِهِما رَأفَةٌ فى دينِ اللَّهِ إِن كُنتُم تُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَاليَومِ الءاخِرِ وَليَشهَد عَذابَهُما طائِفَةٌ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
24.transliteration: Alzzaniyatu waalzzanee faijlidoo kulla wahidin minhuma miata jaldatin wala takhuthkum bihima rafatun fee deeni Allahi in kuntum tuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri walyashhad AAathabahuma taifatun mina almumineena
24.translation: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment

24.arabic: الزّانى لا يَنكِحُ إِلّا زانِيَةً أَو مُشرِكَةً وَالزّانِيَةُ لا يَنكِحُها إِلّا زانٍ أَو مُشرِكٌ وَحُرِّمَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى المُؤمِنينَ
24.transliteration: Alzzanee la yankihu illa zaniyatan aw mushrikatan waalzzaniyatu la yankihuha illa zanin aw mushrikun wahurrima thalika AAala almumineena
24.translation: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers

24.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يَرمونَ المُحصَنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَم يَأتوا بِأَربَعَةِ شُهَداءَ فَاجلِدوهُم ثَمٰنينَ جَلدَةً وَلا تَقبَلوا لَهُم شَهٰدَةً أَبَدًا وَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الفٰسِقونَ
24.transliteration: Waallatheena yarmoona almuhsanati thumma lam yatoo biarbaAAati shuhadaa faijlidoohum thamaneena jaldatan wala taqbaloo lahum shahadatan abadan waolaika humu alfasiqoona
24.translation: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers

24.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذينَ تابوا مِن بَعدِ ذٰلِكَ وَأَصلَحوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
24.transliteration: Illa allatheena taboo min baAAdi thalika waaslahoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
24.translation: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

24.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يَرمونَ أَزوٰجَهُم وَلَم يَكُن لَهُم شُهَداءُ إِلّا أَنفُسُهُم فَشَهٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِم أَربَعُ شَهٰدٰتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
24.transliteration: Waallatheena yarmoona azwajahum walam yakun lahum shuhadao illa anfusuhum fashahadatu ahadihim arbaAAu shahadatin biAllahi innahu lamina alssadiqeena
24.translation: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth

24.arabic: وَالخٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعنَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيهِ إِن كانَ مِنَ الكٰذِبينَ
24.transliteration: Waalkhamisatu anna laAAnata Allahi AAalayhi in kana mina alkathibeena
24.translation: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie

24.arabic: وَيَدرَؤُا۟ عَنهَا العَذابَ أَن تَشهَدَ أَربَعَ شَهٰدٰتٍ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الكٰذِبينَ
24.transliteration: Wayadrao AAanha alAAathaba an tashhada arbaAAa shahadatin biAllahi innahu lamina alkathibeena
24.translation: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false

24.arabic: وَالخٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ اللَّهِ عَلَيها إِن كانَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
24.transliteration: Waalkhamisata anna ghadaba Allahi AAalayha in kana mina alssadiqeena
24.translation: And a fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaketh truth

24.arabic: وَلَولا فَضلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيكُم وَرَحمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَوّابٌ حَكيمٌ
24.transliteration: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha tawwabun hakeemun
24.translation: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone)

24.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ جاءو بِالإِفكِ عُصبَةٌ مِنكُم لا تَحسَبوهُ شَرًّا لَكُم بَل هُوَ خَيرٌ لَكُم لِكُلِّ امرِئٍ مِنهُم مَا اكتَسَبَ مِنَ الإِثمِ وَالَّذى تَوَلّىٰ كِبرَهُ مِنهُم لَهُ عَذابٌ عَظيمٌ
24.transliteration: Inna allatheena jaoo bialifki AAusbatun minkum la tahsaboohu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli imriin minhum ma iktasaba mina alithmi waallathee tawalla kibrahu minhum lahu AAathabun AAatheemun
24.translation: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom

24.arabic: لَولا إِذ سَمِعتُموهُ ظَنَّ المُؤمِنونَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِم خَيرًا وَقالوا هٰذا إِفكٌ مُبينٌ
24.transliteration: Lawla ith samiAAtumoohu thanna almuminoona waalmuminatu bianfusihim khayran waqaloo hatha ifkun mubeenun
24.translation: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth

24.arabic: لَولا جاءو عَلَيهِ بِأَربَعَةِ شُهَداءَ فَإِذ لَم يَأتوا بِالشُّهَداءِ فَأُولٰئِكَ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُمُ الكٰذِبونَ
24.transliteration: Lawla jaoo AAalayhi biarbaAAati shuhadaa faith lam yatoo bialshshuhadai faolaika AAinda Allahi humu alkathiboona
24.translation: Why did they not produce four witnesses? Since they produce not witnesses, they verily are liars in the sight of Allah

24.arabic: وَلَولا فَضلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيكُم وَرَحمَتُهُ فِى الدُّنيا وَالءاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُم فى ما أَفَضتُم فيهِ عَذابٌ عَظيمٌ
24.transliteration: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu fee alddunya waalakhirati lamassakum fee ma afadtum feehi AAathabun AAatheemun
24.translation: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in the world and the Hereafter an awful doom had overtaken you for that whereof ye murmured

24.arabic: إِذ تَلَقَّونَهُ بِأَلسِنَتِكُم وَتَقولونَ بِأَفواهِكُم ما لَيسَ لَكُم بِهِ عِلمٌ وَتَحسَبونَهُ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَظيمٌ
24.transliteration: Ith talaqqawnahu bialsinatikum wataqooloona biafwahikum ma laysa lakum bihi AAilmun watahsaboonahu hayyinan wahuwa AAinda Allahi AAatheemun
24.translation: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great

24.arabic: وَلَولا إِذ سَمِعتُموهُ قُلتُم ما يَكونُ لَنا أَن نَتَكَلَّمَ بِهٰذا سُبحٰنَكَ هٰذا بُهتٰنٌ عَظيمٌ
24.transliteration: Walawla ith samiAAtumoohu qultum ma yakoonu lana an natakallama bihatha subhanaka hatha buhtanun AAatheemun
24.translation: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny

24.arabic: يَعِظُكُمُ اللَّهُ أَن تَعودوا لِمِثلِهِ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُؤمِنينَ
24.transliteration: YaAAithukumu Allahu an taAAoodoo limithlihi abadan in kuntum mumineena
24.translation: Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers

24.arabic: وَيُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الءايٰتِ وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ حَكيمٌ
24.transliteration: Wayubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun
24.translation: And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise

24.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يُحِبّونَ أَن تَشيعَ الفٰحِشَةُ فِى الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ فِى الدُّنيا وَالءاخِرَةِ وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ وَأَنتُم لا تَعلَمونَ
24.transliteration: Inna allatheena yuhibboona an tasheeAAa alfahishatu fee allatheena amanoo lahum AAathabun aleemun fee alddunya waalakhirati waAllahu yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona
24.translation: Lo! those who love that slander should be spread concerning those who believe, theirs will be a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knoweth. Ye know not

24.arabic: وَلَولا فَضلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيكُم وَرَحمَتُهُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ رَءوفٌ رَحيمٌ
24.transliteration: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha raoofun raheemun
24.translation: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Merciful, (ye had been undone)

24.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تَتَّبِعوا خُطُوٰتِ الشَّيطٰنِ وَمَن يَتَّبِع خُطُوٰتِ الشَّيطٰنِ فَإِنَّهُ يَأمُرُ بِالفَحشاءِ وَالمُنكَرِ وَلَولا فَضلُ اللَّهِ عَلَيكُم وَرَحمَتُهُ ما زَكىٰ مِنكُم مِن أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُزَكّى مَن يَشاءُ وَاللَّهُ سَميعٌ عَليمٌ
24.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytani waman yattabiAA khutuwati alshshaytani fainnahu yamuru bialfahshai waalmunkari walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu ma zaka minkum min ahadin abadan walakinna Allaha yuzakkee man yashao waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun
24.translation: O ye who believe! Follow not the footsteps of the devil. Unto whomsoever followeth the footsteps of the devil, lo! he commandeth filthiness and wrong. Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, not one of you would ever have grown pure. But Allah causeth whom He will to grow. And Allah is Hearer, Knower

24.arabic: وَلا يَأتَلِ أُولُوا الفَضلِ مِنكُم وَالسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤتوا أُولِى القُربىٰ وَالمَسٰكينَ وَالمُهٰجِرينَ فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَليَعفوا وَليَصفَحوا أَلا تُحِبّونَ أَن يَغفِرَ اللَّهُ لَكُم وَاللَّهُ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
24.transliteration: Wala yatali oloo alfadli minkum waalssaAAati an yutoo olee alqurba waalmasakeena waalmuhajireena fee sabeeli Allahi walyaAAfoo walyasfahoo ala tuhibboona an yaghfira Allahu lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun
24.translation: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

24.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَرمونَ المُحصَنٰتِ الغٰفِلٰتِ المُؤمِنٰتِ لُعِنوا فِى الدُّنيا وَالءاخِرَةِ وَلَهُم عَذابٌ عَظيمٌ
24.transliteration: Inna allatheena yarmoona almuhsanati alghafilati almuminati luAAinoo fee alddunya waalakhirati walahum AAathabun AAatheemun
24.translation: Lo! as for those who traduce virtuous, believing women (who are) careless, cursed are they in the world and the Hereafter. Theirs will be an awful doom

24.arabic: يَومَ تَشهَدُ عَلَيهِم أَلسِنَتُهُم وَأَيديهِم وَأَرجُلُهُم بِما كانوا يَعمَلونَ
24.transliteration: Yawma tashhadu AAalayhim alsinatuhum waaydeehim waarjuluhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona
24.translation: On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do

24.arabic: يَومَئِذٍ يُوَفّيهِمُ اللَّهُ دينَهُمُ الحَقَّ وَيَعلَمونَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الحَقُّ المُبينُ
24.transliteration: Yawmaithin yuwaffeehimu Allahu deenahumu alhaqqa wayaAAlamoona anna Allaha huwa alhaqqu almubeenu
24.translation: On that day Allah will pay them their just due, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth

24.arabic: الخَبيثٰتُ لِلخَبيثينَ وَالخَبيثونَ لِلخَبيثٰتِ وَالطَّيِّبٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبينَ وَالطَّيِّبونَ لِلطَّيِّبٰتِ أُولٰئِكَ مُبَرَّءونَ مِمّا يَقولونَ لَهُم مَغفِرَةٌ وَرِزقٌ كَريمٌ
24.transliteration: Alkhabeethatu lilkhabeetheena waalkhabeethoona lilkhabeethati waalttayyibatu lilttayyibeena waalttayyiboona lilttayyibati olaika mubarraoona mimma yaqooloona lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun
24.translation: Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision

24.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تَدخُلوا بُيوتًا غَيرَ بُيوتِكُم حَتّىٰ تَستَأنِسوا وَتُسَلِّموا عَلىٰ أَهلِها ذٰلِكُم خَيرٌ لَكُم لَعَلَّكُم تَذَكَّرونَ
24.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra buyootikum hatta tastanisoo watusallimoo AAala ahliha thalikum khayrun lakum laAAallakum tathakkaroona
24.translation: O ye who believe! Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence and invoking peace upon the folk thereof. That is better for you, that ye may be heedful

24.arabic: فَإِن لَم تَجِدوا فيها أَحَدًا فَلا تَدخُلوها حَتّىٰ يُؤذَنَ لَكُم وَإِن قيلَ لَكُمُ ارجِعوا فَارجِعوا هُوَ أَزكىٰ لَكُم وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ عَليمٌ
24.transliteration: Fain lam tajidoo feeha ahadan fala tadkhulooha hatta yuthana lakum wain qeela lakumu irjiAAoo fairjiAAoo huwa azka lakum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun
24.translation: And if ye find no-one therein, still enter not until permission hath been given. And if it be said unto you: Go away again, then go away, for it is purer for you. Allah knoweth what ye do

24.arabic: لَيسَ عَلَيكُم جُناحٌ أَن تَدخُلوا بُيوتًا غَيرَ مَسكونَةٍ فيها مَتٰعٌ لَكُم وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ ما تُبدونَ وَما تَكتُمونَ
24.transliteration: Laysa AAalaykum junahun an tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra maskoonatin feeha mataAAun lakum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma tubdoona wama taktumoona
24.translation: (It is) no sin for you to enter uninhabited houses wherein is comfort for you. Allah knoweth what ye proclaim and what ye hide

24.arabic: قُل لِلمُؤمِنينَ يَغُضّوا مِن أَبصٰرِهِم وَيَحفَظوا فُروجَهُم ذٰلِكَ أَزكىٰ لَهُم إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبيرٌ بِما يَصنَعونَ
24.transliteration: Qul lilmumineena yaghuddoo min absarihum wayahfathoo furoojahum thalika azka lahum inna Allaha khabeerun bima yasnaAAoona
24.translation: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest. That is purer for them. Lo! Allah is aware of what they do

24.arabic: وَقُل لِلمُؤمِنٰتِ يَغضُضنَ مِن أَبصٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحفَظنَ فُروجَهُنَّ وَلا يُبدينَ زينَتَهُنَّ إِلّا ما ظَهَرَ مِنها وَليَضرِبنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلىٰ جُيوبِهِنَّ وَلا يُبدينَ زينَتَهُنَّ إِلّا لِبُعولَتِهِنَّ أَو ءابائِهِنَّ أَو ءاباءِ بُعولَتِهِنَّ أَو أَبنائِهِنَّ أَو أَبناءِ بُعولَتِهِنَّ أَو إِخوٰنِهِنَّ أَو بَنى إِخوٰنِهِنَّ أَو بَنى أَخَوٰتِهِنَّ أَو نِسائِهِنَّ أَو ما مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ التّٰبِعينَ غَيرِ أُولِى الإِربَةِ مِنَ الرِّجالِ أَوِ الطِّفلِ الَّذينَ لَم يَظهَروا عَلىٰ عَورٰتِ النِّساءِ وَلا يَضرِبنَ بِأَرجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعلَمَ ما يُخفينَ مِن زينَتِهِنَّ وَتوبوا إِلَى اللَّهِ جَميعًا أَيُّهَ المُؤمِنونَ لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ
24.transliteration: Waqul lilmuminati yaghdudna min absarihinna wayahfathna furoojahunna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa ma thahara minha walyadribna bikhumurihinna AAala juyoobihinna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa libuAAoolatihinna aw abaihinna aw abai buAAoolatihinna aw abnaihinna aw abnai buAAoolatihinna aw ikhwanihinna aw banee ikhwanihinna aw banee akhawatihinna aw nisaihinna aw ma malakat aymanuhunna awi alttabiAAeena ghayri olee alirbati mina alrrijali awi alttifli allatheena lam yathharoo AAala AAawrati alnnisai wala yadribna biarjulihinna liyuAAlama ma yukhfeena min zeenatihinna watooboo ila Allahi jameeAAan ayyuha almuminoona laAAallakum tuflihoona
24.translation: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and be modest, and to display of their adornment only that which is apparent, and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and not to reveal their adornment save to their own husbands or fathers or husbands' fathers, or their sons or their husbands' sons, or their brothers or their brothers' sons or sisters' sons, or their women, or their slaves, or male attendants who lack vigour, or children who know naught of women's nakedness. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And turn unto Allah together, O believers, in order that ye may succeed

24.arabic: وَأَنكِحُوا الأَيٰمىٰ مِنكُم وَالصّٰلِحينَ مِن عِبادِكُم وَإِمائِكُم إِن يَكونوا فُقَراءَ يُغنِهِمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضلِهِ وَاللَّهُ وٰسِعٌ عَليمٌ
24.transliteration: Waankihoo alayama minkum waalssaliheena min AAibadikum waimaikum in yakoonoo fuqaraa yughnihimu Allahu min fadlihi waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun
24.translation: And marry such of you as are solitary and the pious of your slaves and maid-servants. If they be poor, Allah will enrich them of His bounty. Allah is of ample means, Aware

24.arabic: وَليَستَعفِفِ الَّذينَ لا يَجِدونَ نِكاحًا حَتّىٰ يُغنِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن فَضلِهِ وَالَّذينَ يَبتَغونَ الكِتٰبَ مِمّا مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُكُم فَكاتِبوهُم إِن عَلِمتُم فيهِم خَيرًا وَءاتوهُم مِن مالِ اللَّهِ الَّذى ءاتىٰكُم وَلا تُكرِهوا فَتَيٰتِكُم عَلَى البِغاءِ إِن أَرَدنَ تَحَصُّنًا لِتَبتَغوا عَرَضَ الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا وَمَن يُكرِههُنَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مِن بَعدِ إِكرٰهِهِنَّ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
24.transliteration: WalyastaAAfifi allatheena la yajidoona nikahan hatta yughniyahumu Allahu min fadlihi waallatheena yabtaghoona alkitaba mimma malakat aymanukum fakatiboohum in AAalimtum feehim khayran waatoohum min mali Allahi allathee atakum wala tukrihoo fatayatikum AAala albighai in aradna tahassunan litabtaghoo AAarada alhayati alddunya waman yukrihhunna fainna Allaha min baAAdi ikrahihinna ghafoorun raheemun
24.translation: And let those who cannot find a match keep chaste till Allah give them independence by His grace. And such of your slaves as seek a writing (of emancipation), write it for them if ye are aware of aught of good in them, and bestow upon them of the wealth of Allah which He hath bestowed upon you. Force not your slave-girls to whoredom that ye may seek enjoyment of the life of the world, if they would preserve their chastity. And if one force them, then (unto them), after their compulsion, lo! Allah will be Forgiving, Merciful

24.arabic: وَلَقَد أَنزَلنا إِلَيكُم ءايٰتٍ مُبَيِّنٰتٍ وَمَثَلًا مِنَ الَّذينَ خَلَوا مِن قَبلِكُم وَمَوعِظَةً لِلمُتَّقينَ
24.transliteration: Walaqad anzalna ilaykum ayatin mubayyinatin wamathalan mina allatheena khalaw min qablikum wamawAAithatan lilmuttaqeena
24.translation: And verily We have sent down for you revelations that make plain, and the example of those who passed away before you. An admonition unto those who ward off (evil)

24.arabic: اللَّهُ نورُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ مَثَلُ نورِهِ كَمِشكوٰةٍ فيها مِصباحٌ المِصباحُ فى زُجاجَةٍ الزُّجاجَةُ كَأَنَّها كَوكَبٌ دُرِّىٌّ يوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٍ مُبٰرَكَةٍ زَيتونَةٍ لا شَرقِيَّةٍ وَلا غَربِيَّةٍ يَكادُ زَيتُها يُضيءُ وَلَو لَم تَمسَسهُ نارٌ نورٌ عَلىٰ نورٍ يَهدِى اللَّهُ لِنورِهِ مَن يَشاءُ وَيَضرِبُ اللَّهُ الأَمثٰلَ لِلنّاسِ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمٌ
24.transliteration: Allahu nooru alssamawati waalardi mathalu noorihi kamishkatin feeha misbahun almisbahu fee zujajatin alzzujajatu kaannaha kawkabun durriyyun yooqadu min shajaratin mubarakatin zaytoonatin la sharqiyyatin wala gharbiyyatin yakadu zaytuha yudeeo walaw lam tamsashu narun noorun AAala noorin yahdee Allahu linoorihi man yashao wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun
24.translation: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things

24.arabic: فى بُيوتٍ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ أَن تُرفَعَ وَيُذكَرَ فيهَا اسمُهُ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ فيها بِالغُدُوِّ وَالءاصالِ
24.transliteration: Fee buyootin athina Allahu an turfaAAa wayuthkara feeha ismuhu yusabbihu lahu feeha bialghuduwwi waalasali
24.translation: (This lamp is found) in houses which Allah hath allowed to be exalted and that His name shall be remembered therein. Therein do offer praise to Him at morn and evening

24.arabic: رِجالٌ لا تُلهيهِم تِجٰرَةٌ وَلا بَيعٌ عَن ذِكرِ اللَّهِ وَإِقامِ الصَّلوٰةِ وَإيتاءِ الزَّكوٰةِ يَخافونَ يَومًا تَتَقَلَّبُ فيهِ القُلوبُ وَالأَبصٰرُ
24.transliteration: Rijalun la tulheehim tijaratun wala bayAAun AAan thikri Allahi waiqami alssalati waeetai alzzakati yakhafoona yawman tataqallabu feehi alquloobu waalabsaru
24.translation: Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah and constancy in prayer and paying to the poor their due; who fear a day when hearts and eyeballs will be overturned

24.arabic: لِيَجزِيَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَحسَنَ ما عَمِلوا وَيَزيدَهُم مِن فَضلِهِ وَاللَّهُ يَرزُقُ مَن يَشاءُ بِغَيرِ حِسابٍ
24.transliteration: Liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma AAamiloo wayazeedahum min fadlihi waAllahu yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisabin
24.translation: That Allah may reward them with the best of what they did, and increase reward for them of His bounty. Allah giveth blessings without stint to whom He will

24.arabic: وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا أَعمٰلُهُم كَسَرابٍ بِقيعَةٍ يَحسَبُهُ الظَّمـٔانُ ماءً حَتّىٰ إِذا جاءَهُ لَم يَجِدهُ شَيـًٔا وَوَجَدَ اللَّهَ عِندَهُ فَوَفّىٰهُ حِسابَهُ وَاللَّهُ سَريعُ الحِسابِ
24.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo aAAmaluhum kasarabin biqeeAAatin yahsabuhu alththamanu maan hatta itha jaahu lam yajidhu shayan wawajada Allaha AAindahu fawaffahu hisabahu waAllahu sareeAAu alhisabi
24.translation: As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are as a mirage in a desert. The thirsty one supposeth it to be water till he cometh unto it and findeth it naught, and findeth, in the place thereof, Allah Who payeth him his due; and Allah is swift at reckoning

24.arabic: أَو كَظُلُمٰتٍ فى بَحرٍ لُجِّىٍّ يَغشىٰهُ مَوجٌ مِن فَوقِهِ مَوجٌ مِن فَوقِهِ سَحابٌ ظُلُمٰتٌ بَعضُها فَوقَ بَعضٍ إِذا أَخرَجَ يَدَهُ لَم يَكَد يَرىٰها وَمَن لَم يَجعَلِ اللَّهُ لَهُ نورًا فَما لَهُ مِن نورٍ
24.transliteration: Aw kathulumatin fee bahrin lujjiyyin yaghshahu mawjun min fawqihi mawjun min fawqihi sahabun thulumatun baAAduha fawqa baAAdin itha akhraja yadahu lam yakad yaraha waman lam yajAAali Allahu lahu nooran fama lahu min noorin
24.translation: Or as darkness on a vast, abysmal sea. There covereth him a wave, above which is a wave, above which is a cloud. Layer upon layer of darkness. When he holdeth out his hand he scarce can see it. And he for whom Allah hath not appointed light, for him there is no light

24.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ مَن فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَالطَّيرُ صٰفّٰتٍ كُلٌّ قَد عَلِمَ صَلاتَهُ وَتَسبيحَهُ وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ بِما يَفعَلونَ
24.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha yusabbihu lahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waalttayru saffatin kullun qad AAalima salatahu watasbeehahu waAllahu AAaleemun bima yafAAaloona
24.translation: Hast thou not seen that Allah, He it is Whom all who are in the heavens and the earth praise, and the birds in their flight? Of each He knoweth verily the worship and the praise; and Allah is Aware of what they do

24.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ المَصيرُ
24.transliteration: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi almaseeru
24.translation: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah is the journeying

24.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُزجى سَحابًا ثُمَّ يُؤَلِّفُ بَينَهُ ثُمَّ يَجعَلُهُ رُكامًا فَتَرَى الوَدقَ يَخرُجُ مِن خِلٰلِهِ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّماءِ مِن جِبالٍ فيها مِن بَرَدٍ فَيُصيبُ بِهِ مَن يَشاءُ وَيَصرِفُهُ عَن مَن يَشاءُ يَكادُ سَنا بَرقِهِ يَذهَبُ بِالأَبصٰرِ
24.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha yuzjee sahaban thumma yuallifu baynahu thumma yajAAaluhu rukaman fatara alwadqa yakhruju min khilalihi wayunazzilu mina alssamai min jibalin feeha min baradin fayuseebu bihi man yashao wayasrifuhu AAan man yashao yakadu sana barqihi yathhabu bialabsari
24.translation: Hast thou not seen how Allah wafteth the clouds, then gathereth them, then maketh them layers, and thou seest the rain come forth from between them; He sendeth down from the heaven mountains wherein is hail, and smiteth therewith whom He will, and averteth it from whom He will. The flashing of His lightning all but snatcheth away the sight

24.arabic: يُقَلِّبُ اللَّهُ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَعِبرَةً لِأُولِى الأَبصٰرِ
24.transliteration: Yuqallibu Allahu allayla waalnnahara inna fee thalika laAAibratan liolee alabsari
24.translation: Allah causeth the revolution of the day and the night. Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for those who see

24.arabic: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دابَّةٍ مِن ماءٍ فَمِنهُم مَن يَمشى عَلىٰ بَطنِهِ وَمِنهُم مَن يَمشى عَلىٰ رِجلَينِ وَمِنهُم مَن يَمشى عَلىٰ أَربَعٍ يَخلُقُ اللَّهُ ما يَشاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
24.transliteration: WaAllahu khalaqa kulla dabbatin min main faminhum man yamshee AAala batnihi waminhum man yamshee AAala rijlayni waminhum man yamshee AAala arbaAAin yakhluqu Allahu ma yashao inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
24.translation: Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things

24.arabic: لَقَد أَنزَلنا ءايٰتٍ مُبَيِّنٰتٍ وَاللَّهُ يَهدى مَن يَشاءُ إِلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
24.transliteration: Laqad anzalna ayatin mubayyinatin waAllahu yahdee man yashao ila siratin mustaqeemin
24.translation: Verily We have sent down revelations and explained them. Allah guideth whom He will unto a straight path

24.arabic: وَيَقولونَ ءامَنّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالرَّسولِ وَأَطَعنا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلّىٰ فَريقٌ مِنهُم مِن بَعدِ ذٰلِكَ وَما أُولٰئِكَ بِالمُؤمِنينَ
24.transliteration: Wayaqooloona amanna biAllahi wabialrrasooli waataAAna thumma yatawalla fareequn minhum min baAAdi thalika wama olaika bialmumineena
24.translation: And they say: We believe in Allah and the messenger, and we obey; then after that a faction of them turn away. Such are not believers

24.arabic: وَإِذا دُعوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ لِيَحكُمَ بَينَهُم إِذا فَريقٌ مِنهُم مُعرِضونَ
24.transliteration: Waitha duAAoo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum itha fareequn minhum muAAridoona
24.translation: And when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them, lo! a faction of them are averse

24.arabic: وَإِن يَكُن لَهُمُ الحَقُّ يَأتوا إِلَيهِ مُذعِنينَ
24.transliteration: Wain yakun lahumu alhaqqu yatoo ilayhi muthAAineena
24.translation: But if right had been with them they would have come unto him willingly

24.arabic: أَفى قُلوبِهِم مَرَضٌ أَمِ ارتابوا أَم يَخافونَ أَن يَحيفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم وَرَسولُهُ بَل أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمونَ
24.transliteration: Afee quloobihim maradun ami irtaboo am yakhafoona an yaheefa Allahu AAalayhim warasooluhu bal olaika humu alththalimoona
24.translation: Is there in their hearts a disease, or have they doubts, or fear they lest Allah and His messenger should wrong them in judgment? Nay, but such are evil-doers

24.arabic: إِنَّما كانَ قَولَ المُؤمِنينَ إِذا دُعوا إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ لِيَحكُمَ بَينَهُم أَن يَقولوا سَمِعنا وَأَطَعنا وَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ المُفلِحونَ
24.transliteration: Innama kana qawla almumineena itha duAAoo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum an yaqooloo samiAAna waataAAna waolaika humu almuflihoona
24.translation: The saying of (all true) believers when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them is only that they say: We hear and we obey. And such are the successful

24.arabic: وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ وَيَخشَ اللَّهَ وَيَتَّقهِ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الفائِزونَ
24.transliteration: Waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu wayakhsha Allaha wayattaqhi faolaika humu alfaizoona
24.translation: He who obeyeth Allah and His messenger, and feareth Allah, and keepeth duty (unto Him): such indeed are the victorious

24.arabic: وَأَقسَموا بِاللَّهِ جَهدَ أَيمٰنِهِم لَئِن أَمَرتَهُم لَيَخرُجُنَّ قُل لا تُقسِموا طاعَةٌ مَعروفَةٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبيرٌ بِما تَعمَلونَ
24.transliteration: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain amartahum layakhrujunna qul la tuqsimoo taAAatun maAAroofatun inna Allaha khabeerun bima taAAmaloona
24.translation: They swear by Allah solemnly that, if thou order them, they will go forth. Say: Swear not; known obedience (is better). Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do

24.arabic: قُل أَطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطيعُوا الرَّسولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّوا فَإِنَّما عَلَيهِ ما حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيكُم ما حُمِّلتُم وَإِن تُطيعوهُ تَهتَدوا وَما عَلَى الرَّسولِ إِلَّا البَلٰغُ المُبينُ
24.transliteration: Qul ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaw fainnama AAalayhi ma hummila waAAalaykum ma hummiltum wain tuteeAAoohu tahtadoo wama AAala alrrasooli illa albalaghu almubeena
24.translation: Say: Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if ye turn away, then (it is) for him (to do) only that wherewith he hath been charged, and for you (to do) only that wherewith ye have been charged. If ye obey him, ye will go aright. But the messenger hath no other charge than to convey (the message) plainly

24.arabic: وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا مِنكُم وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَيَستَخلِفَنَّهُم فِى الأَرضِ كَمَا استَخلَفَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُم دينَهُمُ الَّذِى ارتَضىٰ لَهُم وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِن بَعدِ خَوفِهِم أَمنًا يَعبُدونَنى لا يُشرِكونَ بى شَيـًٔا وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعدَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الفٰسِقونَ
24.transliteration: WaAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum waAAamiloo alssalihati layastakhlifannahum fee alardi kama istakhlafa allatheena min qablihim walayumakkinanna lahum deenahumu allathee irtada lahum walayubaddilannahum min baAAdi khawfihim amnan yaAAbudoonanee la yushrikoona bee shayan waman kafara baAAda thalika faolaika humu alfasiqoona
24.translation: Allah hath promised such of you as believe and do good work that He will surely make them to succeed (the present rulers) in the earth even as He caused those who were before them to succeed (others); and that He will surely establish for them their religion which He hath approved for them, and will give them in exchange safety after their fear. They serve Me. They ascribe no thing as partner unto Me. Those who disbelieve henceforth, they are the miscreants

24.arabic: وَأَقيمُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَءاتُوا الزَّكوٰةَ وَأَطيعُوا الرَّسولَ لَعَلَّكُم تُرحَمونَ
24.transliteration: Waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waateeAAoo alrrasoola laAAallakum turhamoona
24.translation: Establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey the messenger, that haply ye may find mercy

24.arabic: لا تَحسَبَنَّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مُعجِزينَ فِى الأَرضِ وَمَأوىٰهُمُ النّارُ وَلَبِئسَ المَصيرُ
24.transliteration: La tahsabanna allatheena kafaroo muAAjizeena fee alardi wamawahumu alnnaru walabisa almaseeru
24.translation: Think not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Fire will be their home - a hapless journey's end

24.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لِيَستَـٔذِنكُمُ الَّذينَ مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُكُم وَالَّذينَ لَم يَبلُغُوا الحُلُمَ مِنكُم ثَلٰثَ مَرّٰتٍ مِن قَبلِ صَلوٰةِ الفَجرِ وَحينَ تَضَعونَ ثِيابَكُم مِنَ الظَّهيرَةِ وَمِن بَعدِ صَلوٰةِ العِشاءِ ثَلٰثُ عَورٰتٍ لَكُم لَيسَ عَلَيكُم وَلا عَلَيهِم جُناحٌ بَعدَهُنَّ طَوّٰفونَ عَلَيكُم بَعضُكُم عَلىٰ بَعضٍ كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الءايٰتِ وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ حَكيمٌ
24.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo liyastathinkumu allatheena malakat aymanukum waallatheena lam yablughoo alhuluma minkum thalatha marratin min qabli salati alfajri waheena tadaAAoona thiyabakum mina alththaheerati wamin baAAdi salati alAAishai thalathu AAawratin lakum laysa AAalaykum wala AAalayhim junahun baAAdahunna tawwafoona AAalaykum baAAdukum AAala baAAdin kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun
24.translation: O ye who believe! Let your slaves, and those of you who have not come to puberty, ask leave of you at three times (before they come into your presence): Before the prayer of dawn, and when ye lay aside your raiment for the heat of noon, and after the prayer of night. Three times of privacy for you. It is no sin for them or for you at other times, when some of you go round attendant upon others (if they come into your presence without leave). Thus Allah maketh clear the revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise

24.arabic: وَإِذا بَلَغَ الأَطفٰلُ مِنكُمُ الحُلُمَ فَليَستَـٔذِنوا كَمَا استَـٔذَنَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُم ءايٰتِهِ وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ حَكيمٌ
24.transliteration: Waitha balagha alatfalu minkumu alhuluma falyastathinoo kama istathana allatheena min qablihim kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun
24.translation: And when the children among you come to puberty then let them ask leave even as those before them used to ask it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise

24.arabic: وَالقَوٰعِدُ مِنَ النِّساءِ الّٰتى لا يَرجونَ نِكاحًا فَلَيسَ عَلَيهِنَّ جُناحٌ أَن يَضَعنَ ثِيابَهُنَّ غَيرَ مُتَبَرِّجٰتٍ بِزينَةٍ وَأَن يَستَعفِفنَ خَيرٌ لَهُنَّ وَاللَّهُ سَميعٌ عَليمٌ
