24.transliteration: WaalqawaAAidu mina alnnisai allatee la yarjoona nikahan falaysa AAalayhinna junahun an yadaAAna thiyabahunna ghayra mutabarrijatin bizeenatin waan yastaAAfifna khayrun lahunna waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun
24.translation: As for women past child-bearing, who have no hope of marriage, it is no sin for them if they discard their (outer) clothing in such a way as not to show adornment. But to refrain is better for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower

24.arabic: لَيسَ عَلَى الأَعمىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلا عَلَى الأَعرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلا عَلَى المَريضِ حَرَجٌ وَلا عَلىٰ أَنفُسِكُم أَن تَأكُلوا مِن بُيوتِكُم أَو بُيوتِ ءابائِكُم أَو بُيوتِ أُمَّهٰتِكُم أَو بُيوتِ إِخوٰنِكُم أَو بُيوتِ أَخَوٰتِكُم أَو بُيوتِ أَعمٰمِكُم أَو بُيوتِ عَمّٰتِكُم أَو بُيوتِ أَخوٰلِكُم أَو بُيوتِ خٰلٰتِكُم أَو ما مَلَكتُم مَفاتِحَهُ أَو صَديقِكُم لَيسَ عَلَيكُم جُناحٌ أَن تَأكُلوا جَميعًا أَو أَشتاتًا فَإِذا دَخَلتُم بُيوتًا فَسَلِّموا عَلىٰ أَنفُسِكُم تَحِيَّةً مِن عِندِ اللَّهِ مُبٰرَكَةً طَيِّبَةً كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللَّهُ لَكُمُ الءايٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم تَعقِلونَ
24.transliteration: Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun wala AAala anfusikum an takuloo min buyootikum aw buyooti abaikum aw buyooti ommahatikum aw buyooti ikhwanikum aw buyooti akhawatikum aw buyooti aAAmamikum aw buyooti AAammatikum aw buyooti akhwalikum aw buyooti khalatikum aw ma malaktum mafatihahu aw sadeeqikum laysa AAalaykum junahun an takuloo jameeAAan aw ashtatan faitha dakhaltum buyootan fasallimoo AAala anfusikum tahiyyatan min AAindi Allahi mubarakatan tayyibatan kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati laAAallakum taAAqiloona
24.translation: No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand

24.arabic: إِنَّمَا المُؤمِنونَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَإِذا كانوا مَعَهُ عَلىٰ أَمرٍ جامِعٍ لَم يَذهَبوا حَتّىٰ يَستَـٔذِنوهُ إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَستَـٔذِنونَكَ أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ يُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ فَإِذَا استَـٔذَنوكَ لِبَعضِ شَأنِهِم فَأذَن لِمَن شِئتَ مِنهُم وَاستَغفِر لَهُمُ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
24.transliteration: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi waitha kanoo maAAahu AAala amrin jamiAAin lam yathhaboo hatta yastathinoohu inna allatheena yastathinoonaka olaika allatheena yuminoona biAllahi warasoolihi faitha istathanooka libaAAdi shanihim fathan liman shita minhum waistaghfir lahumu Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
24.translation: They only are the true believers who believe in Allah and His messenger and, when they are with him on some common errand, go not away until they have asked leave of him. Lo! those who ask leave of thee, those are they who believe in Allah and His messenger. So, if they ask thy leave for some affair of theirs, give leave to whom thou wilt of them, and ask for them forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

24.arabic: لا تَجعَلوا دُعاءَ الرَّسولِ بَينَكُم كَدُعاءِ بَعضِكُم بَعضًا قَد يَعلَمُ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ يَتَسَلَّلونَ مِنكُم لِواذًا فَليَحذَرِ الَّذينَ يُخالِفونَ عَن أَمرِهِ أَن تُصيبَهُم فِتنَةٌ أَو يُصيبَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
24.transliteration: La tajAAaloo duAAaa alrrasooli baynakum kaduAAai baAAdikum baAAdan qad yaAAlamu Allahu allatheena yatasallaloona minkum liwathan falyahthari allatheena yukhalifoona AAan amrihi an tuseebahum fitnatun aw yuseebahum AAathabun aleemun
24.translation: Make not the calling of the messenger among you as your calling one of another. Allah knoweth those of you who steal away, hiding themselves. And let those who conspire to evade orders beware lest grief or painful punishment befall them

24.arabic: أَلا إِنَّ لِلَّهِ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ قَد يَعلَمُ ما أَنتُم عَلَيهِ وَيَومَ يُرجَعونَ إِلَيهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِما عَمِلوا وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمٌ
24.transliteration: Ala inna lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi qad yaAAlamu ma antum AAalayhi wayawma yurjaAAoona ilayhi fayunabbiohum bima AAamiloo waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun
24.translation: Lo! verily unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. He knoweth your condition. And (He knoweth) the Day when they are returned unto Him so that He may inform them of what they did. Allah is Knower of all things

25.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ تَبارَكَ الَّذى نَزَّلَ الفُرقانَ عَلىٰ عَبدِهِ لِيَكونَ لِلعٰلَمينَ نَذيرًا
25.transliteration: Tabaraka allathee nazzala alfurqana AAala AAabdihi liyakoona lilAAalameena natheeran
25.translation: Blessed is He Who hath revealed unto His slave the Criterion (of right and wrong), that he may be a warner to the peoples

25.arabic: الَّذى لَهُ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَلَم يَتَّخِذ وَلَدًا وَلَم يَكُن لَهُ شَريكٌ فِى المُلكِ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَيءٍ فَقَدَّرَهُ تَقديرًا
25.transliteration: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi walam yattakhith waladan walam yakun lahu shareekun fee almulki wakhalaqa kulla shayin faqaddarahu taqdeeran
25.translation: He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, He hath chosen no son nor hath He any partner in the Sovereignty. He hath created everything and hath meted out for it a measure

25.arabic: وَاتَّخَذوا مِن دونِهِ ءالِهَةً لا يَخلُقونَ شَيـًٔا وَهُم يُخلَقونَ وَلا يَملِكونَ لِأَنفُسِهِم ضَرًّا وَلا نَفعًا وَلا يَملِكونَ مَوتًا وَلا حَيوٰةً وَلا نُشورًا
25.transliteration: Waittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona wala yamlikoona lianfusihim darran wala nafAAan wala yamlikoona mawtan wala hayatan wala nushooran
25.translation: Yet they choose beside Him other gods who create naught but are themselves created, and possess not hurt nor profit for themselves, and possess not death nor life, nor power to raise the dead

25.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا إِن هٰذا إِلّا إِفكٌ افتَرىٰهُ وَأَعانَهُ عَلَيهِ قَومٌ ءاخَرونَ فَقَد جاءو ظُلمًا وَزورًا
25.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa ifkun iftarahu waaAAanahu AAalayhi qawmun akharoona faqad jaoo thulman wazooran
25.translation: Those who disbelieve say: This is naught but a lie that he hath invented, and other folk have helped him with it, so that they have produced a slander and a lie

25.arabic: وَقالوا أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ اكتَتَبَها فَهِىَ تُملىٰ عَلَيهِ بُكرَةً وَأَصيلًا
25.transliteration: Waqaloo asateeru alawwaleena iktatabaha fahiya tumla AAalayhi bukratan waaseelan
25.translation: And they say: Fables of the men of old which he hath had written down so that they are dictated to him morn and evening

25.arabic: قُل أَنزَلَهُ الَّذى يَعلَمُ السِّرَّ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ إِنَّهُ كانَ غَفورًا رَحيمًا
25.transliteration: Qul anzalahu allathee yaAAlamu alssirra fee alssamawati waalardi innahu kana ghafooran raheeman
25.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He who knoweth the secret of the heavens and the earth hath revealed it. Lo! He ever is Forgiving, Merciful

25.arabic: وَقالوا مالِ هٰذَا الرَّسولِ يَأكُلُ الطَّعامَ وَيَمشى فِى الأَسواقِ لَولا أُنزِلَ إِلَيهِ مَلَكٌ فَيَكونَ مَعَهُ نَذيرًا
25.transliteration: Waqaloo mali hatha alrrasooli yakulu alttaAAama wayamshee fee alaswaqi lawla onzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona maAAahu natheeran
25.translation: And they say: What aileth this messenger (of Allah) that he eateth food and walketh in the markets? Why is not an angel sent down unto him, to be a warner with him

25.arabic: أَو يُلقىٰ إِلَيهِ كَنزٌ أَو تَكونُ لَهُ جَنَّةٌ يَأكُلُ مِنها وَقالَ الظّٰلِمونَ إِن تَتَّبِعونَ إِلّا رَجُلًا مَسحورًا
25.transliteration: Aw yulqa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahu jannatun yakulu minha waqala alththalimoona in tattabiAAoona illa rajulan mashooran
25.translation: Or (why is not) treasure thrown down unto him, or why hath he not a paradise from whence to eat? And the evil-doers say: Ye are but following a man bewitched

25.arabic: انظُر كَيفَ ضَرَبوا لَكَ الأَمثٰلَ فَضَلّوا فَلا يَستَطيعونَ سَبيلًا
25.transliteration: Onthur kayfa daraboo laka alamthala fadalloo fala yastateeAAoona sabeelan
25.translation: See how they coin similitudes for thee, so that they are all astray and cannot find a road

25.arabic: تَبارَكَ الَّذى إِن شاءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيرًا مِن ذٰلِكَ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ وَيَجعَل لَكَ قُصورًا
25.transliteration: Tabaraka allathee in shaa jaAAala laka khayran min thalika jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wayajAAal laka qusooran
25.translation: Blessed is He Who, if He will, will assign thee better than (all) that - Gardens underneath which rivers flow - and will assign thee mansions

25.arabic: بَل كَذَّبوا بِالسّاعَةِ وَأَعتَدنا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِالسّاعَةِ سَعيرًا
25.transliteration: Bal kaththaboo bialssaAAati waaAAtadna liman kaththaba bialssaAAati saAAeeran
25.translation: Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame

25.arabic: إِذا رَأَتهُم مِن مَكانٍ بَعيدٍ سَمِعوا لَها تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفيرًا
25.transliteration: Itha raathum min makanin baAAeedin samiAAoo laha taghayyuthan wazafeeran
25.translation: When it seeth them from afar, they hear the crackling and the roar thereof

25.arabic: وَإِذا أُلقوا مِنها مَكانًا ضَيِّقًا مُقَرَّنينَ دَعَوا هُنالِكَ ثُبورًا
25.transliteration: Waitha olqoo minha makanan dayyiqan muqarraneena daAAaw hunalika thubooran
25.translation: And when they are flung into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they pray for destruction there

25.arabic: لا تَدعُوا اليَومَ ثُبورًا وٰحِدًا وَادعوا ثُبورًا كَثيرًا
25.transliteration: La tadAAoo alyawma thubooran wahidan waodAAoo thubooran katheeran
25.translation: Pray not that day for one destruction, but pray for many destructions

25.arabic: قُل أَذٰلِكَ خَيرٌ أَم جَنَّةُ الخُلدِ الَّتى وُعِدَ المُتَّقونَ كانَت لَهُم جَزاءً وَمَصيرًا
25.transliteration: Qul athalika khayrun am jannatu alkhuldi allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona kanat lahum jazaan wamaseeran
25.translation: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end

25.arabic: لَهُم فيها ما يَشاءونَ خٰلِدينَ كانَ عَلىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعدًا مَسـٔولًا
25.transliteration: Lahum feeha ma yashaoona khalideena kana AAala rabbika waAAdan masoolan
25.translation: Therein abiding, they have all that they desire. It is for thy Lord a promise that must be fulfilled

25.arabic: وَيَومَ يَحشُرُهُم وَما يَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ فَيَقولُ ءَأَنتُم أَضلَلتُم عِبادى هٰؤُلاءِ أَم هُم ضَلُّوا السَّبيلَ
25.transliteration: Wayawma yahshuruhum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi fayaqoolu aantum adlaltum AAibadee haolai am hum dalloo alssabeela
25.translation: And on the day when He will assemble them and that which they worship instead of Allah and will say: Was it ye who misled these my slaves or did they (themselves) wander from the way

25.arabic: قالوا سُبحٰنَكَ ما كانَ يَنبَغى لَنا أَن نَتَّخِذَ مِن دونِكَ مِن أَولِياءَ وَلٰكِن مَتَّعتَهُم وَءاباءَهُم حَتّىٰ نَسُوا الذِّكرَ وَكانوا قَومًا بورًا
25.transliteration: Qaloo subhanaka ma kana yanbaghee lana an nattakhitha min doonika min awliyaa walakin mattaAAtahum waabaahum hatta nasoo alththikra wakanoo qawman booran
25.translation: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk

25.arabic: فَقَد كَذَّبوكُم بِما تَقولونَ فَما تَستَطيعونَ صَرفًا وَلا نَصرًا وَمَن يَظلِم مِنكُم نُذِقهُ عَذابًا كَبيرًا
25.transliteration: Faqad kaththabookum bima taqooloona fama tastateeAAoona sarfan wala nasran waman yathlim minkum nuthiqhu AAathaban kabeeran
25.translation: Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment

25.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنا قَبلَكَ مِنَ المُرسَلينَ إِلّا إِنَّهُم لَيَأكُلونَ الطَّعامَ وَيَمشونَ فِى الأَسواقِ وَجَعَلنا بَعضَكُم لِبَعضٍ فِتنَةً أَتَصبِرونَ وَكانَ رَبُّكَ بَصيرًا
25.transliteration: Wama arsalna qablaka mina almursaleena illa innahum layakuloona alttaAAama wayamshoona fee alaswaqi wajaAAalna baAAdakum libaAAdin fitnatan atasbiroona wakana rabbuka baseeran
25.translation: We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer

25.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ لا يَرجونَ لِقاءَنا لَولا أُنزِلَ عَلَينَا المَلٰئِكَةُ أَو نَرىٰ رَبَّنا لَقَدِ استَكبَروا فى أَنفُسِهِم وَعَتَو عُتُوًّا كَبيرًا
25.transliteration: Waqala allatheena la yarjoona liqaana lawla onzila AAalayna almalaikatu aw nara rabbana laqadi istakbaroo fee anfusihim waAAataw AAutuwwan kabeeran
25.translation: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride

25.arabic: يَومَ يَرَونَ المَلٰئِكَةَ لا بُشرىٰ يَومَئِذٍ لِلمُجرِمينَ وَيَقولونَ حِجرًا مَحجورًا
25.transliteration: Yawma yarawna almalaikata la bushra yawmaithin lilmujrimeena wayaqooloona hijran mahjooran
25.translation: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban

25.arabic: وَقَدِمنا إِلىٰ ما عَمِلوا مِن عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلنٰهُ هَباءً مَنثورًا
25.transliteration: Waqadimna ila ma AAamiloo min AAamalin fajaAAalnahu habaan manthooran
25.translation: And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes

25.arabic: أَصحٰبُ الجَنَّةِ يَومَئِذٍ خَيرٌ مُستَقَرًّا وَأَحسَنُ مَقيلًا
25.transliteration: Ashabu aljannati yawmaithin khayrun mustaqarran waahsanu maqeelan
25.translation: Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest

25.arabic: وَيَومَ تَشَقَّقُ السَّماءُ بِالغَمٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ المَلٰئِكَةُ تَنزيلًا
25.transliteration: Wayawma tashaqqaqu alssamao bialghamami wanuzzila almalaikatu tanzeelan
25.translation: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent

25.arabic: المُلكُ يَومَئِذٍ الحَقُّ لِلرَّحمٰنِ وَكانَ يَومًا عَلَى الكٰفِرينَ عَسيرًا
25.transliteration: Almulku yawmaithin alhaqqu lilrrahmani wakana yawman AAala alkafireena AAaseeran
25.translation: The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers

25.arabic: وَيَومَ يَعَضُّ الظّالِمُ عَلىٰ يَدَيهِ يَقولُ يٰلَيتَنِى اتَّخَذتُ مَعَ الرَّسولِ سَبيلًا
25.transliteration: Wayawma yaAAaddu alththalimu AAala yadayhi yaqoolu ya laytanee ittakhathtu maAAa alrrasooli sabeelan
25.translation: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)

25.arabic: يٰوَيلَتىٰ لَيتَنى لَم أَتَّخِذ فُلانًا خَليلًا
25.transliteration: Ya waylata laytanee lam attakhith fulanan khaleelan
25.translation: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend

25.arabic: لَقَد أَضَلَّنى عَنِ الذِّكرِ بَعدَ إِذ جاءَنى وَكانَ الشَّيطٰنُ لِلإِنسٰنِ خَذولًا
25.transliteration: Laqad adallanee AAani alththikri baAAda ith jaanee wakana alshshaytanu lilinsani khathoolan
25.translation: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need

25.arabic: وَقالَ الرَّسولُ يٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَومِى اتَّخَذوا هٰذَا القُرءانَ مَهجورًا
25.transliteration: Waqala alrrasoolu ya rabbi inna qawmee ittakhathoo hatha alqurana mahjooran
25.translation: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account

25.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ جَعَلنا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِنَ المُجرِمينَ وَكَفىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هادِيًا وَنَصيرًا
25.transliteration: Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan mina almujrimeena wakafa birabbika hadiyan wanaseeran
25.translation: Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper

25.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لَولا نُزِّلَ عَلَيهِ القُرءانُ جُملَةً وٰحِدَةً كَذٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِ فُؤادَكَ وَرَتَّلنٰهُ تَرتيلًا
25.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lawla nuzzila AAalayhi alquranu jumlatan wahidatan kathalika linuthabbita bihi fuadaka warattalnahu tarteelan
25.translation: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order

25.arabic: وَلا يَأتونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلّا جِئنٰكَ بِالحَقِّ وَأَحسَنَ تَفسيرًا
25.transliteration: Wala yatoonaka bimathalin illa jinaka bialhaqqi waahsana tafseeran
25.translation: And they bring thee no similitude but We bring thee the Truth (as against it), and better (than their similitude) as argument

25.arabic: الَّذينَ يُحشَرونَ عَلىٰ وُجوهِهِم إِلىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُولٰئِكَ شَرٌّ مَكانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبيلًا
25.transliteration: Allatheena yuhsharoona AAala wujoohihim ila jahannama olaika sharrun makanan waadallu sabeelan
25.translation: Those who will be gathered on their faces unto hell: such are worse in plight and further from the right road

25.arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا موسَى الكِتٰبَ وَجَعَلنا مَعَهُ أَخاهُ هٰرونَ وَزيرًا
25.transliteration: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba wajaAAalna maAAahu akhahu haroona wazeeran
25.translation: We verily gave Moses the Scripture and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman

25.arabic: فَقُلنَا اذهَبا إِلَى القَومِ الَّذينَ كَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِنا فَدَمَّرنٰهُم تَدميرًا
25.transliteration: Faqulna ithhaba ila alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina fadammarnahum tadmeeran
25.translation: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction

25.arabic: وَقَومَ نوحٍ لَمّا كَذَّبُوا الرُّسُلَ أَغرَقنٰهُم وَجَعَلنٰهُم لِلنّاسِ ءايَةً وَأَعتَدنا لِلظّٰلِمينَ عَذابًا أَليمًا
25.transliteration: Waqawma noohin lamma kaththaboo alrrusula aghraqnahum wajaAAalnahum lilnnasi ayatan waaAAtadna lilththalimeena AAathaban aleeman
25.translation: And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers

25.arabic: وَعادًا وَثَمودَا۟ وَأَصحٰبَ الرَّسِّ وَقُرونًا بَينَ ذٰلِكَ كَثيرًا
25.transliteration: WaAAadan wathamooda waashaba alrrassi waquroonan bayna thalika katheeran
25.translation: And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and the dwellers in Ar-Rass, and many generations in between

25.arabic: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبنا لَهُ الأَمثٰلَ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرنا تَتبيرًا
25.transliteration: Wakullan darabna lahu alamthala wakullan tabbarna tatbeeran
25.translation: Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin

25.arabic: وَلَقَد أَتَوا عَلَى القَريَةِ الَّتى أُمطِرَت مَطَرَ السَّوءِ أَفَلَم يَكونوا يَرَونَها بَل كانوا لا يَرجونَ نُشورًا
25.transliteration: Walaqad ataw AAala alqaryati allatee omtirat matara alssawi afalam yakoonoo yarawnaha bal kanoo la yarjoona nushooran
25.translation: And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection

25.arabic: وَإِذا رَأَوكَ إِن يَتَّخِذونَكَ إِلّا هُزُوًا أَهٰذَا الَّذى بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رَسولًا
25.transliteration: Waitha raawka in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee baAAatha Allahu rasoolan
25.translation: And when they see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest (saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger

25.arabic: إِن كادَ لَيُضِلُّنا عَن ءالِهَتِنا لَولا أَن صَبَرنا عَلَيها وَسَوفَ يَعلَمونَ حينَ يَرَونَ العَذابَ مَن أَضَلُّ سَبيلًا
25.transliteration: In kada layudilluna AAan alihatina lawla an sabarna AAalayha wasawfa yaAAlamoona heena yarawna alAAathaba man adallu sabeelan
25.translation: He would have led us far away from our gods if we had not been staunch to them. They will know, when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road

25.arabic: أَرَءَيتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلٰهَهُ هَوىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكونُ عَلَيهِ وَكيلًا
25.transliteration: Araayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu afaanta takoonu AAalayhi wakeelan
25.translation: Hast thou seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust? Wouldst thou then be guardian over him

25.arabic: أَم تَحسَبُ أَنَّ أَكثَرَهُم يَسمَعونَ أَو يَعقِلونَ إِن هُم إِلّا كَالأَنعٰمِ بَل هُم أَضَلُّ سَبيلًا
25.transliteration: Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasmaAAoona aw yaAAqiloona in hum illa kaalanAAami bal hum adallu sabeelan
25.translation: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle - nay, but they are farther astray

25.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ إِلىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيفَ مَدَّ الظِّلَّ وَلَو شاءَ لَجَعَلَهُ ساكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلنَا الشَّمسَ عَلَيهِ دَليلًا
25.transliteration: Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa madda alththilla walaw shaa lajaAAalahu sakinan thumma jaAAalna alshshamsa AAalayhi daleelan
25.translation: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot

25.arabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضنٰهُ إِلَينا قَبضًا يَسيرًا
25.transliteration: Thumma qabadnahu ilayna qabdan yaseeran
25.translation: Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal

25.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيلَ لِباسًا وَالنَّومَ سُباتًا وَجَعَلَ النَّهارَ نُشورًا
25.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla libasan waalnnawma subatan wajaAAala alnnahara nushooran
25.translation: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection

25.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى أَرسَلَ الرِّيٰحَ بُشرًا بَينَ يَدَى رَحمَتِهِ وَأَنزَلنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً طَهورًا
25.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee arsala alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi waanzalna mina alssamai maan tahooran
25.translation: And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy, and We send down purifying water from the sky

25.arabic: لِنُحۦِىَ بِهِ بَلدَةً مَيتًا وَنُسقِيَهُ مِمّا خَلَقنا أَنعٰمًا وَأَناسِىَّ كَثيرًا
25.transliteration: Linuhyiya bihi baldatan maytan wanusqiyahu mimma khalaqna anAAaman waanasiyya katheeran
25.translation: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof

25.arabic: وَلَقَد صَرَّفنٰهُ بَينَهُم لِيَذَّكَّروا فَأَبىٰ أَكثَرُ النّاسِ إِلّا كُفورًا
25.transliteration: Walaqad sarrafnahu baynahum liyaththakkaroo faaba aktharu alnnasi illa kufooran
25.translation: And verily We have repeated it among them that they may remember, but most of mankind begrudge aught save ingratitude

25.arabic: وَلَو شِئنا لَبَعَثنا فى كُلِّ قَريَةٍ نَذيرًا
25.transliteration: Walaw shina labaAAathna fee kulli qaryatin natheeran
25.translation: If We willed, We could raise up a warner in every village

25.arabic: فَلا تُطِعِ الكٰفِرينَ وَجٰهِدهُم بِهِ جِهادًا كَبيرًا
25.transliteration: Fala tutiAAi alkafireena wajahidhum bihi jihadan kabeeran
25.translation: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them herewith with a great endeavour

25.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى مَرَجَ البَحرَينِ هٰذا عَذبٌ فُراتٌ وَهٰذا مِلحٌ أُجاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَينَهُما بَرزَخًا وَحِجرًا مَحجورًا
25.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee maraja albahrayni hatha AAathbun furatun wahatha milhun ojajun wajaAAala baynahuma barzakhan wahijran mahjooran
25.translation: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them

25.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى خَلَقَ مِنَ الماءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُ نَسَبًا وَصِهرًا وَكانَ رَبُّكَ قَديرًا
25.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa mina almai basharan fajaAAalahu nasaban wasihran wakana rabbuka qadeeran
25.translation: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful

25.arabic: وَيَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ما لا يَنفَعُهُم وَلا يَضُرُّهُم وَكانَ الكافِرُ عَلىٰ رَبِّهِ ظَهيرًا
25.transliteration: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuhum wala yadurruhum wakana alkafiru AAala rabbihi thaheeran
25.translation: Yet they worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them nor hurt them. The disbeliever was ever a partisan against his Lord

25.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنٰكَ إِلّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذيرًا
25.transliteration: Wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran
25.translation: And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner

25.arabic: قُل ما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِلّا مَن شاءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبيلًا
25.transliteration: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin illa man shaa an yattakhitha ila rabbihi sabeelan
25.translation: Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord

25.arabic: وَتَوَكَّل عَلَى الحَىِّ الَّذى لا يَموتُ وَسَبِّح بِحَمدِهِ وَكَفىٰ بِهِ بِذُنوبِ عِبادِهِ خَبيرًا
25.transliteration: Watawakkal AAala alhayyi allathee la yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafa bihi bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeeran
25.translation: And trust thou in the Living One Who dieth not, and hymn His praise. He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins

25.arabic: الَّذى خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما فى سِتَّةِ أَيّامٍ ثُمَّ استَوىٰ عَلَى العَرشِ الرَّحمٰنُ فَسـَٔل بِهِ خَبيرًا
25.transliteration: Allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi alrrahmanu faisal bihi khabeeran
25.translation: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him

25.arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُمُ اسجُدوا لِلرَّحمٰنِ قالوا وَمَا الرَّحمٰنُ أَنَسجُدُ لِما تَأمُرُنا وَزادَهُم نُفورًا
25.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu osjudoo lilrrahmani qaloo wama alrrahmanu anasjudu lima tamuruna wazadahum nufooran
25.translation: And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them

25.arabic: تَبارَكَ الَّذى جَعَلَ فِى السَّماءِ بُروجًا وَجَعَلَ فيها سِرٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُنيرًا
25.transliteration: Tabaraka allathee jaAAala fee alssamai buroojan wajaAAala feeha sirajan waqamaran muneeran
25.translation: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light

25.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى جَعَلَ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ خِلفَةً لِمَن أَرادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَو أَرادَ شُكورًا
25.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala allayla waalnnahara khilfatan liman arada an yaththakkara aw arada shukooran
25.translation: And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness

25.arabic: وَعِبادُ الرَّحمٰنِ الَّذينَ يَمشونَ عَلَى الأَرضِ هَونًا وَإِذا خاطَبَهُمُ الجٰهِلونَ قالوا سَلٰمًا
25.transliteration: WaAAibadu alrrahmani allatheena yamshoona AAala alardi hawnan waitha khatabahumu aljahiloona qaloo salaman
25.translation: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace

25.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يَبيتونَ لِرَبِّهِم سُجَّدًا وَقِيٰمًا
25.transliteration: Waallatheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyaman
25.translation: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing

25.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يَقولونَ رَبَّنَا اصرِف عَنّا عَذابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذابَها كانَ غَرامًا
25.transliteration: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana isrif AAanna AAathaba jahannama inna AAathabaha kana gharaman
25.translation: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish

25.arabic: إِنَّها ساءَت مُستَقَرًّا وَمُقامًا
25.transliteration: Innaha saat mustaqarran wamuqaman
25.translation: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station

25.arabic: وَالَّذينَ إِذا أَنفَقوا لَم يُسرِفوا وَلَم يَقتُروا وَكانَ بَينَ ذٰلِكَ قَوامًا
25.transliteration: Waallatheena itha anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakana bayna thalika qawaman
25.translation: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two

25.arabic: وَالَّذينَ لا يَدعونَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ وَلا يَقتُلونَ النَّفسَ الَّتى حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَلا يَزنونَ وَمَن يَفعَل ذٰلِكَ يَلقَ أَثامًا
25.transliteration: Waallatheena la yadAAoona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtuloona alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi wala yaznoona waman yafAAal thalika yalqa athaman
25.translation: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty

25.arabic: يُضٰعَف لَهُ العَذابُ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ وَيَخلُد فيهِ مُهانًا
25.transliteration: YudaAAaf lahu alAAathabu yawma alqiyamati wayakhlud feehi muhanan
25.translation: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever

25.arabic: إِلّا مَن تابَ وَءامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صٰلِحًا فَأُولٰئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اللَّهُ سَيِّـٔاتِهِم حَسَنٰتٍ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا
25.transliteration: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila AAamalan salihan faolaika yubaddilu Allahu sayyiatihim hasanatin wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman
25.translation: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

25.arabic: وَمَن تابَ وَعَمِلَ صٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُ يَتوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ مَتابًا
25.transliteration: Waman taba waAAamila salihan fainnahu yatoobu ila Allahi mataban
25.translation: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance

25.arabic: وَالَّذينَ لا يَشهَدونَ الزّورَ وَإِذا مَرّوا بِاللَّغوِ مَرّوا كِرامًا
25.transliteration: Waallatheena la yashhadoona alzzoora waitha marroo biallaghwi marroo kiraman
25.translation: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity

25.arabic: وَالَّذينَ إِذا ذُكِّروا بِـٔايٰتِ رَبِّهِم لَم يَخِرّوا عَلَيها صُمًّا وَعُميانًا
25.transliteration: Waallatheena itha thukkiroo biayati rabbihim lam yakhirroo AAalayha summan waAAumyanan
25.translation: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat

25.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يَقولونَ رَبَّنا هَب لَنا مِن أَزوٰجِنا وَذُرِّيّٰتِنا قُرَّةَ أَعيُنٍ وَاجعَلنا لِلمُتَّقينَ إِمامًا
25.transliteration: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana hab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatina qurrata aAAyunin waijAAalna lilmuttaqeena imaman
25.translation: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil)

25.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ يُجزَونَ الغُرفَةَ بِما صَبَروا وَيُلَقَّونَ فيها تَحِيَّةً وَسَلٰمًا
25.transliteration: Olaika yujzawna alghurfata bima sabaroo wayulaqqawna feeha tahiyyatan wasalaman
25.translation: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace

25.arabic: خٰلِدينَ فيها حَسُنَت مُستَقَرًّا وَمُقامًا
25.transliteration: Khalideena feeha hasunat mustaqarran wamuqaman
25.translation: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station

25.arabic: قُل ما يَعبَؤُا۟ بِكُم رَبّى لَولا دُعاؤُكُم فَقَد كَذَّبتُم فَسَوفَ يَكونُ لِزامًا
25.transliteration: Qul ma yaAAbao bikum rabbee lawla duAAaokum faqad kaththabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaman
25.translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment

26.translation: Ta. Sin. Mim
These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain

26.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بٰخِعٌ نَفسَكَ أَلّا يَكونوا مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena
26.translation: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not

26.arabic: إِن نَشَأ نُنَزِّل عَلَيهِم مِنَ السَّماءِ ءايَةً فَظَلَّت أَعنٰقُهُم لَها خٰضِعينَ
26.transliteration: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena
26.translation: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it

26.arabic: وَما يَأتيهِم مِن ذِكرٍ مِنَ الرَّحمٰنِ مُحدَثٍ إِلّا كانوا عَنهُ مُعرِضينَ
26.transliteration: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena
26.translation: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it

26.arabic: فَقَد كَذَّبوا فَسَيَأتيهِم أَنبٰؤُا۟ ما كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
26.transliteration: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
26.translation: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff

26.arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَوا إِلَى الأَرضِ كَم أَنبَتنا فيها مِن كُلِّ زَوجٍ كَريمٍ
26.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin
26.translation: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein

26.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
26.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26.arabic: وَإِذ نادىٰ رَبُّكَ موسىٰ أَنِ ائتِ القَومَ الظّٰلِمينَ
26.transliteration: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena
26.translation: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk
The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)

26.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ إِنّى أَخافُ أَن يُكَذِّبونِ
26.transliteration: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni
26.translation: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me

26.arabic: وَيَضيقُ صَدرى وَلا يَنطَلِقُ لِسانى فَأَرسِل إِلىٰ هٰرونَ
26.transliteration: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona
26.translation: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me)

26.arabic: وَلَهُم عَلَىَّ ذَنبٌ فَأَخافُ أَن يَقتُلونِ
26.transliteration: Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni
26.translation: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me

26.arabic: قالَ كَلّا فَاذهَبا بِـٔايٰتِنا إِنّا مَعَكُم مُستَمِعونَ
26.transliteration: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona
26.translation: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing

26.arabic: فَأتِيا فِرعَونَ فَقولا إِنّا رَسولُ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
26.transliteration: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena
26.translation: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds
(Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us

26.arabic: قالَ أَلَم نُرَبِّكَ فينا وَليدًا وَلَبِثتَ فينا مِن عُمُرِكَ سِنينَ
26.transliteration: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena
26.translation: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us

26.arabic: وَفَعَلتَ فَعلَتَكَ الَّتى فَعَلتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ الكٰفِرينَ
26.transliteration: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena
26.translation: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates

26.arabic: قالَ فَعَلتُها إِذًا وَأَنا۠ مِنَ الضّالّينَ
26.transliteration: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena
26.translation: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray

26.arabic: فَفَرَرتُ مِنكُم لَمّا خِفتُكُم فَوَهَبَ لى رَبّى حُكمًا وَجَعَلَنى مِنَ المُرسَلينَ
26.transliteration: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena
26.translation: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him)

26.arabic: وَتِلكَ نِعمَةٌ تَمُنُّها عَلَىَّ أَن عَبَّدتَ بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ
26.transliteration: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela
26.translation: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel
Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds

26.arabic: قالَ رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما إِن كُنتُم موقِنينَ
26.transliteration: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
26.translation: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief
(Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not
He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers

26.arabic: قالَ إِنَّ رَسولَكُمُ الَّذى أُرسِلَ إِلَيكُم لَمَجنونٌ
26.transliteration: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun
26.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman

26.arabic: قالَ رَبُّ المَشرِقِ وَالمَغرِبِ وَما بَينَهُما إِن كُنتُم تَعقِلونَ
26.transliteration: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona
26.translation: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand

26.arabic: قالَ لَئِنِ اتَّخَذتَ إِلٰهًا غَيرى لَأَجعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ المَسجونينَ
26.transliteration: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena
26.translation: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners
He said: Even though I show thee something plain

26.arabic: قالَ فَأتِ بِهِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
26.transliteration: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena
26.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful

26.arabic: فَأَلقىٰ عَصاهُ فَإِذا هِىَ ثُعبانٌ مُبينٌ
26.transliteration: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun
26.translation: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest

26.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُ فَإِذا هِىَ بَيضاءُ لِلنّٰظِرينَ
26.transliteration: WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena
26.translation: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders

26.arabic: قالَ لِلمَلَإِ حَولَهُ إِنَّ هٰذا لَسٰحِرٌ عَليمٌ
26.transliteration: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun
26.translation: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard

26.arabic: يُريدُ أَن يُخرِجَكُم مِن أَرضِكُم بِسِحرِهِ فَماذا تَأمُرونَ
26.transliteration: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona
26.translation: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye

26.arabic: قالوا أَرجِه وَأَخاهُ وَابعَث فِى المَدائِنِ حٰشِرينَ
26.transliteration: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena
26.translation: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard
So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed
And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering

26.arabic: لَعَلَّنا نَتَّبِعُ السَّحَرَةَ إِن كانوا هُمُ الغٰلِبينَ
26.transliteration: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena
26.translation: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners

26.arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَ السَّحَرَةُ قالوا لِفِرعَونَ أَئِنَّ لَنا لَأَجرًا إِن كُنّا نَحنُ الغٰلِبينَ
26.transliteration: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena
26.translation: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners

26.arabic: قالَ نَعَم وَإِنَّكُم إِذًا لَمِنَ المُقَرَّبينَ
26.transliteration: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena
26.translation: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me)

26.arabic: قالَ لَهُم موسىٰ أَلقوا ما أَنتُم مُلقونَ
26.transliteration: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona
26.translation: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw

26.arabic: فَأَلقَوا حِبالَهُم وَعِصِيَّهُم وَقالوا بِعِزَّةِ فِرعَونَ إِنّا لَنَحنُ الغٰلِبونَ
26.transliteration: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona
26.translation: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners

26.arabic: فَأَلقىٰ موسىٰ عَصاهُ فَإِذا هِىَ تَلقَفُ ما يَأفِكونَ
26.transliteration: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona
26.translation: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show
And the wizards were flung prostrate
Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds
The Lord of Moses and Aaron

26.arabic: قالَ ءامَنتُم لَهُ قَبلَ أَن ءاذَنَ لَكُم إِنَّهُ لَكَبيرُكُمُ الَّذى عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحرَ فَلَسَوفَ تَعلَمونَ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيدِيَكُم وَأَرجُلَكُم مِن خِلٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُم أَجمَعينَ
26.transliteration: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena
26.translation: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one

26.arabic: قالوا لا ضَيرَ إِنّا إِلىٰ رَبِّنا مُنقَلِبونَ
26.transliteration: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona
26.translation: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return

26.arabic: إِنّا نَطمَعُ أَن يَغفِرَ لَنا رَبُّنا خَطٰيٰنا أَن كُنّا أَوَّلَ المُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena
26.translation: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers

26.arabic: وَأَوحَينا إِلىٰ موسىٰ أَن أَسرِ بِعِبادى إِنَّكُم مُتَّبَعونَ
26.transliteration: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona
26.translation: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued
Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners
(Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop
And lo! they are offenders against us
And lo! we are a ready host
Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings
And treasures and a fair estate
Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them
And they overtook them at sunrise

26.arabic: فَلَمّا تَرٰءَا الجَمعانِ قالَ أَصحٰبُ موسىٰ إِنّا لَمُدرَكونَ
26.transliteration: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona
26.translation: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught

26.arabic: قالَ كَلّا إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبّى سَيَهدينِ
26.transliteration: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni
26.translation: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me

26.arabic: فَأَوحَينا إِلىٰ موسىٰ أَنِ اضرِب بِعَصاكَ البَحرَ فَانفَلَقَ فَكانَ كُلُّ فِرقٍ كَالطَّودِ العَظيمِ
26.transliteration: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi
26.translation: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast
Then brought We near the others to that place
And We saved Moses and those with him, every one
And We drowned the others

26.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
26.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
Recite unto them the story of Abraham

26.arabic: إِذ قالَ لِأَبيهِ وَقَومِهِ ما تَعبُدونَ
26.transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona
26.translation: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye

26.arabic: قالوا نَعبُدُ أَصنامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَها عٰكِفينَ
26.transliteration: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena
26.translation: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them
He said: Do they hear you when ye cry
Or do they benefit or harm you

26.arabic: قالوا بَل وَجَدنا ءاباءَنا كَذٰلِكَ يَفعَلونَ
26.transliteration: Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona
26.translation: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise
He said: See now that which ye worship
Ye and your forefathers

26.arabic: فَإِنَّهُم عَدُوٌّ لى إِلّا رَبَّ العٰلَمينَ
26.transliteration: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena
26.translation: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds
Who created me, and He doth guide me
And Who feedeth me and watereth me
And when I sicken, then He healeth me
And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again)

26.arabic: وَالَّذى أَطمَعُ أَن يَغفِرَ لى خَطيـَٔتى يَومَ الدّينِ
26.transliteration: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni
26.translation: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment

26.arabic: رَبِّ هَب لى حُكمًا وَأَلحِقنى بِالصّٰلِحينَ
26.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena
26.translation: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous

26.arabic: وَاجعَل لى لِسانَ صِدقٍ فِى الءاخِرينَ
26.transliteration: WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena
26.translation: And give unto me a good report in later generations
And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight

26.arabic: وَاغفِر لِأَبى إِنَّهُ كانَ مِنَ الضّالّينَ
26.transliteration: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena
26.translation: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err
And abase me not on the day when they are raised

26.arabic: يَومَ لا يَنفَعُ مالٌ وَلا بَنونَ
26.transliteration: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona
26.translation: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)

26.arabic: إِلّا مَن أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلبٍ سَليمٍ
26.transliteration: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin
26.translation: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart
And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil)
And hell will appear plainly to the erring

26.arabic: وَقيلَ لَهُم أَينَ ما كُنتُم تَعبُدونَ
26.transliteration: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona
26.translation: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship

26.arabic: مِن دونِ اللَّهِ هَل يَنصُرونَكُم أَو يَنتَصِرونَ
26.transliteration: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona
26.translation: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves
Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers
And the hosts of Iblis, together
And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein

26.arabic: تَاللَّهِ إِن كُنّا لَفى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
26.transliteration: TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin
26.translation: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds
It was but the guilty who misled us
Now we have no intercessors
Nor any loving friend

26.arabic: فَلَو أَنَّ لَنا كَرَّةً فَنَكونَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena
26.translation: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers

26.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
26.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah)

26.arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم أَخوهُم نوحٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
26.transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona
26.translation: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me

26.arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
26.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
26.translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds
So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me
They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee

26.arabic: قالَ وَما عِلمى بِما كانوا يَعمَلونَ
26.transliteration: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona
26.translation: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)

26.arabic: إِن حِسابُهُم إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبّى لَو تَشعُرونَ
26.transliteration: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona
26.translation: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew
And I am not (here) to repulse believers
I am only a plain warner

26.arabic: قالوا لَئِن لَم تَنتَهِ يٰنوحُ لَتَكونَنَّ مِنَ المَرجومينَ
26.transliteration: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena
26.translation: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death)
He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me

26.arabic: فَافتَح بَينى وَبَينَهُم فَتحًا وَنَجِّنى وَمَن مَعِىَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena
26.translation: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me

26.arabic: فَأَنجَينٰهُ وَمَن مَعَهُ فِى الفُلكِ المَشحونِ
26.transliteration: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni
26.translation: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship
Then afterward We drowned the others

26.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
26.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
(The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah)

26.arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم أَخوهُم هودٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
26.transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona
26.translation: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26.arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
26.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
26.translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds
Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight
And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever
And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants
Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me
Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know
Hath aided you with cattle and sons
And gardens and watersprings

26.arabic: إِنّى أَخافُ عَلَيكُم عَذابَ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
26.transliteration: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
26.translation: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day

26.arabic: قالوا سَواءٌ عَلَينا أَوَعَظتَ أَم لَم تَكُن مِنَ الوٰعِظينَ
26.transliteration: Qaloo sawaon AAalayna awaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheena
26.translation: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach
This is but a fable of the men of old
And we shall not be doomed

26.arabic: فَكَذَّبوهُ فَأَهلَكنٰهُم إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
26.translation: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
(The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)

26.arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم أَخوهُم صٰلِحٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
26.transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona
26.translation: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26.arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
26.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
26.translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds
Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us
In gardens and watersprings
And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees
Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful
Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me
And obey not the command of the prodigal

26.arabic: الَّذينَ يُفسِدونَ فِى الأَرضِ وَلا يُصلِحونَ
26.transliteration: Allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona
26.translation: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not
They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched

26.arabic: ما أَنتَ إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُنا فَأتِ بِـٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
26.transliteration: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena
26.translation: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful

26.arabic: قالَ هٰذِهِ ناقَةٌ لَها شِربٌ وَلَكُم شِربُ يَومٍ مَعلومٍ
26.transliteration: Qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloomin
26.translation: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day

26.arabic: وَلا تَمَسّوها بِسوءٍ فَيَأخُذَكُم عَذابُ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
26.transliteration: Wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheemin
26.translation: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day
But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent

26.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ العَذابُ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
26.translation: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah)

26.arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم أَخوهُم لوطٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
26.transliteration: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona
26.translation: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26.arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
26.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
26.translation: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds
What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males

26.arabic: وَتَذَرونَ ما خَلَقَ لَكُم رَبُّكُم مِن أَزوٰجِكُم بَل أَنتُم قَومٌ عادونَ
26.transliteration: Watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun AAadoona
26.translation: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk

26.arabic: قالوا لَئِن لَم تَنتَهِ يٰلوطُ لَتَكونَنَّ مِنَ المُخرَجينَ
26.transliteration: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena
26.translation: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast
He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct
My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do
So We saved him and his household, every one
Save an old woman among those who stayed behind
Then afterward We destroyed the others

26.arabic: وَأَمطَرنا عَلَيهِم مَطَرًا فَساءَ مَطَرُ المُنذَرينَ
26.transliteration: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena
26.translation: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned

26.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
26.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah)

26.arabic: إِذ قالَ لَهُم شُعَيبٌ أَلا تَتَّقونَ
26.transliteration: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun ala tattaqoona
26.translation: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you
So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26.arabic: وَما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلىٰ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
26.transliteration: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena
26.translation: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds

26.arabic: أَوفُوا الكَيلَ وَلا تَكونوا مِنَ المُخسِرينَ
26.transliteration: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena
26.translation: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due)
And weigh with the true balance

26.arabic: وَلا تَبخَسُوا النّاسَ أَشياءَهُم وَلا تَعثَوا فِى الأَرضِ مُفسِدينَ
26.transliteration: Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena
26.translation: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth
And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old
They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched

26.arabic: وَما أَنتَ إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُنا وَإِن نَظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ الكٰذِبينَ
26.transliteration: Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena
26.translation: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars

26.arabic: فَأَسقِط عَلَينا كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّماءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
26.transliteration: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena
26.translation: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful
He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do

26.arabic: فَكَذَّبوهُ فَأَخَذَهُم عَذابُ يَومِ الظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كانَ عَذابَ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
26.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
26.translation: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day

26.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً وَما كانَ أَكثَرُهُم مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena
26.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers
And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful
And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds
Which the True Spirit hath brought down
Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners
In plain Arabic speech
And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old

26.arabic: أَوَلَم يَكُن لَهُم ءايَةً أَن يَعلَمَهُ عُلَمٰؤُا۟ بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ
26.transliteration: Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela
26.translation: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it
And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs

26.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيهِم ما كانوا بِهِ مُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena
26.translation: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it
Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty

26.arabic: لا يُؤمِنونَ بِهِ حَتّىٰ يَرَوُا العَذابَ الأَليمَ
26.transliteration: La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema
26.translation: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom
So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not
Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved
Would they (now) hasten on Our doom
Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years
And then cometh that which they were promised

26.arabic: ما أَغنىٰ عَنهُم ما كانوا يُمَتَّعونَ
26.transliteration: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona
26.translation: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them

26.arabic: وَما أَهلَكنا مِن قَريَةٍ إِلّا لَها مُنذِرونَ
26.transliteration: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona
26.translation: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
For reminder, for We never were oppressors
The devils did not bring it down
It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power
Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing

26.arabic: فَلا تَدعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ فَتَكونَ مِنَ المُعَذَّبينَ
26.transliteration: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena
26.translation: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed
And warn thy tribe of near kindred

26.arabic: وَاخفِض جَناحَكَ لِمَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
26.transliteration: Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena
26.translation: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee

26.arabic: فَإِن عَصَوكَ فَقُل إِنّى بَريءٌ مِمّا تَعمَلونَ
26.transliteration: Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona
26.translation: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do
And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful
Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship)
Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower

26.arabic: هَل أُنَبِّئُكُم عَلىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ الشَّيٰطينُ
26.transliteration: Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu
26.translation: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend
They descend on every sinful, false one
They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars
As for poets, the erring follow them

26.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّهُم فى كُلِّ وادٍ يَهيمونَ
26.transliteration: Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona
26.translation: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley
And how they say that which they do not

26.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا وَانتَصَروا مِن بَعدِ ما ظُلِموا وَسَيَعلَمُ الَّذينَ ظَلَموا أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبونَ
26.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona
26.translation: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned

27.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ طس تِلكَ ءايٰتُ القُرءانِ وَكِتابٍ مُبينٍ
27.transliteration: Taseen tilka ayatu alqurani wakitabin mubeenin
27.translation: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain

27.arabic: هُدًى وَبُشرىٰ لِلمُؤمِنينَ
27.transliteration: Hudan wabushra lilmumineena
27.translation: A guidance and good tidings for believers

27.arabic: الَّذينَ يُقيمونَ الصَّلوٰةَ وَيُؤتونَ الزَّكوٰةَ وَهُم بِالءاخِرَةِ هُم يوقِنونَ
27.transliteration: Allatheena yuqeemoona alssalata wayutoona alzzakata wahum bialakhirati hum yooqinoona
27.translation: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter

27.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِالءاخِرَةِ زَيَّنّا لَهُم أَعمٰلَهُم فَهُم يَعمَهونَ
27.transliteration: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati zayyanna lahum aAAmalahum fahum yaAAmahoona
27.translation: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray

27.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ لَهُم سوءُ العَذابِ وَهُم فِى الءاخِرَةِ هُمُ الأَخسَرونَ
27.transliteration: Olaika allatheena lahum sooo alAAathabi wahum fee alakhirati humu alakhsaroona
27.translation: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers

27.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى القُرءانَ مِن لَدُن حَكيمٍ عَليمٍ
27.transliteration: Wainnaka latulaqqa alqurana min ladun hakeemin AAaleemin
27.translation: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware

27.arabic: إِذ قالَ موسىٰ لِأَهلِهِ إِنّى ءانَستُ نارًا سَـٔاتيكُم مِنها بِخَبَرٍ أَو ءاتيكُم بِشِهابٍ قَبَسٍ لَعَلَّكُم تَصطَلونَ
27.transliteration: Ith qala moosa liahlihi innee anastu naran saateekum minha bikhabarin aw ateekum bishihabin qabasin laAAallakum tastaloona
27.translation: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves

27.arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَها نودِىَ أَن بورِكَ مَن فِى النّارِ وَمَن حَولَها وَسُبحٰنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
27.transliteration: Falamma jaaha noodiya an boorika man fee alnnari waman hawlaha wasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAalameena
27.translation: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

27.arabic: يٰموسىٰ إِنَّهُ أَنَا اللَّهُ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
27.transliteration: Ya moosa innahu ana Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu
27.translation: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise

27.arabic: وَأَلقِ عَصاكَ فَلَمّا رَءاها تَهتَزُّ كَأَنَّها جانٌّ وَلّىٰ مُدبِرًا وَلَم يُعَقِّب يٰموسىٰ لا تَخَف إِنّى لا يَخافُ لَدَىَّ المُرسَلونَ
27.transliteration: Waalqi AAasaka falamma raaha tahtazzu kaannaha jannun walla mudbiran walam yuAAaqqib ya moosa la takhaf innee la yakhafu ladayya almursaloona
27.translation: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence

27.arabic: إِلّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسنًا بَعدَ سوءٍ فَإِنّى غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
27.transliteration: Illa man thalama thumma baddala husnan baAAda sooin fainnee ghafoorun raheemun
27.translation: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful

27.arabic: وَأَدخِل يَدَكَ فى جَيبِكَ تَخرُج بَيضاءَ مِن غَيرِ سوءٍ فى تِسعِ ءايٰتٍ إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ وَقَومِهِ إِنَّهُم كانوا قَومًا فٰسِقينَ
27.transliteration: Waadkhil yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin fee tisAAi ayatin ila firAAawna waqawmihi innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
27.translation: And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe, it will come forth white but unhurt. (This will be one) among nine tokens unto Pharaoh and his people Lo! they were ever evil-living folk

27.arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَتهُم ءايٰتُنا مُبصِرَةً قالوا هٰذا سِحرٌ مُبينٌ
27.transliteration: Falamma jaathum ayatuna mubsiratan qaloo hatha sihrun mubeenun
27.translation: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic

27.arabic: وَجَحَدوا بِها وَاستَيقَنَتها أَنفُسُهُم ظُلمًا وَعُلُوًّا فَانظُر كَيفَ كانَ عٰقِبَةُ المُفسِدينَ
27.transliteration: Wajahadoo biha waistayqanatha anfusuhum thulman waAAuluwwan faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almufsideena
27.translation: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers

27.arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا داوۥدَ وَسُلَيمٰنَ عِلمًا وَقالَا الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذى فَضَّلَنا عَلىٰ كَثيرٍ مِن عِبادِهِ المُؤمِنينَ
27.transliteration: Walaqad atayna dawooda wasulaymana AAilman waqala alhamdu lillahi allathee faddalana AAala katheerin min AAibadihi almumineena
27.translation: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves

27.arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيمٰنُ داوۥدَ وَقالَ يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ عُلِّمنا مَنطِقَ الطَّيرِ وَأوتينا مِن كُلِّ شَيءٍ إِنَّ هٰذا لَهُوَ الفَضلُ المُبينُ
27.transliteration: Wawaritha sulaymanu dawooda waqala ya ayyuha alnnasu AAullimna mantiqa alttayri waooteena min kulli shayin inna hatha lahuwa alfadlu almubeenu
27.translation: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour

27.arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيمٰنَ جُنودُهُ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنسِ وَالطَّيرِ فَهُم يوزَعونَ
27.transliteration: Wahushira lisulaymana junooduhu mina aljinni waalinsi waalttayri fahum yoozaAAoona
27.translation: And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order

27.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا أَتَوا عَلىٰ وادِ النَّملِ قالَت نَملَةٌ يٰأَيُّهَا النَّملُ ادخُلوا مَسٰكِنَكُم لا يَحطِمَنَّكُم سُلَيمٰنُ وَجُنودُهُ وَهُم لا يَشعُرونَ
27.transliteration: Hatta itha ataw AAala wadi alnnamli qalat namlatun ya ayyuha alnnamlu odkhuloo masakinakum la yahtimannakum sulaymanu wajunooduhu wahum la yashAAuroona
27.translation: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving

27.arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضاحِكًا مِن قَولِها وَقالَ رَبِّ أَوزِعنى أَن أَشكُرَ نِعمَتَكَ الَّتى أَنعَمتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلىٰ وٰلِدَىَّ وَأَن أَعمَلَ صٰلِحًا تَرضىٰهُ وَأَدخِلنى بِرَحمَتِكَ فى عِبادِكَ الصّٰلِحينَ
27.transliteration: Fatabassama dahikan min qawliha waqala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waadkhilnee birahmatika fee AAibadika alssaliheena
27.translation: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves

27.arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيرَ فَقالَ ما لِىَ لا أَرَى الهُدهُدَ أَم كانَ مِنَ الغائِبينَ
27.transliteration: Watafaqqada alttayra faqala ma liya la ara alhudhuda am kana mina alghaibeena
27.translation: And he sought among the birds and said: How is it that I see not the hoopoe, or is he among the absent

27.arabic: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذابًا شَديدًا أَو لَأَا۟ذبَحَنَّهُ أَو لَيَأتِيَنّى بِسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
27.transliteration: LaoAAaththibannahu AAathaban shadeedan aw laathbahannahu aw layatiyannee bisultanin mubeenin
27.translation: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse

27.arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيرَ بَعيدٍ فَقالَ أَحَطتُ بِما لَم تُحِط بِهِ وَجِئتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقينٍ
27.transliteration: Famakatha ghayra baAAeedin faqala ahattu bima lam tuhit bihi wajituka min sabain binabain yaqeenin
27.translation: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings

27.arabic: إِنّى وَجَدتُ امرَأَةً تَملِكُهُم وَأوتِيَت مِن كُلِّ شَيءٍ وَلَها عَرشٌ عَظيمٌ
27.transliteration: Innee wajadtu imraatan tamlikuhum waootiyat min kulli shayin walaha AAarshun AAatheemun
27.translation: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne

27.arabic: وَجَدتُها وَقَومَها يَسجُدونَ لِلشَّمسِ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيطٰنُ أَعمٰلَهُم فَصَدَّهُم عَنِ السَّبيلِ فَهُم لا يَهتَدونَ
27.transliteration: Wajadtuha waqawmaha yasjudoona lilshshamsi min dooni Allahi wazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fasaddahum AAani alssabeeli fahum la yahtadoona
27.translation: I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth), so that they go not aright

27.arabic: أَلّا يَسجُدوا لِلَّهِ الَّذى يُخرِجُ الخَبءَ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَيَعلَمُ ما تُخفونَ وَما تُعلِنونَ
27.transliteration: Alla yasjudoo lillahi allathee yukhriju alkhabaa fee alssamawati waalardi wayaAAlamu ma tukhfoona wama tuAAlinoona
27.translation: So that they worship not Allah, Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knoweth what ye hide and what ye proclaim

27.arabic: اللَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ رَبُّ العَرشِ العَظيمِ
27.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi
27.translation: Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne

27.arabic: قالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقتَ أَم كُنتَ مِنَ الكٰذِبينَ
27.transliteration: Qala sananthuru asadaqta am kunta mina alkathibeena
27.translation: (Solomon) said: We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars

27.arabic: اذهَب بِكِتٰبى هٰذا فَأَلقِه إِلَيهِم ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنهُم فَانظُر ماذا يَرجِعونَ
27.transliteration: Ithhab bikitabee hatha faalqih ilayhim thumma tawalla AAanhum faonthur matha yarjiAAoona
27.translation: Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away and see what (answer) they return

27.arabic: قالَت يٰأَيُّهَا المَلَؤُا۟ إِنّى أُلقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتٰبٌ كَريمٌ
27.transliteration: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao innee olqiya ilayya kitabun kareemun
27.translation: (The Queen of Sheba) said (when she received the letter): O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter

27.arabic: إِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيمٰنَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ
27.transliteration: Innahu min sulaymana wainnahu bismi Allahi alrrahmani alrraheemi
27.translation: Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful

27.arabic: أَلّا تَعلوا عَلَىَّ وَأتونى مُسلِمينَ
27.transliteration: Alla taAAloo AAalayya watoonee muslimeena
27.translation: Exalt not yourselves against me, but come unto me as those who surrender

27.arabic: قالَت يٰأَيُّهَا المَلَؤُا۟ أَفتونى فى أَمرى ما كُنتُ قاطِعَةً أَمرًا حَتّىٰ تَشهَدونِ
27.transliteration: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao aftoonee fee amree ma kuntu qatiAAatan amran hatta tashhadoona
27.translation: She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case. I decide no case till ye are present with me

27.arabic: قالوا نَحنُ أُولوا قُوَّةٍ وَأُولوا بَأسٍ شَديدٍ وَالأَمرُ إِلَيكِ فَانظُرى ماذا تَأمُرينَ
27.transliteration: Qaloo nahnu oloo quwwatin waoloo basin shadeedin waalamru ilayki faonthuree matha tamureena
27.translation: They said: We are lords of might and lords of great prowess, but it is for thee to command; so consider what thou wilt command

27.arabic: قالَت إِنَّ المُلوكَ إِذا دَخَلوا قَريَةً أَفسَدوها وَجَعَلوا أَعِزَّةَ أَهلِها أَذِلَّةً وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفعَلونَ
27.transliteration: Qalat inna almulooka itha dakhaloo qaryatan afsadooha wajaAAaloo aAAizzata ahliha athillatan wakathalika yafAAaloona
27.translation: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do

27.arabic: وَإِنّى مُرسِلَةٌ إِلَيهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَناظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرجِعُ المُرسَلونَ
27.transliteration: Wainnee mursilatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanathiratun bima yarjiAAu almursaloona
27.translation: But lo! I am going to send a present unto them, and to see with what (answer) the messengers return

27.arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَ سُلَيمٰنَ قالَ أَتُمِدّونَنِ بِمالٍ فَما ءاتىٰنِۦَ اللَّهُ خَيرٌ مِمّا ءاتىٰكُم بَل أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُم تَفرَحونَ
27.transliteration: Falamma jaa sulaymana qala atumiddoonani bimalin fama ataniya Allahu khayrun mimma atakum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafrahoona
27.translation: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon, (the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth? But that which Allah hath given me is better than that which He hath given you. Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift

27.arabic: ارجِع إِلَيهِم فَلَنَأتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنودٍ لا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِها وَلَنُخرِجَنَّهُم مِنها أَذِلَّةً وَهُم صٰغِرونَ
27.transliteration: IrjiAA ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunoodin la qibala lahum biha walanukhrijannahum minha athillatan wahum saghiroona
27.translation: Return unto them. We verily shall come unto them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from thence with shame, and they will be abased

27.arabic: قالَ يٰأَيُّهَا المَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُم يَأتينى بِعَرشِها قَبلَ أَن يَأتونى مُسلِمينَ
27.transliteration: Qala ya ayyuha almalao ayyukum yateenee biAAarshiha qabla an yatoonee muslimeena
27.translation: He said: O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering

27.arabic: قالَ عِفريتٌ مِنَ الجِنِّ أَنا۠ ءاتيكَ بِهِ قَبلَ أَن تَقومَ مِن مَقامِكَ وَإِنّى عَلَيهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمينٌ
27.transliteration: Qala AAifreetun mina aljinni ana ateeka bihi qabla an taqooma min maqamika wainne AAalayhi laqawiyyun ameenun
27.translation: A stalwart of the jinn said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from thy place. Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work

27.arabic: قالَ الَّذى عِندَهُ عِلمٌ مِنَ الكِتٰبِ أَنا۠ ءاتيكَ بِهِ قَبلَ أَن يَرتَدَّ إِلَيكَ طَرفُكَ فَلَمّا رَءاهُ مُستَقِرًّا عِندَهُ قالَ هٰذا مِن فَضلِ رَبّى لِيَبلُوَنى ءَأَشكُرُ أَم أَكفُرُ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّما يَشكُرُ لِنَفسِهِ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبّى غَنِىٌّ كَريمٌ
27.transliteration: Qala allathee AAindahu AAilmun mina alkitabi ana ateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuka falamma raahu mustaqirran AAindahu qala hatha min fadli rabbee liyabluwanee aashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fainnama yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna rabbee ghaniyyun kareemun
27.translation: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee. And when he saw it set in his presence, (Solomon) said: This is of the bounty of my Lord, that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful. Whosoever giveth thanks he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul; and whosoever is ungrateful (is ungrateful only to his own soul's hurt). For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence, Bountiful

27.arabic: قالَ نَكِّروا لَها عَرشَها نَنظُر أَتَهتَدى أَم تَكونُ مِنَ الَّذينَ لا يَهتَدونَ
27.transliteration: Qala nakkiroo laha AAarshaha nanthur atahtadee am takoonu mina allatheena la yahtadoona
27.translation: He said: Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will go aright or be of those not rightly guided

27.arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَت قيلَ أَهٰكَذا عَرشُكِ قالَت كَأَنَّهُ هُوَ وَأوتينَا العِلمَ مِن قَبلِها وَكُنّا مُسلِمينَ
27.transliteration: Falamma jaat qeela ahakatha AAarshuki qalat kaannahu huwa waooteena alAAilma min qabliha wakunna muslimeena
27.translation: So, when she came, it was said (unto her): Is thy throne like this? She said: (It is) as though it were the very one. And (Solomon said): We were given the knowledge before her and we had surrendered (to Allah)

27.arabic: وَصَدَّها ما كانَت تَعبُدُ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ إِنَّها كانَت مِن قَومٍ كٰفِرينَ
27.transliteration: Wasaddaha ma kanat taAAbudu min dooni Allahi innaha kanat min qawmin kafireena
27.translation: And (all) that she was wont to worship instead of Allah hindered her, for she came of disbelieving folk

27.arabic: قيلَ لَهَا ادخُلِى الصَّرحَ فَلَمّا رَأَتهُ حَسِبَتهُ لُجَّةً وَكَشَفَت عَن ساقَيها قالَ إِنَّهُ صَرحٌ مُمَرَّدٌ مِن قَواريرَ قالَت رَبِّ إِنّى ظَلَمتُ نَفسى وَأَسلَمتُ مَعَ سُلَيمٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
