And thou didst hide in thy mind that which Allah was to bring to light, and thou didst fear mankind whereas Allah hath a better right that thou shouldst fear Him. So when Zeyd had performed that necessary formality (of divorce) from her, We gave her unto thee in marriage, so that (henceforth) there may be no sin for believers in respect of wives of their adopted sons, when the latter have performed the necessary formality (of release) from them. The commandment of Allah must be fulfilled

33.arabic: ما كانَ عَلَى النَّبِىِّ مِن حَرَجٍ فيما فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَهُ سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِى الَّذينَ خَلَوا مِن قَبلُ وَكانَ أَمرُ اللَّهِ قَدَرًا مَقدورًا
33.transliteration: Ma kana AAala alnnabiyyi min harajin feema farada Allahu lahu sunnata Allahi fee allatheena khalaw min qablu wakana amru Allahi qadaran maqdooran
33.translation: There is no reproach for the Prophet in that which Allah maketh his due. That was Allah's way with those who passed away of old - and the commandment of Allah is certain destiny

33.arabic: الَّذينَ يُبَلِّغونَ رِسٰلٰتِ اللَّهِ وَيَخشَونَهُ وَلا يَخشَونَ أَحَدًا إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَكَفىٰ بِاللَّهِ حَسيبًا
33.transliteration: Allatheena yuballighoona risalati Allahi wayakhshawnahu wala yakhshawna ahadan illa Allaha wakafa biAllahi haseeban
33.translation: Who delivered the messages of Allah and feared Him, and feared none save Allah. Allah keepeth good account

33.arabic: ما كانَ مُحَمَّدٌ أَبا أَحَدٍ مِن رِجالِكُم وَلٰكِن رَسولَ اللَّهِ وَخاتَمَ النَّبِيّۦنَ وَكانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمًا
33.transliteration: Ma kana muhammadun aba ahadin min rijalikum walakin rasoola Allahi wakhatama alnnabiyyeena wakana Allahu bikulli shayin AAaleeman
33.translation: Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but he is the messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets; and Allah is ever Aware of all things

33.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنُوا اذكُرُوا اللَّهَ ذِكرًا كَثيرًا
33.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo othkuroo Allaha thikran katheeran
33.translation: O ye who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance

33.arabic: وَسَبِّحوهُ بُكرَةً وَأَصيلًا
33.transliteration: Wasabbihoohu bukratan waaseelan
33.translation: And glorify Him early and late

33.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى يُصَلّى عَلَيكُم وَمَلٰئِكَتُهُ لِيُخرِجَكُم مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ إِلَى النّورِ وَكانَ بِالمُؤمِنينَ رَحيمًا
33.transliteration: Huwa allathee yusallee AAalaykum wamalaikatuhu liyukhrijakum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wakana bialmumineena raheeman
33.translation: He it is Who blesseth you, and His angels (bless you), that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and He is ever Merciful to the believers

33.arabic: تَحِيَّتُهُم يَومَ يَلقَونَهُ سَلٰمٌ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُم أَجرًا كَريمًا
33.transliteration: Tahiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahu salamun waaAAadda lahum ajran kareeman
33.translation: Their salutation on the day when they shall meet Him will be: Peace. And He hath prepared for them a goodly recompense

33.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ إِنّا أَرسَلنٰكَ شٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذيرًا
33.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu inna arsalnaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheeran
33.translation: O Prophet! Lo! We have sent thee as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

33.arabic: وَداعِيًا إِلَى اللَّهِ بِإِذنِهِ وَسِراجًا مُنيرًا
33.transliteration: WadaAAiyan ila Allahi biithnihi wasirajan muneeran
33.translation: And as a summoner unto Allah by His permission, and as a lamp that giveth light

33.arabic: وَبَشِّرِ المُؤمِنينَ بِأَنَّ لَهُم مِنَ اللَّهِ فَضلًا كَبيرًا
33.transliteration: Wabashshiri almumineena bianna lahum mina Allahi fadlan kabeeran
33.translation: And announce unto the believers the good tidings that they will have great bounty from Allah

33.arabic: وَلا تُطِعِ الكٰفِرينَ وَالمُنٰفِقينَ وَدَع أَذىٰهُم وَتَوَكَّل عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَفىٰ بِاللَّهِ وَكيلًا
33.transliteration: Wala tutiAAi alkafireena waalmunafiqeena wadaAA athahum watawakkal AAala Allahi wakafa biAllahi wakeelan
33.translation: And incline not to the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Disregard their noxious talk, and put thy trust in Allah. Allah is sufficient as Trustee

33.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِذا نَكَحتُمُ المُؤمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقتُموهُنَّ مِن قَبلِ أَن تَمَسّوهُنَّ فَما لَكُم عَلَيهِنَّ مِن عِدَّةٍ تَعتَدّونَها فَمَتِّعوهُنَّ وَسَرِّحوهُنَّ سَراحًا جَميلًا
33.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha nakahtumu almuminati thumma tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna fama lakum AAalayhinna min AAiddatin taAAtaddoonaha famattiAAoohunna wasarrihoohunna sarahan jameelan
33.translation: O ye who believe! If ye wed believing women and divorce them before ye have touched them, then there is no period that ye should reckon. But content them and release them handsomely

33.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ إِنّا أَحلَلنا لَكَ أَزوٰجَكَ الّٰتى ءاتَيتَ أُجورَهُنَّ وَما مَلَكَت يَمينُكَ مِمّا أَفاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيكَ وَبَناتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَناتِ عَمّٰتِكَ وَبَناتِ خالِكَ وَبَناتِ خٰلٰتِكَ الّٰتى هاجَرنَ مَعَكَ وَامرَأَةً مُؤمِنَةً إِن وَهَبَت نَفسَها لِلنَّبِىِّ إِن أَرادَ النَّبِىُّ أَن يَستَنكِحَها خالِصَةً لَكَ مِن دونِ المُؤمِنينَ قَد عَلِمنا ما فَرَضنا عَلَيهِم فى أَزوٰجِهِم وَما مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُهُم لِكَيلا يَكونَ عَلَيكَ حَرَجٌ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا
33.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu inna ahlalna laka azwajaka allatee atayta ojoorahunna wama malakat yameenuka mimma afaa Allahu AAalayka wabanati AAammika wabanati AAammatika wabanati khalika wabanati khalatika allatee hajarna maAAaka waimraatan muminatan in wahabat nafsaha lilnnabiyyi in arada alnnabiyyu an yastankihaha khalisatan laka min dooni almumineena qad AAalimna ma faradna AAalayhim fee azwajihim wama malakat aymanuhum likayla yakoona AAalayka harajun wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman
33.translation: O Prophet! Lo! We have made lawful unto thee thy wives unto whom thou hast paid their dowries, and those whom thy right hand possesseth of those whom Allah hath given thee as spoils of war, and the daughters of thine uncle on the father's side and the daughters of thine aunts on the father's side, and the daughters of thine uncle on the mother's side and the daughters of thine aunts on the mother's side who emigrated with thee, and a believing woman if she give herself unto the Prophet and the Prophet desire to ask her in marriage - a privilege for thee only, not for the (rest of) believers - We are Aware of that which We enjoined upon them concerning their wives and those whom their right hands possess - that thou mayst be free from blame, for Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

33.arabic: تُرجى مَن تَشاءُ مِنهُنَّ وَتُـٔوى إِلَيكَ مَن تَشاءُ وَمَنِ ابتَغَيتَ مِمَّن عَزَلتَ فَلا جُناحَ عَلَيكَ ذٰلِكَ أَدنىٰ أَن تَقَرَّ أَعيُنُهُنَّ وَلا يَحزَنَّ وَيَرضَينَ بِما ءاتَيتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّ وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ ما فى قُلوبِكُم وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَليمًا حَليمًا
33.transliteration: Turjee man tashao minhunna watuwee ilayka man tashao wamani ibtaghayta mimman AAazalta fala junaha AAalayka thalika adna an taqarra aAAyunuhunna wala yahzanna wayardayna bima ataytahunna kulluhunna waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee quloobikum wakana Allahu AAaleeman haleeman
33.translation: Thou canst defer whom thou wilt of them and receive unto thee whom thou wilt, and whomsoever thou desirest of those whom thou hast set aside (temporarily), it is no sin for thee (to receive her again); that is better; that they may be comforted and not grieve, and may all be pleased with what thou givest them. Allah knoweth what is in your hearts (O men), and Allah is ever Forgiving, Clement

33.arabic: لا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّساءُ مِن بَعدُ وَلا أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِن أَزوٰجٍ وَلَو أَعجَبَكَ حُسنُهُنَّ إِلّا ما مَلَكَت يَمينُكَ وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ رَقيبًا
33.transliteration: La yahillu laka alnnisao min baAAdu wala an tabaddala bihinna min azwajin walaw aAAjabaka husnuhunna illa ma malakat yameenuka wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin raqeeban
33.translation: It is not allowed thee to take (other) women henceforth, nor that thou shouldst change them for other wives even though their beauty pleased thee, save those whom thy right hand possesseth. And Allah is ever Watcher over all things

33.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تَدخُلوا بُيوتَ النَّبِىِّ إِلّا أَن يُؤذَنَ لَكُم إِلىٰ طَعامٍ غَيرَ نٰظِرينَ إِنىٰهُ وَلٰكِن إِذا دُعيتُم فَادخُلوا فَإِذا طَعِمتُم فَانتَشِروا وَلا مُستَـٔنِسينَ لِحَديثٍ إِنَّ ذٰلِكُم كانَ يُؤذِى النَّبِىَّ فَيَستَحيۦ مِنكُم وَاللَّهُ لا يَستَحيۦ مِنَ الحَقِّ وَإِذا سَأَلتُموهُنَّ مَتٰعًا فَسـَٔلوهُنَّ مِن وَراءِ حِجابٍ ذٰلِكُم أَطهَرُ لِقُلوبِكُم وَقُلوبِهِنَّ وَما كانَ لَكُم أَن تُؤذوا رَسولَ اللَّهِ وَلا أَن تَنكِحوا أَزوٰجَهُ مِن بَعدِهِ أَبَدًا إِنَّ ذٰلِكُم كانَ عِندَ اللَّهِ عَظيمًا
33.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyoota alnnabiyyi illa an yuthana lakum ila taAAamin ghayra nathireena inahu walakin itha duAAeetum faodkhuloo faitha taAAimtum faintashiroo wala mustaniseena lihadeethin inna thalikum kana yuthee alnnabiyya fayastahyee minkum waAllahu la yastahyee mina alhaqqi waitha saaltumoohunna mataAAan faisaloohunna min warai hijabin thalikum atharu liquloobikum waquloobihinna wama kana lakum an tuthoo rasoola Allahi wala an tankihoo azwajahu min baAAdihi abadan inna thalikum kana AAinda Allahi AAatheeman
33.translation: O Ye who believe! Enter not the dwellings of the Prophet for a meal without waiting for the proper time, unless permission be granted you. But if ye are invited, enter, and, when your meal is ended, then disperse. Linger not for conversation. Lo! that would cause annoyance to the Prophet, and he would be shy of (asking) you (to go); but Allah is not shy of the truth. And when ye ask of them (the wives of the Prophet) anything, ask it of them from behind a curtain. That is purer for your hearts and for their hearts. And it is not for you to cause annoyance to the messenger of Allah, nor that ye should ever marry his wives after him. Lo! that in Allah's sight would be an enormity

33.arabic: إِن تُبدوا شَيـًٔا أَو تُخفوهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمًا
33.transliteration: In tubdoo shayan aw tukhfoohu fainna Allaha kana bikulli shayin AAaleeman
33.translation: Whether ye divulge a thing or keep it hidden, lo! Allah is ever Knower of all things

33.arabic: لا جُناحَ عَلَيهِنَّ فى ءابائِهِنَّ وَلا أَبنائِهِنَّ وَلا إِخوٰنِهِنَّ وَلا أَبناءِ إِخوٰنِهِنَّ وَلا أَبناءِ أَخَوٰتِهِنَّ وَلا نِسائِهِنَّ وَلا ما مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُهُنَّ وَاتَّقينَ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ شَهيدًا
33.transliteration: La junaha AAalayhinna fee abaihinna wala abnaihinna wala ikhwanihinna wala abnai ikhwanihinna wala abnai akhawatihinna wala nisaihinna wala ma malakat aymanuhunna waittaqeena Allaha inna Allaha kana AAala kulli shayin shaheedan
33.translation: It is no sin for them (thy wives) to converse freely) with their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or the sons of their sisters or of their own women, or their slaves. O women! Keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is ever Witness over all things

33.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلٰئِكَتَهُ يُصَلّونَ عَلَى النَّبِىِّ يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا صَلّوا عَلَيهِ وَسَلِّموا تَسليمًا
33.transliteration: Inna Allaha wamalaikatahu yusalloona AAala alnnabiyyi ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo salloo AAalayhi wasallimoo tasleeman
33.translation: Lo! Allah and His angels shower blessings on the Prophet. O ye who believe! Ask blessings on him and salute him with a worthy salutation

33.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يُؤذونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِى الدُّنيا وَالءاخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُم عَذابًا مُهينًا
33.transliteration: Inna allatheena yuthoona Allaha warasoolahu laAAanahumu Allahu fee alddunya waalakhirati waaAAadda lahum AAathaban muheenan
33.translation: Lo! those who malign Allah and His messenger, Allah hath cursed them in the world and the Hereafter, and hath prepared for them the doom of the disdained

33.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يُؤذونَ المُؤمِنينَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتِ بِغَيرِ مَا اكتَسَبوا فَقَدِ احتَمَلوا بُهتٰنًا وَإِثمًا مُبينًا
33.transliteration: Waallatheena yuthoona almumineena waalmuminati bighayri ma iktasaboo faqadi ihtamaloo buhtanan waithman mubeenan
33.translation: And those who malign believing men and believing women undeservedly, they bear the guilt of slander and manifest sin

33.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ قُل لِأَزوٰجِكَ وَبَناتِكَ وَنِساءِ المُؤمِنينَ يُدنينَ عَلَيهِنَّ مِن جَلٰبيبِهِنَّ ذٰلِكَ أَدنىٰ أَن يُعرَفنَ فَلا يُؤذَينَ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا
33.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu qul liazwajika wabanatika wanisai almumineena yudneena AAalayhinna min jalabeebihinna thalika adna an yuAArafna fala yuthayna wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman
33.translation: O Prophet! Tell thy wives and thy daughters and the women of the believers to draw their cloaks close round them (when they go abroad). That will be better, so that they may be recognised and not annoyed. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

33.arabic: لَئِن لَم يَنتَهِ المُنٰفِقونَ وَالَّذينَ فى قُلوبِهِم مَرَضٌ وَالمُرجِفونَ فِى المَدينَةِ لَنُغرِيَنَّكَ بِهِم ثُمَّ لا يُجاوِرونَكَ فيها إِلّا قَليلًا
33.transliteration: Lain lam yantahi almunafiqoona waallatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalmurjifoona fee almadeenati lanughriyannaka bihim thumma la yujawiroonaka feeha illa qaleelan
33.translation: If the hypocrites, and those in whose hearts is a disease, and the alarmists in the city do not cease, We verily shall urge thee on against them, then they will be your neighbours in it but a little while

33.arabic: مَلعونينَ أَينَما ثُقِفوا أُخِذوا وَقُتِّلوا تَقتيلًا
33.transliteration: MalAAooneena aynama thuqifoo okhithoo waquttiloo taqteelan
33.translation: Accursed, they will be seized wherever found and slain with a (fierce) slaughter

33.arabic: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ فِى الَّذينَ خَلَوا مِن قَبلُ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبديلًا
33.transliteration: Sunnata Allahi fee allatheena khalaw min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan
33.translation: That was the way of Allah in the case of those who passed away of old; thou wilt not find for the way of Allah aught of power to change

33.arabic: يَسـَٔلُكَ النّاسُ عَنِ السّاعَةِ قُل إِنَّما عِلمُها عِندَ اللَّهِ وَما يُدريكَ لَعَلَّ السّاعَةَ تَكونُ قَريبًا
33.transliteration: Yasaluka alnnasu AAani alssaAAati qul innama AAilmuha AAinda Allahi wama yudreeka laAAalla alssaAAata takoonu qareeban
33.translation: Men ask thee of the Hour. Say: The knowledge of it is with Allah only. What can convey (the knowledge) unto thee? It may be that the Hour is nigh

33.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ الكٰفِرينَ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُم سَعيرًا
33.transliteration: Inna Allaha laAAana alkafireena waaAAadda lahum saAAeeran
33.translation: Lo! Allah hath cursed the disbelievers, and hath prepared for them a flaming fire

33.arabic: خٰلِدينَ فيها أَبَدًا لا يَجِدونَ وَلِيًّا وَلا نَصيرًا
33.transliteration: Khalideena feeha abadan la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseeran
33.translation: Wherein they will abide for ever. They will find (then) no protecting friend nor helper

33.arabic: يَومَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجوهُهُم فِى النّارِ يَقولونَ يٰلَيتَنا أَطَعنَا اللَّهَ وَأَطَعنَا الرَّسولا۠
33.transliteration: Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fee alnnari yaqooloona ya laytana ataAAna Allaha waataAAna alrrasoola
33.translation: On the day when their faces are turned over in the Fire, they say: Oh, would that we had obeyed Allah and had obeyed His messenger

33.arabic: وَقالوا رَبَّنا إِنّا أَطَعنا سادَتَنا وَكُبَراءَنا فَأَضَلّونَا السَّبيلا۠
33.transliteration: Waqaloo rabbana inna ataAAna sadatana wakubaraana faadalloona alssabeela
33.translation: And they say: Our Lord! Lo! we obeyed our princes and great men, and they misled us from the Way

33.arabic: رَبَّنا ءاتِهِم ضِعفَينِ مِنَ العَذابِ وَالعَنهُم لَعنًا كَبيرًا
33.transliteration: Rabbana atihim diAAfayni mina alAAathabi wailAAanhum laAAnan kabeeran
33.translation: Our Lord! Oh, give them double torment and curse them with a mighty curse

33.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تَكونوا كَالَّذينَ ءاذَوا موسىٰ فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمّا قالوا وَكانَ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَجيهًا
33.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la takoonoo kaallatheena athaw moosa fabarraahu Allahu mimma qaloo wakana AAinda Allahi wajeehan
33.translation: O ye who believe! Be not as those who slandered Moses, but Allah proved his innocence of that which they alleged, and he was well esteemed in Allah's sight

33.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَقولوا قَولًا سَديدًا
33.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waqooloo qawlan sadeedan
33.translation: O ye who believe! Guard your duty to Allah, and speak words straight to the point

33.arabic: يُصلِح لَكُم أَعمٰلَكُم وَيَغفِر لَكُم ذُنوبَكُم وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ فَقَد فازَ فَوزًا عَظيمًا
33.transliteration: Yuslih lakum aAAmalakum wayaghfir lakum thunoobakum waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu faqad faza fawzan AAatheeman
33.translation: He will adjust your works for you and will forgive you your sins. Whosoever obeyeth Allah and His messenger, he verily hath gained a signal victory

33.arabic: إِنّا عَرَضنَا الأَمانَةَ عَلَى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَالجِبالِ فَأَبَينَ أَن يَحمِلنَها وَأَشفَقنَ مِنها وَحَمَلَهَا الإِنسٰنُ إِنَّهُ كانَ ظَلومًا جَهولًا
33.transliteration: Inna AAaradna alamanata AAala alssamawati waalardi waaljibali faabayna an yahmilnaha waashfaqna minha wahamalaha alinsanu innahu kana thalooman jahoolan
33.translation: Lo! We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the hills, but they shrank from bearing it and were afraid of it. And man assumed it. Lo! he hath proved a tyrant and a fool

33.arabic: لِيُعَذِّبَ اللَّهُ المُنٰفِقينَ وَالمُنٰفِقٰتِ وَالمُشرِكينَ وَالمُشرِكٰتِ وَيَتوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَى المُؤمِنينَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتِ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا
33.transliteration: LiyuAAaththiba Allahu almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati waalmushrikeena waalmushrikati wayatooba Allahu AAala almumineena waalmuminati wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman
33.translation: So Allah punisheth hypocritical men and hypocritical women, and idolatrous men and idolatrous women. But Allah pardoneth believing men and believing women, and Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

34.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذى لَهُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ وَلَهُ الحَمدُ فِى الءاخِرَةِ وَهُوَ الحَكيمُ الخَبيرُ
34.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi walahu alhamdu fee alakhirati wahuwa alhakeemu alkhabeeru
34.translation: Praise be to Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. His is the praise in the Hereafter, and He is the Wise, the Aware

34.arabic: يَعلَمُ ما يَلِجُ فِى الأَرضِ وَما يَخرُجُ مِنها وَما يَنزِلُ مِنَ السَّماءِ وَما يَعرُجُ فيها وَهُوَ الرَّحيمُ الغَفورُ
34.transliteration: YaAAlamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina alssamai wama yaAAruju feeha wahuwa alrraheemu alghafooru
34.translation: He knoweth that which goeth into the earth and that which cometh forth from it, and that descendeth from the heaven and that which ascendeth into it. He is the Merciful, the Forgiving

34.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لا تَأتينَا السّاعَةُ قُل بَلىٰ وَرَبّى لَتَأتِيَنَّكُم عٰلِمِ الغَيبِ لا يَعزُبُ عَنهُ مِثقالُ ذَرَّةٍ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلا فِى الأَرضِ وَلا أَصغَرُ مِن ذٰلِكَ وَلا أَكبَرُ إِلّا فى كِتٰبٍ مُبينٍ
34.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo la tateena alssaAAatu qul bala warabbee latatiyannakum AAalimi alghaybi la yaAAzubu AAanhu mithqalu tharratin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi wala asgharu min thalika wala akbaru illa fee kitabin mubeenin
34.translation: Those who disbelieve say: The Hour will never come unto us. Say: Nay, by my Lord, but it is coming unto you surely. (He is) the Knower of the Unseen. Not an atom's weight, or less than that or greater, escapeth Him in the heavens or in the earth, but it is in a clear Record

34.arabic: لِيَجزِىَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ أُولٰئِكَ لَهُم مَغفِرَةٌ وَرِزقٌ كَريمٌ
34.transliteration: Liyajziya allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun
34.translation: That He may reward those who believe and do good works. For them is pardon and a rich provision

34.arabic: وَالَّذينَ سَعَو فى ءايٰتِنا مُعٰجِزينَ أُولٰئِكَ لَهُم عَذابٌ مِن رِجزٍ أَليمٌ
34.transliteration: Waallatheena saAAaw fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika lahum AAathabun min rijzin aleemin
34.translation: But those who strive against Our revelations, challenging (Us), theirs will be a painful doom of wrath

34.arabic: وَيَرَى الَّذينَ أوتُوا العِلمَ الَّذى أُنزِلَ إِلَيكَ مِن رَبِّكَ هُوَ الحَقَّ وَيَهدى إِلىٰ صِرٰطِ العَزيزِ الحَميدِ
34.transliteration: Wayara allatheena ootoo alAAilma allathee onzila ilayka min rabbika huwa alhaqqa wayahdee ila sirati alAAazeezi alhameedi
34.translation: Those who have been given knowledge see that what is revealed unto thee from thy Lord is the truth and leadeth unto the path of the Mighty, the Owner of Praise

34.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا هَل نَدُلُّكُم عَلىٰ رَجُلٍ يُنَبِّئُكُم إِذا مُزِّقتُم كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّكُم لَفى خَلقٍ جَديدٍ
34.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo hal nadullukum AAala rajulin yunabbiokum itha muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeedin
34.translation: Those who disbelieve say: Shall we show you a man who will tell you (that) when ye have become dispersed in dust with most complete dispersal still, even then, ye will be created anew

34.arabic: أَفتَرىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا أَم بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلِ الَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِالءاخِرَةِ فِى العَذابِ وَالضَّلٰلِ البَعيدِ
34.transliteration: Aftara AAala Allahi kathiban am bihi jinnatun bali allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati fee alAAathabi waalddalali albaAAeedi
34.translation: Hath he invented a lie concerning Allah, or is there in him a madness? Nay, but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are in torment and far error

34.arabic: أَفَلَم يَرَوا إِلىٰ ما بَينَ أَيديهِم وَما خَلفَهُم مِنَ السَّماءِ وَالأَرضِ إِن نَشَأ نَخسِف بِهِمُ الأَرضَ أَو نُسقِط عَلَيهِم كِسَفًا مِنَ السَّماءِ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايَةً لِكُلِّ عَبدٍ مُنيبٍ
34.transliteration: Afalam yaraw ila ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum mina alssamai waalardi in nasha nakhsif bihimu alarda aw nusqit AAalayhim kisafan mina alssamai inna fee thalika laayatan likulli AAabdin muneebin
34.translation: Have they not observed what is before them and what is behind them of the sky and the earth? If We will, We can make the earth swallow them, or cause obliteration from the sky to fall on them. Lo! herein surely is a portent for every slave who turneth (to Allah) repentant

34.arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا داوۥدَ مِنّا فَضلًا يٰجِبالُ أَوِّبى مَعَهُ وَالطَّيرَ وَأَلَنّا لَهُ الحَديدَ
34.transliteration: Walaqad atayna dawooda minna fadlan ya jibalu awwibee maAAahu waalttayra waalanna lahu alhadeeda
34.translation: And assuredly We gave David grace from Us, (saying): O ye hills and birds, echo his psalms of praise! And We made the iron supple unto him

34.arabic: أَنِ اعمَل سٰبِغٰتٍ وَقَدِّر فِى السَّردِ وَاعمَلوا صٰلِحًا إِنّى بِما تَعمَلونَ بَصيرٌ
34.transliteration: Ani iAAmal sabighatin waqaddir fee alssardi waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona baseerun
34.translation: Saying: Make thou long coats of mail and measure the links (thereof). And do ye right. Lo! I am Seer of what ye do

34.arabic: وَلِسُلَيمٰنَ الرّيحَ غُدُوُّها شَهرٌ وَرَواحُها شَهرٌ وَأَسَلنا لَهُ عَينَ القِطرِ وَمِنَ الجِنِّ مَن يَعمَلُ بَينَ يَدَيهِ بِإِذنِ رَبِّهِ وَمَن يَزِغ مِنهُم عَن أَمرِنا نُذِقهُ مِن عَذابِ السَّعيرِ
34.transliteration: Walisulaymana alrreeha ghuduwwuha shahrun warawahuha shahrun waasalna lahu AAayna alqitri wamina aljinni man yaAAmalu bayna yadayhi biithni rabbihi waman yazigh minhum AAan amrina nuthiqhu min AAathabi alssaAAeeri
34.translation: And unto Solomon (We gave) the wind, whereof the morning course was a month's journey and the evening course a month's journey, and We caused the fount of copper to gush forth for him, and (We gave him) certain of the jinn who worked before him by permission of his Lord. And such of them as deviated from Our command, them We caused to taste the punishment of flaming Fire

34.arabic: يَعمَلونَ لَهُ ما يَشاءُ مِن مَحٰريبَ وَتَمٰثيلَ وَجِفانٍ كَالجَوابِ وَقُدورٍ راسِيٰتٍ اعمَلوا ءالَ داوۥدَ شُكرًا وَقَليلٌ مِن عِبادِىَ الشَّكورُ
34.transliteration: YaAAmaloona lahu ma yashao min mahareeba watamatheela wajifanin kaaljawabi waqudoorin rasiyatin iAAmaloo ala dawooda shukran waqaleelun min AAibadiya alshshakooru
34.translation: They made for him what he willed: synagogues and statues, basins like wells and boilers built into the ground. Give thanks, O House of David! Few of My bondmen are thankful

34.arabic: فَلَمّا قَضَينا عَلَيهِ المَوتَ ما دَلَّهُم عَلىٰ مَوتِهِ إِلّا دابَّةُ الأَرضِ تَأكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُ فَلَمّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ الجِنُّ أَن لَو كانوا يَعلَمونَ الغَيبَ ما لَبِثوا فِى العَذابِ المُهينِ
34.transliteration: Falamma qadayna AAalayhi almawta ma dallahum AAala mawtihi illa dabbatu alardi takulu minsaatahu falamma kharra tabayyanati aljinnu an law kanoo yaAAlamoona alghayba ma labithoo fee alAAathabi almuheeni
34.translation: And when We decreed death for him, nothing showed his death to them save a creeping creature of the earth which gnawed away his staff. And when he fell the jinn saw clearly how, if they had known the Unseen, they would not have continued in despised toil

34.arabic: لَقَد كانَ لِسَبَإٍ فى مَسكَنِهِم ءايَةٌ جَنَّتانِ عَن يَمينٍ وَشِمالٍ كُلوا مِن رِزقِ رَبِّكُم وَاشكُروا لَهُ بَلدَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ وَرَبٌّ غَفورٌ
34.transliteration: Laqad kana lisabain fee maskanihim ayatun jannatani AAan yameenin washimalin kuloo min rizqi rabbikum waoshkuroo lahu baldatun tayyibatun warabbun ghafoorun
34.translation: There was indeed a sign for Sheba in their dwelling-place: Two gardens on the right hand and the left (as who should say): Eat of the provision of your Lord and render thanks to Him. A fair land and an indulgent Lord

34.arabic: فَأَعرَضوا فَأَرسَلنا عَلَيهِم سَيلَ العَرِمِ وَبَدَّلنٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيهِم جَنَّتَينِ ذَواتَى أُكُلٍ خَمطٍ وَأَثلٍ وَشَيءٍ مِن سِدرٍ قَليلٍ
34.transliteration: FaaAAradoo faarsalna AAalayhim sayla alAAarimi wabaddalnahum bijannatayhim jannatayni thawatay okulin khamtin waathlin washayin min sidrin qaleelin
34.translation: But they were froward, so We sent on them the flood of 'Iram, and in exchange for their two gardens gave them two gardens bearing bitter fruit, the tamarisk and here and there a lote-tree

34.arabic: ذٰلِكَ جَزَينٰهُم بِما كَفَروا وَهَل نُجٰزى إِلَّا الكَفورَ
34.transliteration: Thalika jazaynahum bima kafaroo wahal nujazee illa alkafoora
34.translation: This We awarded them because of their ingratitude. Punish We ever any save the ingrates

34.arabic: وَجَعَلنا بَينَهُم وَبَينَ القُرَى الَّتى بٰرَكنا فيها قُرًى ظٰهِرَةً وَقَدَّرنا فيهَا السَّيرَ سيروا فيها لَيالِىَ وَأَيّامًا ءامِنينَ
34.transliteration: WajaAAalna baynahum wabayna alqura allatee barakna feeha quran thahiratan waqaddarna feeha alssayra seeroo feeha layaliya waayyaman amineena
34.translation: And We set, between them and the towns which We had blessed, towns easy to be seen, and We made the stage between them easy, (saying): Travel in them safely both by night and day

34.arabic: فَقالوا رَبَّنا بٰعِد بَينَ أَسفارِنا وَظَلَموا أَنفُسَهُم فَجَعَلنٰهُم أَحاديثَ وَمَزَّقنٰهُم كُلَّ مُمَزَّقٍ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِكُلِّ صَبّارٍ شَكورٍ
34.transliteration: Faqaloo rabbana baAAid bayna asfarina wathalamoo anfusahum fajaAAalnahum ahadeetha wamazzaqnahum kulla mumazzaqin inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin
34.translation: But they said: Our Lord! Make the stage between our journeys longer. And they wronged themselves, therefore We made them bywords (in the land) and scattered them abroad, a total scattering. Lo! herein verily are portents for each steadfast, grateful (heart)

34.arabic: وَلَقَد صَدَّقَ عَلَيهِم إِبليسُ ظَنَّهُ فَاتَّبَعوهُ إِلّا فَريقًا مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
34.transliteration: Walaqad saddaqa AAalayhim ibleesu thannahu faittabaAAoohu illa fareeqan mina almumineena
34.translation: And Satan indeed found his calculation true concerning them, for they follow him, all save a group of true believers

34.arabic: وَما كانَ لَهُ عَلَيهِم مِن سُلطٰنٍ إِلّا لِنَعلَمَ مَن يُؤمِنُ بِالءاخِرَةِ مِمَّن هُوَ مِنها فى شَكٍّ وَرَبُّكَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ حَفيظٌ
34.transliteration: Wama kana lahu AAalayhim min sultanin illa linaAAlama man yuminu bialakhirati mimman huwa minha fee shakkin warabbuka AAala kulli shayin hafeethun
34.translation: And he had no warrant whatsoever against them, save that We would know him who believeth in the Hereafter from him who is in doubt thereof; and thy Lord (O Muhammad) taketh note of all things

34.arabic: قُلِ ادعُوا الَّذينَ زَعَمتُم مِن دونِ اللَّهِ لا يَملِكونَ مِثقالَ ذَرَّةٍ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلا فِى الأَرضِ وَما لَهُم فيهِما مِن شِركٍ وَما لَهُ مِنهُم مِن ظَهيرٍ
34.transliteration: Quli odAAoo allatheena zaAAamtum min dooni Allahi la yamlikoona mithqala tharratin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi wama lahum feehima min shirkin wama lahu minhum min thaheerin
34.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Call upon those whom ye set up beside Allah! They possess not an atom's weight either in the heavens or in the earth, nor have they any share in either, nor hath He an auxiliary among them

34.arabic: وَلا تَنفَعُ الشَّفٰعَةُ عِندَهُ إِلّا لِمَن أَذِنَ لَهُ حَتّىٰ إِذا فُزِّعَ عَن قُلوبِهِم قالوا ماذا قالَ رَبُّكُم قالُوا الحَقَّ وَهُوَ العَلِىُّ الكَبيرُ
34.transliteration: Wala tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu AAindahu illa liman athina lahu hatta itha fuzziAAa AAan quloobihim qaloo matha qala rabbukum qaloo alhaqqa wahuwa alAAaliyyu alkabeeru
34.translation: No intercession availeth with Him save for him whom He permitteth. Yet, when fear is banished from their hearts, they say: What was it that your Lord said? They say: The Truth. And He is the Sublime, the Great

34.arabic: قُل مَن يَرزُقُكُم مِنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ قُلِ اللَّهُ وَإِنّا أَو إِيّاكُم لَعَلىٰ هُدًى أَو فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
34.transliteration: Qul man yarzuqukum mina alssamawati waalardi quli Allahu wainna aw iyyakum laAAala hudan aw fee dalalin mubeenin
34.translation: Say: Who giveth you provision from the sky and the earth? Say: Allah, Lo! we or you assuredly are rightly guided or in error manifest

34.arabic: قُل لا تُسـَٔلونَ عَمّا أَجرَمنا وَلا نُسـَٔلُ عَمّا تَعمَلونَ
34.transliteration: Qul la tusaloona AAamma ajramna wala nusalu AAamma taAAmaloona
34.translation: Say: Ye will not be asked of what we committed, nor shall we be asked of what ye do

34.arabic: قُل يَجمَعُ بَينَنا رَبُّنا ثُمَّ يَفتَحُ بَينَنا بِالحَقِّ وَهُوَ الفَتّاحُ العَليمُ
34.transliteration: Qul yajmaAAu baynana rabbuna thumma yaftahu baynana bialhaqqi wahuwa alfattahu alAAaleemu
34.translation: Say: Our Lord will bring us all together, then He will judge between us with truth. He is the All-knowing Judge

34.arabic: قُل أَرونِىَ الَّذينَ أَلحَقتُم بِهِ شُرَكاءَ كَلّا بَل هُوَ اللَّهُ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
34.transliteration: Qul arooniya allatheena alhaqtum bihi shurakaa kalla bal huwa Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu
34.translation: Say: Show me those whom ye have joined unto Him as partners. Nay (ye dare not)! For He is Allah, the Mighty, the Wise

34.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنٰكَ إِلّا كافَّةً لِلنّاسِ بَشيرًا وَنَذيرًا وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَعلَمونَ
34.transliteration: Wama arsalnaka illa kaffatan lilnnasi basheeran wanatheeran walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona
34.translation: And We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) save as a bringer of good tidings and a warner unto all mankind; but most of mankind know not

34.arabic: وَيَقولونَ مَتىٰ هٰذَا الوَعدُ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
34.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
34.translation: And they say: When is this promise (to be fulfilled) if ye are truthful

34.arabic: قُل لَكُم ميعادُ يَومٍ لا تَستَـٔخِرونَ عَنهُ ساعَةً وَلا تَستَقدِمونَ
34.transliteration: Qul lakum meeAAadu yawmin la tastakhiroona AAanhu saAAatan wala tastaqdimoona
34.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Yours is the promise of a Day which ye cannot postpone nor hasten by an hour

34.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لَن نُؤمِنَ بِهٰذَا القُرءانِ وَلا بِالَّذى بَينَ يَدَيهِ وَلَو تَرىٰ إِذِ الظّٰلِمونَ مَوقوفونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِم يَرجِعُ بَعضُهُم إِلىٰ بَعضٍ القَولَ يَقولُ الَّذينَ استُضعِفوا لِلَّذينَ استَكبَروا لَولا أَنتُم لَكُنّا مُؤمِنينَ
34.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lan numina bihatha alqurani wala biallathee bayna yadayhi walaw tara ithi alththalimoona mawqoofoona AAinda rabbihim yarjiAAu baAAduhum ila baAAdin alqawla yaqoolu allatheena istudAAifoo lillatheena istakbaroo lawla antum lakunna mumineena
34.translation: And those who disbelieve say: We believe not in this Qur'an nor in that which was before it; but oh, if thou couldst see, when the wrong-doers are brought up before their Lord, how they cast the blame one to another; how those who were despised (in the earth) say unto those who were proud: But for you, we should have been believers

34.arabic: قالَ الَّذينَ استَكبَروا لِلَّذينَ استُضعِفوا أَنَحنُ صَدَدنٰكُم عَنِ الهُدىٰ بَعدَ إِذ جاءَكُم بَل كُنتُم مُجرِمينَ
34.transliteration: Qala allatheena istakbaroo lillatheena istudAAifoo anahnu sadadnakum AAani alhuda baAAda ith jaakum bal kuntum mujrimeena
34.translation: Those who were proud say unto those who were despised: Did we drive you away from the guidance after it had come unto you? Nay, but ye were guilty

34.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ استُضعِفوا لِلَّذينَ استَكبَروا بَل مَكرُ الَّيلِ وَالنَّهارِ إِذ تَأمُرونَنا أَن نَكفُرَ بِاللَّهِ وَنَجعَلَ لَهُ أَندادًا وَأَسَرُّوا النَّدامَةَ لَمّا رَأَوُا العَذابَ وَجَعَلنَا الأَغلٰلَ فى أَعناقِ الَّذينَ كَفَروا هَل يُجزَونَ إِلّا ما كانوا يَعمَلونَ
34.transliteration: Waqala allatheena istudAAifoo lillatheena istakbaroo bal makru allayli waalnnahari ith tamuroonana an nakfura biAllahi wanajAAala lahu andadan waasarroo alnnadamata lamma raawoo alAAathaba wajaAAalna alaghlala fee aAAnaqi allatheena kafaroo hal yujzawna illa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona
34.translation: Those who were despised say unto those who were proud: Nay but (it was your) scheming night and day, when ye commanded us to disbelieve in Allah and set up rivals unto Him. And they are filled with remorse when they behold the doom; and We place carcans on the necks of those who disbelieved. Are they requited aught save what they used to do

34.arabic: وَما أَرسَلنا فى قَريَةٍ مِن نَذيرٍ إِلّا قالَ مُترَفوها إِنّا بِما أُرسِلتُم بِهِ كٰفِرونَ
34.transliteration: Wama arsalna fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona
34.translation: And We sent not unto any township a warner, but its pampered ones declared: Lo! we are disbelievers in that wherewith ye have been sent

34.arabic: وَقالوا نَحنُ أَكثَرُ أَموٰلًا وَأَولٰدًا وَما نَحنُ بِمُعَذَّبينَ
34.transliteration: Waqaloo nahnu aktharu amwalan waawladan wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena
34.translation: And they say: We are more (than you) in wealth and children. We are not the punished

34.arabic: قُل إِنَّ رَبّى يَبسُطُ الرِّزقَ لِمَن يَشاءُ وَيَقدِرُ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَعلَمونَ
34.transliteration: Qul inna rabbee yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona
34.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will and narroweth it (for whom He will). But most of mankind know not

34.arabic: وَما أَموٰلُكُم وَلا أَولٰدُكُم بِالَّتى تُقَرِّبُكُم عِندَنا زُلفىٰ إِلّا مَن ءامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صٰلِحًا فَأُولٰئِكَ لَهُم جَزاءُ الضِّعفِ بِما عَمِلوا وَهُم فِى الغُرُفٰتِ ءامِنونَ
34.transliteration: Wama amwalukum wala awladukum biallatee tuqarribukum AAindana zulfa illa man amana waAAamila salihan faolaika lahum jazao alddiAAfi bima AAamiloo wahum fee alghurufati aminoona
34.translation: And it is not your wealth nor your children that will bring you near unto Us, but he who believeth and doeth good (he draweth near). As for such, theirs will be twofold reward for what they did and they will dwell secure in lofty halls

34.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يَسعَونَ فى ءايٰتِنا مُعٰجِزينَ أُولٰئِكَ فِى العَذابِ مُحضَرونَ
34.transliteration: Waallatheena yasAAawna fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika fee alAAathabi muhdaroona
34.translation: And as for those who strive against Our revelations, challenging, they will be brought to the doom

34.arabic: قُل إِنَّ رَبّى يَبسُطُ الرِّزقَ لِمَن يَشاءُ مِن عِبادِهِ وَيَقدِرُ لَهُ وَما أَنفَقتُم مِن شَيءٍ فَهُوَ يُخلِفُهُ وَهُوَ خَيرُ الرّٰزِقينَ
34.transliteration: Qul inna rabbee yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao min AAibadihi wayaqdiru lahu wama anfaqtum min shayin fahuwa yukhlifuhu wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena
34.translation: Say: Lo! my Lord enlargeth the provision for whom He will of His bondmen, and narroweth (it) for him. And whatsoever ye spend (for good) He replaceth it. And He is the Best of Providers

34.arabic: وَيَومَ يَحشُرُهُم جَميعًا ثُمَّ يَقولُ لِلمَلٰئِكَةِ أَهٰؤُلاءِ إِيّاكُم كانوا يَعبُدونَ
34.transliteration: Wayawma yahshuruhum jameeAAan thumma yaqoolu lilmalaikati ahaolai iyyakum kanoo yaAAbudoona
34.translation: And on the day when He will gather them all together, He will say unto the angels: Did these worship you

34.arabic: قالوا سُبحٰنَكَ أَنتَ وَلِيُّنا مِن دونِهِم بَل كانوا يَعبُدونَ الجِنَّ أَكثَرُهُم بِهِم مُؤمِنونَ
34.transliteration: Qaloo subhanaka anta waliyyuna min doonihim bal kanoo yaAAbudoona aljinna aktharuhum bihim muminoona
34.translation: They will say: Be Thou Glorified. Thou (alone) art our Guardian, not them! Nay, but they worshipped the jinn; most of them were believers in them

34.arabic: فَاليَومَ لا يَملِكُ بَعضُكُم لِبَعضٍ نَفعًا وَلا ضَرًّا وَنَقولُ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا ذوقوا عَذابَ النّارِ الَّتى كُنتُم بِها تُكَذِّبونَ
34.transliteration: Faalyawma la yamliku baAAdukum libaAAdin nafAAan wala darran wanaqoolu lillatheena thalamoo thooqoo AAathaba alnnari allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona
34.translation: That day ye will possess no use nor hurt one for another. And We shall say unto those who did wrong: Taste the doom of the Fire which ye used to deny

34.arabic: وَإِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتُنا بَيِّنٰتٍ قالوا ما هٰذا إِلّا رَجُلٌ يُريدُ أَن يَصُدَّكُم عَمّا كانَ يَعبُدُ ءاباؤُكُم وَقالوا ما هٰذا إِلّا إِفكٌ مُفتَرًى وَقالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لِلحَقِّ لَمّا جاءَهُم إِن هٰذا إِلّا سِحرٌ مُبينٌ
34.transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qaloo ma hatha illa rajulun yureedu an yasuddakum AAamma kana yaAAbudu abaokum waqaloo ma hatha illa ifkun muftaran waqala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun
34.translation: And if Our revelations are recited unto them in plain terms, they say: This is naught else than a man who would turn you away from what your fathers used to worship; and they say: This is naught else than an invented lie. Those who disbelieve say of the truth when it reacheth them: This is naught else than mere magic

34.arabic: وَما ءاتَينٰهُم مِن كُتُبٍ يَدرُسونَها وَما أَرسَلنا إِلَيهِم قَبلَكَ مِن نَذيرٍ
34.transliteration: Wama ataynahum min kutubin yadrusoonaha wama arsalna ilayhim qablaka min natheerin
34.translation: And We have given them no scriptures which they study, nor sent We unto them, before thee, any warner

34.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم وَما بَلَغوا مِعشارَ ما ءاتَينٰهُم فَكَذَّبوا رُسُلى فَكَيفَ كانَ نَكيرِ
34.transliteration: Wakaththaba allatheena min qablihim wama balaghoo miAAshara ma ataynahum fakaththaboo rusulee fakayfa kana nakeeri
34.translation: Those before them denied, and these have not attained a tithe of that which We bestowed on them (of old); yet they denied My messengers. How intense then was My abhorrence (of them)

34.arabic: قُل إِنَّما أَعِظُكُم بِوٰحِدَةٍ أَن تَقوموا لِلَّهِ مَثنىٰ وَفُرٰدىٰ ثُمَّ تَتَفَكَّروا ما بِصاحِبِكُم مِن جِنَّةٍ إِن هُوَ إِلّا نَذيرٌ لَكُم بَينَ يَدَى عَذابٍ شَديدٍ
34.transliteration: Qul innama aAAithukum biwahidatin an taqoomoo lillahi mathna wafurada thumma tatafakkaroo ma bisahibikum min jinnatin in huwa illa natheerun lakum bayna yaday AAathabin shadeedin
34.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I exhort you unto one thing only: that ye awake, for Allah's sake, by twos and singly, and then reflect: There is no madness in your comrade. He is naught else than a warner unto you in face of a terrific doom

34.arabic: قُل ما سَأَلتُكُم مِن أَجرٍ فَهُوَ لَكُم إِن أَجرِىَ إِلّا عَلَى اللَّهِ وَهُوَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ شَهيدٌ
34.transliteration: Qul ma saaltukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum in ajriya illa AAala Allahi wahuwa AAala kulli shayin shaheedun
34.translation: Say: Whatever reward I might have asked of you is yours. My reward is the affair of Allah only. He is Witness over all things

34.arabic: قُل إِنَّ رَبّى يَقذِفُ بِالحَقِّ عَلّٰمُ الغُيوبِ
34.transliteration: Qul inna rabbee yaqthifu bialhaqqi AAallamu alghuyoobi
34.translation: Say: Lo! my Lord hurleth the truth. (He is) the Knower of Things Hidden

34.arabic: قُل جاءَ الحَقُّ وَما يُبدِئُ البٰطِلُ وَما يُعيدُ
34.transliteration: Qul jaa alhaqqu wama yubdio albatilu wama yuAAeedu
34.translation: Say: The Truth hath come, and falsehood showeth not its face and will not return

34.arabic: قُل إِن ضَلَلتُ فَإِنَّما أَضِلُّ عَلىٰ نَفسى وَإِنِ اهتَدَيتُ فَبِما يوحى إِلَىَّ رَبّى إِنَّهُ سَميعٌ قَريبٌ
34.transliteration: Qul in dalaltu fainnama adillu AAala nafsee waini ihtadaytu fabima yoohee ilayya rabbee innahu sameeAAun qareebun
34.translation: Say: If I err, I err only to my own loss, and if I am rightly guided it is because of that which my Lord hath revealed unto me. Lo! He is Hearer, Nigh

34.arabic: وَلَو تَرىٰ إِذ فَزِعوا فَلا فَوتَ وَأُخِذوا مِن مَكانٍ قَريبٍ
34.transliteration: Walaw tara ith faziAAoo fala fawta waokhithoo min makanin qareebin
34.translation: Couldst thou but see when they are terrified with no escape, and are seized from near at hand

34.arabic: وَقالوا ءامَنّا بِهِ وَأَنّىٰ لَهُمُ التَّناوُشُ مِن مَكانٍ بَعيدٍ
34.transliteration: Waqaloo amanna bihi waanna lahumu alttanawushu min makanin baAAeedin
34.translation: And say: We (now) believe therein. But how can they reach (faith) from afar off

34.arabic: وَقَد كَفَروا بِهِ مِن قَبلُ وَيَقذِفونَ بِالغَيبِ مِن مَكانٍ بَعيدٍ
34.transliteration: Waqad kafaroo bihi min qablu wayaqthifoona bialghaybi min makanin baAAeedin
34.translation: When they disbelieved in it of yore. They aim at the unseen from afar off

34.arabic: وَحيلَ بَينَهُم وَبَينَ ما يَشتَهونَ كَما فُعِلَ بِأَشياعِهِم مِن قَبلُ إِنَّهُم كانوا فى شَكٍّ مُريبٍ
34.transliteration: Waheela baynahum wabayna ma yashtahoona kama fuAAila biashyaAAihim min qablu innahum kanoo fee shakkin mureebin
34.translation: And a gulf is set between them and that which they desire, as was done for people of their kind of old. Lo! they were in hopeless doubt

35.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ فاطِرِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ جاعِلِ المَلٰئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُولى أَجنِحَةٍ مَثنىٰ وَثُلٰثَ وَرُبٰعَ يَزيدُ فِى الخَلقِ ما يَشاءُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
35.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi fatiri alssamawati waalardi jaAAili almalaikati rusulan olee ajnihatin mathna wathulatha warubaAAa yazeedu fee alkhalqi ma yashao inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
35.translation: Praise be to Allah, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, Who appointeth the angels messengers having wings two, three and four. He multiplieth in creation what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things

35.arabic: ما يَفتَحِ اللَّهُ لِلنّاسِ مِن رَحمَةٍ فَلا مُمسِكَ لَها وَما يُمسِك فَلا مُرسِلَ لَهُ مِن بَعدِهِ وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
35.transliteration: Ma yaftahi Allahu lilnnasi min rahmatin fala mumsika laha wama yumsik fala mursila lahu min baAAdihi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
35.translation: That which Allah openeth unto mankind of mercy none can withhold it; and that which He withholdeth none can release thereafter. He is the Mighty, the Wise

35.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ اذكُروا نِعمَتَ اللَّهِ عَلَيكُم هَل مِن خٰلِقٍ غَيرُ اللَّهِ يَرزُقُكُم مِنَ السَّماءِ وَالأَرضِ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ فَأَنّىٰ تُؤفَكونَ
35.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum hal min khaliqin ghayru Allahi yarzuqukum mina alssamai waalardi la ilaha illa huwa faanna tufakoona
35.translation: O mankind! Remember Allah's grace toward you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provideth for you from the sky and the earth? There is no Allah save Him. Whither then are ye turned

35.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبوكَ فَقَد كُذِّبَت رُسُلٌ مِن قَبلِكَ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرجَعُ الأُمورُ
35.transliteration: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kuththibat rusulun min qablika waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru
35.translation: And if they deny thee, (O Muhammad), messengers (of Allah) were denied before thee. Unto Allah all things are brought back

35.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ إِنَّ وَعدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَلا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ الحَيوٰةُ الدُّنيا وَلا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِاللَّهِ الغَرورُ
35.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fala taghurrannakumu alhayatu alddunya wala yaghurrannakum biAllahi algharooru
35.translation: O mankind! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. So let not the life of the world beguile you, and let not the (avowed) beguiler beguile you with regard to Allah

35.arabic: إِنَّ الشَّيطٰنَ لَكُم عَدُوٌّ فَاتَّخِذوهُ عَدُوًّا إِنَّما يَدعوا حِزبَهُ لِيَكونوا مِن أَصحٰبِ السَّعيرِ
35.transliteration: Inna alshshaytana lakum AAaduwwun faittakhithoohu AAaduwwan innama yadAAoo hizbahu liyakoonoo min ashabi alssaAAeeri
35.translation: Lo! the devil is an enemy for you, so treat him as an enemy. He only summoneth his faction to be owners of the flaming Fire

35.arabic: الَّذينَ كَفَروا لَهُم عَذابٌ شَديدٌ وَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُم مَغفِرَةٌ وَأَجرٌ كَبيرٌ
35.transliteration: Allatheena kafaroo lahum AAathabun shadeedun waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun
35.translation: Those who disbelieve, theirs will be an awful doom; and those who believe and do good works, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward

35.arabic: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سوءُ عَمَلِهِ فَرَءاهُ حَسَنًا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشاءُ وَيَهدى مَن يَشاءُ فَلا تَذهَب نَفسُكَ عَلَيهِم حَسَرٰتٍ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَليمٌ بِما يَصنَعونَ
35.transliteration: Afaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi faraahu hasanan fainna Allaha yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao fala tathhab nafsuka AAalayhim hasaratin inna Allaha AAaleemun bima yasnaAAoona
35.translation: Is he, the evil of whose deeds is made fairseeming unto him so that he deemeth it good, (other than Satan's dupe)? Allah verily sendeth whom He will astray, and guideth whom He will; so let not thy soul expire in sighings for them. Lo! Allah is Aware of what they do

35.arabic: وَاللَّهُ الَّذى أَرسَلَ الرِّيٰحَ فَتُثيرُ سَحابًا فَسُقنٰهُ إِلىٰ بَلَدٍ مَيِّتٍ فَأَحيَينا بِهِ الأَرضَ بَعدَ مَوتِها كَذٰلِكَ النُّشورُ
35.transliteration: WaAllahu allathee arsala alrriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fasuqnahu ila baladin mayyitin faahyayna bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha kathalika alnnushooru
35.translation: And Allah it is Who sendeth the winds and they raise a cloud; then We lead it unto a dead land and revive therewith the earth after its death. Such is the Resurrection

35.arabic: مَن كانَ يُريدُ العِزَّةَ فَلِلَّهِ العِزَّةُ جَميعًا إِلَيهِ يَصعَدُ الكَلِمُ الطَّيِّبُ وَالعَمَلُ الصّٰلِحُ يَرفَعُهُ وَالَّذينَ يَمكُرونَ السَّيِّـٔاتِ لَهُم عَذابٌ شَديدٌ وَمَكرُ أُولٰئِكَ هُوَ يَبورُ
35.transliteration: Man kana yureedu alAAizzata falillahi alAAizzatu jameeAAan ilayhi yasAAadu alkalimu alttayyibu waalAAamalu alssalihu yarfaAAuhu waallatheena yamkuroona alssayyiati lahum AAathabun shadeedun wamakru olaika huwa yabooru
35.translation: Whoso desireth power (should know that) all power belongeth to Allah. Unto Him good words ascend, and the pious deed doth He exalt; but those who plot iniquities, theirs will be an awful doom; and the plotting of such (folk) will come to naught

35.arabic: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِن تُرابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُطفَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُم أَزوٰجًا وَما تَحمِلُ مِن أُنثىٰ وَلا تَضَعُ إِلّا بِعِلمِهِ وَما يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُعَمَّرٍ وَلا يُنقَصُ مِن عُمُرِهِ إِلّا فى كِتٰبٍ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسيرٌ
35.transliteration: WaAllahu khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma jaAAalakum azwajan wama tahmilu min ontha wala tadaAAu illa biAAilmihi wama yuAAammaru min muAAammarin wala yunqasu min AAumurihi illa fee kitabin inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun
35.translation: Allah created you from dust, then from a little fluid, then He made you pairs (the male and female). No female beareth or bringeth forth save with His knowledge. And no-one groweth old who groweth old, nor is aught lessened of his life, but it is recorded in a Book, Lo! that is easy for Allah

35.arabic: وَما يَستَوِى البَحرانِ هٰذا عَذبٌ فُراتٌ سائِغٌ شَرابُهُ وَهٰذا مِلحٌ أُجاجٌ وَمِن كُلٍّ تَأكُلونَ لَحمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَستَخرِجونَ حِليَةً تَلبَسونَها وَتَرَى الفُلكَ فيهِ مَواخِرَ لِتَبتَغوا مِن فَضلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُم تَشكُرونَ
35.transliteration: Wama yastawee albahrani hatha AAathbun furatun saighun sharabuhu wahatha milhun ojajun wamin kullin takuloona lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka feehi mawakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona
35.translation: And the two seas are not alike: this, fresh, sweet, good to drink, this (other) bitter, salt. And from them both ye eat fresh meat and derive the ornament that ye wear. And thou seest the ship cleaving them with its prow that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may give thanks

35.arabic: يولِجُ الَّيلَ فِى النَّهارِ وَيولِجُ النَّهارَ فِى الَّيلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمسَ وَالقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجرى لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى ذٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُم لَهُ المُلكُ وَالَّذينَ تَدعونَ مِن دونِهِ ما يَملِكونَ مِن قِطميرٍ
35.transliteration: Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku waallatheena tadAAoona min doonihi ma yamlikoona min qitmeerin
35.translation: He maketh the night to pass into the day and He maketh the day to pass into the night. He hath subdued the sun and moon to service. Each runneth unto an appointed term. Such is Allah, your Lord; His is the Sovereignty; and those unto whom ye pray instead of Him own not so much as the white spot on a date-stone

35.arabic: إِن تَدعوهُم لا يَسمَعوا دُعاءَكُم وَلَو سَمِعوا مَا استَجابوا لَكُم وَيَومَ القِيٰمَةِ يَكفُرونَ بِشِركِكُم وَلا يُنَبِّئُكَ مِثلُ خَبيرٍ
35.transliteration: In tadAAoohum la yasmaAAoo duAAaakum walaw samiAAoo ma istajaboo lakum wayawma alqiyamati yakfuroona bishirkikum wala yunabbioka mithlu khabeerin
35.translation: If ye pray unto them they hear not your prayer, and if they heard they could not grant it you. On the Day of Resurrection they will disown association with you. None can inform you like Him Who is Aware

35.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ أَنتُمُ الفُقَراءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ هُوَ الغَنِىُّ الحَميدُ
35.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu antumu alfuqarao ila Allahi waAllahu huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu
35.translation: O mankind! Ye are the poor in your relation to Allah. And Allah! He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise

35.arabic: إِن يَشَأ يُذهِبكُم وَيَأتِ بِخَلقٍ جَديدٍ
35.transliteration: In yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin
35.translation: If He will, He can be rid of you and bring (instead of you) some new creation

35.arabic: وَما ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ بِعَزيزٍ
35.transliteration: Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin
35.translation: That is not a hard thing for Allah

35.arabic: وَلا تَزِرُ وازِرَةٌ وِزرَ أُخرىٰ وَإِن تَدعُ مُثقَلَةٌ إِلىٰ حِملِها لا يُحمَل مِنهُ شَيءٌ وَلَو كانَ ذا قُربىٰ إِنَّما تُنذِرُ الَّذينَ يَخشَونَ رَبَّهُم بِالغَيبِ وَأَقامُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَمَن تَزَكّىٰ فَإِنَّما يَتَزَكّىٰ لِنَفسِهِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ المَصيرُ
35.transliteration: Wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wain tadAAu muthqalatun ila himliha la yuhmal minhu shayon walaw kana tha qurba innama tunthiru allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi waaqamoo alssalata waman tazakka fainnama yatazakka linafsihi waila Allahi almaseeru
35.translation: And no burdened soul can bear another's burden, and if one heavy laden crieth for (help with) his load, naught of it will be lifted even though he (unto whom he crieth) be of kin. Thou warnest only those who fear their Lord in secret, and have established worship. He who groweth (in goodness), groweth only for himself, (he cannot by his merit redeem others). Unto Allah is the journeying

35.arabic: وَما يَستَوِى الأَعمىٰ وَالبَصيرُ
35.transliteration: Wama yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru
35.translation: The blind man is not equal with the seer

35.arabic: وَلَا الظُّلُمٰتُ وَلَا النّورُ
35.transliteration: Wala alththulumatu wala alnnooru
35.translation: Nor is darkness (tantamount to) light

35.arabic: وَلَا الظِّلُّ وَلَا الحَرورُ
35.transliteration: Wala alththillu wala alharooru
35.translation: Nor is the shadow equal with the sun's full heat

35.arabic: وَما يَستَوِى الأَحياءُ وَلَا الأَموٰتُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسمِعُ مَن يَشاءُ وَما أَنتَ بِمُسمِعٍ مَن فِى القُبورِ
35.transliteration: Wama yastawee alahyao wala alamwatu inna Allaha yusmiAAu man yashao wama anta bimusmiAAin man fee alquboori
35.translation: Nor are the living equal with the dead. Lo! Allah maketh whom He will to hear. Thou canst not reach those who are in the graves

35.arabic: إِن أَنتَ إِلّا نَذيرٌ
35.transliteration: In anta illa natheerun
35.translation: Thou art but a warner

35.arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنٰكَ بِالحَقِّ بَشيرًا وَنَذيرًا وَإِن مِن أُمَّةٍ إِلّا خَلا فيها نَذيرٌ
35.transliteration: Inna arsalnaka bialhaqqi basheeran wanatheeran wain min ommatin illa khala feeha natheerun
35.translation: Lo! We have sent thee with the Truth, a bearer of glad tidings and a warner; and there is not a nation but a warner hath passed among them

35.arabic: وَإِن يُكَذِّبوكَ فَقَد كَذَّبَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم جاءَتهُم رُسُلُهُم بِالبَيِّنٰتِ وَبِالزُّبُرِ وَبِالكِتٰبِ المُنيرِ
35.transliteration: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati wabialzzuburi wabialkitabi almuneeri
35.translation: And if they deny thee, those before them also denied. Their messengers came unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), and with the Psalms and the Scripture giving light

35.arabic: ثُمَّ أَخَذتُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فَكَيفَ كانَ نَكيرِ
35.transliteration: Thumma akhathtu allatheena kafaroo fakayfa kana nakeeri
35.translation: Then seized I those who disbelieved, and how intense was My abhorrence

35.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَأَخرَجنا بِهِ ثَمَرٰتٍ مُختَلِفًا أَلوٰنُها وَمِنَ الجِبالِ جُدَدٌ بيضٌ وَحُمرٌ مُختَلِفٌ أَلوٰنُها وَغَرابيبُ سودٌ
35.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi thamaratin mukhtalifan alwanuha wamina aljibali judadun beedun wahumrun mukhtalifun alwanuha wagharabeebu soodun
35.translation: Hast thou not seen that Allah causeth water to fall from the sky, and We produce therewith fruit of divers hues; and among the hills are streaks white and red, of divers hues, and (others) raven-black

35.arabic: وَمِنَ النّاسِ وَالدَّوابِّ وَالأَنعٰمِ مُختَلِفٌ أَلوٰنُهُ كَذٰلِكَ إِنَّما يَخشَى اللَّهَ مِن عِبادِهِ العُلَمٰؤُا۟ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزيزٌ غَفورٌ
35.transliteration: Wamina alnnasi waalddawabbi waalanAAami mukhtalifun alwanuhu kathalika innama yakhsha Allaha min AAibadihi alAAulamao inna Allaha AAazeezun ghafoorun
35.translation: And of men and beasts and cattle, in like manner, divers hues? The erudite among His bondmen fear Allah alone. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Forgiving

35.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَتلونَ كِتٰبَ اللَّهِ وَأَقامُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَأَنفَقوا مِمّا رَزَقنٰهُم سِرًّا وَعَلانِيَةً يَرجونَ تِجٰرَةً لَن تَبورَ
35.transliteration: Inna allatheena yatloona kitaba Allahi waaqamoo alssalata waanfaqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan yarjoona tijaratan lan taboora
35.translation: Lo! those who read the Scripture of Allah, and establish worship, and spend of that which We have bestowed on them secretly and openly, they look forward to imperishable gain

35.arabic: لِيُوَفِّيَهُم أُجورَهُم وَيَزيدَهُم مِن فَضلِهِ إِنَّهُ غَفورٌ شَكورٌ
35.transliteration: Liyuwaffiyahum ojoorahum wayazeedahum min fadlihi innahu ghafoorun shakoorun
35.translation: That He will pay them their wages and increase them of His grace. Lo! He is Forgiving, Responsive

35.arabic: وَالَّذى أَوحَينا إِلَيكَ مِنَ الكِتٰبِ هُوَ الحَقُّ مُصَدِّقًا لِما بَينَ يَدَيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِعِبادِهِ لَخَبيرٌ بَصيرٌ
35.transliteration: Waallathee awhayna ilayka mina alkitabi huwa alhaqqu musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi inna Allaha biAAibadihi lakhabeerun baseerun
35.translation: As for that which We inspire in thee of the Scripture, it is the Truth confirming that which was (revealed) before it. Lo! Allah is indeed Observer, Seer of His slaves

35.arabic: ثُمَّ أَورَثنَا الكِتٰبَ الَّذينَ اصطَفَينا مِن عِبادِنا فَمِنهُم ظالِمٌ لِنَفسِهِ وَمِنهُم مُقتَصِدٌ وَمِنهُم سابِقٌ بِالخَيرٰتِ بِإِذنِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الفَضلُ الكَبيرُ
35.transliteration: Thumma awrathna alkitaba allatheena istafayna min AAibadina faminhum thalimun linafsihi waminhum muqtasidun waminhum sabiqun bialkhayrati biithni Allahi thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru
35.translation: Then We gave the Scripture as inheritance unto those whom We elected of Our bondmen. But of them are some who wrong themselves and of them are some who are lukewarm, and of them are some who outstrip (others) through good deeds, by Allah's leave. That is the great favour

35.arabic: جَنّٰتُ عَدنٍ يَدخُلونَها يُحَلَّونَ فيها مِن أَساوِرَ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَلُؤلُؤًا وَلِباسُهُم فيها حَريرٌ
35.transliteration: Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun
35.translation: Gardens of Eden! They enter them wearing armlets of gold and pearl and their raiment therein is silk

35.arabic: وَقالُوا الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذى أَذهَبَ عَنَّا الحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنا لَغَفورٌ شَكورٌ
35.transliteration: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee athhaba AAanna alhazana inna rabbana laghafoorun shakoorun
35.translation: And they say: Praise be to Allah Who hath put grief away from us. Lo! Our Lord is Forgiving, Bountiful

35.arabic: الَّذى أَحَلَّنا دارَ المُقامَةِ مِن فَضلِهِ لا يَمَسُّنا فيها نَصَبٌ وَلا يَمَسُّنا فيها لُغوبٌ
35.transliteration: Allathee ahallana dara almuqamati min fadlihi la yamassuna feeha nasabun wala yamassuna feeha lughoobun
35.translation: Who, of His grace, hath installed us in the mansion of eternity, where toil toucheth us not nor can weariness affect us

35.arabic: وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا لَهُم نارُ جَهَنَّمَ لا يُقضىٰ عَلَيهِم فَيَموتوا وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنهُم مِن عَذابِها كَذٰلِكَ نَجزى كُلَّ كَفورٍ
35.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo lahum naru jahannama la yuqda AAalayhim fayamootoo wala yukhaffafu AAanhum min AAathabiha kathalika najzee kulla kafoorin
35.translation: But as for those who disbelieve, for them is fire of hell; it taketh not complete effect upon them so that they can die, nor is its torment lightened for them. Thus We punish every ingrate

35.arabic: وَهُم يَصطَرِخونَ فيها رَبَّنا أَخرِجنا نَعمَل صٰلِحًا غَيرَ الَّذى كُنّا نَعمَلُ أَوَلَم نُعَمِّركُم ما يَتَذَكَّرُ فيهِ مَن تَذَكَّرَ وَجاءَكُمُ النَّذيرُ فَذوقوا فَما لِلظّٰلِمينَ مِن نَصيرٍ
35.transliteration: Wahum yastarikhoona feeha rabbana akhrijna naAAmal salihan ghayra allathee kunna naAAmalu awalam nuAAammirkum ma yatathakkaru feehi man tathakkara wajaakumu alnnatheeru fathooqoo fama lilththalimeena min naseerin
35.translation: And they cry for help there, (saying): Our Lord! Release us; we will do right, not (the wrong) that we used to do. Did not We grant you a life long enough for him who reflected to reflect therein? And the warner came unto you. Now taste (the flavour of your deeds), for evil-doers have no helper

35.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ عٰلِمُ غَيبِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ إِنَّهُ عَليمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدورِ
35.transliteration: Inna Allaha AAalimu ghaybi alssamawati waalardi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori
35.translation: Lo! Allah is the Knower of the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. Lo! He is Aware of the secret of (men's) breasts

35.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى جَعَلَكُم خَلٰئِفَ فِى الأَرضِ فَمَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيهِ كُفرُهُ وَلا يَزيدُ الكٰفِرينَ كُفرُهُم عِندَ رَبِّهِم إِلّا مَقتًا وَلا يَزيدُ الكٰفِرينَ كُفرُهُم إِلّا خَسارًا
35.transliteration: Huwa allathee jaAAalakum khalaifa fee alardi faman kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum AAinda rabbihim illa maqtan wala yazeedu alkafireena kufruhum illa khasaran
35.translation: He it is Who hath made you regents in the earth; so he who disbelieveth, his disbelief be on his own head. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers, in their Lord's sight, naught save abhorrence. Their disbelief increaseth for the disbelievers naught save loss

35.arabic: قُل أَرَءَيتُم شُرَكاءَكُمُ الَّذينَ تَدعونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ أَرونى ماذا خَلَقوا مِنَ الأَرضِ أَم لَهُم شِركٌ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ أَم ءاتَينٰهُم كِتٰبًا فَهُم عَلىٰ بَيِّنَتٍ مِنهُ بَل إِن يَعِدُ الظّٰلِمونَ بَعضُهُم بَعضًا إِلّا غُرورًا
35.transliteration: Qul araaytum shurakaakumu allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati am ataynahum kitaban fahum AAala bayyinatin minhu bal in yaAAidu alththalimoona baAAduhum baAAdan illa ghurooran
35.translation: Say: Have ye seen your partner-gods to whom ye pray beside Allah? Show me what they created of the earth! Or have they any portion in the heavens? Or have We given them a scripture so they act on clear proof therefrom? Nay, the evil-doers promise one another only to deceive

35.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُمسِكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ أَن تَزولا وَلَئِن زالَتا إِن أَمسَكَهُما مِن أَحَدٍ مِن بَعدِهِ إِنَّهُ كانَ حَليمًا غَفورًا
35.transliteration: Inna Allaha yumsiku alssamawati waalarda an tazoola walain zalata in amsakahuma min ahadin min baAAdihi innahu kana haleeman ghafooran
35.translation: Lo! Allah graspeth the heavens and the earth that they deviate not, and if they were to deviate there is not one that could grasp them after Him. Lo! He is ever Clement, Forgiving

35.arabic: وَأَقسَموا بِاللَّهِ جَهدَ أَيمٰنِهِم لَئِن جاءَهُم نَذيرٌ لَيَكونُنَّ أَهدىٰ مِن إِحدَى الأُمَمِ فَلَمّا جاءَهُم نَذيرٌ ما زادَهُم إِلّا نُفورًا
35.transliteration: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain jaahum natheerun layakoonunna ahda min ihda alomami falamma jaahum natheerun ma zadahum illa nufooran
35.translation: And they swore by Allah, their most binding oath, that if a warner came unto them they would be more tractable than any of the nations; yet, when a warner came unto them it aroused in them naught save repugnance

35.arabic: استِكبارًا فِى الأَرضِ وَمَكرَ السَّيِّئِ وَلا يَحيقُ المَكرُ السَّيِّئُ إِلّا بِأَهلِهِ فَهَل يَنظُرونَ إِلّا سُنَّتَ الأَوَّلينَ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَبديلًا وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ اللَّهِ تَحويلًا
35.transliteration: Istikbaran fee alardi wamakra alssayyii wala yaheequ almakru alssayyio illa biahlihi fahal yanthuroona illa sunnata alawwaleena falan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tahweelan
35.translation: (Shown in their) behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil; and the evil plot encloseth but the men who make it. Then, can they expect aught save the treatment of the folk of old? Thou wilt not find for Allah's way of treatment any substitute, nor wilt thou find for Allah's way of treatment aught of power to change

35.arabic: أَوَلَم يَسيروا فِى الأَرضِ فَيَنظُروا كَيفَ كانَ عٰقِبَةُ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم وَكانوا أَشَدَّ مِنهُم قُوَّةً وَما كانَ اللَّهُ لِيُعجِزَهُ مِن شَيءٍ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَلا فِى الأَرضِ إِنَّهُ كانَ عَليمًا قَديرًا
35.transliteration: Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim wakanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wama kana Allahu liyuAAjizahu min shayin fee alssamawati wala fee alardi innahu kana AAaleeman qadeeran
35.translation: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty

35.arabic: وَلَو يُؤاخِذُ اللَّهُ النّاسَ بِما كَسَبوا ما تَرَكَ عَلىٰ ظَهرِها مِن دابَّةٍ وَلٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُم إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَإِذا جاءَ أَجَلُهُم فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ بِعِبادِهِ بَصيرًا
35.transliteration: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bima kasaboo ma taraka AAala thahriha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum fainna Allaha kana biAAibadihi baseeran
35.translation: If Allah took mankind to task by that which they deserve, He would not leave a living creature on the surface of the earth; but He reprieveth them unto an appointed term, and when their term cometh - then verily (they will know that) Allah is ever Seer of His slaves

36.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يس
36.transliteration: Yaseen
36.translation: Ya Sin

36.arabic: وَالقُرءانِ الحَكيمِ
36.transliteration: Waalqurani alhakeemi
36.translation: By the wise Qur'an

36.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ المُرسَلينَ
36.transliteration: Innaka lamina almursaleena
36.translation: Lo! thou art of those sent

36.arabic: عَلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
36.transliteration: AAala siratin mustaqeemin
36.translation: On a straight path

36.arabic: تَنزيلَ العَزيزِ الرَّحيمِ
36.transliteration: Tanzeela alAAazeezi alrraheemi
36.translation: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful

36.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَومًا ما أُنذِرَ ءاباؤُهُم فَهُم غٰفِلونَ
36.transliteration: Litunthira qawman ma onthira abaohum fahum ghafiloona
36.translation: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless

36.arabic: لَقَد حَقَّ القَولُ عَلىٰ أَكثَرِهِم فَهُم لا يُؤمِنونَ
36.transliteration: Laqad haqqa alqawlu AAala aktharihim fahum la yuminoona
36.translation: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not

36.arabic: إِنّا جَعَلنا فى أَعنٰقِهِم أَغلٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى الأَذقانِ فَهُم مُقمَحونَ
36.transliteration: Inna jaAAalna fee aAAnaqihim aghlalan fahiya ila alathqani fahum muqmahoona
36.translation: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked

36.arabic: وَجَعَلنا مِن بَينِ أَيديهِم سَدًّا وَمِن خَلفِهِم سَدًّا فَأَغشَينٰهُم فَهُم لا يُبصِرونَ
36.transliteration: WajaAAalna min bayni aydeehim saddan wamin khalfihim saddan faaghshaynahum fahum la yubsiroona
36.translation: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not

36.arabic: وَسَواءٌ عَلَيهِم ءَأَنذَرتَهُم أَم لَم تُنذِرهُم لا يُؤمِنونَ
36.transliteration: Wasawaon AAalayhim aanthartahum am lam tunthirhum la yuminoona
36.translation: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not

36.arabic: إِنَّما تُنذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكرَ وَخَشِىَ الرَّحمٰنَ بِالغَيبِ فَبَشِّرهُ بِمَغفِرَةٍ وَأَجرٍ كَريمٍ
36.transliteration: Innama tunthiru mani ittabaAAa alththikra wakhashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi fabashshirhu bimaghfiratin waajrin kareemin
36.translation: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward

36.arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نُحىِ المَوتىٰ وَنَكتُبُ ما قَدَّموا وَءاثٰرَهُم وَكُلَّ شَيءٍ أَحصَينٰهُ فى إِمامٍ مُبينٍ
36.transliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee almawta wanaktubu ma qaddamoo waatharahum wakulla shayin ahsaynahu fee imamin mubeenin
36.translation: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register)

36.arabic: وَاضرِب لَهُم مَثَلًا أَصحٰبَ القَريَةِ إِذ جاءَهَا المُرسَلونَ
36.transliteration: Waidrib lahum mathalan ashaba alqaryati ith jaaha almursaloona
36.translation: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them

36.arabic: إِذ أَرسَلنا إِلَيهِمُ اثنَينِ فَكَذَّبوهُما فَعَزَّزنا بِثالِثٍ فَقالوا إِنّا إِلَيكُم مُرسَلونَ
36.transliteration: Ith arsalna ilayhimu ithnayni fakaththaboohuma faAAazzazna bithalithin faqaloo inna ilaykum mursaloona
36.translation: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you

36.arabic: قالوا ما أَنتُم إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُنا وَما أَنزَلَ الرَّحمٰنُ مِن شَيءٍ إِن أَنتُم إِلّا تَكذِبونَ
36.transliteration: Qaloo ma antum illa basharun mithluna wama anzala alrrahmanu min shayin in antum illa takthiboona
36.translation: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie

36.arabic: قالوا رَبُّنا يَعلَمُ إِنّا إِلَيكُم لَمُرسَلونَ
36.transliteration: Qaloo rabbuna yaAAlamu inna ilaykum lamursaloona
36.translation: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you

36.arabic: وَما عَلَينا إِلَّا البَلٰغُ المُبينُ
36.transliteration: Wama AAalayna illa albalaghu almubeenu
36.translation: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message)

36.arabic: قالوا إِنّا تَطَيَّرنا بِكُم لَئِن لَم تَنتَهوا لَنَرجُمَنَّكُم وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِنّا عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
36.transliteration: Qaloo inna tatayyarna bikum lain lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minna AAathabun aleemun
36.translation: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands

36.arabic: قالوا طٰئِرُكُم مَعَكُم أَئِن ذُكِّرتُم بَل أَنتُم قَومٌ مُسرِفونَ
36.transliteration: Qaloo tairukum maAAakum ain thukkirtum bal antum qawmun musrifoona
36.translation: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk

36.arabic: وَجاءَ مِن أَقصَا المَدينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسعىٰ قالَ يٰقَومِ اتَّبِعُوا المُرسَلينَ
36.transliteration: Wajaa min aqsa almadeenati rajulun yasAAa qala ya qawmi ittabiAAoo almursaleena
36.translation: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent

36.arabic: اتَّبِعوا مَن لا يَسـَٔلُكُم أَجرًا وَهُم مُهتَدونَ
36.transliteration: IttabiAAoo man la yasalukum ajran wahum muhtadoona
36.translation: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided

36.arabic: وَما لِىَ لا أَعبُدُ الَّذى فَطَرَنى وَإِلَيهِ تُرجَعونَ
36.transliteration: Wama liya la aAAbudu allathee fataranee wailayhi turjaAAoona
36.translation: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back

36.arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دونِهِ ءالِهَةً إِن يُرِدنِ الرَّحمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لا تُغنِ عَنّى شَفٰعَتُهُم شَيـًٔا وَلا يُنقِذونِ
36.transliteration: Aattakhithu min doonihi alihatan in yuridni alrrahmanu bidurrin la tughni AAannee shafaAAatuhum shayan wala yunqithooni
36.translation: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save

36.arabic: إِنّى إِذًا لَفى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
36.transliteration: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin
36.translation: Then truly I should be in error manifest

36.arabic: إِنّى ءامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُم فَاسمَعونِ
36.transliteration: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni
36.translation: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me

36.arabic: قيلَ ادخُلِ الجَنَّةَ قالَ يٰلَيتَ قَومى يَعلَمونَ
36.transliteration: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona
36.translation: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew

36.arabic: بِما غَفَرَ لى رَبّى وَجَعَلَنى مِنَ المُكرَمينَ
36.transliteration: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena
36.translation: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones

36.arabic: وَما أَنزَلنا عَلىٰ قَومِهِ مِن بَعدِهِ مِن جُندٍ مِنَ السَّماءِ وَما كُنّا مُنزِلينَ
36.transliteration: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena
36.translation: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send

36.arabic: إِن كانَت إِلّا صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً فَإِذا هُم خٰمِدونَ
36.transliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona
36.translation: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct

36.arabic: يٰحَسرَةً عَلَى العِبادِ ما يَأتيهِم مِن رَسولٍ إِلّا كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
36.transliteration: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
36.translation: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

36.arabic: أَلَم يَرَوا كَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِنَ القُرونِ أَنَّهُم إِلَيهِم لا يَرجِعونَ
36.transliteration: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona
36.translation: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them

36.arabic: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَمّا جَميعٌ لَدَينا مُحضَرونَ
36.transliteration: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
36.translation: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us

36.arabic: وَءايَةٌ لَهُمُ الأَرضُ المَيتَةُ أَحيَينٰها وَأَخرَجنا مِنها حَبًّا فَمِنهُ يَأكُلونَ
36.transliteration: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona
36.translation: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof

36.arabic: وَجَعَلنا فيها جَنّٰتٍ مِن نَخيلٍ وَأَعنٰبٍ وَفَجَّرنا فيها مِنَ العُيونِ
36.transliteration: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni
36.translation: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein

36.arabic: لِيَأكُلوا مِن ثَمَرِهِ وَما عَمِلَتهُ أَيديهِم أَفَلا يَشكُرونَ
36.transliteration: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona
36.translation: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks

36.arabic: سُبحٰنَ الَّذى خَلَقَ الأَزوٰجَ كُلَّها مِمّا تُنبِتُ الأَرضُ وَمِن أَنفُسِهِم وَمِمّا لا يَعلَمونَ
36.transliteration: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona
36.translation: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not

36.arabic: وَءايَةٌ لَهُمُ الَّيلُ نَسلَخُ مِنهُ النَّهارَ فَإِذا هُم مُظلِمونَ
36.transliteration: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona
36.translation: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness

36.arabic: وَالشَّمسُ تَجرى لِمُستَقَرٍّ لَها ذٰلِكَ تَقديرُ العَزيزِ العَليمِ
36.transliteration: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi
36.translation: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise

36.arabic: وَالقَمَرَ قَدَّرنٰهُ مَنازِلَ حَتّىٰ عادَ كَالعُرجونِ القَديمِ
36.transliteration: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi
36.translation: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf

36.arabic: لَا الشَّمسُ يَنبَغى لَها أَن تُدرِكَ القَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيلُ سابِقُ النَّهارِ وَكُلٌّ فى فَلَكٍ يَسبَحونَ
36.transliteration: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona
36.translation: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit

36.arabic: وَءايَةٌ لَهُم أَنّا حَمَلنا ذُرِّيَّتَهُم فِى الفُلكِ المَشحونِ
36.transliteration: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni
36.translation: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship

36.arabic: وَخَلَقنا لَهُم مِن مِثلِهِ ما يَركَبونَ
36.transliteration: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona
36.translation: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride

36.arabic: وَإِن نَشَأ نُغرِقهُم فَلا صَريخَ لَهُم وَلا هُم يُنقَذونَ
36.transliteration: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona
36.translation: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved

36.arabic: إِلّا رَحمَةً مِنّا وَمَتٰعًا إِلىٰ حينٍ
36.transliteration: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin
36.translation: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while

36.arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقوا ما بَينَ أَيديكُم وَما خَلفَكُم لَعَلَّكُم تُرحَمونَ
36.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona
36.translation: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless)

36.arabic: وَما تَأتيهِم مِن ءايَةٍ مِن ءايٰتِ رَبِّهِم إِلّا كانوا عَنها مُعرِضينَ
36.transliteration: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena
36.translation: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it

36.arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُم أَنفِقوا مِمّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللَّهُ قالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا أَنُطعِمُ مَن لَو يَشاءُ اللَّهُ أَطعَمَهُ إِن أَنتُم إِلّا فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
36.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin
36.translation: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest

36.arabic: وَيَقولونَ مَتىٰ هٰذَا الوَعدُ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
36.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
36.translation: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful

36.arabic: ما يَنظُرونَ إِلّا صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً تَأخُذُهُم وَهُم يَخِصِّمونَ
36.transliteration: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona
36.translation: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing

36.arabic: فَلا يَستَطيعونَ تَوصِيَةً وَلا إِلىٰ أَهلِهِم يَرجِعونَ
36.transliteration: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona
36.translation: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk

36.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ فَإِذا هُم مِنَ الأَجداثِ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِم يَنسِلونَ
36.transliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona
36.translation: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord

36.arabic: قالوا يٰوَيلَنا مَن بَعَثَنا مِن مَرقَدِنا هٰذا ما وَعَدَ الرَّحمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ المُرسَلونَ
36.transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona
36.translation: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth

36.arabic: إِن كانَت إِلّا صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً فَإِذا هُم جَميعٌ لَدَينا مُحضَرونَ
36.transliteration: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona
36.translation: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us

36.arabic: فَاليَومَ لا تُظلَمُ نَفسٌ شَيـًٔا وَلا تُجزَونَ إِلّا ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
36.transliteration: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
