36.translation: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do

36.arabic: إِنَّ أَصحٰبَ الجَنَّةِ اليَومَ فى شُغُلٍ فٰكِهونَ
36.transliteration: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona
36.translation: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed

36.arabic: هُم وَأَزوٰجُهُم فى ظِلٰلٍ عَلَى الأَرائِكِ مُتَّكِـٔونَ
36.transliteration: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona
36.translation: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining

36.arabic: لَهُم فيها فٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم ما يَدَّعونَ
36.transliteration: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona
36.translation: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask

36.arabic: سَلٰمٌ قَولًا مِن رَبٍّ رَحيمٍ
36.transliteration: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin
36.translation: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace

36.arabic: وَامتٰزُوا اليَومَ أَيُّهَا المُجرِمونَ
36.transliteration: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona
36.translation: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day

36.arabic: أَلَم أَعهَد إِلَيكُم يٰبَنى ءادَمَ أَن لا تَعبُدُوا الشَّيطٰنَ إِنَّهُ لَكُم عَدُوٌّ مُبينٌ
36.transliteration: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
36.translation: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe

36.arabic: وَأَنِ اعبُدونى هٰذا صِرٰطٌ مُستَقيمٌ
36.transliteration: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun
36.translation: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path

36.arabic: وَلَقَد أَضَلَّ مِنكُم جِبِلًّا كَثيرًا أَفَلَم تَكونوا تَعقِلونَ
36.transliteration: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona
36.translation: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense

36.arabic: هٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتى كُنتُم توعَدونَ
36.transliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona
36.translation: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him)

36.arabic: اصلَوهَا اليَومَ بِما كُنتُم تَكفُرونَ
36.transliteration: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona
36.translation: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved

36.arabic: اليَومَ نَختِمُ عَلىٰ أَفوٰهِهِم وَتُكَلِّمُنا أَيديهِم وَتَشهَدُ أَرجُلُهُم بِما كانوا يَكسِبونَ
36.transliteration: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona
36.translation: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn

36.arabic: وَلَو نَشاءُ لَطَمَسنا عَلىٰ أَعيُنِهِم فَاستَبَقُوا الصِّرٰطَ فَأَنّىٰ يُبصِرونَ
36.transliteration: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona
36.translation: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen

36.arabic: وَلَو نَشاءُ لَمَسَخنٰهُم عَلىٰ مَكانَتِهِم فَمَا استَطٰعوا مُضِيًّا وَلا يَرجِعونَ
36.transliteration: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona
36.translation: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back

36.arabic: وَمَن نُعَمِّرهُ نُنَكِّسهُ فِى الخَلقِ أَفَلا يَعقِلونَ
36.transliteration: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona
36.translation: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense

36.arabic: وَما عَلَّمنٰهُ الشِّعرَ وَما يَنبَغى لَهُ إِن هُوَ إِلّا ذِكرٌ وَقُرءانٌ مُبينٌ
36.transliteration: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun
36.translation: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain

36.arabic: لِيُنذِرَ مَن كانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ القَولُ عَلَى الكٰفِرينَ
36.transliteration: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena
36.translation: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers

36.arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَوا أَنّا خَلَقنا لَهُم مِمّا عَمِلَت أَيدينا أَنعٰمًا فَهُم لَها مٰلِكونَ
36.transliteration: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona
36.translation: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners

36.arabic: وَذَلَّلنٰها لَهُم فَمِنها رَكوبُهُم وَمِنها يَأكُلونَ
36.transliteration: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona
36.translation: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food

36.arabic: وَلَهُم فيها مَنٰفِعُ وَمَشارِبُ أَفَلا يَشكُرونَ
36.transliteration: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona
36.translation: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks

36.arabic: وَاتَّخَذوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ ءالِهَةً لَعَلَّهُم يُنصَرونَ
36.transliteration: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona
36.translation: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped

36.arabic: لا يَستَطيعونَ نَصرَهُم وَهُم لَهُم جُندٌ مُحضَرونَ
36.transliteration: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona
36.translation: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms

36.arabic: فَلا يَحزُنكَ قَولُهُم إِنّا نَعلَمُ ما يُسِرّونَ وَما يُعلِنونَ
36.transliteration: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona
36.translation: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim

36.arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَ الإِنسٰنُ أَنّا خَلَقنٰهُ مِن نُطفَةٍ فَإِذا هُوَ خَصيمٌ مُبينٌ
36.transliteration: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun
36.translation: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent

36.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلقَهُ قالَ مَن يُحىِ العِظٰمَ وَهِىَ رَميمٌ
36.transliteration: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun
36.translation: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away

36.arabic: قُل يُحييهَا الَّذى أَنشَأَها أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلقٍ عَليمٌ
36.transliteration: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun
36.translation: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation

36.arabic: الَّذى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِنَ الشَّجَرِ الأَخضَرِ نارًا فَإِذا أَنتُم مِنهُ توقِدونَ
36.transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona
36.translation: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it

36.arabic: أَوَلَيسَ الَّذى خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلىٰ أَن يَخلُقَ مِثلَهُم بَلىٰ وَهُوَ الخَلّٰقُ العَليمُ
36.transliteration: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu
36.translation: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator

36.arabic: إِنَّما أَمرُهُ إِذا أَرادَ شَيـًٔا أَن يَقولَ لَهُ كُن فَيَكونُ
36.transliteration: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu
36.translation: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is

36.arabic: فَسُبحٰنَ الَّذى بِيَدِهِ مَلَكوتُ كُلِّ شَيءٍ وَإِلَيهِ تُرجَعونَ
36.transliteration: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona
36.translation: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back

37.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالصّٰفّٰتِ صَفًّا
37.translation: By those who set the ranks in battle order
And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
And those who read (the Word) for a reminder
Lo! thy Lord is surely One

37.arabic: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما وَرَبُّ المَشٰرِقِ
37.transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi
37.translation: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings

37.arabic: إِنّا زَيَّنَّا السَّماءَ الدُّنيا بِزينَةٍ الكَواكِبِ
37.transliteration: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi
37.translation: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets
With security from every froward devil

37.arabic: لا يَسَّمَّعونَ إِلَى المَلَإِ الأَعلىٰ وَيُقذَفونَ مِن كُلِّ جانِبٍ
37.transliteration: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin
37.translation: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side
Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment

37.arabic: إِلّا مَن خَطِفَ الخَطفَةَ فَأَتبَعَهُ شِهابٌ ثاقِبٌ
37.transliteration: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun
37.translation: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame

37.arabic: فَاستَفتِهِم أَهُم أَشَدُّ خَلقًا أَم مَن خَلَقنا إِنّا خَلَقنٰهُم مِن طينٍ لازِبٍ
37.transliteration: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin
37.translation: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay
Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
And heed not when they are reminded
And seek to scoff when they behold a portent

37.arabic: وَقالوا إِن هٰذا إِلّا سِحرٌ مُبينٌ
37.transliteration: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun
37.translation: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic

37.arabic: أَءِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَءِنّا لَمَبعوثونَ
37.transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
37.translation: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)
And our forefathers
Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low

37.arabic: فَإِنَّما هِىَ زَجرَةٌ وٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذا هُم يَنظُرونَ
37.transliteration: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona
37.translation: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold

37.transliteration: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni
37.translation: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment

37.arabic: هٰذا يَومُ الفَصلِ الَّذى كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبونَ
37.transliteration: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
37.translation: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny

37.arabic: احشُرُوا الَّذينَ ظَلَموا وَأَزوٰجَهُم وَما كانوا يَعبُدونَ
37.transliteration: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona
37.translation: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship

37.arabic: مِن دونِ اللَّهِ فَاهدوهُم إِلىٰ صِرٰطِ الجَحيمِ
37.transliteration: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi
37.translation: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell
And stop them, for they must be questioned
What aileth you that ye help not one another
Nay, but this day they make full submission
And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning

37.arabic: قالوا إِنَّكُم كُنتُم تَأتونَنا عَنِ اليَمينِ
37.transliteration: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni
37.translation: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth)
They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers

37.arabic: وَما كانَ لَنا عَلَيكُم مِن سُلطٰنٍ بَل كُنتُم قَومًا طٰغينَ
37.transliteration: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena
37.translation: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk

37.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَينا قَولُ رَبِّنا إِنّا لَذائِقونَ
37.transliteration: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona
37.translation: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom)
Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray
Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom
Lo! thus deal We with the guilty

37.arabic: إِنَّهُم كانوا إِذا قيلَ لَهُم لا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ يَستَكبِرونَ
37.transliteration: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona
37.translation: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful

37.arabic: وَيَقولونَ أَئِنّا لَتارِكوا ءالِهَتِنا لِشاعِرٍ مَجنونٍ
37.transliteration: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin
37.translation: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet
Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him)
Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom

37.arabic: وَما تُجزَونَ إِلّا ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
37.transliteration: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona
37.translation: Ye are requited naught save what ye did
Save single-minded slaves of Allah
For them there is a known provision
Fruits. And they will be honoured
In the Gardens of delight
On couches facing one another
A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them
White, delicious to the drinkers

37.arabic: لا فيها غَولٌ وَلا هُم عَنها يُنزَفونَ
37.transliteration: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona
37.translation: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby
And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes
(Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich)
And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning

37.arabic: قالَ قائِلٌ مِنهُم إِنّى كانَ لى قَرينٌ
37.transliteration: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun
37.translation: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)

37.arabic: أَءِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَءِنّا لَمَدينونَ
37.transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona
37.translation: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book
He saith: Will ye look
Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell
He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin

37.arabic: وَلَولا نِعمَةُ رَبّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ المُحضَرينَ
37.transliteration: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena
37.translation: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom)
Are we then not to die

37.arabic: إِلّا مَوتَتَنَا الأولىٰ وَما نَحنُ بِمُعَذَّبينَ
37.transliteration: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena
37.translation: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished
Lo! this is the supreme triumph
For the like of this, then, let the workers work

37.arabic: أَذٰلِكَ خَيرٌ نُزُلًا أَم شَجَرَةُ الزَّقّومِ
37.transliteration: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi
37.translation: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum
Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers

37.arabic: إِنَّها شَجَرَةٌ تَخرُجُ فى أَصلِ الجَحيمِ
37.transliteration: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi
37.translation: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell
Its crop is as it were the heads of devils

37.arabic: فَإِنَّهُم لَءاكِلونَ مِنها فَمالِـٔونَ مِنهَا البُطونَ
37.transliteration: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona
37.translation: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith

37.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُم عَلَيها لَشَوبًا مِن حَميمٍ
37.transliteration: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin
37.translation: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell
They indeed found their fathers astray
But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps
And verily most of the men of old went astray before them
And verily We sent among them warners
Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned
Save single-minded slaves of Allah
And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
And We saved him and his household from the great distress
And made his seed the survivors
And left for him among the later folk (the salutation)
Peace be unto Noah among the peoples
Lo! thus do We reward the good
Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves
Then We did drown the others
And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart

37.arabic: إِذ قالَ لِأَبيهِ وَقَومِهِ ماذا تَعبُدونَ
37.transliteration: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona
37.translation: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship
Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire
What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds
And he glanced a glance at the stars
Then said: Lo! I feel sick
And they turned their backs and went away from him

37.arabic: فَراغَ إِلىٰ ءالِهَتِهِم فَقالَ أَلا تَأكُلونَ
37.transliteration: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona
37.translation: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat
What aileth you that ye speak not
Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand
And (his people) came toward him, hastening
He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
When Allah hath created you and what ye make

37.arabic: قالُوا ابنوا لَهُ بُنيٰنًا فَأَلقوهُ فِى الجَحيمِ
37.transliteration: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi
37.translation: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire
And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost

37.arabic: وَقالَ إِنّى ذاهِبٌ إِلىٰ رَبّى سَيَهدينِ
37.transliteration: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni
37.translation: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me
My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous
So We gave him tidings of a gentle son

37.arabic: فَلَمّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ السَّعىَ قالَ يٰبُنَىَّ إِنّى أَرىٰ فِى المَنامِ أَنّى أَذبَحُكَ فَانظُر ماذا تَرىٰ قالَ يٰأَبَتِ افعَل ما تُؤمَرُ سَتَجِدُنى إِن شاءَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الصّٰبِرينَ
37.transliteration: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena
37.translation: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast
Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face
We called unto him: O Abraham

37.arabic: قَد صَدَّقتَ الرُّءيا إِنّا كَذٰلِكَ نَجزِى المُحسِنينَ
37.transliteration: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena
37.translation: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good
Lo! that verily was a clear test
Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim
And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation)
Peace be unto Abraham
Thus do We reward the good
Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves
And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous

37.arabic: وَبٰرَكنا عَلَيهِ وَعَلىٰ إِسحٰقَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِما مُحسِنٌ وَظالِمٌ لِنَفسِهِ مُبينٌ
37.transliteration: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun
37.translation: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves
And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron
And saved them and their people from the great distress
And helped them so that they became the victors
And We gave them the clear Scripture
And showed them the right path
And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation)
Peace be unto Moses and Aaron
Lo! thus do We reward the good
Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves
And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn)
When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)
Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators
Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers
But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
Save single-minded slaves of Allah
And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation)
Peace be unto Elias
Lo! thus do We reward the good
Lo! he is one of our believing slaves
And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn)
When We saved him and his household, every one
Save an old woman among those who stayed behind
Then We destroyed the others
And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning
And at night-time; have ye then no sense
And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
When he fled unto the laden ship
And then drew lots and was of those rejected
And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy
And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)

37.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فى بَطنِهِ إِلىٰ يَومِ يُبعَثونَ
37.transliteration: Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona
37.translation: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised
Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick
And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him

37.arabic: وَأَرسَلنٰهُ إِلىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلفٍ أَو يَزيدونَ
37.transliteration: Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona
37.translation: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while
Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons

37.arabic: أَم خَلَقنَا المَلٰئِكَةَ إِنٰثًا وَهُم شٰهِدونَ
37.transliteration: Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona
37.translation: Or created We the angels females while they were present
Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say
Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie
(And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons
What aileth you? How judge ye
Will ye not then reflect
Or have ye a clear warrant
Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful

37.arabic: وَجَعَلوا بَينَهُ وَبَينَ الجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا وَلَقَد عَلِمَتِ الجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُم لَمُحضَرونَ
37.transliteration: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona
37.translation: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him)
Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him)
Save single-minded slaves of Allah
Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship
Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him
Save him who is to burn in hell

37.arabic: وَما مِنّا إِلّا لَهُ مَقامٌ مَعلومٌ
37.transliteration: Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun
37.translation: There is not one of us but hath his known position
Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks
Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
And indeed they used to say

37.arabic: لَو أَنَّ عِندَنا ذِكرًا مِنَ الأَوَّلينَ
37.transliteration: Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena
37.translation: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
We would be single-minded slaves of Allah
Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know
And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
That they verily would be helped
And that Our host, they verily would be the victors
So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile
And watch, for they will (soon) see
Would they hasten on Our doom

37.arabic: فَإِذا نَزَلَ بِساحَتِهِم فَساءَ صَباحُ المُنذَرينَ
37.transliteration: Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena
37.translation: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned
Withdraw from them awhile
And watch, for they will (soon) see

37.arabic: سُبحٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ العِزَّةِ عَمّا يَصِفونَ
37.transliteration: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona
37.translation: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
And peace be unto those sent (to warn)
And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds

38.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ ص وَالقُرءانِ ذِى الذِّكرِ
38.transliteration: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri
38.translation: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an

38.arabic: بَلِ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقاقٍ
38.transliteration: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin
38.translation: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism

38.arabic: كَم أَهلَكنا مِن قَبلِهِم مِن قَرنٍ فَنادَوا وَلاتَ حينَ مَناصٍ
38.transliteration: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin
38.translation: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape

38.arabic: وَعَجِبوا أَن جاءَهُم مُنذِرٌ مِنهُم وَقالَ الكٰفِرونَ هٰذا سٰحِرٌ كَذّابٌ
38.transliteration: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun
38.translation: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan

38.arabic: أَجَعَلَ الءالِهَةَ إِلٰهًا وٰحِدًا إِنَّ هٰذا لَشَيءٌ عُجابٌ
38.transliteration: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun
38.translation: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing

38.arabic: وَانطَلَقَ المَلَأُ مِنهُم أَنِ امشوا وَاصبِروا عَلىٰ ءالِهَتِكُم إِنَّ هٰذا لَشَيءٌ يُرادُ
38.transliteration: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu
38.translation: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed

38.arabic: ما سَمِعنا بِهٰذا فِى المِلَّةِ الءاخِرَةِ إِن هٰذا إِلَّا اختِلٰقٌ
38.transliteration: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun
38.translation: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention

38.arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيهِ الذِّكرُ مِن بَينِنا بَل هُم فى شَكٍّ مِن ذِكرى بَل لَمّا يَذوقوا عَذابِ
38.transliteration: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi
38.translation: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom

38.arabic: أَم عِندَهُم خَزائِنُ رَحمَةِ رَبِّكَ العَزيزِ الوَهّابِ
38.transliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi
38.translation: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower

38.arabic: أَم لَهُم مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما فَليَرتَقوا فِى الأَسبٰبِ
38.transliteration: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi
38.translation: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes

38.arabic: جُندٌ ما هُنالِكَ مَهزومٌ مِنَ الأَحزابِ
38.transliteration: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi
38.translation: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there

38.arabic: كَذَّبَت قَبلَهُم قَومُ نوحٍ وَعادٌ وَفِرعَونُ ذُو الأَوتادِ
38.transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi
38.translation: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted

38.arabic: وَثَمودُ وَقَومُ لوطٍ وَأَصحٰبُ لـَٔيكَةِ أُولٰئِكَ الأَحزابُ
38.transliteration: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu
38.translation: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions

38.arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقابِ
38.transliteration: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi
38.translation: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified

38.arabic: وَما يَنظُرُ هٰؤُلاءِ إِلّا صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً ما لَها مِن فَواقٍ
38.transliteration: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin
38.translation: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto

38.arabic: وَقالوا رَبَّنا عَجِّل لَنا قِطَّنا قَبلَ يَومِ الحِسابِ
38.transliteration: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi
38.translation: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning

38.arabic: اصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَاذكُر عَبدَنا داوۥدَ ذَا الأَيدِ إِنَّهُ أَوّابٌ
38.transliteration: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun
38.translation: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah)

38.arabic: إِنّا سَخَّرنَا الجِبالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحنَ بِالعَشِىِّ وَالإِشراقِ
38.transliteration: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi
38.translation: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise

38.arabic: وَالطَّيرَ مَحشورَةً كُلٌّ لَهُ أَوّابٌ
38.transliteration: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun
38.translation: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him

38.arabic: وَشَدَدنا مُلكَهُ وَءاتَينٰهُ الحِكمَةَ وَفَصلَ الخِطابِ
38.transliteration: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi
38.translation: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech

38.arabic: وَهَل أَتىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ الخَصمِ إِذ تَسَوَّرُوا المِحرابَ
38.transliteration: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba
38.translation: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber

38.arabic: إِذ دَخَلوا عَلىٰ داوۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنهُم قالوا لا تَخَف خَصمانِ بَغىٰ بَعضُنا عَلىٰ بَعضٍ فَاحكُم بَينَنا بِالحَقِّ وَلا تُشطِط وَاهدِنا إِلىٰ سَواءِ الصِّرٰطِ
38.transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati
38.translation: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way

38.arabic: إِنَّ هٰذا أَخى لَهُ تِسعٌ وَتِسعونَ نَعجَةً وَلِىَ نَعجَةٌ وٰحِدَةٌ فَقالَ أَكفِلنيها وَعَزَّنى فِى الخِطابِ
38.transliteration: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi
38.translation: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech

38.arabic: قالَ لَقَد ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤالِ نَعجَتِكَ إِلىٰ نِعاجِهِ وَإِنَّ كَثيرًا مِنَ الخُلَطاءِ لَيَبغى بَعضُهُم عَلىٰ بَعضٍ إِلَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَقَليلٌ ما هُم وَظَنَّ داوۥدُ أَنَّما فَتَنّٰهُ فَاستَغفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ راكِعًا وَأَنابَ
38.transliteration: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba
38.translation: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented

38.arabic: فَغَفَرنا لَهُ ذٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنا لَزُلفىٰ وَحُسنَ مَـٔابٍ
38.transliteration: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin
38.translation: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end

38.arabic: يٰداوۥدُ إِنّا جَعَلنٰكَ خَليفَةً فِى الأَرضِ فَاحكُم بَينَ النّاسِ بِالحَقِّ وَلا تَتَّبِعِ الهَوىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَضِلّونَ عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُم عَذابٌ شَديدٌ بِما نَسوا يَومَ الحِسابِ
38.transliteration: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi
38.translation: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning

38.arabic: وَما خَلَقنَا السَّماءَ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما بٰطِلًا ذٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فَوَيلٌ لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا مِنَ النّارِ
38.transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari
38.translation: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire

38.arabic: أَم نَجعَلُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالمُفسِدينَ فِى الأَرضِ أَم نَجعَلُ المُتَّقينَ كَالفُجّارِ
38.transliteration: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari
38.translation: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked

38.arabic: كِتٰبٌ أَنزَلنٰهُ إِلَيكَ مُبٰرَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّروا ءايٰتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُوا الأَلبٰبِ
38.transliteration: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi
38.translation: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect

38.arabic: وَوَهَبنا لِداوۥدَ سُلَيمٰنَ نِعمَ العَبدُ إِنَّهُ أَوّابٌ
38.transliteration: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun
38.translation: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah)

38.arabic: إِذ عُرِضَ عَلَيهِ بِالعَشِىِّ الصّٰفِنٰتُ الجِيادُ
38.transliteration: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu
38.translation: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers

38.arabic: فَقالَ إِنّى أَحبَبتُ حُبَّ الخَيرِ عَن ذِكرِ رَبّى حَتّىٰ تَوارَت بِالحِجابِ
38.transliteration: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi
38.translation: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain

38.arabic: رُدّوها عَلَىَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسحًا بِالسّوقِ وَالأَعناقِ
38.transliteration: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi
38.translation: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks

38.arabic: وَلَقَد فَتَنّا سُلَيمٰنَ وَأَلقَينا عَلىٰ كُرسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنابَ
38.transliteration: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba
38.translation: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent

38.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ اغفِر لى وَهَب لى مُلكًا لا يَنبَغى لِأَحَدٍ مِن بَعدى إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الوَهّابُ
38.transliteration: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu
38.translation: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower

38.arabic: فَسَخَّرنا لَهُ الرّيحَ تَجرى بِأَمرِهِ رُخاءً حَيثُ أَصابَ
38.transliteration: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba
38.translation: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended

38.arabic: وَالشَّيٰطينَ كُلَّ بَنّاءٍ وَغَوّاصٍ
38.transliteration: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin
38.translation: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient)

38.arabic: وَءاخَرينَ مُقَرَّنينَ فِى الأَصفادِ
38.transliteration: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi
38.translation: And others linked together in chains

38.arabic: هٰذا عَطاؤُنا فَامنُن أَو أَمسِك بِغَيرِ حِسابٍ
38.transliteration: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin
38.translation: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning

38.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِندَنا لَزُلفىٰ وَحُسنَ مَـٔابٍ
38.transliteration: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin
38.translation: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end

38.arabic: وَاذكُر عَبدَنا أَيّوبَ إِذ نادىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنّى مَسَّنِىَ الشَّيطٰنُ بِنُصبٍ وَعَذابٍ
38.transliteration: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin
38.translation: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment

38.arabic: اركُض بِرِجلِكَ هٰذا مُغتَسَلٌ بارِدٌ وَشَرابٌ
38.transliteration: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun
38.translation: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink

38.arabic: وَوَهَبنا لَهُ أَهلَهُ وَمِثلَهُم مَعَهُم رَحمَةً مِنّا وَذِكرىٰ لِأُولِى الأَلبٰبِ
38.transliteration: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi
38.translation: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding

38.arabic: وَخُذ بِيَدِكَ ضِغثًا فَاضرِب بِهِ وَلا تَحنَث إِنّا وَجَدنٰهُ صابِرًا نِعمَ العَبدُ إِنَّهُ أَوّابٌ
38.transliteration: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun
38.translation: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord)

38.arabic: وَاذكُر عِبٰدَنا إِبرٰهيمَ وَإِسحٰقَ وَيَعقوبَ أُولِى الأَيدى وَالأَبصٰرِ
38.transliteration: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari
38.translation: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision

38.arabic: إِنّا أَخلَصنٰهُم بِخالِصَةٍ ذِكرَى الدّارِ
38.transliteration: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari
38.translation: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter)

38.arabic: وَإِنَّهُم عِندَنا لَمِنَ المُصطَفَينَ الأَخيارِ
38.transliteration: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari
38.translation: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent

38.arabic: وَاذكُر إِسمٰعيلَ وَاليَسَعَ وَذَا الكِفلِ وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الأَخيارِ
38.transliteration: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari
38.translation: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen

38.arabic: هٰذا ذِكرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلمُتَّقينَ لَحُسنَ مَـٔابٍ
38.transliteration: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin
38.translation: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end

38.arabic: جَنّٰتِ عَدنٍ مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الأَبوٰبُ
38.transliteration: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu
38.translation: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them

38.arabic: مُتَّكِـٔينَ فيها يَدعونَ فيها بِفٰكِهَةٍ كَثيرَةٍ وَشَرابٍ
38.transliteration: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin
38.translation: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein

38.arabic: وَعِندَهُم قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرفِ أَترابٌ
38.transliteration: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun
38.translation: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions

38.arabic: هٰذا ما توعَدونَ لِيَومِ الحِسابِ
38.transliteration: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi
38.translation: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning

38.arabic: إِنَّ هٰذا لَرِزقُنا ما لَهُ مِن نَفادٍ
38.transliteration: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin
38.translation: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away

38.arabic: هٰذا وَإِنَّ لِلطّٰغينَ لَشَرَّ مَـٔابٍ
38.transliteration: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin
38.translation: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end

38.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصلَونَها فَبِئسَ المِهادُ
38.transliteration: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu
38.translation: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place

38.arabic: هٰذا فَليَذوقوهُ حَميمٌ وَغَسّاقٌ
38.transliteration: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun
38.translation: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it

38.arabic: وَءاخَرُ مِن شَكلِهِ أَزوٰجٌ
38.transliteration: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun
38.translation: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)

38.arabic: هٰذا فَوجٌ مُقتَحِمٌ مَعَكُم لا مَرحَبًا بِهِم إِنَّهُم صالُوا النّارِ
38.transliteration: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari
38.translation: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire

38.arabic: قالوا بَل أَنتُم لا مَرحَبًا بِكُم أَنتُم قَدَّمتُموهُ لَنا فَبِئسَ القَرارُ
38.transliteration: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu
38.translation: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight

38.arabic: قالوا رَبَّنا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنا هٰذا فَزِدهُ عَذابًا ضِعفًا فِى النّارِ
38.transliteration: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari
38.translation: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire

38.arabic: وَقالوا ما لَنا لا نَرىٰ رِجالًا كُنّا نَعُدُّهُم مِنَ الأَشرارِ
38.transliteration: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari
38.translation: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked

38.arabic: أَتَّخَذنٰهُم سِخرِيًّا أَم زاغَت عَنهُمُ الأَبصٰرُ
38.transliteration: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru
38.translation: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them

38.arabic: إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخاصُمُ أَهلِ النّارِ
38.transliteration: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari
38.translation: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire

38.arabic: قُل إِنَّما أَنا۠ مُنذِرٌ وَما مِن إِلٰهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الوٰحِدُ القَهّارُ
38.transliteration: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu
38.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute

38.arabic: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُمَا العَزيزُ الغَفّٰرُ
38.transliteration: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru
38.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning

38.arabic: قُل هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظيمٌ
38.transliteration: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun
38.translation: Say: It is tremendous tidings

38.arabic: أَنتُم عَنهُ مُعرِضونَ
38.transliteration: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona
38.translation: Whence ye turn away

38.arabic: ما كانَ لِىَ مِن عِلمٍ بِالمَلَإِ الأَعلىٰ إِذ يَختَصِمونَ
38.transliteration: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona
38.translation: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed

38.arabic: إِن يوحىٰ إِلَىَّ إِلّا أَنَّما أَنا۠ نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
38.transliteration: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun
38.translation: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner

38.arabic: إِذ قالَ رَبُّكَ لِلمَلٰئِكَةِ إِنّى خٰلِقٌ بَشَرًا مِن طينٍ
38.transliteration: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin
38.translation: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire

38.arabic: فَإِذا سَوَّيتُهُ وَنَفَختُ فيهِ مِن روحى فَقَعوا لَهُ سٰجِدينَ
38.transliteration: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena
38.translation: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate

38.arabic: فَسَجَدَ المَلٰئِكَةُ كُلُّهُم أَجمَعونَ
38.transliteration: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona
38.translation: The angels fell down prostrate, every one

38.arabic: إِلّا إِبليسَ استَكبَرَ وَكانَ مِنَ الكٰفِرينَ
38.transliteration: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena
38.translation: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers

38.arabic: قالَ يٰإِبليسُ ما مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسجُدَ لِما خَلَقتُ بِيَدَىَّ أَستَكبَرتَ أَم كُنتَ مِنَ العالينَ
38.transliteration: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena
38.translation: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted

38.arabic: قالَ أَنا۠ خَيرٌ مِنهُ خَلَقتَنى مِن نارٍ وَخَلَقتَهُ مِن طينٍ
38.transliteration: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin
38.translation: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay

38.arabic: قالَ فَاخرُج مِنها فَإِنَّكَ رَجيمٌ
38.transliteration: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun
38.translation: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast

38.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيكَ لَعنَتى إِلىٰ يَومِ الدّينِ
38.transliteration: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni
38.translation: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment

38.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرنى إِلىٰ يَومِ يُبعَثونَ
38.transliteration: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona
38.translation: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised

38.arabic: قالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ المُنظَرينَ
38.transliteration: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena
38.translation: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved

38.arabic: إِلىٰ يَومِ الوَقتِ المَعلومِ
38.transliteration: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi
38.translation: Until the day of the time appointed

38.arabic: قالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغوِيَنَّهُم أَجمَعينَ
38.transliteration: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena
38.translation: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one

38.arabic: إِلّا عِبادَكَ مِنهُمُ المُخلَصينَ
38.transliteration: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena
38.translation: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them

38.arabic: قالَ فَالحَقُّ وَالحَقَّ أَقولُ
38.transliteration: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu
38.translation: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak

38.arabic: لَأَملَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنهُم أَجمَعينَ
38.transliteration: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena
38.translation: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together

38.arabic: قُل ما أَسـَٔلُكُم عَلَيهِ مِن أَجرٍ وَما أَنا۠ مِنَ المُتَكَلِّفينَ
38.transliteration: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena
38.translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating

38.arabic: إِن هُوَ إِلّا ذِكرٌ لِلعٰلَمينَ
38.transliteration: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena
38.translation: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples

38.arabic: وَلَتَعلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعدَ حينٍ
38.transliteration: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin
38.translation: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof

39.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ تَنزيلُ الكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللَّهِ العَزيزِ الحَكيمِ
39.transliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi
39.translation: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise

39.arabic: إِنّا أَنزَلنا إِلَيكَ الكِتٰبَ بِالحَقِّ فَاعبُدِ اللَّهَ مُخلِصًا لَهُ الدّينَ
39.transliteration: Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi faoAAbudi Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena
39.translation: Lo! We have revealed the Scripture unto thee (Muhammad) with truth; so worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only)

39.arabic: أَلا لِلَّهِ الدّينُ الخالِصُ وَالَّذينَ اتَّخَذوا مِن دونِهِ أَولِياءَ ما نَعبُدُهُم إِلّا لِيُقَرِّبونا إِلَى اللَّهِ زُلفىٰ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَحكُمُ بَينَهُم فى ما هُم فيهِ يَختَلِفونَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَهدى مَن هُوَ كٰذِبٌ كَفّارٌ
39.transliteration: Ala lillahi alddeenu alkhalisu waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa ma naAAbuduhum illa liyuqarriboona ila Allahi zulfa inna Allaha yahkumu baynahum fee ma hum feehi yakhtalifoona inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa kathibun kaffarun
39.translation: Surely pure religion is for Allah only. And those who choose protecting friends beside Him (say): We worship them only that they may bring us near unto Allah. Lo! Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Lo! Allah guideth not him who is a liar, an ingrate

39.arabic: لَو أَرادَ اللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَاصطَفىٰ مِمّا يَخلُقُ ما يَشاءُ سُبحٰنَهُ هُوَ اللَّهُ الوٰحِدُ القَهّارُ
39.transliteration: Law arada Allahu an yattakhitha waladan laistafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashao subhanahu huwa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu
39.translation: If Allah had willed to choose a son, He could have chosen what He would of that which He hath created. Be He Glorified! He is Allah, the One, the Absolute

39.arabic: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بِالحَقِّ يُكَوِّرُ الَّيلَ عَلَى النَّهارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ النَّهارَ عَلَى الَّيلِ وَسَخَّرَ الشَّمسَ وَالقَمَرَ كُلٌّ يَجرى لِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى أَلا هُوَ العَزيزُ الغَفّٰرُ
39.transliteration: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi yukawwiru allayla AAala alnnahari wayukawwiru alnnahara AAala allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman ala huwa alAAazeezu alghaffaru
39.translation: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night, and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver

39.arabic: خَلَقَكُم مِن نَفسٍ وٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنها زَوجَها وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِنَ الأَنعٰمِ ثَمٰنِيَةَ أَزوٰجٍ يَخلُقُكُم فى بُطونِ أُمَّهٰتِكُم خَلقًا مِن بَعدِ خَلقٍ فى ظُلُمٰتٍ ثَلٰثٍ ذٰلِكُمُ اللَّهُ رَبُّكُم لَهُ المُلكُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ فَأَنّىٰ تُصرَفونَ
39.transliteration: Khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin thumma jaAAala minha zawjaha waanzala lakum mina alanAAami thamaniyata azwajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ommahatikum khalqan min baAAdi khalqin fee thulumatin thalathin thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku la ilaha illa huwa faanna tusrafoona
39.translation: He created you from one being, then from that (being) He made its mate; and He hath provided for you of cattle eight kinds. He created you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold gloom. Such is Allah, your Lord. His is the Sovereignty. There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye turned away

39.arabic: إِن تَكفُروا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُم وَلا يَرضىٰ لِعِبادِهِ الكُفرَ وَإِن تَشكُروا يَرضَهُ لَكُم وَلا تَزِرُ وازِرَةٌ وِزرَ أُخرىٰ ثُمَّ إِلىٰ رَبِّكُم مَرجِعُكُم فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ إِنَّهُ عَليمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدورِ
39.transliteration: In takfuroo fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAankum wala yarda liAAibadihi alkufra wain tashkuroo yardahu lakum wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marjiAAukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori
39.translation: If ye are thankless, yet Allah is Independent of you, though He is not pleased with thanklessness for His bondmen; and if ye are thankful He is pleased therewith for you. No laden soul will bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return; and He will tell you what ye used to do. Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men)

39.arabic: وَإِذا مَسَّ الإِنسٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعا رَبَّهُ مُنيبًا إِلَيهِ ثُمَّ إِذا خَوَّلَهُ نِعمَةً مِنهُ نَسِىَ ما كانَ يَدعوا إِلَيهِ مِن قَبلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندادًا لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبيلِهِ قُل تَمَتَّع بِكُفرِكَ قَليلًا إِنَّكَ مِن أَصحٰبِ النّارِ
39.transliteration: Waitha massa alinsana durrun daAAa rabbahu muneeban ilayhi thumma itha khawwalahu niAAmatan minhu nasiya ma kana yadAAoo ilayhi min qablu wajaAAala lillahi andadan liyudilla AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAA bikufrika qaleelan innaka min ashabi alnnari
39.translation: And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire

39.arabic: أَمَّن هُوَ قٰنِتٌ ءاناءَ الَّيلِ ساجِدًا وَقائِمًا يَحذَرُ الءاخِرَةَ وَيَرجوا رَحمَةَ رَبِّهِ قُل هَل يَستَوِى الَّذينَ يَعلَمونَ وَالَّذينَ لا يَعلَمونَ إِنَّما يَتَذَكَّرُ أُولُوا الأَلبٰبِ
39.transliteration: Amman huwa qanitun anaa allayli sajidan waqaiman yahtharu alakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawee allatheena yaAAlamoona waallatheena la yaAAlamoona innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi
39.translation: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed

39.arabic: قُل يٰعِبادِ الَّذينَ ءامَنُوا اتَّقوا رَبَّكُم لِلَّذينَ أَحسَنوا فى هٰذِهِ الدُّنيا حَسَنَةٌ وَأَرضُ اللَّهِ وٰسِعَةٌ إِنَّما يُوَفَّى الصّٰبِرونَ أَجرَهُم بِغَيرِ حِسابٍ
39.transliteration: Qul ya AAibadi allatheena amanoo ittaqoo rabbakum lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waardu Allahi wasiAAatun innama yuwaffa alssabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisabin
39.translation: Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint

39.arabic: قُل إِنّى أُمِرتُ أَن أَعبُدَ اللَّهَ مُخلِصًا لَهُ الدّينَ
39.transliteration: Qul innee omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena
39.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only)

39.arabic: وَأُمِرتُ لِأَن أَكونَ أَوَّلَ المُسلِمينَ
39.transliteration: Waomirtu lian akoona awwala almuslimeena
39.translation: And I am commanded to be the first of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him)

39.arabic: قُل إِنّى أَخافُ إِن عَصَيتُ رَبّى عَذابَ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
39.transliteration: Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
39.translation: Say: Lo! if I should disobey my Lord, I fear the doom of a tremendous Day

39.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهَ أَعبُدُ مُخلِصًا لَهُ دينى
39.transliteration: Quli Allaha aAAbudu mukhlisan lahu deenee
39.translation: Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only)

39.arabic: فَاعبُدوا ما شِئتُم مِن دونِهِ قُل إِنَّ الخٰسِرينَ الَّذينَ خَسِروا أَنفُسَهُم وَأَهليهِم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ أَلا ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الخُسرانُ المُبينُ
39.transliteration: FaoAAbudoo ma shitum min doonihi qul inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu
39.translation: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss

39.arabic: لَهُم مِن فَوقِهِم ظُلَلٌ مِنَ النّارِ وَمِن تَحتِهِم ظُلَلٌ ذٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اللَّهُ بِهِ عِبادَهُ يٰعِبادِ فَاتَّقونِ
39.transliteration: Lahum min fawqihim thulalun mina alnnari wamin tahtihim thulalun thalika yukhawwifu Allahu bihi AAibadahu ya AAibadi faittaqooni
39.translation: They have an awning of fire above them and beneath them a dais (of fire). With this doth Allah appal His bondmen. O My bondmen, therefor fear Me

39.arabic: وَالَّذينَ اجتَنَبُوا الطّٰغوتَ أَن يَعبُدوها وَأَنابوا إِلَى اللَّهِ لَهُمُ البُشرىٰ فَبَشِّر عِبادِ
39.transliteration: Waallatheena ijtanaboo alttaghoota an yaAAbudooha waanaboo ila Allahi lahumu albushra fabashshir AAibadi
39.translation: And those who put away false gods lest they should worship them and turn to Allah in repentance, for them there are glad tidings. Therefor give good tidings (O Muhammad) to My bondmen

39.arabic: الَّذينَ يَستَمِعونَ القَولَ فَيَتَّبِعونَ أَحسَنَهُ أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ هَدىٰهُمُ اللَّهُ وَأُولٰئِكَ هُم أُولُوا الأَلبٰبِ
39.transliteration: Allatheena yastamiAAoona alqawla fayattabiAAoona ahsanahu olaika allatheena hadahumu Allahu waolaika hum oloo alalbabi
39.translation: Who hear advice and follow the best thereof. Such are those whom Allah guideth, and such are men of understanding

39.arabic: أَفَمَن حَقَّ عَلَيهِ كَلِمَةُ العَذابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى النّارِ
39.transliteration: Afaman haqqa AAalayhi kalimatu alAAathabi afaanta tunqithu man fee alnnari
39.translation: Is he on whom the word of doom is fulfilled (to be helped), and canst thou (O Muhammad) rescue him who is in the Fire

39.arabic: لٰكِنِ الَّذينَ اتَّقَوا رَبَّهُم لَهُم غُرَفٌ مِن فَوقِها غُرَفٌ مَبنِيَّةٌ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ وَعدَ اللَّهِ لا يُخلِفُ اللَّهُ الميعادَ
39.transliteration: Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqiha ghurafun mabniyyatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu waAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu almeeAAada
39.translation: But those who keep their duty to their Lord, for them are lofty halls with lofty halls above them, built (for them), beneath which rivers flow. (It is) a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise

39.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَسَلَكَهُ يَنٰبيعَ فِى الأَرضِ ثُمَّ يُخرِجُ بِهِ زَرعًا مُختَلِفًا أَلوٰنُهُ ثُمَّ يَهيجُ فَتَرىٰهُ مُصفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَجعَلُهُ حُطٰمًا إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَذِكرىٰ لِأُولِى الأَلبٰبِ
39.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fasalakahu yanabeeAAa fee alardi thumma yukhriju bihi zarAAan mukhtalifan alwanuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yajAAaluhu hutaman inna fee thalika lathikra liolee alalbabi
39.translation: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings, and afterward thereby produceth crops of divers hues; and afterward they wither and thou seest them turn yellow; then He maketh them chaff. Lo! herein verily is a reminder for men of understanding

39.arabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدرَهُ لِلإِسلٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلىٰ نورٍ مِن رَبِّهِ فَوَيلٌ لِلقٰسِيَةِ قُلوبُهُم مِن ذِكرِ اللَّهِ أُولٰئِكَ فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
39.transliteration: Afaman sharaha Allahu sadrahu lilislami fahuwa AAala noorin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqasiyati quloobuhum min thikri Allahi olaika fee dalalin mubeenin
39.translation: Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error

39.arabic: اللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحسَنَ الحَديثِ كِتٰبًا مُتَشٰبِهًا مَثانِىَ تَقشَعِرُّ مِنهُ جُلودُ الَّذينَ يَخشَونَ رَبَّهُم ثُمَّ تَلينُ جُلودُهُم وَقُلوبُهُم إِلىٰ ذِكرِ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللَّهِ يَهدى بِهِ مَن يَشاءُ وَمَن يُضلِلِ اللَّهُ فَما لَهُ مِن هادٍ
39.transliteration: Allahu nazzala ahsana alhadeethi kitaban mutashabihan mathaniya taqshaAAirru minhu juloodu allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ila thikri Allahi thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin
39.translation: Allah hath (now) revealed the fairest of statements, a Scripture consistent, (wherein promises of reward are) paired (with threats of punishment), whereat doth creep the flesh of those who fear their Lord, so that their flesh and their hearts soften to Allah's reminder. Such is Allah's guidance, wherewith He guideth whom He will. And him whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide

39.arabic: أَفَمَن يَتَّقى بِوَجهِهِ سوءَ العَذابِ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ وَقيلَ لِلظّٰلِمينَ ذوقوا ما كُنتُم تَكسِبونَ
39.transliteration: Afaman yattaqee biwajhihi sooa alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati waqeela lilththalimeena thooqoo ma kuntum taksiboona
39.translation: Is he then, who will strike his face against the awful doom upon the Day of Resurrection (as he who doeth right)? And it will be said unto the wrong-doers: Taste what ye used to earn

39.arabic: كَذَّبَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم فَأَتىٰهُمُ العَذابُ مِن حَيثُ لا يَشعُرونَ
39.transliteration: Kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona
39.translation: Those before them denied, and so the doom came on them whence they knew not

39.arabic: فَأَذاقَهُمُ اللَّهُ الخِزىَ فِى الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا وَلَعَذابُ الءاخِرَةِ أَكبَرُ لَو كانوا يَعلَمونَ
39.transliteration: Faathaqahumu Allahu alkhizya fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona
39.translation: Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be greater if they did but know

39.arabic: وَلَقَد ضَرَبنا لِلنّاسِ فى هٰذَا القُرءانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ لَعَلَّهُم يَتَذَكَّرونَ
39.transliteration: Walaqad darabna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin laAAallahum yatathakkaroona
39.translation: And verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes, that haply they may reflect

39.arabic: قُرءانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيرَ ذى عِوَجٍ لَعَلَّهُم يَتَّقونَ
39.transliteration: Quranan AAarabiyyan ghayra thee AAiwajin laAAallahum yattaqoona
39.translation: A Lecture in Arabic, containing no crookedness, that haply they may ward off (evil)

39.arabic: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا رَجُلًا فيهِ شُرَكاءُ مُتَشٰكِسونَ وَرَجُلًا سَلَمًا لِرَجُلٍ هَل يَستَوِيانِ مَثَلًا الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ بَل أَكثَرُهُم لا يَعلَمونَ
39.transliteration: Daraba Allahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakao mutashakisoona warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyani mathalan alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona
39.translation: Allah coineth a similitude: A man in relation to whom are several part-owners, quarrelling, and a man belonging wholly to one man. Are the two equal in similitude? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not

39.arabic: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌ وَإِنَّهُم مَيِّتونَ
39.transliteration: Innaka mayyitun wainnahum mayyitoona
39.translation: Lo! thou wilt die, and lo! they will die

39.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُم تَختَصِمونَ
39.transliteration: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati AAinda rabbikum takhtasimoona
39.translation: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord ye will dispute

39.arabic: فَمَن أَظلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدقِ إِذ جاءَهُ أَلَيسَ فى جَهَنَّمَ مَثوًى لِلكٰفِرينَ
39.transliteration: Faman athlamu mimman kathaba AAala Allahi wakaththaba bialssidqi ith jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena
39.translation: And who doth greater wrong than he who telleth a lie against Allah, and denieth the truth when it reacheth him? Will not the home of disbelievers be in hell

39.arabic: وَالَّذى جاءَ بِالصِّدقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِ أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ المُتَّقونَ
39.transliteration: Waallathee jaa bialssidqi wasaddaqa bihi olaika humu almuttaqoona
39.translation: And whoso bringeth the truth and believeth therein - Such are the dutiful

39.arabic: لَهُم ما يَشاءونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِم ذٰلِكَ جَزاءُ المُحسِنينَ
39.transliteration: Lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika jazao almuhsineena
39.translation: They shall have what they will of their Lord's bounty. That is the reward of the good

39.arabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ اللَّهُ عَنهُم أَسوَأَ الَّذى عَمِلوا وَيَجزِيَهُم أَجرَهُم بِأَحسَنِ الَّذى كانوا يَعمَلونَ
39.transliteration: Liyukaffira Allahu AAanhum aswaa allathee AAamiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum biahsani allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona
39.translation: That Allah will remit from them the worst of what they did, and will pay them for reward the best they used to do

39.arabic: أَلَيسَ اللَّهُ بِكافٍ عَبدَهُ وَيُخَوِّفونَكَ بِالَّذينَ مِن دونِهِ وَمَن يُضلِلِ اللَّهُ فَما لَهُ مِن هادٍ
39.transliteration: Alaysa Allahu bikafin AAabdahu wayukhawwifoonaka biallatheena min doonihi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin
39.translation: Will not Allah defend His slave? Yet they would frighten thee with those beside Him. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide

39.arabic: وَمَن يَهدِ اللَّهُ فَما لَهُ مِن مُضِلٍّ أَلَيسَ اللَّهُ بِعَزيزٍ ذِى انتِقامٍ
39.transliteration: Waman yahdi Allahu fama lahu min mudillin alaysa Allahu biAAazeezin thee intiqamin
39.translation: And he whom Allah guideth, for him there can be no misleader. Is not Allah Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong)

39.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلتَهُم مَن خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ لَيَقولُنَّ اللَّهُ قُل أَفَرَءَيتُم ما تَدعونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ إِن أَرادَنِىَ اللَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَل هُنَّ كٰشِفٰتُ ضُرِّهِ أَو أَرادَنى بِرَحمَةٍ هَل هُنَّ مُمسِكٰتُ رَحمَتِهِ قُل حَسبِىَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ المُتَوَكِّلونَ
39.transliteration: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu qul afaraaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi in aradaniya Allahu bidurrin hal hunna kashifatu durrihi aw aradanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikatu rahmatihi qul hasbiya Allahu AAalayhi yatawakkalu almutawakkiloona
39.translation: And verily, if thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they will say: Allah. Say: Bethink you then of those ye worship beside Allah, if Allah willed some hurt for me, could they remove from me His hurt; or if He willed some mercy for me, could they restrain His mercy? Say: Allah is my all. In Him do (all) the trusting put their trust

39.arabic: قُل يٰقَومِ اعمَلوا عَلىٰ مَكانَتِكُم إِنّى عٰمِلٌ فَسَوفَ تَعلَمونَ
39.transliteration: Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona
39.translation: Say: O my people! Act in your manner. Lo! I (too) am acting. Thus ye will come to know

39.arabic: مَن يَأتيهِ عَذابٌ يُخزيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيهِ عَذابٌ مُقيمٌ
39.transliteration: Man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi wayahillu AAalayhi AAathabun muqeemun
39.translation: Who it is unto whom cometh a doom that will abase him, and on whom there falleth everlasting doom

39.arabic: إِنّا أَنزَلنا عَلَيكَ الكِتٰبَ لِلنّاسِ بِالحَقِّ فَمَنِ اهتَدىٰ فَلِنَفسِهِ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّما يَضِلُّ عَلَيها وَما أَنتَ عَلَيهِم بِوَكيلٍ
39.transliteration: Inna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba lilnnasi bialhaqqi famani ihtada falinafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin
39.translation: Lo! We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture for mankind with truth. Then whosoever goeth right it is for his soul, and whosoever strayeth, strayeth only to its hurt. And thou art not a warder over them

39.arabic: اللَّهُ يَتَوَفَّى الأَنفُسَ حينَ مَوتِها وَالَّتى لَم تَمُت فى مَنامِها فَيُمسِكُ الَّتى قَضىٰ عَلَيهَا المَوتَ وَيُرسِلُ الأُخرىٰ إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِقَومٍ يَتَفَكَّرونَ
39.transliteration: Allahu yatawaffa alanfusa heena mawtiha waallatee lam tamut fee manamiha fayumsiku allatee qada AAalayha almawta wayursilu alokhra ila ajalin musamman inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona
39.translation: Allah receiveth (men's) souls at the time of their death, and that (soul) which dieth not (yet) in its sleep. He keepeth that (soul) for which He hath ordained death and dismisseth the rest till an appointed term. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought

39.arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ شُفَعاءَ قُل أَوَلَو كانوا لا يَملِكونَ شَيـًٔا وَلا يَعقِلونَ
39.transliteration: Ami ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi shufaAAaa qul awalaw kanoo la yamlikoona shayan wala yaAAqiloona
39.translation: Or choose they intercessors other than Allah? Say: What! Even though they have power over nothing and have no intelligence

39.arabic: قُل لِلَّهِ الشَّفٰعَةُ جَميعًا لَهُ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ ثُمَّ إِلَيهِ تُرجَعونَ
39.transliteration: Qul lillahi alshshafaAAatu jameeAAan lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona
39.translation: Say: Unto Allah belongeth all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. And afterward unto Him ye will be brought back

39.arabic: وَإِذا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَحدَهُ اشمَأَزَّت قُلوبُ الَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِالءاخِرَةِ وَإِذا ذُكِرَ الَّذينَ مِن دونِهِ إِذا هُم يَستَبشِرونَ
39.transliteration: Waitha thukira Allahu wahdahu ishmaazzat quloobu allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati waitha thukira allatheena min doonihi itha hum yastabshiroona
39.translation: And when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are repelled, and when those (whom they worship) beside Him are mentioned, behold! they are glad

39.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ فاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ عٰلِمَ الغَيبِ وَالشَّهٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحكُمُ بَينَ عِبادِكَ فى ما كانوا فيهِ يَختَلِفونَ
39.transliteration: Quli allahumma fatira alssamawati waalardi AAalima alghaybi waalshshahadati anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika fee ma kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona
39.translation: Say: O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! Thou wilt judge between Thy slaves concerning that wherein they used to differ

39.arabic: وَلَو أَنَّ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا ما فِى الأَرضِ جَميعًا وَمِثلَهُ مَعَهُ لَافتَدَوا بِهِ مِن سوءِ العَذابِ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ وَبَدا لَهُم مِنَ اللَّهِ ما لَم يَكونوا يَحتَسِبونَ
39.transliteration: Walaw anna lillatheena thalamoo ma fee alardi jameeAAan wamithlahu maAAahu laiftadaw bihi min sooi alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati wabada lahum mina Allahi ma lam yakoonoo yahtasiboona
39.translation: And though those who do wrong possess all that is in the earth, and therewith as much again, they verily will seek to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the awful doom; and there will appear unto them, from their Lord, that wherewith they never reckoned

39.arabic: وَبَدا لَهُم سَيِّـٔاتُ ما كَسَبوا وَحاقَ بِهِم ما كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
39.transliteration: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
39.translation: And the evils that they earned will appear unto them, and that whereat they used to scoff will surround them

39.arabic: فَإِذا مَسَّ الإِنسٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعانا ثُمَّ إِذا خَوَّلنٰهُ نِعمَةً مِنّا قالَ إِنَّما أوتيتُهُ عَلىٰ عِلمٍ بَل هِىَ فِتنَةٌ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَهُم لا يَعلَمونَ
39.transliteration: Faitha massa alinsana durrun daAAana thumma itha khawwalnahu niAAmatan minna qala innama ooteetuhu AAala AAilmin bal hiya fitnatun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
39.translation: Now when hurt toucheth a man he crieth unto Us, and afterward when We have granted him a boon from Us, he saith: Only by force of knowledge I obtained it. Nay, but it is a test. But most of them know not

39.arabic: قَد قالَهَا الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم فَما أَغنىٰ عَنهُم ما كانوا يَكسِبونَ
39.transliteration: Qad qalaha allatheena min qablihim fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona
39.translation: Those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not

39.arabic: فَأَصابَهُم سَيِّـٔاتُ ما كَسَبوا وَالَّذينَ ظَلَموا مِن هٰؤُلاءِ سَيُصيبُهُم سَيِّـٔاتُ ما كَسَبوا وَما هُم بِمُعجِزينَ
39.transliteration: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo waallatheena thalamoo min haolai sayuseebuhum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wama hum bimuAAjizeena
39.translation: But the evils that they earned smote them; and such of these as do wrong, the evils that they earn will smite them; they cannot escape

39.arabic: أَوَلَم يَعلَموا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَبسُطُ الرِّزقَ لِمَن يَشاءُ وَيَقدِرُ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِقَومٍ يُؤمِنونَ
39.transliteration: Awalam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona
39.translation: Know they not that Allah enlargeth providence for whom He will, and straiteneth it (for whom He will). Lo! herein verily are portents for people who believe

39.arabic: قُل يٰعِبادِىَ الَّذينَ أَسرَفوا عَلىٰ أَنفُسِهِم لا تَقنَطوا مِن رَحمَةِ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَغفِرُ الذُّنوبَ جَميعًا إِنَّهُ هُوَ الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ
39.transliteration: Qul ya AAibadiya allatheena asrafoo AAala anfusihim la taqnatoo min rahmati Allahi inna Allaha yaghfiru alththunooba jameeAAan innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu
39.translation: Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful

39.arabic: وَأَنيبوا إِلىٰ رَبِّكُم وَأَسلِموا لَهُ مِن قَبلِ أَن يَأتِيَكُمُ العَذابُ ثُمَّ لا تُنصَرونَ
39.transliteration: Waaneeboo ila rabbikum waaslimoo lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu thumma la tunsaroona
39.translation: Turn unto your Lord repentant, and surrender unto Him, before there come unto you the doom, when ye cannot be helped

39.arabic: وَاتَّبِعوا أَحسَنَ ما أُنزِلَ إِلَيكُم مِن رَبِّكُم مِن قَبلِ أَن يَأتِيَكُمُ العَذابُ بَغتَةً وَأَنتُم لا تَشعُرونَ
39.transliteration: WaittabiAAoo ahsana ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu baghtatan waantum la tashAAuroona
39.translation: And follow the better (guidance) of that which is revealed unto you from your Lord, before the doom cometh on you suddenly when ye know not

39.arabic: أَن تَقولَ نَفسٌ يٰحَسرَتىٰ عَلىٰ ما فَرَّطتُ فى جَنبِ اللَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ السّٰخِرينَ
39.transliteration: An taqoola nafsun ya hasrata AAala ma farrattu fee janbi Allahi wain kuntu lamina alssakhireena
39.translation: Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah, and I was indeed among the scoffers

39.arabic: أَو تَقولَ لَو أَنَّ اللَّهَ هَدىٰنى لَكُنتُ مِنَ المُتَّقينَ
39.transliteration: Aw taqoola law anna Allaha hadanee lakuntu mina almuttaqeena
39.translation: Or should say: If Allah had but guided me I should have been among the dutiful

39.arabic: أَو تَقولَ حينَ تَرَى العَذابَ لَو أَنَّ لى كَرَّةً فَأَكونَ مِنَ المُحسِنينَ
39.transliteration: Aw taqoola heena tara alAAathaba law anna lee karratan faakoona mina almuhsineena
39.translation: Or should say, when it seeth the doom: Oh, that I had but a second chance that I might be among the righteous

39.arabic: بَلىٰ قَد جاءَتكَ ءايٰتى فَكَذَّبتَ بِها وَاستَكبَرتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ الكٰفِرينَ
39.transliteration: Bala qad jaatka ayatee fakaththabta biha waistakbarta wakunta mina alkafireena
39.translation: (But now the answer will be): Nay, for My revelations came unto thee, but thou didst deny them and wast scornful and wast among the disbelievers

39.arabic: وَيَومَ القِيٰمَةِ تَرَى الَّذينَ كَذَبوا عَلَى اللَّهِ وُجوهُهُم مُسوَدَّةٌ أَلَيسَ فى جَهَنَّمَ مَثوًى لِلمُتَكَبِّرينَ
39.transliteration: Wayawma alqiyamati tara allatheena kathaboo AAala Allahi wujoohuhum muswaddatun alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilmutakabbireena
39.translation: And on the Day of Resurrection thou (Muhammad) seest those who lied concerning Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the home of the scorners in hell

39.arabic: وَيُنَجِّى اللَّهُ الَّذينَ اتَّقَوا بِمَفازَتِهِم لا يَمَسُّهُمُ السّوءُ وَلا هُم يَحزَنونَ
39.transliteration: Wayunajjee Allahu allatheena ittaqaw bimafazatihim la yamassuhumu alssooo wala hum yahzanoona
39.translation: And Allah delivereth those who ward off (evil) because of their deserts. Evil toucheth them not, nor do they grieve

39.arabic: اللَّهُ خٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيءٍ وَهُوَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ وَكيلٌ
39.transliteration: Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa AAala kulli shayin wakeelun
39.translation: Allah is Creator of all things, and He is Guardian over all things

39.arabic: لَهُ مَقاليدُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا بِـٔايٰتِ اللَّهِ أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الخٰسِرونَ
39.transliteration: Lahu maqaleedu alssamawati waalardi waallatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi olaika humu alkhasiroona
39.translation: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth, and they who disbelieve the revelations of Allah - such are they who are the losers

39.arabic: قُل أَفَغَيرَ اللَّهِ تَأمُرونّى أَعبُدُ أَيُّهَا الجٰهِلونَ
39.transliteration: Qul afaghayra Allahi tamuroonnee aAAbudu ayyuha aljahiloona
39.translation: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Do ye bid me serve other than Allah? O ye fools

39.arabic: وَلَقَد أوحِىَ إِلَيكَ وَإِلَى الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِكَ لَئِن أَشرَكتَ لَيَحبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكونَنَّ مِنَ الخٰسِرينَ
39.transliteration: Walaqad oohiya ilayka waila allatheena min qablika lain ashrakta layahbatanna AAamaluka walatakoonanna mina alkhasireena
39.translation: And verily it hath been revealed unto thee as unto those before thee (saying): If thou ascribe a partner to Allah thy work will fail and thou indeed wilt be among the losers

39.arabic: بَلِ اللَّهَ فَاعبُد وَكُن مِنَ الشّٰكِرينَ
39.transliteration: Bali Allaha faoAAbud wakun mina alshshakireena
39.translation: Nay, but Allah must thou serve, and be among the thankful

39.arabic: وَما قَدَرُوا اللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدرِهِ وَالأَرضُ جَميعًا قَبضَتُهُ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ وَالسَّمٰوٰتُ مَطوِيّٰتٌ بِيَمينِهِ سُبحٰنَهُ وَتَعٰلىٰ عَمّا يُشرِكونَ
39.transliteration: Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi waalardu jameeAAan qabdatuhu yawma alqiyamati waalssamawatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona
39.translation: And they esteem not Allah as He hath the right to be esteemed, when the whole earth is His handful on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens are rolled in His right hand. Glorified is He and High Exalted from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

39.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَن فِى الأَرضِ إِلّا مَن شاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فيهِ أُخرىٰ فَإِذا هُم قِيامٌ يَنظُرونَ
39.transliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori fasaAAiqa man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu thumma nufikha feehi okhra faitha hum qiyamun yanthuroona
39.translation: And the trumpet is blown, and all who are in the heavens and all who are in the earth swoon away, save him whom Allah willeth. Then it is blown a second time, and behold them standing waiting

39.arabic: وَأَشرَقَتِ الأَرضُ بِنورِ رَبِّها وَوُضِعَ الكِتٰبُ وَجِا۟يءَ بِالنَّبِيّۦنَ وَالشُّهَداءِ وَقُضِىَ بَينَهُم بِالحَقِّ وَهُم لا يُظلَمونَ
39.transliteration: Waashraqati alardu binoori rabbiha wawudiAAa alkitabu wajeea bialnnabiyyeena waalshshuhadai waqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona
39.translation: And the earth shineth with the light of her Lord, and the Book is set up, and the prophets and the witnesses are brought, and it is judged between them with truth, and they are not wronged

39.arabic: وَوُفِّيَت كُلُّ نَفسٍ ما عَمِلَت وَهُوَ أَعلَمُ بِما يَفعَلونَ
39.transliteration: Wawuffiyat kullu nafsin ma AAamilat wahuwa aAAlamu bima yafAAaloona
39.translation: And each soul is paid in full for what it did. And He is Best Aware of what they do

39.arabic: وَسيقَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا إِلىٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَرًا حَتّىٰ إِذا جاءوها فُتِحَت أَبوٰبُها وَقالَ لَهُم خَزَنَتُها أَلَم يَأتِكُم رُسُلٌ مِنكُم يَتلونَ عَلَيكُم ءايٰتِ رَبِّكُم وَيُنذِرونَكُم لِقاءَ يَومِكُم هٰذا قالوا بَلىٰ وَلٰكِن حَقَّت كَلِمَةُ العَذابِ عَلَى الكٰفِرينَ
39.transliteration: Waseeqa allatheena kafaroo ila jahannama zumaran hatta itha jaooha futihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatloona AAalaykum ayati rabbikum wayunthiroonakum liqaa yawmikum hatha qaloo bala walakin haqqat kalimatu alAAathabi AAala alkafireena
