42.arabic: إِنَّمَا السَّبيلُ عَلَى الَّذينَ يَظلِمونَ النّاسَ وَيَبغونَ فِى الأَرضِ بِغَيرِ الحَقِّ أُولٰئِكَ لَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
42.transliteration: Innama alssabeelu AAala allatheena yathlimoona alnnasa wayabghoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi olaika lahum AAathabun aleemun
42.translation: The way (of blame) is only against those who oppress mankind, and wrongfully rebel in the earth. For such there is a painful doom

42.arabic: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمِن عَزمِ الأُمورِ
42.transliteration: Walaman sabara waghafara inna thalika lamin AAazmi alomoori
42.translation: And verily whoso is patient and forgiveth - lo! that, verily, is (of) the steadfast heart of things

42.arabic: وَمَن يُضلِلِ اللَّهُ فَما لَهُ مِن وَلِىٍّ مِن بَعدِهِ وَتَرَى الظّٰلِمينَ لَمّا رَأَوُا العَذابَ يَقولونَ هَل إِلىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِن سَبيلٍ
42.transliteration: Waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min waliyyin min baAAdihi watara alththalimeena lamma raawoo alAAathaba yaqooloona hal ila maraddin min sabeelin
42.translation: He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no protecting friend after Him. And thou (Muhammad) wilt see the evil-doers when they see the doom, (how) they say: Is there any way of return

42.arabic: وَتَرىٰهُم يُعرَضونَ عَلَيها خٰشِعينَ مِنَ الذُّلِّ يَنظُرونَ مِن طَرفٍ خَفِىٍّ وَقالَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِنَّ الخٰسِرينَ الَّذينَ خَسِروا أَنفُسَهُم وَأَهليهِم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ أَلا إِنَّ الظّٰلِمينَ فى عَذابٍ مُقيمٍ
42.transliteration: Watarahum yuAAradoona AAalayha khashiAAeena mina alththulli yanthuroona min tarfin khafiyyin waqala allatheena amanoo inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala inna alththalimeena fee AAathabin muqeemin
42.translation: And thou wilt see them exposed to (the Fire), made humble by disgrace, and looking with veiled eyes. And those who believe will say: Lo! the (eternal) losers are they who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! are not the wrong-doers in perpetual torment

42.arabic: وَما كانَ لَهُم مِن أَولِياءَ يَنصُرونَهُم مِن دونِ اللَّهِ وَمَن يُضلِلِ اللَّهُ فَما لَهُ مِن سَبيلٍ
42.transliteration: Wama kana lahum min awliyaa yansuroonahum min dooni Allahi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min sabeelin
42.translation: And they will have no protecting friends to help them instead of Allah. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no road

42.arabic: استَجيبوا لِرَبِّكُم مِن قَبلِ أَن يَأتِىَ يَومٌ لا مَرَدَّ لَهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ ما لَكُم مِن مَلجَإٍ يَومَئِذٍ وَما لَكُم مِن نَكيرٍ
42.transliteration: Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi ma lakum min maljain yawmaithin wama lakum min nakeerin
42.translation: Answer the call of your Lord before there cometh unto you from Allah a Day which there is no averting. Ye have no refuge on that Day, nor have a ye any (power of) refusal

42.arabic: فَإِن أَعرَضوا فَما أَرسَلنٰكَ عَلَيهِم حَفيظًا إِن عَلَيكَ إِلَّا البَلٰغُ وَإِنّا إِذا أَذَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ مِنّا رَحمَةً فَرِحَ بِها وَإِن تُصِبهُم سَيِّئَةٌ بِما قَدَّمَت أَيديهِم فَإِنَّ الإِنسٰنَ كَفورٌ
42.transliteration: Fain aAAradoo fama arsalnaka AAalayhim hafeethan in AAalayka illa albalaghu wainna itha athaqna alinsana minna rahmatan fariha biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fainna alinsana kafoorun
42.translation: But if they are averse, We have not sent thee as a warder over them. Thine is only to convey (the message). And lo! when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us he exulteth therefor. And if some evil striketh them because of that which their own hands have sent before, then lo! man is an ingrate

42.arabic: لِلَّهِ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ يَخلُقُ ما يَشاءُ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشاءُ إِنٰثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشاءُ الذُّكورَ
42.transliteration: Lillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yakhluqu ma yashao yahabu liman yashao inathan wayahabu liman yashao alththukoora
42.translation: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He createth what He will. He bestoweth female (offspring) upon whom He will, and bestoweth male (offspring) upon whom He will

42.arabic: أَو يُزَوِّجُهُم ذُكرانًا وَإِنٰثًا وَيَجعَلُ مَن يَشاءُ عَقيمًا إِنَّهُ عَليمٌ قَديرٌ
42.transliteration: Aw yuzawwijuhum thukranan wainathan wayajAAalu man yashao AAaqeeman innahu AAaleemun qadeerun
42.translation: Or He mingleth them, males and females, and He maketh barren whom He will. Lo! He is Knower, Powerful

42.arabic: وَما كانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ اللَّهُ إِلّا وَحيًا أَو مِن وَرائِ حِجابٍ أَو يُرسِلَ رَسولًا فَيوحِىَ بِإِذنِهِ ما يَشاءُ إِنَّهُ عَلِىٌّ حَكيمٌ
42.transliteration: Wama kana libasharin an yukallimahu Allahu illa wahyan aw min warai hijabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya biithnihi ma yashao innahu AAaliyyun hakeemun
42.translation: And it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil, or (that) He sendeth a messenger to reveal what He will by His leave. Lo! He is Exalted, Wise

42.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَوحَينا إِلَيكَ روحًا مِن أَمرِنا ما كُنتَ تَدرى مَا الكِتٰبُ وَلَا الإيمٰنُ وَلٰكِن جَعَلنٰهُ نورًا نَهدى بِهِ مَن نَشاءُ مِن عِبادِنا وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهدى إِلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
42.transliteration: Wakathalika awhayna ilayka roohan min amrina ma kunta tadree ma alkitabu wala aleemanu walakin jaAAalnahu nooran nahdee bihi man nashao min AAibadina wainnaka latahdee ila siratin mustaqeemin
42.translation: And thus have We inspired in thee (Muhammad) a Spirit of Our command. Thou knewest not what the Scripture was, nor what the Faith. But We have made it a light whereby We guide whom We will of Our bondmen. And lo! thou verily dost guide unto a right path

42.arabic: صِرٰطِ اللَّهِ الَّذى لَهُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ أَلا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَصيرُ الأُمورُ
42.transliteration: Sirati Allahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi ala ila Allahi taseeru alomooru
42.translation: The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Do not all things reach Allah at last

43.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ حم
43.transliteration: Hameem
43.translation: Ha. Mim

43.arabic: وَالكِتٰبِ المُبينِ
43.transliteration: Waalkitabi almubeeni
43.translation: By the Scripture which maketh plain

43.arabic: إِنّا جَعَلنٰهُ قُرءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَعَلَّكُم تَعقِلونَ
43.transliteration: Inna jaAAalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona
43.translation: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand

43.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ فى أُمِّ الكِتٰبِ لَدَينا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكيمٌ
43.transliteration: Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna laAAaliyyun hakeemun
43.translation: And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive

43.arabic: أَفَنَضرِبُ عَنكُمُ الذِّكرَ صَفحًا أَن كُنتُم قَومًا مُسرِفينَ
43.transliteration: Afanadribu AAankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena
43.translation: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk

43.arabic: وَكَم أَرسَلنا مِن نَبِىٍّ فِى الأَوَّلينَ
43.transliteration: Wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena
43.translation: How many a prophet did We send among the men of old

43.arabic: وَما يَأتيهِم مِن نَبِىٍّ إِلّا كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
43.transliteration: Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona
43.translation: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him

43.arabic: فَأَهلَكنا أَشَدَّ مِنهُم بَطشًا وَمَضىٰ مَثَلُ الأَوَّلينَ
43.transliteration: Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena
43.translation: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them)

43.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلتَهُم مَن خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ لَيَقولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ العَزيزُ العَليمُ
43.transliteration: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna alAAazeezu alAAaleemu
43.translation: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them

43.arabic: الَّذى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الأَرضَ مَهدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم فيها سُبُلًا لَعَلَّكُم تَهتَدونَ
43.transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wajaAAala lakum feeha subulan laAAallakum tahtadoona
43.translation: Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way

43.arabic: وَالَّذى نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرنا بِهِ بَلدَةً مَيتًا كَذٰلِكَ تُخرَجونَ
43.transliteration: Waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona
43.translation: And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth

43.arabic: وَالَّذى خَلَقَ الأَزوٰجَ كُلَّها وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِنَ الفُلكِ وَالأَنعٰمِ ما تَركَبونَ
43.transliteration: Waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha wajaAAala lakum mina alfulki waalanAAami ma tarkaboona
43.translation: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride

43.arabic: لِتَستَوۥا عَلىٰ ظُهورِهِ ثُمَّ تَذكُروا نِعمَةَ رَبِّكُم إِذَا استَوَيتُم عَلَيهِ وَتَقولوا سُبحٰنَ الَّذى سَخَّرَ لَنا هٰذا وَما كُنّا لَهُ مُقرِنينَ
43.transliteration: Litastawoo AAala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo niAAmata rabbikum itha istawaytum AAalayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena
43.translation: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them)

43.arabic: وَإِنّا إِلىٰ رَبِّنا لَمُنقَلِبونَ
43.transliteration: Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona
43.translation: And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning

43.arabic: وَجَعَلوا لَهُ مِن عِبادِهِ جُزءًا إِنَّ الإِنسٰنَ لَكَفورٌ مُبينٌ
43.transliteration: WajaAAaloo lahu min AAibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun
43.translation: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate

43.arabic: أَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمّا يَخلُقُ بَناتٍ وَأَصفىٰكُم بِالبَنينَ
43.transliteration: Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena
43.translation: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons

43.arabic: وَإِذا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِما ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحمٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجهُهُ مُسوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظيمٌ
43.transliteration: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun
43.translation: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage

43.arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى الحِليَةِ وَهُوَ فِى الخِصامِ غَيرُ مُبينٍ
43.transliteration: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin
43.translation: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain

43.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا المَلٰئِكَةَ الَّذينَ هُم عِبٰدُ الرَّحمٰنِ إِنٰثًا أَشَهِدوا خَلقَهُم سَتُكتَبُ شَهٰدَتُهُم وَيُسـَٔلونَ
43.transliteration: WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona
43.translation: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned

43.arabic: وَقالوا لَو شاءَ الرَّحمٰنُ ما عَبَدنٰهُم ما لَهُم بِذٰلِكَ مِن عِلمٍ إِن هُم إِلّا يَخرُصونَ
43.transliteration: Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona
43.translation: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess

43.arabic: أَم ءاتَينٰهُم كِتٰبًا مِن قَبلِهِ فَهُم بِهِ مُستَمسِكونَ
43.transliteration: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona
43.translation: Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur'an) so that they are holding fast thereto

43.arabic: بَل قالوا إِنّا وَجَدنا ءاباءَنا عَلىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنّا عَلىٰ ءاثٰرِهِم مُهتَدونَ
43.transliteration: Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona
43.translation: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints

43.arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ ما أَرسَلنا مِن قَبلِكَ فى قَريَةٍ مِن نَذيرٍ إِلّا قالَ مُترَفوها إِنّا وَجَدنا ءاباءَنا عَلىٰ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنّا عَلىٰ ءاثٰرِهِم مُقتَدونَ
43.transliteration: Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona
43.translation: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints

43.arabic: قٰلَ أَوَلَو جِئتُكُم بِأَهدىٰ مِمّا وَجَدتُم عَلَيهِ ءاباءَكُم قالوا إِنّا بِما أُرسِلتُم بِهِ كٰفِرونَ
43.transliteration: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona
43.translation: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers

43.arabic: فَانتَقَمنا مِنهُم فَانظُر كَيفَ كانَ عٰقِبَةُ المُكَذِّبينَ
43.transliteration: Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena
43.translation: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters

43.arabic: وَإِذ قالَ إِبرٰهيمُ لِأَبيهِ وَقَومِهِ إِنَّنى بَراءٌ مِمّا تَعبُدونَ
43.transliteration: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona
43.translation: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship

43.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذى فَطَرَنى فَإِنَّهُ سَيَهدينِ
43.transliteration: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni
43.translation: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me

43.arabic: وَجَعَلَها كَلِمَةً باقِيَةً فى عَقِبِهِ لَعَلَّهُم يَرجِعونَ
43.transliteration: WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona
43.translation: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return

43.arabic: بَل مَتَّعتُ هٰؤُلاءِ وَءاباءَهُم حَتّىٰ جاءَهُمُ الحَقُّ وَرَسولٌ مُبينٌ
43.transliteration: Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun
43.translation: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain

43.arabic: وَلَمّا جاءَهُمُ الحَقُّ قالوا هٰذا سِحرٌ وَإِنّا بِهِ كٰفِرونَ
43.transliteration: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona
43.translation: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein

43.arabic: وَقالوا لَولا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا القُرءانُ عَلىٰ رَجُلٍ مِنَ القَريَتَينِ عَظيمٍ
43.transliteration: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun
43.translation: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns

43.arabic: أَهُم يَقسِمونَ رَحمَتَ رَبِّكَ نَحنُ قَسَمنا بَينَهُم مَعيشَتَهُم فِى الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا وَرَفَعنا بَعضَهُم فَوقَ بَعضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِيَتَّخِذَ بَعضُهُم بَعضًا سُخرِيًّا وَرَحمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيرٌ مِمّا يَجمَعونَ
43.transliteration: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona
43.translation: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass

43.arabic: وَلَولا أَن يَكونَ النّاسُ أُمَّةً وٰحِدَةً لَجَعَلنا لِمَن يَكفُرُ بِالرَّحمٰنِ لِبُيوتِهِم سُقُفًا مِن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعارِجَ عَلَيها يَظهَرونَ
43.transliteration: Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona
43.translation: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount

43.arabic: وَلِبُيوتِهِم أَبوٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيها يَتَّكِـٔونَ
43.transliteration: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona
43.translation: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline

43.arabic: وَزُخرُفًا وَإِن كُلُّ ذٰلِكَ لَمّا مَتٰعُ الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا وَالءاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلمُتَّقينَ
43.transliteration: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena
43.translation: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil

43.arabic: وَمَن يَعشُ عَن ذِكرِ الرَّحمٰنِ نُقَيِّض لَهُ شَيطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُ قَرينٌ
43.transliteration: Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun
43.translation: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade

43.arabic: وَإِنَّهُم لَيَصُدّونَهُم عَنِ السَّبيلِ وَيَحسَبونَ أَنَّهُم مُهتَدونَ
43.transliteration: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona
43.translation: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided

43.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا جاءَنا قالَ يٰلَيتَ بَينى وَبَينَكَ بُعدَ المَشرِقَينِ فَبِئسَ القَرينُ
43.transliteration: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu
43.translation: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade

43.arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ اليَومَ إِذ ظَلَمتُم أَنَّكُم فِى العَذابِ مُشتَرِكونَ
43.transliteration: Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona
43.translation: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom

43.arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسمِعُ الصُّمَّ أَو تَهدِى العُمىَ وَمَن كانَ فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
43.transliteration: Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin
43.translation: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest

43.arabic: فَإِمّا نَذهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنّا مِنهُم مُنتَقِمونَ
43.transliteration: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona
43.translation: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them

43.arabic: أَو نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذى وَعَدنٰهُم فَإِنّا عَلَيهِم مُقتَدِرونَ
43.transliteration: Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona
43.translation: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them

43.arabic: فَاستَمسِك بِالَّذى أوحِىَ إِلَيكَ إِنَّكَ عَلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
43.transliteration: Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin
43.translation: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path

43.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَذِكرٌ لَكَ وَلِقَومِكَ وَسَوفَ تُسـَٔلونَ
43.transliteration: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona
43.translation: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned

43.arabic: وَسـَٔل مَن أَرسَلنا مِن قَبلِكَ مِن رُسُلِنا أَجَعَلنا مِن دونِ الرَّحمٰنِ ءالِهَةً يُعبَدونَ
43.transliteration: Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona
43.translation: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent

43.arabic: وَلَقَد أَرسَلنا موسىٰ بِـٔايٰتِنا إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِ فَقالَ إِنّى رَسولُ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
43.transliteration: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena
43.translation: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds

43.arabic: فَلَمّا جاءَهُم بِـٔايٰتِنا إِذا هُم مِنها يَضحَكونَ
43.transliteration: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona
43.translation: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them

43.arabic: وَما نُريهِم مِن ءايَةٍ إِلّا هِىَ أَكبَرُ مِن أُختِها وَأَخَذنٰهُم بِالعَذابِ لَعَلَّهُم يَرجِعونَ
43.transliteration: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona
43.translation: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again

43.arabic: وَقالوا يٰأَيُّهَ السّاحِرُ ادعُ لَنا رَبَّكَ بِما عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنا لَمُهتَدونَ
43.transliteration: Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona
43.translation: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright

43.arabic: فَلَمّا كَشَفنا عَنهُمُ العَذابَ إِذا هُم يَنكُثونَ
43.transliteration: Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona
43.translation: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word

43.arabic: وَنادىٰ فِرعَونُ فى قَومِهِ قالَ يٰقَومِ أَلَيسَ لى مُلكُ مِصرَ وَهٰذِهِ الأَنهٰرُ تَجرى مِن تَحتى أَفَلا تُبصِرونَ
43.transliteration: Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona
43.translation: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern

43.arabic: أَم أَنا۠ خَيرٌ مِن هٰذَا الَّذى هُوَ مَهينٌ وَلا يَكادُ يُبينُ
43.transliteration: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu
43.translation: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain

43.arabic: فَلَولا أُلقِىَ عَلَيهِ أَسوِرَةٌ مِن ذَهَبٍ أَو جاءَ مَعَهُ المَلٰئِكَةُ مُقتَرِنينَ
43.transliteration: Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena
43.translation: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him

43.arabic: فَاستَخَفَّ قَومَهُ فَأَطاعوهُ إِنَّهُم كانوا قَومًا فٰسِقينَ
43.transliteration: Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
43.translation: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk

43.arabic: فَلَمّا ءاسَفونَا انتَقَمنا مِنهُم فَأَغرَقنٰهُم أَجمَعينَ
43.transliteration: Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena
43.translation: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one

43.arabic: فَجَعَلنٰهُم سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِلءاخِرينَ
43.transliteration: FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena
43.translation: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them)

43.arabic: وَلَمّا ضُرِبَ ابنُ مَريَمَ مَثَلًا إِذا قَومُكَ مِنهُ يَصِدّونَ
43.transliteration: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona
43.translation: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out

43.arabic: وَقالوا ءَأٰلِهَتُنا خَيرٌ أَم هُوَ ما ضَرَبوهُ لَكَ إِلّا جَدَلًا بَل هُم قَومٌ خَصِمونَ
43.transliteration: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona
43.translation: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk

43.arabic: إِن هُوَ إِلّا عَبدٌ أَنعَمنا عَلَيهِ وَجَعَلنٰهُ مَثَلًا لِبَنى إِسرٰءيلَ
43.transliteration: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela
43.translation: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel

43.arabic: وَلَو نَشاءُ لَجَعَلنا مِنكُم مَلٰئِكَةً فِى الأَرضِ يَخلُفونَ
43.transliteration: Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona
43.translation: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth

43.arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلمٌ لِلسّاعَةِ فَلا تَمتَرُنَّ بِها وَاتَّبِعونِ هٰذا صِرٰطٌ مُستَقيمٌ
43.transliteration: Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun
43.translation: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path

43.arabic: وَلا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيطٰنُ إِنَّهُ لَكُم عَدُوٌّ مُبينٌ
43.transliteration: Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun
43.translation: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you

43.arabic: وَلَمّا جاءَ عيسىٰ بِالبَيِّنٰتِ قالَ قَد جِئتُكُم بِالحِكمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعضَ الَّذى تَختَلِفونَ فيهِ فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطيعونِ
43.transliteration: Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni
43.translation: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me

43.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ رَبّى وَرَبُّكُم فَاعبُدوهُ هٰذا صِرٰطٌ مُستَقيمٌ
43.transliteration: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun
43.translation: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path

43.arabic: فَاختَلَفَ الأَحزابُ مِن بَينِهِم فَوَيلٌ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا مِن عَذابِ يَومٍ أَليمٍ
43.transliteration: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin
43.translation: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day

43.arabic: هَل يَنظُرونَ إِلَّا السّاعَةَ أَن تَأتِيَهُم بَغتَةً وَهُم لا يَشعُرونَ
43.transliteration: Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona
43.translation: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not

43.arabic: الأَخِلّاءُ يَومَئِذٍ بَعضُهُم لِبَعضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا المُتَّقينَ
43.transliteration: Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena
43.translation: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah)

43.arabic: يٰعِبادِ لا خَوفٌ عَلَيكُمُ اليَومَ وَلا أَنتُم تَحزَنونَ
43.transliteration: Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona
43.translation: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve

43.arabic: الَّذينَ ءامَنوا بِـٔايٰتِنا وَكانوا مُسلِمينَ
43.transliteration: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena
43.translation: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered

43.arabic: ادخُلُوا الجَنَّةَ أَنتُم وَأَزوٰجُكُم تُحبَرونَ
43.transliteration: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona
43.translation: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad

43.arabic: يُطافُ عَلَيهِم بِصِحافٍ مِن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكوابٍ وَفيها ما تَشتَهيهِ الأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الأَعيُنُ وَأَنتُم فيها خٰلِدونَ
43.transliteration: Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona
43.translation: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein

43.arabic: وَتِلكَ الجَنَّةُ الَّتى أورِثتُموها بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
43.transliteration: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona
43.translation: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do

43.arabic: لَكُم فيها فٰكِهَةٌ كَثيرَةٌ مِنها تَأكُلونَ
43.transliteration: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona
43.translation: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat

43.arabic: إِنَّ المُجرِمينَ فى عَذابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدونَ
43.transliteration: Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona
43.translation: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment

43.arabic: لا يُفَتَّرُ عَنهُم وَهُم فيهِ مُبلِسونَ
43.transliteration: La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona
43.translation: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein

43.arabic: وَما ظَلَمنٰهُم وَلٰكِن كانوا هُمُ الظّٰلِمينَ
43.transliteration: Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena
43.translation: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong

43.arabic: وَنادَوا يٰمٰلِكُ لِيَقضِ عَلَينا رَبُّكَ قالَ إِنَّكُم مٰكِثونَ
43.transliteration: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona
43.translation: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain

43.arabic: لَقَد جِئنٰكُم بِالحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَكُم لِلحَقِّ كٰرِهونَ
43.transliteration: Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona
43.translation: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth

43.arabic: أَم أَبرَموا أَمرًا فَإِنّا مُبرِمونَ
43.transliteration: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona
43.translation: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining

43.arabic: أَم يَحسَبونَ أَنّا لا نَسمَعُ سِرَّهُم وَنَجوىٰهُم بَلىٰ وَرُسُلُنا لَدَيهِم يَكتُبونَ
43.transliteration: Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona
43.translation: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record

43.arabic: قُل إِن كانَ لِلرَّحمٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنا۠ أَوَّلُ العٰبِدينَ
43.transliteration: Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena
43.translation: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son)

43.arabic: سُبحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ رَبِّ العَرشِ عَمّا يَصِفونَ
43.transliteration: Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona
43.translation: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)

43.arabic: فَذَرهُم يَخوضوا وَيَلعَبوا حَتّىٰ يُلٰقوا يَومَهُمُ الَّذى يوعَدونَ
43.transliteration: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona
43.translation: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised

43.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى فِى السَّماءِ إِلٰهٌ وَفِى الأَرضِ إِلٰهٌ وَهُوَ الحَكيمُ العَليمُ
43.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu
43.translation: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower

43.arabic: وَتَبارَكَ الَّذى لَهُ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما وَعِندَهُ عِلمُ السّاعَةِ وَإِلَيهِ تُرجَعونَ
43.transliteration: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona
43.translation: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned

43.arabic: وَلا يَملِكُ الَّذينَ يَدعونَ مِن دونِهِ الشَّفٰعَةَ إِلّا مَن شَهِدَ بِالحَقِّ وَهُم يَعلَمونَ
43.transliteration: Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona
43.translation: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly

43.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلتَهُم مَن خَلَقَهُم لَيَقولُنَّ اللَّهُ فَأَنّىٰ يُؤفَكونَ
43.transliteration: Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona
43.translation: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away

43.arabic: وَقيلِهِ يٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ قَومٌ لا يُؤمِنونَ
43.transliteration: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona
43.translation: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not

43.arabic: فَاصفَح عَنهُم وَقُل سَلٰمٌ فَسَوفَ يَعلَمونَ
43.transliteration: Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona
43.translation: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know

44.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ حم
44.transliteration: Hameem
44.translation: Ha. Mim

44.arabic: وَالكِتٰبِ المُبينِ
44.transliteration: Waalkitabi almubeeni
44.translation: By the Scripture that maketh plain

44.arabic: إِنّا أَنزَلنٰهُ فى لَيلَةٍ مُبٰرَكَةٍ إِنّا كُنّا مُنذِرينَ
44.transliteration: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena
44.translation: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning

44.arabic: فيها يُفرَقُ كُلُّ أَمرٍ حَكيمٍ
44.transliteration: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin
44.translation: Whereon every wise command is made clear

44.arabic: أَمرًا مِن عِندِنا إِنّا كُنّا مُرسِلينَ
44.transliteration: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena
44.translation: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending

44.arabic: رَحمَةً مِن رَبِّكَ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّميعُ العَليمُ
44.transliteration: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu
44.translation: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower

44.arabic: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما إِن كُنتُم موقِنينَ
44.transliteration: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
44.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure

44.arabic: لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ يُحيۦ وَيُميتُ رَبُّكُم وَرَبُّ ءابائِكُمُ الأَوَّلينَ
44.transliteration: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena
44.translation: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers

44.arabic: بَل هُم فى شَكٍّ يَلعَبونَ
44.transliteration: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona
44.translation: Nay, but they play in doubt

44.arabic: فَارتَقِب يَومَ تَأتِى السَّماءُ بِدُخانٍ مُبينٍ
44.transliteration: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin
44.translation: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke

44.arabic: يَغشَى النّاسَ هٰذا عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
44.transliteration: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun
44.translation: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment

44.arabic: رَبَّنَا اكشِف عَنَّا العَذابَ إِنّا مُؤمِنونَ
44.transliteration: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona
44.translation: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers

44.arabic: أَنّىٰ لَهُمُ الذِّكرىٰ وَقَد جاءَهُم رَسولٌ مُبينٌ
44.transliteration: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun
44.translation: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them

44.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوا عَنهُ وَقالوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَجنونٌ
44.transliteration: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun
44.translation: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman

44.arabic: إِنّا كاشِفُوا العَذابِ قَليلًا إِنَّكُم عائِدونَ
44.transliteration: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona
44.translation: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief)

44.arabic: يَومَ نَبطِشُ البَطشَةَ الكُبرىٰ إِنّا مُنتَقِمونَ
44.transliteration: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona
44.translation: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish

44.arabic: وَلَقَد فَتَنّا قَبلَهُم قَومَ فِرعَونَ وَجاءَهُم رَسولٌ كَريمٌ
44.transliteration: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun
44.translation: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger

44.arabic: أَن أَدّوا إِلَىَّ عِبادَ اللَّهِ إِنّى لَكُم رَسولٌ أَمينٌ
44.transliteration: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun
44.translation: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

44.arabic: وَأَن لا تَعلوا عَلَى اللَّهِ إِنّى ءاتيكُم بِسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
44.transliteration: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin
44.translation: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant

44.arabic: وَإِنّى عُذتُ بِرَبّى وَرَبِّكُم أَن تَرجُمونِ
44.transliteration: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni
44.translation: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death

44.arabic: وَإِن لَم تُؤمِنوا لى فَاعتَزِلونِ
44.transliteration: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni
44.translation: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go

44.arabic: فَدَعا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ قَومٌ مُجرِمونَ
44.transliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona
44.translation: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk

44.arabic: فَأَسرِ بِعِبادى لَيلًا إِنَّكُم مُتَّبَعونَ
44.transliteration: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona
44.translation: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed

44.arabic: وَاترُكِ البَحرَ رَهوًا إِنَّهُم جُندٌ مُغرَقونَ
44.transliteration: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona
44.translation: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host

44.arabic: كَم تَرَكوا مِن جَنّٰتٍ وَعُيونٍ
44.transliteration: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin
44.translation: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind

44.arabic: وَزُروعٍ وَمَقامٍ كَريمٍ
44.transliteration: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin
44.translation: And the cornlands and the goodly sites

44.arabic: وَنَعمَةٍ كانوا فيها فٰكِهينَ
44.transliteration: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena
44.translation: And pleasant things wherein they took delight

44.arabic: كَذٰلِكَ وَأَورَثنٰها قَومًا ءاخَرينَ
44.transliteration: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena
44.translation: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk

44.arabic: فَما بَكَت عَلَيهِمُ السَّماءُ وَالأَرضُ وَما كانوا مُنظَرينَ
44.transliteration: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena
44.translation: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved

44.arabic: وَلَقَد نَجَّينا بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ مِنَ العَذابِ المُهينِ
44.transliteration: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni
44.translation: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom

44.arabic: مِن فِرعَونَ إِنَّهُ كانَ عالِيًا مِنَ المُسرِفينَ
44.transliteration: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena
44.translation: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones

44.arabic: وَلَقَدِ اختَرنٰهُم عَلىٰ عِلمٍ عَلَى العٰلَمينَ
44.transliteration: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena
44.translation: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures

44.arabic: وَءاتَينٰهُم مِنَ الءايٰتِ ما فيهِ بَلٰؤٌا۟ مُبينٌ
44.transliteration: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun
44.translation: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial

44.arabic: إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ لَيَقولونَ
44.transliteration: Inna haolai layaqooloona
44.translation: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying

44.arabic: إِن هِىَ إِلّا مَوتَتُنَا الأولىٰ وَما نَحنُ بِمُنشَرينَ
44.transliteration: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena
44.translation: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again

44.arabic: فَأتوا بِـٔابائِنا إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
44.transliteration: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena
44.translation: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth

44.arabic: أَهُم خَيرٌ أَم قَومُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم أَهلَكنٰهُم إِنَّهُم كانوا مُجرِمينَ
44.transliteration: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena
44.translation: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty

44.arabic: وَما خَلَقنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما لٰعِبينَ
44.transliteration: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena
44.translation: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play

44.arabic: ما خَلَقنٰهُما إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَهُم لا يَعلَمونَ
44.transliteration: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
44.translation: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not

44.arabic: إِنَّ يَومَ الفَصلِ ميقٰتُهُم أَجمَعينَ
44.transliteration: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena
44.translation: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them

44.arabic: يَومَ لا يُغنى مَولًى عَن مَولًى شَيـًٔا وَلا هُم يُنصَرونَ
44.transliteration: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona
44.translation: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped

44.arabic: إِلّا مَن رَحِمَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ العَزيزُ الرَّحيمُ
44.transliteration: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu
44.translation: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful

44.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقّومِ
44.transliteration: Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi
44.translation: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum

44.arabic: طَعامُ الأَثيمِ
44.transliteration: TaAAamu alatheemi
44.translation: The food of the sinner

44.arabic: كَالمُهلِ يَغلى فِى البُطونِ
44.transliteration: Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni
44.translation: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies

44.arabic: كَغَلىِ الحَميمِ
44.transliteration: Kaghalyi alhameemi
44.translation: As the seething of boiling water

44.arabic: خُذوهُ فَاعتِلوهُ إِلىٰ سَواءِ الجَحيمِ
44.transliteration: Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi
44.translation: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell

44.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبّوا فَوقَ رَأسِهِ مِن عَذابِ الحَميمِ
44.transliteration: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi
44.translation: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water

44.arabic: ذُق إِنَّكَ أَنتَ العَزيزُ الكَريمُ
44.transliteration: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu
44.translation: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble

44.arabic: إِنَّ هٰذا ما كُنتُم بِهِ تَمتَرونَ
44.transliteration: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona
44.translation: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt

44.arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى مَقامٍ أَمينٍ
44.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin
44.translation: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured

44.arabic: فى جَنّٰتٍ وَعُيونٍ
44.transliteration: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
44.translation: Amid gardens and watersprings

44.arabic: يَلبَسونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِستَبرَقٍ مُتَقٰبِلينَ
44.transliteration: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena
44.translation: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another

44.arabic: كَذٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجنٰهُم بِحورٍ عينٍ
44.transliteration: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin
44.translation: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

44.arabic: يَدعونَ فيها بِكُلِّ فٰكِهَةٍ ءامِنينَ
44.transliteration: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena
44.translation: They call therein for every fruit in safety

44.arabic: لا يَذوقونَ فيهَا المَوتَ إِلَّا المَوتَةَ الأولىٰ وَوَقىٰهُم عَذابَ الجَحيمِ
44.transliteration: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi
44.translation: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell

44.arabic: فَضلًا مِن رَبِّكَ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الفَوزُ العَظيمُ
44.transliteration: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu
44.translation: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph

44.arabic: فَإِنَّما يَسَّرنٰهُ بِلِسانِكَ لَعَلَّهُم يَتَذَكَّرونَ
44.transliteration: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona
44.translation: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed

44.arabic: فَارتَقِب إِنَّهُم مُرتَقِبونَ
44.transliteration: Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona
44.translation: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting

45.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ حم
45.transliteration: Hameem
45.translation: Ha. Mim

45.arabic: تَنزيلُ الكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللَّهِ العَزيزِ الحَكيمِ
45.transliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi
45.translation: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise

45.arabic: إِنَّ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ لَءايٰتٍ لِلمُؤمِنينَ
45.transliteration: Inna fee alssamawati waalardi laayatin lilmumineena
45.translation: Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers

45.arabic: وَفى خَلقِكُم وَما يَبُثُّ مِن دابَّةٍ ءايٰتٌ لِقَومٍ يوقِنونَ
45.transliteration: Wafee khalqikum wama yabuththu min dabbatin ayatun liqawmin yooqinoona
45.translation: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure

45.arabic: وَاختِلٰفِ الَّيلِ وَالنَّهارِ وَما أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّماءِ مِن رِزقٍ فَأَحيا بِهِ الأَرضَ بَعدَ مَوتِها وَتَصريفِ الرِّيٰحِ ءايٰتٌ لِقَومٍ يَعقِلونَ
45.transliteration: Waikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari wama anzala Allahu mina alssamai min rizqin faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha watasreefi alrriyahi ayatun liqawmin yaAAqiloona
45.translation: And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense

45.arabic: تِلكَ ءايٰتُ اللَّهِ نَتلوها عَلَيكَ بِالحَقِّ فَبِأَىِّ حَديثٍ بَعدَ اللَّهِ وَءايٰتِهِ يُؤمِنونَ
45.transliteration: Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha AAalayka bialhaqqi fabiayyi hadeethin baAAda Allahi waayatihi yuminoona
45.translation: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth. Then in what fact, after Allah and His portents, will they believe

45.arabic: وَيلٌ لِكُلِّ أَفّاكٍ أَثيمٍ
45.transliteration: Waylun likulli affakin atheemin
45.translation: Woe unto each sinful liar

45.arabic: يَسمَعُ ءايٰتِ اللَّهِ تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُستَكبِرًا كَأَن لَم يَسمَعها فَبَشِّرهُ بِعَذابٍ أَليمٍ
45.transliteration: YasmaAAu ayati Allahi tutla AAalayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran kaan lam yasmaAAha fabashshirhu biAAathabin aleemin
45.translation: Who heareth the revelations of Allah recited unto him, and then continueth in pride as though he heard them not. Give him tidings of a painful doom

45.arabic: وَإِذا عَلِمَ مِن ءايٰتِنا شَيـًٔا اتَّخَذَها هُزُوًا أُولٰئِكَ لَهُم عَذابٌ مُهينٌ
45.transliteration: Waitha AAalima min ayatina shayan ittakhathaha huzuwan olaika lahum AAathabun muheenun
45.translation: And when he knoweth aught of Our revelations he maketh it a jest. For such there is a shameful doom

45.arabic: مِن وَرائِهِم جَهَنَّمُ وَلا يُغنى عَنهُم ما كَسَبوا شَيـًٔا وَلا مَا اتَّخَذوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ أَولِياءَ وَلَهُم عَذابٌ عَظيمٌ
45.transliteration: Min waraihim jahannamu wala yughnee AAanhum ma kasaboo shayan wala ma ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa walahum AAathabun AAatheemun
45.translation: Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom

45.arabic: هٰذا هُدًى وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا بِـٔايٰتِ رَبِّهِم لَهُم عَذابٌ مِن رِجزٍ أَليمٌ
45.transliteration: Hatha hudan waallatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim lahum AAathabun min rijzin aleemin
45.translation: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath

45.arabic: اللَّهُ الَّذى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ البَحرَ لِتَجرِىَ الفُلكُ فيهِ بِأَمرِهِ وَلِتَبتَغوا مِن فَضلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُم تَشكُرونَ
45.transliteration: Allahu allathee sakhkhara lakumu albahra litajriya alfulku feehi biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona
45.translation: Allah it is Who hath made the sea of service unto you that the ships may run thereon by His command, and that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful

45.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ جَميعًا مِنهُ إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِقَومٍ يَتَفَكَّرونَ
45.transliteration: Wasakhkhara lakum ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi jameeAAan minhu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona
45.translation: And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect

45.arabic: قُل لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا يَغفِروا لِلَّذينَ لا يَرجونَ أَيّامَ اللَّهِ لِيَجزِىَ قَومًا بِما كانوا يَكسِبونَ
45.transliteration: Qul lillatheena amanoo yaghfiroo lillatheena la yarjoona ayyama Allahi liyajziya qawman bima kanoo yaksiboona
45.translation: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn

45.arabic: مَن عَمِلَ صٰلِحًا فَلِنَفسِهِ وَمَن أَساءَ فَعَلَيها ثُمَّ إِلىٰ رَبِّكُم تُرجَعونَ
45.transliteration: Man AAamila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa faAAalayha thumma ila rabbikum turjaAAoona
45.translation: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back

45.arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ الكِتٰبَ وَالحُكمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقنٰهُم مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَفَضَّلنٰهُم عَلَى العٰلَمينَ
45.transliteration: Walaqad atayna banee israeela alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati wafaddalnahum AAala alAAalameena
45.translation: And verily we gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and the Command and the Prophethood, and provided them with good things and favoured them above (all) peoples

45.arabic: وَءاتَينٰهُم بَيِّنٰتٍ مِنَ الأَمرِ فَمَا اختَلَفوا إِلّا مِن بَعدِ ما جاءَهُمُ العِلمُ بَغيًا بَينَهُم إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقضى بَينَهُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ فيما كانوا فيهِ يَختَلِفونَ
45.transliteration: Waataynahum bayyinatin mina alamri fama ikhtalafoo illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona
45.translation: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ

45.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلنٰكَ عَلىٰ شَريعَةٍ مِنَ الأَمرِ فَاتَّبِعها وَلا تَتَّبِع أَهواءَ الَّذينَ لا يَعلَمونَ
45.transliteration: Thumma jaAAalnaka AAala shareeAAatin mina alamri faittabiAAha wala tattabiAA ahwaa allatheena la yaAAlamoona
45.translation: And now have We set thee (O Muhammad) on a clear road of (Our) commandment; so follow it, and follow not the whims of those who know not

45.arabic: إِنَّهُم لَن يُغنوا عَنكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيـًٔا وَإِنَّ الظّٰلِمينَ بَعضُهُم أَولِياءُ بَعضٍ وَاللَّهُ وَلِىُّ المُتَّقينَ
45.transliteration: Innahum lan yughnoo AAanka mina Allahi shayan wainna alththalimeena baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin waAllahu waliyyu almuttaqeena
45.translation: Lo! they can avail thee naught against Allah. And lo! as for the wrong-doers, some of them are friends of others; and Allah is the Friend of those who ward off (evil)

45.arabic: هٰذا بَصٰئِرُ لِلنّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحمَةٌ لِقَومٍ يوقِنونَ
45.transliteration: Hatha basairu lilnnasi wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yooqinoona
45.translation: This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure

45.arabic: أَم حَسِبَ الَّذينَ اجتَرَحُوا السَّيِّـٔاتِ أَن نَجعَلَهُم كَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَواءً مَحياهُم وَمَماتُهُم ساءَ ما يَحكُمونَ
45.transliteration: Am hasiba allatheena ijtarahoo alssayyiati an najAAalahum kaallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sawaan mahyahum wamamatuhum saa ma yahkumoona
45.translation: Or do those who commit ill-deeds suppose that We shall make them as those who believe and do good works, the same in life and death? Bad is their judgment

45.arabic: وَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بِالحَقِّ وَلِتُجزىٰ كُلُّ نَفسٍ بِما كَسَبَت وَهُم لا يُظلَمونَ
45.transliteration: Wakhalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi walitujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona
45.translation: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged

45.arabic: أَفَرَءَيتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ إِلٰهَهُ هَوىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ اللَّهُ عَلىٰ عِلمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلىٰ سَمعِهِ وَقَلبِهِ وَجَعَلَ عَلىٰ بَصَرِهِ غِشٰوَةً فَمَن يَهديهِ مِن بَعدِ اللَّهِ أَفَلا تَذَكَّرونَ
45.transliteration: Afaraayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu waadallahu Allahu AAala AAilmin wakhatama AAala samAAihi waqalbihi wajaAAala AAala basarihi ghishawatan faman yahdeehi min baAAdi Allahi afala tathakkaroona
45.translation: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed

45.arabic: وَقالوا ما هِىَ إِلّا حَياتُنَا الدُّنيا نَموتُ وَنَحيا وَما يُهلِكُنا إِلَّا الدَّهرُ وَما لَهُم بِذٰلِكَ مِن عِلمٍ إِن هُم إِلّا يَظُنّونَ
45.transliteration: Waqaloo ma hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama yuhlikuna illa alddahru wama lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yathunnoona
45.translation: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess

45.arabic: وَإِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتُنا بَيِّنٰتٍ ما كانَ حُجَّتَهُم إِلّا أَن قالُوا ائتوا بِـٔابائِنا إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
45.transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ma kana hujjatahum illa an qaloo itoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena
45.translation: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful

45.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُ يُحييكُم ثُمَّ يُميتُكُم ثُمَّ يَجمَعُكُم إِلىٰ يَومِ القِيٰمَةِ لا رَيبَ فيهِ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَ النّاسِ لا يَعلَمونَ
45.transliteration: Quli Allahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajmaAAukum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona
45.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not

45.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَيَومَ تَقومُ السّاعَةُ يَومَئِذٍ يَخسَرُ المُبطِلونَ
45.transliteration: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yawmaithin yakhsaru almubtiloona
45.translation: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost

45.arabic: وَتَرىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جاثِيَةً كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدعىٰ إِلىٰ كِتٰبِهَا اليَومَ تُجزَونَ ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
45.transliteration: Watara kulla ommatin jathiyatan kullu ommatin tudAAa ila kitabiha alyawma tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona
45.translation: And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do

45.arabic: هٰذا كِتٰبُنا يَنطِقُ عَلَيكُم بِالحَقِّ إِنّا كُنّا نَستَنسِخُ ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
45.transliteration: Hatha kitabuna yantiqu AAalaykum bialhaqqi inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum taAAmaloona
45.translation: This Our Book pronounceth against you with truth. Lo! We have caused (all) that ye did to be recorded

45.arabic: فَأَمَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُدخِلُهُم رَبُّهُم فى رَحمَتِهِ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الفَوزُ المُبينُ
45.transliteration: Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatihi thalika huwa alfawzu almubeenu
45.translation: Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph

45.arabic: وَأَمَّا الَّذينَ كَفَروا أَفَلَم تَكُن ءايٰتى تُتلىٰ عَلَيكُم فَاستَكبَرتُم وَكُنتُم قَومًا مُجرِمينَ
45.transliteration: Waamma allatheena kafaroo afalam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum faistakbartum wakuntum qawman mujrimeena
45.translation: And as for those who disbelieved (it will be said unto them): Were not Our revelations recited unto you? But ye were scornful and became a guilty folk

45.arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ إِنَّ وَعدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَالسّاعَةُ لا رَيبَ فيها قُلتُم ما نَدرى مَا السّاعَةُ إِن نَظُنُّ إِلّا ظَنًّا وَما نَحنُ بِمُستَيقِنينَ
45.transliteration: Waitha qeela inna waAAda Allahi haqqun waalssaAAatu la rayba feeha qultum ma nadree ma alssaAAatu in nathunnu illa thannan wama nahnu bimustayqineena
45.translation: And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced

45.arabic: وَبَدا لَهُم سَيِّـٔاتُ ما عَمِلوا وَحاقَ بِهِم ما كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
45.transliteration: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
45.translation: And the evils of what they did will appear unto them, and that which they used to deride will befall them

45.arabic: وَقيلَ اليَومَ نَنسىٰكُم كَما نَسيتُم لِقاءَ يَومِكُم هٰذا وَمَأوىٰكُمُ النّارُ وَما لَكُم مِن نٰصِرينَ
45.transliteration: Waqeela alyawma nansakum kama naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha wamawakumu alnnaru wama lakum min nasireena
45.translation: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you

45.arabic: ذٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذتُم ءايٰتِ اللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتكُمُ الحَيوٰةُ الدُّنيا فَاليَومَ لا يُخرَجونَ مِنها وَلا هُم يُستَعتَبونَ
45.transliteration: Thalikum biannakumu ittakhathtum ayati Allahi huzuwan wagharratkumu alhayatu alddunya faalyawma la yukhrajoona minha wala hum yustaAAtaboona
45.translation: This, forasmuch as ye made the revelations of Allah a jest, and the life of the world beguiled you. Therefor this day they come not forth from thence, nor can they make amends

45.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ الحَمدُ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَرَبِّ الأَرضِ رَبِّ العٰلَمينَ
45.transliteration: Falillahi alhamdu rabbi alssamawati warabbi alardi rabbi alAAalameena
45.translation: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds

45.arabic: وَلَهُ الكِبرِياءُ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
45.transliteration: Walahu alkibriyao fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
45.translation: And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise

46.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ حم
46.transliteration: Hameem
46.translation: Ha. Mim

46.arabic: تَنزيلُ الكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللَّهِ العَزيزِ الحَكيمِ
46.transliteration: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi
46.translation: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah the Mighty, the Wise

46.arabic: ما خَلَقنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما إِلّا بِالحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا عَمّا أُنذِروا مُعرِضونَ
46.transliteration: Ma khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi waajalin musamman waallatheena kafaroo AAamma onthiroo muAAridoona
46.translation: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned

46.arabic: قُل أَرَءَيتُم ما تَدعونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ أَرونى ماذا خَلَقوا مِنَ الأَرضِ أَم لَهُم شِركٌ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ ائتونى بِكِتٰبٍ مِن قَبلِ هٰذا أَو أَثٰرَةٍ مِن عِلمٍ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
46.transliteration: Qul araaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati eetoonee bikitabin min qabli hatha aw atharatin min AAilmin in kuntum sadiqeena
46.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful

46.arabic: وَمَن أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدعوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ مَن لا يَستَجيبُ لَهُ إِلىٰ يَومِ القِيٰمَةِ وَهُم عَن دُعائِهِم غٰفِلونَ
46.transliteration: Waman adallu mimman yadAAoo min dooni Allahi man la yastajeebu lahu ila yawmi alqiyamati wahum AAan duAAaihim ghafiloona
46.translation: And who is further astray than those who, instead of Allah, pray unto such as hear not their prayer until the Day of Resurrection, and are unconscious of their prayer

46.arabic: وَإِذا حُشِرَ النّاسُ كانوا لَهُم أَعداءً وَكانوا بِعِبادَتِهِم كٰفِرينَ
46.transliteration: Waitha hushira alnnasu kanoo lahum aAAdaan wakanoo biAAibadatihim kafireena
46.translation: And when mankind are gathered (to the Judgment) will become enemies for them, and will become deniers of having been worshipped

46.arabic: وَإِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِم ءايٰتُنا بَيِّنٰتٍ قالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لِلحَقِّ لَمّا جاءَهُم هٰذا سِحرٌ مُبينٌ
46.transliteration: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum hatha sihrun mubeenun
46.translation: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say of the Truth when it reacheth them: This is mere magic

46.arabic: أَم يَقولونَ افتَرىٰهُ قُل إِنِ افتَرَيتُهُ فَلا تَملِكونَ لى مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيـًٔا هُوَ أَعلَمُ بِما تُفيضونَ فيهِ كَفىٰ بِهِ شَهيدًا بَينى وَبَينَكُم وَهُوَ الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ
46.transliteration: Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul ini iftaraytuhu fala tamlikoona lee mina Allahi shayan huwa aAAlamu bima tufeedoona feehi kafa bihi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum wahuwa alghafooru alrraheemu
46.translation: Or say they: He hath invented it? Say (O Muhammad): If I have invented it, still ye have no power to support me against Allah. He is Best Aware of what ye say among yourselves concerning it. He sufficeth for a witness between me and you. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful

46.arabic: قُل ما كُنتُ بِدعًا مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَما أَدرى ما يُفعَلُ بى وَلا بِكُم إِن أَتَّبِعُ إِلّا ما يوحىٰ إِلَىَّ وَما أَنا۠ إِلّا نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
46.transliteration: Qul ma kuntu bidAAan mina alrrusuli wama adree ma yufAAalu bee wala bikum in attabiAAu illa ma yooha ilayya wama ana illa natheerun mubeenun
46.translation: Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner

46.arabic: قُل أَرَءَيتُم إِن كانَ مِن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَكَفَرتُم بِهِ وَشَهِدَ شاهِدٌ مِن بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ عَلىٰ مِثلِهِ فَـٔامَنَ وَاستَكبَرتُم إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَهدِى القَومَ الظّٰلِمينَ
46.transliteration: Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi wakafartum bihi washahida shahidun min banee israeela AAala mithlihi faamana waistakbartum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena
46.translation: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye disbelieve therein, and a witness of the Children of Israel hath already testified to the like thereof and hath believed, and ye are too proud (what plight is yours)? Lo! Allah guideth not wrong-doing folk

46.arabic: وَقالَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا لَو كانَ خَيرًا ما سَبَقونا إِلَيهِ وَإِذ لَم يَهتَدوا بِهِ فَسَيَقولونَ هٰذا إِفكٌ قَديمٌ
46.transliteration: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo law kana khayran ma sabaqoona ilayhi waith lam yahtadoo bihi fasayaqooloona hatha ifkun qadeemun
46.translation: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe: If it had been (any) good, they would not have been before us in attaining it. And since they will not be guided by it, they say: This is an ancient lie

46.arabic: وَمِن قَبلِهِ كِتٰبُ موسىٰ إِمامًا وَرَحمَةً وَهٰذا كِتٰبٌ مُصَدِّقٌ لِسانًا عَرَبِيًّا لِيُنذِرَ الَّذينَ ظَلَموا وَبُشرىٰ لِلمُحسِنينَ
46.transliteration: Wamin qablihi kitabu moosa imaman warahmatan wahatha kitabun musaddiqun lisanan AAarabiyyan liyunthira allatheena thalamoo wabushra lilmuhsineena
46.translation: When before it there was the Scripture of Moses, an example and a mercy; and this is a confirming Scripture in the Arabic language, that it may warn those who do wrong and bring good tidings for the righteous

46.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ قالوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ استَقٰموا فَلا خَوفٌ عَلَيهِم وَلا هُم يَحزَنونَ
46.transliteration: Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona
46.translation: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and thereafter walk aright, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve

46.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ أَصحٰبُ الجَنَّةِ خٰلِدينَ فيها جَزاءً بِما كانوا يَعمَلونَ
46.transliteration: Olaika ashabu aljannati khalideena feeha jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona
46.translation: Such are rightful owners of the Garden, immortal therein, as a reward for what they used to do

46.arabic: وَوَصَّينَا الإِنسٰنَ بِوٰلِدَيهِ إِحسٰنًا حَمَلَتهُ أُمُّهُ كُرهًا وَوَضَعَتهُ كُرهًا وَحَملُهُ وَفِصٰلُهُ ثَلٰثونَ شَهرًا حَتّىٰ إِذا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ وَبَلَغَ أَربَعينَ سَنَةً قالَ رَبِّ أَوزِعنى أَن أَشكُرَ نِعمَتَكَ الَّتى أَنعَمتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلىٰ وٰلِدَىَّ وَأَن أَعمَلَ صٰلِحًا تَرضىٰهُ وَأَصلِح لى فى ذُرِّيَّتى إِنّى تُبتُ إِلَيكَ وَإِنّى مِنَ المُسلِمينَ
46.transliteration: Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi ihsanan hamalathu ommuhu kurhan wawadaAAathu kurhan wahamluhu wafisaluhu thalathoona shahran hatta itha balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaAAeena sanatan qala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waaslih lee fee thurriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wainnee mina almuslimeena
46.translation: And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee)

46.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ نَتَقَبَّلُ عَنهُم أَحسَنَ ما عَمِلوا وَنَتَجاوَزُ عَن سَيِّـٔاتِهِم فى أَصحٰبِ الجَنَّةِ وَعدَ الصِّدقِ الَّذى كانوا يوعَدونَ
46.transliteration: Olaika allatheena nataqabbalu AAanhum ahsana ma AAamiloo wanatajawazu AAan sayyiatihim fee ashabi aljannati waAAda alssidqi allathee kanoo yooAAadoona
46.translation: Those are they from whom We accept the best of what they do, and overlook their evil deeds. (They are) among the owners of the Garden. This is the true promise which they were promised (in the world)

46.arabic: وَالَّذى قالَ لِوٰلِدَيهِ أُفٍّ لَكُما أَتَعِدانِنى أَن أُخرَجَ وَقَد خَلَتِ القُرونُ مِن قَبلى وَهُما يَستَغيثانِ اللَّهَ وَيلَكَ ءامِن إِنَّ وَعدَ اللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَيَقولُ ما هٰذا إِلّا أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ
46.transliteration: Waallathee qala liwalidayhi offin lakuma ataAAidaninee an okhraja waqad khalati alquroonu min qablee wahuma yastagheethani Allaha waylaka amin inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fayaqoolu ma hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena
46.translation: And whoso saith unto his parents: Fie upon you both! Do ye threaten me that I shall be brought forth (again) when generations before me have passed away? And they twain cry unto Allah for help (and say): Woe unto thee! Believe! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. But he saith: This is naught save fables of the men of old

46.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ حَقَّ عَلَيهِمُ القَولُ فى أُمَمٍ قَد خَلَت مِن قَبلِهِم مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنسِ إِنَّهُم كانوا خٰسِرينَ
46.transliteration: Olaika allatheena haqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni waalinsi innahum kanoo khasireena
46.translation: Such are those on whom the Word concerning nations of the jinn and mankind which have passed away before them hath effect. Lo! they are the losers

46.arabic: وَلِكُلٍّ دَرَجٰتٌ مِمّا عَمِلوا وَلِيُوَفِّيَهُم أَعمٰلَهُم وَهُم لا يُظلَمونَ
46.transliteration: Walikullin darajatun mimma AAamiloo waliyuwaffiyahum aAAmalahum wahum la yuthlamoona
46.translation: And for all there will be ranks from what they do, that He may pay them for their deeds; and they will not be wronged

46.arabic: وَيَومَ يُعرَضُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا عَلَى النّارِ أَذهَبتُم طَيِّبٰتِكُم فى حَياتِكُمُ الدُّنيا وَاستَمتَعتُم بِها فَاليَومَ تُجزَونَ عَذابَ الهونِ بِما كُنتُم تَستَكبِرونَ فِى الأَرضِ بِغَيرِ الحَقِّ وَبِما كُنتُم تَفسُقونَ
46.transliteration: Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari athhabtum tayyibatikum fee hayatikumu alddunya waistamtaAAtum biha faalyawma tujzawna AAathaba alhooni bima kuntum tastakbiroona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tafsuqoona
46.translation: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (it will be said): Ye squandered your good things in the life of the world and sought comfort therein. Now this day ye are rewarded with the doom of ignominy because ye were disdainful in the land without a right, and because ye used to transgress

46.arabic: وَاذكُر أَخا عادٍ إِذ أَنذَرَ قَومَهُ بِالأَحقافِ وَقَد خَلَتِ النُّذُرُ مِن بَينِ يَدَيهِ وَمِن خَلفِهِ أَلّا تَعبُدوا إِلَّا اللَّهَ إِنّى أَخافُ عَلَيكُم عَذابَ يَومٍ عَظيمٍ
46.transliteration: Waothkur akha AAadin ith anthara qawmahu bialahqafi waqad khalati alnnuthuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi alla taAAbudoo illa Allaha innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin
46.translation: And make mention (O Muhammad) of the brother of A'ad when he warned his folk among the wind-curved sandhills - and verily warners came and went before and after him - saying: Serve none but Allah. Lo! I fear for you the doom of a tremendous Day

46.arabic: قالوا أَجِئتَنا لِتَأفِكَنا عَن ءالِهَتِنا فَأتِنا بِما تَعِدُنا إِن كُنتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقينَ
46.transliteration: Qaloo ajitana litafikana AAan alihatina fatina bima taAAiduna in kunta mina alssadiqeena
46.translation: They said: Hast come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us, if thou art of the truthful

46.arabic: قالَ إِنَّمَا العِلمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَأُبَلِّغُكُم ما أُرسِلتُ بِهِ وَلٰكِنّى أَرىٰكُم قَومًا تَجهَلونَ
46.transliteration: Qala innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi waoballighukum ma orsiltu bihi walakinnee arakum qawman tajhaloona
46.translation: He said: The knowledge is with Allah only. I convey unto you that wherewith I have been sent, but I see you are a folk that know not

46.arabic: فَلَمّا رَأَوهُ عارِضًا مُستَقبِلَ أَودِيَتِهِم قالوا هٰذا عارِضٌ مُمطِرُنا بَل هُوَ مَا استَعجَلتُم بِهِ ريحٌ فيها عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
46.transliteration: Falamma raawhu AAaridan mustaqbila awdiyatihim qaloo hatha AAaridun mumtiruna bal huwa ma istaAAjaltum bihi reehun feeha AAathabun aleemun
46.translation: Then, when they beheld it as a dense cloud coming toward their valleys, they said: Here is a cloud bringing us rain. Nay, but it is that which ye did seek to hasten, a wind wherein is painful torment

46.arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَيءٍ بِأَمرِ رَبِّها فَأَصبَحوا لا يُرىٰ إِلّا مَسٰكِنُهُم كَذٰلِكَ نَجزِى القَومَ المُجرِمينَ
46.transliteration: Tudammiru kulla shayin biamri rabbiha faasbahoo la yura illa masakinuhum kathalika najzee alqawma almujrimeena
46.translation: Destroying all things by commandment of its Lord. And morning found them so that naught could be seen save their dwellings. Thus do We reward the guilty folk

46.arabic: وَلَقَد مَكَّنّٰهُم فيما إِن مَكَّنّٰكُم فيهِ وَجَعَلنا لَهُم سَمعًا وَأَبصٰرًا وَأَفـِٔدَةً فَما أَغنىٰ عَنهُم سَمعُهُم وَلا أَبصٰرُهُم وَلا أَفـِٔدَتُهُم مِن شَيءٍ إِذ كانوا يَجحَدونَ بِـٔايٰتِ اللَّهِ وَحاقَ بِهِم ما كانوا بِهِ يَستَهزِءونَ
46.transliteration: Walaqad makkannahum feema in makkannakum feehi wajaAAalna lahum samAAan waabsaran waafidatan fama aghna AAanhum samAAuhum wala absaruhum wala afidatuhum min shayin ith kanoo yajhadoona biayati Allahi wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
46.translation: And verily We had empowered them with that wherewith We have not empowered you, and had assigned them ears and eyes and hearts; but their ears and eyes and hearts availed them naught since they denied the revelations of Allah; and what they used to mock befell them

46.arabic: وَلَقَد أَهلَكنا ما حَولَكُم مِنَ القُرىٰ وَصَرَّفنَا الءايٰتِ لَعَلَّهُم يَرجِعونَ
46.transliteration: Walaqad ahlakna ma hawlakum mina alqura wasarrafna alayati laAAallahum yarjiAAoona
46.translation: And verily We have destroyed townships round about you, and displayed (for them) Our revelation, that haply they might return

46.arabic: فَلَولا نَصَرَهُمُ الَّذينَ اتَّخَذوا مِن دونِ اللَّهِ قُربانًا ءالِهَةً بَل ضَلّوا عَنهُم وَذٰلِكَ إِفكُهُم وَما كانوا يَفتَرونَ
46.transliteration: Falawla nasarahumu allatheena ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi qurbanan alihatan bal dalloo AAanhum wathalika ifkuhum wama kanoo yaftaroona
46.translation: Then why did those whom they had chosen for gods as a way of approach (unto Allah) not help them? Nay, but they did fail them utterly. And (all) that was their lie, and what they used to invent

46.arabic: وَإِذ صَرَفنا إِلَيكَ نَفَرًا مِنَ الجِنِّ يَستَمِعونَ القُرءانَ فَلَمّا حَضَروهُ قالوا أَنصِتوا فَلَمّا قُضِىَ وَلَّوا إِلىٰ قَومِهِم مُنذِرينَ
46.transliteration: Waith sarafna ilayka nafaran mina aljinni yastamiAAoona alqurana falamma hadaroohu qaloo ansitoo falamma qudiya wallaw ila qawmihim munthireena
46.translation: And when We inclined toward thee (Muhammad) certain of the jinn, who wished to hear the Qur'an and, when they were in its presence, said: Give ear! and, when it was finished, turned back to their people, warning

46.arabic: قالوا يٰقَومَنا إِنّا سَمِعنا كِتٰبًا أُنزِلَ مِن بَعدِ موسىٰ مُصَدِّقًا لِما بَينَ يَدَيهِ يَهدى إِلَى الحَقِّ وَإِلىٰ طَريقٍ مُستَقيمٍ
46.transliteration: Qaloo ya qawmana inna samiAAna kitaban onzila min baAAdi moosa musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi yahdee ila alhaqqi waila tareeqin mustaqeemin
46.translation: They said: O our people! Lo! we have heard a scripture which hath been revealed after Moses, confirming that which was before it, guiding unto the truth and a right road

46.arabic: يٰقَومَنا أَجيبوا داعِىَ اللَّهِ وَءامِنوا بِهِ يَغفِر لَكُم مِن ذُنوبِكُم وَيُجِركُم مِن عَذابٍ أَليمٍ
46.transliteration: Ya qawmana ajeeboo daAAiya Allahi waaminoo bihi yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayujirkum min AAathabin aleemin
46.translation: O our people! respond to Allah's summoner and believe in Him. He will forgive you some of your sins and guard you from a painful doom

46.arabic: وَمَن لا يُجِب داعِىَ اللَّهِ فَلَيسَ بِمُعجِزٍ فِى الأَرضِ وَلَيسَ لَهُ مِن دونِهِ أَولِياءُ أُولٰئِكَ فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
46.transliteration: Waman la yujib daAAiya Allahi falaysa bimuAAjizin fee alardi walaysa lahu min doonihi awliyaa olaika fee dalalin mubeenin
46.translation: And whoso respondeth not to Allah's summoner he can nowise escape in the earth, and he hath no protecting friends instead of Him. Such are in error manifest

46.arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ الَّذى خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَلَم يَعىَ بِخَلقِهِنَّ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلىٰ أَن يُحۦِىَ المَوتىٰ بَلىٰ إِنَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
46.transliteration: Awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda walam yaAAya bikhalqihinna biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta bala innahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
46.translation: Have they not seen that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and was not wearied by their creation, is Able to give life to the dead? Aye, He verily is Able to do all things

46.arabic: وَيَومَ يُعرَضُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا عَلَى النّارِ أَلَيسَ هٰذا بِالحَقِّ قالوا بَلىٰ وَرَبِّنا قالَ فَذوقُوا العَذابَ بِما كُنتُم تَكفُرونَ
46.transliteration: Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari alaysa hatha bialhaqqi qaloo bala warabbina qala fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum takfuroona
46.translation: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (they will be asked): Is not this real? They will say: Yea, by our Lord. He will say: Then taste the doom for that ye disbelieved

46.arabic: فَاصبِر كَما صَبَرَ أُولُوا العَزمِ مِنَ الرُّسُلِ وَلا تَستَعجِل لَهُم كَأَنَّهُم يَومَ يَرَونَ ما يوعَدونَ لَم يَلبَثوا إِلّا ساعَةً مِن نَهارٍ بَلٰغٌ فَهَل يُهلَكُ إِلَّا القَومُ الفٰسِقونَ
46.transliteration: Faisbir kama sabara oloo alAAazmi mina alrrusuli wala tastaAAjil lahum kaannahum yawma yarawna ma yooAAadoona lam yalbathoo illa saAAatan min naharin balaghun fahal yuhlaku illa alqawmu alfasiqoona
46.translation: Then have patience (O Muhammad) even as the stout of heart among the messengers (of old) had patience, and seek not to hasten on (the doom) for them. On the day when they see that which they are promised (it will seem to them) as though they had tarried but an hour of daylight. A clear message. Shall any be destroyed save evil-living folk

47.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَصَدّوا عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ أَضَلَّ أَعمٰلَهُم
47.transliteration: Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi adalla aAAmalahum
47.translation: Those who disbelieve and turn (men) from the way of Allah, He rendereth their actions vain

47.arabic: وَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَءامَنوا بِما نُزِّلَ عَلىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَهُوَ الحَقُّ مِن رَبِّهِم كَفَّرَ عَنهُم سَيِّـٔاتِهِم وَأَصلَحَ بالَهُم
47.transliteration: Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waamanoo bima nuzzila AAala muhammadin wahuwa alhaqqu min rabbihim kaffara AAanhum sayyiatihim waaslaha balahum
47.translation: And those who believe and do good works and believe in that which is revealed unto Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He riddeth them of their ill-deeds and improveth their state

47.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ الَّذينَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا البٰطِلَ وَأَنَّ الَّذينَ ءامَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الحَقَّ مِن رَبِّهِم كَذٰلِكَ يَضرِبُ اللَّهُ لِلنّاسِ أَمثٰلَهُم
47.transliteration: Thalika bianna allatheena kafaroo ittabaAAoo albatila waanna allatheena amanoo ittabaAAoo alhaqqa min rabbihim kathalika yadribu Allahu lilnnasi amthalahum
47.translation: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood and because those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus Allah coineth their similitudes for mankind

47.arabic: فَإِذا لَقيتُمُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فَضَربَ الرِّقابِ حَتّىٰ إِذا أَثخَنتُموهُم فَشُدُّوا الوَثاقَ فَإِمّا مَنًّا بَعدُ وَإِمّا فِداءً حَتّىٰ تَضَعَ الحَربُ أَوزارَها ذٰلِكَ وَلَو يَشاءُ اللَّهُ لَانتَصَرَ مِنهُم وَلٰكِن لِيَبلُوَا۟ بَعضَكُم بِبَعضٍ وَالَّذينَ قُتِلوا فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَن يُضِلَّ أَعمٰلَهُم
47.transliteration: Faitha laqeetumu allatheena kafaroo fadarba alrriqabi hatta itha athkhantumoohum fashuddoo alwathaqa faimma mannan baAAdu waimma fidaan hatta tadaAAa alharbu awzaraha thalika walaw yashao Allahu laintasara minhum walakin liyabluwa baAAdakum bibaAAdin waallatheena qutiloo fee sabeeli Allahi falan yudilla aAAmalahum
