47.translation: Now when ye meet in battle those who disbelieve, then it is smiting of the necks until, when ye have routed them, then making fast of bonds; and afterward either grace or ransom till the war lay down its burdens. That (is the ordinance). And if Allah willed He could have punished them (without you) but (thus it is ordained) that He may try some of you by means of others. And those who are slain in the way of Allah, He rendereth not their actions vain

47.arabic: سَيَهديهِم وَيُصلِحُ بالَهُم
47.transliteration: Sayahdeehim wayuslihu balahum
47.translation: He will guide them and improve their state

47.arabic: وَيُدخِلُهُمُ الجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَها لَهُم
47.transliteration: Wayudkhiluhumu aljannata AAarrafaha lahum
47.translation: And bring them in unto the Garden which He hath made known to them

47.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِن تَنصُرُوا اللَّهَ يَنصُركُم وَيُثَبِّت أَقدامَكُم
47.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tansuroo Allaha yansurkum wayuthabbit aqdamakum
47.translation: O ye who believe! If ye help Allah, He will help you and will make your foothold firm

47.arabic: وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا فَتَعسًا لَهُم وَأَضَلَّ أَعمٰلَهُم
47.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo fataAAsan lahum waadalla aAAmalahum
47.translation: And those who disbelieve, perdition is for them, and He will make their actions vain

47.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُم كَرِهوا ما أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأَحبَطَ أَعمٰلَهُم
47.transliteration: Thalika biannahum karihoo ma anzala Allahu faahbata aAAmalahum
47.translation: That is because they are averse to that which Allah hath revealed, therefor maketh He their actions fruitless

47.arabic: أَفَلَم يَسيروا فِى الأَرضِ فَيَنظُروا كَيفَ كانَ عٰقِبَةُ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم دَمَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم وَلِلكٰفِرينَ أَمثٰلُها
47.transliteration: Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim dammara Allahu AAalayhim walilkafireena amthaluha
47.translation: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who were before them? Allah wiped them out. And for the disbelievers there will be the like thereof

47.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَولَى الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَأَنَّ الكٰفِرينَ لا مَولىٰ لَهُم
47.transliteration: Thalika bianna Allaha mawla allatheena amanoo waanna alkafireena la mawla lahum
47.translation: That is because Allah is patron of those who believe, and because the disbelievers have no patron

47.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدخِلُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا يَتَمَتَّعونَ وَيَأكُلونَ كَما تَأكُلُ الأَنعٰمُ وَالنّارُ مَثوًى لَهُم
47.transliteration: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waallatheena kafaroo yatamattaAAoona wayakuloona kama takulu alanAAamu waalnnaru mathwan lahum
47.translation: Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; while those who disbelieve take their comfort in this life and eat even as the cattle eat, and the Fire is their habitation

47.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِن قَريَةٍ هِىَ أَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِن قَريَتِكَ الَّتى أَخرَجَتكَ أَهلَكنٰهُم فَلا ناصِرَ لَهُم
47.transliteration: Wakaayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatee akhrajatka ahlaknahum fala nasira lahum
47.translation: And how many a township stronger than thy township (O Muhammad) which hath cast thee out, have We destroyed, and they had no helper

47.arabic: أَفَمَن كانَ عَلىٰ بَيِّنَةٍ مِن رَبِّهِ كَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُ سوءُ عَمَلِهِ وَاتَّبَعوا أَهواءَهُم
47.transliteration: Afaman kana AAala bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi waittabaAAoo ahwaahum
47.translation: Is he who relieth on a clear proof from his Lord like those for whom the evil that they do is beautified while they follow their own lusts

47.arabic: مَثَلُ الجَنَّةِ الَّتى وُعِدَ المُتَّقونَ فيها أَنهٰرٌ مِن ماءٍ غَيرِ ءاسِنٍ وَأَنهٰرٌ مِن لَبَنٍ لَم يَتَغَيَّر طَعمُهُ وَأَنهٰرٌ مِن خَمرٍ لَذَّةٍ لِلشّٰرِبينَ وَأَنهٰرٌ مِن عَسَلٍ مُصَفًّى وَلَهُم فيها مِن كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ وَمَغفِرَةٌ مِن رَبِّهِم كَمَن هُوَ خٰلِدٌ فِى النّارِ وَسُقوا ماءً حَميمًا فَقَطَّعَ أَمعاءَهُم
47.transliteration: Mathalu aljannati allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona feeha anharun min main ghayri asinin waanharun min labanin lam yataghayyar taAAmuhu waanharun min khamrin laththatin lilshsharibeena waanharun min AAasalin musaffan walahum feeha min kulli alththamarati wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khalidun fee alnnari wasuqoo maan hameeman faqattaAAa amAAaahum
47.translation: A similitude of the Garden which those who keep their duty (to Allah) are promised: Therein are rivers of water unpolluted, and rivers of milk whereof the flavour changeth not, and rivers of wine delicious to the drinkers, and rivers of clear-run honey; therein for them is every kind of fruit, with pardon from their Lord. (Are those who enjoy all this) like those who are immortal in the Fire and are given boiling water to drink so that it teareth their bowels

47.arabic: وَمِنهُم مَن يَستَمِعُ إِلَيكَ حَتّىٰ إِذا خَرَجوا مِن عِندِكَ قالوا لِلَّذينَ أوتُوا العِلمَ ماذا قالَ ءانِفًا أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلىٰ قُلوبِهِم وَاتَّبَعوا أَهواءَهُم
47.transliteration: Waminhum man yastamiAAu ilayka hatta itha kharajoo min AAindika qaloo lillatheena ootoo alAAilma matha qala anifan olaika allatheena tabaAAa Allahu AAala quloobihim waittabaAAoo ahwaahum
47.translation: Among them are some who give ear unto thee (Muhammad) till, when they go forth from thy presence they say unto those who have been given knowledge: What was that he said just now? Those are they whose hearts Allah hath sealed, and they follow their own lusts

47.arabic: وَالَّذينَ اهتَدَوا زادَهُم هُدًى وَءاتىٰهُم تَقوىٰهُم
47.transliteration: Waallatheena ihtadaw zadahum hudan waatahum taqwahum
47.translation: While as for those who walk aright, He addeth to their guidance, and giveth them their protection (against evil)

47.arabic: فَهَل يَنظُرونَ إِلَّا السّاعَةَ أَن تَأتِيَهُم بَغتَةً فَقَد جاءَ أَشراطُها فَأَنّىٰ لَهُم إِذا جاءَتهُم ذِكرىٰهُم
47.transliteration: Fahal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jaa ashratuha faanna lahum itha jaathum thikrahum
47.translation: Await they aught save the Hour, that it should come upon them unawares? And the beginnings thereof have already come. But how, when it hath come upon them, can they take their warning

47.arabic: فَاعلَم أَنَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاستَغفِر لِذَنبِكَ وَلِلمُؤمِنينَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتِ وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُم وَمَثوىٰكُم
47.transliteration: FaiAAlam annahu la ilaha illa Allahu waistaghfir lithanbika walilmumineena waalmuminati waAllahu yaAAlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwakum
47.translation: So know (O Muhammad) that there is no Allah save Allah, and ask forgiveness for thy sin and for believing men and believing women. Allah knoweth (both) your place of turmoil and your place of rest

47.arabic: وَيَقولُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لَولا نُزِّلَت سورَةٌ فَإِذا أُنزِلَت سورَةٌ مُحكَمَةٌ وَذُكِرَ فيهَا القِتالُ رَأَيتَ الَّذينَ فى قُلوبِهِم مَرَضٌ يَنظُرونَ إِلَيكَ نَظَرَ المَغشِىِّ عَلَيهِ مِنَ المَوتِ فَأَولىٰ لَهُم
47.transliteration: Wayaqoolu allatheena amanoo lawla nuzzilat sooratun faitha onzilat sooratun muhkamatun wathukira feeha alqitalu raayta allatheena fee quloobihim maradun yanthuroona ilayka nathara almaghshiyyi AAalayhi mina almawti faawla lahum
47.translation: And those who believe say: If only a surah were revealed! But when a decisive surah is revealed and war is mentioned therein, thou seest those in whose hearts is a disease looking at thee with the look of men fainting unto death. Therefor woe unto them

47.arabic: طاعَةٌ وَقَولٌ مَعروفٌ فَإِذا عَزَمَ الأَمرُ فَلَو صَدَقُوا اللَّهَ لَكانَ خَيرًا لَهُم
47.transliteration: TaAAatun waqawlun maAAroofun faitha AAazama alamru falaw sadaqoo Allaha lakana khayran lahum
47.translation: Obedience and a civil word. Then, when the matter is determined, if they are loyal to Allah it will be well for them

47.arabic: فَهَل عَسَيتُم إِن تَوَلَّيتُم أَن تُفسِدوا فِى الأَرضِ وَتُقَطِّعوا أَرحامَكُم
47.transliteration: Fahal AAasaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidoo fee alardi watuqattiAAoo arhamakum
47.translation: Would ye then, if ye were given the command, work corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship

47.arabic: أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُم وَأَعمىٰ أَبصٰرَهُم
47.transliteration: Olaika allatheena laAAanahumu Allahu faasammahum waaAAma absarahum
47.translation: Such are they whom Allah curseth so that He deafeneth them and maketh blind their eyes

47.arabic: أَفَلا يَتَدَبَّرونَ القُرءانَ أَم عَلىٰ قُلوبٍ أَقفالُها
47.transliteration: Afala yatadabbaroona alqurana am AAala quloobin aqfaluha
47.translation: Will they then not meditate on the Qur'an, or are there locks on the hearts

47.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ ارتَدّوا عَلىٰ أَدبٰرِهِم مِن بَعدِ ما تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الهُدَى الشَّيطٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُم وَأَملىٰ لَهُم
47.transliteration: Inna allatheena irtaddoo AAala adbarihim min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda alshshaytanu sawwala lahum waamla lahum
47.translation: Lo! those who turn back after the guidance hath been manifested unto them, Satan hath seduced them, and He giveth them the rein

47.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُم قالوا لِلَّذينَ كَرِهوا ما نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ سَنُطيعُكُم فى بَعضِ الأَمرِ وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ إِسرارَهُم
47.transliteration: Thalika biannahum qaloo lillatheena karihoo ma nazzala Allahu sanuteeAAukum fee baAAdi alamri waAllahu yaAAlamu israrahum
47.translation: That is because they say unto those who hate what Allah hath revealed: We will obey you in some matters; and Allah knoweth their secret talk

47.arabic: فَكَيفَ إِذا تَوَفَّتهُمُ المَلٰئِكَةُ يَضرِبونَ وُجوهَهُم وَأَدبٰرَهُم
47.transliteration: Fakayfa itha tawaffathumu almalaikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbarahum
47.translation: Then how (will it be with them) when the angels gather them, smiting their faces and their backs

47.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعوا ما أَسخَطَ اللَّهَ وَكَرِهوا رِضوٰنَهُ فَأَحبَطَ أَعمٰلَهُم
47.transliteration: Thalika biannahumu ittabaAAoo ma askhata Allaha wakarihoo ridwanahu faahbata aAAmalahum
47.translation: That will be because they followed that which angereth Allah, and hated that which pleaseth Him. Therefor He hath made their actions vain

47.arabic: أَم حَسِبَ الَّذينَ فى قُلوبِهِم مَرَضٌ أَن لَن يُخرِجَ اللَّهُ أَضغٰنَهُم
47.transliteration: Am hasiba allatheena fee quloobihim maradun an lan yukhrija Allahu adghanahum
47.translation: Or do those in whose hearts is a disease deem that Allah will not bring to light their (secret) hates

47.arabic: وَلَو نَشاءُ لَأَرَينٰكَهُم فَلَعَرَفتَهُم بِسيمٰهُم وَلَتَعرِفَنَّهُم فى لَحنِ القَولِ وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ أَعمٰلَكُم
47.transliteration: Walaw nashao laaraynakahum falaAAaraftahum biseemahum walataAArifannahum fee lahni alqawli waAllahu yaAAlamu aAAmalakum
47.translation: And if We would, We could show them unto thee (Muhammad) so that thou shouldst know them surely by their marks. And thou shalt know them by the burden of their talk. And Allah knoweth your deeds

47.arabic: وَلَنَبلُوَنَّكُم حَتّىٰ نَعلَمَ المُجٰهِدينَ مِنكُم وَالصّٰبِرينَ وَنَبلُوَا۟ أَخبارَكُم
47.transliteration: Walanabluwannakum hatta naAAlama almujahideena minkum waalssabireena wanabluwa akhbarakum
47.translation: And verily We shall try you till We know those of you who strive hard (for the cause of Allah) and the steadfast, and till We test your record

47.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَصَدّوا عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَشاقُّوا الرَّسولَ مِن بَعدِ ما تَبَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الهُدىٰ لَن يَضُرُّوا اللَّهَ شَيـًٔا وَسَيُحبِطُ أَعمٰلَهُم
47.transliteration: Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi washaqqoo alrrasoola min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda lan yaduroo Allaha shayan wasayuhbitu aAAmalahum
47.translation: Lo! those who disbelieve and turn from the way of Allah and oppose the messenger after the guidance hath been manifested unto them, they hurt Allah not a jot, and He will make their actions fruitless

47.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا أَطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطيعُوا الرَّسولَ وَلا تُبطِلوا أَعمٰلَكُم
47.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola wala tubtiloo aAAmalakum
47.translation: O ye who believe! Obey Allah and obey the messenger, and render not your actions vain

47.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَصَدّوا عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ ماتوا وَهُم كُفّارٌ فَلَن يَغفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُم
47.transliteration: Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi thumma matoo wahum kuffarun falan yaghfira Allahu lahum
47.translation: Lo! those who disbelieve and turn from the way of Allah and then die disbelievers, Allah surely will not pardon them

47.arabic: فَلا تَهِنوا وَتَدعوا إِلَى السَّلمِ وَأَنتُمُ الأَعلَونَ وَاللَّهُ مَعَكُم وَلَن يَتِرَكُم أَعمٰلَكُم
47.transliteration: Fala tahinoo watadAAoo ila alssalmi waantumu alaAAlawna waAllahu maAAakum walan yatirakum aAAmalakum
47.translation: So do not falter and cry out for peace when ye (will be) the uppermost, and Allah is with you, and He will not grudge (the reward of) your actions

47.arabic: إِنَّمَا الحَيوٰةُ الدُّنيا لَعِبٌ وَلَهوٌ وَإِن تُؤمِنوا وَتَتَّقوا يُؤتِكُم أُجورَكُم وَلا يَسـَٔلكُم أَموٰلَكُم
47.transliteration: Innama alhayatu alddunya laAAibun walahwun wain tuminoo watattaqoo yutikum ojoorakum wala yasalkum amwalakum
47.translation: The life of the world is but a sport and a pastime. And if ye believe and ward off (evil). He will give you your wages, and will not ask of you your wordly wealth

47.arabic: إِن يَسـَٔلكُموها فَيُحفِكُم تَبخَلوا وَيُخرِج أَضغٰنَكُم
47.transliteration: In yasalkumooha fayuhfikum tabkhaloo wayukhrij adghanakum
47.translation: If He should ask it of you and importune you, ye would hoard it, and He would bring to light your (secret) hates

47.arabic: هٰأَنتُم هٰؤُلاءِ تُدعَونَ لِتُنفِقوا فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَمِنكُم مَن يَبخَلُ وَمَن يَبخَل فَإِنَّما يَبخَلُ عَن نَفسِهِ وَاللَّهُ الغَنِىُّ وَأَنتُمُ الفُقَراءُ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوا يَستَبدِل قَومًا غَيرَكُم ثُمَّ لا يَكونوا أَمثٰلَكُم
47.transliteration: Haantum haolai tudAAawna litunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fainnama yabkhalu AAan nafsihi waAllahu alghaniyyu waantumu alfuqarao wain tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma la yakoonoo amthalakum
47.translation: Lo! ye are those who are called to spend in the way of Allah, yet among you there are some who hoard. And as for him who hoardeth, he hoardeth only from his soul. And Allah is the Rich, and ye are the poor. And if ye turn away He will exchange you for some other folk, and they will not be the likes of you

48.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِنّا فَتَحنا لَكَ فَتحًا مُبينًا
48.transliteration: Inna fatahna laka fathan mubeenan
48.translation: Lo! We have given thee (O Muhammad) a signal victory

48.arabic: لِيَغفِرَ لَكَ اللَّهُ ما تَقَدَّمَ مِن ذَنبِكَ وَما تَأَخَّرَ وَيُتِمَّ نِعمَتَهُ عَلَيكَ وَيَهدِيَكَ صِرٰطًا مُستَقيمًا
48.transliteration: Liyaghfira laka Allahu ma taqaddama min thanbika wama taakhkhara wayutimma niAAmatahu AAalayka wayahdiyaka siratan mustaqeeman
48.translation: That Allah may forgive thee of thy sin that which is past and that which is to come, and may perfect His favour unto thee, and may guide thee on a right path

48.arabic: وَيَنصُرَكَ اللَّهُ نَصرًا عَزيزًا
48.transliteration: Wayansuraka Allahu nasran AAazeezan
48.translation: And that Allah may help thee with strong help

48.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى أَنزَلَ السَّكينَةَ فى قُلوبِ المُؤمِنينَ لِيَزدادوا إيمٰنًا مَعَ إيمٰنِهِم وَلِلَّهِ جُنودُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَليمًا حَكيمًا
48.transliteration: Huwa allathee anzala alssakeenata fee quloobi almumineena liyazdadoo eemanan maAAa eemanihim walillahi junoodu alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman
48.translation: He it is Who sent down peace of reassurance into the hearts of the believers that they might add faith unto their faith. Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Knower, Wise

48.arabic: لِيُدخِلَ المُؤمِنينَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها وَيُكَفِّرَ عَنهُم سَيِّـٔاتِهِم وَكانَ ذٰلِكَ عِندَ اللَّهِ فَوزًا عَظيمًا
48.transliteration: Liyudkhila almumineena waalmuminati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wayukaffira AAanhum sayyiatihim wakana thalika AAinda Allahi fawzan AAatheeman
48.translation: That He may bring the believing men and the believing women into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide, and may remit from them their evil deeds - That, in the sight of Allah, is the supreme triumph

48.arabic: وَيُعَذِّبَ المُنٰفِقينَ وَالمُنٰفِقٰتِ وَالمُشرِكينَ وَالمُشرِكٰتِ الظّانّينَ بِاللَّهِ ظَنَّ السَّوءِ عَلَيهِم دائِرَةُ السَّوءِ وَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم وَلَعَنَهُم وَأَعَدَّ لَهُم جَهَنَّمَ وَساءَت مَصيرًا
48.transliteration: WayuAAaththiba almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati waalmushrikeena waalmushrikati alththanneena biAllahi thanna alssawi AAalayhim dairatu alssawi waghadiba Allahu AAalayhim walaAAanahum waaAAadda lahum jahannama wasaat maseeran
48.translation: And may punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the idolatrous men and the idolatrous women, who think an evil thought concerning Allah. For them is the evil turn of fortune, and Allah is wroth against them and hath cursed them, and hath made ready for them hell, a hapless journey's end

48.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ جُنودُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَزيزًا حَكيمًا
48.transliteration: Walillahi junoodu alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman
48.translation: Allah's are the hosts of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is ever Mighty, Wise

48.arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنٰكَ شٰهِدًا وَمُبَشِّرًا وَنَذيرًا
48.transliteration: Inna arsalnaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheeran
48.translation: Lo! We have sent thee (O Muhammad) as a witness and a bearer of good tidings and a warner

48.arabic: لِتُؤمِنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَتُعَزِّروهُ وَتُوَقِّروهُ وَتُسَبِّحوهُ بُكرَةً وَأَصيلًا
48.transliteration: Lituminoo biAllahi warasoolihi watuAAazziroohu watuwaqqiroohu watusabbihoohu bukratan waaseelan
48.translation: That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day

48.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يُبايِعونَكَ إِنَّما يُبايِعونَ اللَّهَ يَدُ اللَّهِ فَوقَ أَيديهِم فَمَن نَكَثَ فَإِنَّما يَنكُثُ عَلىٰ نَفسِهِ وَمَن أَوفىٰ بِما عٰهَدَ عَلَيهُ اللَّهَ فَسَيُؤتيهِ أَجرًا عَظيمًا
48.transliteration: Inna allatheena yubayiAAoonaka innama yubayiAAoona Allaha yadu Allahi fawqa aydeehim faman nakatha fainnama yankuthu AAala nafsihi waman awfa bima AAahada AAalayhu Allaha fasayuteehi ajran AAatheeman
48.translation: Lo! those who swear allegiance unto thee (Muhammad), swear allegiance only unto Allah. The Hand of Allah is above their hands. So whosoever breaketh his oath, breaketh it only to his soul's hurt; while whosoever keepeth his covenant with Allah, on him will He bestow immense reward

48.arabic: سَيَقولُ لَكَ المُخَلَّفونَ مِنَ الأَعرابِ شَغَلَتنا أَموٰلُنا وَأَهلونا فَاستَغفِر لَنا يَقولونَ بِأَلسِنَتِهِم ما لَيسَ فى قُلوبِهِم قُل فَمَن يَملِكُ لَكُم مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيـًٔا إِن أَرادَ بِكُم ضَرًّا أَو أَرادَ بِكُم نَفعًا بَل كانَ اللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ خَبيرًا
48.transliteration: Sayaqoolu laka almukhallafoona mina alaAArabi shaghalatna amwaluna waahloona faistaghfir lana yaqooloona bialsinatihim ma laysa fee quloobihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina Allahi shayan in arada bikum darran aw arada bikum nafAAan bal kana Allahu bima taAAmaloona khabeeran
48.translation: Those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind will tell thee: Our possessions and our households occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us! They speak with their tongues that which is not in their hearts. Say: Who can avail you aught against Allah, if He intend you hurt or intend you profit? Nay, but Allah is ever Aware of what ye do

48.arabic: بَل ظَنَنتُم أَن لَن يَنقَلِبَ الرَّسولُ وَالمُؤمِنونَ إِلىٰ أَهليهِم أَبَدًا وَزُيِّنَ ذٰلِكَ فى قُلوبِكُم وَظَنَنتُم ظَنَّ السَّوءِ وَكُنتُم قَومًا بورًا
48.transliteration: Bal thanantum an lan yanqaliba alrrasoolu waalmuminoona ila ahleehim abadan wazuyyina thalika fee quloobikum wathanantum thanna alssawi wakuntum qawman booran
48.translation: Nay, but ye deemed that the messenger and the believers would never return to their own folk, and that was made fairseeming in your hearts, and ye did think an evil thought, and ye were worthless folk

48.arabic: وَمَن لَم يُؤمِن بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ فَإِنّا أَعتَدنا لِلكٰفِرينَ سَعيرًا
48.transliteration: Waman lam yumin biAllahi warasoolihi fainna aAAtadna lilkafireena saAAeeran
48.translation: And so for him who believeth not in Allah and His messenger - Lo! We have prepared a flame for disbelievers

48.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ يَغفِرُ لِمَن يَشاءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشاءُ وَكانَ اللَّهُ غَفورًا رَحيمًا
48.transliteration: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yaghfiru liman yashao wayuAAaththibu man yashao wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman
48.translation: And Allah's is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He forgiveth whom He will, and punisheth whom He will. And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

48.arabic: سَيَقولُ المُخَلَّفونَ إِذَا انطَلَقتُم إِلىٰ مَغانِمَ لِتَأخُذوها ذَرونا نَتَّبِعكُم يُريدونَ أَن يُبَدِّلوا كَلٰمَ اللَّهِ قُل لَن تَتَّبِعونا كَذٰلِكُم قالَ اللَّهُ مِن قَبلُ فَسَيَقولونَ بَل تَحسُدونَنا بَل كانوا لا يَفقَهونَ إِلّا قَليلًا
48.transliteration: Sayaqoolu almukhallafoona itha intalaqtum ila maghanima litakhuthooha tharoona nattabiAAkum yureedoona an yubaddiloo kalama Allahi qul lan tattabiAAoona kathalikum qala Allahu min qablu fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonana bal kanoo la yafqahoona illa qaleelan
48.translation: Those who were left behind will say, when ye set forth to capture booty: Let us go with you. They fain would change the verdict of Allah. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye shall not go with us. Thus hath Allah said beforehand. Then they will say: Ye are envious of us. Nay, but they understand not, save a little

48.arabic: قُل لِلمُخَلَّفينَ مِنَ الأَعرابِ سَتُدعَونَ إِلىٰ قَومٍ أُولى بَأسٍ شَديدٍ تُقٰتِلونَهُم أَو يُسلِمونَ فَإِن تُطيعوا يُؤتِكُمُ اللَّهُ أَجرًا حَسَنًا وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوا كَما تَوَلَّيتُم مِن قَبلُ يُعَذِّبكُم عَذابًا أَليمًا
48.transliteration: Qul lilmukhallafeena mina alaAArabi satudAAawna ila qawmin olee basin shadeedin tuqatiloonahum aw yuslimoona fain tuteeAAoo yutikumu Allahu ajran hasanan wain tatawallaw kama tawallaytum min qablu yuAAaththibkum AAathaban aleeman
48.translation: Say unto those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind: Ye will be called against a folk of mighty prowess, to fight them until they surrender; and if ye obey, Allah will give you a fair reward; but if ye turn away as ye did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful doom

48.arabic: لَيسَ عَلَى الأَعمىٰ حَرَجٌ وَلا عَلَى الأَعرَجِ حَرَجٌ وَلا عَلَى المَريضِ حَرَجٌ وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ يُدخِلهُ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبهُ عَذابًا أَليمًا
48.transliteration: Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waman yatawalla yuAAaththibhu AAathaban aleeman
48.translation: There is no blame for the blind, nor is there blame for the lame, nor is there blame for the sick (that they go not forth to war). And whoso obeyeth Allah and His messenger, He will make him enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow; and whoso turneth back, him will He punish with a painful doom

48.arabic: لَقَد رَضِىَ اللَّهُ عَنِ المُؤمِنينَ إِذ يُبايِعونَكَ تَحتَ الشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ ما فى قُلوبِهِم فَأَنزَلَ السَّكينَةَ عَلَيهِم وَأَثٰبَهُم فَتحًا قَريبًا
48.transliteration: Laqad radiya Allahu AAani almumineena ith yubayiAAoonaka tahta alshshajarati faAAalima ma fee quloobihim faanzala alsakeenata AAalayhim waathabahum fathan qareeban
48.translation: Allah was well pleased with the believers when they swore allegiance unto thee beneath the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, and He sent down peace of reassurance on them, and hath rewarded them with a near victory

48.arabic: وَمَغانِمَ كَثيرَةً يَأخُذونَها وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَزيزًا حَكيمًا
48.transliteration: Wamaghanima katheeratan yakhuthoonaha wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman
48.translation: And much booty that they will capture. Allah is ever Mighty, Wise

48.arabic: وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّهُ مَغانِمَ كَثيرَةً تَأخُذونَها فَعَجَّلَ لَكُم هٰذِهِ وَكَفَّ أَيدِىَ النّاسِ عَنكُم وَلِتَكونَ ءايَةً لِلمُؤمِنينَ وَيَهدِيَكُم صِرٰطًا مُستَقيمًا
48.transliteration: WaAAadakumu Allahu maghanima katheeratan takhuthoonaha faAAajjala lakum hathihi wakaffa aydiya alnnasi AAankum walitakoona ayatan lilmumineena wayahdiyakum siratan mustaqeeman
48.translation: Allah promiseth you much booty that ye will capture, and hath given you this in advance, and hath withheld men's hands from you, that it may be a token for the believers, and that He may guide you on a right path

48.arabic: وَأُخرىٰ لَم تَقدِروا عَلَيها قَد أَحاطَ اللَّهُ بِها وَكانَ اللَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرًا
48.transliteration: Waokhra lam taqdiroo AAalayha qad ahata Allahu biha wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin qadeeran
48.translation: And other (gain), which ye have not been able to achieve, Allah will compass it, Allah is Able to do all things

48.arabic: وَلَو قٰتَلَكُمُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لَوَلَّوُا الأَدبٰرَ ثُمَّ لا يَجِدونَ وَلِيًّا وَلا نَصيرًا
48.transliteration: Walaw qatalakumu allatheena kafaroo lawallawoo aladbara thumma la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseeran
48.translation: And if those who disbelieve join battle with you they will take to flight, and afterward they will find no protecting friend nor helper

48.arabic: سُنَّةَ اللَّهِ الَّتى قَد خَلَت مِن قَبلُ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللَّهِ تَبديلًا
48.transliteration: Sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan
48.translation: It is the law of Allah which hath taken course aforetime. Thou wilt not find for the law of Allah aught of power to change

48.arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى كَفَّ أَيدِيَهُم عَنكُم وَأَيدِيَكُم عَنهُم بِبَطنِ مَكَّةَ مِن بَعدِ أَن أَظفَرَكُم عَلَيهِم وَكانَ اللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ بَصيرًا
48.transliteration: Wahuwa allathee kaffa aydiyahum AAankum waaydiyakum AAanhum bibatni makkata min baAAdi an athfarakum AAalayhim wakana Allahu bima taAAmaloona baseeran
48.translation: And He it is Who hath withheld men's hands from you, and hath withheld your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after He had made you victors over them. Allah is Seer of what ye do

48.arabic: هُمُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَصَدّوكُم عَنِ المَسجِدِ الحَرامِ وَالهَدىَ مَعكوفًا أَن يَبلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ وَلَولا رِجالٌ مُؤمِنونَ وَنِساءٌ مُؤمِنٰتٌ لَم تَعلَموهُم أَن تَطَـٔوهُم فَتُصيبَكُم مِنهُم مَعَرَّةٌ بِغَيرِ عِلمٍ لِيُدخِلَ اللَّهُ فى رَحمَتِهِ مَن يَشاءُ لَو تَزَيَّلوا لَعَذَّبنَا الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِنهُم عَذابًا أَليمًا
48.transliteration: Humu allatheena kafaroo wasaddookum AAani almasjidi alharami waalhadya maAAkoofan an yablugha mahillahu walawla rijalun muminoona wanisaon muminatun lam taAAlamoohum an tataoohum fatuseebakum minhum maAAarratun bighayri AAilmin liyudkhila Allahu fee rahmatihi man yashao law tazayyaloo laAAaththabna allatheena kafaroo minhum AAathaban aleeman
48.translation: These it was who disbelieved and debarred you from the Inviolable Place of Worship, and debarred the offering from reaching its goal. And if it had not been for believing men and believing women, whom ye know not - lest ye should tread them under foot and thus incur guilt for them unknowingly; that Allah might bring into His mercy whom He will - If (the believers and the disbelievers) had been clearly separated We verily had punished those of them who disbelieved with painful punishment

48.arabic: إِذ جَعَلَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا فى قُلوبِهِمُ الحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ الجٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ اللَّهُ سَكينَتَهُ عَلىٰ رَسولِهِ وَعَلَى المُؤمِنينَ وَأَلزَمَهُم كَلِمَةَ التَّقوىٰ وَكانوا أَحَقَّ بِها وَأَهلَها وَكانَ اللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمًا
48.transliteration: Ith jaAAala allatheena kafaroo fee quloobihimu alhamiyyata hamiyyata aljahiliyyati faanzala Allahu sakeenatahu AAala rasoolihi waAAala almumineena waalzamahum kalimata alttaqwa wakanoo ahaqqa biha waahlaha wakana Allahu bikulli shayin AAaleeman
48.translation: When those who disbelieve had set up in their hearts zealotry, the zealotry of the Age of Ignorance, then Allah sent down His peace of reassurance upon His messenger and upon the believers and imposed on them the word of self-restraint, for they were worthy of it and meet for it. And Allah is Aware of all things

48.arabic: لَقَد صَدَقَ اللَّهُ رَسولَهُ الرُّءيا بِالحَقِّ لَتَدخُلُنَّ المَسجِدَ الحَرامَ إِن شاءَ اللَّهُ ءامِنينَ مُحَلِّقينَ رُءوسَكُم وَمُقَصِّرينَ لا تَخافونَ فَعَلِمَ ما لَم تَعلَموا فَجَعَلَ مِن دونِ ذٰلِكَ فَتحًا قَريبًا
48.transliteration: Laqad sadaqa Allahu rasoolahu alrruya bialhaqqi latadkhulunna almasjida alharama in shaa Allahu amineena muhalliqeena ruoosakum wamuqassireena la takhafoona faAAalima ma lam taAAlamoo fajaAAala min dooni thalika fathan qareeban
48.translation: Allah hath fulfilled the vision for His messenger in very truth. Ye shall indeed enter the Inviolable Place of Worship, if Allah will, secure, (having your hair) shaven and cut, not fearing. But He knoweth that which ye know not, and hath given you a near victory beforehand

48.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى أَرسَلَ رَسولَهُ بِالهُدىٰ وَدينِ الحَقِّ لِيُظهِرَهُ عَلَى الدّينِ كُلِّهِ وَكَفىٰ بِاللَّهِ شَهيدًا
48.transliteration: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi wakafa biAllahi shaheedan
48.translation: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may cause it to prevail over all religion. And Allah sufficeth as a Witness

48.arabic: مُحَمَّدٌ رَسولُ اللَّهِ وَالَّذينَ مَعَهُ أَشِدّاءُ عَلَى الكُفّارِ رُحَماءُ بَينَهُم تَرىٰهُم رُكَّعًا سُجَّدًا يَبتَغونَ فَضلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضوٰنًا سيماهُم فى وُجوهِهِم مِن أَثَرِ السُّجودِ ذٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُم فِى التَّورىٰةِ وَمَثَلُهُم فِى الإِنجيلِ كَزَرعٍ أَخرَجَ شَطـَٔهُ فَـٔازَرَهُ فَاستَغلَظَ فَاستَوىٰ عَلىٰ سوقِهِ يُعجِبُ الزُّرّاعَ لِيَغيظَ بِهِمُ الكُفّارَ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ مِنهُم مَغفِرَةً وَأَجرًا عَظيمًا
48.transliteration: Muhammadun rasoolu Allahi waallatheena maAAahu ashiddao AAala alkuffari ruhamao baynahum tarahum rukkaAAan sujjadan yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan seemahum fee wujoohihim min athari alssujoodi thalika mathaluhum fee alttawrati wamathaluhum fee alinjeeli kazarAAin akhraja shatahu faazarahu faistaghlatha faistawa AAala sooqihi yuAAjibu alzzurraAAa liyagheetha bihimu alkuffara waAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati minhum maghfiratan waajran AAatheeman
48.translation: Muhammad is the messenger of Allah. And those with him are hard against the disbelievers and merciful among themselves. Thou (O Muhammad) seest them bowing and falling prostrate (in worship), seeking bounty from Allah and (His) acceptance. The mark of them is on their foreheads from the traces of prostration. Such is their likeness in the Torah and their likeness in the Gospel - like as sown corn that sendeth forth its shoot and strengtheneth it and riseth firm upon its stalk, delighting the sowers - that He may enrage the disbelievers with (the sight of) them. Allah hath promised, unto such of them as believe and do good works, forgiveness and immense reward

49.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تُقَدِّموا بَينَ يَدَىِ اللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَميعٌ عَليمٌ
49.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuqaddimoo bayna yadayi Allahi warasoolihi waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun
49.translation: O ye who believe! Be not forward in the presence of Allah and His messenger, and keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower

49.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تَرفَعوا أَصوٰتَكُم فَوقَ صَوتِ النَّبِىِّ وَلا تَجهَروا لَهُ بِالقَولِ كَجَهرِ بَعضِكُم لِبَعضٍ أَن تَحبَطَ أَعمٰلُكُم وَأَنتُم لا تَشعُرونَ
49.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tarfaAAoo aswatakum fawqa sawti alnnabiyyi wala tajharoo lahu bialqawli kajahri baAAdikum libaAAdin an tahbata aAAmalukum waantum la tashAAuroona
49.translation: O ye who believe! Lift not up your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor shout when speaking to him as ye shout one to another, lest your works be rendered vain while ye perceive not

49.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَغُضّونَ أَصوٰتَهُم عِندَ رَسولِ اللَّهِ أُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ امتَحَنَ اللَّهُ قُلوبَهُم لِلتَّقوىٰ لَهُم مَغفِرَةٌ وَأَجرٌ عَظيمٌ
49.transliteration: Inna allatheena yaghuddoona aswatahum AAinda rasooli Allahi olaika allatheena imtahana Allahu quloobahum lilttaqwa lahum maghfiratun waajrun AAatheemun
49.translation: Lo! they who subdue their voices in the presence of the messenger of Allah, those are they whose hearts Allah hath proven unto righteousness. Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward

49.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يُنادونَكَ مِن وَراءِ الحُجُرٰتِ أَكثَرُهُم لا يَعقِلونَ
49.transliteration: Inna allatheena yunadoonaka min warai alhujurati aktharuhum la yaAAqiloona
49.translation: Lo! those who call thee from behind the private apartments, most of them have no sense

49.arabic: وَلَو أَنَّهُم صَبَروا حَتّىٰ تَخرُجَ إِلَيهِم لَكانَ خَيرًا لَهُم وَاللَّهُ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
49.transliteration: Walaw annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilayhim lakana khayran lahum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun
49.translation: And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

49.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِن جاءَكُم فاسِقٌ بِنَبَإٍ فَتَبَيَّنوا أَن تُصيبوا قَومًا بِجَهٰلَةٍ فَتُصبِحوا عَلىٰ ما فَعَلتُم نٰدِمينَ
49.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in jaakum fasiqun binabain fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawman bijahalatin fatusbihoo AAala ma faAAaltum nadimeena
49.translation: O ye who believe! If an evil-liver bring you tidings, verify it, lest ye smite some folk in ignorance and afterward repent of what ye did

49.arabic: وَاعلَموا أَنَّ فيكُم رَسولَ اللَّهِ لَو يُطيعُكُم فى كَثيرٍ مِنَ الأَمرِ لَعَنِتُّم وَلٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيكُمُ الإيمٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُ فى قُلوبِكُم وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيكُمُ الكُفرَ وَالفُسوقَ وَالعِصيانَ أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الرّٰشِدونَ
49.transliteration: WaiAAlamoo anna feekum rasoola Allahi law yuteeAAukum fee katheerin mina alamri laAAanittum walakinna Allaha habbaba ilaykumu aleemana wazayyanahu fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumu alkufra waalfusooqa waalAAisyana olaika humu alrrashidoona
49.translation: And know that the messenger of Allah is among you. If he were to obey you in much of the government, ye would surely be in trouble; but Allah hath endeared the faith to you and hath beautified it in your hearts, and hath made disbelief and lewdness and rebellion hateful unto you. Such are they who are the rightly guided

49.arabic: فَضلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَنِعمَةً وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ حَكيمٌ
49.transliteration: Fadlan mina Allahi waniAAmatan waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun
49.translation: (It is) a bounty and a grace from Allah; and Allah is Knower, Wise

49.arabic: وَإِن طائِفَتانِ مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ اقتَتَلوا فَأَصلِحوا بَينَهُما فَإِن بَغَت إِحدىٰهُما عَلَى الأُخرىٰ فَقٰتِلُوا الَّتى تَبغى حَتّىٰ تَفيءَ إِلىٰ أَمرِ اللَّهِ فَإِن فاءَت فَأَصلِحوا بَينَهُما بِالعَدلِ وَأَقسِطوا إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ المُقسِطينَ
49.transliteration: Wain taifatani mina almumineena iqtataloo faaslihoo baynahuma fain baghat ihdahuma AAala alokhra faqatiloo allatee tabghee hatta tafeea ila amri Allahi fain faat faaslihoo baynahuma bialAAadli waaqsitoo inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena
49.translation: And if two parties of believers fall to fighting, then make peace between them. And if one party of them doeth wrong to the other, fight ye that which doeth wrong till it return unto the ordinance of Allah; then, if it return, make peace between them justly, and act equitably. Lo! Allah loveth the equitable

49.arabic: إِنَّمَا المُؤمِنونَ إِخوَةٌ فَأَصلِحوا بَينَ أَخَوَيكُم وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُم تُرحَمونَ
49.transliteration: Innama almuminoona ikhwatun faaslihoo bayna akhawaykum waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona
49.translation: The believers are naught else than brothers. Therefore make peace between your brethren and observe your duty to Allah that haply ye may obtain mercy

49.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا يَسخَر قَومٌ مِن قَومٍ عَسىٰ أَن يَكونوا خَيرًا مِنهُم وَلا نِساءٌ مِن نِساءٍ عَسىٰ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيرًا مِنهُنَّ وَلا تَلمِزوا أَنفُسَكُم وَلا تَنابَزوا بِالأَلقٰبِ بِئسَ الِاسمُ الفُسوقُ بَعدَ الإيمٰنِ وَمَن لَم يَتُب فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمونَ
49.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yaskhar qawmun min qawmin AAasa an yakoonoo khayran minhum wala nisaon min nisain AAasa an yakunna khayran minhunna wala talmizoo anfusakum wala tanabazoo bialalqabi bisa alismu alfusooqu baAAda aleemani waman lam yatub faolaika humu alththalimoona
49.translation: O ye who believe! Let not a folk deride a folk who may be better than they (are), not let women (deride) women who may be better than they are; neither defame one another, nor insult one another by nicknames. Bad is the name of lewdness after faith. And whoso turneth not in repentance, such are evil-doers

49.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنُوا اجتَنِبوا كَثيرًا مِنَ الظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعضَ الظَّنِّ إِثمٌ وَلا تَجَسَّسوا وَلا يَغتَب بَعضُكُم بَعضًا أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُم أَن يَأكُلَ لَحمَ أَخيهِ مَيتًا فَكَرِهتُموهُ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَوّابٌ رَحيمٌ
49.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ijtaniboo katheeran mina alththanni inna baAAda alththanni ithmun wala tajassasoo wala yaghtab baAAdukum baAAdan ayuhibbu ahadukum an yakula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumoohu waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha tawwabun raheemun
49.translation: O ye who believe! Shun much suspicion; for lo! some suspicion is a crime. And spy not, neither backbite one another. Would one of you love to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Ye abhor that (so abhor the other)! And keep your duty (to Allah). Lo! Allah is Relenting, Merciful

49.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النّاسُ إِنّا خَلَقنٰكُم مِن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثىٰ وَجَعَلنٰكُم شُعوبًا وَقَبائِلَ لِتَعارَفوا إِنَّ أَكرَمَكُم عِندَ اللَّهِ أَتقىٰكُم إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَليمٌ خَبيرٌ
49.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna khalaqnakum min thakarin waontha wajaAAalnakum shuAAooban waqabaila litaAAarafoo inna akramakum AAinda Allahi atqakum inna Allaha AAaleemun khabeerun
49.translation: O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that ye may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware

49.arabic: قالَتِ الأَعرابُ ءامَنّا قُل لَم تُؤمِنوا وَلٰكِن قولوا أَسلَمنا وَلَمّا يَدخُلِ الإيمٰنُ فى قُلوبِكُم وَإِن تُطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ لا يَلِتكُم مِن أَعمٰلِكُم شَيـًٔا إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
49.transliteration: Qalati alaAArabu amanna qul lam tuminoo walakin qooloo aslamna walamma yadkhuli aleemanu fee quloobikum wain tuteeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu la yalitkum min aAAmalikum shayan inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
49.translation: The wandering Arabs say: We believe. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Ye believe not, but rather say "We submit," for the faith hath not yet entered into your hearts. Yet, if ye obey Allah and His messenger, He will not withhold from you aught of (the reward of) your deeds. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

49.arabic: إِنَّمَا المُؤمِنونَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ ثُمَّ لَم يَرتابوا وَجٰهَدوا بِأَموٰلِهِم وَأَنفُسِهِم فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الصّٰدِقونَ
49.transliteration: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaboo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi olaika humu alssadiqoona
49.translation: The (true) believers are those only who believe in Allah and His messenger and afterward doubt not, but strive with their wealth and their lives for the cause of Allah. Such are the sincere

49.arabic: قُل أَتُعَلِّمونَ اللَّهَ بِدينِكُم وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمٌ
49.transliteration: Qul atuAAallimoona Allaha bideenikum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun
49.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Would ye teach Allah your religion, when Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, and Allah is Aware of all things

49.arabic: يَمُنّونَ عَلَيكَ أَن أَسلَموا قُل لا تَمُنّوا عَلَىَّ إِسلٰمَكُم بَلِ اللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيكُم أَن هَدىٰكُم لِلإيمٰنِ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
49.transliteration: Yamunnoona AAalayka an aslamoo qul la tamunnoo AAalayya islamakum bali Allahu yamunnu AAalaykum an hadakum lileemani in kuntum sadiqeena
49.translation: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest

49.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَعلَمُ غَيبَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَاللَّهُ بَصيرٌ بِما تَعمَلونَ
49.transliteration: Inna Allaha yaAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waAllahu baseerun bima taAAmaloona
49.translation: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do

50.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ ق وَالقُرءانِ المَجيدِ
50.transliteration: Qaf waalqurani almajeedi
50.translation: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an

50.arabic: بَل عَجِبوا أَن جاءَهُم مُنذِرٌ مِنهُم فَقالَ الكٰفِرونَ هٰذا شَيءٌ عَجيبٌ
50.transliteration: Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun
50.translation: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing

50.arabic: أَءِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا ذٰلِكَ رَجعٌ بَعيدٌ
50.transliteration: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun
50.translation: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return

50.arabic: قَد عَلِمنا ما تَنقُصُ الأَرضُ مِنهُم وَعِندَنا كِتٰبٌ حَفيظٌ
50.transliteration: Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun
50.translation: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book

50.arabic: بَل كَذَّبوا بِالحَقِّ لَمّا جاءَهُم فَهُم فى أَمرٍ مَريجٍ
50.transliteration: Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin
50.translation: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case

50.arabic: أَفَلَم يَنظُروا إِلَى السَّماءِ فَوقَهُم كَيفَ بَنَينٰها وَزَيَّنّٰها وَما لَها مِن فُروجٍ
50.transliteration: Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin
50.translation: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein

50.arabic: وَالأَرضَ مَدَدنٰها وَأَلقَينا فيها رَوٰسِىَ وَأَنبَتنا فيها مِن كُلِّ زَوجٍ بَهيجٍ
50.transliteration: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin
50.translation: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon

50.arabic: تَبصِرَةً وَذِكرىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبدٍ مُنيبٍ
50.transliteration: Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin
50.translation: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave

50.arabic: وَنَزَّلنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً مُبٰرَكًا فَأَنبَتنا بِهِ جَنّٰتٍ وَحَبَّ الحَصيدِ
50.transliteration: Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi
50.translation: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops

50.arabic: وَالنَّخلَ باسِقٰتٍ لَها طَلعٌ نَضيدٌ
50.transliteration: Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun
50.translation: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters

50.arabic: رِزقًا لِلعِبادِ وَأَحيَينا بِهِ بَلدَةً مَيتًا كَذٰلِكَ الخُروجُ
50.transliteration: Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju
50.translation: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead

50.arabic: كَذَّبَت قَبلَهُم قَومُ نوحٍ وَأَصحٰبُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمودُ
50.transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu
50.translation: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud

50.arabic: وَعادٌ وَفِرعَونُ وَإِخوٰنُ لوطٍ
50.transliteration: WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin
50.translation: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot

50.arabic: وَأَصحٰبُ الأَيكَةِ وَقَومُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعيدِ
50.transliteration: Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi
50.translation: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect

50.arabic: أَفَعَيينا بِالخَلقِ الأَوَّلِ بَل هُم فى لَبسٍ مِن خَلقٍ جَديدٍ
50.transliteration: AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin
50.translation: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation

50.arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ وَنَعلَمُ ما تُوَسوِسُ بِهِ نَفسُهُ وَنَحنُ أَقرَبُ إِلَيهِ مِن حَبلِ الوَريدِ
50.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi
50.translation: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein

50.arabic: إِذ يَتَلَقَّى المُتَلَقِّيانِ عَنِ اليَمينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمالِ قَعيدٌ
50.transliteration: Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun
50.translation: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left

50.arabic: ما يَلفِظُ مِن قَولٍ إِلّا لَدَيهِ رَقيبٌ عَتيدٌ
50.transliteration: Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun
50.translation: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready

50.arabic: وَجاءَت سَكرَةُ المَوتِ بِالحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ ما كُنتَ مِنهُ تَحيدُ
50.transliteration: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu
50.translation: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun

50.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ ذٰلِكَ يَومُ الوَعيدِ
50.transliteration: Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi
50.translation: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day

50.arabic: وَجاءَت كُلُّ نَفسٍ مَعَها سائِقٌ وَشَهيدٌ
50.transliteration: Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun
50.translation: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness

50.arabic: لَقَد كُنتَ فى غَفلَةٍ مِن هٰذا فَكَشَفنا عَنكَ غِطاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ اليَومَ حَديدٌ
50.transliteration: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun
50.translation: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day

50.arabic: وَقالَ قَرينُهُ هٰذا ما لَدَىَّ عَتيدٌ
50.transliteration: Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun
50.translation: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony)

50.arabic: أَلقِيا فى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفّارٍ عَنيدٍ
50.transliteration: Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin
50.translation: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate

50.arabic: مَنّاعٍ لِلخَيرِ مُعتَدٍ مُريبٍ
50.transliteration: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin
50.translation: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter

50.arabic: الَّذى جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ فَأَلقِياهُ فِى العَذابِ الشَّديدِ
50.transliteration: Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi
50.translation: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom

50.arabic: قالَ قَرينُهُ رَبَّنا ما أَطغَيتُهُ وَلٰكِن كانَ فى ضَلٰلٍ بَعيدٍ
50.transliteration: Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin
50.translation: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error

50.arabic: قالَ لا تَختَصِموا لَدَىَّ وَقَد قَدَّمتُ إِلَيكُم بِالوَعيدِ
50.transliteration: Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi
50.translation: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning

50.arabic: ما يُبَدَّلُ القَولُ لَدَىَّ وَما أَنا۠ بِظَلّٰمٍ لِلعَبيدِ
50.transliteration: Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi
50.translation: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves

50.arabic: يَومَ نَقولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امتَلَأتِ وَتَقولُ هَل مِن مَزيدٍ
50.transliteration: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin
50.translation: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come

50.arabic: وَأُزلِفَتِ الجَنَّةُ لِلمُتَّقينَ غَيرَ بَعيدٍ
50.transliteration: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin
50.translation: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant

50.arabic: هٰذا ما توعَدونَ لِكُلِّ أَوّابٍ حَفيظٍ
50.transliteration: Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin
50.translation: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one

50.arabic: مَن خَشِىَ الرَّحمٰنَ بِالغَيبِ وَجاءَ بِقَلبٍ مُنيبٍ
50.transliteration: Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin
50.translation: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart

50.arabic: ادخُلوها بِسَلٰمٍ ذٰلِكَ يَومُ الخُلودِ
50.transliteration: Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi
50.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality

50.arabic: لَهُم ما يَشاءونَ فيها وَلَدَينا مَزيدٌ
50.transliteration: Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun
50.translation: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us

50.arabic: وَكَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِن قَرنٍ هُم أَشَدُّ مِنهُم بَطشًا فَنَقَّبوا فِى البِلٰدِ هَل مِن مَحيصٍ
50.transliteration: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin
50.translation: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)

50.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَذِكرىٰ لِمَن كانَ لَهُ قَلبٌ أَو أَلقَى السَّمعَ وَهُوَ شَهيدٌ
50.transliteration: Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun
50.translation: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence

50.arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ وَما بَينَهُما فى سِتَّةِ أَيّامٍ وَما مَسَّنا مِن لُغوبٍ
50.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin
50.translation: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us

50.arabic: فَاصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ قَبلَ طُلوعِ الشَّمسِ وَقَبلَ الغُروبِ
50.transliteration: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi
50.translation: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun

50.arabic: وَمِنَ الَّيلِ فَسَبِّحهُ وَأَدبٰرَ السُّجودِ
50.transliteration: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi
50.translation: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations

50.arabic: وَاستَمِع يَومَ يُنادِ المُنادِ مِن مَكانٍ قَريبٍ
50.transliteration: WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin
50.translation: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place

50.arabic: يَومَ يَسمَعونَ الصَّيحَةَ بِالحَقِّ ذٰلِكَ يَومُ الخُروجِ
50.transliteration: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji
50.translation: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves)

50.arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نُحيۦ وَنُميتُ وَإِلَينَا المَصيرُ
50.transliteration: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru
50.translation: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying

50.arabic: يَومَ تَشَقَّقُ الأَرضُ عَنهُم سِراعًا ذٰلِكَ حَشرٌ عَلَينا يَسيرٌ
50.transliteration: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun
50.translation: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make)

50.arabic: نَحنُ أَعلَمُ بِما يَقولونَ وَما أَنتَ عَلَيهِم بِجَبّارٍ فَذَكِّر بِالقُرءانِ مَن يَخافُ وَعيدِ
50.transliteration: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi
50.translation: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat

51.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالذّٰرِيٰتِ ذَروًا
51.transliteration: Waalththariyati tharwan
51.translation: By those that winnow with a winnowing

51.arabic: فَالحٰمِلٰتِ وِقرًا
51.transliteration: Faalhamilati wiqran
51.translation: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

51.arabic: فَالجٰرِيٰتِ يُسرًا
51.transliteration: Faaljariyati yusran
51.translation: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

51.arabic: فَالمُقَسِّمٰتِ أَمرًا
51.transliteration: Faalmuqassimati amran
51.translation: And those who distribute (blessings) by command

51.arabic: إِنَّما توعَدونَ لَصادِقٌ
51.transliteration: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun
51.translation: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true

51.arabic: وَإِنَّ الدّينَ لَوٰقِعٌ
51.transliteration: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun
51.translation: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall

51.arabic: وَالسَّماءِ ذاتِ الحُبُكِ
51.transliteration: Waalssamai thati alhubuki
51.translation: By the heaven full of paths

51.arabic: إِنَّكُم لَفى قَولٍ مُختَلِفٍ
51.transliteration: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin
51.translation: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth)

51.arabic: يُؤفَكُ عَنهُ مَن أُفِكَ
51.transliteration: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika
51.translation: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse

51.arabic: قُتِلَ الخَرّٰصونَ
51.transliteration: Qutila alkharrasoona
51.translation: Accursed be the conjecturers

51.arabic: الَّذينَ هُم فى غَمرَةٍ ساهونَ
51.transliteration: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona
51.translation: Who are careless in an abyss

51.arabic: يَسـَٔلونَ أَيّانَ يَومُ الدّينِ
51.transliteration: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni
51.translation: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment

51.arabic: يَومَ هُم عَلَى النّارِ يُفتَنونَ
51.transliteration: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona
51.translation: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire

51.arabic: ذوقوا فِتنَتَكُم هٰذَا الَّذى كُنتُم بِهِ تَستَعجِلونَ
51.transliteration: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona
51.translation: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten

51.arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى جَنّٰتٍ وَعُيونٍ
51.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
51.translation: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings

51.arabic: ءاخِذينَ ما ءاتىٰهُم رَبُّهُم إِنَّهُم كانوا قَبلَ ذٰلِكَ مُحسِنينَ
51.transliteration: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena
51.translation: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good

51.arabic: كانوا قَليلًا مِنَ الَّيلِ ما يَهجَعونَ
51.transliteration: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona
51.translation: They used to sleep but little of the night

51.arabic: وَبِالأَسحارِ هُم يَستَغفِرونَ
51.transliteration: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona
51.translation: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness

51.arabic: وَفى أَموٰلِهِم حَقٌّ لِلسّائِلِ وَالمَحرومِ
51.transliteration: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi
51.translation: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share

51.arabic: وَفِى الأَرضِ ءايٰتٌ لِلموقِنينَ
51.transliteration: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena
51.translation: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure

51.arabic: وَفى أَنفُسِكُم أَفَلا تُبصِرونَ
51.transliteration: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona
51.translation: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see

51.arabic: وَفِى السَّماءِ رِزقُكُم وَما توعَدونَ
51.transliteration: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona
51.translation: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised

51.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ السَّماءِ وَالأَرضِ إِنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثلَ ما أَنَّكُم تَنطِقونَ
51.transliteration: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona
51.translation: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak

51.arabic: هَل أَتىٰكَ حَديثُ ضَيفِ إِبرٰهيمَ المُكرَمينَ
51.transliteration: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena
51.translation: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)

51.arabic: إِذ دَخَلوا عَلَيهِ فَقالوا سَلٰمًا قالَ سَلٰمٌ قَومٌ مُنكَرونَ
51.transliteration: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona
51.translation: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me)

51.arabic: فَراغَ إِلىٰ أَهلِهِ فَجاءَ بِعِجلٍ سَمينٍ
51.transliteration: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin
51.translation: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf

51.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُ إِلَيهِم قالَ أَلا تَأكُلونَ
51.transliteration: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona
51.translation: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat

51.arabic: فَأَوجَسَ مِنهُم خيفَةً قالوا لا تَخَف وَبَشَّروهُ بِغُلٰمٍ عَليمٍ
51.transliteration: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin
51.translation: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son

51.arabic: فَأَقبَلَتِ امرَأَتُهُ فى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّت وَجهَها وَقالَت عَجوزٌ عَقيمٌ
51.transliteration: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun
51.translation: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman

51.arabic: قالوا كَذٰلِكِ قالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الحَكيمُ العَليمُ
51.transliteration: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu
51.translation: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower

51.arabic: قالَ فَما خَطبُكُم أَيُّهَا المُرسَلونَ
51.transliteration: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona
51.translation: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)

51.arabic: قالوا إِنّا أُرسِلنا إِلىٰ قَومٍ مُجرِمينَ
51.transliteration: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena
51.translation: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk

51.arabic: لِنُرسِلَ عَلَيهِم حِجارَةً مِن طينٍ
51.transliteration: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin
51.translation: That we may send upon them stones of clay

51.arabic: مُسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلمُسرِفينَ
51.transliteration: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena
51.translation: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton

51.arabic: فَأَخرَجنا مَن كانَ فيها مِنَ المُؤمِنينَ
51.transliteration: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena
51.translation: Then we brought forth such believers as were there

51.arabic: فَما وَجَدنا فيها غَيرَ بَيتٍ مِنَ المُسلِمينَ
51.transliteration: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena
51.translation: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah)

51.arabic: وَتَرَكنا فيها ءايَةً لِلَّذينَ يَخافونَ العَذابَ الأَليمَ
51.transliteration: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema
51.translation: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom

51.arabic: وَفى موسىٰ إِذ أَرسَلنٰهُ إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ بِسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
51.transliteration: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin
51.translation: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant

51.arabic: فَتَوَلّىٰ بِرُكنِهِ وَقالَ سٰحِرٌ أَو مَجنونٌ
51.transliteration: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun
51.translation: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman

51.arabic: فَأَخَذنٰهُ وَجُنودَهُ فَنَبَذنٰهُم فِى اليَمِّ وَهُوَ مُليمٌ
51.transliteration: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun
51.translation: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate

51.arabic: وَفى عادٍ إِذ أَرسَلنا عَلَيهِمُ الرّيحَ العَقيمَ
51.transliteration: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema
51.translation: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them

51.arabic: ما تَذَرُ مِن شَيءٍ أَتَت عَلَيهِ إِلّا جَعَلَتهُ كَالرَّميمِ
51.transliteration: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi
51.translation: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust

51.arabic: وَفى ثَمودَ إِذ قيلَ لَهُم تَمَتَّعوا حَتّىٰ حينٍ
51.transliteration: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin
51.translation: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile

51.arabic: فَعَتَوا عَن أَمرِ رَبِّهِم فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصّٰعِقَةُ وَهُم يَنظُرونَ
51.transliteration: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona
51.translation: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed

51.arabic: فَمَا استَطٰعوا مِن قِيامٍ وَما كانوا مُنتَصِرينَ
51.transliteration: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena
51.translation: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves

51.arabic: وَقَومَ نوحٍ مِن قَبلُ إِنَّهُم كانوا قَومًا فٰسِقينَ
51.transliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena
51.translation: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk

51.arabic: وَالسَّماءَ بَنَينٰها بِأَيي۟دٍ وَإِنّا لَموسِعونَ
51.transliteration: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona
51.translation: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof)

51.arabic: وَالأَرضَ فَرَشنٰها فَنِعمَ المٰهِدونَ
51.transliteration: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona
51.translation: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)

51.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيءٍ خَلَقنا زَوجَينِ لَعَلَّكُم تَذَكَّرونَ
51.transliteration: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona
51.translation: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect

51.arabic: فَفِرّوا إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنّى لَكُم مِنهُ نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
51.transliteration: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
51.translation: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him

51.arabic: وَلا تَجعَلوا مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ إِنّى لَكُم مِنهُ نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
51.transliteration: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun
51.translation: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him

51.arabic: كَذٰلِكَ ما أَتَى الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم مِن رَسولٍ إِلّا قالوا ساحِرٌ أَو مَجنونٌ
51.transliteration: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun
51.translation: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman

51.arabic: أَتَواصَوا بِهِ بَل هُم قَومٌ طاغونَ
51.transliteration: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona
51.translation: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk

51.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنهُم فَما أَنتَ بِمَلومٍ
51.transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin
51.translation: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy

51.arabic: وَذَكِّر فَإِنَّ الذِّكرىٰ تَنفَعُ المُؤمِنينَ
51.transliteration: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena
51.translation: And warn, for warning profiteth believers

51.arabic: وَما خَلَقتُ الجِنَّ وَالإِنسَ إِلّا لِيَعبُدونِ
51.transliteration: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni
51.translation: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me

51.arabic: ما أُريدُ مِنهُم مِن رِزقٍ وَما أُريدُ أَن يُطعِمونِ
51.transliteration: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni
51.translation: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me

51.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزّاقُ ذُو القُوَّةِ المَتينُ
51.transliteration: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu
51.translation: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might

51.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا ذَنوبًا مِثلَ ذَنوبِ أَصحٰبِهِم فَلا يَستَعجِلونِ
51.transliteration: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona
51.translation: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day)

51.arabic: فَوَيلٌ لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن يَومِهِمُ الَّذى يوعَدونَ
51.transliteration: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona
51.translation: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised

52.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالطّورِ
52.transliteration: Waalttoori
52.translation: By the Mount

52.arabic: وَكِتٰبٍ مَسطورٍ
52.transliteration: Wakitabin mastoorin
52.translation: And a Scripture inscribed

52.arabic: فى رَقٍّ مَنشورٍ
52.transliteration: Fee raqqin manshoorin
52.translation: On fine parchment unrolled

52.arabic: وَالبَيتِ المَعمورِ
52.transliteration: Waalbayti almaAAmoori
52.translation: And the House frequented

52.arabic: وَالسَّقفِ المَرفوعِ
52.transliteration: Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi
52.translation: And the roof exalted

52.arabic: وَالبَحرِ المَسجورِ
52.transliteration: Waalbahri almasjoori
52.translation: And the sea kept filled

52.arabic: إِنَّ عَذابَ رَبِّكَ لَوٰقِعٌ
52.transliteration: Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun
52.translation: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass

52.arabic: ما لَهُ مِن دافِعٍ
52.transliteration: Ma lahu min dafiAAin
52.translation: There is none that can ward it off

52.arabic: يَومَ تَمورُ السَّماءُ مَورًا
52.transliteration: Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran
52.translation: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving

52.arabic: وَتَسيرُ الجِبالُ سَيرًا
52.transliteration: Wataseeru aljibalu sayran
52.translation: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement

52.arabic: فَوَيلٌ يَومَئِذٍ لِلمُكَذِّبينَ
52.transliteration: Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena
52.translation: Then woe that day unto the deniers

52.arabic: الَّذينَ هُم فى خَوضٍ يَلعَبونَ
52.transliteration: Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona
52.translation: Who play in talk of grave matters

52.arabic: يَومَ يُدَعّونَ إِلىٰ نارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
52.transliteration: Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan
52.translation: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell

52.arabic: هٰذِهِ النّارُ الَّتى كُنتُم بِها تُكَذِّبونَ
52.transliteration: Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona
52.translation: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny

52.arabic: أَفَسِحرٌ هٰذا أَم أَنتُم لا تُبصِرونَ
52.transliteration: Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona
52.translation: Is this magic, or do ye not see

52.arabic: اصلَوها فَاصبِروا أَو لا تَصبِروا سَواءٌ عَلَيكُم إِنَّما تُجزَونَ ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
52.transliteration: Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona
52.translation: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do

52.arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى جَنّٰتٍ وَنَعيمٍ
52.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin
52.translation: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight

52.arabic: فٰكِهينَ بِما ءاتىٰهُم رَبُّهُم وَوَقىٰهُم رَبُّهُم عَذابَ الجَحيمِ
52.transliteration: Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi
52.translation: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire

52.arabic: كُلوا وَاشرَبوا هَنيـًٔا بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
52.transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona
52.translation: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do

52.arabic: مُتَّكِـٔينَ عَلىٰ سُرُرٍ مَصفوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجنٰهُم بِحورٍ عينٍ
52.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin
52.translation: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

52.arabic: وَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَاتَّبَعَتهُم ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإيمٰنٍ أَلحَقنا بِهِم ذُرِّيَّتَهُم وَما أَلَتنٰهُم مِن عَمَلِهِم مِن شَيءٍ كُلُّ امرِئٍ بِما كَسَبَ رَهينٌ
52.transliteration: Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun
52.translation: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned

52.arabic: وَأَمدَدنٰهُم بِفٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحمٍ مِمّا يَشتَهونَ
52.transliteration: Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona
52.translation: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire

52.arabic: يَتَنٰزَعونَ فيها كَأسًا لا لَغوٌ فيها وَلا تَأثيمٌ
52.transliteration: YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun
52.translation: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin

52.arabic: وَيَطوفُ عَلَيهِم غِلمانٌ لَهُم كَأَنَّهُم لُؤلُؤٌ مَكنونٌ
52.transliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun
52.translation: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls

52.arabic: وَأَقبَلَ بَعضُهُم عَلىٰ بَعضٍ يَتَساءَلونَ
52.transliteration: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona
52.translation: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning

52.arabic: قالوا إِنّا كُنّا قَبلُ فى أَهلِنا مُشفِقينَ
52.transliteration: Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena
52.translation: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious

52.arabic: فَمَنَّ اللَّهُ عَلَينا وَوَقىٰنا عَذابَ السَّمومِ
52.transliteration: Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi
52.translation: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire

52.arabic: إِنّا كُنّا مِن قَبلُ نَدعوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ البَرُّ الرَّحيمُ
52.transliteration: Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu
52.translation: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful

52.arabic: فَذَكِّر فَما أَنتَ بِنِعمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكاهِنٍ وَلا مَجنونٍ
52.transliteration: Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin
52.translation: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman

52.arabic: أَم يَقولونَ شاعِرٌ نَتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيبَ المَنونِ
52.transliteration: Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni
52.translation: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time

52.arabic: قُل تَرَبَّصوا فَإِنّى مَعَكُم مِنَ المُتَرَبِّصينَ
52.transliteration: Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena
52.translation: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant

52.arabic: أَم تَأمُرُهُم أَحلٰمُهُم بِهٰذا أَم هُم قَومٌ طاغونَ
52.transliteration: Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona
52.translation: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk

52.arabic: أَم يَقولونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَل لا يُؤمِنونَ
52.transliteration: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona
52.translation: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe

52.arabic: فَليَأتوا بِحَديثٍ مِثلِهِ إِن كانوا صٰدِقينَ
52.transliteration: Falyatoo bihadeethin mithlihi in kanoo sadiqeena
52.translation: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful

52.arabic: أَم خُلِقوا مِن غَيرِ شَيءٍ أَم هُمُ الخٰلِقونَ
52.transliteration: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona
52.translation: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators

52.arabic: أَم خَلَقُوا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بَل لا يوقِنونَ
52.transliteration: Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona
52.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing

52.arabic: أَم عِندَهُم خَزائِنُ رَبِّكَ أَم هُمُ المُصَۣيطِرونَ
52.transliteration: Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona
52.translation: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)

52.arabic: أَم لَهُم سُلَّمٌ يَستَمِعونَ فيهِ فَليَأتِ مُستَمِعُهُم بِسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
52.transliteration: Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin
52.translation: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest

52.arabic: أَم لَهُ البَنٰتُ وَلَكُمُ البَنونَ
52.transliteration: Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona
52.translation: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons

52.arabic: أَم تَسـَٔلُهُم أَجرًا فَهُم مِن مَغرَمٍ مُثقَلونَ
52.transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona
52.translation: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt

52.arabic: أَم عِندَهُمُ الغَيبُ فَهُم يَكتُبونَ
52.transliteration: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona
52.translation: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down

52.arabic: أَم يُريدونَ كَيدًا فَالَّذينَ كَفَروا هُمُ المَكيدونَ
52.transliteration: Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona
52.translation: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared

52.arabic: أَم لَهُم إِلٰهٌ غَيرُ اللَّهِ سُبحٰنَ اللَّهِ عَمّا يُشرِكونَ
52.transliteration: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona
52.translation: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

52.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوا كِسفًا مِنَ السَّماءِ ساقِطًا يَقولوا سَحابٌ مَركومٌ
52.transliteration: Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun
52.translation: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds

52.arabic: فَذَرهُم حَتّىٰ يُلٰقوا يَومَهُمُ الَّذى فيهِ يُصعَقونَ
52.transliteration: Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona
52.translation: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken

52.arabic: يَومَ لا يُغنى عَنهُم كَيدُهُم شَيـًٔا وَلا هُم يُنصَرونَ
52.transliteration: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona
52.translation: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped

52.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذينَ ظَلَموا عَذابًا دونَ ذٰلِكَ وَلٰكِنَّ أَكثَرَهُم لا يَعلَمونَ
52.transliteration: Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
52.translation: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not

52.arabic: وَاصبِر لِحُكمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعيُنِنا وَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ حينَ تَقومُ
52.transliteration: Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu
52.translation: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest

52.arabic: وَمِنَ الَّيلِ فَسَبِّحهُ وَإِدبٰرَ النُّجومِ
52.transliteration: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi
52.translation: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars

53.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالنَّجمِ إِذا هَوىٰ
53.translation: By the Star when it setteth
Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived
Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire
It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired
Which one of mighty powers hath taught him
One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
When he was on the uppermost horizon
Then he drew nigh and came down
Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer
And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed
The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw
Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth
And verily he saw him yet another time
By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary
Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode
When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree
The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold

53.arabic: لَقَد رَأىٰ مِن ءايٰتِ رَبِّهِ الكُبرىٰ
53.transliteration: Laqad raa min ayati rabbihi alkubra
53.translation: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord
Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza
And Manat, the third, the other
Are yours the males and His the females
That indeed were an unfair division

53.arabic: إِن هِىَ إِلّا أَسماءٌ سَمَّيتُموها أَنتُم وَءاباؤُكُم ما أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ بِها مِن سُلطٰنٍ إِن يَتَّبِعونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَما تَهوَى الأَنفُسُ وَلَقَد جاءَهُم مِن رَبِّهِمُ الهُدىٰ
53.transliteration: In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda
53.translation: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them
Or shall man have what he coveteth
But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former

53.arabic: وَكَم مِن مَلَكٍ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ لا تُغنى شَفٰعَتُهُم شَيـًٔا إِلّا مِن بَعدِ أَن يَأذَنَ اللَّهُ لِمَن يَشاءُ وَيَرضىٰ
53.transliteration: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda
53.translation: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth

53.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِالءاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمّونَ المَلٰئِكَةَ تَسمِيَةَ الأُنثىٰ
53.transliteration: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha
53.translation: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females
