53.arabic: وَما لَهُم بِهِ مِن عِلمٍ إِن يَتَّبِعونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ لا يُغنى مِنَ الحَقِّ شَيـًٔا
53.transliteration: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan
53.translation: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth

53.arabic: فَأَعرِض عَن مَن تَوَلّىٰ عَن ذِكرِنا وَلَم يُرِد إِلَّا الحَيوٰةَ الدُّنيا
53.transliteration: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya
53.translation: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world

53.arabic: ذٰلِكَ مَبلَغُهُم مِنَ العِلمِ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعلَمُ بِمَنِ اهتَدىٰ
53.transliteration: Thalika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtada
53.translation: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right

53.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ لِيَجزِىَ الَّذينَ أَسٰـٔوا بِما عَمِلوا وَيَجزِىَ الَّذينَ أَحسَنوا بِالحُسنَى
53.transliteration: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna
53.translation: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness

53.arabic: الَّذينَ يَجتَنِبونَ كَبٰئِرَ الإِثمِ وَالفَوٰحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وٰسِعُ المَغفِرَةِ هُوَ أَعلَمُ بِكُم إِذ أَنشَأَكُم مِنَ الأَرضِ وَإِذ أَنتُم أَجِنَّةٌ فى بُطونِ أُمَّهٰتِكُم فَلا تُزَكّوا أَنفُسَكُم هُوَ أَعلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقىٰ
53.transliteration: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa
53.translation: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil)
Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away
And gave a little, then was grudging
Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth

53.arabic: أَم لَم يُنَبَّأ بِما فى صُحُفِ موسىٰ
53.transliteration: Am lam yunabba bima fee suhufi moosa
53.translation: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
And Abraham who paid his debt
That no laden one shall bear another's load

53.arabic: وَأَن لَيسَ لِلإِنسٰنِ إِلّا ما سَعىٰ
53.transliteration: Waan laysa lilinsani illa ma saAAa
53.translation: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort
And that his effort will be seen
And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment
And that thy Lord, He is the goal
And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep
And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life
And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female
From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth
And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth
And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth
And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius
And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad
And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not

53.arabic: وَقَومَ نوحٍ مِن قَبلُ إِنَّهُم كانوا هُم أَظلَمَ وَأَطغىٰ
53.transliteration: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha
53.translation: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious
And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
So that there covered them that which did cover
Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute
This is a warner of the warners of old
The threatened Hour is nigh

53.arabic: لَيسَ لَها مِن دونِ اللَّهِ كاشِفَةٌ
53.transliteration: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun
53.translation: None beside Allah can disclose it
Marvel ye then at this statement
And laugh and not weep
While ye amuse yourselves
Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him

54.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ اقتَرَبَتِ السّاعَةُ وَانشَقَّ القَمَرُ
54.transliteration: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru
54.translation: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain

54.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوا ءايَةً يُعرِضوا وَيَقولوا سِحرٌ مُستَمِرٌّ
54.transliteration: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun
54.translation: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion

54.arabic: وَكَذَّبوا وَاتَّبَعوا أَهواءَهُم وَكُلُّ أَمرٍ مُستَقِرٌّ
54.transliteration: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun
54.translation: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision

54.arabic: وَلَقَد جاءَهُم مِنَ الأَنباءِ ما فيهِ مُزدَجَرٌ
54.transliteration: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun
54.translation: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter

54.arabic: حِكمَةٌ بٰلِغَةٌ فَما تُغنِ النُّذُرُ
54.transliteration: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru
54.translation: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not

54.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنهُم يَومَ يَدعُ الدّاعِ إِلىٰ شَيءٍ نُكُرٍ
54.transliteration: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin
54.translation: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing

54.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبصٰرُهُم يَخرُجونَ مِنَ الأَجداثِ كَأَنَّهُم جَرادٌ مُنتَشِرٌ
54.transliteration: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun
54.translation: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad

54.arabic: مُهطِعينَ إِلَى الدّاعِ يَقولُ الكٰفِرونَ هٰذا يَومٌ عَسِرٌ
54.transliteration: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun
54.translation: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day

54.arabic: كَذَّبَت قَبلَهُم قَومُ نوحٍ فَكَذَّبوا عَبدَنا وَقالوا مَجنونٌ وَازدُجِرَ
54.transliteration: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira
54.translation: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed

54.arabic: فَدَعا رَبَّهُ أَنّى مَغلوبٌ فَانتَصِر
54.transliteration: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir
54.translation: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help

54.arabic: فَفَتَحنا أَبوٰبَ السَّماءِ بِماءٍ مُنهَمِرٍ
54.transliteration: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin
54.translation: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

54.arabic: وَفَجَّرنَا الأَرضَ عُيونًا فَالتَقَى الماءُ عَلىٰ أَمرٍ قَد قُدِرَ
54.transliteration: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira
54.translation: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose

54.arabic: وَحَمَلنٰهُ عَلىٰ ذاتِ أَلوٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
54.transliteration: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin
54.translation: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails

54.arabic: تَجرى بِأَعيُنِنا جَزاءً لِمَن كانَ كُفِرَ
54.transliteration: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira
54.translation: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected

54.arabic: وَلَقَد تَرَكنٰها ءايَةً فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
54.transliteration: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin
54.translation: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth

54.arabic: فَكَيفَ كانَ عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
54.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
54.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

54.arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرنَا القُرءانَ لِلذِّكرِ فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
54.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
54.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

54.arabic: كَذَّبَت عادٌ فَكَيفَ كانَ عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
54.transliteration: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
54.translation: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

54.arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنا عَلَيهِم ريحًا صَرصَرًا فى يَومِ نَحسٍ مُستَمِرٍّ
54.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin
54.translation: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity

54.arabic: تَنزِعُ النّاسَ كَأَنَّهُم أَعجازُ نَخلٍ مُنقَعِرٍ
54.transliteration: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin
54.translation: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees

54.arabic: فَكَيفَ كانَ عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
54.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
54.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

54.arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرنَا القُرءانَ لِلذِّكرِ فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
54.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
54.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

54.arabic: كَذَّبَت ثَمودُ بِالنُّذُرِ
54.transliteration: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri
54.translation: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings

54.arabic: فَقالوا أَبَشَرًا مِنّا وٰحِدًا نَتَّبِعُهُ إِنّا إِذًا لَفى ضَلٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
54.transliteration: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin
54.translation: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness

54.arabic: أَءُلقِىَ الذِّكرُ عَلَيهِ مِن بَينِنا بَل هُوَ كَذّابٌ أَشِرٌ
54.transliteration: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun
54.translation: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar

54.arabic: سَيَعلَمونَ غَدًا مَنِ الكَذّابُ الأَشِرُ
54.transliteration: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru
54.translation: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar

54.arabic: إِنّا مُرسِلُوا النّاقَةِ فِتنَةً لَهُم فَارتَقِبهُم وَاصطَبِر
54.transliteration: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir
54.translation: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience

54.arabic: وَنَبِّئهُم أَنَّ الماءَ قِسمَةٌ بَينَهُم كُلُّ شِربٍ مُحتَضَرٌ
54.transliteration: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun
54.translation: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed

54.arabic: فَنادَوا صاحِبَهُم فَتَعاطىٰ فَعَقَرَ
54.transliteration: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara
54.translation: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her)

54.arabic: فَكَيفَ كانَ عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
54.transliteration: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri
54.translation: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

54.arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنا عَلَيهِم صَيحَةً وٰحِدَةً فَكانوا كَهَشيمِ المُحتَظِرِ
54.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri
54.translation: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold

54.arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرنَا القُرءانَ لِلذِّكرِ فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
54.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
54.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

54.arabic: كَذَّبَت قَومُ لوطٍ بِالنُّذُرِ
54.transliteration: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri
54.translation: The folk of Lot rejected warnings

54.arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنا عَلَيهِم حاصِبًا إِلّا ءالَ لوطٍ نَجَّينٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
54.transliteration: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin
54.translation: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night

54.arabic: نِعمَةً مِن عِندِنا كَذٰلِكَ نَجزى مَن شَكَرَ
54.transliteration: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara
54.translation: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks

54.arabic: وَلَقَد أَنذَرَهُم بَطشَتَنا فَتَمارَوا بِالنُّذُرِ
54.transliteration: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri
54.translation: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings

54.arabic: وَلَقَد رٰوَدوهُ عَن ضَيفِهِ فَطَمَسنا أَعيُنَهُم فَذوقوا عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
54.transliteration: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
54.translation: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings

54.arabic: وَلَقَد صَبَّحَهُم بُكرَةً عَذابٌ مُستَقِرٌّ
54.transliteration: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun
54.translation: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning

54.arabic: فَذوقوا عَذابى وَنُذُرِ
54.transliteration: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri
54.translation: Now taste My punishment after My warnings

54.arabic: وَلَقَد يَسَّرنَا القُرءانَ لِلذِّكرِ فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
54.transliteration: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin
54.translation: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

54.arabic: وَلَقَد جاءَ ءالَ فِرعَونَ النُّذُرُ
54.transliteration: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru
54.translation: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

54.arabic: كَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِنا كُلِّها فَأَخَذنٰهُم أَخذَ عَزيزٍ مُقتَدِرٍ
54.transliteration: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin
54.translation: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful

54.arabic: أَكُفّارُكُم خَيرٌ مِن أُولٰئِكُم أَم لَكُم بَراءَةٌ فِى الزُّبُرِ
54.transliteration: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi
54.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures

54.arabic: أَم يَقولونَ نَحنُ جَميعٌ مُنتَصِرٌ
54.transliteration: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun
54.translation: Or say they: We are a host victorious

54.arabic: سَيُهزَمُ الجَمعُ وَيُوَلّونَ الدُّبُرَ
54.transliteration: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura
54.translation: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee

54.arabic: بَلِ السّاعَةُ مَوعِدُهُم وَالسّاعَةُ أَدهىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
54.transliteration: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru
54.translation: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure)

54.arabic: إِنَّ المُجرِمينَ فى ضَلٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
54.transliteration: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin
54.translation: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness

54.arabic: يَومَ يُسحَبونَ فِى النّارِ عَلىٰ وُجوهِهِم ذوقوا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
54.transliteration: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara
54.translation: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell

54.arabic: إِنّا كُلَّ شَيءٍ خَلَقنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
54.transliteration: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin
54.translation: Lo! We have created every thing by measure

54.arabic: وَما أَمرُنا إِلّا وٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمحٍ بِالبَصَرِ
54.transliteration: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari
54.translation: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye

54.arabic: وَلَقَد أَهلَكنا أَشياعَكُم فَهَل مِن مُدَّكِرٍ
54.transliteration: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin
54.translation: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth

54.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَيءٍ فَعَلوهُ فِى الزُّبُرِ
54.transliteration: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi
54.translation: And every thing they did is in the scriptures

54.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغيرٍ وَكَبيرٍ مُستَطَرٌ
54.transliteration: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun
54.translation: And every small and great thing is recorded

54.arabic: إِنَّ المُتَّقينَ فى جَنّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
54.transliteration: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin
54.translation: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers

54.arabic: فى مَقعَدِ صِدقٍ عِندَ مَليكٍ مُقتَدِرٍ
54.transliteration: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin
54.translation: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King

55.translation: The Beneficent
Hath made known the Qur'an
He hath created man
He hath taught him utterance
The sun and the moon are made punctual
The stars and the trees prostrate
And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure
That ye exceed not the measure

55.arabic: وَأَقيمُوا الوَزنَ بِالقِسطِ وَلا تُخسِرُوا الميزانَ
55.transliteration: Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana
55.translation: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof
And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures
Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees
Husked grain and scented herb
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
He created man of clay like the potter's

55.arabic: وَخَلَقَ الجانَّ مِن مارِجٍ مِن نارٍ
55.transliteration: Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin
55.translation: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
He hath loosed the two seas. They meet
There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other)
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: وَلَهُ الجَوارِ المُنشَـٔاتُ فِى البَحرِ كَالأَعلٰمِ
55.transliteration: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami
55.translation: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Everyone that is thereon will pass away

55.arabic: وَيَبقىٰ وَجهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو الجَلٰلِ وَالإِكرامِ
55.transliteration: Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami
55.translation: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: يَسـَٔلُهُ مَن فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ كُلَّ يَومٍ هُوَ فى شَأنٍ
55.transliteration: Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin
55.translation: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn)
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: يٰمَعشَرَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنسِ إِنِ استَطَعتُم أَن تَنفُذوا مِن أَقطارِ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ فَانفُذوا لا تَنفُذونَ إِلّا بِسُلطٰنٍ
55.transliteration: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin
55.translation: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: يُرسَلُ عَلَيكُما شُواظٌ مِن نارٍ وَنُحاسٌ فَلا تَنتَصِرانِ
55.transliteration: Yursalu AAalaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani
55.translation: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: فَإِذَا انشَقَّتِ السَّماءُ فَكانَت وَردَةً كَالدِّهانِ
55.transliteration: Faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani
55.translation: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: فَيَومَئِذٍ لا يُسـَٔلُ عَن ذَنبِهِ إِنسٌ وَلا جانٌّ
55.transliteration: Fayawmaithin la yusalu AAan thanbihi insun wala jannun
55.translation: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: يُعرَفُ المُجرِمونَ بِسيمٰهُم فَيُؤخَذُ بِالنَّوٰصى وَالأَقدامِ
55.transliteration: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami
55.translation: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: هٰذِهِ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا المُجرِمونَ
55.transliteration: Hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona
55.translation: This is hell which the guilty deny
They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Of spreading branches
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Wherein are two fountains flowing
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: مُتَّكِـٔينَ عَلىٰ فُرُشٍ بَطائِنُها مِن إِستَبرَقٍ وَجَنَى الجَنَّتَينِ دانٍ
55.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin
55.translation: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: فيهِنَّ قٰصِرٰتُ الطَّرفِ لَم يَطمِثهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبلَهُم وَلا جانٌّ
55.transliteration: Feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
55.translation: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
(In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
And beside them are two other gardens
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Dark green with foliage
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Wherein are two abundant springs
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny
Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: لَم يَطمِثهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبلَهُم وَلا جانٌّ
55.transliteration: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun
55.translation: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: مُتَّكِـٔينَ عَلىٰ رَفرَفٍ خُضرٍ وَعَبقَرِىٍّ حِسانٍ
55.transliteration: Muttakieena AAala rafrafin khudrin waAAabqariyyin hisanin
55.translation: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets
Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55.arabic: تَبٰرَكَ اسمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى الجَلٰلِ وَالإِكرامِ
55.transliteration: Tabaraka ismu rabbika thee aljalali waalikrami
55.translation: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious

56.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذا وَقَعَتِ الواقِعَةُ
56.translation: When the event befalleth
There is no denying that it will befall
Abasing (some), exalting (others)
When the earth is shaken with a shock
And the hills are ground to powder
So that they become a scattered dust
And ye will be three kinds
(First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand
And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand
And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race
Those are they who will be brought nigh
In gardens of delight
A multitude of those of old
And a few of those of later time
On lined couches
Reclining therein face to face
There wait on them immortal youths
With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness
And fruit that they prefer
And flesh of fowls that they desire
And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes
Like unto hidden pearls
Reward for what they used to do

56.arabic: لا يَسمَعونَ فيها لَغوًا وَلا تَأثيمًا
56.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala tatheeman
56.translation: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
(Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace
And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand
Among thornless lote-trees
And clustered plantains
And spreading shade
And water gushing
And fruit in plenty
Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden
And raised couches
Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
And made them virgins
Lovers, friends
For those on the right hand
A multitude of those of old
And a multitude of those of later time
And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand
In scorching wind and scalding water
And shadow of black smoke
Neither cool nor refreshing
Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
And used to persist in the awful sin

56.arabic: وَكانوا يَقولونَ أَئِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَءِنّا لَمَبعوثونَ
56.transliteration: Wakanoo yaqooloona aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
56.translation: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again
And also our forefathers
Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day
Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers
Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
And will fill your bellies therewith
And thereon ye will drink of boiling water
Drinking even as the camel drinketh
This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment
We created you. Will ye then admit the truth
Have ye seen that which ye emit
Do ye create it or are We the Creator

56.arabic: نَحنُ قَدَّرنا بَينَكُمُ المَوتَ وَما نَحنُ بِمَسبوقينَ
56.transliteration: Nahnu qaddarna baynakumu almawta wama nahnu bimasbooqeena
56.translation: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun

56.arabic: عَلىٰ أَن نُبَدِّلَ أَمثٰلَكُم وَنُنشِئَكُم فى ما لا تَعلَمونَ
56.transliteration: AAala an nubaddila amthalakum wanunshiakum fee ma la taAAlamoona
56.translation: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not

56.arabic: وَلَقَد عَلِمتُمُ النَّشأَةَ الأولىٰ فَلَولا تَذَكَّرونَ
56.transliteration: Walaqad AAalimtumu alnnashata aloola falawla tathakkaroona
56.translation: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect
Have ye seen that which ye cultivate
Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer

56.arabic: لَو نَشاءُ لَجَعَلنٰهُ حُطٰمًا فَظَلتُم تَفَكَّهونَ
56.transliteration: Law nashao lajaAAalnahu hutaman fathaltum tafakkahoona
56.translation: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim
Lo! we are laden with debt
Nay, but we are deprived
Have ye observed the water which ye drink

56.arabic: ءَأَنتُم أَنزَلتُموهُ مِنَ المُزنِ أَم نَحنُ المُنزِلونَ
56.transliteration: Aantum anzaltumoohu mina almuzni am nahnu almunziloona
56.translation: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder

56.arabic: لَو نَشاءُ جَعَلنٰهُ أُجاجًا فَلَولا تَشكُرونَ
56.transliteration: Law nashao jaAAalnahu ojajan falawla tashkuroona
56.translation: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks
Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out

56.arabic: ءَأَنتُم أَنشَأتُم شَجَرَتَها أَم نَحنُ المُنشِـٔونَ
56.transliteration: Aantum anshatum shajarataha am nahnu almunshioona
56.translation: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower
We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness
Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous
Nay, I swear by the places of the stars
And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew
That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
In a Book kept hidden
Which none toucheth save the purified
A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds
Is it this Statement that ye scorn
And make denial thereof your livelihood
Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
And ye are at that moment looking

56.arabic: وَنَحنُ أَقرَبُ إِلَيهِ مِنكُم وَلٰكِن لا تُبصِرونَ
56.transliteration: Wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walakin la tubsiroona
56.translation: And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not
Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us)
Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful
Thus if he is of those brought nigh
Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight

56.arabic: وَأَمّا إِن كانَ مِن أَصحٰبِ اليَمينِ
56.transliteration: Waamma in kana min ashabi alyameeni
56.translation: And if he is of those on the right hand
Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand

56.arabic: وَأَمّا إِن كانَ مِنَ المُكَذِّبينَ الضّالّينَ
56.transliteration: Waamma in kana mina almukaththibeena alddalleena
56.translation: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring
Then the welcome will be boiling water
And roasting at hell-fire
Lo! this is certain truth
Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous

57.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
57.transliteration: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
57.translation: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise

57.arabic: لَهُ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ يُحيۦ وَيُميتُ وَهُوَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
57.transliteration: Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
57.translation: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things

57.arabic: هُوَ الأَوَّلُ وَالءاخِرُ وَالظّٰهِرُ وَالباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمٌ
57.transliteration: Huwa alawwalu waalakhiru waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun
57.translation: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things

57.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ فى سِتَّةِ أَيّامٍ ثُمَّ استَوىٰ عَلَى العَرشِ يَعلَمُ ما يَلِجُ فِى الأَرضِ وَما يَخرُجُ مِنها وَما يَنزِلُ مِنَ السَّماءِ وَما يَعرُجُ فيها وَهُوَ مَعَكُم أَينَ ما كُنتُم وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ بَصيرٌ
57.transliteration: Huwa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi yaAAlamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina alssamai wama yaAAruju feeha wahuwa maAAakum ayna ma kuntum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun
57.translation: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do

57.arabic: لَهُ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَإِلَى اللَّهِ تُرجَعُ الأُمورُ
57.transliteration: Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru
57.translation: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back

57.arabic: يولِجُ الَّيلَ فِى النَّهارِ وَيولِجُ النَّهارَ فِى الَّيلِ وَهُوَ عَليمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدورِ
57.transliteration: Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayi wahuwa AAaleemun bithati alssudoori
57.translation: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts

57.arabic: ءامِنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَأَنفِقوا مِمّا جَعَلَكُم مُستَخلَفينَ فيهِ فَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا مِنكُم وَأَنفَقوا لَهُم أَجرٌ كَبيرٌ
57.transliteration: Aminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waanfiqoo mimma jaAAalakum mustakhlafeena feehi faallatheena amanoo minkum waanfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeerun
57.translation: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward

57.arabic: وَما لَكُم لا تُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّسولُ يَدعوكُم لِتُؤمِنوا بِرَبِّكُم وَقَد أَخَذَ ميثٰقَكُم إِن كُنتُم مُؤمِنينَ
57.transliteration: Wama lakum la tuminoona biAllahi waalrrasoolu yadAAookum lituminoo birabbikum waqad akhatha meethaqakum in kuntum mumineena
57.translation: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers

57.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى يُنَزِّلُ عَلىٰ عَبدِهِ ءايٰتٍ بَيِّنٰتٍ لِيُخرِجَكُم مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ إِلَى النّورِ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُم لَرَءوفٌ رَحيمٌ
57.transliteration: Huwa allathee yunazzilu AAala AAabdihi ayatin bayyinatin liyukhrijakum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wainna Allaha bikum laraoofun raheemun
57.translation: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful

57.arabic: وَما لَكُم أَلّا تُنفِقوا فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ ميرٰثُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ لا يَستَوى مِنكُم مَن أَنفَقَ مِن قَبلِ الفَتحِ وَقٰتَلَ أُولٰئِكَ أَعظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِنَ الَّذينَ أَنفَقوا مِن بَعدُ وَقٰتَلوا وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ الحُسنىٰ وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ خَبيرٌ
57.transliteration: Wama lakum alla tunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi walillahi meerathu alssamawati waalardi la yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qabli alfathi waqatala olaika aAAthamu darajatan mina allatheena anfaqoo min baAAdu waqataloo wakullan waAAada Allahu alhusna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun
57.translation: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do

57.arabic: مَن ذَا الَّذى يُقرِضُ اللَّهَ قَرضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضٰعِفَهُ لَهُ وَلَهُ أَجرٌ كَريمٌ
57.transliteration: Man tha allathee yuqridu Allaha qardan hasanan fayudaAAifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareemun
57.translation: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward

57.arabic: يَومَ تَرَى المُؤمِنينَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتِ يَسعىٰ نورُهُم بَينَ أَيديهِم وَبِأَيمٰنِهِم بُشرىٰكُمُ اليَومَ جَنّٰتٌ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الفَوزُ العَظيمُ
57.transliteration: Yawma tara almumineena waalmuminati yasAAa nooruhum bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim bushrakumu alyawma jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu
57.translation: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph

57.arabic: يَومَ يَقولُ المُنٰفِقونَ وَالمُنٰفِقٰتُ لِلَّذينَ ءامَنُوا انظُرونا نَقتَبِس مِن نورِكُم قيلَ ارجِعوا وَراءَكُم فَالتَمِسوا نورًا فَضُرِبَ بَينَهُم بِسورٍ لَهُ بابٌ باطِنُهُ فيهِ الرَّحمَةُ وَظٰهِرُهُ مِن قِبَلِهِ العَذابُ
57.transliteration: Yawma yaqoolu almunafiqoona waalmunafiqatu lillatheena amanoo onthuroona naqtabis min noorikum qeela irjiAAoo waraakum failtamisoo nooran faduriba baynahum bisoorin lahu babun batinuhu feehi alrrahmatu wathahiruhu min qibalihi alAAathabu
57.translation: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom

57.arabic: يُنادونَهُم أَلَم نَكُن مَعَكُم قالوا بَلىٰ وَلٰكِنَّكُم فَتَنتُم أَنفُسَكُم وَتَرَبَّصتُم وَارتَبتُم وَغَرَّتكُمُ الأَمانِىُّ حَتّىٰ جاءَ أَمرُ اللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِاللَّهِ الغَرورُ
57.transliteration: Yunadoonahum alam nakun maAAakum qaloo bala walakinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbastum wairtabtum wagharratkumu alamaniyyu hatta jaa amru Allahi wagharrakum biAllahi algharooru
57.translation: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah

57.arabic: فَاليَومَ لا يُؤخَذُ مِنكُم فِديَةٌ وَلا مِنَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مَأوىٰكُمُ النّارُ هِىَ مَولىٰكُم وَبِئسَ المَصيرُ
57.transliteration: Faalyawma la yukhathu minkum fidyatun wala mina allatheena kafaroo mawakumu alnnaru hiya mawlakum wabisa almaseeru
57.translation: So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end

57.arabic: أَلَم يَأنِ لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا أَن تَخشَعَ قُلوبُهُم لِذِكرِ اللَّهِ وَما نَزَلَ مِنَ الحَقِّ وَلا يَكونوا كَالَّذينَ أوتُوا الكِتٰبَ مِن قَبلُ فَطالَ عَلَيهِمُ الأَمَدُ فَقَسَت قُلوبُهُم وَكَثيرٌ مِنهُم فٰسِقونَ
57.transliteration: Alam yani lillatheena amanoo an takhshaAAa quloobuhum lithikri Allahi wama nazala mina alhaqqi wala yakoonoo kaallatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablu fatala AAalayhimu alamadu faqasat quloobuhum wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona
57.translation: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers

57.arabic: اعلَموا أَنَّ اللَّهَ يُحىِ الأَرضَ بَعدَ مَوتِها قَد بَيَّنّا لَكُمُ الءايٰتِ لَعَلَّكُم تَعقِلونَ
57.transliteration: IAAlamoo anna Allaha yuhyee alarda baAAda mawtiha qad bayyanna lakumu alayati laAAallakum taAAqiloona
57.translation: Know that Allah quickeneth the earth after its death. We have made clear Our revelations for you, that haply ye may understand

57.arabic: إِنَّ المُصَّدِّقينَ وَالمُصَّدِّقٰتِ وَأَقرَضُوا اللَّهَ قَرضًا حَسَنًا يُضٰعَفُ لَهُم وَلَهُم أَجرٌ كَريمٌ
57.transliteration: Inna almussaddiqeena waalmussaddiqati waaqradoo Allaha qardan hasanan yudaAAafu lahum walahum ajrun kareemun
57.translation: Lo! those who give alms, both men and women, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan, it will be doubled for them, and theirs will be a rich reward

57.arabic: وَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الصِّدّيقونَ وَالشُّهَداءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِم لَهُم أَجرُهُم وَنورُهُم وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا وَكَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِنا أُولٰئِكَ أَصحٰبُ الجَحيمِ
57.transliteration: Waallatheena amanoo biAllahi warusulihi olaika humu alssiddeeqoona waalshshuhadao AAinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanooruhum waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu aljaheemi
57.translation: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire

57.arabic: اعلَموا أَنَّمَا الحَيوٰةُ الدُّنيا لَعِبٌ وَلَهوٌ وَزينَةٌ وَتَفاخُرٌ بَينَكُم وَتَكاثُرٌ فِى الأَموٰلِ وَالأَولٰدِ كَمَثَلِ غَيثٍ أَعجَبَ الكُفّارَ نَباتُهُ ثُمَّ يَهيجُ فَتَرىٰهُ مُصفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكونُ حُطٰمًا وَفِى الءاخِرَةِ عَذابٌ شَديدٌ وَمَغفِرَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضوٰنٌ وَمَا الحَيوٰةُ الدُّنيا إِلّا مَتٰعُ الغُرورِ
57.transliteration: IAAlamoo annama alhayatu alddunya laAAibun walahwun wazeenatun watafakhurun baynakum watakathurun fee alamwali waalawladi kamathali ghaythin aAAjaba alkuffara nabatuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yakoonu hutaman wafee alakhirati AAathabun shadeedun wamaghfiratun mina Allahi waridwanun wama alhayatu alddunya illa mataAAu alghuroori
57.translation: Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion

57.arabic: سابِقوا إِلىٰ مَغفِرَةٍ مِن رَبِّكُم وَجَنَّةٍ عَرضُها كَعَرضِ السَّماءِ وَالأَرضِ أُعِدَّت لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ ذٰلِكَ فَضلُ اللَّهِ يُؤتيهِ مَن يَشاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الفَضلِ العَظيمِ
57.transliteration: Sabiqoo ila maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin AAarduha kaAAardi alssamai waalardi oAAiddat lillatheena amanoo biAllahi warusulihi thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi
57.translation: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty

57.arabic: ما أَصابَ مِن مُصيبَةٍ فِى الأَرضِ وَلا فى أَنفُسِكُم إِلّا فى كِتٰبٍ مِن قَبلِ أَن نَبرَأَها إِنَّ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسيرٌ
57.transliteration: Ma asaba min museebatin fee alardi wala fee anfusikum illa fee kitabin min qabli an nabraaha inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun
57.translation: Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah

57.arabic: لِكَيلا تَأسَوا عَلىٰ ما فاتَكُم وَلا تَفرَحوا بِما ءاتىٰكُم وَاللَّهُ لا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُختالٍ فَخورٍ
57.transliteration: Likayla tasaw AAala ma fatakum wala tafrahoo bima atakum waAllahu la yuhibbu kulla mukhtalin fakhoorin
57.translation: That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters

57.arabic: الَّذينَ يَبخَلونَ وَيَأمُرونَ النّاسَ بِالبُخلِ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الغَنِىُّ الحَميدُ
57.transliteration: Allatheena yabkhaloona wayamuroona alnnasa bialbukhli waman yatawalla fainna Allaha huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu
57.translation: Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice. And whosoever turneth away, still Allah is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise

57.arabic: لَقَد أَرسَلنا رُسُلَنا بِالبَيِّنٰتِ وَأَنزَلنا مَعَهُمُ الكِتٰبَ وَالميزانَ لِيَقومَ النّاسُ بِالقِسطِ وَأَنزَلنَا الحَديدَ فيهِ بَأسٌ شَديدٌ وَمَنٰفِعُ لِلنّاسِ وَلِيَعلَمَ اللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُ وَرُسُلَهُ بِالغَيبِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزيزٌ
57.transliteration: Laqad arsalna rusulana bialbayyinati waanzalna maAAahumu alkitaba waalmeezana liyaqooma alnnasu bialqisti waanzalna alhadeeda feehi basun shadeedun wamanafiAAu lilnnasi waliyaAAlama Allahu man yansuruhu warusulahu bialghaybi inna Allaha qawiyyun AAazeezun
57.translation: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty

57.arabic: وَلَقَد أَرسَلنا نوحًا وَإِبرٰهيمَ وَجَعَلنا فى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا النُّبُوَّةَ وَالكِتٰبَ فَمِنهُم مُهتَدٍ وَكَثيرٌ مِنهُم فٰسِقونَ
57.transliteration: Walaqad arsalna noohan waibraheema wajaAAalna fee thurriyyatihima alnnubuwwata waalkitaba faminhum muhtadin wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona
57.translation: And We verily sent Noah and Abraham and placed the prophethood and the scripture among their seed, and among them there is he who goeth right, but many of them are evil-livers

57.arabic: ثُمَّ قَفَّينا عَلىٰ ءاثٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنا وَقَفَّينا بِعيسَى ابنِ مَريَمَ وَءاتَينٰهُ الإِنجيلَ وَجَعَلنا فى قُلوبِ الَّذينَ اتَّبَعوهُ رَأفَةً وَرَحمَةً وَرَهبانِيَّةً ابتَدَعوها ما كَتَبنٰها عَلَيهِم إِلَّا ابتِغاءَ رِضوٰنِ اللَّهِ فَما رَعَوها حَقَّ رِعايَتِها فَـٔاتَينَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا مِنهُم أَجرَهُم وَكَثيرٌ مِنهُم فٰسِقونَ
57.transliteration: Thumma qaffayna AAala atharihim birusulina waqaffayna biAAeesa ibni maryama waataynahu alinjeela wajaAAalna fee quloobi allatheena ittabaAAoohu rafatan warahmatan warahbaniyyatan ibtadaAAooha ma katabnaha AAalayhim illa ibtighaa ridwani Allahi fama raAAawha haqqa riAAayatiha faatayna allatheena amanoo minhum ajrahum wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona
57.translation: Then We caused Our messengers to follow in their footsteps; and We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow, and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. But monasticism they invented - We ordained it not for them - only seeking Allah's pleasure, and they observed it not with right observance. So We give those of them who believe their reward, but many of them are evil-livers

57.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَءامِنوا بِرَسولِهِ يُؤتِكُم كِفلَينِ مِن رَحمَتِهِ وَيَجعَل لَكُم نورًا تَمشونَ بِهِ وَيَغفِر لَكُم وَاللَّهُ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
57.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waaminoo birasoolihi yutikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wayajAAal lakum nooran tamshoona bihi wayaghfir lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun
57.translation: O ye who believe! Be mindful of your duty to Allah and put faith in His messenger. He will give you twofold of His mercy and will appoint for you a light wherein ye shall walk, and will forgive you. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

57.arabic: لِئَلّا يَعلَمَ أَهلُ الكِتٰبِ أَلّا يَقدِرونَ عَلىٰ شَيءٍ مِن فَضلِ اللَّهِ وَأَنَّ الفَضلَ بِيَدِ اللَّهِ يُؤتيهِ مَن يَشاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الفَضلِ العَظيمِ
57.transliteration: Lialla yaAAlama ahlu alkitabi alla yaqdiroona AAala shayin min fadli Allahi waanna alfadla biyadi Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi
57.translation: That the People of the Scripture may know that they control naught of the bounty of Allah, but that the bounty is in Allah's hand to give to whom He will. And Allah is of Infinite Bounty

58.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قَد سَمِعَ اللَّهُ قَولَ الَّتى تُجٰدِلُكَ فى زَوجِها وَتَشتَكى إِلَى اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسمَعُ تَحاوُرَكُما إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَميعٌ بَصيرٌ
58.transliteration: Qad samiAAa Allahu qawla allatee tujadiluka fee zawjiha watashtakee ila Allahi waAllahu yasmaAAu tahawurakuma inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun
58.translation: Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad) concerning her husband, and complaineth unto Allah. And Allah heareth your colloquy. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower

58.arabic: الَّذينَ يُظٰهِرونَ مِنكُم مِن نِسائِهِم ما هُنَّ أُمَّهٰتِهِم إِن أُمَّهٰتُهُم إِلَّا الّٰـٔى وَلَدنَهُم وَإِنَّهُم لَيَقولونَ مُنكَرًا مِنَ القَولِ وَزورًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفورٌ
58.transliteration: Allatheena yuthahiroona minkum min nisaihim ma hunna ommahatihim in ommahatuhum illa allaee waladnahum wainnahum layaqooloona munkaran mina alqawli wazooran wainna Allaha laAAafuwwun ghafoorun
58.translation: Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) - They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth - they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

58.arabic: وَالَّذينَ يُظٰهِرونَ مِن نِسائِهِم ثُمَّ يَعودونَ لِما قالوا فَتَحريرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِن قَبلِ أَن يَتَماسّا ذٰلِكُم توعَظونَ بِهِ وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ خَبيرٌ
58.transliteration: Waallatheena yuthahiroona min nisaihim thumma yaAAoodoona lima qaloo fatahreeru raqabatin min qabli an yatamassa thalikum tooAAathoona bihi waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun
58.translation: Those who put away their wives (by saying they are as their mothers) and afterward would go back on that which they have said, (the penalty) in that case (is) the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. Unto this ye are exhorted; and Allah is Informed of what ye do

58.arabic: فَمَن لَم يَجِد فَصِيامُ شَهرَينِ مُتَتابِعَينِ مِن قَبلِ أَن يَتَماسّا فَمَن لَم يَستَطِع فَإِطعامُ سِتّينَ مِسكينًا ذٰلِكَ لِتُؤمِنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَتِلكَ حُدودُ اللَّهِ وَلِلكٰفِرينَ عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
58.transliteration: Faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabiAAayni min qabli an yatamassa faman lam yastatiAA faitAAamu sitteena miskeenan thalika lituminoo biAllahi warasoolihi watilka hudoodu Allahi walilkafireena AAathabun aleemun
58.translation: And he who findeth not (the wherewithal), let him fast for two successive months before they touch one another; and for him who is unable to do so (the penance is) the feeding of sixty needy ones. This, that ye may put trust in Allah and His messenger. Such are the limits (imposed by Allah); and for disbelievers is a painful doom

58.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يُحادّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ كُبِتوا كَما كُبِتَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم وَقَد أَنزَلنا ءايٰتٍ بَيِّنٰتٍ وَلِلكٰفِرينَ عَذابٌ مُهينٌ
58.transliteration: Inna allatheena yuhaddoona Allaha warasoolahu kubitoo kama kubita allatheena min qablihim waqad anzalna ayatin bayyinatin walilkafireena AAathabun muheenun
58.translation: Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger will be abased even as those before them were abased; and We have sent down clear tokens, and for disbelievers is a shameful doom

58.arabic: يَومَ يَبعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَميعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِما عَمِلوا أَحصىٰهُ اللَّهُ وَنَسوهُ وَاللَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ شَهيدٌ
58.transliteration: Yawma yabAAathuhumu Allahu jameeAAan fayunabbiohum bima AAamiloo ahsahu Allahu wanasoohu waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun
58.translation: On the day when Allah will raise them all together and inform them of what they did. Allah hath kept account of it while they forgot it. And Allah is Witness over all things

58.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ أَنَّ اللَّهَ يَعلَمُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ ما يَكونُ مِن نَجوىٰ ثَلٰثَةٍ إِلّا هُوَ رابِعُهُم وَلا خَمسَةٍ إِلّا هُوَ سادِسُهُم وَلا أَدنىٰ مِن ذٰلِكَ وَلا أَكثَرَ إِلّا هُوَ مَعَهُم أَينَ ما كانوا ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِما عَمِلوا يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمٌ
58.transliteration: Alam tara anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi ma yakoonu min najwa thalathatin illa huwa rabiAAuhum wala khamsatin illa huwa sadisuhum wala adna min thalika wala akthara illa huwa maAAahum ayna ma kanoo thumma yunabbiohum bima AAamiloo yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun
58.translation: Hast thou not seen that Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth? There is no secret conference of three but He is their fourth, nor of five but He is their sixth, nor of less than that or more but He is with them wheresoever they may be; and afterward, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things

58.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ إِلَى الَّذينَ نُهوا عَنِ النَّجوىٰ ثُمَّ يَعودونَ لِما نُهوا عَنهُ وَيَتَنٰجَونَ بِالإِثمِ وَالعُدوٰنِ وَمَعصِيَتِ الرَّسولِ وَإِذا جاءوكَ حَيَّوكَ بِما لَم يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اللَّهُ وَيَقولونَ فى أَنفُسِهِم لَولا يُعَذِّبُنَا اللَّهُ بِما نَقولُ حَسبُهُم جَهَنَّمُ يَصلَونَها فَبِئسَ المَصيرُ
58.transliteration: Alam tara ila allatheena nuhoo AAani alnnajwa thumma yaAAoodoona lima nuhoo AAanhu wayatanajawna bialithmi waalAAudwani wamaAAsiyati alrrasooli waitha jaooka hayyawka bima lam yuhayyika bihi Allahu wayaqooloona fee anfusihim lawla yuAAaththibuna Allahu bima naqoolu hasbuhum jahannamu yaslawnaha fabisa almaseeru
58.translation: Hast thou not observed those who were forbidden conspiracy and afterward returned to that which they had been forbidden, and (now) conspire together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger? And when they come unto thee they greet thee with a greeting wherewith Allah greeteth thee not, and say within themselves: Why should Allah punish us for what we say? Hell will suffice them; they will feel the heat thereof - a hapless journey's end

58.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِذا تَنٰجَيتُم فَلا تَتَنٰجَوا بِالإِثمِ وَالعُدوٰنِ وَمَعصِيَتِ الرَّسولِ وَتَنٰجَوا بِالبِرِّ وَالتَّقوىٰ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذى إِلَيهِ تُحشَرونَ
58.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha tanajaytum fala tatanajaw bialithmi waalAAudwani wamaAAsiyati alrrasooli watanajaw bialbirri waalttaqwa waittaqoo Allaha allathee ilayhi tuhsharoona
58.translation: O ye who believe! When ye conspire together, conspire not together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger, but conspire together for righteousness and piety, and keep your duty toward Allah, unto whom ye will be gathered

58.arabic: إِنَّمَا النَّجوىٰ مِنَ الشَّيطٰنِ لِيَحزُنَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَلَيسَ بِضارِّهِم شَيـًٔا إِلّا بِإِذنِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَليَتَوَكَّلِ المُؤمِنونَ
58.transliteration: Innama alnnajwa mina alshshaytani liyahzuna allatheena amanoo walaysa bidarrihim shayan illa biithni Allahi waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona
58.translation: Lo! Conspiracy is only of the devil, that he may vex those who believe; but he can harm them not at all unless by Allah's leave. In Allah let believers put their trust

58.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِذا قيلَ لَكُم تَفَسَّحوا فِى المَجٰلِسِ فَافسَحوا يَفسَحِ اللَّهُ لَكُم وَإِذا قيلَ انشُزوا فَانشُزوا يَرفَعِ اللَّهُ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا مِنكُم وَالَّذينَ أوتُوا العِلمَ دَرَجٰتٍ وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ خَبيرٌ
58.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha qeela lakum tafassahoo fee almajalisi faifsahoo yafsahi Allahu lakum waitha qeela onshuzoo faonshuzoo yarfaAAi Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum waallatheena ootoo alAAilma darajatin waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun
58.translation: O ye who believe! when it is said unto you, Make room! in assemblies, then make room; Allah will make way for you (hereafter). And when it is said, Come up higher! go up higher; Allah will exalt those who believe among you, and those who have knowledge, to high ranks. Allah is Informed of what ye do

58.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِذا نٰجَيتُمُ الرَّسولَ فَقَدِّموا بَينَ يَدَى نَجوىٰكُم صَدَقَةً ذٰلِكَ خَيرٌ لَكُم وَأَطهَرُ فَإِن لَم تَجِدوا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
58.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha najaytumu alrrasoola faqaddimoo bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatan thalika khayrun lakum waatharu fain lam tajidoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
58.translation: O ye who believe! When ye hold conference with the messenger, offer an alms before your conference. That is better and purer for you. But if ye cannot find (the wherewithal) then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

58.arabic: ءَأَشفَقتُم أَن تُقَدِّموا بَينَ يَدَى نَجوىٰكُم صَدَقٰتٍ فَإِذ لَم تَفعَلوا وَتابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيكُم فَأَقيمُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَءاتُوا الزَّكوٰةَ وَأَطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ وَاللَّهُ خَبيرٌ بِما تَعمَلونَ
58.transliteration: Aashfaqtum an tuqaddimoo bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatin faith lam tafAAaloo wataba Allahu AAalaykum faaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waateeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu waAllahu khabeerun bima taAAmaloona
58.translation: Fear ye to offer alms before your conference? Then, when ye do it not and Allah hath forgiven you, establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey Allah and His messenger. And Allah is Aware of what ye do

58.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ إِلَى الَّذينَ تَوَلَّوا قَومًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم ما هُم مِنكُم وَلا مِنهُم وَيَحلِفونَ عَلَى الكَذِبِ وَهُم يَعلَمونَ
58.transliteration: Alam tara ila allatheena tawallaw qawman ghadiba Allahu AAalayhim ma hum minkum wala minhum wayahlifoona AAala alkathibi wahum yaAAlamoona
58.translation: Hast thou not seen those who take for friends a folk with whom Allah is wroth? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear a false oath knowingly

58.arabic: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُم عَذابًا شَديدًا إِنَّهُم ساءَ ما كانوا يَعمَلونَ
58.transliteration: aAAadda Allahu lahum AAathaban shadeedan innahum saa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona
58.translation: Allah hath prepared for them a dreadful doom. Evil indeed is that which they are wont to do

58.arabic: اتَّخَذوا أَيمٰنَهُم جُنَّةً فَصَدّوا عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَلَهُم عَذابٌ مُهينٌ
58.transliteration: Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi falahum AAathabun muheenun
58.translation: They make a shelter of their oaths and turn (men) from the way of Allah; so theirs will be a shameful doom

58.arabic: لَن تُغنِىَ عَنهُم أَموٰلُهُم وَلا أَولٰدُهُم مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيـًٔا أُولٰئِكَ أَصحٰبُ النّارِ هُم فيها خٰلِدونَ
58.transliteration: Lan tughniya AAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona
58.translation: Their wealth and their children will avail them naught against Allah. Such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein

58.arabic: يَومَ يَبعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ جَميعًا فَيَحلِفونَ لَهُ كَما يَحلِفونَ لَكُم وَيَحسَبونَ أَنَّهُم عَلىٰ شَيءٍ أَلا إِنَّهُم هُمُ الكٰذِبونَ
58.transliteration: Yawma yabAAathuhumu Allahu jameeAAan fayahlifoona lahu kama yahlifoona lakum wayahsaboona annahum AAala shayin ala innahum humu alkathiboona
58.translation: On the day when Allah will raise them all together, then will they swear unto Him as they (now) swear unto you, and they will fancy that they have some standing. Lo! is it not they who are the liars

58.arabic: استَحوَذَ عَلَيهِمُ الشَّيطٰنُ فَأَنسىٰهُم ذِكرَ اللَّهِ أُولٰئِكَ حِزبُ الشَّيطٰنِ أَلا إِنَّ حِزبَ الشَّيطٰنِ هُمُ الخٰسِرونَ
58.transliteration: Istahwatha AAalayhimu alshshaytanu faansahum thikra Allahi olaika hizbu alshshaytani ala inna hizba alshshaytani humu alkhasiroona
58.translation: The devil hath engrossed them and so hath caused them to forget remembrance of Allah. They are the devil's party. Lo! is it not the devil's party who will be the losers

58.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يُحادّونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ أُولٰئِكَ فِى الأَذَلّينَ
58.transliteration: Inna allatheena yuhaddoona Allaha warasoolahu olaika fee alathalleena
58.translation: Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger, they will be among the lowest

58.arabic: كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَأَغلِبَنَّ أَنا۠ وَرُسُلى إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزيزٌ
58.transliteration: Kataba Allahu laaghlibanna ana warusulee inna Allaha qawiyyun AAazeezun
58.translation: Allah hath decreed: Lo! I verily shall conquer, I and My messengers. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty

58.arabic: لا تَجِدُ قَومًا يُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَاليَومِ الءاخِرِ يُوادّونَ مَن حادَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ وَلَو كانوا ءاباءَهُم أَو أَبناءَهُم أَو إِخوٰنَهُم أَو عَشيرَتَهُم أُولٰئِكَ كَتَبَ فى قُلوبِهِمُ الإيمٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِروحٍ مِنهُ وَيُدخِلُهُم جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها رَضِىَ اللَّهُ عَنهُم وَرَضوا عَنهُ أُولٰئِكَ حِزبُ اللَّهِ أَلا إِنَّ حِزبَ اللَّهِ هُمُ المُفلِحونَ
58.transliteration: La tajidu qawman yuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri yuwaddoona man hadda Allaha warasoolahu walaw kanoo abaahum aw abnaahum aw ikhwanahum aw AAasheeratahum olaika kataba fee quloobihimu aleemana waayyadahum biroohin minhu wayudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu olaika hizbu Allahi ala inna hizba Allahi humu almuflihoona
58.translation: Thou wilt not find folk who believe in Allah and the Last Day loving those who oppose Allah and His messenger, even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brethren or their clan. As for such, He hath written faith upon their hearts and hath strengthened them with a Spirit from Him, and He will bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. They are Allah's party. Lo! is it not Allah's party who are the successful

59.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
59.transliteration: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
59.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise

59.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى أَخرَجَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن أَهلِ الكِتٰبِ مِن دِيٰرِهِم لِأَوَّلِ الحَشرِ ما ظَنَنتُم أَن يَخرُجوا وَظَنّوا أَنَّهُم مانِعَتُهُم حُصونُهُم مِنَ اللَّهِ فَأَتىٰهُمُ اللَّهُ مِن حَيثُ لَم يَحتَسِبوا وَقَذَفَ فى قُلوبِهِمُ الرُّعبَ يُخرِبونَ بُيوتَهُم بِأَيديهِم وَأَيدِى المُؤمِنينَ فَاعتَبِروا يٰأُولِى الأَبصٰرِ
59.transliteration: Huwa allathee akhraja allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi min diyarihim liawwali alhashri ma thanantum an yakhrujoo wathannoo annahum maniAAatuhum husoonuhum mina Allahi faatahumu Allahu min haythu lam yahtasiboo waqathafa fee quloobihimu alrruAAba yukhriboona buyootahum biaydeehim waaydee almumineena faiAAtabiroo ya olee alabsari
59.translation: He it is Who hath caused those of the People of the Scripture who disbelieved to go forth from their homes unto the first exile. Ye deemed not that they would go forth, while they deemed that their strongholds would protect them from Allah. But Allah reached them from a place whereof they recked not, and cast terror in their hearts so that they ruined their houses with their own hands and the hands of the believers. So learn a lesson, O ye who have eyes

59.arabic: وَلَولا أَن كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِمُ الجَلاءَ لَعَذَّبَهُم فِى الدُّنيا وَلَهُم فِى الءاخِرَةِ عَذابُ النّارِ
59.transliteration: Walawla an kataba Allahu AAalayhimu aljalaa laAAaththabahum fee alddunya walahum fee alakhirati AAathabu alnnari
59.translation: And if Allah had not decreed migration for them, He verily would have punished them in the world, and theirs in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire

59.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُم شاقُّوا اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ وَمَن يُشاقِّ اللَّهَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَديدُ العِقابِ
59.transliteration: Thalika biannahum shaqqoo Allaha warasoolahu waman yushaqqi Allaha fainna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi
59.translation: That is because they were opposed to Allah and His messenger; and whoso is opposed to Allah, (for him) verily Allah is stern in reprisal

59.arabic: ما قَطَعتُم مِن لينَةٍ أَو تَرَكتُموها قائِمَةً عَلىٰ أُصولِها فَبِإِذنِ اللَّهِ وَلِيُخزِىَ الفٰسِقينَ
59.transliteration: Ma qataAAtum min leenatin aw taraktumooha qaimatan AAala osooliha fabiithni Allahi waliyukhziya alfasiqeena
59.translation: Whatsoever palm-trees ye cut down or left standing on their roots, it was by Allah's leave, in order that He might confound the evil-livers

59.arabic: وَما أَفاءَ اللَّهُ عَلىٰ رَسولِهِ مِنهُم فَما أَوجَفتُم عَلَيهِ مِن خَيلٍ وَلا رِكابٍ وَلٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُ عَلىٰ مَن يَشاءُ وَاللَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
59.transliteration: Wama afaa Allahu AAala rasoolihi minhum fama awjaftum AAalayhi min khaylin wala rikabin walakinna Allaha yusallitu rusulahu AAala man yashao waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
59.translation: And that which Allah gave as spoil unto His messenger from them, ye urged not any horse or riding-camel for the sake thereof, but Allah giveth His messenger lordship over whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things

59.arabic: ما أَفاءَ اللَّهُ عَلىٰ رَسولِهِ مِن أَهلِ القُرىٰ فَلِلَّهِ وَلِلرَّسولِ وَلِذِى القُربىٰ وَاليَتٰمىٰ وَالمَسٰكينِ وَابنِ السَّبيلِ كَى لا يَكونَ دولَةً بَينَ الأَغنِياءِ مِنكُم وَما ءاتىٰكُمُ الرَّسولُ فَخُذوهُ وَما نَهىٰكُم عَنهُ فَانتَهوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ شَديدُ العِقابِ
59.transliteration: Ma afaa Allahu AAala rasoolihi min ahli alqura falillahi walilrrasooli walithee alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeeni waibni alssabeeli kay la yakoona doolatan bayna alaghniyai minkum wama atakumu alrrasoolu fakhuthoohu wama nahakum AAanhu faintahoo waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi
59.translation: That which Allah giveth as spoil unto His messenger from the people of the townships, it is for Allah and His messenger and for the near of kin and the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, that it become not a commodity between the rich among you. And whatsoever the messenger giveth you, take it. And whatsoever he forbiddeth, abstain (from it). And keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is stern in reprisal

59.arabic: لِلفُقَراءِ المُهٰجِرينَ الَّذينَ أُخرِجوا مِن دِيٰرِهِم وَأَموٰلِهِم يَبتَغونَ فَضلًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِضوٰنًا وَيَنصُرونَ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الصّٰدِقونَ
59.transliteration: Lilfuqarai almuhajireena allatheena okhrijoo min diyarihim waamwalihim yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan wayansuroona Allaha warasoolahu olaika humu alssadiqoona
59.translation: And (it is) for the poor fugitives who have been driven out from their homes and their belongings, who seek bounty from Allah and help Allah and His messenger. They are the loyal

59.arabic: وَالَّذينَ تَبَوَّءُو الدّارَ وَالإيمٰنَ مِن قَبلِهِم يُحِبّونَ مَن هاجَرَ إِلَيهِم وَلا يَجِدونَ فى صُدورِهِم حاجَةً مِمّا أوتوا وَيُؤثِرونَ عَلىٰ أَنفُسِهِم وَلَو كانَ بِهِم خَصاصَةٌ وَمَن يوقَ شُحَّ نَفسِهِ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ المُفلِحونَ
59.transliteration: Waallatheena tabawwaoo alddara waaleemana min qablihim yuhibboona man hajara ilayhim wala yajidoona fee sudoorihim hajatan mimma ootoo wayuthiroona AAala anfusihim walaw kana bihim khasasatun waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoona
59.translation: Those who entered the city and the faith before them love those who flee unto them for refuge, and find in their breasts no need for that which hath been given them, but prefer (the fugitives) above themselves though poverty become their lot. And whoso is saved from his own avarice - such are they who are successful

59.arabic: وَالَّذينَ جاءو مِن بَعدِهِم يَقولونَ رَبَّنَا اغفِر لَنا وَلِإِخوٰنِنَا الَّذينَ سَبَقونا بِالإيمٰنِ وَلا تَجعَل فى قُلوبِنا غِلًّا لِلَّذينَ ءامَنوا رَبَّنا إِنَّكَ رَءوفٌ رَحيمٌ
59.transliteration: Waallatheena jaoo min baAAdihim yaqooloona rabbana ighfir lana waliikhwanina allatheena sabaqoona bialeemani wala tajAAal fee quloobina ghillan lillatheena amanoo rabbana innaka raoofun raheemun
59.translation: And those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful

59.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ إِلَى الَّذينَ نافَقوا يَقولونَ لِإِخوٰنِهِمُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن أَهلِ الكِتٰبِ لَئِن أُخرِجتُم لَنَخرُجَنَّ مَعَكُم وَلا نُطيعُ فيكُم أَحَدًا أَبَدًا وَإِن قوتِلتُم لَنَنصُرَنَّكُم وَاللَّهُ يَشهَدُ إِنَّهُم لَكٰذِبونَ
59.transliteration: Alam tara ila allatheena nafaqoo yaqooloona liikhwanihimu allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi lain okhrijtum lanakhrujanna maAAakum wala nuteeAAu feekum ahadan abadan wain qootiltum lanansurannakum waAllahu yashhadu innahum lakathiboona
59.translation: Hast thou not observed those who are hypocrites, (how) they tell their brethren who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture: If ye are driven out, we surely will go out with you, and we will never obey anyone against you, and if ye are attacked we verily will help you. And Allah beareth witness that they verily are liars

59.arabic: لَئِن أُخرِجوا لا يَخرُجونَ مَعَهُم وَلَئِن قوتِلوا لا يَنصُرونَهُم وَلَئِن نَصَروهُم لَيُوَلُّنَّ الأَدبٰرَ ثُمَّ لا يُنصَرونَ
59.transliteration: Lain okhrijoo la yakhrujoona maAAahum walain qootiloo la yansuroonahum walain nasaroohum layuwallunna aladbara thumma la yunsaroona
59.translation: (For) indeed if they are driven out they go not out with them, and indeed if they are attacked they help them not, and indeed if they had helped them they would have turned and fled, and then they would not have been victorious

59.arabic: لَأَنتُم أَشَدُّ رَهبَةً فى صُدورِهِم مِنَ اللَّهِ ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُم قَومٌ لا يَفقَهونَ
59.transliteration: Laantum ashaddu rahbatan fee sudoorihim mina Allahi thalika biannahum qawmun la yafqahoona
59.translation: Ye are more awful as a fear in their bosoms than Allah. That is because they are a folk who understand not

59.arabic: لا يُقٰتِلونَكُم جَميعًا إِلّا فى قُرًى مُحَصَّنَةٍ أَو مِن وَراءِ جُدُرٍ بَأسُهُم بَينَهُم شَديدٌ تَحسَبُهُم جَميعًا وَقُلوبُهُم شَتّىٰ ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُم قَومٌ لا يَعقِلونَ
59.transliteration: La yuqatiloonakum jameeAAan illa fee quran muhassanatin aw min warai judurin basuhum baynahum shadeedun tahsabuhum jameeAAan waquloobuhum shatta thalika biannahum qawmun la yaAAqiloona
59.translation: They will not fight against you in a body save in fortified villages or from behind walls. Their adversity among themselves is very great. Ye think of them as a whole whereas their hearts are divers. That is because they are a folk who have no sense

59.arabic: كَمَثَلِ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم قَريبًا ذاقوا وَبالَ أَمرِهِم وَلَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
59.transliteration: Kamathali allatheena min qablihim qareeban thaqoo wabala amrihim walahum AAathabun aleemun
59.translation: On the likeness of those (who suffered) a short time before them, they taste the ill-effects of their own conduct, and theirs is painful punishment

59.arabic: كَمَثَلِ الشَّيطٰنِ إِذ قالَ لِلإِنسٰنِ اكفُر فَلَمّا كَفَرَ قالَ إِنّى بَريءٌ مِنكَ إِنّى أَخافُ اللَّهَ رَبَّ العٰلَمينَ
59.transliteration: Kamathali alshshaytani ith qala lilinsani okfur falamma kafara qala innee bareeon minka innee akhafu Allaha rabba alAAalameena
59.translation: (And the hypocrites are) on the likeness of the devil when he telleth man to disbelieve, then, when he disbelieveth saith: Lo! I am quit of thee. Lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

59.arabic: فَكانَ عٰقِبَتَهُما أَنَّهُما فِى النّارِ خٰلِدَينِ فيها وَذٰلِكَ جَزٰؤُا۟ الظّٰلِمينَ
59.transliteration: Fakana AAaqibatahuma annahuma fee alnnari khalidayni feeha wathalika jazao alththalimeena
59.translation: And the consequence for both will be that they are in the Fire, therein abiding. Such is the reward of evil-doers

59.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ وَلتَنظُر نَفسٌ ما قَدَّمَت لِغَدٍ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَبيرٌ بِما تَعمَلونَ
59.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waltanthur nafsun ma qaddamat lighadin waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha khabeerun bima taAAmaloona
59.translation: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah. And let every soul look to that which it sendeth on before for the morrow. And observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do

59.arabic: وَلا تَكونوا كَالَّذينَ نَسُوا اللَّهَ فَأَنسىٰهُم أَنفُسَهُم أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الفٰسِقونَ
59.transliteration: Wala takoonoo kaallatheena nasoo Allaha faansahum anfusahum olaika humu alfasiqoona
59.translation: And be not ye as those who forgot Allah, therefor He caused them to forget their souls. Such are the evil-doers

59.arabic: لا يَستَوى أَصحٰبُ النّارِ وَأَصحٰبُ الجَنَّةِ أَصحٰبُ الجَنَّةِ هُمُ الفائِزونَ
59.transliteration: La yastawee ashabu alnnari waashabu aljannati ashabu aljannati humu alfaizoona
59.translation: Not equal are the owners of the Fire and the owners of the Garden. The owners of the Garden, they are the victorious

59.arabic: لَو أَنزَلنا هٰذَا القُرءانَ عَلىٰ جَبَلٍ لَرَأَيتَهُ خٰشِعًا مُتَصَدِّعًا مِن خَشيَةِ اللَّهِ وَتِلكَ الأَمثٰلُ نَضرِبُها لِلنّاسِ لَعَلَّهُم يَتَفَكَّرونَ
59.transliteration: Law anzalna hatha alqurana AAala jabalin laraaytahu khashiAAan mutasaddiAAan min khashyati Allahi watilka alamthalu nadribuha lilnnasi laAAallahum yatafakkaroona
59.translation: If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect

59.arabic: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذى لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ عٰلِمُ الغَيبِ وَالشَّهٰدَةِ هُوَ الرَّحمٰنُ الرَّحيمُ
59.transliteration: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati huwa alrrahmanu alrraheemu
59.translation: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible. He is the Beneficent, Merciful

59.arabic: هُوَ اللَّهُ الَّذى لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ المَلِكُ القُدّوسُ السَّلٰمُ المُؤمِنُ المُهَيمِنُ العَزيزُ الجَبّارُ المُتَكَبِّرُ سُبحٰنَ اللَّهِ عَمّا يُشرِكونَ
59.transliteration: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa almaliku alquddoosu alssalamu almuminu almuhayminu alAAazeezu aljabbaru almutakabbiru subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona
59.translation: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

59.arabic: هُوَ اللَّهُ الخٰلِقُ البارِئُ المُصَوِّرُ لَهُ الأَسماءُ الحُسنىٰ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
59.transliteration: Huwa Allahu alkhaliqu albario almusawwiru lahu alasmao alhusna yusabbihu lahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
59.translation: He is Allah, the Creator, the Shaper out of naught, the Fashioner. His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise

60.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تَتَّخِذوا عَدُوّى وَعَدُوَّكُم أَولِياءَ تُلقونَ إِلَيهِم بِالمَوَدَّةِ وَقَد كَفَروا بِما جاءَكُم مِنَ الحَقِّ يُخرِجونَ الرَّسولَ وَإِيّاكُم أَن تُؤمِنوا بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُم إِن كُنتُم خَرَجتُم جِهٰدًا فى سَبيلى وَابتِغاءَ مَرضاتى تُسِرّونَ إِلَيهِم بِالمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنا۠ أَعلَمُ بِما أَخفَيتُم وَما أَعلَنتُم وَمَن يَفعَلهُ مِنكُم فَقَد ضَلَّ سَواءَ السَّبيلِ
60.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo AAaduwwee waAAaduwwakum awliyaa tulqoona ilayhim bialmawaddati waqad kafaroo bima jaakum mina alhaqqi yukhrijoona alrrasoola waiyyakum an tuminoo biAllahi rabbikum in kuntum kharajtum jihadan fee sabeelee waibtighaa mardatee tusirroona ilayhim bialmawaddati waana aAAlamu bima akhfaytum wama aAAlantum waman yafAAalhu minkum faqad dalla sawaa alssabeeli
60.translation: O ye who believe! Choose not My enemy and your enemy for allies. Do ye give them friendship when they disbelieve in that truth which hath come unto you, driving out the messenger and you because ye believe in Allah, your Lord? If ye have come forth to strive in My way and seeking My good pleasure, (show them not friendship). Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of what ye hide and what ye proclaim? And whosoever doeth it among you, he verily hath strayed from the right way

60.arabic: إِن يَثقَفوكُم يَكونوا لَكُم أَعداءً وَيَبسُطوا إِلَيكُم أَيدِيَهُم وَأَلسِنَتَهُم بِالسّوءِ وَوَدّوا لَو تَكفُرونَ
60.transliteration: In yathqafookum yakoonoo lakam aAAdaan wayabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum waalsinatahum bialssooi wawaddoo law takfuroona
60.translation: If they have the upper hand of you, they will be your foes, and will stretch out their hands and their tongues toward you with evil (intent), and they long for you to disbelieve

60.arabic: لَن تَنفَعَكُم أَرحامُكُم وَلا أَولٰدُكُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ يَفصِلُ بَينَكُم وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ بَصيرٌ
60.transliteration: Lan tanfaAAakum arhamukum wala awladukum yawma alqiyamati yafsilu baynakum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun
60.translation: Your ties of kindred and your children will avail you naught upon the Day of Resurrection. He will part you. Allah is Seer of what ye do

60.arabic: قَد كانَت لَكُم أُسوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ فى إِبرٰهيمَ وَالَّذينَ مَعَهُ إِذ قالوا لِقَومِهِم إِنّا بُرَءٰؤُا۟ مِنكُم وَمِمّا تَعبُدونَ مِن دونِ اللَّهِ كَفَرنا بِكُم وَبَدا بَينَنا وَبَينَكُمُ العَدٰوَةُ وَالبَغضاءُ أَبَدًا حَتّىٰ تُؤمِنوا بِاللَّهِ وَحدَهُ إِلّا قَولَ إِبرٰهيمَ لِأَبيهِ لَأَستَغفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَما أَملِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِن شَيءٍ رَبَّنا عَلَيكَ تَوَكَّلنا وَإِلَيكَ أَنَبنا وَإِلَيكَ المَصيرُ
60.transliteration: Qad kanat lakum oswatun hasanatun fee ibraheema waallatheena maAAahu ith qaloo liqawmihim inna buraao minkum wamimma taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi kafarna bikum wabada baynana wabaynakumu alAAadawatu waalbaghdao abadan hatta tuminoo biAllahi wahdahu illa qawla ibraheema liabeehi laastaghfiranna laka wama amliku laka mina Allahi min shayin rabbana AAalayka tawakkalna wailayka anabna wailayka almaseeru
60.translation: There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying

60.arabic: رَبَّنا لا تَجعَلنا فِتنَةً لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا وَاغفِر لَنا رَبَّنا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
60.transliteration: Rabbana la tajAAalna fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo waighfir lana rabbana innaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu
60.translation: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise

60.arabic: لَقَد كانَ لَكُم فيهِم أُسوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِمَن كانَ يَرجُوا اللَّهَ وَاليَومَ الءاخِرَ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الغَنِىُّ الحَميدُ
60.transliteration: Laqad kana lakum feehim oswatun hasanatun liman kana yarjoo Allaha waalyawma alakhira waman yatawalla fainna Allaha huwa alghanniyyu alhameedu
60.translation: Verily ye have in them a goodly pattern for everyone who looketh to Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever may turn away, lo! still Allah, He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise

60.arabic: عَسَى اللَّهُ أَن يَجعَلَ بَينَكُم وَبَينَ الَّذينَ عادَيتُم مِنهُم مَوَدَّةً وَاللَّهُ قَديرٌ وَاللَّهُ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
60.transliteration: AAasa Allahu an yajAAala baynakum wabayna allatheena AAadaytum minhum mawaddatan waAllahu qadeerun waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun
60.translation: It may be that Allah will ordain love between you and those of them with whom ye are at enmity. Allah is Mighty, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

60.arabic: لا يَنهىٰكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذينَ لَم يُقٰتِلوكُم فِى الدّينِ وَلَم يُخرِجوكُم مِن دِيٰرِكُم أَن تَبَرّوهُم وَتُقسِطوا إِلَيهِم إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ المُقسِطينَ
60.transliteration: La yanhakumu Allahu AAani allatheena lam yuqatilookum fee alddeeni walam yukhrijookum min diyarikum an tabarroohum watuqsitoo ilayhim inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena
60.translation: Allah forbiddeth you not those who warred not against you on account of religion and drove you not out from your homes, that ye should show them kindness and deal justly with them. Lo! Allah loveth the just dealers

60.arabic: إِنَّما يَنهىٰكُمُ اللَّهُ عَنِ الَّذينَ قٰتَلوكُم فِى الدّينِ وَأَخرَجوكُم مِن دِيٰرِكُم وَظٰهَروا عَلىٰ إِخراجِكُم أَن تَوَلَّوهُم وَمَن يَتَوَلَّهُم فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمونَ
60.transliteration: Innama yanhakumu Allahu AAani allatheena qatalookum fee alddeeni waakhrajookum min diyarikum wathaharoo AAala ikhrajikum an tawallawhum waman yatawallahum faolaika humu alththalimoona
60.translation: Allah forbiddeth you only those who warred against you on account of religion and have driven you out from your homes and helped to drive you out, that ye make friends of them. Whosoever maketh friends of them - (All) such are wrong-doers
