60.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِذا جاءَكُمُ المُؤمِنٰتُ مُهٰجِرٰتٍ فَامتَحِنوهُنَّ اللَّهُ أَعلَمُ بِإيمٰنِهِنَّ فَإِن عَلِمتُموهُنَّ مُؤمِنٰتٍ فَلا تَرجِعوهُنَّ إِلَى الكُفّارِ لا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَهُم وَلا هُم يَحِلّونَ لَهُنَّ وَءاتوهُم ما أَنفَقوا وَلا جُناحَ عَلَيكُم أَن تَنكِحوهُنَّ إِذا ءاتَيتُموهُنَّ أُجورَهُنَّ وَلا تُمسِكوا بِعِصَمِ الكَوافِرِ وَسـَٔلوا ما أَنفَقتُم وَليَسـَٔلوا ما أَنفَقوا ذٰلِكُم حُكمُ اللَّهِ يَحكُمُ بَينَكُم وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ حَكيمٌ
60.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha jaakumu almuminatu muhajiratin faimtahinoohunna Allahu aAAlamu bieemanihinna fain AAalimtumoohunna muminatin fala tarjiAAoohunna ila alkuffari la hunna hillun lahum wala hum yahilloona lahunna waatoohum ma anfaqoo wala junaha AAalaykum an tankihoohunna itha ataytumoohunna ojoorahunna wala tumsikoo biAAisami alkawafiri waisaloo ma anfaqtum walyasaloo ma anfaqoo thalikum hukmu Allahi yahkumu baynakum waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun
60.translation: O ye who believe! When believing women come unto you as fugitives, examine them. Allah is Best Aware of their faith. Then, if ye know them for true believers, send them not back unto the disbelievers. They are not lawful for them (the disbelievers), nor are they (the disbelievers) lawful for them. And give them (the disbelievers) that which they have spent (upon them). And it is no sin for you to marry such women when ye have given them their dues. And hold not to the ties of disbelieving women; and ask for (the return of) that which ye have spent; and let them (the disbelievers) ask for that which they have spent. That is the judgment of Allah. He judgeth between you. Allah is Knower, Wise

60.arabic: وَإِن فاتَكُم شَيءٌ مِن أَزوٰجِكُم إِلَى الكُفّارِ فَعاقَبتُم فَـٔاتُوا الَّذينَ ذَهَبَت أَزوٰجُهُم مِثلَ ما أَنفَقوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذى أَنتُم بِهِ مُؤمِنونَ
60.transliteration: Wain fatakum shayon min azwajikum ila alkuffari faAAaqabtum faatoo allatheena thahabat azwajuhum mithla ma anfaqoo waittaqoo Allaha allathee antum bihi muminoona
60.translation: And if any of your wives have gone from you unto the disbelievers and afterward ye have your turn (of triumph), then give unto those whose wives have gone the like of that which they have spent, and keep your duty to Allah in Whom ye are believers

60.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ إِذا جاءَكَ المُؤمِنٰتُ يُبايِعنَكَ عَلىٰ أَن لا يُشرِكنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيـًٔا وَلا يَسرِقنَ وَلا يَزنينَ وَلا يَقتُلنَ أَولٰدَهُنَّ وَلا يَأتينَ بِبُهتٰنٍ يَفتَرينَهُ بَينَ أَيديهِنَّ وَأَرجُلِهِنَّ وَلا يَعصينَكَ فى مَعروفٍ فَبايِعهُنَّ وَاستَغفِر لَهُنَّ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
60.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu itha jaaka almuminatu yubayiAAnaka AAala an la yushrikna biAllahi shayan wala yasriqna wala yazneena wala yaqtulna awladahunna wala yateena bibuhtanin yaftareenahu bayna aydeehinna waarjulihinna wala yaAAseenaka fee maAAroofin fabayiAAhunna waistaghfir lahunna Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
60.translation: O Prophet! If believing women come unto thee, taking oath of allegiance unto thee that they will ascribe no thing as partner unto Allah, and will neither steal nor commit adultery nor kill their children, nor produce any lie that they have devised between their hands and feet, nor disobey thee in what is right, then accept their allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

60.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تَتَوَلَّوا قَومًا غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِم قَد يَئِسوا مِنَ الءاخِرَةِ كَما يَئِسَ الكُفّارُ مِن أَصحٰبِ القُبورِ
60.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tatawallaw qawman ghadiba Allahu AAalayhim qad yaisoo mina alakhirati kama yaisa alkuffaru min ashabi alquboori
60.translation: O ye who believe! Be not friendly with a folk with whom Allah is wroth, (a folk) who have despaired of the Hereafter as the disbelievers despair of those who are in the graves

61.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
61.transliteration: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
61.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise

61.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لِمَ تَقولونَ ما لا تَفعَلونَ
61.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo lima taqooloona ma la tafAAaloona
61.translation: O ye who believe! Why say ye that which ye do not

61.arabic: كَبُرَ مَقتًا عِندَ اللَّهِ أَن تَقولوا ما لا تَفعَلونَ
61.transliteration: Kabura maqtan AAinda Allahi an taqooloo ma la tafAAaloona
61.translation: It is most hateful in the sight of Allah that ye say that which ye do not

61.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الَّذينَ يُقٰتِلونَ فى سَبيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنيٰنٌ مَرصوصٌ
61.transliteration: Inna Allaha yuhibbu allatheena yuqatiloona fee sabeelihi saffan kaannahum bunyanun marsoosun
61.translation: Lo! Allah loveth them who battle for His cause in ranks, as if they were a solid structure

61.arabic: وَإِذ قالَ موسىٰ لِقَومِهِ يٰقَومِ لِمَ تُؤذونَنى وَقَد تَعلَمونَ أَنّى رَسولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيكُم فَلَمّا زاغوا أَزاغَ اللَّهُ قُلوبَهُم وَاللَّهُ لا يَهدِى القَومَ الفٰسِقينَ
61.transliteration: Waith qala moosa liqawmihi ya qawmi lima tuthoonanee waqad taAAlamoona annee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum falamma zaghoo azagha Allahu quloobahum waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena
61.translation: And (remember) when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Why persecute ye me, when ye well know that I am Allah's messenger unto you? So when they went astray Allah sent their hearts astray. And Allah guideth not the evil-living folk

61.arabic: وَإِذ قالَ عيسَى ابنُ مَريَمَ يٰبَنى إِسرٰءيلَ إِنّى رَسولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيكُم مُصَدِّقًا لِما بَينَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ التَّورىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسولٍ يَأتى مِن بَعدِى اسمُهُ أَحمَدُ فَلَمّا جاءَهُم بِالبَيِّنٰتِ قالوا هٰذا سِحرٌ مُبينٌ
61.transliteration: Waith qala AAeesa ibnu maryama ya banee israeela innee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum musaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina alttawrati wamubashshiran birasoolin yatee min baAAdee ismuhu ahmadu falamma jaahum bialbayyinati qaloo hatha sihrun mubeenun
61.translation: And when Jesus son of Mary said: O Children of Israel! Lo! I am the messenger of Allah unto you, confirming that which was (revealed) before me in the Torah, and bringing good tidings of a messenger who cometh after me, whose name is the Praised One. Yet when he hath come unto them with clear proofs, they say: This is mere magic

61.arabic: وَمَن أَظلَمُ مِمَّنِ افتَرىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ الكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدعىٰ إِلَى الإِسلٰمِ وَاللَّهُ لا يَهدِى القَومَ الظّٰلِمينَ
61.transliteration: Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi alkathiba wahuwa yudAAa ila alislami waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena
61.translation: And who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie against Allah when he is summoned unto Al-Islam? And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk

61.arabic: يُريدونَ لِيُطفِـٔوا نورَ اللَّهِ بِأَفوٰهِهِم وَاللَّهُ مُتِمُّ نورِهِ وَلَو كَرِهَ الكٰفِرونَ
61.transliteration: Yureedoona liyutfioo noora Allahi biafwahihim waAllahu mutimmu noorihi walaw kariha alkafiroona
61.translation: Fain would they put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah will perfect His light however much the disbelievers are averse

61.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى أَرسَلَ رَسولَهُ بِالهُدىٰ وَدينِ الحَقِّ لِيُظهِرَهُ عَلَى الدّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَو كَرِهَ المُشرِكونَ
61.transliteration: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi walaw kariha almushrikoona
61.translation: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it conqueror of all religion however much idolaters may be averse

61.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا هَل أَدُلُّكُم عَلىٰ تِجٰرَةٍ تُنجيكُم مِن عَذابٍ أَليمٍ
61.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo hal adullukum AAala tijaratin tunjeekum min AAathabin aleemin
61.translation: O ye who believe! Shall I show you a commerce that will save you from a painful doom

61.arabic: تُؤمِنونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَتُجٰهِدونَ فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ بِأَموٰلِكُم وَأَنفُسِكُم ذٰلِكُم خَيرٌ لَكُم إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
61.transliteration: Tuminoona biAllahi warasoolihi watujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi biamwalikum waanfusikum thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona
61.translation: Ye should believe in Allah and His messenger, and should strive for the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is better for you, if ye did but know

61.arabic: يَغفِر لَكُم ذُنوبَكُم وَيُدخِلكُم جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ وَمَسٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةً فى جَنّٰتِ عَدنٍ ذٰلِكَ الفَوزُ العَظيمُ
61.transliteration: Yaghfir lakum thunoobakum wayudkhilkum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wamasakina tayyibatan fee jannati AAadnin thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu
61.translation: He will forgive you your sins and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme triumph

61.arabic: وَأُخرىٰ تُحِبّونَها نَصرٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَفَتحٌ قَريبٌ وَبَشِّرِ المُؤمِنينَ
61.transliteration: Waokhra tuhibboonaha nasrun mina Allahi wafathun qarreebun wabashshiri almumineena
61.translation: And (He will give you) another (blessing) which ye love: help from Allah and present victory. Give good tidings (O Muhammad) to believers

61.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا كونوا أَنصارَ اللَّهِ كَما قالَ عيسَى ابنُ مَريَمَ لِلحَوارِيّۦنَ مَن أَنصارى إِلَى اللَّهِ قالَ الحَوارِيّونَ نَحنُ أَنصارُ اللَّهِ فَـٔامَنَت طائِفَةٌ مِن بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ وَكَفَرَت طائِفَةٌ فَأَيَّدنَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا عَلىٰ عَدُوِّهِم فَأَصبَحوا ظٰهِرينَ
61.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo ansara Allahi kama qala AAeesa ibnu maryama lilhawariyyeena man ansaree ila Allahi qala alhawariyyoona nahnu ansaru Allahi faamanat taifatun min banee israeela wakafarat taifatun faayyadna allatheena amanoo AAala AAaduwwihim faasbahoo thahireena
61.translation: O ye who believe! Be Allah's helpers, even as Jesus son of Mary said unto the disciples: Who are my helpers for Allah? They said: We are Allah's helpers. And a party of the Children of Israel believed, while a party disbelieved. Then We strengthened those who believed against their foe, and they became the uppermost

62.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ المَلِكِ القُدّوسِ العَزيزِ الحَكيمِ
62.transliteration: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi almaliki alquddoosi alAAazeezi alhakeemi
62.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, the Mighty, the Wise

62.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى بَعَثَ فِى الأُمِّيّۦنَ رَسولًا مِنهُم يَتلوا عَلَيهِم ءايٰتِهِ وَيُزَكّيهِم وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ الكِتٰبَ وَالحِكمَةَ وَإِن كانوا مِن قَبلُ لَفى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
62.transliteration: Huwa allathee baAAatha fee alommiyyeena rasoolan minhum yatloo AAalayhim ayatihi wayuzakkeehim wayuAAallimuhumu alkitaba waalhikmata wain kanoo min qablu lafee dalalin mubeenin
62.translation: He it is Who hath sent among the unlettered ones a messenger of their own, to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow, and to teach them the Scripture and wisdom, though heretofore they were indeed in error manifest

62.arabic: وَءاخَرينَ مِنهُم لَمّا يَلحَقوا بِهِم وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الحَكيمُ
62.transliteration: Waakhareena minhum lamma yalhaqoo bihim wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu
62.translation: Along with others of them who have not yet joined them. He is the Mighty, the Wise

62.arabic: ذٰلِكَ فَضلُ اللَّهِ يُؤتيهِ مَن يَشاءُ وَاللَّهُ ذُو الفَضلِ العَظيمِ
62.transliteration: Thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi
62.translation: That is the bounty of Allah; which He giveth unto whom He will. Allah is of Infinite Bounty

62.arabic: مَثَلُ الَّذينَ حُمِّلُوا التَّورىٰةَ ثُمَّ لَم يَحمِلوها كَمَثَلِ الحِمارِ يَحمِلُ أَسفارًا بِئسَ مَثَلُ القَومِ الَّذينَ كَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ لا يَهدِى القَومَ الظّٰلِمينَ
62.transliteration: Mathalu allatheena hummiloo alttawrata thumma lam yahmilooha kamathali alhimari yahmilu asfaran bisa mathalu alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayati Allahi waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena
62.translation: The likeness of those who are entrusted with the Law of Moses, yet apply it not, is as the likeness of the ass carrying books. Wretched is the likeness of folk who deny the revelations of Allah. And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk

62.arabic: قُل يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ هادوا إِن زَعَمتُم أَنَّكُم أَولِياءُ لِلَّهِ مِن دونِ النّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُا المَوتَ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
62.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuha allatheena hadoo in zaAAamtum annakum awliyao lillahi min dooni alnnasi fatamannawoo almawta in kuntum sadiqeena
62.translation: Say (O Muhammad): O ye who are Jews! If ye claim that ye are favoured of Allah apart from (all) mankind, then long for death if ye are truthful

62.arabic: وَلا يَتَمَنَّونَهُ أَبَدًا بِما قَدَّمَت أَيديهِم وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ بِالظّٰلِمينَ
62.transliteration: Wala yatamannawnahu abadan bima qaddamat aydeehim waAllahu AAaleemun bialththalimeena
62.translation: But they will never long for it because of all that their own hands have sent before, and Allah is Aware of evil-doers

62.arabic: قُل إِنَّ المَوتَ الَّذى تَفِرّونَ مِنهُ فَإِنَّهُ مُلٰقيكُم ثُمَّ تُرَدّونَ إِلىٰ عٰلِمِ الغَيبِ وَالشَّهٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
62.transliteration: Qul inna almawta allathee tafirroona minhu fainnahu mulaqeekum thumma turaddoona ila AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona
62.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! the death from which ye shrink will surely meet you, and afterward ye will be returned unto the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, and He will tell you what ye used to do

62.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِذا نودِىَ لِلصَّلوٰةِ مِن يَومِ الجُمُعَةِ فَاسعَوا إِلىٰ ذِكرِ اللَّهِ وَذَرُوا البَيعَ ذٰلِكُم خَيرٌ لَكُم إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
62.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha noodiya lilssalati min yawmi aljumuAAati faisAAaw ila thikri Allahi watharoo albayAAa thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona
62.translation: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know

62.arabic: فَإِذا قُضِيَتِ الصَّلوٰةُ فَانتَشِروا فِى الأَرضِ وَابتَغوا مِن فَضلِ اللَّهِ وَاذكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثيرًا لَعَلَّكُم تُفلِحونَ
62.transliteration: Faitha qudiyati alssalatu faintashiroo fee alardi waibtaghoo min fadli Allahi waothkuroo Allaha katheeran laAAallakum tuflihoona
62.translation: And when the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty, and remember Allah much, that ye may be successful

62.arabic: وَإِذا رَأَوا تِجٰرَةً أَو لَهوًا انفَضّوا إِلَيها وَتَرَكوكَ قائِمًا قُل ما عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيرٌ مِنَ اللَّهوِ وَمِنَ التِّجٰرَةِ وَاللَّهُ خَيرُ الرّٰزِقينَ
62.transliteration: Waitha raaw tijaratan aw lahwan infaddoo ilayha watarakooka qaiman qul ma AAinda Allahi khayrun mina allahwi wamina alttijarati waAllahu khayru alrraziqeena
62.translation: But when they spy some merchandise or pastime they break away to it and leave thee standing. Say: That which Allah hath is better than pastime and than merchandise, and Allah is the Best of providers

63.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذا جاءَكَ المُنٰفِقونَ قالوا نَشهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسولُ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَعلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسولُهُ وَاللَّهُ يَشهَدُ إِنَّ المُنٰفِقينَ لَكٰذِبونَ
63.transliteration: Itha jaaka almunafiqoona qaloo nashhadu innaka larasoolu Allahi waAllahu yaAAlamu innaka larasooluhu waAllahu yashhadu inna almunafiqeena lakathiboona
63.translation: When the hypocrites come unto thee (O Muhammad), they say: We bear witness that thou art indeed Allah's messenger. And Allah knoweth that thou art indeed His messenger, and Allah beareth witness that the hypocrites indeed are speaking falsely

63.arabic: اتَّخَذوا أَيمٰنَهُم جُنَّةً فَصَدّوا عَن سَبيلِ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُم ساءَ ما كانوا يَعمَلونَ
63.transliteration: Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi innahum saa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona
63.translation: They make their faith a pretext so that they may turn (men) from the way of Allah. Verily evil is that which they are wont to do

63.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُم ءامَنوا ثُمَّ كَفَروا فَطُبِعَ عَلىٰ قُلوبِهِم فَهُم لا يَفقَهونَ
63.transliteration: Thalika biannahum amanoo thumma kafaroo fatubiAAa AAala quloobihim fahum la yafqahoona
63.translation: That is because they believed, then disbelieved, therefore their hearts are sealed so that they understand not

63.arabic: وَإِذا رَأَيتَهُم تُعجِبُكَ أَجسامُهُم وَإِن يَقولوا تَسمَع لِقَولِهِم كَأَنَّهُم خُشُبٌ مُسَنَّدَةٌ يَحسَبونَ كُلَّ صَيحَةٍ عَلَيهِم هُمُ العَدُوُّ فَاحذَرهُم قٰتَلَهُمُ اللَّهُ أَنّىٰ يُؤفَكونَ
63.transliteration: Waitha raaytahum tuAAjibuka ajsamuhum wain yaqooloo tasmaAA liqawlihim kaannahum khushubun musannadatun yahsaboona kulla sayhatin AAalayhim humu alAAaduwwu faihtharhum qatalahumu Allahu anna yufakoona
63.translation: And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted

63.arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُم تَعالَوا يَستَغفِر لَكُم رَسولُ اللَّهِ لَوَّوا رُءوسَهُم وَرَأَيتَهُم يَصُدّونَ وَهُم مُستَكبِرونَ
63.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahum taAAalaw yastaghfir lakum rasoolu Allahi lawwaw ruoosahum waraaytahum yasuddoona wahum mustakbiroona
63.translation: And when it is said unto them: Come! The messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you! they avert their faces and thou seest them turning away, disdainful

63.arabic: سَواءٌ عَلَيهِم أَستَغفَرتَ لَهُم أَم لَم تَستَغفِر لَهُم لَن يَغفِرَ اللَّهُ لَهُم إِنَّ اللَّهَ لا يَهدِى القَومَ الفٰسِقينَ
63.transliteration: Sawaon AAalayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira Allahu lahum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena
63.translation: Whether thou ask forgiveness for them or ask not forgiveness for them is all one for them; Allah will not forgive them. Lo! Allah guideth not the evil-living folk

63.arabic: هُمُ الَّذينَ يَقولونَ لا تُنفِقوا عَلىٰ مَن عِندَ رَسولِ اللَّهِ حَتّىٰ يَنفَضّوا وَلِلَّهِ خَزائِنُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَلٰكِنَّ المُنٰفِقينَ لا يَفقَهونَ
63.transliteration: Humu allatheena yaqooloona la tunfiqoo AAala man AAinda rasooli Allahi hatta yanfaddoo walillahi khazainu alssamawati waalardi walakinna almunafiqeena la yafqahoona
63.translation: They it is who say: Spend not on behalf of those (who dwell) with Allah's messenger that they may disperse (and go away from you); when Allah's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites comprehend not

63.arabic: يَقولونَ لَئِن رَجَعنا إِلَى المَدينَةِ لَيُخرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنهَا الأَذَلَّ وَلِلَّهِ العِزَّةُ وَلِرَسولِهِ وَلِلمُؤمِنينَ وَلٰكِنَّ المُنٰفِقينَ لا يَعلَمونَ
63.transliteration: Yaqooloona lain rajaAAna ila almadeenati layukhrijanna alaAAazzu minha alathalla walillahi alAAizzatu walirasoolihi walilmumineena walakinna almunafiqeena la yaAAlamoona
63.translation: They say: Surely, if we return to Al-Madinah the mightier will soon drive out the weaker; when might belongeth to Allah and to His messenger and to the believers; but the hypocrites know not

63.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا لا تُلهِكُم أَموٰلُكُم وَلا أَولٰدُكُم عَن ذِكرِ اللَّهِ وَمَن يَفعَل ذٰلِكَ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الخٰسِرونَ
63.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tulhikum amwalukum wala awladukum AAan thikri Allahi waman yafAAal thalika faolaika humu alkhasiroona
63.translation: O ye who believe! Let not your wealth nor your children distract you from remembrance of Allah. Those who do so, they are the losers

63.arabic: وَأَنفِقوا مِن ما رَزَقنٰكُم مِن قَبلِ أَن يَأتِىَ أَحَدَكُمُ المَوتُ فَيَقولَ رَبِّ لَولا أَخَّرتَنى إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ قَريبٍ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِنَ الصّٰلِحينَ
63.transliteration: Waanfiqoo min ma razaqnakum min qabli an yatiya ahadakumu almawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawla akhkhartanee ila ajalin qareebin faassaddaqa waakun mina alssaliheena
63.translation: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous

63.arabic: وَلَن يُؤَخِّرَ اللَّهُ نَفسًا إِذا جاءَ أَجَلُها وَاللَّهُ خَبيرٌ بِما تَعمَلونَ
63.transliteration: Walan yuakhkhira Allahu nafsan itha jaa ajaluha waAllahu khabeerun bima taAAmaloona
63.translation: But Allah reprieveth no soul when its term cometh, and Allah is Informed of what ye do

64.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ لَهُ المُلكُ وَلَهُ الحَمدُ وَهُوَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
64.transliteration: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
64.translation: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah; unto Him belongeth Sovereignty and unto Him belongeth praise, and He is Able to do all things

64.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى خَلَقَكُم فَمِنكُم كافِرٌ وَمِنكُم مُؤمِنٌ وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ بَصيرٌ
64.transliteration: Huwa allathee khalaqakum faminkum kafirun waminkum muminun waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun
64.translation: He it is Who created you, but one of you is a disbeliever and one of you is a believer, and Allah is Seer of what ye do

64.arabic: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضَ بِالحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُم فَأَحسَنَ صُوَرَكُم وَإِلَيهِ المَصيرُ
64.transliteration: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi wasawwarakum faahsana suwarakum wailayhi almaseeru
64.translation: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying

64.arabic: يَعلَمُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَيَعلَمُ ما تُسِرّونَ وَما تُعلِنونَ وَاللَّهُ عَليمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدورِ
64.transliteration: YaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati waalardi wayaAAlamu ma tusirroona wama tuAAlinoona waAllahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori
64.translation: He knoweth all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He knoweth what ye conceal and what ye publish. And Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men)

64.arabic: أَلَم يَأتِكُم نَبَؤُا۟ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن قَبلُ فَذاقوا وَبالَ أَمرِهِم وَلَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
64.transliteration: Alam yatikum nabao allatheena kafaroo min qablu fathaqoo wabala amrihim walahum AAathabun aleemun
64.translation: Hath not the story reached you of those who disbelieved of old and so did taste the ill-effects of their conduct, and theirs will be a painful doom

64.arabic: ذٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُ كانَت تَأتيهِم رُسُلُهُم بِالبَيِّنٰتِ فَقالوا أَبَشَرٌ يَهدونَنا فَكَفَروا وَتَوَلَّوا وَاستَغنَى اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ غَنِىٌّ حَميدٌ
64.transliteration: Thalika biannahu kanat tateehim rusuluhum bialbayyinati faqaloo abasharun yahdoonana fakafaroo watawallaw waistaghna Allahu waAllahu ghaniyyun hameedun
64.translation: That was because their messengers (from Allah) kept coming unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they said: Shall mere mortals guide us? So they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was independent (of them). Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise

64.arabic: زَعَمَ الَّذينَ كَفَروا أَن لَن يُبعَثوا قُل بَلىٰ وَرَبّى لَتُبعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِما عَمِلتُم وَذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَسيرٌ
64.transliteration: ZaAAama allatheena kafaroo an lan yubAAathoo qul bala warabbee latubAAathunna thumma latunabbaonna bima AAamiltum wathalika AAala Allahi yaseerun
64.translation: Those who disbelieve assert that they will not be raised again. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Yea, verily, by my Lord! ye will be raised again and then ye will be informed of what ye did; and that is easy for Allah

64.arabic: فَـٔامِنوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسولِهِ وَالنّورِ الَّذى أَنزَلنا وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعمَلونَ خَبيرٌ
64.transliteration: Faaminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waalnnoori allathee anzalna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun
64.translation: So believe in Allah and His messenger and the light which We have revealed. And Allah is Informed of what ye do

64.arabic: يَومَ يَجمَعُكُم لِيَومِ الجَمعِ ذٰلِكَ يَومُ التَّغابُنِ وَمَن يُؤمِن بِاللَّهِ وَيَعمَل صٰلِحًا يُكَفِّر عَنهُ سَيِّـٔاتِهِ وَيُدخِلهُ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها أَبَدًا ذٰلِكَ الفَوزُ العَظيمُ
64.transliteration: Yawma yajmaAAukum liyawmi aljamAAi thalika yawmu alttaghabuni waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu
64.translation: The day when He shall gather you unto the Day of Assembling, that will be a day of mutual disillusion. And whoso believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will remit from him his evil deeds and will bring him unto Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. That is the supreme triumph

64.arabic: وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا وَكَذَّبوا بِـٔايٰتِنا أُولٰئِكَ أَصحٰبُ النّارِ خٰلِدينَ فيها وَبِئسَ المَصيرُ
64.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari khalideena feeha wabisa almaseeru
64.translation: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are owners of the Fire; they will abide therein - a hapless journey's end

64.arabic: ما أَصابَ مِن مُصيبَةٍ إِلّا بِإِذنِ اللَّهِ وَمَن يُؤمِن بِاللَّهِ يَهدِ قَلبَهُ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَليمٌ
64.transliteration: Ma asaba min museebatin illa biithni Allahi waman yumin biAllahi yahdi qalbahu waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun
64.translation: No calamity befalleth save by Allah's leave. And whosoever believeth in Allah, He guideth his heart. And Allah is Knower of all things

64.arabic: وَأَطيعُوا اللَّهَ وَأَطيعُوا الرَّسولَ فَإِن تَوَلَّيتُم فَإِنَّما عَلىٰ رَسولِنَا البَلٰغُ المُبينُ
64.transliteration: WaateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaytum fainnama AAala rasoolina albalaghu almubeenu
64.translation: Obey Allah and obey His messenger; but if ye turn away, then the duty of Our messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly

64.arabic: اللَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَليَتَوَكَّلِ المُؤمِنونَ
64.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona
64.translation: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. In Allah, therefore, let believers put their trust

64.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إِنَّ مِن أَزوٰجِكُم وَأَولٰدِكُم عَدُوًّا لَكُم فَاحذَروهُم وَإِن تَعفوا وَتَصفَحوا وَتَغفِروا فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
64.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna min azwajikum waawladikum AAaduwwan lakum faihtharoohum wain taAAfoo watasfahoo wataghfiroo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
64.translation: O ye who believe! Lo! among your wives and your children there are enemies for you, therefor beware of them. And if ye efface and overlook and forgive, then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

64.arabic: إِنَّما أَموٰلُكُم وَأَولٰدُكُم فِتنَةٌ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ أَجرٌ عَظيمٌ
64.transliteration: Innama amwalukum waawladukum fitnatun waAllahu AAindahu ajrun AAatheemun
64.translation: Your wealth and your children are only a temptation, whereas Allah! with Him is an immense reward

64.arabic: فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ مَا استَطَعتُم وَاسمَعوا وَأَطيعوا وَأَنفِقوا خَيرًا لِأَنفُسِكُم وَمَن يوقَ شُحَّ نَفسِهِ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ المُفلِحونَ
64.transliteration: Faittaqoo Allaha ma istataAAtum waismaAAoo waateeAAoo waanfiqoo khayran lianfusikum waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoona
64.translation: So keep your duty to Allah as best ye can, and listen, and obey, and spend; that is better for your souls. And whoso is saved from his own greed, such are the successful

64.arabic: إِن تُقرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرضًا حَسَنًا يُضٰعِفهُ لَكُم وَيَغفِر لَكُم وَاللَّهُ شَكورٌ حَليمٌ
64.transliteration: In tuqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan yudaAAifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum waAllahu shakoorun haleemun
64.translation: If ye lend unto Allah a goodly loan, He will double it for you and will forgive you, for Allah is Responsive, Clement
Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Mighty, the Wise

65.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يٰأَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ إِذا طَلَّقتُمُ النِّساءَ فَطَلِّقوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحصُوا العِدَّةَ وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ رَبَّكُم لا تُخرِجوهُنَّ مِن بُيوتِهِنَّ وَلا يَخرُجنَ إِلّا أَن يَأتينَ بِفٰحِشَةٍ مُبَيِّنَةٍ وَتِلكَ حُدودُ اللَّهِ وَمَن يَتَعَدَّ حُدودَ اللَّهِ فَقَد ظَلَمَ نَفسَهُ لا تَدرى لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحدِثُ بَعدَ ذٰلِكَ أَمرًا
65.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu itha tallaqtumu alnnisaa fatalliqoohunna liAAiddatihinna waahsoo alAAiddata waittaqoo Allaha rabbakum la tukhrijoohunna min buyootihinna wala yakhrujna illa an yateena bifahishatin mubayyinatin watilka hudoodu Allahi waman yataAAadda hudooda Allahi faqad thalama nafsahu la tadree laAAalla Allaha yuhdithu baAAda thalika amran
65.translation: O Prophet! When ye (men) put away women, put them away for their (legal) period and reckon the period, and keep your duty to Allah, your Lord. Expel them not from their houses nor let them go forth unless they commit open immorality. Such are the limits (imposed by) Allah; and whoso transgresseth Allah's limits, he verily wrongeth his soul. Thou knowest not: it may be that Allah will afterward bring some new thing to pass

65.arabic: فَإِذا بَلَغنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمسِكوهُنَّ بِمَعروفٍ أَو فارِقوهُنَّ بِمَعروفٍ وَأَشهِدوا ذَوَى عَدلٍ مِنكُم وَأَقيمُوا الشَّهٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ذٰلِكُم يوعَظُ بِهِ مَن كانَ يُؤمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَاليَومِ الءاخِرِ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجعَل لَهُ مَخرَجًا
65.transliteration: Faitha balaghna ajalahunna faamsikoohunna bimaAAroofin aw fariqoohunna bimaAAroofin waashhidoo thaway AAadlin minkum waaqeemoo alshshahadata lillahi thalikum yooAAathu bihi man kana yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu makhrajan
65.translation: Then, when they have reached their term, take them back in kindness or part from them in kindness, and call to witness two just men among you, and keep your testimony upright for Allah. Whoso believeth in Allah and the Last Day is exhorted to act thus. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, Allah will appoint a way out for him

65.arabic: وَيَرزُقهُ مِن حَيثُ لا يَحتَسِبُ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّل عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسبُهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بٰلِغُ أَمرِهِ قَد جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيءٍ قَدرًا
65.transliteration: Wayarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasibu waman yatawakkal AAala Allahi fahuwa hasbuhu inna Allaha balighu amrihi qad jaAAala Allahu likulli shayin qadran
65.translation: And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation. And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things

65.arabic: وَالّٰـٔى يَئِسنَ مِنَ المَحيضِ مِن نِسائِكُم إِنِ ارتَبتُم فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلٰثَةُ أَشهُرٍ وَالّٰـٔى لَم يَحِضنَ وَأُولٰتُ الأَحمالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَن يَضَعنَ حَملَهُنَّ وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجعَل لَهُ مِن أَمرِهِ يُسرًا
65.transliteration: Waallaee yaisna mina almaheedi min nisaikum ini irtabtum faAAiddatuhunna thalathatu ashhurin waallaee lam yahidna waolatu alahmali ajaluhunna an yadaAAna hamlahunna waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu min amrihi yusran
65.translation: And for such of your women as despair of menstruation, if ye doubt, their period (of waiting) shall be three months, along with those who have it not. And for those with child, their period shall be till they bring forth their burden. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, He maketh his course easy for him

65.arabic: ذٰلِكَ أَمرُ اللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُ إِلَيكُم وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يُكَفِّر عَنهُ سَيِّـٔاتِهِ وَيُعظِم لَهُ أَجرًا
65.transliteration: Thalika amru Allahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi Allaha yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayuAAthim lahu ajran
65.translation: That is the commandment of Allah which He revealeth unto you. And whoso keepeth his duty to Allah, He will remit from him his evil deeds and magnify reward for him

65.arabic: أَسكِنوهُنَّ مِن حَيثُ سَكَنتُم مِن وُجدِكُم وَلا تُضارّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقوا عَلَيهِنَّ وَإِن كُنَّ أُولٰتِ حَملٍ فَأَنفِقوا عَلَيهِنَّ حَتّىٰ يَضَعنَ حَملَهُنَّ فَإِن أَرضَعنَ لَكُم فَـٔاتوهُنَّ أُجورَهُنَّ وَأتَمِروا بَينَكُم بِمَعروفٍ وَإِن تَعاسَرتُم فَسَتُرضِعُ لَهُ أُخرىٰ
65.transliteration: Askinoohunna min haythu sakantum min wujdikum wala tudarroohunna litudayyiqoo AAalayhinna wain kunna olati hamlin faanfiqoo AAalayhinna hatta yadaAAna hamlahunna fain ardaAAna lakum faatoohunna ojoorahunna watamiroo baynakum bimaAAroofin wain taAAasartum fasaturdiAAu lahu okhra
65.translation: Lodge them where ye dwell, according to your wealth, and harass them not so as to straiten life for them. And if they are with child, then spend for them till they bring forth their burden. Then, if they give suck for you, give them their due payment and consult together in kindness; but if ye make difficulties for one another, then let some other woman give suck for him (the father of the child)

65.arabic: لِيُنفِق ذو سَعَةٍ مِن سَعَتِهِ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيهِ رِزقُهُ فَليُنفِق مِمّا ءاتىٰهُ اللَّهُ لا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفسًا إِلّا ما ءاتىٰها سَيَجعَلُ اللَّهُ بَعدَ عُسرٍ يُسرًا
65.transliteration: Liyunfiq thoo saAAatin min saAAatihi waman qudira AAalayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma atahu Allahu la yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa ma ataha sayajAAalu Allahu baAAda AAusrin yusran
65.translation: Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after hardship, ease

65.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِن قَريَةٍ عَتَت عَن أَمرِ رَبِّها وَرُسُلِهِ فَحاسَبنٰها حِسابًا شَديدًا وَعَذَّبنٰها عَذابًا نُكرًا
65.transliteration: Wakaayyin min qaryatin AAatat AAan amri rabbiha warusulihi fahasabnaha hisaban shadeedan waAAaththabnaha AAathaban nukran
65.translation: And how many a community revolted against the ordinance of its Lord and His messengers, and We called it to a stern account and punished it with dire punishment

65.arabic: فَذاقَت وَبالَ أَمرِها وَكانَ عٰقِبَةُ أَمرِها خُسرًا
65.transliteration: Fathaqat wabala amriha wakana AAaqibatu amriha khusran
65.translation: So that it tasted the ill-effects of its conduct, and the consequence of its conduct was loss

65.arabic: أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُم عَذابًا شَديدًا فَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يٰأُولِى الأَلبٰبِ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا قَد أَنزَلَ اللَّهُ إِلَيكُم ذِكرًا
65.transliteration: aAAadda Allahu lahum AAathaban shadeedan faittaqoo Allaha ya olee alalbabi allatheena amanoo qad anzala Allahu ilaykum thikran
65.translation: Allah hath prepared for them stern punishment; so keep your duty to Allah, O men of understanding! O ye who believe! Now Allah hath sent down unto you a reminder

65.arabic: رَسولًا يَتلوا عَلَيكُم ءايٰتِ اللَّهِ مُبَيِّنٰتٍ لِيُخرِجَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ مِنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ إِلَى النّورِ وَمَن يُؤمِن بِاللَّهِ وَيَعمَل صٰلِحًا يُدخِلهُ جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها أَبَدًا قَد أَحسَنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ رِزقًا
65.transliteration: Rasoolan yatloo AAalaykum ayati Allahi mubayyinatin liyukhrija allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati mina alththulumati ila alnnoori waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan qad ahsana Allahu lahu rizqan
65.translation: A messenger reciting unto you the revelations of Allah made plain, that He may bring forth those who believe and do good works from darkness unto light. And whosoever believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will bring him into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. Allah hath made good provision for him

65.arabic: اللَّهُ الَّذى خَلَقَ سَبعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ وَمِنَ الأَرضِ مِثلَهُنَّ يَتَنَزَّلُ الأَمرُ بَينَهُنَّ لِتَعلَموا أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَد أَحاطَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عِلمًا
65.transliteration: Allahu allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin wamina alardi mithlahunna yatanazzalu alamru baynahunna litaAAlamoo anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun waanna Allaha qad ahata bikulli shayin AAilman
65.translation: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge

66.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يٰأَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ ما أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ تَبتَغى مَرضاتَ أَزوٰجِكَ وَاللَّهُ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
66.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu lima tuharrimu ma ahalla Allahu laka tabtaghee mardata azwajika waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun
66.translation: O Prophet! Why bannest thou that which Allah hath made lawful for thee, seeking to please thy wives? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

66.arabic: قَد فَرَضَ اللَّهُ لَكُم تَحِلَّةَ أَيمٰنِكُم وَاللَّهُ مَولىٰكُم وَهُوَ العَليمُ الحَكيمُ
66.transliteration: Qad farada Allahu lakum tahillata aymanikum waAllahu mawlakum wahuwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu
66.translation: Allah hath made lawful for you (Muslims) absolution from your oaths (of such a kind), and Allah is your Protector. He is the Knower, the Wise

66.arabic: وَإِذ أَسَرَّ النَّبِىُّ إِلىٰ بَعضِ أَزوٰجِهِ حَديثًا فَلَمّا نَبَّأَت بِهِ وَأَظهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَيهِ عَرَّفَ بَعضَهُ وَأَعرَضَ عَن بَعضٍ فَلَمّا نَبَّأَها بِهِ قالَت مَن أَنبَأَكَ هٰذا قالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ العَليمُ الخَبيرُ
66.transliteration: Waith asarra alnnabiyyu ila baAAdi azwajihi hadeethan falamma nabbaat bihi waathharahu Allahu AAalayhi AAarrafa baAAdahu waaAArada AAan baAAdin falamma nabbaaha bihi qalat man anbaaka hatha qala nabbaaniya alAAaleemu alkhabeeru
66.translation: When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives and when she afterward divulged it and Allah apprised him thereof, he made known (to her) part thereof and passed over part. And when he told it her she said: Who hath told thee? He said: The Knower, the Aware hath told me

66.arabic: إِن تَتوبا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَقَد صَغَت قُلوبُكُما وَإِن تَظٰهَرا عَلَيهِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ مَولىٰهُ وَجِبريلُ وَصٰلِحُ المُؤمِنينَ وَالمَلٰئِكَةُ بَعدَ ذٰلِكَ ظَهيرٌ
66.transliteration: In tatooba ila Allahi faqad saghat quloobukuma wain tathahara AAalayhi fainna Allaha huwa mawlahu wajibreelu wasalihu almumineena waalmalaikatu baAAda thalika thaheerun
66.translation: If ye twain turn unto Allah repentant, (ye have cause to do so) for your hearts desired (the ban); and if ye aid one another against him (Muhammad) then lo! Allah, even He, is his Protecting Friend, and Gabriel and the righteous among the believers; and furthermore the angels are his helpers

66.arabic: عَسىٰ رَبُّهُ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَن يُبدِلَهُ أَزوٰجًا خَيرًا مِنكُنَّ مُسلِمٰتٍ مُؤمِنٰتٍ قٰنِتٰتٍ تٰئِبٰتٍ عٰبِدٰتٍ سٰئِحٰتٍ ثَيِّبٰتٍ وَأَبكارًا
66.transliteration: AAasa rabbuhu in tallaqakunna an yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatin muminatin qanitatin taibatin AAabidatin saihatin thayyibatin waabkaran
66.translation: It may happen that his Lord, if he divorce you, will give him in your stead wives better than you, submissive (to Allah), believing, pious, penitent, devout, inclined to fasting, widows and maids

66.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا قوا أَنفُسَكُم وَأَهليكُم نارًا وَقودُهَا النّاسُ وَالحِجارَةُ عَلَيها مَلٰئِكَةٌ غِلاظٌ شِدادٌ لا يَعصونَ اللَّهَ ما أَمَرَهُم وَيَفعَلونَ ما يُؤمَرونَ
66.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qoo anfusakum waahleekum naran waqooduha alnnasu waalhijaratu AAalayha malaikatun ghilathun shidadun la yaAAsoona Allaha ma amarahum wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona
66.translation: O ye who believe! Ward off from yourselves and your families a Fire whereof the fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels strong, severe, who resist not Allah in that which He commandeth them, but do that which they are commanded

66.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ كَفَروا لا تَعتَذِرُوا اليَومَ إِنَّما تُجزَونَ ما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
66.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena kafaroo la taAAtathiroo alyawma innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona
66.translation: (Then it will be said): O ye who disbelieve! Make no excuses for yourselves this day. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do

66.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا توبوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوبَةً نَصوحًا عَسىٰ رَبُّكُم أَن يُكَفِّرَ عَنكُم سَيِّـٔاتِكُم وَيُدخِلَكُم جَنّٰتٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ يَومَ لا يُخزِى اللَّهُ النَّبِىَّ وَالَّذينَ ءامَنوا مَعَهُ نورُهُم يَسعىٰ بَينَ أَيديهِم وَبِأَيمٰنِهِم يَقولونَ رَبَّنا أَتمِم لَنا نورَنا وَاغفِر لَنا إِنَّكَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
66.transliteration: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo tooboo ila Allahi tawbatan nasoohan AAasa rabbukum an yukaffira AAankum sayyiatikum wayudkhilakum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yawma la yukhzee Allahu alnnabiyya waallatheena amanoo maAAahu nooruhum yasAAa bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim yaqooloona rabbana atmim lana noorana waighfir lana innaka AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
66.translation: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things

66.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا النَّبِىُّ جٰهِدِ الكُفّارَ وَالمُنٰفِقينَ وَاغلُظ عَلَيهِم وَمَأوىٰهُم جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئسَ المَصيرُ
66.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara waalmunafiqeena waoghluth AAalayhim wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almaseeru
66.translation: O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Hell will be their home, a hapless journey's end

66.arabic: ضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذينَ كَفَرُوا امرَأَتَ نوحٍ وَامرَأَتَ لوطٍ كانَتا تَحتَ عَبدَينِ مِن عِبادِنا صٰلِحَينِ فَخانَتاهُما فَلَم يُغنِيا عَنهُما مِنَ اللَّهِ شَيـًٔا وَقيلَ ادخُلَا النّارَ مَعَ الدّٰخِلينَ
66.transliteration: Daraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena kafaroo imraata noohin waimraata lootin kanata tahta AAabdayni min AAibadina salihayni fakhanatahuma falam yughniya AAanhuma mina Allahi shayan waqeela odkhula alnnara maAAa alddakhileena
66.translation: Allah citeth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves yet betrayed them so that they (the husbands) availed them naught against Allah and it was said (unto them): Enter the Fire along with those who enter

66.arabic: وَضَرَبَ اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذينَ ءامَنُوا امرَأَتَ فِرعَونَ إِذ قالَت رَبِّ ابنِ لى عِندَكَ بَيتًا فِى الجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنى مِن فِرعَونَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنى مِنَ القَومِ الظّٰلِمينَ
66.transliteration: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena amanoo imraata firAAawna ith qalat rabbi ibni lee AAindaka baytan fee aljannati wanajjinee min firAAawna waAAamalihi wanajjinee mina alqawmi alththalimeena
66.translation: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk

66.arabic: وَمَريَمَ ابنَتَ عِمرٰنَ الَّتى أَحصَنَت فَرجَها فَنَفَخنا فيهِ مِن روحِنا وَصَدَّقَت بِكَلِمٰتِ رَبِّها وَكُتُبِهِ وَكانَت مِنَ القٰنِتينَ
66.transliteration: Wamaryama ibnata AAimrana allatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feehi min roohina wasaddaqat bikalimati rabbiha wakutubihi wakanat mina alqaniteena
66.translation: And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient

67.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ تَبٰرَكَ الَّذى بِيَدِهِ المُلكُ وَهُوَ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَديرٌ
67.transliteration: Tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun
67.translation: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things

67.arabic: الَّذى خَلَقَ المَوتَ وَالحَيوٰةَ لِيَبلُوَكُم أَيُّكُم أَحسَنُ عَمَلًا وَهُوَ العَزيزُ الغَفورُ
67.transliteration: Allathee khalaqa almawta waalhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan wahuwa alAAazeezu alghafooru
67.translation: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving

67.arabic: الَّذى خَلَقَ سَبعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِباقًا ما تَرىٰ فى خَلقِ الرَّحمٰنِ مِن تَفٰوُتٍ فَارجِعِ البَصَرَ هَل تَرىٰ مِن فُطورٍ
67.transliteration: Allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairjiAAi albasara hal tara min futoorin
67.translation: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts

67.arabic: ثُمَّ ارجِعِ البَصَرَ كَرَّتَينِ يَنقَلِب إِلَيكَ البَصَرُ خاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسيرٌ
67.transliteration: Thumma irjiAAi albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseerun
67.translation: Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim

67.arabic: وَلَقَد زَيَّنَّا السَّماءَ الدُّنيا بِمَصٰبيحَ وَجَعَلنٰها رُجومًا لِلشَّيٰطينِ وَأَعتَدنا لَهُم عَذابَ السَّعيرِ
67.transliteration: Walaqad zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wajaAAalnaha rujooman lilshshayateeni waaAAtadna lahum AAathaba alssaAAeeri
67.translation: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame

67.arabic: وَلِلَّذينَ كَفَروا بِرَبِّهِم عَذابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئسَ المَصيرُ
67.transliteration: Walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim AAathabu jahannama wabisa almaseeru
67.translation: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end

67.arabic: إِذا أُلقوا فيها سَمِعوا لَها شَهيقًا وَهِىَ تَفورُ
67.transliteration: Itha olqoo feeha samiAAoo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafooru
67.translation: When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up

67.arabic: تَكادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الغَيظِ كُلَّما أُلقِىَ فيها فَوجٌ سَأَلَهُم خَزَنَتُها أَلَم يَأتِكُم نَذيرٌ
67.transliteration: Takadu tamayyazu mina alghaythi kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheerun
67.translation: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner

67.arabic: قالوا بَلىٰ قَد جاءَنا نَذيرٌ فَكَذَّبنا وَقُلنا ما نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ مِن شَيءٍ إِن أَنتُم إِلّا فى ضَلٰلٍ كَبيرٍ
67.transliteration: Qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala Allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeerin
67.translation: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error

67.arabic: وَقالوا لَو كُنّا نَسمَعُ أَو نَعقِلُ ما كُنّا فى أَصحٰبِ السَّعيرِ
67.transliteration: Waqaloo law kunna nasmaAAu aw naAAqilu ma kunna fee ashabi alssaAAeeri
67.translation: And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames

67.arabic: فَاعتَرَفوا بِذَنبِهِم فَسُحقًا لِأَصحٰبِ السَّعيرِ
67.transliteration: FaiAAtarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi alssaAAeeri
67.translation: So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the dwellers in the flames

67.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ يَخشَونَ رَبَّهُم بِالغَيبِ لَهُم مَغفِرَةٌ وَأَجرٌ كَبيرٌ
67.transliteration: Inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun
67.translation: Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward

67.arabic: وَأَسِرّوا قَولَكُم أَوِ اجهَروا بِهِ إِنَّهُ عَليمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدورِ
67.transliteration: Waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori
67.translation: And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men)

67.arabic: أَلا يَعلَمُ مَن خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اللَّطيفُ الخَبيرُ
67.transliteration: Ala yaAAlamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru
67.translation: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware

67.arabic: هُوَ الَّذى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الأَرضَ ذَلولًا فَامشوا فى مَناكِبِها وَكُلوا مِن رِزقِهِ وَإِلَيهِ النُّشورُ
67.transliteration: Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda thaloolan faimshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi alnnushooru
67.translation: He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead)

67.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَن فِى السَّماءِ أَن يَخسِفَ بِكُمُ الأَرضَ فَإِذا هِىَ تَمورُ
67.transliteration: Aamintum man fee alssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamooru
67.translation: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed

67.arabic: أَم أَمِنتُم مَن فِى السَّماءِ أَن يُرسِلَ عَلَيكُم حاصِبًا فَسَتَعلَمونَ كَيفَ نَذيرِ
67.transliteration: Am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila AAalaykum hasiban fasataAAlamoona kayfa natheeri
67.translation: Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning

67.arabic: وَلَقَد كَذَّبَ الَّذينَ مِن قَبلِهِم فَكَيفَ كانَ نَكيرِ
67.transliteration: Walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeeri
67.translation: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)

67.arabic: أَوَلَم يَرَوا إِلَى الطَّيرِ فَوقَهُم صٰفّٰتٍ وَيَقبِضنَ ما يُمسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحمٰنُ إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ بَصيرٌ
67.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ila alttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa alrrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseerun
67.translation: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things

67.arabic: أَمَّن هٰذَا الَّذى هُوَ جُندٌ لَكُم يَنصُرُكُم مِن دونِ الرَّحمٰنِ إِنِ الكٰفِرونَ إِلّا فى غُرورٍ
67.transliteration: Amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni alrrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroorin
67.translation: Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the Beneficent? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion

67.arabic: أَمَّن هٰذَا الَّذى يَرزُقُكُم إِن أَمسَكَ رِزقَهُ بَل لَجّوا فى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفورٍ
67.transliteration: Amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee AAutuwwin wanufoorin
67.translation: Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness

67.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمشى مُكِبًّا عَلىٰ وَجهِهِ أَهدىٰ أَمَّن يَمشى سَوِيًّا عَلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
67.transliteration: Afaman yamshee mukibban AAala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan AAala siratin mustaqeemin
67.translation: Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road

67.arabic: قُل هُوَ الَّذى أَنشَأَكُم وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمعَ وَالأَبصٰرَ وَالأَفـِٔدَةَ قَليلًا ما تَشكُرونَ
67.transliteration: Qul huwa allathee anshaakum wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona
67.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye

67.arabic: قُل هُوَ الَّذى ذَرَأَكُم فِى الأَرضِ وَإِلَيهِ تُحشَرونَ
67.transliteration: Qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona
67.translation: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered

67.arabic: وَيَقولونَ مَتىٰ هٰذَا الوَعدُ إِن كُنتُم صٰدِقينَ
67.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena
67.translation: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful

67.arabic: قُل إِنَّمَا العِلمُ عِندَ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّما أَنا۠ نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
67.transliteration: Qul innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun
67.translation: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner

67.arabic: فَلَمّا رَأَوهُ زُلفَةً سيـَٔت وُجوهُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَقيلَ هٰذَا الَّذى كُنتُم بِهِ تَدَّعونَ
67.transliteration: Falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi taddaAAoona
67.translation: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call

67.arabic: قُل أَرَءَيتُم إِن أَهلَكَنِىَ اللَّهُ وَمَن مَعِىَ أَو رَحِمَنا فَمَن يُجيرُ الكٰفِرينَ مِن عَذابٍ أَليمٍ
67.transliteration: Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahu waman maAAiya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min AAathabin aleemin
67.translation: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom

67.arabic: قُل هُوَ الرَّحمٰنُ ءامَنّا بِهِ وَعَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلنا فَسَتَعلَمونَ مَن هُوَ فى ضَلٰلٍ مُبينٍ
67.transliteration: Qul huwa alrrahmanu amanna bihi waAAalayhi tawakkalna fasataAAlamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeenin
67.translation: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest

67.arabic: قُل أَرَءَيتُم إِن أَصبَحَ ماؤُكُم غَورًا فَمَن يَأتيكُم بِماءٍ مَعينٍ
67.transliteration: Qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain maAAeenin
67.translation: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water

68.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ ن وَالقَلَمِ وَما يَسطُرونَ
68.translation: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith)
Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman
And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing
And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature
And thou wilt see and they will see
Which of you is the demented

68.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعلَمُ بِالمُهتَدينَ
68.transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena
68.translation: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright
Therefor obey not thou the rejecters
Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise
Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger
Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders
Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
Greedy therewithal, intrusive
It is because he is possessed of wealth and children

68.arabic: إِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِ ءايٰتُنا قالَ أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ
68.transliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena
68.translation: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old
We shall brand him on the nose

68.arabic: إِنّا بَلَونٰهُم كَما بَلَونا أَصحٰبَ الجَنَّةِ إِذ أَقسَموا لَيَصرِمُنَّها مُصبِحينَ
68.transliteration: Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba aljannati ith aqsamoo layasrimunnaha musbiheena
68.translation: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning
And made no exception (for the Will of Allah)

68.arabic: فَطافَ عَلَيها طائِفٌ مِن رَبِّكَ وَهُم نائِمونَ
68.transliteration: Fatafa AAalayha taifun min rabbika wahum naimoona
68.translation: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
And in the morning it was as if plucked
And they cried out one unto another in the morning

68.arabic: أَنِ اغدوا عَلىٰ حَرثِكُم إِن كُنتُم صٰرِمينَ
68.transliteration: Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum in kuntum sarimeena
68.translation: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit)
So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones

68.arabic: أَن لا يَدخُلَنَّهَا اليَومَ عَلَيكُم مِسكينٌ
68.transliteration: An la yadkhulannaha alyawma AAalaykum miskeenun
68.translation: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you
They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose
But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error
Nay, but we are desolate

68.arabic: قالَ أَوسَطُهُم أَلَم أَقُل لَكُم لَولا تُسَبِّحونَ
68.transliteration: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihoona
68.translation: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)

68.arabic: قالوا سُبحٰنَ رَبِّنا إِنّا كُنّا ظٰلِمينَ
68.transliteration: Qaloo subhana rabbina inna kunna thalimeena
68.translation: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers
Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching

68.transliteration: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna tagheena
68.translation: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous

68.arabic: عَسىٰ رَبُّنا أَن يُبدِلَنا خَيرًا مِنها إِنّا إِلىٰ رَبِّنا رٰغِبونَ
68.transliteration: AAasa rabbuna an yubdilana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona
68.translation: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord

68.arabic: كَذٰلِكَ العَذابُ وَلَعَذابُ الءاخِرَةِ أَكبَرُ لَو كانوا يَعلَمونَ
68.transliteration: Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona
68.translation: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know

68.arabic: إِنَّ لِلمُتَّقينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِم جَنّٰتِ النَّعيمِ
68.transliteration: Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannati alnnaAAeemi
68.translation: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord
Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty
What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge
Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn
That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose

68.arabic: أَم لَكُم أَيمٰنٌ عَلَينا بٰلِغَةٌ إِلىٰ يَومِ القِيٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُم لَما تَحكُمونَ
68.transliteration: Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatun ila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoona
68.translation: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain
Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that

68.arabic: أَم لَهُم شُرَكاءُ فَليَأتوا بِشُرَكائِهِم إِن كانوا صٰدِقينَ
68.transliteration: Am lahum shurakao falyatoo bishurakaihim in kanoo sadiqeena
68.translation: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

68.arabic: يَومَ يُكشَفُ عَن ساقٍ وَيُدعَونَ إِلَى السُّجودِ فَلا يَستَطيعونَ
68.transliteration: Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawna ila alssujoodi fala yastateeAAoona
68.translation: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able

68.arabic: خٰشِعَةً أَبصٰرُهُم تَرهَقُهُم ذِلَّةٌ وَقَد كانوا يُدعَونَ إِلَى السُّجودِ وَهُم سٰلِمونَ
68.transliteration: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ila alssujoodi wahum salimoona
68.translation: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt

68.arabic: فَذَرنى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهٰذَا الحَديثِ سَنَستَدرِجُهُم مِن حَيثُ لا يَعلَمونَ
68.transliteration: Fatharnee waman yukaththibu bihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona
68.translation: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not
Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm

68.arabic: أَم تَسـَٔلُهُم أَجرًا فَهُم مِن مَغرَمٍ مُثقَلونَ
68.transliteration: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona
68.translation: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed
Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)

68.arabic: فَاصبِر لِحُكمِ رَبِّكَ وَلا تَكُن كَصاحِبِ الحوتِ إِذ نادىٰ وَهُوَ مَكظومٌ
68.transliteration: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nada wahuwa makthoomun
68.translation: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair

68.arabic: لَولا أَن تَدٰرَكَهُ نِعمَةٌ مِن رَبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالعَراءِ وَهُوَ مَذمومٌ
68.transliteration: Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatun min rabbihi lanubitha bialAAarai wahuwa mathmoomun
68.translation: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate
But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous

68.arabic: وَإِن يَكادُ الَّذينَ كَفَروا لَيُزلِقونَكَ بِأَبصٰرِهِم لَمّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكرَ وَيَقولونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجنونٌ
68.transliteration: Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma samiAAoo alththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoonun
68.translation: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad
When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation

69.translation: The Reality
What is the Reality
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is
(The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come
As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning

69.arabic: وَأَمّا عادٌ فَأُهلِكوا بِريحٍ صَرصَرٍ عاتِيَةٍ
69.transliteration: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin
69.translation: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind

69.arabic: سَخَّرَها عَلَيهِم سَبعَ لَيالٍ وَثَمٰنِيَةَ أَيّامٍ حُسومًا فَتَرَى القَومَ فيها صَرعىٰ كَأَنَّهُم أَعجازُ نَخلٍ خاوِيَةٍ
69.transliteration: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun
69.translation: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees
Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them

69.arabic: وَجاءَ فِرعَونُ وَمَن قَبلَهُ وَالمُؤتَفِكٰتُ بِالخاطِئَةِ
69.transliteration: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati
69.translation: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error

69.arabic: فَعَصَوا رَسولَ رَبِّهِم فَأَخَذَهُم أَخذَةً رابِيَةً
69.transliteration: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan
69.translation: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip

69.arabic: إِنّا لَمّا طَغَا الماءُ حَمَلنٰكُم فِى الجارِيَةِ
69.transliteration: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati
69.translation: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

69.arabic: لِنَجعَلَها لَكُم تَذكِرَةً وَتَعِيَها أُذُنٌ وٰعِيَةٌ
69.transliteration: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun
69.translation: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember

69.arabic: فَإِذا نُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ نَفخَةٌ وٰحِدَةٌ
69.transliteration: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun
69.translation: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

69.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ الأَرضُ وَالجِبالُ فَدُكَّتا دَكَّةً وٰحِدَةً
69.transliteration: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan
69.translation: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash
Then, on that day will the Event befall
And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail

69.arabic: وَالمَلَكُ عَلىٰ أَرجائِها وَيَحمِلُ عَرشَ رَبِّكَ فَوقَهُم يَومَئِذٍ ثَمٰنِيَةٌ
69.transliteration: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun
69.translation: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them

69.arabic: يَومَئِذٍ تُعرَضونَ لا تَخفىٰ مِنكُم خافِيَةٌ
69.transliteration: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun
69.translation: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden

69.arabic: فَأَمّا مَن أوتِىَ كِتٰبَهُ بِيَمينِهِ فَيَقولُ هاؤُمُ اقرَءوا كِتٰبِيَه
69.transliteration: Faamma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah
69.translation: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book
Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning
Then he will be in blissful state
In a high garden
Whereof the clusters are in easy reach

69.arabic: كُلوا وَاشرَبوا هَنيـًٔا بِما أَسلَفتُم فِى الأَيّامِ الخالِيَةِ
69.transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati
69.translation: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days

69.arabic: وَأَمّا مَن أوتِىَ كِتٰبَهُ بِشِمالِهِ فَيَقولُ يٰلَيتَنى لَم أوتَ كِتٰبِيَه
69.transliteration: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu bishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah
69.translation: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
And knew not what my reckoning
Oh, would that it had been death
My wealth hath not availed me
My power hath gone from me
(It will be said): Take him and fetter him
And then expose him to hell-fire

69.arabic: ثُمَّ فى سِلسِلَةٍ ذَرعُها سَبعونَ ذِراعًا فَاسلُكوهُ
69.transliteration: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu
69.translation: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits

69.arabic: إِنَّهُ كانَ لا يُؤمِنُ بِاللَّهِ العَظيمِ
69.transliteration: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi
69.translation: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous
And urged not on the feeding of the wretched
Therefor hath he no lover here this day
Nor any food save filth
Which none but sinners eat
But nay! I swear by all that ye see
And all that ye see not
That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger

69.arabic: وَما هُوَ بِقَولِ شاعِرٍ قَليلًا ما تُؤمِنونَ
69.transliteration: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona
69.translation: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe

69.arabic: وَلا بِقَولِ كاهِنٍ قَليلًا ما تَذَكَّرونَ
69.transliteration: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona
69.translation: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember
It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds
And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us
We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
And then severed his life-artery

69.arabic: فَما مِنكُم مِن أَحَدٍ عَنهُ حٰجِزينَ
69.transliteration: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena
69.translation: And not one of you could have held Us off from him
And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil)
And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it)
And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers
And lo! it is absolute truth
So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord

70.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ سَأَلَ سائِلٌ بِعَذابٍ واقِعٍ
70.translation: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall
Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel
From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways

70.arabic: تَعرُجُ المَلٰئِكَةُ وَالرّوحُ إِلَيهِ فى يَومٍ كانَ مِقدارُهُ خَمسينَ أَلفَ سَنَةٍ
70.transliteration: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin
70.translation: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years
But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see
Lo! they behold it afar off
While we behold it nigh
The day when the sky will become as molten copper
And the hills become as flakes of wool
And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend

70.arabic: يُبَصَّرونَهُم يَوَدُّ المُجرِمُ لَو يَفتَدى مِن عَذابِ يَومِئِذٍ بِبَنيهِ
70.transliteration: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi
70.translation: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
And his spouse and his brother
And his kin that harboured him

70.arabic: وَمَن فِى الأَرضِ جَميعًا ثُمَّ يُنجيهِ
70.transliteration: Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi
70.translation: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him
But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
Eager to roast
It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth)
And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it
Lo! man was created anxious
Fretful when evil befalleth him
And, when good befalleth him, grudging
Save worshippers
Who are constant at their worship
And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
For the beggar and the destitute
And those who believe in the Day of Judgment

70.arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم مِن عَذابِ رَبِّهِم مُشفِقونَ
70.transliteration: Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona
70.translation: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom
Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure
And those who preserve their chastity

70.arabic: إِلّا عَلىٰ أَزوٰجِهِم أَو ما مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُهُم فَإِنَّهُم غَيرُ مَلومينَ
70.transliteration: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena
70.translation: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy

70.arabic: فَمَنِ ابتَغىٰ وَراءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ العادونَ
70.transliteration: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona
70.translation: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors
And those who keep their pledges and their covenant
And those who stand by their testimony
And those who are attentive at their worship
These will dwell in Gardens, honoured
What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed
On the right and on the left, in groups

70.arabic: أَيَطمَعُ كُلُّ امرِئٍ مِنهُم أَن يُدخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعيمٍ
70.transliteration: AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin
70.translation: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight
Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know

70.arabic: فَلا أُقسِمُ بِرَبِّ المَشٰرِقِ وَالمَغٰرِبِ إِنّا لَقٰدِرونَ
70.transliteration: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona
70.translation: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able

70.arabic: عَلىٰ أَن نُبَدِّلَ خَيرًا مِنهُم وَما نَحنُ بِمَسبوقينَ
70.transliteration: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena
70.translation: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun

70.arabic: فَذَرهُم يَخوضوا وَيَلعَبوا حَتّىٰ يُلٰقوا يَومَهُمُ الَّذى يوعَدونَ
70.transliteration: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona
70.translation: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised

70.arabic: يَومَ يَخرُجونَ مِنَ الأَجداثِ سِراعًا كَأَنَّهُم إِلىٰ نُصُبٍ يوفِضونَ
70.transliteration: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona
70.translation: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal

70.arabic: خٰشِعَةً أَبصٰرُهُم تَرهَقُهُم ذِلَّةٌ ذٰلِكَ اليَومُ الَّذى كانوا يوعَدونَ
70.transliteration: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona
70.translation: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised

71.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِنّا أَرسَلنا نوحًا إِلىٰ قَومِهِ أَن أَنذِر قَومَكَ مِن قَبلِ أَن يَأتِيَهُم عَذابٌ أَليمٌ
71.transliteration: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun
71.translation: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them

71.arabic: قالَ يٰقَومِ إِنّى لَكُم نَذيرٌ مُبينٌ
71.transliteration: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun
71.translation: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you

71.arabic: أَنِ اعبُدُوا اللَّهَ وَاتَّقوهُ وَأَطيعونِ
71.transliteration: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni
71.translation: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me

71.arabic: يَغفِر لَكُم مِن ذُنوبِكُم وَيُؤَخِّركُم إِلىٰ أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ اللَّهِ إِذا جاءَ لا يُؤَخَّرُ لَو كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
71.transliteration: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona
71.translation: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew

71.arabic: قالَ رَبِّ إِنّى دَعَوتُ قَومى لَيلًا وَنَهارًا
71.transliteration: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan
71.translation: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day

71.arabic: فَلَم يَزِدهُم دُعاءى إِلّا فِرارًا
71.transliteration: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran
71.translation: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance

71.arabic: وَإِنّى كُلَّما دَعَوتُهُم لِتَغفِرَ لَهُم جَعَلوا أَصٰبِعَهُم فى ءاذانِهِم وَاستَغشَوا ثِيابَهُم وَأَصَرّوا وَاستَكبَرُوا استِكبارًا
71.transliteration: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran
71.translation: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride

71.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنّى دَعَوتُهُم جِهارًا
71.transliteration: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan
71.translation: And lo! I have called unto them aloud

71.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنّى أَعلَنتُ لَهُم وَأَسرَرتُ لَهُم إِسرارًا
71.transliteration: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran
71.translation: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private

71.arabic: فَقُلتُ استَغفِروا رَبَّكُم إِنَّهُ كانَ غَفّارًا
71.transliteration: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran
71.translation: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving

71.arabic: يُرسِلِ السَّماءَ عَلَيكُم مِدرارًا
71.transliteration: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran
71.translation: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain

71.arabic: وَيُمدِدكُم بِأَموٰلٍ وَبَنينَ وَيَجعَل لَكُم جَنّٰتٍ وَيَجعَل لَكُم أَنهٰرًا
71.transliteration: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan
71.translation: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers

71.arabic: ما لَكُم لا تَرجونَ لِلَّهِ وَقارًا
71.transliteration: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran
71.translation: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

71.arabic: وَقَد خَلَقَكُم أَطوارًا
71.transliteration: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran
71.translation: When He created you by (divers) stages

71.arabic: أَلَم تَرَوا كَيفَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ سَبعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِباقًا
71.transliteration: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan
71.translation: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony

71.arabic: وَجَعَلَ القَمَرَ فيهِنَّ نورًا وَجَعَلَ الشَّمسَ سِراجًا
71.transliteration: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan
71.translation: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp

71.arabic: وَاللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُم مِنَ الأَرضِ نَباتًا
71.transliteration: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan
71.translation: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth

71.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعيدُكُم فيها وَيُخرِجُكُم إِخراجًا
71.transliteration: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan
71.translation: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing

71.arabic: وَاللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الأَرضَ بِساطًا
71.transliteration: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan
71.translation: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

71.arabic: لِتَسلُكوا مِنها سُبُلًا فِجاجًا
71.transliteration: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan
71.translation: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof

71.arabic: قالَ نوحٌ رَبِّ إِنَّهُم عَصَونى وَاتَّبَعوا مَن لَم يَزِدهُ مالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلّا خَسارًا
71.transliteration: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran
71.translation: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin

71.arabic: وَمَكَروا مَكرًا كُبّارًا
71.transliteration: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran
71.translation: And they have plotted a mighty plot

71.arabic: وَقالوا لا تَذَرُنَّ ءالِهَتَكُم وَلا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلا سُواعًا وَلا يَغوثَ وَيَعوقَ وَنَسرًا
71.transliteration: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran
71.translation: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

71.arabic: وَقَد أَضَلّوا كَثيرًا وَلا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمينَ إِلّا ضَلٰلًا
71.transliteration: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan
71.translation: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error

71.arabic: مِمّا خَطيـٰٔتِهِم أُغرِقوا فَأُدخِلوا نارًا فَلَم يَجِدوا لَهُم مِن دونِ اللَّهِ أَنصارًا
71.transliteration: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran
71.translation: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah

71.arabic: وَقالَ نوحٌ رَبِّ لا تَذَر عَلَى الأَرضِ مِنَ الكٰفِرينَ دَيّارًا
71.transliteration: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran
71.translation: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land

71.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرهُم يُضِلّوا عِبادَكَ وَلا يَلِدوا إِلّا فاجِرًا كَفّارًا
71.transliteration: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran
71.translation: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates

71.arabic: رَبِّ اغفِر لى وَلِوٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيتِىَ مُؤمِنًا وَلِلمُؤمِنينَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتِ وَلا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمينَ إِلّا تَبارًا
71.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran
71.translation: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin

72.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قُل أوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ استَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الجِنِّ فَقالوا إِنّا سَمِعنا قُرءانًا عَجَبًا
72.transliteration: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban
72.translation: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an

72.arabic: يَهدى إِلَى الرُّشدِ فَـٔامَنّا بِهِ وَلَن نُشرِكَ بِرَبِّنا أَحَدًا
72.transliteration: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan
72.translation: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord

72.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ تَعٰلىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنا مَا اتَّخَذَ صٰحِبَةً وَلا وَلَدًا
72.transliteration: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan
72.translation: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son

72.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كانَ يَقولُ سَفيهُنا عَلَى اللَّهِ شَطَطًا
