72.transliteration: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan
72.translation: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie

72.arabic: وَأَنّا ظَنَنّا أَن لَن تَقولَ الإِنسُ وَالجِنُّ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا
72.transliteration: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban
72.translation: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah

72.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كانَ رِجالٌ مِنَ الإِنسِ يَعوذونَ بِرِجالٍ مِنَ الجِنِّ فَزادوهُم رَهَقًا
72.transliteration: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan
72.translation: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah

72.arabic: وَأَنَّهُم ظَنّوا كَما ظَنَنتُم أَن لَن يَبعَثَ اللَّهُ أَحَدًا
72.transliteration: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan
72.translation: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead)

72.arabic: وَأَنّا لَمَسنَا السَّماءَ فَوَجَدنٰها مُلِئَت حَرَسًا شَديدًا وَشُهُبًا
72.transliteration: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban
72.translation: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors

72.arabic: وَأَنّا كُنّا نَقعُدُ مِنها مَقٰعِدَ لِلسَّمعِ فَمَن يَستَمِعِ الءانَ يَجِد لَهُ شِهابًا رَصَدًا
72.transliteration: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan
72.translation: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him

72.arabic: وَأَنّا لا نَدرى أَشَرٌّ أُريدَ بِمَن فِى الأَرضِ أَم أَرادَ بِهِم رَبُّهُم رَشَدًا
72.transliteration: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan
72.translation: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them

72.arabic: وَأَنّا مِنَّا الصّٰلِحونَ وَمِنّا دونَ ذٰلِكَ كُنّا طَرائِقَ قِدَدًا
72.transliteration: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan
72.translation: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules

72.arabic: وَأَنّا ظَنَنّا أَن لَن نُعجِزَ اللَّهَ فِى الأَرضِ وَلَن نُعجِزَهُ هَرَبًا
72.transliteration: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban
72.translation: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight

72.arabic: وَأَنّا لَمّا سَمِعنَا الهُدىٰ ءامَنّا بِهِ فَمَن يُؤمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلا يَخافُ بَخسًا وَلا رَهَقًا
72.transliteration: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan
72.translation: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression

72.arabic: وَأَنّا مِنَّا المُسلِمونَ وَمِنَّا القٰسِطونَ فَمَن أَسلَمَ فَأُولٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوا رَشَدًا
72.transliteration: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan
72.translation: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully

72.arabic: وَأَمَّا القٰسِطونَ فَكانوا لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
72.transliteration: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban
72.translation: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell

72.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ استَقٰموا عَلَى الطَّريقَةِ لَأَسقَينٰهُم ماءً غَدَقًا
72.transliteration: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan
72.translation: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance

72.arabic: لِنَفتِنَهُم فيهِ وَمَن يُعرِض عَن ذِكرِ رَبِّهِ يَسلُكهُ عَذابًا صَعَدًا
72.transliteration: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan
72.translation: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment

72.arabic: وَأَنَّ المَسٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلا تَدعوا مَعَ اللَّهِ أَحَدًا
72.transliteration: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan
72.translation: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah

72.arabic: وَأَنَّهُ لَمّا قامَ عَبدُ اللَّهِ يَدعوهُ كادوا يَكونونَ عَلَيهِ لِبَدًا
72.transliteration: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan
72.translation: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling

72.arabic: قُل إِنَّما أَدعوا رَبّى وَلا أُشرِكُ بِهِ أَحَدًا
72.transliteration: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan
72.translation: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner

72.arabic: قُل إِنّى لا أَملِكُ لَكُم ضَرًّا وَلا رَشَدًا
72.transliteration: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan
72.translation: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you

72.arabic: قُل إِنّى لَن يُجيرَنى مِنَ اللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَن أَجِدَ مِن دونِهِ مُلتَحَدًا
72.transliteration: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan
72.translation: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him

72.arabic: إِلّا بَلٰغًا مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرِسٰلٰتِهِ وَمَن يَعصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نارَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدينَ فيها أَبَدًا
72.transliteration: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan
72.translation: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever

72.arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا رَأَوا ما يوعَدونَ فَسَيَعلَمونَ مَن أَضعَفُ ناصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
72.transliteration: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan
72.translation: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude

72.arabic: قُل إِن أَدرى أَقَريبٌ ما توعَدونَ أَم يَجعَلُ لَهُ رَبّى أَمَدًا
72.transliteration: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan
72.translation: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it

72.arabic: عٰلِمُ الغَيبِ فَلا يُظهِرُ عَلىٰ غَيبِهِ أَحَدًا
72.transliteration: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan
72.translation: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret

72.arabic: إِلّا مَنِ ارتَضىٰ مِن رَسولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسلُكُ مِن بَينِ يَدَيهِ وَمِن خَلفِهِ رَصَدًا
72.transliteration: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan
72.translation: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him

72.arabic: لِيَعلَمَ أَن قَد أَبلَغوا رِسٰلٰتِ رَبِّهِم وَأَحاطَ بِما لَدَيهِم وَأَحصىٰ كُلَّ شَيءٍ عَدَدًا
72.transliteration: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan
72.translation: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things

73.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يٰأَيُّهَا المُزَّمِّلُ
73.transliteration: Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu
73.translation: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment

73.arabic: قُمِ الَّيلَ إِلّا قَليلًا
73.transliteration: Qumi allayla illa qaleelan
73.translation: Keep vigil the night long, save a little

73.arabic: نِصفَهُ أَوِ انقُص مِنهُ قَليلًا
73.transliteration: Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan
73.translation: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof

73.arabic: أَو زِد عَلَيهِ وَرَتِّلِ القُرءانَ تَرتيلًا
73.transliteration: Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan
73.translation: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure

73.arabic: إِنّا سَنُلقى عَلَيكَ قَولًا ثَقيلًا
73.transliteration: Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan
73.translation: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight

73.arabic: إِنَّ ناشِئَةَ الَّيلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطـًٔا وَأَقوَمُ قيلًا
73.transliteration: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan
73.translation: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain

73.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى النَّهارِ سَبحًا طَويلًا
73.transliteration: Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan
73.translation: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business

73.arabic: وَاذكُرِ اسمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّل إِلَيهِ تَبتيلًا
73.transliteration: Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan
73.translation: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion

73.arabic: رَبُّ المَشرِقِ وَالمَغرِبِ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذهُ وَكيلًا
73.transliteration: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan
73.translation: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender

73.arabic: وَاصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَاهجُرهُم هَجرًا جَميلًا
73.transliteration: Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan
73.translation: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking

73.arabic: وَذَرنى وَالمُكَذِّبينَ أُولِى النَّعمَةِ وَمَهِّلهُم قَليلًا
73.transliteration: Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan
73.translation: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile

73.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَينا أَنكالًا وَجَحيمًا
73.transliteration: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman
73.translation: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire

73.arabic: وَطَعامًا ذا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذابًا أَليمًا
73.transliteration: WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman
73.translation: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom

73.arabic: يَومَ تَرجُفُ الأَرضُ وَالجِبالُ وَكانَتِ الجِبالُ كَثيبًا مَهيلًا
73.transliteration: Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan
73.translation: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand

73.arabic: إِنّا أَرسَلنا إِلَيكُم رَسولًا شٰهِدًا عَلَيكُم كَما أَرسَلنا إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ رَسولًا
73.transliteration: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan
73.translation: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger

73.arabic: فَعَصىٰ فِرعَونُ الرَّسولَ فَأَخَذنٰهُ أَخذًا وَبيلًا
73.transliteration: FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan
73.translation: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip

73.arabic: فَكَيفَ تَتَّقونَ إِن كَفَرتُم يَومًا يَجعَلُ الوِلدٰنَ شيبًا
73.transliteration: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban
73.translation: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey

73.arabic: السَّماءُ مُنفَطِرٌ بِهِ كانَ وَعدُهُ مَفعولًا
73.transliteration: Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan
73.translation: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled

73.arabic: إِنَّ هٰذِهِ تَذكِرَةٌ فَمَن شاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبيلًا
73.transliteration: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan
73.translation: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord

73.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقومُ أَدنىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ الَّيلِ وَنِصفَهُ وَثُلُثَهُ وَطائِفَةٌ مِنَ الَّذينَ مَعَكَ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ الَّيلَ وَالنَّهارَ عَلِمَ أَن لَن تُحصوهُ فَتابَ عَلَيكُم فَاقرَءوا ما تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ القُرءانِ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكونُ مِنكُم مَرضىٰ وَءاخَرونَ يَضرِبونَ فِى الأَرضِ يَبتَغونَ مِن فَضلِ اللَّهِ وَءاخَرونَ يُقٰتِلونَ فى سَبيلِ اللَّهِ فَاقرَءوا ما تَيَسَّرَ مِنهُ وَأَقيمُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَءاتُوا الزَّكوٰةَ وَأَقرِضُوا اللَّهَ قَرضًا حَسَنًا وَما تُقَدِّموا لِأَنفُسِكُم مِن خَيرٍ تَجِدوهُ عِندَ اللَّهِ هُوَ خَيرًا وَأَعظَمَ أَجرًا وَاستَغفِرُوا اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ
73.transliteration: Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun
73.translation: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

74.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ يٰأَيُّهَا المُدَّثِّرُ
74.translation: O thou enveloped in thy cloak
Arise and warn
Thy Lord magnify
Thy raiment purify
Pollution shun
And show not favour, seeking wordly gain
For the sake of thy Lord, be patient
For when the trumpet shall sound
Surely that day will be a day of anguish
Not of ease, for disbelievers
Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely
And then bestowed upon him ample means
And sons abiding in his presence
And made (life) smooth for him
Yet he desireth that I should give more
Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations
On him I shall impose a fearful doom
For lo! he did consider; then he planned
(Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned
Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned
Then looked he
Then frowned he and showed displeasure
Then turned he away in pride

74.arabic: فَقالَ إِن هٰذا إِلّا سِحرٌ يُؤثَرُ
74.transliteration: Faqala in hatha illa sihrun yutharu
74.translation: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old
This is naught else than speech of mortal man
Him shall I fling unto the burning
Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is
It leaveth naught; it spareth naught
It shrivelleth the man
Above it are nineteen

74.arabic: وَما جَعَلنا أَصحٰبَ النّارِ إِلّا مَلٰئِكَةً وَما جَعَلنا عِدَّتَهُم إِلّا فِتنَةً لِلَّذينَ كَفَروا لِيَستَيقِنَ الَّذينَ أوتُوا الكِتٰبَ وَيَزدادَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا إيمٰنًا وَلا يَرتابَ الَّذينَ أوتُوا الكِتٰبَ وَالمُؤمِنونَ وَلِيَقولَ الَّذينَ فى قُلوبِهِم مَرَضٌ وَالكٰفِرونَ ماذا أَرادَ اللَّهُ بِهٰذا مَثَلًا كَذٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اللَّهُ مَن يَشاءُ وَيَهدى مَن يَشاءُ وَما يَعلَمُ جُنودَ رَبِّكَ إِلّا هُوَ وَما هِىَ إِلّا ذِكرىٰ لِلبَشَرِ
74.transliteration: Wama jaAAalna ashaba alnnari illa malaikatan wama jaAAalna AAiddatahum illa fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo liyastayqina allatheena ootoo alkitaba wayazdada allatheena amanoo eemanan wala yartaba allatheena ootoo alkitaba waalmuminoona waliyaqoola allatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalkafiroona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan kathalika yudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wama yaAAlamu junooda rabbika illa huwa wama hiya illa thikra lilbashari
74.translation: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals
Nay, by the Moon
And the night when it withdraweth
And the dawn when it shineth forth
Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)
As a warning unto men

74.arabic: لِمَن شاءَ مِنكُم أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَو يَتَأَخَّرَ
74.transliteration: Liman shaa minkum an yataqaddama aw yataakhkhara
74.translation: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back
Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds
Save those who will stand on the right hand
In gardens they will ask one another
Concerning the guilty
What hath brought you to this burning
They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
Nor did we feed the wretched
We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders
And we used to deny the Day of Judgment
Till the Inevitable came unto us
The mediation of no mediators will avail them then
Why now turn they away from the Admonishment
As they were frightened asses
Fleeing from a lion

74.arabic: بَل يُريدُ كُلُّ امرِئٍ مِنهُم أَن يُؤتىٰ صُحُفًا مُنَشَّرَةً
74.transliteration: Bal yureedu kullu imriin minhum an yuta suhufan munashsharatan
74.translation: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah)
Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter
Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment
So whosoever will may heed

74.arabic: وَما يَذكُرونَ إِلّا أَن يَشاءَ اللَّهُ هُوَ أَهلُ التَّقوىٰ وَأَهلُ المَغفِرَةِ
74.transliteration: Wama yathkuroona illa an yashaa Allahu huwa ahlu alttaqwa waahlu almaghfirati
74.translation: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy

75.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ لا أُقسِمُ بِيَومِ القِيٰمَةِ
75.translation: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection
Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true)
Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones

75.arabic: بَلىٰ قٰدِرينَ عَلىٰ أَن نُسَوِّىَ بَنانَهُ
75.transliteration: Bala qadireena AAala an nusawwiya bananahu
75.translation: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers
But man would fain deny what is before him
He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection
But when sight is confounded
And the moon is eclipsed
And sun and moon are united
On that day man will cry: Whither to flee
Alas! No refuge
Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day

75.arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ الإِنسٰنُ يَومَئِذٍ بِما قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
75.transliteration: Yunabbao alinsanu yawmaithin bima qaddama waakhkhara
75.translation: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind
Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself
Although he tender his excuses

75.arabic: لا تُحَرِّك بِهِ لِسانَكَ لِتَعجَلَ بِهِ
75.transliteration: La tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaAAjala bihi
75.translation: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it
Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof
And when We read it, follow thou the reading
Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof
Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
And neglect the Hereafter
That day will faces be resplendent
Looking toward their Lord
And that day will other faces be despondent
Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them
Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)
And he knoweth that it is the parting
And agony is heaped on agony
Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving
For he neither trusted, nor prayed
But he denied and flouted
Then went he to his folk with glee
Nearer unto thee and nearer
Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom)
Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless

75.arabic: أَلَم يَكُ نُطفَةً مِن مَنِىٍّ يُمنىٰ
75.transliteration: Alam yaku nutfatan min manayyin yumna
75.translation: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth
Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
And made of him a pair, the male and female

75.arabic: أَلَيسَ ذٰلِكَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلىٰ أَن يُحۦِىَ المَوتىٰ
75.transliteration: Alaysa thalika biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta
75.translation: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life

76.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ هَل أَتىٰ عَلَى الإِنسٰنِ حينٌ مِنَ الدَّهرِ لَم يَكُن شَيـًٔا مَذكورًا
76.transliteration: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran
76.translation: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered

76.arabic: إِنّا خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ مِن نُطفَةٍ أَمشاجٍ نَبتَليهِ فَجَعَلنٰهُ سَميعًا بَصيرًا
76.transliteration: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran
76.translation: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing

76.arabic: إِنّا هَدَينٰهُ السَّبيلَ إِمّا شاكِرًا وَإِمّا كَفورًا
76.transliteration: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran
76.translation: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving

76.arabic: إِنّا أَعتَدنا لِلكٰفِرينَ سَلٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغلٰلًا وَسَعيرًا
76.transliteration: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran
76.translation: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire

76.arabic: إِنَّ الأَبرارَ يَشرَبونَ مِن كَأسٍ كانَ مِزاجُها كافورًا
76.transliteration: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran
76.translation: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur

76.arabic: عَينًا يَشرَبُ بِها عِبادُ اللَّهِ يُفَجِّرونَها تَفجيرًا
76.transliteration: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran
76.translation: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly

76.arabic: يوفونَ بِالنَّذرِ وَيَخافونَ يَومًا كانَ شَرُّهُ مُستَطيرًا
76.transliteration: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran
76.translation: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading

76.arabic: وَيُطعِمونَ الطَّعامَ عَلىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسكينًا وَيَتيمًا وَأَسيرًا
76.transliteration: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran
76.translation: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him

76.arabic: إِنَّما نُطعِمُكُم لِوَجهِ اللَّهِ لا نُريدُ مِنكُم جَزاءً وَلا شُكورًا
76.transliteration: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran
76.translation: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you

76.arabic: إِنّا نَخافُ مِن رَبِّنا يَومًا عَبوسًا قَمطَريرًا
76.transliteration: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran
76.translation: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate

76.arabic: فَوَقىٰهُمُ اللَّهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ اليَومِ وَلَقّىٰهُم نَضرَةً وَسُرورًا
76.transliteration: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran
76.translation: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy

76.arabic: وَجَزىٰهُم بِما صَبَروا جَنَّةً وَحَريرًا
76.transliteration: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran
76.translation: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire

76.arabic: مُتَّكِـٔينَ فيها عَلَى الأَرائِكِ لا يَرَونَ فيها شَمسًا وَلا زَمهَريرًا
76.transliteration: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran
76.translation: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold

76.arabic: وَدانِيَةً عَلَيهِم ظِلٰلُها وَذُلِّلَت قُطوفُها تَذليلًا
76.transliteration: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan
76.translation: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down

76.arabic: وَيُطافُ عَلَيهِم بِـٔانِيَةٍ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكوابٍ كانَت قَواريرا۠
76.transliteration: Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera
76.translation: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

76.arabic: قَواريرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّروها تَقديرًا
76.transliteration: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran
76.translation: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds)

76.arabic: وَيُسقَونَ فيها كَأسًا كانَ مِزاجُها زَنجَبيلًا
76.transliteration: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan
76.translation: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil

76.arabic: عَينًا فيها تُسَمّىٰ سَلسَبيلًا
76.transliteration: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan
76.translation: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil

76.arabic: وَيَطوفُ عَلَيهِم وِلدٰنٌ مُخَلَّدونَ إِذا رَأَيتَهُم حَسِبتَهُم لُؤلُؤًا مَنثورًا
76.transliteration: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran
76.translation: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls

76.arabic: وَإِذا رَأَيتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيتَ نَعيمًا وَمُلكًا كَبيرًا
76.transliteration: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran
76.translation: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate

76.arabic: عٰلِيَهُم ثِيابُ سُندُسٍ خُضرٌ وَإِستَبرَقٌ وَحُلّوا أَساوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقىٰهُم رَبُّهُم شَرابًا طَهورًا
76.transliteration: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran
76.translation: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink

76.arabic: إِنَّ هٰذا كانَ لَكُم جَزاءً وَكانَ سَعيُكُم مَشكورًا
76.transliteration: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran
76.translation: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance

76.arabic: إِنّا نَحنُ نَزَّلنا عَلَيكَ القُرءانَ تَنزيلًا
76.transliteration: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan
76.translation: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation

76.arabic: فَاصبِر لِحُكمِ رَبِّكَ وَلا تُطِع مِنهُم ءاثِمًا أَو كَفورًا
76.transliteration: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran
76.translation: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever

76.arabic: وَاذكُرِ اسمَ رَبِّكَ بُكرَةً وَأَصيلًا
76.transliteration: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan
76.translation: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening

76.arabic: وَمِنَ الَّيلِ فَاسجُد لَهُ وَسَبِّحهُ لَيلًا طَويلًا
76.transliteration: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan
76.translation: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night

76.arabic: إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ يُحِبّونَ العاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرونَ وَراءَهُم يَومًا ثَقيلًا
76.transliteration: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan
76.translation: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day

76.arabic: نَحنُ خَلَقنٰهُم وَشَدَدنا أَسرَهُم وَإِذا شِئنا بَدَّلنا أَمثٰلَهُم تَبديلًا
76.transliteration: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan
76.translation: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead

76.arabic: إِنَّ هٰذِهِ تَذكِرَةٌ فَمَن شاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبيلًا
76.transliteration: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan
76.translation: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord

76.arabic: وَما تَشاءونَ إِلّا أَن يَشاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كانَ عَليمًا حَكيمًا
76.transliteration: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman
76.translation: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise

76.arabic: يُدخِلُ مَن يَشاءُ فى رَحمَتِهِ وَالظّٰلِمينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُم عَذابًا أَليمًا
76.transliteration: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman
76.translation: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom

77.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالمُرسَلٰتِ عُرفًا
77.translation: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
By the raging hurricanes
By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive
By those who winnow with a winnowing
By those who bring down the Reminder
To excuse or to warn
Surely that which ye are promised will befall
So when the stars are put out
And when the sky is riven asunder
And when the mountains are blown away
And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed
For what day is the time appointed
For the Day of Decision
And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
Destroyed We not the former folk
Then caused the latter folk to follow after
Thus deal We ever with the guilty
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
Did We not create you from a base fluid
Which We laid up in a safe abode
For a known term
Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
Have We not made the earth a receptacle
Both for the living and the dead

77.arabic: وَجَعَلنا فيها رَوٰسِىَ شٰمِخٰتٍ وَأَسقَينٰكُم ماءً فُراتًا
77.transliteration: WajaAAalna feeha rawasiya shamikhatin waasqaynakum maan furatan
77.translation: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein
Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77.arabic: انطَلِقوا إِلىٰ ما كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبونَ
77.transliteration: Intaliqoo ila ma kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
77.translation: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny

77.arabic: انطَلِقوا إِلىٰ ظِلٍّ ذى ثَلٰثِ شُعَبٍ
77.transliteration: Intaliqoo ila thillin thee thalathi shuAAabin
77.translation: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold

77.arabic: لا ظَليلٍ وَلا يُغنى مِنَ اللَّهَبِ
77.transliteration: La thaleelin wala yughnee mina allahabi
77.translation: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame
Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles
(Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
This is a day wherein they speak not
Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together
If now ye have any wit, outwit Me
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains
And fruits such as they desire

77.arabic: كُلوا وَاشرَبوا هَنيـًٔا بِما كُنتُم تَعمَلونَ
77.transliteration: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona
77.translation: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did
Thus do We reward the good
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty
Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77.arabic: وَإِذا قيلَ لَهُمُ اركَعوا لا يَركَعونَ
77.transliteration: Waitha qeela lahumu irkaAAoo la yarkaAAoona
77.translation: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
In what statement, after this, will they believe

78.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ عَمَّ يَتَساءَلونَ
78.translation: Whereof do they question one another
(It is) of the awful tidings
Concerning which they are in disagreement
Nay, but they will come to know
Nay, again, but they will come to know
Have We not made the earth an expanse
And the high hills bulwarks
And We have created you in pairs
And have appointed your sleep for repose
And have appointed the night as a cloak
And have appointed the day for livelihood
And We have built above you seven strong (heavens)
And have appointed a dazzling lamp
And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water
Thereby to produce grain and plant
And gardens of thick foliage
Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time

78.arabic: يَومَ يُنفَخُ فِى الصّورِ فَتَأتونَ أَفواجًا
78.transliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan
78.translation: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes
And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates
And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage
Lo! hell lurketh in ambush
A home for the rebellious
They will abide therein for ages

78.arabic: لا يَذوقونَ فيها بَردًا وَلا شَرابًا
78.transliteration: La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban
78.translation: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
Save boiling water and a paralysing cold
Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds)
For lo! they looked not for a reckoning
They called Our revelations false with strong denial
Everything have We recorded in a Book
So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment
Lo! for the duteous is achievement
Gardens enclosed and vineyards
And voluptuous women of equal age
And a full cup

78.arabic: لا يَسمَعونَ فيها لَغوًا وَلا كِذّٰبًا
78.transliteration: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban
78.translation: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying
Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment

78.arabic: رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُمَا الرَّحمٰنِ لا يَملِكونَ مِنهُ خِطابًا
78.transliteration: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban
78.translation: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse

78.arabic: يَومَ يَقومُ الرّوحُ وَالمَلٰئِكَةُ صَفًّا لا يَتَكَلَّمونَ إِلّا مَن أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحمٰنُ وَقالَ صَوابًا
78.transliteration: Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban
78.translation: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right

78.arabic: ذٰلِكَ اليَومُ الحَقُّ فَمَن شاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلىٰ رَبِّهِ مَـٔابًا
78.transliteration: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban
78.translation: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord

78.arabic: إِنّا أَنذَرنٰكُم عَذابًا قَريبًا يَومَ يَنظُرُ المَرءُ ما قَدَّمَت يَداهُ وَيَقولُ الكافِرُ يٰلَيتَنى كُنتُ تُرٰبًا
78.transliteration: Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban
78.translation: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust

79.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالنّٰزِعٰتِ غَرقًا
79.translation: By those who drag forth to destruction
By the meteors rushing
By the lone stars floating
By the angels hastening
And those who govern the event
On the day when the first trump resoundeth
And the second followeth it
On that day hearts beat painfully
While eyes are downcast
(Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
Even after we are crumbled bones
They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding
Surely it will need but one shout
And lo! they will be awakened
Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses

79.arabic: إِذ نادىٰهُ رَبُّهُ بِالوادِ المُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
79.transliteration: Ith nadahu rabbuhu bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan
79.translation: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa
(Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled

79.arabic: فَقُل هَل لَكَ إِلىٰ أَن تَزَكّىٰ
79.transliteration: Faqul hal laka ila an tazakka
79.translation: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)
Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him)
And he showed him the tremendous token
But he denied and disobeyed
Then turned he away in haste
Then gathered he and summoned
And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest
So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former

79.arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَعِبرَةً لِمَن يَخشىٰ
79.transliteration: Inna fee thalika laAAibratan liman yakhsha
79.translation: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth

79.arabic: ءَأَنتُم أَشَدُّ خَلقًا أَمِ السَّماءُ بَنىٰها
79.transliteration: Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami alssamao banaha
79.translation: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built
He raised the height thereof and ordered it
And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof
And after that He spread the earth
And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof
And He made fast the hills
A provision for you and for your cattle
But when the great disaster cometh
The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour
And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth
Then, as for him who rebelled
And chose the life of the world
Lo! hell will be his home

79.arabic: وَأَمّا مَن خافَ مَقامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى النَّفسَ عَنِ الهَوىٰ
79.transliteration: Waama man khafa maqama rabbihi wanaha alnnafsa AAani alhawa
79.translation: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust
Lo! the Garden will be his home
They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port
Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof
Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof
Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it

79.arabic: كَأَنَّهُم يَومَ يَرَونَها لَم يَلبَثوا إِلّا عَشِيَّةً أَو ضُحىٰها
79.transliteration: Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha
79.translation: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof

80.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلّىٰ
80.translation: He frowned and turned away
Because the blind man came unto him
What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him
As for him who thinketh himself independent
Unto him thou payest regard
Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace)
But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
And hath fear
From him thou art distracted
Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment
So let whosoever will pay heed to it
On honoured leaves
Exalted, purified
(Set down) by scribes
Noble and righteous
Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful
From what thing doth He create him
From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him
Then maketh the way easy for him
Then causeth him to die, and burieth him
Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life
Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him
Let man consider his food
How We pour water in showers
Then split the earth in clefts
And cause the grain to grow therein
And grapes and green fodder
And olive-trees and palm-trees
And garden-closes of thick foliage
And fruits and grasses
Provision for you and your cattle
But when the Shout cometh
On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
And his mother and his father
And his wife and his children

80.arabic: لِكُلِّ امرِئٍ مِنهُم يَومَئِذٍ شَأنٌ يُغنيهِ
80.transliteration: Likulli imriin minhum yawmaithin shanun yughneehi
80.translation: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others)
On that day faces will be bright as dawn
Laughing, rejoicing at good news
And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them
Veiled in darkness
Those are the disbelievers, the wicked

81.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذَا الشَّمسُ كُوِّرَت
81.translation: When the sun is overthrown
And when the stars fall
And when the hills are moved
And when the camels big with young are abandoned
And when the wild beasts are herded together
And when the seas rise
And when souls are reunited
And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
For what sin she was slain
And when the pages are laid open
And when the sky is torn away
And when hell is lighted
And when the Garden is brought nigh
(Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready
Oh, but I call to witness the planets
The stars which rise and set
And the close of night
And the breath of morning
That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger

81.arabic: ذى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى العَرشِ مَكينٍ
81.transliteration: Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin
81.translation: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne
(One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy
And your comrade is not mad
Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon
And he is not avid of the Unseen
Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned
Whither then go ye
This is naught else than a reminder unto creation
Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight

81.arabic: وَما تَشاءونَ إِلّا أَن يَشاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ العٰلَمينَ
81.transliteration: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameena
81.translation: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation

82.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذَا السَّماءُ انفَطَرَت
82.translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder
When the seas are poured forth
A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind

82.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الإِنسٰنُ ما غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ الكَريمِ
82.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi
82.translation: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful
Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee

82.arabic: فى أَىِّ صورَةٍ ما شاءَ رَكَّبَكَ
82.transliteration: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka
82.translation: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee
Nay, but ye deny the Judgment
Lo! there are above you guardians
Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight
And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell
They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment
And will not be absent thence
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

82.arabic: ثُمَّ ما أَدرىٰكَ ما يَومُ الدّينِ
82.transliteration: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni
82.translation: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

82.arabic: يَومَ لا تَملِكُ نَفسٌ لِنَفسٍ شَيـًٔا وَالأَمرُ يَومَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
82.transliteration: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi
82.translation: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's

83.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَيلٌ لِلمُطَفِّفينَ
83.translation: Woe unto the defrauders

83.arabic: الَّذينَ إِذَا اكتالوا عَلَى النّاسِ يَستَوفونَ
83.transliteration: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona
83.translation: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full
But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss
Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
Unto an Awful Day
The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds

83.arabic: كَلّا إِنَّ كِتٰبَ الفُجّارِ لَفى سِجّينٍ
83.transliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin
83.translation: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin
Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is
A written record
Woe unto the repudiators on that day
Those who deny the Day of Judgment

83.arabic: وَما يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلّا كُلُّ مُعتَدٍ أَثيمٍ
83.transliteration: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin
83.translation: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor

83.arabic: إِذا تُتلىٰ عَلَيهِ ءايٰتُنا قالَ أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ
83.transliteration: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena
83.translation: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old

83.arabic: كَلّا بَل رانَ عَلىٰ قُلوبِهِم ما كانوا يَكسِبونَ
83.transliteration: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona
83.translation: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts

83.arabic: كَلّا إِنَّهُم عَن رَبِّهِم يَومَئِذٍ لَمَحجوبونَ
83.transliteration: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona
83.translation: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord
Then lo! they verily will burn in hell

83.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقالُ هٰذَا الَّذى كُنتُم بِهِ تُكَذِّبونَ
83.transliteration: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona
83.translation: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny

83.arabic: كَلّا إِنَّ كِتٰبَ الأَبرارِ لَفى عِلِّيّينَ
83.transliteration: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena
83.translation: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin
Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is
A written record
Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)
Lo! the righteous verily are in delight
On couches, gazing
Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight
They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed

83.arabic: خِتٰمُهُ مِسكٌ وَفى ذٰلِكَ فَليَتَنافَسِ المُتَنٰفِسونَ
83.transliteration: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona
83.translation: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss
And mixed with water of Tasnim
A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink

83.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ أَجرَموا كانوا مِنَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا يَضحَكونَ
83.transliteration: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona
83.translation: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed
And wink one to another when they passed them

83.arabic: وَإِذَا انقَلَبوا إِلىٰ أَهلِهِمُ انقَلَبوا فَكِهينَ
83.transliteration: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena
83.translation: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting

83.arabic: وَإِذا رَأَوهُم قالوا إِنَّ هٰؤُلاءِ لَضالّونَ
83.transliteration: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona
83.translation: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray
Yet they were not sent as guardians over them

83.arabic: فَاليَومَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا مِنَ الكُفّارِ يَضحَكونَ
83.transliteration: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona
83.translation: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers
On high couches, gazing

83.arabic: هَل ثُوِّبَ الكُفّارُ ما كانوا يَفعَلونَ
83.transliteration: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona
83.translation: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do

84.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذَا السَّماءُ انشَقَّت
84.translation: When the heaven is split asunder
And attentive to her Lord in fear
And when the earth is spread out
And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
And attentive to her Lord in fear

84.arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الإِنسٰنُ إِنَّكَ كادِحٌ إِلىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدحًا فَمُلٰقيهِ
84.transliteration: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi
84.translation: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence)
Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
He truly will receive an easy reckoning
And will return unto his folk in joy

84.arabic: وَأَمّا مَن أوتِىَ كِتٰبَهُ وَراءَ ظَهرِهِ
84.transliteration: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi
84.translation: But whoso is given his account behind his back
He surely will invoke destruction
And be thrown to scorching fire
He verily lived joyous with his folk
He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah)

84.arabic: بَلىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كانَ بِهِ بَصيرًا
84.transliteration: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran
84.translation: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him
Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset
And by the night and all that it enshroudeth
And by the moon when she is at the full
That ye shall journey on from plane to plane
What aileth them, then, that they believe not

84.arabic: وَإِذا قُرِئَ عَلَيهِمُ القُرءانُ لا يَسجُدونَ
84.transliteration: Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona
84.translation: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)
Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny
And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding
So give them tidings of a painful doom

84.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُم أَجرٌ غَيرُ مَمنونٍ
84.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin
84.translation: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing

85.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالسَّماءِ ذاتِ البُروجِ
85.translation: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars
And by the Promised Day
And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony
(Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
Of the fuel-fed fire
When they sat by it

85.arabic: وَهُم عَلىٰ ما يَفعَلونَ بِالمُؤمِنينَ شُهودٌ
85.transliteration: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun
85.translation: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers

85.arabic: وَما نَقَموا مِنهُم إِلّا أَن يُؤمِنوا بِاللَّهِ العَزيزِ الحَميدِ
85.transliteration: Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi
85.translation: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise

85.arabic: الَّذى لَهُ مُلكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالأَرضِ وَاللَّهُ عَلىٰ كُلِّ شَيءٍ شَهيدٌ
85.transliteration: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun
85.translation: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness

85.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ فَتَنُوا المُؤمِنينَ وَالمُؤمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَم يَتوبوا فَلَهُم عَذابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُم عَذابُ الحَريقِ
85.transliteration: Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi
85.translation: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning

85.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُم جَنّٰتٌ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ ذٰلِكَ الفَوزُ الكَبيرُ
85.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru
85.translation: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success
Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern
Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth
And He is the Forgiving, the Loving
Lord of the Throne of Glory
Doer of what He will
Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud
Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them
Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an
On a guarded tablet

86.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالسَّماءِ وَالطّارِقِ
86.translation: By the heaven and the Morning Star
Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is

86.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفسٍ لَمّا عَلَيها حافِظٌ
86.transliteration: In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafithun
86.translation: No human soul but hath a guardian over it
So let man consider from what he is created
He is created from a gushing fluid
That issued from between the loins and ribs
Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out

86.arabic: فَما لَهُ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلا ناصِرٍ
86.transliteration: Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasirin
86.translation: Then will he have no might nor any helper
By the heaven which giveth the returning rain
And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word
Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
And I plot a plot (against them)
So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while

87.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ سَبِّحِ اسمَ رَبِّكَ الأَعلَى
87.translation: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High
Then turneth it to russet stubble
We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget

87.arabic: إِلّا ما شاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ يَعلَمُ الجَهرَ وَما يَخفىٰ
87.transliteration: Illa ma shaa Allahu innahu yaAAlamu aljahra wama yakhfa
87.translation: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden
And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease
Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder
But the most hapless will flout it
He who will be flung to the great Fire

87.arabic: ثُمَّ لا يَموتُ فيها وَلا يَحيىٰ
87.transliteration: Thumma la yamootu feeha wala yahya
87.translation: Wherein he will neither die nor live
And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth
But ye prefer the life of the world
Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting
Lo! This is in the former scrolls
The Books of Abraham and Moses

88.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ هَل أَتىٰكَ حَديثُ الغٰشِيَةِ
88.translation: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming
On that day (many) faces will be downcast
Toiling, weary
Scorched by burning fire
Drinking from a boiling spring

88.arabic: لَيسَ لَهُم طَعامٌ إِلّا مِن ضَريعٍ
88.transliteration: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin
88.translation: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit

88.arabic: لا يُسمِنُ وَلا يُغنى مِن جوعٍ
88.transliteration: La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin
88.translation: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger
In that day other faces will be calm
Glad for their effort past
In a high Garden
Where they hear no idle speech
Wherein is a gushing spring
Wherein are couches raised
And goblets set at hand
And cushions ranged
And silken carpets spread

88.arabic: أَفَلا يَنظُرونَ إِلَى الإِبِلِ كَيفَ خُلِقَت
88.transliteration: Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat
88.translation: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created
And the heaven, how it is raised
And the hills, how they are set up
And the earth, how it is spread
Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer
Thou art not at all a warder over them
But whoso is averse and disbelieveth
Allah will punish him with direst punishment
Lo! unto Us is their return
And Ours their reckoning

89.translation: By the Dawn
And ten nights
And the Even and the Odd
And the night when it departeth

89.arabic: هَل فى ذٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِذى حِجرٍ
89.transliteration: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin
89.translation: There surely is an oath for thinking man

89.arabic: أَلَم تَرَ كَيفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعادٍ
89.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin
89.translation: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad
With many-columned Iram

89.arabic: الَّتى لَم يُخلَق مِثلُها فِى البِلٰدِ
89.transliteration: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi
89.translation: The like of which was not created in the lands
And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley
And with Pharaoh, firm of might
Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands
And multiplied iniquity therein
Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment
Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful

89.arabic: فَأَمَّا الإِنسٰنُ إِذا مَا ابتَلىٰهُ رَبُّهُ فَأَكرَمَهُ وَنَعَّمَهُ فَيَقولُ رَبّى أَكرَمَنِ
89.transliteration: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani
89.translation: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me

89.arabic: وَأَمّا إِذا مَا ابتَلىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيهِ رِزقَهُ فَيَقولُ رَبّى أَهٰنَنِ
89.transliteration: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani
89.translation: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me
Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
And urge not on the feeding of the poor
And ye devour heritages with devouring greed
And love wealth with abounding love

89.arabic: كَلّا إِذا دُكَّتِ الأَرضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
89.transliteration: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan
89.translation: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding
And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank

89.arabic: وَجِا۟يءَ يَومَئِذٍ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَومَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ الإِنسٰنُ وَأَنّىٰ لَهُ الذِّكرىٰ
89.transliteration: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra
89.translation: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)
He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life
None punisheth as He will punish on that day
None bindeth as He then will bind
But ah! thou soul at peace
Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure
Enter thou among My bondmen
Enter thou My Garden

90.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ لا أُقسِمُ بِهٰذَا البَلَدِ
90.translation: Nay, I swear by this city
And thou art an indweller of this city
And the begetter and that which he begat
We verily have created man in an atmosphere

90.arabic: أَيَحسَبُ أَن لَن يَقدِرَ عَلَيهِ أَحَدٌ
90.transliteration: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun
90.translation: Thinketh he that none hath power over him
And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth
Thinketh he that none beholdeth him
Did We not assign unto him two eyes
And a tongue and two lips
And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways
But he hath not attempted the Ascent
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is
(It is) to free a slave

90.arabic: أَو إِطعٰمٌ فى يَومٍ ذى مَسغَبَةٍ
90.transliteration: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin
90.translation: And to feed in the day of hunger
An orphan near of kin
Or some poor wretch in misery

90.arabic: ثُمَّ كانَ مِنَ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَتَواصَوا بِالصَّبرِ وَتَواصَوا بِالمَرحَمَةِ
90.transliteration: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati
90.translation: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity
Their place will be on the right hand

90.arabic: وَالَّذينَ كَفَروا بِـٔايٰتِنا هُم أَصحٰبُ المَشـَٔمَةِ
90.transliteration: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati
90.translation: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand
Fire will be an awning over them

91.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالشَّمسِ وَضُحىٰها
91.translation: By the sun and his brightness
And the moon when she followeth him
And the day when it revealeth him
And the night when it enshroudeth him
And the heaven and Him Who built it
And the earth and Him Who spread it
And a soul and Him Who perfected it
And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it
He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow
And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it
(The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride
When the basest of them broke forth

91.arabic: فَقالَ لَهُم رَسولُ اللَّهِ ناقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقيٰها
91.transliteration: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqata Allahi wasuqyaha
91.translation: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink

91.arabic: فَكَذَّبوهُ فَعَقَروها فَدَمدَمَ عَلَيهِم رَبُّهُم بِذَنبِهِم فَسَوّىٰها
91.transliteration: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha
91.translation: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings)
He dreadeth not the sequel (of events)

92.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالَّيلِ إِذا يَغشىٰ
92.translation: By the night enshrouding
And the day resplendent
And Him Who hath created male and female
Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends)
As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
And believeth in goodness
Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease
But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent
And disbelieveth in goodness
Surely We will ease his way unto adversity

92.arabic: وَما يُغنى عَنهُ مالُهُ إِذا تَرَدّىٰ
92.transliteration: Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu itha taradda
92.translation: His riches will not save him when he perisheth
Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former
Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
Which only the most wretched must endure
He who denieth and turneth away
Far removed from it will be the righteous
Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness)

92.arabic: وَما لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُ مِن نِعمَةٍ تُجزىٰ
92.transliteration: Wama liahadin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujza
92.translation: And none hath with him any favour for reward
Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High
He verily will be content

93.translation: And by the night when it is stillest
Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee
And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former
And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content
Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)
Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)
Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)
Therefor the beggar drive not away
Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse

94.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ أَلَم نَشرَح لَكَ صَدرَكَ
94.translation: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate
And eased thee of the burden
But lo! with hardship goeth ease
So when thou art relieved, still toil
And strive to please thy Lord

95.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالتّينِ وَالزَّيتونِ
95.translation: By the fig and the olive
And by this land made safe

95.arabic: لَقَد خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ فى أَحسَنِ تَقويمٍ
95.transliteration: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin
95.translation: Surely We created man of the best stature
Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low

95.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُم أَجرٌ غَيرُ مَمنونٍ
95.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin
95.translation: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing
So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment
Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges

96.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ اقرَأ بِاسمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذى خَلَقَ
96.translation: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth
Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous
Teacheth man that which he knew not
Nay, but verily man is rebellious
Lo! unto thy Lord is the return
Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward
Is he then unaware that Allah seeth

96.arabic: كَلّا لَئِن لَم يَنتَهِ لَنَسفَعًا بِالنّاصِيَةِ
96.transliteration: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati
96.translation: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock
Then let him call upon his henchmen
We will call the guards of hell
Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah)

97.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِنّا أَنزَلنٰهُ فى لَيلَةِ القَدرِ
97.translation: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is

97.arabic: لَيلَةُ القَدرِ خَيرٌ مِن أَلفِ شَهرٍ
97.transliteration: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin
97.translation: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months

97.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ المَلٰئِكَةُ وَالرّوحُ فيها بِإِذنِ رَبِّهِم مِن كُلِّ أَمرٍ
97.transliteration: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin
97.translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees
(The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn

98.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ لَم يَكُنِ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن أَهلِ الكِتٰبِ وَالمُشرِكينَ مُنفَكّينَ حَتّىٰ تَأتِيَهُمُ البَيِّنَةُ
98.transliteration: Lam yakuni allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena munfakkeena hatta tatiyahumu albayyinatu
98.translation: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them

98.arabic: رَسولٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ يَتلوا صُحُفًا مُطَهَّرَةً
98.transliteration: Rasoolun mina Allahi yatloo suhufan mutahharatan
98.translation: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages

98.arabic: وَما تَفَرَّقَ الَّذينَ أوتُوا الكِتٰبَ إِلّا مِن بَعدِ ما جاءَتهُمُ البَيِّنَةُ
98.transliteration: Wama tafarraqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu
98.translation: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them

98.arabic: وَما أُمِروا إِلّا لِيَعبُدُوا اللَّهَ مُخلِصينَ لَهُ الدّينَ حُنَفاءَ وَيُقيمُوا الصَّلوٰةَ وَيُؤتُوا الزَّكوٰةَ وَذٰلِكَ دينُ القَيِّمَةِ
98.transliteration: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena hunafaa wayuqeemoo alssalata wayutoo alzzakata wathalika deenu alqayyimati
98.translation: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion

98.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن أَهلِ الكِتٰبِ وَالمُشرِكينَ فى نارِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدينَ فيها أُولٰئِكَ هُم شَرُّ البَرِيَّةِ
98.transliteration: Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideena feeha olaika hum sharru albariyyati
98.translation: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings

98.arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ أُولٰئِكَ هُم خَيرُ البَرِيَّةِ
98.transliteration: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika hum khayru albariyyati
98.translation: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings

98.arabic: جَزاؤُهُم عِندَ رَبِّهِم جَنّٰتُ عَدنٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها أَبَدًا رَضِىَ اللَّهُ عَنهُم وَرَضوا عَنهُ ذٰلِكَ لِمَن خَشِىَ رَبَّهُ
98.transliteration: Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbahu
98.translation: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord

99.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذا زُلزِلَتِ الأَرضُ زِلزالَها
99.translation: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
And Earth yieldeth up her burdens
And man saith: What aileth her
That day she will relate her chronicles

99.arabic: يَومَئِذٍ يَصدُرُ النّاسُ أَشتاتًا لِيُرَوا أَعمٰلَهُم
99.transliteration: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum
99.translation: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds

99.arabic: فَمَن يَعمَل مِثقالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيرًا يَرَهُ
99.transliteration: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu
99.translation: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then

99.arabic: وَمَن يَعمَل مِثقالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُ
99.transliteration: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu
99.translation: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then

100.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَالعٰدِيٰتِ ضَبحًا

100.translation: And scouring to the raid at dawn
Then, therewith, with their trail of dust
Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe)
Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
And lo! he is a witness unto that
And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent

100.arabic: أَفَلا يَعلَمُ إِذا بُعثِرَ ما فِى القُبورِ
100.transliteration: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori
100.translation: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
And the secrets of the breasts are made known
On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them

101.translation: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is
A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
And the mountains will become as carded wool
Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works)
He will live a pleasant life
But as for him whose scales are light
A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother
Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is

102.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ أَلهىٰكُمُ التَّكاثُرُ
102.translation: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
Until ye come to the graves
Nay, but ye will come to know
Nay, but ye will come to know
Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge
Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision
Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure

103.translation: Lo! man is a state of loss

103.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذينَ ءامَنوا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَتَواصَوا بِالحَقِّ وَتَواصَوا بِالصَّبرِ
103.transliteration: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati watawasaw bialhaqqi watawasaw bialssabri
103.translation: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance

104.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ وَيلٌ لِكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُمَزَةٍ

104.translation: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it
He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal
Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is
(It is) the fire of Allah, kindled
Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men)
Lo! it is closed in on them

105.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ أَلَم تَرَ كَيفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصحٰبِ الفيلِ
105.transliteration: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli
105.translation: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant
Did He not bring their stratagem to naught
And send against them swarms of flying creatures
Which pelted them with stones of baked clay
And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)

106.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ لِإيلٰفِ قُرَيشٍ

106.translation: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer
So let them worship the Lord of this House

106.arabic: الَّذى أَطعَمَهُم مِن جوعٍ وَءامَنَهُم مِن خَوفٍ
106.transliteration: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin
106.translation: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear

107.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ أَرَءَيتَ الَّذى يُكَذِّبُ بِالدّينِ
107.translation: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion
That is he who repelleth the orphan
And urgeth not the feeding of the needy
Who are heedless of their prayer

108.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِنّا أَعطَينٰكَ الكَوثَرَ
108.translation: Lo! We have given thee Abundance
So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice
Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity

109.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قُل يٰأَيُّهَا الكٰفِرونَ

109.translation: I worship not that which ye worship
Nor worship ye that which I worship
And I shall not worship that which ye worship
Nor will ye worship that which I worship
Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion

110.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ إِذا جاءَ نَصرُ اللَّهِ وَالفَتحُ
110.translation: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

110.arabic: وَرَأَيتَ النّاسَ يَدخُلونَ فى دينِ اللَّهِ أَفواجًا
110.transliteration: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan
110.translation: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops

110.arabic: فَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ وَاستَغفِرهُ إِنَّهُ كانَ تَوّابًا
110.transliteration: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban
110.translation: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy

111.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ تَبَّت يَدا أَبى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
111.translation: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish

111.arabic: ما أَغنىٰ عَنهُ مالُهُ وَما كَسَبَ
111.transliteration: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba
111.translation: His wealth and gains will not exempt him
He will be plunged in flaming Fire
Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre

112.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قُل هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
112.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One
Allah, the eternally Besought of all
He begetteth not nor was begotten
And there is none comparable unto Him

113.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قُل أَعوذُ بِرَبِّ الفَلَقِ
113.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
From the evil of that which He created
From the evil of the darkness when it is intense
And from the evil of malignant witchcraft
And from the evil of the envier when he envieth

114.arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قُل أَعوذُ بِرَبِّ النّاسِ
114.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
From the evil of the sneaking whisperer
Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind
Of the jinn and of mankind
